paper.title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
paper.abstract: We introduce Mobius-v0, an architecture that comprises a globally shared Memory (FFN) that stores knowledge vectors and multiple Reasoners (Self-Attn) that iteratively achieve compositional reasoning. Using hidden states as cache and carrier, reasoners repeatedly query memory for required knowledge-vectors, while the knowledge is transmitted back to reasoning operators. Through this knowledge-reasoning-separation architecture, Mobius achieves better knowledge compression and reasoning efficiency

summary.core_problem: 尝试把 Transformer 中混合在一起的知识存储和推理计算拆开，用共享 Memory 存知识、用多个 Reasoner 迭代组合推理，以提升知识压缩和推理效率。
summary.importance: 贡献是 LLM 架构范式创新。它不是单纯改 attention 或做推理加速，而是重新组织 FFN 与 self-attention 的角色分工：FFN 作为全局共享知识记忆，Self-Attn 模块作为可重复调用的推理算子。若结果成立，会影响大模型参数分配、层结构设计和 continual pretrain 的迁移方式。
summary.technical_approach: Mobius-v0 包含一个全局共享 Memory，即 FFN，用来存储 knowledge vectors；同时包含多个 Reasoners，即 Self-Attn，用 hidden states 作为缓存和信息载体，反复查询 Memory，并把检索到的知识向推理算子回传。Intern-S2-Mobius 在该结构上继续扩展：一方面从零训练 7B 模型验证数据效率，另一方面从 Qwen3.5-35B 做 continual pretraining，验证大模型迁移和端到端推理速度。
summary.experiments: 7B 从零训练模型在只使用 Transformer baseline 62.6% 训练数据的情况下，达到相近下游分数。Intern-S2-Mobius 从 Qwen3.5-35B 持续预训练后，在相近下游分数下实现接近 4 倍端到端推理加速。摘要未给出训练 token 数、benchmark 列表、具体分数或消融细节。
summary.authors_note: Intern 系列模型团队工作。Kai Chen 是 OpenMMLab / InternVL / InternLM 相关生态中的代表性研究者之一。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper separates knowledge storage from reasoning computation in Transformer-like models, using a shared Memory for knowledge and multiple Reasoners for iterative composition.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an architectural modeling proposal. Rather than merely optimizing attention or inference kernels, it reassigns the roles of FFNs and self-attention: FFNs act as globally shared knowledge memory, while self-attention blocks serve as reusable reasoning operators. If the claims hold, this changes how one might allocate parameters, design layers, and perform continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mobius-v0 contains a globally shared Memory, implemented as an FFN that stores knowledge vectors, and multiple Reasoners, implemented as self-attention modules. Hidden states serve as cache and carrier; reasoners repeatedly query memory and receive knowledge vectors back for compositional reasoning. Intern-S2-Mobius scales this design by training a 7B model from scratch and by continually pretraining from Qwen3.5-35B to test transfer and end-to-end speed.
summary_en.experiments: The 7B model trained from scratch reaches downstream performance comparable to a 7B Transformer baseline using 62.6% of the baseline training data. Intern-S2-Mobius, continually pretrained from Qwen3.5-35B, reportedly matches downstream performance while delivering nearly 4x end-to-end inference speedup. The abstract does not provide token counts, benchmark names, exact scores, or ablation details.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from the Intern model ecosystem. Kai Chen is a prominent researcher associated with OpenMMLab, InternVL, and InternLM-related work.

recommendation.zh: 这篇应优先复现消融：若 62.6% data 和 4x speed 成立，会改变 FFN 作为知识层的设计先验。
recommendation.en: Prioritize reproducing the ablations: if the 62.6% data and 4x speed claims hold, FFN-as-knowledge design priors need updating.

paper.title: QUASAR: Lowering the Loss Floor of Quantization-Aware Training with Loss-Aware Reconstruction
paper.abstract: As large language model inference shifts toward lower precision, post-training quantization (PTQ) becomes increasingly brittle, making quantization-aware training (QAT) essential for preserving model quality. However, QAT computes the loss and surrogate gradients using a lossy reconstruction of latent full-precision weights, while applying updates to the latent weights themselves. This mismatch can lead to suboptimal training trajectories and a higher loss floor. Second-order PTQ methods mitigat

summary.core_problem: QUASAR 解决的是 QAT 中一个比较核心但常被简化处理的优化错配：前向和损失是在量化再反量化后的权重 r 上计算，优化器实际更新的是潜在全精度权重 w。STE 把对 r 的梯度近似当作对 w 的梯度，但这个方向通常不是 latent weight 的理想下降方向，因此 QAT 会比全精度训练收敛到更高的 loss floor。
summary.importance: 这项工作对基座模型研究的启发主要在低精度训练和训练-部署一致性。它不是简单改一个量化格式，而是把 QAT 的误差来源写成 loss-aware reconstruction error，并把 PTQ 中的二阶重构思想搬进训练循环。贡献量级偏方法型：对 native low-precision LLM、持续预训练后的低精度适配、以及推理精度越来越低时的训练 recipe 都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: QUASAR 将重构拆成两步。第一步是 quantization，把全精度权重映射到离散 code，并把 clipping range 当作可搜索变量；第二步是 dequantization，把 code 映射回重构权重，学习 scale，非对称量化时还可学习 offset。关键点在于重构目标不是普通 L2 误差，而是用 Hessian 加权的 loss-aware reconstruction error。为了避免每步做昂贵二阶优化，QUASAR 用平方梯度的指数滑动平均近似 Hessian 对角项，得到每个参数的 saliency。随后在一小组候选 clipping range 上搜索；每个 clipping range 决定一组离散 code，再用 saliency-weighted least squares 闭式求解 dequantization 参数，最后选择重构误差最小的候选。理论部分将 QAT 收敛界分成初始化项、minibatch noise 项和 loss-aware reconstruction error 项，其中只有最后一项由重构映射控制，正好对应 QUASAR 的优化目标；在额外 PL 条件下，这个误差也影响最终量化模型的 loss。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 bit width 和模型族，主要指标是训练 loss 与 evaluation loss。对 Qwen3-4B-Thinking 做 quantization-aware distillation 时，QUASAR 在所有测试 bit width 上都低于 Standard QAT、LSQ、Denoising QAT 和 BitDistiller。文中报告 INT4 和 INT3 下 evaluation loss 至少降低 10%，INT2 下至少降低 29%。在 NVFP4 设置下，相比 Standard QAT evaluation loss 约降低 30%。这些结果说明收益主要来自更好的训练轨迹，而不是只在训练结束时做一次静态重构。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 QAT structural mismatch 和 loss-floor gap 的定义，这决定了整篇工作的动机。然后看方法部分的 clipping range 搜索、saliency-weighted least squares 闭式解，以及 Hessian 对角近似如何进入训练循环。理论部分重点看收敛界的三项分解，不必逐行推导，但要确认 reconstruction error 为什么是可控项。实验部分优先看 INT4/INT3/INT2、NVFP4，以及与 LSQ、Denoising QAT、BitDistiller 的对比和消融。

summary_en.core_problem: QUASAR targets a structural optimization mismatch in QAT. The forward pass and loss are computed with quantized-dequantized weights r, while the optimizer updates latent full-precision weights w. Because the straight-through estimator uses gradients with respect to r as a surrogate for gradients with respect to w, QAT can follow a suboptimal trajectory and converge to a higher loss floor than full-precision training.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is native low-precision training and the interface between training and deployment. The work reframes QAT as a continual loss-aware reconstruction problem rather than a fixed quantization conversion problem. This is useful for LLM settings where FP4, INT4, or lower-precision serving is expected, and where PTQ becomes brittle for reasoning, agentic, or long-context models.
summary_en.technical_approach: QUASAR separates reconstruction into quantization and dequantization. Quantization maps full-precision weights to discrete codes while treating the clipping range as a searchable variable. Dequantization maps those codes back to reconstructed weights using learned scales, and optionally offsets for asymmetric quantization. The reconstruction objective is not plain L2 error; it is a Hessian-weighted, loss-aware reconstruction error inspired by second-order PTQ. To make this usable inside QAT, QUASAR approximates the Hessian diagonal with an exponential moving average of squared gradients, giving per-parameter saliency scores. For a small set of candidate clipping ranges, it fixes the discrete code assignment, solves the dequantization parameters in closed form by saliency-weighted least squares, and chooses the candidate with the smallest loss-aware reconstruction error. The analysis decomposes the QAT convergence bound into initialization, minibatch noise, and reconstruction error; only the last term is directly controlled by the reconstruction map.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show lower training and evaluation loss across bit widths and model families. In quantization-aware distillation of Qwen3-4B-Thinking, QUASAR outperforms Standard QAT, LSQ, Denoising QAT, and BitDistiller at every tested bit width. The evaluation loss reduction is at least 10% for INT4 and INT3, at least 29% for INT2, and about 30% for NVFP4 relative to Standard QAT. The gains are consistent with the proposed mechanism: improving the reconstruction during training changes the optimization trajectory, rather than only repairing a frozen model at the end.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25 minutes. Read the motivation around QAT structural mismatch and the loss-floor gap first. Then focus on the reconstruction algorithm: candidate clipping ranges, saliency-weighted least squares, and the EMA squared-gradient Hessian approximation. The convergence analysis is worth reading for the decomposition, not necessarily for every proof detail. In the experiments, prioritize the low-bit comparisons against LSQ, Denoising QAT, BitDistiller, and Standard QAT, especially the INT2 and NVFP4 settings.

recommendation.zh: 不是新范式，但问题抓得准：QAT 的 surrogate mismatch 常被忽略；先看方法图和 ablation，若你做 4-bit 训练应尽快复现。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it targets a real blind spot in QAT: surrogate mismatch; read the method figure and ablations first, and reproduce if you train 4-bit models.

paper.title: QuaSAR: Quantization Compensation via Stable Activation-Aware Rank Truncation
paper.abstract: Recent training-free post-training quantization methods restore model accuracy through closed-form residual compensation. To constrain additional model storage overhead, several existing methods gate layer selection by goodness-of-fit, retaining only those layers whose compensation yields a positive residual fit score and discarding the rest. In this paper, we show that, under the low-bit W4A4 setting, this gating mechanism fails to distinguish poorly predictable quantization error from numerica

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 W4A4 训练后量化里一个被长期低估的问题：闭式残差补偿在一些层上不是“效果差”，而是数值上已经塌掉了。已有方法通常把补偿写成对量化误差的线性回归，再通过激活协方差矩阵的逆或伪逆求解补偿参数；一旦输入激活存在强冗余、近低秩，尤其再叠加激活量化噪声后，求解会沿着塌陷方向爆炸，得到巨大参数范数和负的 R²。更糟的是，现有基于 R² 的门控会把这些层判成“不值得补偿”，于是恰恰丢掉了最有价值的补偿层。作者把问题从“病态矩阵需要正则化”进一步收紧为“真正触发失败的是秩亏方向上的数值塌陷”，这是全文最关键的诊断。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，这不是训练方法论文，但它对大模型部署和量化研究有两个直接启发。第一，闭式补偿类 PTQ 方法的上限，不只取决于回归形式，还取决于你是否正确识别并保留了可补偿子空间；很多过去被当成‘这层补不了’的现象，其实是求解器坏了。第二，视觉 Transformer 的 W4A4 比 LLM 常见的 weight-only 更容易把这个问题放大出来，因为激活也被压到 4 bit，误差更大、输入结构更脆弱。论文因此把“数值稳定性”从实现细节提升成了方法设计的一部分。若把视角放宽到 LLM，凡是依赖 Hessian / activation covariance 逆的 PTQ、低秩补偿、二阶近似方法，都可以借这篇的诊断重新检查失败层到底是不可补，还是被错误筛掉了。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是更细粒度的 layer-wise compensation。作者不再像一些先前方法那样按 block 共享一个补偿器，而是给 Transformer block 内四个线性层分别挂独立补偿分支。补偿目标是拟合该层在真实部署输入分布下的量化误差，因此求解顺序也不是一次性离线完成，而是逐层顺序补偿：补完上一层后立刻把补偿后的层放回模型，再采集下一层的真实输入，避免训练时输入和部署时输入不一致。第二层是数值稳定求解，也是论文的核心。作者没有继续在原闭式解上做 damping 或 ridge，而是直接对激活矩阵对应的伪逆做截断，只去掉已经塌陷的奇异方向，保留其余可补偿子空间。这个 truncated pseudoinverse 是无额外超参或近乎参数自由的稳定化方案，目标不是缩小所有方向，而是只切掉那些会把解推向爆炸的方向。论文强调这和常规正则化不同：正则化会整体收缩，可能连有用方向一起伤到；截断伪逆则更像在做子空间清洗。第三层是部署压缩。补偿矩阵再做低秩分解，并对补偿参数继续量化，形成双轴压缩，在精度和额外存储之间找中间点。作者还专门研究了预算分配：不是按细粒度位置或层重要性去精打细算，而是按全局规模控制总 rank 更有效，因为‘重要层’并不等于‘对高 rank 更敏感的层’。
summary.experiments: 结果里最有信息量的是几个反直觉点。1）在 ViT-B 的 W4A4 设置下，作者指出一个被旧门控最自信丢弃的层 b0.fc2，拟合时出现 R² = -68.6、补偿参数范数 6.2×10^7，看起来像完全不可用；但它其实是全模型最有价值的补偿层，去掉它会损失 1.05% top-1，超过任何其他单层。这个例子很直接地证明了“负 R² 不是低价值，而是数值塌陷报警”。2）方法在不额外训练的前提下，把 ViT-B/W4A4 做到 81.42% top-1，超过此前 training-free 方法，文中还称超过了基于微调的 QwT*。3）若进一步做低秩分解和补偿量化，得到一个更可部署的点：80.26% top-1，模型大小 54.7MB，精度和体积都落在 QwT 与 QwT-v2 之间，填上了此前“要么精度高但太重，要么很轻但补偿弱”的空档。4）独立层补偿相对 block-wise 补偿带来 +3.1% 的准确率增益，说明误差结构在 block 内并不适合共享一个补偿器。5）预算分配实验也很有意思：把‘高 rank 给重要层’的分配完全反过来，准确率只变 0.02%，说明层重要性和 rank 敏感性几乎解耦，这对后续做自动预算分配很重要。全文还强调这一失败机制同时出现在 CNN 和 Transformer 上，不是单一架构偶然现象。
summary.reading_guide: 如果只花一小时，先看引言里关于负 R² 和被误删层的案例，再看方法部分对“rank deficiency 而非一般 ill-conditioning” 的区分，这是理解全文的钥匙。随后重点看三处：1）顺序式 layer-wise compensation 的求解流程，弄清为什么必须在每层补完后重新采样下游输入；2）截断伪逆的构造方式，以及它和 ridge / dampening 的差别，尤其是它保留可补偿子空间、只删除塌陷方向这一点；3）预算分配实验，作者为什么得出‘全局 rank 预算比细粒度分配更重要’。实验部分建议优先看 ViT-B/W4A4 主表、单层移除分析、block-wise vs layer-wise 消融、以及压缩后的精度-体积折中表。若想深挖，可以继续追两个问题：一是截断阈值是否真的跨模型稳定，二是这套诊断能否迁移到 LLM 的 weight-only / W8A8 PTQ 补偿里，尤其是 GPTQ、QERA、CALDERA 这类依赖二阶或协方差结构的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in training-free W4A4 post-training quantization that is usually misread as “this layer is not worth compensating.” Closed-form residual compensation fits quantization error as a linear function of layer input and solves it through an inverse or pseudoinverse of the activation covariance. When activations are highly redundant or effectively low-rank, and activation quantization further perturbs them, the solver can collapse along degenerate directions. The result is exploding compensation norms, negative R² even on the fitted data, and a gate that incorrectly discards exactly the layers that would have contributed the most. The key diagnosis is sharper than the usual “ill-conditioned matrix” story: the real trigger is rank deficiency and numerical collapse in specific subspaces, not generic conditioning alone.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model deployment and for how we interpret PTQ failures. First, it shows that the ceiling of closed-form compensation methods depends as much on identifying the compensable subspace as on the regression form itself. Some layers previously treated as inherently uncompensable may simply have been filtered out by a broken solver. Second, the issue is amplified in W4A4, especially for vision Transformers, because activation quantization makes the regression target noisier and the input geometry more fragile than in weight-only settings common in LLM quantization. The broader lesson extends to LLM PTQ methods that rely on Hessian or activation-covariance inverses: before concluding that a layer cannot be repaired, one should check whether the optimization collapsed numerically rather than semantically.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three main parts. First, compensation is moved from block level to individual linear layers. Instead of sharing one compensator across a Transformer block, the paper attaches separate compensators to each of the four linear layers. This matters because quantization error structure differs substantially across layers. The fitting is also sequential rather than one-shot: after compensating one layer, the compensated layer is inserted back into the model, and the next layer is solved using the true downstream input distribution under upstream quantization and compensation. This avoids train-deploy mismatch. Second, the core contribution is a numerically stable solver based on a truncated pseudoinverse. Rather than adding damping or ridge regularization to all directions, the method removes only the collapsed singular directions and preserves the remaining compensable subspace. That is the conceptual difference from prior stabilizers: they shrink everything; QuaSAR tries to delete only the directions that make the solution explode. Third, the compensation itself is compressed for deployment through low-rank factorization and compensation quantization, giving a practical accuracy-size tradeoff. The paper also studies budget allocation and argues that global rank budgeting is more meaningful than fine-grained per-layer allocation, because layer importance does not reliably predict rank sensitivity.
summary_en.experiments: Several results are especially informative. On ViT-B under W4A4, the paper highlights layer b0.fc2 as a canonical failure case: prior gating reports R² = -68.6 and a compensation norm of 6.2×10^7, so the layer is confidently discarded. Yet it is actually the single most valuable compensator in the model; removing it costs 1.05% top-1 accuracy, more than any other layer. This directly validates the paper’s claim that negative R² can be a sign of numerical collapse rather than low utility. In the main result, the method reaches 81.42% top-1 on ViT-B/W4A4 without additional training, outperforming prior training-free methods and, according to the paper, even a fine-tuning-based QwT variant. With low-rank decomposition and compensation quantization, it obtains a more deployable point at 80.26% top-1 and 54.7 MB, filling the gap between the heavier but stronger QwT and the lighter but weaker QwT-v2. The layer-wise design gives a +3.1% gain over block-wise compensation. Another notable ablation is rank allocation: reversing a “high-rank to important layers” policy changes accuracy by only 0.02%, suggesting that layer importance and rank sensitivity are largely decoupled. The paper also reports that the same failure mechanism appears in both CNNs and Transformers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction example around negative R² and the wrongly discarded layer; it gives the clearest intuition for why the paper exists. Then read the method section with one question in mind: why is rank deficiency, not generic ill-conditioning, the decisive failure mode? After that, focus on three pieces. First, the sequential layer-wise fitting procedure and why downstream inputs must be recollected after each compensation step. Second, the truncated pseudoinverse construction and how it differs from ridge or damped inverses. Third, the budget-allocation study, which is easy to overlook but carries a useful systems-level message for deployable compensation. In the experiments, prioritize the main ViT-B/W4A4 table, the single-layer removal analysis, the block-wise vs layer-wise ablation, and the accuracy-size tradeoff after compression. If reading more deeply, two follow-up questions are worth testing mentally: whether the truncation rule is stable across architectures, and whether the same diagnosis can improve LLM PTQ methods such as GPTQ, QERA, or CALDERA in weight-only or mixed-precision settings.

recommendation.zh: 建议看数值病态分析而不是只看指标；W4A4 失败常被归因于量化噪声，这篇把锅拆到 solver 稳定性。
recommendation.en: Read the numerical-pathology argument, not just the metrics; it shifts part of W4A4 failure from quantization noise to solver instability.

paper.title: Thought-Aware KV Cache Compaction for Reasoning via Adaptive Attention Matching
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models generate lengthy chain-of-thought (CoT) sequences whose key-value (KV) cache grows linearly and becomes a memory bottleneck during decoding. Existing compaction methods treat reasoning trajectories as flat token sequences and apply uniform compression, ignoring the hierarchical structure of CoT reasoning where different steps vary drastically in importance. We propose \textbf{Thought-Aware Attention Matching (TAM)}, which exploits this structure through three mechanisms

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是推理模型长 CoT 解码时的 KV cache 内存瓶颈。现有压缩方法通常把生成轨迹当作平坦 token 序列处理，统一分配压缩预算；作者认为 CoT 有步骤结构，不同 reasoning block 对未来生成的重要性差异很大，因此压缩预算也应按结构和重要性分配。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更偏推理效率和 serving，但对预训练研究也有间接启发。长推理能力如果依赖大量中间 token，训练和部署都会遇到 memory-time tradeoff。TAM 的结论说明，推理轨迹中的 token 并不等价；问题定义、中间结论和关键计算锚点比探索性或废弃路径更应保留。这对后续研究有两个影响：一是可以把 reasoning trace 看成可压缩的分层状态，而不是必须完整保留的文本；二是训练阶段可能需要让模型生成更可分段、更可压缩的推理轨迹。
summary.technical_approach: TAM 建在 Attention Matching 之上。Attention Matching 的目标不是简单丢 token，而是构造更短的 compact KV，使其在参考 query 上同时匹配局部 attention output 和 attention mass。TAM 加了三个结构化机制。第一，thought segmentation，把已经生成的推理轨迹切成若干 reasoning blocks。第二，adaptive budget allocation，根据每个 block 的重要性权重和长度分配 compact token 数，理论上给出 t_i ∝ sqrt(w_i n_i) 的分配规则；这比统一压缩更适合误差随预算递减的场景。第三，pivotal token protection，保留高 attention 的关键 token，避免被压缩过程抹掉。参考 query 来自最近 selector window，使方法适合 mid-trajectory compaction，而不是只在 prefill 阶段处理静态上下文。底层拟合仍使用 AM 的闭式或轻量求解流程，包括 attention mass 的非负最小二乘和 value 的普通最小二乘。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B，在 AIME 2024 和 MATH-500 上评估长推理场景下的压缩效果。作者报告 TAM 在相同 memory budget 下相比 uniform compaction 有更稳定的准确率收益；周期性 compaction 最高可降低约 65% peak memory。消融设计围绕三个部件展开：分段、按重要性分配预算、保护 pivotal tokens。核心结果是，单纯 uniform compression 在高压缩率下更容易损失关键 reasoning anchor，而 TAM 通过把预算集中在高权重 block 和关键 token 上，能在较低 KV 内存下保留更多解题性能。文中还给出理论支撑：预算分配规则在凸误差模型下最优，保护 pivotal token 可降低近似误差，连续多次压缩的累计误差有界。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 AM、RPC 和 TAM 三者差异的定位：compaction primitive、query source、structure-aware budget allocation。然后看 Preliminaries 里 attention mass matching 的分解，这是理解为什么 AM 不等于 token eviction 的关键。方法部分重点读 segmentation、importance score、t_i ∝ sqrt(w_i n_i) 分配规则，以及 pivotal token 的定义。实验部分主要看不同压缩率下的 accuracy-memory 曲线和 ablation。若只关心 serving，可重点看 peak-memory reduction 和 compaction 周期；若关心预训练或推理建模，可重点看推理轨迹的分层结构假设。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache growth during long chain-of-thought decoding. Existing cache compaction methods usually treat the generated reasoning trace as a flat token sequence and apply a uniform compression policy. TAM argues that reasoning traces have block structure, and that different blocks should receive different cache budgets because their relevance to future generation varies substantially.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about inference efficiency, but it has useful implications for reasoning-model training. Long reasoning is not only a capability problem; it also creates a memory and bandwidth problem. TAM shows that generated reasoning tokens are not equally useful: problem statements, intermediate results, and conclusion anchors deserve more preservation than abandoned explorations. This supports a view of reasoning traces as compressible hierarchical state, which may influence how models are trained to produce structured, reusable, and cache-friendly reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: TAM extends Attention Matching rather than relying on simple token eviction. Attention Matching constructs a shorter set of compact keys and values that match both local attention outputs and attention mass under a set of reference queries. TAM adds three mechanisms. First, it segments the generated trajectory into thought blocks. Second, it allocates the compression budget adaptively using each block’s importance and length, with an allocation rule of the form t_i proportional to sqrt(w_i n_i). Third, it protects pivotal tokens, identified as high-attention anchors, so that important reasoning states are not removed by the compaction step. Reference queries are drawn from a recent selector window, making the method suitable for mid-trajectory compaction during decoding. The underlying fitting still follows the AM pipeline, including nonnegative least squares for attention-mass matching and ordinary least squares for value fitting.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen3-4B on AIME 2024 and MATH-500. TAM improves accuracy over uniform compaction at the same memory budget, and periodic compaction reduces peak memory by up to about 65%. The ablations are organized around the three main components: thought segmentation, adaptive budget allocation, and pivotal-token protection. The reported pattern is consistent with the method’s premise: uniform compression loses important reasoning anchors at high compression ratios, while TAM spends more budget on high-importance blocks and preserves key tokens. The paper also provides theoretical support: the allocation rule is optimal under a convex error model, pivotal-token protection reduces approximation error, and sequential compaction has bounded cumulative error.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the introduction’s comparison among Attention Matching, Reasoning Path Compression, and TAM, especially the distinction between the compaction primitive, the query source, and structure-aware budget allocation. Then read the preliminaries on attention-mass decomposition, since this explains why AM-style compaction differs from eviction. In the method section, focus on thought segmentation, the importance score, the sqrt(w_i n_i) budget rule, and pivotal-token protection. In the experiments, prioritize the accuracy-memory curves and the ablations. For serving work, the peak-memory and compaction-period results are the main pieces; for reasoning-model research, the more interesting part is the assumption that CoT traces form a compressible hierarchy.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“CoT 不是均匀 token 流”讲成了可操作的 cache 策略；先看方法图和误差界，再核对 memory budget 是否算干净。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it operationalizes the idea that CoT is not a uniform token stream; read the method figure and error-bound section first, then verify whether the memory-budget accounting is actually clean.

paper.title: TEMPO: Makespan-Aware Expert-Parallel Load Balancing Across Memory- and Compute-Bound Regimes
paper.abstract: In expert-parallel (EP) MoE serving, every layer synchronizes at the slowest GPU. Dispatchers balance token counts (EPLB, LPLB, UltraEP) or activated-expert counts (METRO), assuming expert time is linear in one. Measurements on two datacenter GPU generations show it is neither: below $\nstar\!\approx\!156$--$168$ tokens, HBM weight streaming dominates---cost attaches to \emph{activated replicas}, not tokens; above it, grouped GEMM rounds tokens to 128-tile $M$-tiles, so \emph{splitting} an exper

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MoE 推理里 expert-parallel dispatch 的目标函数错配问题。现有做法通常用 token 数或 activated expert 数做代理，默认单个 GPU 的 expert 计算时间分别近似线性依赖于 token 数或 expert 数。但作者直接测量后发现，真实时延由两类硬件效应共同决定：一是小 token 区间里权重从 HBM 流入带来的固定开销，二是 grouped GEMM 的 tile padding 让 token 成本呈台阶状而不是线性。由于 EP 每层在 all-to-all 前后都要同步，真正决定吞吐的是最慢 GPU 的 makespan，而不是平均负载。问题的难点不在单一 regime，而在真实 decode batch 中 memory-bound 的冷 expert 与 compute-bound 的热 expert 同时存在，导致任何单一 proxy 都会系统性失真。
summary.importance: 对大模型基座研究的意义主要在两点。第一，它把 MoE serving 中常被工程经验处理的 dispatch 问题，明确改写成一个由 kernel 级测量驱动的 makespan 优化问题，说明 proxy-based balancing 为什么会在现代 GPU 上失效。第二，它给出一个很清楚的信号：MoE 的系统优化不能只看 token-level load，也不能只看 activation count，训练侧若继续追求更强路由稀疏性、更大 expert、更高复制率，推理侧的最优 dispatch 目标会越来越依赖硬件 cost model。这对 pretrain 研究也有启发，因为 MoE 架构设计、capacity factor、expert size、replication 策略，都会通过 serving kernel 的 regime 切换反过来影响可部署性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是 cost model。作者对部署 kernel 做黑盒标定，用很短时间测出每个 expert 在不同 token 数下的执行时间，并用一个两段式模型拟合：小 token 区间由每次激活 replica 的固定成本主导，大 token 区间再叠加近似线性的 compute 成本；同时再显式加入 grouped GEMM 的 M-tile padding，解释为什么把一个 expert 的 token 切碎到多个 replica 上会凭空制造额外计算。这个模型里，b 对应每多实例化一个 replica 的权重流式加载成本，另一个参数刻画 padding 台阶。第二层是问题形式化。给定 batch 内各 expert 的路由 token、各 replica 的 placement，目标是最小化所有 GPU 上 modeled time 的最大值。作者证明这个 fixed-charge makespan dispatch 问题在很小规模下就已 NP-hard，但在 b→0 或 padding 消失等退化情形会退回已有 token LP 或 activation balancing，这个分析把旧方法放到了统一框架里。第三层是算法 tempo_fast。它不是求全局最优，而是围绕 cost model 做多阶段近似：先做 cost-aware seeding 初始化，再用 augmenting-chain 做 activation rebalancing，优先处理 flat regime 下多开 replica 的固定成本；然后在 bottleneck GPU 周围做 local search 和 partial migration，处理 linear regime 下热 expert 的 token 搬移；最后把 token-LP 解和 round-robin 证书一起放到同一 cost model 下打分，做一个小型 ensemble 选最优。这个设计的关键不是某个单独技巧，而是每一步都对应一个明确的硬件机制，而不是继续优化代理指标。
summary.experiments: 实验最有价值的是测量和误差分析。作者在两代数据中心 GPU 上测得单 expert FFN 时间在大约 n*=156–168 tokens 之前基本平坦，之后才进入近似线性区间。拟合得到的 activation floor b 从 1.74 微秒到 14.8 微秒，随 expert shape 变化可达 8.5 倍，说明 expert 大小会显著改变 dispatch 的最优策略。模型拟合误差均值在 4–8% 左右，说明这个黑盒 cost model 足够用于在线决策。真实 trace 上，92–100% 的 decode batch 同时包含两种 regime：少数热 expert 承载约 91% token，很多冷 expert 却仍停留在 flat regime。只改 split、不改 batch 和 placement 时，现有 proxy policy 产生的 modeled block time 可相差 1.2–1.6 倍，p95 达 1.7 倍；每种 proxy 在自己不擅长的 regime 会多付 30–70% 成本。算法层面，tempo_fast 相对最优或强基线的 gap 被压到约 1.02% 量级，说明它在复杂目标下已接近最优。更重要的是，作者给出 phase diagram，展示不同 b、padding 强度、负载形态下最优 dispatch policy 会发生边界翻转，因此不存在一个固定 proxy 能在所有区间都稳定最好。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三处。第一看引言和第 2 节的测量图，尤其是 per-expert latency 对 token 数的曲线，以及 grouped GEMM padding 的解释；这是全文最关键的经验事实。第二看第 3 节的问题建模和 phase diagram，理解为什么 token balancing 与 activation balancing 其实分别对应两个退化极限，而真实部署落在中间混合区。第三看第 4 节 tempo_fast 的三个步骤，重点不是实现细节，而是每一步在修正哪一种 proxy 误差。若时间有限，优先看 Fig.1、Fig.2、Fig.5、phase diagram 相关图，以及 Table 6 的拟合参数与误差。预计 25–35 分钟能把核心思想读明白；若要判断是否能迁移到训练侧或 serving 系统，需要再细看附录里的 kernel 假设、复杂度和 trace 设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a mismatch between what EP MoE dispatchers optimize and what actually determines latency. Existing dispatch policies balance token counts or activated-expert counts, implicitly assuming expert time is linear in one of them. The full paper shows this assumption breaks on real GPUs for two hardware reasons: a per-replica memory-bound weight-streaming cost dominates at low token counts, and grouped GEMM introduces tile-padding overhead so token cost is staircase-like rather than linear. Since each MoE layer synchronizes at all-to-all boundaries, the relevant objective is the per-batch makespan of the slowest GPU, not average load. The hard case is not one regime or the other, but mixed batches where hot experts are compute-bound while many cold experts remain memory-bound.
summary_en.importance: The contribution matters because it reframes MoE serving dispatch from proxy balancing into measured cost-model optimization. That is useful beyond serving engineering. It clarifies why larger experts, higher replication, and sparse routing can create deployment bottlenecks that are invisible if one only tracks token load. For pretraining-oriented readers, the paper is a reminder that MoE architectural choices feed directly into serving-time dispatch geometry. Expert size, routing skew, capacity settings, and replica placement all interact with kernel-level cost regimes, so system-aware MoE design should not stop at FLOPs or training throughput.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three parts. First, the authors build a black-box calibrated cost model for the deployed expert kernel. Per-expert latency is modeled with a two-regime structure: a fixed activation floor for instantiating an expert replica, plus a token-dependent term that becomes relevant beyond an inflection point. They also explicitly model grouped-GEMM M-tile padding, which explains why splitting one expert across multiple replicas can create extra work instead of merely redistributing it. Second, they formulate per-batch dispatch as a fixed-charge makespan minimization problem over routed tokens and replica placements. The paper proves the problem is already NP-hard in a small setting, while showing that prior token-balancing and activation-balancing methods emerge as degenerate limits when certain terms vanish. This is a clean unification of earlier heuristics. Third, they propose tempo_fast, a practical near-optimal solver. It uses cost-aware seeding, augmenting-chain activation rebalancing for the flat regime, bottleneck-focused local search with partial migrations for the linear regime, and an ensemble that scores candidate solutions such as token-LP and round-robin under the same calibrated model. The strength of the algorithm is that each move is tied to a measured hardware effect rather than a surrogate objective.
summary_en.experiments: The most informative results are the measurement studies. On two generations of datacenter GPUs, expert FFN latency stays nearly flat up to about 156–168 tokens per expert, then transitions to a more linear region. The fitted activation floor b ranges from 1.74 microseconds to 14.8 microseconds depending on expert shape, an 8.5x spread, with mean fit error around 4–8%. In real decode traces, 92–100% of batches contain both regimes simultaneously: a few hot experts carry roughly 91% of tokens, while many activated experts still sit in the flat regime. Holding the batch and placement fixed and varying only the split, deployed proxy policies differ by 1.2–1.6x in modeled MoE block time, with p95 reaching 1.7x; each proxy pays a 30–70% penalty away from its preferred regime. On the optimization side, tempo_fast gets within about 1.02% of optimal or near-optimal references, which is strong given the combinatorial objective. The phase-diagram analysis is also useful: the winning policy flips along predictable boundaries, so no fixed proxy is robust across operating conditions.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim-level read, start with the measurement section and the figures showing latency versus tokens per expert. Those plots carry the main empirical claim. Then read the formalization section to see how prior dispatchers appear as special cases of the full objective. After that, inspect the tempo_fast section with one question in mind: which hardware pathology is each step correcting? If time is limited, prioritize the latency curves, the mixed-regime trace analysis, the phase diagram, and the table reporting fitted parameters and model error. About 30 minutes is enough to extract the main idea. Read the appendix only if you need the exact kernel assumptions or want to judge transferability to another MoE stack.

recommendation.zh: 实测MoE EP服务的双regime时延特性非常扎实，直接推翻了“专家时延与token数线性”的默认假设，做MoE训练与推理系统的人必须看§3的测量方法与Fig 2。
recommendation.en: The empirical characterization of dual-regime latency in MoE EP serving is rigorous and directly invalidates the default linear token-count assumption; MoE training and inference system researchers must read §3 measurement methodology and Fig 2.

paper.title: CoverPrune: Coverage-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Optimal Transport
paper.abstract: While 3D Vision-Language Models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable spatial reasoning capabilities, they suffer from massive visual token counts that create severe computational bottlenecks during inference. Existing token pruning methods primarily rely on diversity-based selection, discarding similar tokens to maximize dispersion. However, in 3D environments, this approach frequently drops representative prototype tokens in favor of outliers, breaking the multi-view consistencies and geometr

summary.core_problem: 3D VLM 推理时视觉 token 数量过大，现有基于多样性的 token pruning 容易保留离群点、丢掉代表性几何证据，影响空间推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它把 3D VLM 的 token 裁剪从“选得更分散”改成“覆盖视觉证据”，对多视角/3D 输入的 token 压缩有一定方法参考，但问题域较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoverPrune，一个 training-free 的推理期 pruning 框架，将 token 子集选择表述为 Optimal Transport 问题。方法设计 Feature-Spatial-Temporal transport cost 和 target capacity，用特征、空间、时间信息共同衡量候选 token 对原始视觉证据的覆盖能力，并用近似求解避免组合优化不可 tractable。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、压缩率和性能数字。实验应主要围绕 3D VLM 空间推理任务，对比 diversity-based pruning，评估 token 削减后的准确率、几何一致性和推理成本。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学深圳国际研究生院和 LIGHTSPEED。

summary_en.core_problem: 3D VLMs carry very large visual-token budgets at inference time, and diversity-based pruning can keep outliers while dropping representative geometric evidence needed for spatial reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. Its useful idea is to frame 3D token pruning as evidence coverage rather than dispersion, though the setting is narrower than general LLM or VLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoverPrune is a training-free pruning framework that formulates subset selection as an Optimal Transport problem. It introduces a Feature-Spatial-Temporal transport cost and target capacity so selected tokens cover the original evidence in feature, spatial, and temporal dimensions, with an approximate solver for the otherwise combinatorial objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, pruning ratios, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation compares against diversity-driven pruning on 3D VLM spatial reasoning tasks, measuring accuracy, geometric consistency, and inference cost after token reduction.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School and LIGHTSPEED.

recommendation.zh: 只看 pruning objective 即可；coverage 比 diversity 更适合 3D token，但离通用 VLM pretrain 还有距离。
recommendation.en: Skim the pruning objective only; coverage is a cleaner prior than diversity for 3D tokens, but it is not a general VLM pretraining result.

paper.title: Context-Matched Distillation: Teacher Causality for Autoregressive Video Distillation
paper.abstract: Interactive autoregressive video generation demands both low-latency rollouts and precise online control. Few-step distillation accelerates generation by reducing denoising steps, while online control imposes a causal constraint: frames and blocks should depend on history and controls available during generation. Existing video distribution matching distillation (DMD) pipelines, however, often supervise causal few-step students using bidirectional teachers that score complete clips. The score fo

summary.core_problem: 为交互式自回归视频生成做少步蒸馏时，解决 teacher 监督使用未来帧和未来控制信号导致的因果不匹配问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理加速和蒸馏方法改进。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但指出了 AR 生成模型蒸馏中的一个干净问题：teacher 的信息集合必须和 student 生成目标时可见的信息集合一致。这个原则对自回归多模态生成和在线控制模型有一定迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Context-Matched Distillation。现有 video DMD 流程通常用 bidirectional full-clip teacher 给 causal few-step student 打分，teacher 的 score 可能依赖未来帧和未来 controls。CMD 改用 causal teacher，在评估每个目标时不访问未来帧或未来控制信号，使 teacher supervision 与 student 生成时的上下文匹配。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集和定量结果。实验目标应是交互式自回归视频生成中的低延迟 rollout 和在线控制质量，对比对象是使用 bidirectional teacher 的 video distribution matching distillation 管线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a causal mismatch in few-step distillation for interactive autoregressive video generation, where teacher supervision may depend on future frames or controls unavailable to the student.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and distillation contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it isolates a clean issue in autoregressive generative distillation: the teacher’s information set should match what the student had when generating the target. The idea may transfer to online multimodal generation and controllable AR systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Context-Matched Distillation replaces bidirectional full-clip scoring in video DMD with a causal teacher. Instead of letting the teacher score targets using complete clips, CMD evaluates each target without access to future frames or future control signals, aligning the teacher supervision with the student’s causal context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, or numerical improvements. The intended comparisons are against video distribution matching distillation pipelines that supervise causal few-step students with bidirectional teachers, focusing on low-latency rollouts and online control.

recommendation.zh: 只看 causal teacher 设定即可；信息集合匹配这个坑真实存在，但视频蒸馏细节不必深读。
recommendation.en: Skim the causal-teacher setup; information-set matching is a real pitfall, but the video-distillation details are not central for pretraining.

paper.title: FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference for Autonomous Driving
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise to bring end-to-end reasoning to autonomous driving, but their computational cost remains far too high for real-time control. The core challenge is structural: VLA inference is not a single bottleneck but a cascade of four. Visual encoding wastes compute on overlapping video frames; language-model prefill recomputes context that could be carried over from the previous timestep; reasoning tokens are generated serially despite low entropy; and flow-match

summary.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action 模型用于自动驾驶时推理成本过高，且瓶颈不是单点，而是视觉编码、语言模型 prefill、推理 token 生成和 flow-matching 去噪四级串联。
summary.importance: 提出算法-系统协同设计框架，同时处理四个推理瓶颈，展示面向实时控制的 VLA 推理优化思路。
summary.technical_approach: FlashDrive 分别用时间重叠实现跨帧流式 KV-cache 复用；跨时间步携带上下文避免重复 prefill；利用驾驶域推理 token 的低熵和强块内相关性降低串行生成开销；对 flow-matching 速度场非均匀区域施加非均匀计算。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名、延迟、加速比或基线数值，仅描述四类瓶颈和对应 shortcut。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action inference for autonomous driving is too expensive for real-time control because it has a cascade of four bottlenecks rather than one.
summary_en.importance: It proposes an algorithm-system co-design framework that addresses all four stages together, offering an engineering template for real-time VLA inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlashDrive uses temporal overlap for streaming KV-cache reuse across frames, carries over context to avoid recomputing LM prefill, exploits low entropy and strong intra-block correlations in driving-domain reasoning tokens, and allocates non-uniform compute to the non-uniform flow-matching velocity field.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model names, latency, speedups, or baseline numbers; it describes the four bottlenecks and corresponding shortcuts.

recommendation.zh: 把 VLA 推理拆成四个瓶颈并分别找 shortcut 的工程框架值得看，但自驾 domain 太重；只借思路，不必细读实验。
recommendation.en: The four-bottleneck decomposition of VLA inference is a useful engineering frame, but the autonomous-driving setup is too domain-specific; borrow the ideas, skip the detailed experiments.

paper.title: SPADE: Speculative Decoding for Precise and Low Cost Distributed Edge Cloud Inference
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in natural language understanding and generation, but their deployment is constrained by high computational demands. Deploying smaller LLMs directly on the edge can circumvent this, but with degraded accuracy. Deploying smaller cloud-based big LLMs preserves performance, but at the cost of expensive per-token computation. We present a distributed inference framework, \our{}, that integrates speculative decoding (SD) across edge and cl

summary.core_problem: 在边缘-云分布式部署场景下，同时降低LLM推理延迟与云端计算成本并保持大模型精度。
summary.importance: 提出边缘-云协同的推测解码框架，属于推理系统工程创新，无需重新训练模型。
summary.technical_approach: 边缘端部署小型草稿模型快速生成候选token，云端部署大模型并行验证；接受的token直接保留，仅拒绝时由云端修正，从而减少云端查询次数。
summary.experiments: 以即插即用方式实现，无需重训练；核心指标为推理延迟降低与云端成本节省，同时保持大模型原始精度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自印度理工学院等学术机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduces LLM inference latency and cloud compute cost while preserving large-model accuracy in a distributed edge-cloud deployment setting.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an edge-cloud collaborative speculative decoding framework; inference system engineering innovation requiring no model retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A compact draft model on the edge generates candidate tokens quickly; a large verifier model on the cloud validates them in parallel. Accepted tokens are retained, and only rejections trigger cloud correction, reducing the number of cloud queries.
summary_en.experiments: Plug-and-play design with no retraining; measured by inference latency reduction, cloud cost savings, and preservation of large-model accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from academic institutions including IIT.

recommendation.zh: 边缘云协同推测解码的工程实现，思路直接无新理论，对pretrain研究员价值有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering implementation of edge-cloud speculative decoding; straightforward idea with no new theory, limited value for pretrain researchers.

paper.title: Ripple-Pivot Search: Active Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive language models, offering the potential for substantially faster inference through parallel decoding. Existing parallel decoding schedulers typically commit positions only after they meet a per-position criterion, overlooking how early commitments may benefit subsequent decoding. We identify a ripple effect in dLLM decoding: proactively committing a mid-entropy pivot position can induce a pronounc

summary.core_problem: 提升 diffusion LLM 的并行解码效率，避免现有调度器只按单位置置信度保守提交 token。
summary.importance: 这是 diffusion LM 推理机制与高效解码工作。它提出的关键观察是 ripple effect：主动提交一个中等熵位置，可能降低其他 masked positions 的不确定性，从而让后续步骤一次解码更多 token。对关注非 AR 语言建模的人来说，这直接关系到 diffusion LM 相对 AR 的速度优势能否兑现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Ripple-Pivot Search，一个 training-free decoding 方法。方法不只选择最低熵位置，而是寻找中等熵 pivot，并通过 lookahead evaluation 评估不同 token assignment 对后续整体不确定性的影响。它把“当前位置是否足够确定”改成“当前位置提交后是否能让剩余位置更容易解码”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、数据集、baseline 名称或速度提升数字。实验应围绕 diffusion LLM 的并行解码调度，与现有按位置置信度提交的 parallel decoding scheduler 对比，评估总解码步数、并行 unmask 数量和生成质量保持情况。
summary.authors_note: Hong Kong Baptist University、A*STAR CFAR、Nanyang Technological University。作者列表包含 Bo Han、Ivor Tsang、Yanfeng Wang、Bo Zheng 等机器学习研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to accelerate diffusion LLM decoding by avoiding conservative per-position commitment rules in existing parallel schedulers.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficient decoding and diffusion-LM inference paper. Its key observation is a ripple effect: proactively committing a mid-entropy position can reduce uncertainty over the remaining masked positions, enabling more tokens to be unmasked in later steps. For researchers following non-autoregressive language modeling, this matters because inference speed is a central part of the diffusion-LM value proposition.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Ripple-Pivot Search, a training-free decoding method. Instead of only committing low-entropy positions, it searches for mid-entropy pivots and uses lookahead evaluation to choose token assignments that create the largest downstream uncertainty reduction. The decision rule shifts from local confidence to global decoding benefit.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baseline names, or exact speedups. The experiments are expected to compare against existing parallel decoding schedulers for diffusion LLMs, measuring decoding steps, parallel unmasking rate, and quality preservation.
summary_en.authors_note: Hong Kong Baptist University, A*STAR CFAR, and Nanyang Technological University. The author list includes Bo Han, Ivor Tsang, Yanfeng Wang, and Bo Zheng.

recommendation.zh: dLLM 推理值得看这篇的 pivot/ripple 设定；若实验数字扎实，应在内部 masked decoding baseline 里复现。
recommendation.en: For dLLM inference, the pivot/ripple setup is worth reading; if the numbers hold, it should be reproduced in internal masked-decoding baselines.

institutions: Affiliation:A*STAR CFAR and Nanyang Technological University

paper.title: When Vision Becomes Text: Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Residual Guidance in VLMs
paper.abstract: Abundant visual information strengthens vision-language model (VLM) perception, yet massive visual tokens raise inference costs. Existing visual token pruning methods rely on similarity-based guidance, which exploits pairwise text-vision and vision-vision token correlations for compression. However, such methods only capture local layer-level signals and overlook the whole inference process in VLM. In this paper, we revisit VLM inference and present a new efficient guidance scheme that complemen

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 VLM 推理中的视觉 token 冗余问题：现有剪枝方法多依赖单层 attention 或相似度，缺少对文本 token 在深层逐步吸收视觉信息这一过程的刻画。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练目标，而在多模态表示动态分析和推理效率。论文给出一个清晰观察：随着 LLM 层数加深，一部分视觉 token 信息会被文本表示吸收，因此继续保留所有视觉 token 的边际收益下降。这对 native multimodal pretrain、视觉 token budget、跨模态 token routing 都有启发。训练阶段可以考虑让视觉信息在合适层被压缩到文本或共享 latent 中；推理阶段则可以用残差信息而不是原始相似度判断哪些视觉 token 仍有保留价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是分析指标 Cross Modal Absorption，简称 CMA。它在每一层把中心化后的视觉 token 矩阵投影到文本 token 张成的子空间中，用投影可解释的 Frobenius norm 比例衡量视觉信息被文本子空间吸收的程度。CMA 是层级指标，用来描述随层深变化的整体趋势。第二步是 token 级剪枝指标 Cross Modal Residual，简称 CMR。对每个视觉 token，用 Tikhonov regularization 做正则化最小二乘投影，计算它在文本子空间之外的残差；残差越大，说明该 token 仍包含文本表示尚未解释的视觉信息。最终方法 SIEVE 把三类信号结合起来：CMR 衡量视觉独特性，text-to-visual attention 衡量任务相关性，残差空间中的 diversity selection 去除冗余。与只看原特征相似度的剪枝相比，残差空间先剥离了已被文本解释的成分，因此更适合找互补视觉信息。方法不训练模型，可插入已有 VLM。
summary.experiments: 分析部分在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的 32 层上进行，覆盖 TextVQA、POPE、MME 三个 benchmark，共 16,284 个样本。CMA 随层数单调增加：POPE 从 0.008 到 0.209，MME 从 0.009 到 0.217，TextVQA 从 0.017 到 0.396；三者与层深的 Spearman 相关系数均为 +0.99。这说明视觉表征确实逐层变得更容易由文本子空间解释。方法实验覆盖三种 VLM 架构和八个 benchmark，报告在降低计算和显存开销的同时保持任务表现，并带来实际推理加速。给定正文没有完整提供各压缩率、延迟、显存和精度表，因此具体收益需要读实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Analysis 中 CMA 的定义和 Figure 2，因为这是方法成立的核心证据。再看 Method 中 CMR 的正则化投影公式、SIEVE 如何融合 CMR、attention relevance 和 residual-space diversity。实验部分重点看不同保留率下的 accuracy-latency 曲线、跨 LLaVA / InternVL / Qwen-VL 等架构的稳定性，以及 OCR、幻觉检测、多图或高分辨率场景是否掉点。消融部分要确认 CMR 单独使用、attention 单独使用、diversity 单独使用的贡献，避免把收益误认为只是常规 attention pruning 的变体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets visual-token redundancy in VLM inference. Existing pruning methods mostly use single-layer attention or feature similarity, while this work models a process that happens across depth: text tokens gradually absorb part of the visual information.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal representation dynamics and efficient inference, rather than pretraining objectives. The key observation is that visual information does not remain fully isolated in visual tokens; deeper text states can explain an increasing portion of it. This has implications for native multimodal pretraining, visual token budgets, and cross-modal routing. During training, one may encourage visual information to move into shared or textual latent states at the right depth. During inference, pruning can focus on visual residuals that have not yet been explained by text.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis first defines Cross Modal Absorption, or CMA. At each layer, centered visual-token representations are projected onto the subspace spanned by text-token representations, and the explainable Frobenius-norm ratio measures how much visual information has been absorbed by the text subspace. CMA is a layer-level diagnostic. For pruning, the paper introduces Cross Modal Residual, or CMR, at the token level. Each visual token is projected onto the text subspace using Tikhonov-regularized least squares, and the residual measures the visual information not explained by text. A larger residual means the token still carries complementary visual content. The final method, SIEVE, combines CMR for visual distinctiveness, text-to-visual attention for task relevance, and diversity selection in the residual space to reduce redundancy. It is training-free and can be applied to existing VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The representation analysis uses all 32 layers of LLaVA-1.5-7B on TextVQA, POPE, and MME, with 16,284 samples in total. CMA increases monotonically with depth: from 0.008 to 0.209 on POPE, from 0.009 to 0.217 on MME, and from 0.017 to 0.396 on TextVQA. The Spearman correlation with layer depth is +0.99 for all three benchmarks. This provides direct evidence that deeper text representations explain more visual-token content. The pruning experiments cover three VLM architectures and eight benchmarks, reporting reduced compute and memory with practical inference acceleration while maintaining task performance. The provided text does not include the full accuracy, latency, memory, or pruning-ratio tables, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the CMA definition and Figure 2, since they motivate the whole method. Then read the CMR derivation, especially the regularized projection onto the text subspace, and how SIEVE combines CMR, attention relevance, and residual-space diversity. In the experiments, focus on accuracy-latency trade-off curves, robustness across different VLM backbones, and behavior on OCR-heavy, hallucination-sensitive, high-resolution, or multi-image inputs. The ablations should be checked carefully: CMR alone, attention alone, diversity alone, and their combinations determine whether the method is more than a variant of standard attention-based pruning.

recommendation.zh: CMA 这个度量可借鉴到 VLM KV-cache 压缩，看方法和图即可，不必复现。
recommendation.en: The CMA metric is a useful angle for VLM KV-cache compression; read the method and figures, no need to reproduce.

paper.title: Neural Introspection Gating for Adaptive KV-Cache Reuse in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models map camera images and language instructions directly to motor commands through a single autoregressive transformer. In real-time control, they still spend substantial compute recomputing key-value(KV) representations for visual tokens that barely change across neighboring frames. Recent work such as VLA-Cache reduces that cost by reusing KV states for visually static patches, but its policy relies only on observation-space heuristics and does not account for th

summary.core_problem: 在视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的实时控制中，如何更高效、自适应地重用视觉 token 的 KV Cache，以减少计算开销？
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需训练的门控机制，利用模型自身的置信度信号来决定是否重用 KV Cache，改进了仅依赖观察空间启发式规则的现有方法，对 VLM 的高效推理有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Gated VLA-Cache，通过监控解码期间预测的前两个动作 token 之间的 logit margin（零成本的置信度信号）来实现神经内省。当 margin 低于阈值时，缓存失效并触发完全重新计算。
summary.experiments: 在四个 LIBERO 基准测试套件上使用 OpenVLA 和 OpenVLA-OFT 进行了评估，证明了该方法能有效提升推理效率。

summary_en.core_problem: How to more efficiently and adaptively reuse the KV Cache of visual tokens in real-time control of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to reduce computational overhead?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free gating mechanism that uses the model's own confidence signal to decide whether to reuse the KV Cache, improving upon existing methods that rely solely on observation-space heuristics, offering insights for efficient VLM inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Gated VLA-Cache, which achieves neural introspection by monitoring the logit margin between the top two predicted action tokens (a zero-cost confidence signal) during decoding. When the margin drops below a threshold, the cache is invalidated and a full recompute is triggered.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four LIBERO benchmark suites with OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT, demonstrating the method's effectiveness in improving inference efficiency.

recommendation.zh: 利用 logit margin 作为置信度信号来控制 KV Cache 重用，思路简单有效，可作为 VLM 推理优化的参考，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Using logit margin as a confidence signal to control KV Cache reuse is simple and effective, serving as a reference for VLM inference optimization; no need to read the full text.

paper.title: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality
paper.abstract: Modern reinforcement learning (RL) post-training pipelines for large language models (LLMs) increasingly combine rollout workloads across multiple domains and feedback paradigms. Prefix-aware routing improves inference efficiency through cache reuse and load balancing, but it does not control how heterogeneous rollout sessions compete for KV-cache capacity. When reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and agentic rollouts share an

summary.core_problem: RL 后训练中 RLVR、RLHF、agentic rollout 共享异步推理服务时，异构 workload 对 KV-cache 的竞争未被现有 prefix-aware 路由控制，且不能扭曲 trainer 指定的 workload 混合比例。
summary.importance: 系统工作：针对混合 RL rollout 场景的 KV-cache 调度，解决 prefix-aware 路由只关注 cache 复用和负载均衡、不处理异构 session 对 KV 容量竞争的问题。
summary.technical_approach: MISA-T 是路由层的准入策略，结合三部分：自适应 session 准入、workload 感知的 KV 容量分配、驻留时间感知的 KV 计费。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或 baseline 对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Zetao Hong、Song Yuan、Yuanhao Ding、Yibo Zhu、Daxin Jiang、Zhibin Wang、Chen Tian；机构未在摘要中明确。

summary_en.core_problem: When RLVR, RLHF, and agentic rollouts share an asynchronous inference service, existing prefix-aware routing does not control how heterogeneous rollout sessions compete for KV-cache capacity, and must not distort the workload mixture specified by the trainer.
summary_en.importance: System work on KV-cache scheduling for mixed RL rollout serving, addressing the gap that prefix-aware routing only optimizes cache reuse and load balancing without handling KV-capacity competition across heterogeneous sessions.
summary_en.technical_approach: MISA-T is a routing-layer admission policy combining adaptive session admission, workload-aware KV-capacity allocation, and residency-time-aware KV accounting.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental results or baselines are provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Zetao Hong, Song Yuan, Yuanhao Ding, Yibo Zhu, Daxin Jiang, Zhibin Wang, Chen Tian; institution not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 做 RL 后训练 serving 的人可看，核心是 KV-cache 按 workload 异构性分配容量；对纯预训练研究员参考价值有限。
recommendation.en: Useful for RL post-training serving teams; the core idea is workload-aware KV-cache allocation. Limited direct value for pure pretraining researchers.

paper.title: Deferred Audio Pruning with Local Audio-Visual Dynamics for Omni-LLMs
paper.abstract: Omni-modal LLMs jointly process audio, video, and text, but long multimodal sequences incur substantial prefill and KV-cache costs. Existing omni-modal compression methods primarily focus on pre-LLM token reduction, leaving modality-specific compression across the LLM boundary underexplored. We propose A-PACK, a two-stage framework that defers audio pruning until query-conditioned multimodal interactions emerge. Our analysis shows that audio exhibits higher task-relevant information density and

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 omni-LLM 在长音视频输入下 prefill 和 KV-cache 成本过高的问题，尤其关注跨 LLM 边界的模态特定压缩策略。
summary.importance: 它不是基座预训练论文，但对统一多模态模型的系统设计很有参考价值。贡献点在于：不是一味在 LLM 前做 token reduction，而是把压缩延后到 query-conditioned 跨模态交互出现之后，再做模态差异化裁剪，这对未来 native multimodal pretrain 和 serving 一体化设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 A-PACK，两阶段压缩框架。第一阶段在进入 LLM 前保留音频、利用局部音视频动态信息压缩视频；第二阶段在 LLM 内部根据相关性逐步裁剪音频和视觉 token 及其 KV-cache。论文的关键观察是：音频 token 的任务相关信息密度和表示多样性高于视频，因此不应像现有方法那样过早压缩音频；同时，局部 audio-visual dynamics 比 token-wise matching 更适合作为视觉选择信号。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 和 3B 上、四个 benchmark 上评测。摘要称 A-PACK 在所比较方法中取得最强平均性能，同时显著降低 prefill 与 KV-cache 开销，但未给出具体压缩率和精度损失。若正文 ablation 充分，这篇的价值主要在“何时压缩、压哪种模态、是否连 KV 一起裁”这三个设计判断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high prefill and KV-cache cost of omni-LLMs on long audio-video inputs, with a focus on modality-specific compression across the LLM boundary.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base pretraining paper, but it is relevant to system design for unified multimodal models. The key contribution is to avoid compressing everything before the LLM; instead, it defers pruning until query-conditioned multimodal interactions emerge, which is a useful design idea for future native multimodal pretraining and serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose A-PACK, a two-stage framework. Before the LLM, it preserves audio and compresses video using local audio-visual dynamics. Inside the LLM, it progressively prunes low-relevance audio and visual tokens together with their KV-cache entries. The central empirical observations are that audio has higher task-relevant information density and representational diversity per token than video, and that local audio-visual dynamics are a better cue for visual selection than token-wise matching.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and 3B across four benchmarks. The abstract claims the best average performance among prior methods while reducing prefill and KV-cache costs, but does not report exact trade-offs. The main value likely lies in the ablations around when to compress, which modality to preserve, and whether KV entries should be pruned jointly.

recommendation.zh: 多模态长序列系统里“先压视频、晚压音频”这个判断值得记住；读实验部分和 ablation 就够，方法本身偏工程但 prior 改得还算干净。
recommendation.en: The useful takeaway is the design prior: compress video early, defer audio pruning; read the experiments and ablations, since the method is mostly systems work but the modality asymmetry is worth internalizing.

paper.title: LegoLM: Structured Weight Sharing for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: We present \LegoLM{}, a structured weight-sharing compression framework for large language models grounded in a systematic study of why global weight sharing fails and how to fix it. We identify two distinct failure modes. Distributional mismatch: for vector blocks of dimension d <= 2, transformer layers with heterogeneous weight scales impose a scale-mismatch penalty that grows linearly with d and cannot be resolved by increasing K, producing perplexity in the millions.Outlier dominance: for sc

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 全局权重共享压缩容易造成灾难性质量退化的问题，并解释为什么简单增加 codebook 大小不能修复。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩方法与失败机制分析。它不直接改进预训练 recipe，但对理解 LLM 权重分布、量化/共享的结构性失败很有用，尤其适合推理压缩和训练后压缩研究参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LegoLM，一种 data-free structured weight-sharing compression 框架。论文先区分两类失败模式：低维 vector block 上，不同 Transformer 层权重尺度异质性导致 distributional mismatch，惩罚随 block dimension d 线性增长且无法靠增大 K 消除；scalar block 上，约 1/K 的权重落在 Lloyd-Max 最外侧决策阈值之外，形成 outlier dominance。对应地，LegoLM 使用 scalar-block encoding、percentile-selective replacement 保留离群权重，以及 boundary-layer protection 保护边界层权重。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LLM 参数规模、压缩率、perplexity 或下游任务表格；明确报告 baseline 失败现象包括 vector blocks 在 d<=2 时可产生百万级 perplexity，以及 scalar blocks 中离群权重误表示会跨层累积导致质量崩溃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses catastrophic quality loss in global weight-sharing compression for LLMs and explains why simply increasing the codebook size is insufficient.
summary_en.importance: It contributes both a compression method and a failure-mode analysis. It does not change pretraining recipes, but it is useful for understanding LLM weight distributions and structural limits of quantization or weight sharing.
summary_en.technical_approach: LegoLM is a data-free structured weight-sharing framework. It identifies two failure modes: distributional mismatch in low-dimensional vector blocks, where heterogeneous layer scales induce a penalty growing linearly with block dimension d and not removable by increasing K; and outlier dominance in scalar blocks, where roughly 1/K of weights lie beyond the outermost Lloyd-Max decision threshold. The proposed fixes are scalar-block encoding, percentile-selective replacement that preserves outlier weights verbatim, and boundary-layer protection.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, compression ratios, perplexity tables, or downstream scores. It does report severe baseline failures, including perplexity in the millions for vector blocks with d<=2 and catastrophic quality loss from accumulated scalar outlier misrepresentation.

recommendation.zh: 读 failure-mode 分析就够；若内部还在做全局共享量化，这篇应触发一次干净复现。
recommendation.en: Read the failure-mode analysis; if global shared quantization is on your roadmap, this deserves a clean internal reproduction.

paper.title: VoxZip: Semantic-Anchored Temporal KV Cache Compression for Long-Context Audio Inference
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Speech Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding complex audio tasks. Despite this progress, their long-context inference remains severely bottlenecked by prohibitive KV cache memory demands. Existing text-centric compression methods struggle here, often disrupting speech continuity or discarding crucial semantic cues. To address this, we propose VoxZip, a train-free, two-stage semantic-anchored KV cache compression framework. The fir

summary.core_problem: 解决 Speech LLM 在长音频上下文推理时 KV cache 占用过高、直接套用文本压缩方法会破坏语音连续性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法，重点在音频长上下文场景。它不是预训练方法，但对语音 LM 的 token 冗余、语义锚点和缓存保留策略有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VoxZip，一个免训练的两阶段 KV cache 压缩框架。第一阶段用 ASR 转写作为显式语义锚点，对音频 token 做时间对齐、压缩和融合，以降低初始 KV cache 并提高 token 信息密度；第二阶段使用带时间衰减的累积 attention 动态过滤低价值 token，同时缓解早期 token 偏置。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在 Qwen3-Omni 上覆盖六类音频任务做综合评测。具体压缩率、准确率变化和延迟收益未在给定摘要中完整呈现，因此需要读实验表确认质量-压缩曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: VoxZip addresses the excessive KV-cache memory cost of long-context inference in Speech LLMs, where text-oriented compression can damage speech continuity and remove semantic cues.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for audio LLMs. It is not a pretraining paper, but it gives useful evidence about redundancy, semantic anchoring, and cache retention in speech-token sequences.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a training-free two-stage KV-cache compression framework. Stage one uses ASR transcripts as explicit semantic anchors to temporally align, compress, and fuse audio tokens, reducing the initial cache while increasing token information density. Stage two applies dynamic filtering with temporally decayed accumulated attention to evict less useful tokens and reduce early-token bias.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on Qwen3-Omni across six audio task categories. The provided text does not expose exact compression ratios, accuracy deltas, or latency numbers, so the quality-compression tradeoff needs to be checked in the experimental tables.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和压缩率-质量曲线；ASR anchor 若有效，说明语音 token cache 不能照搬文本启发式。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and compression-quality curves; if ASR anchoring holds, audio-token caches should not reuse text heuristics blindly.

paper.title: RippleKV: Cross-Layer KV Cache Allocation via Perturbation Propagation
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by KV cache memory, yet distributing a limited cache budget across layers remains challenging. Existing methods rely on proxies such as layer depth, attention statistics, or representation change. These proxies do not measure how perturbations at each layer propagate to the output and may therefore cause sensitive layers to be underallocated while tolerant layers are overallocated. To address this issue, we propose RippleKV, which allocates cache across

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 总预算有限时，如何在不同层之间分配缓存的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理内存优化方法。它把层级 KV 分配从启发式代理指标，转向直接测量某层 value cache 扰动对最终预测分布的影响，对长上下文 serving 和 cache compression 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RippleKV：在小校准集上，对每一层的 value cache 独立注入范数自适应扰动，测量输出分布的 KL divergence；把多样本平均后的响应作为层敏感度，再归一化为各层缓存预算 multiplier。方法不是按深度单调分配，也不直接依赖 attention statistic 或 hidden-state change。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、校准集规模、压缩比例或吞吐/困惑度提升。可确认的实验信号是方法围绕有限 KV cache budget 下的跨层分配，与基于层深、注意力统计、表示变化等代理方法比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to allocate a fixed KV-cache budget across transformer layers during long-context LLM inference.
summary_en.importance: It is an inference-memory optimization contribution. The useful shift is from heuristic layer proxies to a direct estimate of how perturbing a layer’s value cache changes the final predictive distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: RippleKV injects norm-adaptive perturbations into each layer’s value cache independently on a small calibration set, measures the induced output KL divergence, averages the responses into a model-specific sensitivity profile, and converts that profile into layer-wise budget multipliers. The allocation is not assumed to be monotonic with depth.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, calibration-set size, compression ratios, or latency/quality numbers. The stated comparisons are against allocation rules based on layer depth, attention statistics, and representation-change proxies.

recommendation.zh: 只看扰动校准的定义和层敏感度曲线；若曲线稳定，内部 KV 压缩 ablation 可以复现。
recommendation.en: Read the perturbation calibration and layer-sensitivity plots; if the profiles are stable, this is worth reproducing in internal KV-compression ablations.

paper.title: Can We Optimize the Performance-Carbon Emission Break-Even Point?: The Quest for Greener LLMs
paper.abstract: The carbon footprint of any deployed Large Language Model (LLM) accumulates during inference, where repeated use of the model substantially exceeds the one-time cost of fine-tuning. Yet most efficiency interventions target either pre-training scale or post-hoc compression. We ask whether folding a calibrated, differentiable energy surrogate into the fine-tuning objective can produce inference behavior that gains task accuracy at zero or near-zero carbon cost, a break-even configuration. We propo

summary.core_problem: 探索能否在 LLM 微调目标中加入可微碳排放代理项，使任务性能提升同时推理阶段碳排放接近不增加。
summary.importance: 贡献是能耗感知微调的探索性实验，而不是预训练或 serving 系统突破。对基座研究的价值主要在负结果和测量框架：把硬件能耗 profiling 拟合成 loss 项后，并不保证得到性能—碳排放 break-even。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造 joint loss，在常规任务损失外加入每个模型校准的 carbon-emission parameter。能耗代理是参数范数、FLOP proxy 和 memory proxy 的线性组合，系数来自 on-hardware energy profiling。随后对不同架构家族进行微调，观察准确率和 CO2 排放的共同变化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gemma-2 2B、Llama-3.1 8B、Qwen-2.5 14B，在 MMLU 的 abstract algebra、philosophy、formal logic 三个科目上评估 inference F1 和 CO2 emissions。摘要称 carbon term 在若干结果中表现为有害干扰或有限收益，未给出完整数值和统计稳健性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a differentiable carbon-emission surrogate can be added to LLM fine-tuning so task performance improves with zero or near-zero additional inference carbon cost.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an exploratory energy-aware fine-tuning study rather than a pretraining or serving-system advance. Its main value for base-model work is the measurement lesson: fitting a hardware-profiled energy proxy into the loss does not guarantee a performance-carbon break-even point.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a joint loss that augments the task objective with a per-model carbon-emission parameter. The carbon surrogate is a linear function of parameter norm, a FLOP proxy, and a memory proxy, calibrated from on-hardware energy profiling. The authors fine-tune different model families and track both task accuracy and CO2 emissions.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover Gemma-2 2B, Llama-3.1 8B, and Qwen-2.5 14B on three MMLU subjects: abstract algebra, philosophy, and formal logic. The reported metrics are inference F1 and CO2 emissions. The abstract indicates that the carbon term can act as harmful interference or offer limited benefit, but does not provide full numerical results or robustness checks.

recommendation.zh: 可当 energy-aware fine-tuning 的弱负例看；三科 MMLU 太窄，结论别外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a weak negative case for energy-aware fine-tuning; three MMLU subjects are too narrow to extrapolate to pretraining.

paper.title: Retrofitting Linear Attention into Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive models by accelerating inference through parallel decoding. Recent dLLMs commonly use blockwise semi-autoregressive decoding, generating blocks autoregressively while denoising tokens within each active block in parallel. However, despite KV caching, each denoising step still attends to all previous blocks, repeatedly incurring prefix-attention cost. Motivated by this bottleneck, we ask whether dLLM inference can b

summary.core_problem: Diffusion LM 在 blockwise semi-AR 解码时，每步去噪都要对所有历史 block 做 softmax attention，prefix-attention 成本随生成长度线性增长。
summary.importance: 方法创新：把 linear attention 以 hybrid 形式 retrofit 进已预训练的 dLLM，几乎无需 post-training 即可显著降本，对 diffusion LM 推理范式有直接推动。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 block-hybrid attention：当前 active denoising block 内保留精确 softmax attention，对之前的 blocks 使用 linear attention；在 LLaDA 2.1 16B 上替换 20 层中的 6 层，转换流程参考 LoLCAT，仅需少量 post-training。
summary.experiments: 基于 LLaDA 2.1 16B；替换 6/20 层；abstract 未给具体速度/质量数字，强调 minimal post-training 即可保持质量。

summary_en.core_problem: In blockwise semi-autoregressive diffusion LMs, each denoising step attends over all previous blocks with softmax attention, causing prefix-attention cost to grow linearly with generated length.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: retrofits linear attention into a pretrained dLLM in a hybrid form with minimal post-training, directly reducing inference cost of diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Block-hybrid attention keeps exact softmax attention within the active denoising block and uses linear attention over previous blocks; replaces 6 of 20 layers in LLaDA 2.1 16B following LoLCAT, with minimal post-training.
summary_en.experiments: On LLaDA 2.1 16B; replaces 6/20 attention layers; abstract reports quality retained with minimal post-training but no concrete speed/quality numbers.

recommendation.zh: 把 linear attention 塞进 dLLM 的历史 block 是自然但关键的一步，建议复现并测长序列下的质量-时延权衡。
recommendation.en: Linearizing attention over past blocks is the obvious next move for dLLMs; reproduce and benchmark the quality-latency tradeoff on long generations.

paper.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
paper.abstract: Recent optimization studies on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have exploited chunk-level KV cache reuse to avoid processing long retrieved contexts for higher efficiency, while significant information redundancy and noise still remain in the coarse-grained chunks. This paper optimizes the Pareto frontier under low prefill latency constraints while maximizing accuracy by proposing CoinRAG (Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG). The name metaphorically reflec

summary.core_problem: 降低 long-context RAG 的 prefill latency，同时避免粗粒度 chunk 级 KV cache 复用带来的冗余和噪声。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统与 RAG efficiency 工作，贡献点在 KV cache 复用粒度。对预训练研究员的间接价值在于理解长上下文系统瓶颈，以及 retrieval context 表示是否需要在训练阶段适配更细粒度的复用结构。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoinRAG，把离线计算的 fine-grained information nugget KV cache 作为可组合单元。系统先用两阶段检索从 retrieved chunks 中定位 query-relevant semantic units，再拼接或组装这些 sliced KV representations，形成更紧凑、语义相关性更高的上下文表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型、数据集和数值。实验目标是优化低 prefill latency 约束下的 accuracy-latency Pareto frontier，并与 chunk-level KV cache reuse 方案比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce prefill latency in long-context RAG while avoiding the redundancy and noise of coarse chunk-level KV-cache reuse.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and RAG-efficiency contribution focused on cache granularity. For pretraining researchers, its indirect value is in exposing long-context serving bottlenecks and raising the question of whether retrieval-context representations should be trained for finer-grained reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoinRAG reuses offline-computed fine-grained information-nugget KV caches as composable units. It uses two-stage retrieval to identify query-relevant semantic units inside retrieved chunks, then assembles sliced KV representations into a compact, semantically relevant contextual representation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not include concrete model names, datasets, or numerical results. The evaluation targets the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier under low prefill-latency constraints and compares against chunk-level KV-cache reuse approaches.

recommendation.zh: 只看 cache 粒度和 Pareto 图；若结果干净，它提示 RAG context 可以按 semantic unit 预编码，而不是按 chunk 硬切。
recommendation.en: Read the cache granularity and Pareto plots; if clean, it argues for semantic-unit pre-encoding rather than hard chunking in RAG.

paper.title: FutureBridge: Token Selection Beyond Local Preference in Collaborative Decoding
paper.abstract: Token-level collaboration allows a large language model (LLM) to assist a small language model (SLM) when their predictions diverge. Existing methods either use LLM-generated intervention tokens or rank candidates with the LLM's next-token probabilities. Both rely on the LLM's local preference, even though an LLM-selected token may be difficult for the SLM to build on. We present FutureBridge, which ranks joint LLM-SLM token candidates according to how well they support the SLM's subsequent reas

summary.core_problem: 解决协同解码中“大模型选出的局部高概率 token 未必适合小模型继续推理”的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理解码方法改进。它把 token 选择从 LLM 的局部偏好，改成“这个 token 是否能让 SLM 后续更容易走向正确答案”的反事实评估，对大小模型协作和低成本推理有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: FutureBridge 在训练阶段使用经过答案验证的 LLM 轨迹作为固定共享未来，让冻结的 SLM 在相同未来上下文下评价不同候选 token 的可延续性，得到反事实分数；再用这些分数监督一个轻量 token reranker。推理阶段只用 LLM 扩展候选池，由 reranker 选一个 token 后把生成权交回 SLM，不追加未来 suffix。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个数学推理任务，比较已有 LLM-SLM token-level collaboration 方法，包括直接使用 LLM intervention token 或按 LLM next-token probability 排序的方案。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华东师范大学、北京大学、中国科学技术大学、南洋理工大学、上海交通大学、广东工业大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in collaborative decoding: a token preferred locally by the LLM may be hard for the SLM to continue from.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time decoding method. It reframes token selection from local LLM preference to downstream SLM continuation quality, which is relevant to cost-aware large-small model collaboration.
summary_en.technical_approach: FutureBridge uses answer-verified LLM trajectories during training as a fixed shared future. A frozen SLM evaluates each candidate token under this common future context to produce counterfactual scores, which supervise a lightweight token reranker. At inference time, the LLM only expands the candidate pool; the reranker selects one token and control returns to the SLM without appending a generated future suffix.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on five mathematical reasoning tasks against prior token-level collaboration methods that either inject LLM-generated tokens or rank candidates by LLM next-token probabilities. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data scale, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with East China Normal University, Peking University, University of Science and Technology of China, Nanyang Technological University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Guangdong University of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 作为 decoding 备查即可；核心想法是把 token 选择目标对齐到 SLM 的未来可延续性，不必读实验细节。
recommendation.en: Useful as a decoding reference: the interesting bit is aligning token choice with the SLM’s future continuation quality, not the benchmark numbers.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: RoRA: Role-Oriented Regional Allocation for Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode images as long visual token sequences, making prefilling and KV-cache storage expensive. Existing training-free pruning methods select tokens by importance, diversity, or spatial coverage, but treat retained tokens as interchangeable and do not explicitly track which object-related regions are already covered. We present RoRA, a training-free framework that casts visual token pruning as role-oriented regional evidence allocation. Given a fixed budg

summary.core_problem: MLLM 中图像被编码为长视觉 token 序列，prefill 和 KV-cache 开销大；现有无训练剪枝方法把保留 token 视为可互换，未显式覆盖对象区域。
summary.importance: 推理效率类工作，对多模态 KV-cache 压缩和视觉 token 预算分配有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RoRA 是无训练框架，把视觉 token 剪枝建模为面向角色的区域证据分配：受保护语义核心、互补上下文、细粒度细节；用位置先验和 prompt 校准的对象先验校正 attention，构造 Attention-Anchored Regions 作为已覆盖对象代理，上下文主要在 AAR 外探索，少量预算用于局部细节恢复。
summary.experiments: 在多个 MLLM 和 benchmark 上做训练无关剪枝对比（摘要未给具体数字）。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLMs encode images as long visual token sequences, making prefilling and KV-cache storage expensive; existing training-free pruning methods treat retained tokens as interchangeable without tracking object-region coverage.
summary_en.importance: Inference-efficiency work relevant to multimodal KV-cache compression and visual token budget allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: RoRA is a training-free framework casting visual token pruning as role-oriented regional evidence allocation: a protected semantic core, complementary context, and fine-grained detail. It calibrates text-conditioned attention with positional and prompt-calibrated object priors, builds Attention-Anchored Regions as proxies for covered object support, explores context mainly outside AARs, and uses a small AAR-guided budget to restore local detail.
summary_en.experiments: Training-free pruning comparisons across multiple MLLMs and benchmarks (specific numbers not in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把对象覆盖显式纳入视觉 token 剪枝是合理方向，但无训练方法上限有限；看 AAR 构造和与 FastV/视觉 token 剪枝基线的对比即可。
recommendation.en: Explicit object-coverage accounting is a sensible angle for visual token pruning, but training-free methods have limited headroom; inspect the AAR construction and comparisons to FastV-style baselines.

paper.title: Learning to Predict Middle-Layer Attention in MLLMs for Visual Token Prunin
