paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse vision-language tasks, but their efficiency is limited by the cost of processing numerous visual tokens. Visual token pruning can reduce this cost, but requires accurate token importance estimates. Recent studies have demonstrated that text-to-vision attention from middle language model layers can effectively guide visual token pruning, typically using attention from a predefined middle layer to select the visual

summary.core_problem: MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝依赖固定中间层的 text-to-vision attention，但最优层随样本变化，且算到该层已付出大量视觉 token 计算。
summary.importance: 效率方法贡献：通过预测中间层 attention 提前剪枝视觉 token，减少 MLLM 多模态推理开销。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Middle-layer Attention Prediction (MAP)，从早期层特征预测对问题更敏感的中间层 text-to-vision attention，并据此选择保留的视觉 token，避免处理全部视觉 token 到固定中间层。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、加速比或精度下降数值；仅说明用于视觉 token pruning。

summary_en.core_problem: Visual token pruning in MLLMs relies on text-to-vision attention from a fixed middle layer, but the most responsive layer varies by sample and reaching it already costs substantial computation.
summary_en.importance: Efficiency-method contribution: predicts middle-layer attention to prune visual tokens earlier and reduce multimodal inference cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Middle-layer Attention Prediction (MAP), which predicts question-sensitive middle-layer text-to-vision attention from early-layer features and uses it to select retained visual tokens before heavy middle-layer computation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, speedups, or accuracy drops; it only positions the method for visual token pruning.

recommendation.zh: 视觉 token 剪枝的小改进，predictor 思路直接；只看方法图和消融，对 LLM 主干本身无新 insight。
recommendation.en: A modest visual-token-pruning improvement with a straightforward predictor; read the method figure and ablations only, as it offers little new insight into LLM backbones.

paper.title: Multi-Level Modeling of Large Language Model Inference Latency and Energy via Hybrid Analytical--Machine-Learning Predictors
paper.abstract: The rapid scaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly increased computational cost, energy consumption, and inference latency, making accurate estimation essential for sustainable artificial intelligence deployment and hardware-aware design. In this work, we introduce Hybrid Modeling for Energy and Latency of LLMs (HYMELL), a hybrid three-level framework for estimating LLM inference latency and energy by combining analytical modeling with machine learning (ML). HYMELL models LLM ex

summary.core_problem: 解决LLM推理延迟与能耗难以准确估计的问题，支撑可持续AI部署与硬件感知架构设计。
summary.importance: 方法+系统贡献，提出混合解析建模与机器学习的三层框架，支持dense/MoE、MHA/GQA等多种主流LLM架构。
summary.technical_approach: HYMELL三层混合建模框架：底层用解析模型估算基础算子的耗时与能耗；中层用ML预测高层组件的开销；顶层端到端模型捕获prefill与decode阶段的系统级额外开销，结合解析模型的准确性与ML的泛化性。
summary.experiments: 在NVIDIA H100 GPU上评估，支持dense、MoE FFN以及MHA、GQA架构，原摘要实验部分截断，具体预测精度未完整披露。
summary.authors_note: 包含南加州大学Massoud Pedram教授团队成员，该团队长期从事低功耗计算与AI系统优化研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the difficulty of accurately estimating LLM inference latency and energy, critical for sustainable AI deployment and hardware-aware architecture design.
summary_en.importance: Methodological and system contribution proposing a three-level hybrid analytical-ML framework that supports mainstream LLM architectures including dense/MoE FFNs and MHA/GQA attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: HYMELL uses a three-level hierarchy: analytical estimation of primitive operations at the bottom, ML prediction of higher-level components in the middle, and an end-to-end model capturing system-level overheads across prefill and decode phases at the top, combining accuracy of analytical models with generalization of ML.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on NVIDIA H100 GPU across dense/MoE FFNs and MHA/GQA attention; the abstract is truncated, so full prediction accuracy results are not available.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes members of Massoud Pedram's group at USC, a team long working on low-power computing and AI system optimization.

recommendation.zh: 推理延迟与能耗的混合建模方法，做硬件感知架构设计时可参考，看框架结构即可。
recommendation.en: Hybrid inference latency/energy modeling useful for hardware-aware architecture design; skim the framework structure only.

paper.title: DBLAST: Dependent Block Drafting for Stochastic Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models' inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens and a target model to verify them. While recent block and diffusion-style drafters can predict several positions in a single pass, their training and sampling procedures are typically optimized for greedy decoding or assume that positions in the draft block are conditionally independent. This assumption becomes brittle in non-greedy speculative decoding, where the ta

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是随机采样场景下的 speculative decoding：块式 drafter 一次提出多个 token，但常见做法把块内位置近似为条件独立，导致它在高熵目标分布下很难提出一条前后一致、能被 sequential verifier 接受的候选轨迹。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对高吞吐推理、RL rollout、开放式生成服务有直接参考价值。关键启发是：多 token 预测或 diffusion-style drafter 不能只优化每个位置的边缘分布；如果 verifier 按自回归条件分布逐 token 接受，训练目标就需要贴近 accepted prefix length，而不是只看 block NLL。
summary.technical_approach: DBLAST 在 DFlash 风格的 block diffusion drafter 上加入块内依赖。方法使用一个 CP-style categorical latent mixture：给整个 block 引入轻量类别 latent variable；在给定类别后，各位置仍可并行预测；对类别边缘化后，块内 token 之间形成相关性。这样保留了一次前向预测多个位置的并行性，同时比独立采样更容易生成条件上连贯的 draft block。训练上，论文不只优化 block NLL，而是提出面向 accepted length 的 log-domain surrogate，并用 threshold-truncated prefixes 稳定早期训练。这个目标更贴近 speculative verifier 的实际行为：第 i 个 token 是否被接受，取决于前面 token 是否已经被接受以及目标模型在该条件下的分布。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B，任务包括 GSM8K、MT-Bench、HumanEval 和 creative writing。论文重点报告了高熵采样下的收益：在 Qwen3-8B 高熵设置中，DBLAST 的 accepted length 宏平均提升超过 12%。诊断实验把样本按 target-block early determinism 分桶，发现独立 block proposal 在低确定性区域最脆弱；DBLAST 在所有分桶中提升 accepted length，且相对收益集中在早期位置不确定、存在多条合理续写的区域。这支持了论文的核心判断：随机 speculative decoding 的瓶颈不是单点预测质量，而是块级条件轨迹质量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 independent block sampling mismatch 的分析，以及 Figure 1 的 early determinism 分桶结果。方法部分重点看 CP-style latent mixture 如何在不牺牲并行性的情况下引入块内依赖，再看 accepted-length surrogate 的定义。实验部分可重点看高熵设置下 Qwen3-8B 的 accepted length 结果；如果关心 RL rollout 或开放式生成服务，这部分比 greedy decoding 指标更有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies speculative decoding under stochastic target sampling. Existing block drafters propose several future tokens in one pass, but often treat positions in the block as conditionally independent. This works better for greedy or low-entropy decoding, and breaks down when the target distribution admits several plausible continuations.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper, but it has useful implications for training multi-token and diffusion-style drafters. The main lesson is that matching per-position marginals is not enough when verification is sequential. A drafter should optimize for the accepted prefix process, not only for block likelihood.
summary_en.technical_approach: DBLAST adds dependence to a DFlash-like block diffusion drafter through a CP-style categorical latent mixture. A lightweight latent category is shared across the block. Conditioned on that category, token positions are still predicted in parallel; after marginalizing over categories, the proposal defines a correlated joint distribution over the block. The paper also introduces an accepted-length-oriented log-domain surrogate, with threshold-truncated prefixes for stable early training. This aligns the drafter more directly with the verifier, which accepts token i under the target distribution conditioned on the already accepted draft prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on GSM8K, MT-Bench, HumanEval, and creative-writing tasks. In the high-entropy Qwen3-8B setting, DBLAST reports more than 12% macro-average improvement in accepted length. A diagnostic experiment groups examples by early target-block determinism. Independent proposals degrade most in the least deterministic bins, while DBLAST improves accepted length in every bin, with the largest relative gains where early positions have multiple plausible continuations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20–30 minutes. Read the Introduction for the mismatch between independent block sampling and sequential verification. Then inspect the early-determinism analysis around Figure 1. In the method section, focus on the latent-mixture parameterization and the accepted-length surrogate. The most relevant experimental results are the high-entropy Qwen3-8B accepted-length comparisons, especially for readers interested in RL rollouts or open-ended generation.

recommendation.zh: 只看熵升高下 accepted length 崩掉的实验和 loss 设计；这对采样式 serving 比常规 greedy 加速更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-vs-accepted-length results and the loss design; this is more relevant to sampling-heavy serving than standard greedy acceleration.

paper.title: BaKron: Efficient Quantization with Kronecker-Factored Hessians
paper.abstract: We accelerate a family of algorithms for neural network quantization whose geometry is informed by any Kronecker-factored approximation of the Hessian. GPTQ-style adaptive rounding typically uses one-sided information derived from input activations. Two-sided Kronecker-factored Hessian approximations can additionally capture correlations across output coordinates, but applying GPTQ directly in the vectorized weight domain is computationally expensive. Building on the two-sided adaptive-rounding

summary.core_problem: 现有基于双边克罗内克分解Hessian的GPTQ类权重量化方法（如BoA、YAQA）计算复杂度过高，总运算量达O(m²n²)，难以落地到大规模Transformer模型的后训练量化场景。
summary.importance: 将双边Hessian量化的总复杂度降至与原生GPTQ同阶的O(mn(m+n))，同时保留输出维度相关性建模能力，为大模型低比特量化提供了可实用的高效算法基础。
summary.technical_approach: 核心提出BaKron求解器，结合反对角线并行与递归分治构造，求解任意A⊗B形式克罗内克Hessian（A捕捉输入相关性、B捕捉输出相关性）下的自适应舍入优化问题；同时提供4种Hessian构造方案：分别搭配全局/局部损失的K-FAC风格（基于独立性假设）与Shampoo风格（基于幂迭代求最优克罗内克分解）近似，还优化了全局Hessian的反向传播计算流程以降低显存占用。
summary.experiments: 复杂度层面，总运算量从BoA/YAQA的O(m²n²)降至O(mn(m+n))，串行步数维持O(m+n)，与YAQA一致、接近GPTQ的O(n)；附录端到端量化实验验证了不同Hessian配置下的精度与推理速度权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章BaKron算法推导与复杂度分析、第4章4种Hessian构造方案；附录D的端到端实验可快速浏览，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GPTQ-style weight quantization methods using two-sided Kronecker-factored Hessians (e.g., BoA, YAQA) suffer from prohibitive O(m²n²) total computational cost, making them impractical for post-training quantization of large-scale Transformer models.
summary_en.importance: Reduces the total complexity of two-sided Hessian quantization to O(mn(m+n)), on par with vanilla GPTQ, while retaining the ability to model output feature correlations, providing a practical efficient algorithmic foundation for low-bit LLM quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BaKron, a solver for adaptive rounding under arbitrary Kronecker-factored Hessians (A⊗B, where A captures input correlations and B captures output correlations) that combines anti-diagonal parallelism with a recursive divide-and-conquer construction. It also provides 4 Hessian instantiations: K-FAC-style (independence assumption) and Shampoo-style (power iteration for optimal Kronecker factorization) approximations paired with either rich global loss or cheap local loss, plus an optimized backpropagation scheme for global Hessian computation to reduce memory footprint.
summary_en.experiments: Complexity-wise, total work drops from O(m²n²) (BoA/YAQA) to O(mn(m+n)), while sequential steps stay at O(m+n) (matching YAQA, close to GPTQ's O(n)). End-to-end quantization experiments in Appendix D validate accuracy-speed tradeoffs across different Hessian configurations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (BaKron algorithm derivation and complexity analysis) and Section 4 (four Hessian construction schemes). Skim Appendix D for end-to-end empirical results. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 量化研究员可读算法部分；若实测吞吐和困惑度稳住，两侧 Hessian 可能不再只是漂亮但太贵的设定。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for quantization people; if the runtime and perplexity hold, two-sided Hessian rounding becomes less of a pretty-but-too-expensive idea.

paper.title: Evidence-Driven Dynamic Visual Selector for Efficient Long Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in MLLM-based long-form video understanding have mitigated inference-time computational cost and limited context lengths by selecting query-relevant frames. However, existing approaches predominantly rely on external proxy scorers and rigid heuristic rules, inevitably suffering from misalignment with the target MLLM's intrinsic evidence and failing to accommodate the non-uniform spatiotemporal information density. In this paper, we propose a fine-grained dynamic visual select

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频 MLLM 推理中视觉 token / 帧过多导致的计算开销和上下文压力问题，目标是在不显著损失答案质量的前提下选择查询相关证据帧。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态推理效率方法。它不是预训练方法，但对长上下文多模态模型的 evidence selection 有参考价值，尤其是用目标模型内部注意力替代外部 proxy scorer 的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EviSelect：先用高度压缩的视觉输入和稀疏 prefilling 近似目标 MLLM 的注意力图，把该注意力作为结构化先验；再从注意力中提取三个互补证据分量，驱动分布感知的动态采样，避免固定规则选帧。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明该方法的稀疏注意力近似与完整注意力对齐，并用于长视频理解中的动态视觉选择；给定信息未提供具体模型规模、视频 benchmark、baseline 名称和量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the inference cost and context pressure of long-video MLLMs by selecting query-relevant visual evidence instead of feeding all frames.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution for multimodal long-context models. It is not a pretraining paper, but the use of the target model’s own attention as selection evidence is a useful design signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: EviSelect probes approximate attention maps through compressed visual inputs and sparse prefilling, uses them as a structured prior, and derives complementary attention components to guide distribution-aware dynamic frame sampling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that the sparse attention approximation aligns with the full counterpart and supports efficient long-video understanding, but the provided text does not include model sizes, benchmark names, baselines, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和注意力近似部分；对预训练没直接动作，但可作为长视频 token pruning 的弱参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and attention-probing setup; it is not pretraining work, but it is a useful weak signal for long-video token pruning.

paper.title: One Qubit Can Beat One Bit: Quantum Advantage for Post-Training Quantization
paper.abstract: One-bit post-training quantization represents each weight using only its sign, requiring all deployment contexts to share the same binary weight matrix even when their activation statistics favor different sign patterns. We study this shared-sign constraint and introduce Quantum Random Access Quantization (QRAQ). This framework encodes context-dependent signs in a quantum random-access code and retrieves them via context-matched Pauli measurements. Under an explicit fresh-copy logical readout mo

summary.core_problem: 研究一比特后训练量化中所有上下文共享同一个符号权重矩阵的限制，并用量子随机访问编码表达上下文相关符号。
summary.importance: 贡献是量化理论和量子读出模型下的分离结果；与 LLM 推理压缩相关，但部署假设离当前 GPU/ASIC 推理系统较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Quantum Random Access Quantization，将上下文依赖的权重符号编码进 quantum random-access code，并通过上下文匹配的 Pauli measurement 读出；在 fresh-copy logical readout 模型下得到无偏的上下文特定二值 surrogate，同时分析 shot-noise、有限 shot 和校准噪声条件。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论证明，包括相对共享符号 one-bit PTQ 加 signed per-row scales 的 row-wise separation；未报告真实 LLM 规模实验、推理吞吐或主流量化 baseline 的实测结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the shared-sign constraint in one-bit post-training quantization and proposes using quantum random-access coding for context-dependent weight signs.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a theoretical separation for quantization under a quantum readout model. It touches LLM compression, but the deployment assumptions are far from current accelerator-based inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Quantum Random Access Quantization encodes context-dependent signs in a quantum random-access code and retrieves them via context-matched Pauli measurements. Under a fresh-copy logical readout model, it yields an unbiased context-specific binary surrogate with a tractable shot-noise penalty.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports theoretical row-wise separation from shared-sign one-bit PTQ with signed per-row scales and derives finite-shot and calibrated-noise conditions. No real LLM-scale deployment experiment is described.

recommendation.zh: 量化理论有趣但离可部署系统很远；只看 separation 假设，别当 PTQ recipe。
recommendation.en: Interesting quantization theory but far from deployable inference; read the separation assumptions, not as a PTQ recipe.

paper.title: Elbow-Based MoE Routing: A Training-Free Inference Time Plugin for Expert Selection
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable model scaling while maintaining low inference-time compute by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, conventional routing relies on a fixed top-k selection, forcing the model to spend the same compute regardless of how many experts are relevant. We introduce elbow-based routing, a training-free inference-time modification that dynamically adjusts the number of experts on a per-token basis. Our method examines the sorted router probability d

summary.core_problem: MoE模型传统固定top-k路由机制不区分token的专家需求度——部分仅需少量专家的token浪费算力，而需要更多专家的token可能被分配不足；现有动态路由方案均需要重新训练或超参数搜索，成本高且无法直接复用已训练完成的MoE checkpoint。
summary.importance: 提出了首个无需训练、无需额外超参数的MoE动态路由插件，可直接部署于已训练完成的MoE模型，在不损失精度的前提下降低推理延迟，为MoE推理优化提供了轻量可落地的新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 对每个token的路由概率做降序排序，使用Kneedle算法识别概率曲线的肘点（即快速衰减的头部过渡到平坦尾部的拐点），将肘点作为该token的动态激活专家数，上限为原模型的固定top-K值；该方法仅裁剪原top-K中的低概率专家，不改变专家排序或引入新路径，从信号-噪声分解角度解释：高概率头部对应与输入相关的信号专家，平坦尾部对应正交残差驱动的噪声专家，肘点即为二者的分界。
summary.experiments: 在OLMoE模型上测试，覆盖MMLU、ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande六个基准；分析超过200万条路由概率曲线，99.7%存在清晰的尖锐肘点，且肘点分布跨数据集、跨层、跨学科主题一致；随机替换肘点后的低概率专家不影响精度，替换肘点前的专家则精度显著下降；最终实现平均5.3%的推理延迟降低，同时保持精度与专家负载平衡。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节的肘点检测算法和信号-噪声解释，图2的尾部分布随机化实验和图3的肘点分布统计；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，适合快速了解MoE推理侧的无训练优化思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional fixed top-k routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models applies uniform expert allocation across all tokens, wasting compute on tokens that only need a small number of relevant experts while potentially under-provisioning tokens that require more. Existing dynamic routing methods all require retraining, auxiliary losses, or expensive hyperparameter grid search, limiting their deployability on finished pretrained MoE checkpoints.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces the first training-free, hyperparameter-free dynamic routing plugin for MoE models that can be directly applied to existing checkpoints. It delivers measurable latency reduction without accuracy loss, providing a lightweight, production-ready path for MoE inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each token, router probabilities are sorted in descending order. A Kneedle-style algorithm detects the elbow point on the sorted probability curve — the inflection point where the rapidly decaying high-probability head transitions to a flat low-probability tail. The number of active experts for the token is set to the minimum of the elbow index and the model's original fixed top-K value. The method only prunes low-probability experts from the original top-K set, preserving expert ordering and introducing no new routing paths. A signal-noise decomposition framework explains the approach: high-probability head experts correspond to signal aligned with input-relevant routing directions, while flat tail experts reflect noise from orthogonal residual variation, with the elbow marking the boundary between the two.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted on the OLMoE model across six benchmarks: MMLU, ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, PIQA, and WinoGrande. Analysis of over 2 million router probability curves shows 99.7% have clear, sharp elbows, with elbow distributions consistent across datasets, router layers, and MMLU subject categories. Randomly replacing post-elbow low-probability experts has no measurable impact on accuracy, while replacing pre-elbow experts causes significant accuracy drops. The method achieves an average 5.3% inference latency reduction while preserving full benchmark accuracy and expert load balance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the elbow detection algorithm and signal-noise interpretation, Figure 2 for the tail randomization validation experiment, and Figure 3 for elbow distribution statistics. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. It is suitable for a quick overview of training-free MoE inference optimization strategies.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由分布分析和 latency setup；5.3% 不大，但 training-free，值得放进 MoE serving 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the router-distribution analysis and latency setup; 5.3% is modest, but the training-free nature makes it worth a MoE serving ablation.

paper.title: Training-Free Hashing-Based Attention via Binary Principal Components
paper.abstract: Long-context large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet self-attention remains a major efficiency bottleneck -- especially during decoding -- due to the necessity of repeatedly processing ever-growing key-value (KV) caches. Existing sparse attention reduce computation by attending to fewer KV pairs, but often suffer from substantial accuracy degradation, require additional training, or rely on expensive hashing. In this work, we present BinaryPC, a tra

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM解码阶段自注意力随KV缓存增长成为计算瓶颈，现有稀疏注意力方案要么精度损失大、要么需要额外训练、要么哈希计算开销高
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练-free、数据感知的哈希稀疏注意力方案BinaryPC，在不修改模型参数、不增加训练成本的前提下降低长上下文解码的注意力计算量
summary.technical_approach: 通过计算KV数据的二值主成分构造紧凑二进制哈希码与对应哈希函数，相比于数据无关的LSH和需要训练的非线性哈希，可显式保留数据结构信息，无需梯度训练，基于哈希桶做稀疏注意力计算
summary.experiments: 在多个长上下文任务上测试，BinaryPC在不同上下文长度下均优于LSH等无训练稀疏注意力基线，精度接近全注意力，同时显著降低解码阶段的KV计算量

summary_en.core_problem: Self-attention during long-context LLM decoding becomes a compute bottleneck as KV cache grows; existing sparse attention methods either suffer large accuracy drops, require additional training, or incur high hashing overhead.
summary_en.importance: A method contribution proposing BinaryPC, a training-free, data-aware hashing-based sparse attention that reduces long-context decoding compute without modifying model parameters or adding training costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs compact binary hash codes and hash functions by computing binary principal components of KV data. Unlike data-independent LSH or trained non-linear hashing, it explicitly preserves data structure without gradient-based training, then performs sparse attention within hash buckets.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple long-context tasks, BinaryPC outperforms training-free sparse attention baselines including LSH across context lengths, achieves accuracy close to full attention while significantly reducing KV compute during decoding.

recommendation.zh: 训练-free的长上下文稀疏注意力方案，无需改模型即可降低解码算力，知道结论即可，无需深读
recommendation.en: A training-free sparse attention approach for long-context decoding that cuts compute without model modifications; know the result, no need to read in depth.

paper.title: Not All Redundant Tokens Are Alike: Analyzing Visual Token Pruning through Token Roles
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) process an image as a sequence of visual tokens, which creates a substantial computational bottleneck during inference. Recent visual token pruning methods address this issue by removing seemingly redundant tokens, yet it remains unclear how these pruning decisions relate to the functional roles of visual tokens. In this work, we analyze visual token pruning through the lens of token roles identified by EmbedLens. We first show that representative pruning methods ex

summary.core_problem: 分析 VLM 中视觉 token 剪枝决策与 token 功能角色之间的关系，解释为何看似冗余的 token 被剪去后会影响性能。
summary.importance: 属于视觉 token 剪枝的机制分析工作；主要贡献是用 EmbedLens 定义的 token role 审视现有剪枝方法的偏差，并发现弱语义 token 不一定可安全删除。
summary.technical_approach: 先用 EmbedLens 识别视觉 token 角色，比较多种代表性剪枝方法的角色偏好；再改进 token-role 分配流程，设计 role-protected pruning 变体，观察保留不同角色 token 对下游性能的影响。
summary.experiments: 在多种视觉 token 剪枝方法上做角色偏差分析和受控剪枝实验；结果显示保留 non-alive tokens 有时能维持或提升性能。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Analyze how visual token pruning decisions in VLMs relate to the functional roles of visual tokens, and why pruning seemingly redundant tokens can hurt behavior.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis of visual token pruning; its main contribution is using EmbedLens-derived token roles to reveal biases in existing pruners and show that weakly semantic tokens are not always safe to remove.
summary_en.technical_approach: It identifies token roles with EmbedLens, compares role biases across representative pruning methods, refines the role-assignment procedure, and evaluates role-protected pruning variants that preserve specific token groups.
summary_en.experiments: It analyzes role biases and runs controlled pruning experiments across several pruning methods; preserving non-alive tokens sometimes maintains or improves performance. The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 视觉 token 剪枝的小分析，结论对 VLM 推理优化有边际参考；只看 role-protected pruning 的对照实验即可。
recommendation.en: A small analysis of visual token pruning; marginally useful for VLM inference work. Read only the role-protected pruning comparisons.

paper.title: DIVE: Dynamic Iterative Visual Evidence Construction for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Visual inputs in vision-language models (VLMs) are often encoded into substantially longer token sequences than text, making visual tokens a major bottleneck for efficient inference. Abundant recent methods address this bottleneck by scoring token importance and pruning low-scoring tokens in a single pass. However, one-shot scoring is insufficient because a token's prompt-relevant usefulness depends on the evidence already retained. Motivated by this insight, we introduce DIVE (Dynamic Iterative

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 中一次性视觉 token 评分无法考虑已保留证据、导致剪枝 token 与 prompt 需求不互补的问题。
summary.importance: 方法型工作，把视觉 token 剪枝重新表述为动态证据构建；对 VLM 推理加速有参考，但属于训练-free 的增量式剪枝改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DIVE，一个 training-free 框架：迭代选择当前 residual-conditioned score 最高的 token，更新视觉和 prompt residual 以折扣已解释证据，再重新评估剩余 token，形成互补的保留集合。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个图像理解 benchmark 上评估；摘要未给出具体模型、baseline 或数值结果，仅说明该 select-update-re-evaluate 流程用于构建 prompt-relevant visual evidence。

summary_en.core_problem: One-shot visual token scoring in VLMs ignores which evidence has already been retained, so pruned tokens may fail to complement the prompt-relevant evidence set.
summary_en.importance: A methods paper that recasts visual token pruning as dynamic evidence construction; relevant to VLM inference acceleration, but it is an incremental training-free pruning improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: DIVE repeatedly selects the token with the highest residual-conditioned score, updates visual and prompt residuals to discount explained evidence, and re-evaluates remaining tokens to build a complementary retained set.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on eight image-understanding benchmarks. The abstract does not report model names, baselines, or numeric results, only describing the select-update-re-evaluate procedure.

recommendation.zh: 训练-free 的迭代剪枝技巧，思路清楚但更像 VLM 推理工程改进；看 residual 更新公式和主表即可。
recommendation.en: A training-free iterative pruning trick with a clear idea, but mostly VLM inference engineering. Read the residual update and main table.

paper.title: Fewer Tokens, Smaller Cache: Reward-Coordinated Efficient Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel on complex tasks through long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, but their lengthy intermediate steps cause severe overthinking that inflates inference cost. KV-cache compression is a common solution, yet existing reasoning-oriented methods apply a uniform policy across the trajectory and judge compression only by what it removes from the cache. Two observations point the other way. First, a reasoning state's tolerance to context loss varies along the trajector

summary.core_problem: 长链推理模型的KV-cache压缩方法采用统一策略且忽略缓存压缩与生成侧token增长的相互抵消效应，导致推理成本节省被部分侵蚀。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出用过程奖励协调缓存压缩与生成侧token数的联合优化框架，指出压缩-生成的双向权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReCo（Reward-Coordinated Compression）框架，用轻量过程奖励估计器逐步骤打分，高奖励步骤保留更多上下文，同时在压缩预算和生成token长度间做联合优化。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未完整披露模型规模、数据集和具体提升幅度，仅给出方法动机和框架描述。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache compression for reasoning models applies uniform policies and ignores the tradeoff where smaller caches induce more generated tokens, partially canceling cost savings.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: first framework that coordinates cache compression and generation-side token budget under a unified process reward signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReCo (Reward-Coordinated Compression) uses a lightweight process-reward estimator to score each reasoning step, preserving context at high-reward steps and jointly optimizing compression budget against generated token length.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details (model size, datasets, numerical gains) are not provided in the available abstract; only motivation and framework description are present.

recommendation.zh: 压缩-生成双向抵消的观察有价值，但方法本身是推理侧工程组合，对预训练无直接启示，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The compression-generation tradeoff observation is useful, but the method is inference-side engineering with no direct pretraining implications; read the abstract only.

paper.title: ATFlash: Per-RoPE-Wavelength Attention Windows for Compute/Memory-Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: The attention score with rotary position embeddings (RoPE) decomposes exactly into a sum over its 2D-rotation frequency pairs, and each pair's wavelength limits how far it can discriminate position. Aligned with this structure, we propose the per-RoPE-wavelength distance window: it prunes the query--key inner-product terms beyond a wavelength-proportional distance. Unlike a sliding window, every key remains reachable, at least through the low-frequency pairs. The reduction rate is input-independ

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是另一类长上下文推理瓶颈：attention 计算量和 KV 读取带宽随序列长度增长过快。很多近似 attention 方法靠 token 级稀疏化或动态选择来减算，但常见问题是压缩率依赖输入、难以提前预算；或者直接让一部分 token 不可达，带来结构性信息损失；或者方法和某个 kernel 绑得太死，迁移成本高。ATFlash 试图给出一种更“结构对齐”的近似：不是删 token，而是利用 RoPE 打分在频率维度上的精确分解，对不同频率分量施加不同距离窗口，只裁掉那些在该距离上已经失去位置判别力的频率项。
summary.importance: 这项工作的价值在于，它把 RoPE 从“位置编码实现细节”提升成了可直接指导推理近似的结构先验。对基座研究员来说，关键启发不是一个新的 kernel trick，而是：如果位置编码本身具有多尺度频率结构，那么 attention 的近似不一定非得在 token 维度做 hard pruning，也可以在频率维度做更细粒度的裁剪。这样做有两个好处。第一，压缩率可预测，作者给出 closed-form reduction rate，部署时能提前知道算力和带宽节省，而不是像很多动态稀疏方法那样依赖输入分布。第二，远距离 token 并没有整体消失，而是仍通过低频 RoPE 分量参与打分，这比固定 sliding window 更温和，也更符合 RoPE 低频负责长程位置信息的直觉。它未必直接改变预训练 recipe，但会影响未来对 RoPE、长上下文外推、以及 inference-aware positional design 的思考。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在一个精确观察上：带 RoPE 的 query-key score 可以写成各个二维旋转频率对的求和，每个频率对都有自己的波长 λ_r。高频分量波长短，只能在近距离区分相对位置；低频分量波长长，能在更远距离保持位置判别力。作者据此提出 per-RoPE-wavelength distance window：对第 r 个频率对，只在相对距离 z 不超过 w_r = min(k·λ_r, N) 时保留其贡献，超出窗口就把该频率项从 score sum 中裁掉。

这里最重要的点有三个。

第一，它裁的是“score sum 里的部分频率项”，不是裁 token。本质上是 frequency-level pruning，而不是 token-level pruning。只要 N < k·λ_max，最慢的低频项仍覆盖全序列，因此所有 token 仍可通过低频通道被访问。

第二，它和 FlashAttention 类 kernel 的兼容性较好。作者声称该窗口可以实现为 online softmax reduction 轴上的切片，因此保留了 FA 类 kernel 的主体结构和数值路径，window 关闭时还能做到 bit-identical。这说明方法不是另起一套 attention 实现，而是在现有高性能 kernel 上做局部改动。

第三，方法只有一个自由参数 k，即保留多少个周期。k 越大，保留的频率项越多，近似越接近全注意力；k 越小，减算越强。作者默认 k=2，并给出 reduction rate 关于 N 的对数级闭式表达。这个“可提前预算”的特性，是它区别于 MInference 一类动态稀疏方法的重要地方。

从建模角度看，这个方法隐含的假设是：当某个频率对在某距离上已经发生周期混叠、失去唯一位置判别能力时，该频率项对注意力分数的贡献可以视为冗余。这个假设并不是严格由理论推出的，而是由 RoPE 结构和经验验证共同支撑。因此方法更像“结构化近似”而不是严格误差有界算法。
summary.experiments:
作者在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 和 Llama-3.2-3B 上验证，并把方法分别移植到 FlashAttention-4 prefill 和 FlashInfer decode。系统结果上，论文声称在 RTX PRO 6000 上，两个实现版本在所测 Llama 上下文长度范围内都超过各自 stock kernel，并且把理论可减算上限转化成了 85–96% 的实际收益。这说明收益不是某个特定实现偶然吃到的，而是方法本身与 kernel 结构较匹配。

精度和鲁棒性方面，作者给出两层验证。分布层面，非外推区间内可实现 37–48% 的 reduction，KL divergence 量级约为 10^-3。能力层面，in-text needle retrieval 保持 100% recall，并且在相同计算量下，相比 sliding window 有两个数量级的差距。这个结果很关键，因为它直接支撑了“保留低频长程通道比直接截断 token 更稳”的主张。

论文也坦诚给出边界条件：对结构化较弱、接近随机字符串式的 retrieval，统一使用 k=64 时虽然仍能裁掉 29% 项，但最坏情况需要把 k 调大才能回到 full-attention 分数。这说明方法依赖语义和位置模式的自然性，对极端人工构造的长程精确匹配任务更敏感。

另外，理论 reduction rate 与实测 reduction 基本一致，只差 1–2 个点的积分近似误差。这一点很重要，因为很多近似 attention 方法论文只给经验曲线，不给可部署的预算模型。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“理论动机—实现方式—鲁棒性验证”三段看。

先看方法部分关于 RoPE score 精确分解的推导，确认作者不是做启发式频带裁剪，而是从原始打分公式出发。这里要重点理解每个频率对的波长 λ_r 为什么能解释其有效判别距离。

再看 reduction rate 的闭式推导和对应实验图。若这部分成立，方法最大的工程价值就成立了：压缩率可预测、可预算。

然后看两类实验。第一类是 kernel 移植和实际加速，确认它是否真能在 FA4 / FlashInfer 上以小改动落地。第二类是 needle retrieval、KL divergence、benchmark 保真度，尤其要看它和 sliding window 在相同计算预算下的差别。

预计阅读时间 20 分钟左右。若只想快速判断方法是否靠谱，读 Introduction、RoPE 分解公式、主系统结果图、needle retrieval 结果即可。若关心是否能迁移到别的 RoPE 模型，再补实现细节和对不同 k 的敏感性分析。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper addresses the other major long-context inference bottleneck: attention compute and KV-read bandwidth growing too quickly with sequence length. Many approximate-attention methods reduce work through token-level sparsity or dynamic selection, but they often have one of three problems: the reduction depends on the input and is hard to budget in advance, some tokens become structurally unreachable, or the method is too tightly coupled to one kernel implementation. ATFlash proposes a more structure-aligned approximation: instead of pruning tokens, it exploits the exact frequency-wise decomposition of RoPE attention scores and prunes only those frequency components that should no longer carry positional discrimination at a given distance.
summary_en.importance: The main value is conceptual. It treats RoPE not as a positional-encoding detail, but as a structural prior that can guide inference-time approximation. For foundation-model work, the interesting idea is that long-context attention need not be approximated only in token space. If positional encoding already has a multi-scale frequency structure, then pruning in frequency space may preserve long-range access more gracefully than hard token truncation. Two properties matter. First, the reduction rate is predictable: the paper derives a closed-form expression, so compute savings can be budgeted before deployment. Second, distant tokens are not removed wholesale; they remain reachable through low-frequency RoPE components. That makes the approximation milder than a sliding window and more aligned with the intuition that low frequencies carry long-range positional information. It is not a pretraining recipe change by itself, but it should influence how people think about RoPE design, extrapolation, and inference-aware positional schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method starts from an exact observation: with RoPE, the query-key score can be written as a sum over 2D rotation-frequency pairs, and each pair has its own wavelength λ_r. High-frequency pairs have short wavelengths and can only discriminate relative position locally; low-frequency pairs have long wavelengths and remain informative at larger distances. Based on this, the paper defines a per-RoPE-wavelength distance window: for frequency pair r, keep its contribution only when the relative distance z is within w_r = min(k·λ_r, N); beyond that distance, drop that pair’s term from the score sum.

Three aspects are central.

First, the method prunes frequency terms, not tokens. It is frequency-level pruning rather than token-level pruning. As long as N < k·λ_max, the lowest-frequency components still span the full sequence, so every token remains reachable through at least those channels.

Second, it is designed to fit FlashAttention-style kernels. The paper argues that the window can be implemented as a slice along the reduction axis of online softmax, preserving the main kernel skeleton and numerical path. With the window disabled, the implementation is bit-identical to the stock kernel. That suggests a relatively clean deployment path rather than a full reimplementation of attention.

Third, the method has a single free parameter k, the number of retained periods. Larger k keeps more frequency terms and approaches full attention; smaller k gives more reduction. The default is k=2, and the paper derives a logarithmic closed-form reduction rate as a function of sequence length N. That predictability is a major distinction from dynamic sparse methods such as MInference.

The underlying modeling assumption is important: once a frequency pair has entered an aliasing regime at a given distance and can no longer uniquely discriminate position, its contribution to the attention score is treated as redundant. This is not a strict worst-case error guarantee; it is a structured approximation motivated by RoPE geometry and then validated empirically.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates on Qwen2.5-0.5B and Llama-3.2-3B, and ports the method into FlashAttention-4 prefill and FlashInfer decode. On the systems side, it reports that both ports outperform their stock implementations across the tested Llama context lengths on RTX PRO 6000, while recovering 85–96% of the theoretical reduction ceiling. That matters because it suggests the gains are not an artifact of one specific implementation.

On robustness and quality, the paper presents two layers of evidence. At the distribution level, in the non-extrapolation regime it achieves 37–48% reduction with KL divergence on the order of 1e-3. At the capability level, it maintains 100% recall on in-text needle retrieval, with a two-order-of-magnitude advantage over a sliding window at equal compute. This directly supports the claim that preserving low-frequency long-range channels is much safer than truncating tokens outright.

The paper is also explicit about a boundary case: retrieval over structureless strings is harder. With a uniform k=64, it still prunes 29% of terms, but the worst case may require increasing k to recover the full-attention score. That suggests the method is more sensitive on adversarial or highly synthetic exact-match tasks than on natural long-context workloads.

Another useful point is that measured reduction closely matches the closed-form prediction, within a 1–2 point integral-approximation error. Many approximate-attention papers show empirical savings without a deployable budget model; this one does provide one.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim is to read it in three passes: theoretical motivation, implementation path, and robustness checks.

Start with the derivation of the exact RoPE score decomposition. The key is to verify that the method is not a heuristic frequency mask, but is grounded in the original attention formula. Pay attention to why wavelength λ_r determines the distance over which a frequency pair can still discriminate position.

Then read the closed-form reduction analysis and compare it with the empirical reduction plots. If that part holds, the paper’s main engineering promise—predictable savings—holds as well.

Finally, inspect two experiment groups: kernel integration and quality preservation. The first tells you whether the method really drops into FA4 and FlashInfer with small diffs. The second tells you whether the approximation is safe, especially the needle-retrieval comparison against sliding windows under matched compute.

A practical skim should take around 20 minutes. If you only want to judge whether the idea is sound, read the introduction, the RoPE decomposition formula, the main systems results, and the needle-retrieval section. If you care about portability to other RoPE models, then also read the implementation details and the sensitivity to k.

recommendation.zh: 从RoPE波长结构出发的频率级裁剪比token级稀疏更有理论支撑，重点看§2分解推导和§3窗口公式，可与现有滑动窗口叠加测试。
recommendation.en: Frequency-level pruning grounded in RoPE wavelength structure is theoretically cleaner than token-level sparsity; focus on §2 decomposition derivation and §3 window formula, testable stacked with existing sliding windows.

institutions: Graduate School of Informatics, Nagoya University

paper.title: TaskPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression via Task-Guided Pruning
paper.abstract: Long-context inference with large language models is constrained by the linear growth of the key-value cache to sequence length. While pruning offers mitigation, prevailing methods determine query-specific token importance that cannot be reused across unseen queries. In contrast, we introduce TaskPress, a framework for task-guided, query-agnostic KV cache eviction. Instead of optimizing the cache for a single query, TaskPress constructs a reusable memory representation conditioned on a high-leve

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决长上下文推理中的一个 serving 问题：现有 KV cache pruning 多数依赖具体 query 的 attention，因此每来一个新 query 都要重新判断保留哪些 token，压缩后的 cache 难以复用。TaskPress 试图在任务级别而不是 query 级别构造一份可复用的压缩 KV cache。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究是间接相关，但有参考价值。长上下文模型的瓶颈不只在训练时的 attention cost，也在部署时 KV cache 的线性增长。TaskPress 提供了一个有意思的视角：如果一个长 context 会服务同一任务下的多轮查询，那么 token 重要性可以由“任务意图”提前估计，而不必等真实 query 出现。这个思路对长上下文数据组织、memory token 设计、task-conditioned retrieval、prefill/decode 解耦都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: TaskPress 的核心是用 task guide 充当 meta-query。在 prefill 阶段，把任务描述追加到长 context 后面，让任务描述 token 对 context token 做 attention；随后立刻丢弃 task guide 自身的 KV，只保留被筛选后的 context KV。具体打分分两部分。Key 侧重要性来自 task guide 到 context 的 attention map，形状为 Lt × Lc，作者沿 task token 维度聚合，并用一维 average pooling 捕捉局部连续片段的重要性。Value 侧重要性来自量化 scale factor γ。对于 per-token quantization，γ 与 value 向量的最大幅值成正比，可近似反映 activation outlier。最终 retention score 是 key score 与 value outlier score 的逐元素乘积。乘法的含义是：一个 token 既要能被任务语义检索到，也要携带较强的 value 表征信号。对于已知任务，task guide 可以由现成 LLM zero-shot 生成；对于未知或动态任务，作者用少量校准 query 做 evolutionary prompt optimization，自动搜索更合适的任务描述。
summary.experiments: 实验在 LongBench 和 RULER 上比较 query-agnostic 与 query-dependent 的压缩基线。给出的正文内容显示，TaskPress 在可复用 cache 的设定下优于普通 query-agnostic 方法，并接近或超过部分依赖具体 query 的 pruning 方法，同时避免为每个 query 重建压缩 cache。消融重点包括 task guide 的作用、量化 scale factor 作为 value outlier proxy 的作用，以及二者乘法融合的必要性。作者强调 scale factor 是 zero-cost 信号，因为量化 serving 中这些值通常已经计算并保存在系统路径里。当前提供的全文片段没有包含完整数值表，因此不应过度解读具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 20 分钟左右。重点看 Method 中四个机制：task-guided key importance、quantization-scale value importance、multiplicative scoring、task guide discovery。若只关心系统实现，可以看 prefill 时追加 task guide、随后丢弃 guide KV 的流程图。若关心研究启发，建议看 value scale factor 的消融，因为它把 serving 中已有的量化统计量转成 pruning 信号，这个连接比较实用。实验部分主要看 LongBench/RULER 上 query-agnostic reuse 场景，而不是单 query pruning 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a long-context serving problem: most KV-cache pruning methods estimate token importance from a specific downstream query, so the compressed cache cannot be reused efficiently for future queries. TaskPress moves pruning from query time to task time by building a reusable compressed cache conditioned on a task guide.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining is indirect but useful. Long-context capability is constrained not only by training-time attention cost, but also by inference-time KV-cache growth. TaskPress suggests that, when a long context will serve multiple queries under the same task, token importance can be estimated from the task intent before any concrete query arrives. This connects to task-conditioned memory, long-context data layout, prefill/decode separation, and possible designs for learned memory tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach: TaskPress uses a task guide as a meta-query. During prefill, the task description is appended after the context. The model computes attention from task-guide tokens to context tokens, and the KV entries for the task guide are immediately discarded after prefill. The retention score has two factors. The key-side score is derived from the attention map between the task guide and the context, with aggregation over guide tokens and one-dimensional average pooling to capture local spans. The value-side score uses the per-token quantization scale factor γ, which is proportional to the maximum magnitude of the value vector under per-token quantization and acts as a proxy for activation outliers. The final score is the elementwise product of key importance and value-outlier importance, so a retained token must be both task-retrievable and representation-rich. For known tasks, the guide can be generated zero-shot by an off-the-shelf LLM. For unknown or changing tasks, the authors use a small calibration set of queries and evolutionary prompt optimization to infer and refine the guide.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on LongBench and RULER against both query-agnostic and query-dependent baselines. The provided text reports that TaskPress improves reusable-cache compression over standard query-agnostic methods and remains competitive with methods that rely on a specific query, while avoiding repeated cache reconstruction for each query. The main ablations concern the task guide, the quantization scale factor as a value-outlier proxy, and the multiplicative fusion of key and value scores. A practical point is that the scale factor is treated as a zero-overhead signal because it is already available in quantized serving pipelines. The available full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so exact performance deltas should not be inferred beyond the reported qualitative claims.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 minute skim is sufficient. Focus on the method section: task-guided key importance, quantization-scale value importance, multiplicative scoring, and task-guide discovery. For system-oriented readers, the key detail is the prefill procedure: append the task guide, use its attention to score context tokens, then evict the guide KV. For research-oriented readers, the most useful part is the value-score ablation, because it turns an existing quantization statistic into a pruning signal. In the experiments, prioritize the reusable query-agnostic setting on LongBench and RULER rather than single-query pruning results.

recommendation.zh: §3.2用量化缩放因子做token重要性信号的设计很巧妙，可在内部长上下文推理优化中快速验证
recommendation.en: The design of using quantization scale factors as token importance signals in §3.2 is clever; quick validation in internal long-context inference optimizations is warranted

paper.title: ARCHead: Activation-Metric Residual Correction for Large Language Model Output Heads
paper.abstract: Weight-only quantization substantially reduces the storage of large language model (LLM) transformer blocks, but practical backends often retain the final language-modeling head (LM-head) in BF16 or FP16. Quantizing this projection naively can strongly perturb the vocabulary-logit distribution. We present ARCHead, a packed LM-head compressor that combines a quantized low-rank core, group-wise INT4 residuals, and a low-rank correction fitted in an activation-derived metric. ARCHead stores no dens

summary.core_problem: 很多量化方案压缩了 Transformer 主体，却把巨大的 LM head 留在 BF16/FP16；而直接量化输出头会明显破坏词表 logit 分布。
summary.importance: 这是一个推理与存储效率问题。对做部署和全模型压缩的人有实际价值，但对预训练方法论本身影响有限；更像补齐现有 weight-only quantization 的最后一块短板。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ARCHead：用量化低秩 core 表示 LM head 主体，再加 group-wise INT4 residual，以及在 activation-derived metric 下拟合的低秩校正项。目标是在不保留稠密 BF16 head 的前提下，尽量恢复输出分布。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，ARCHead 只用 BF16 head 存储的 25.6%，实现 3.7-3.9x 的 LM-head 持久存储压缩；relative perplexity 为 1.007，而同等存储预算的 naive INT4 为 1.14-1.16。替换 AWQ 或 bitsandbytes 留下的 BF16 head 时，额外 cross-entropy 只增加 0.006-0.007，吞吐变化小于 2%。没有涉及训练新模型。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 aiXplain, Inc 和独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Many quantization pipelines compress transformer blocks but leave the large LM head in BF16/FP16, while naive quantization of the output head badly perturbs the vocabulary-logit distribution.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference/storage efficiency paper. It is practically useful for deployment and full-model compression, but its impact on pretraining methodology is limited; it mainly closes a gap left by existing weight-only quantization schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ARCHead represents the LM head with a quantized low-rank core, group-wise INT4 residuals, and a low-rank correction fitted under an activation-derived metric. The goal is to remove the dense BF16 head while preserving the output distribution.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-8B-Base, ARCHead uses 25.6% of BF16 head storage, giving 3.7-3.9x persistent LM-head compression. It achieves 1.007 relative perplexity, whereas storage-matched naive INT4 gives 1.14-1.16. When replacing the BF16 head left by AWQ or bitsandbytes, it adds only 0.006-0.007 cross-entropy with less than 2% throughput change. No new model training is involved.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from aiXplain, Inc and an independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 做部署可看，但对 pretrain 研究员只需知道一点：LM head 不是可忽略尾巴，量化时它常是最后的精度瓶颈；读实验表即可。
recommendation.en: Useful for deployment, but for a pretraining researcher the main takeaway is simple: the LM head is not a negligible tail and often becomes the last accuracy bottleneck in quantization; the result tables are enough.

paper.title: OmniPack: Unified Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on audio-visual understanding tasks, but processing long and highly redundant visual and audio token sequences incurs substantial computational overhead, demanding aggressive token compression for efficient deployment. Existing methods often degrade at low token budgets: pre-LLM compression may discard structurally important and globally distributed evidence, whereas inner-LLM compression often underexploits query-

summary.core_problem: 全模态大语言模型处理长而冗余的音视频token序列计算开销大，现有压缩方法在低token预算下性能下降明显
summary.importance: 提出训练无关的两级token压缩框架，属于多模态推理效率方向的增量改进
summary.technical_approach: 在LLM前通过模态重要性、全局覆盖和相似性合并去除结构冗余，在LLM内通过文本引导进一步整合任务相关的多模态表示，实现两级协同压缩
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型规模、基准数据集及量化提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Omni-modal LLMs incur high computational cost from long redundant audio-visual token sequences, and existing compression methods degrade severely at low token budgets
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free two-stage token compression framework; incremental improvement in multimodal inference efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: Combines pre-LLM structural compression via modality-specific importance, global coverage and similarity-aware merging with inner-LLM task-relevant semantic refinement guided by text
summary_en.experiments: Model scale, benchmark datasets, and quantitative improvement not disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 多模态token压缩的工程性工作，思路常规，对纯文本预训练研究员参考价值有限，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Engineering work on multimodal token compression with conventional design; limited reference value for text-only pretraining researchers

paper.title: Shorter Reasoning, Earlier Answers? An Evaluation of Reasoning Interfaces
paper.abstract: Large language models often reason at length before answering, increasing cost and latency. Prompts and trained settings can shorten this reasoning, but a shorter trace may only show that the model stopped sooner. Here, we evaluate paired runs of the same question at matched reasoning horizons across 198 GPQA Diamond and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. We test a numeric/concision prompt that announces a token limit for Qwen3-14B and the trained effort settings of gpt-oss-20b and -120b. The Qwen prompt s

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是推理长度控制评测中的混淆问题：一个 prompt 或 effort setting 让模型更早给答案，并不等于模型在相同推理 token 预算下有更好的中间状态。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练本身不直接相关，但对 post-train 与 test-time compute 的接口有参考价值。它强调评测 reasoning control 时必须区分两件事：模型何时停止并提交答案，以及在固定推理 horizon 被截断时模型当前倾向于哪个答案。这个区分对训练短推理、RL 奖励设计、推理预算标定都有用。如果只看最终完成 trace 的准确率和长度，很容易把“更早停止”误读成“更高效地思考”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 matched-horizon paired evaluation。对同一道题、同一个模型的不同 generation condition，论文在相同 reasoning token horizon B 处比较答案，而不是只比较自然结束后的答案。它定义了多种 readout：natural-terminal readout 使用模型自然结束时的答案；standardized prefix-probe readout 在截断的 reasoning prefix 后接闭合模板，并用候选答案 logits 读出；generated-answer continuation 在截断后让模型贪心生成 final answer；common-context readout 用统一 answer context 回放不同条件的 reasoning token，以减少 answer-time prompt 差异。实现上使用 token-exact replay，避免 decode 再 tokenize 改变 prefix；候选答案评分汇总每个选项字母的有效 one-token spelling，并报告 argmax accuracy、conditional log loss、multiclass Brier score 和 valid-option probability mass。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖 198 道 GPQA Diamond 和 500 道 MMLU-Pro，模型包括 Qwen3-14B、gpt-oss-20b 和 gpt-oss-120b，并用 Qwen3-4B/8B 做测量校准，Omni-MATH-2 用于开放数学扩展。Qwen3-14B 的 numeric/concision prompt 可以把 reasoning trace 缩短约 12% 到 17%，但在 matched token limits 下准确率变化小且方向不稳定。另一个 concise/early-answer instruction 在 MMLU-Pro 512 token 预算下提升 3.8 个百分点；即使只看两条 run 都未完成的样本，也有 2.7 个百分点提升，但在 2048 token 时收益不确定。对 gpt-oss 的 low/medium/high effort 比较显示，低 effort 更早正确主要来自更早停止和提交，而不是在同样 horizon 下已经形成更好的答案。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 matched-horizon probe 的定义、Figure 1、Table A1，以及 readout 设计。实验结果可以优先看 Qwen3-14B 的 concision prompt、concise/early-answer instruction 的九臂 MMLU-Pro 实验，以及 gpt-oss effort setting 的对比。真正有用的部分不是某个 prompt 是否有效，而是评测协议如何把 completion timing、forced answer、common context 和 both-active subset 分开。做 reasoning SFT/RL 或评测推理预算的人可以细看候选 logit probe 的实现细节。
summary.authors_note: 从正文片段可见通讯作者为 Francesca Carlon，机构信息包含 VUB。其他作者和完整机构无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a confound in evaluating reasoning-length controls: shorter traces may mean that the model stops earlier, not that it has a better answer after the same amount of reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to post-training and evaluation than to pretraining recipes, but it is useful for understanding the interface between reasoning training and test-time compute. It separates answer timing from answer quality at a fixed reasoning horizon. This distinction matters for short-reasoning training, RL reward design, and benchmark protocols under token budgets. Final accuracy versus completed trace length is not enough to tell whether a control improves intermediate reasoning or merely changes the stopping policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core protocol is paired matched-horizon evaluation. For the same question and model, different generation conditions are stopped and evaluated at the same reasoning-token horizon B. The paper defines several readouts: natural-terminal readout for the answer produced by an uninterrupted run; standardized prefix-probe readout that closes a stopped reasoning block and scores answer candidates from logits; generated-answer continuation that lets the model generate an answer after interruption; and common-context readout that replays stored reasoning tokens under a shared answer context. Token-exact replay is used to avoid perturbing prefixes through decode-retokenize cycles. Candidate-logit scoring aggregates all valid one-token spellings of each answer letter and reports argmax accuracy, conditional log loss, multiclass Brier score, and valid-option probability mass.
summary_en.experiments: The main paired experiments use 198 GPQA Diamond questions and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. Models include Qwen3-14B and gpt-oss-20b/120b, with Qwen3-4B/8B used for calibration and Omni-MATH-2 used as an open-ended math extension. For Qwen3-14B, a numeric/concision prompt shortens reasoning traces by about 12-17%, but matched-horizon accuracy changes are small and mixed. A concise/early-answer instruction improves MMLU-Pro accuracy by 3.8 percentage points at a 512-token horizon, including a 2.7-point gain when both paired runs are still unfinished; the effect at 2,048 tokens is uncertain. For gpt-oss effort settings, lower effort tends to provide correct answers earlier mainly because it stops and commits earlier, not because its stopped intermediate state is clearly better at the same horizon.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25-35 minutes. Focus on the matched-horizon probe definition, Figure 1, Table A1, and the readout taxonomy. For results, prioritize the Qwen3-14B concision prompt, the nine-arm MMLU-Pro experiment for concise early answering, and the gpt-oss effort-setting comparison. The main reusable contribution is the evaluation protocol, especially the separation of completion timing, forced answers, common-context replay, and both-active subsets. Readers working on reasoning SFT, RL, or budgeted inference should inspect the candidate-logit probe implementation.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided text identifies Francesca Carlon as the corresponding author and includes VUB. Other authors and affiliations cannot be verified from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 控制变量评测做的很干净，打破长推理必然更准的直觉，做test-time scaling的同学应复现这个对照，只看§3实验setup和核心结果即可。
recommendation.en: This well-controlled evaluation challenges the intuition that longer reasoning always yields higher accuracy; test-time scaling teams should replicate this setup, skip to §3 for the design and core results.

paper.title: RestoreKV: Recovering Full-Cache Behavior Under Aggressive Query-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
paper.abstract: Query-agnostic KV cache eviction compresses a context once and reuses the resulting cache for arbitrary future queries, but performance can collapse under tight budgets. Existing methods primarily improve which original KV pairs are retained. We introduce RestoreKV, which complements this selection-based formulation with learned restoration under the same total KV budget. Our key insight is that, although the information lost through eviction is context-specific, the mechanism for generating its

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的一个很具体但很实际的问题：在 query-agnostic KV eviction 设定下，系统需要在不知道未来用户查询的前提下，先把整段上下文压缩成一个可复用的 KV cache。现有方法几乎都把问题表述成“在固定预算下保留哪些原始 KV 对”，也就是纯选择式压缩。论文指出，这个表述在高压缩率下会失效，因为很多对未来回答有用的信息并不适合靠少量原始 token 直接保留下来。真正缺的是一种预算内的“补偿项”：在 eviction 之前，利用完整上下文生成少量、上下文相关的 restore KV，用来弥补被删掉的信息。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在长上下文 serving 与模型记忆表征之间的接口。它提出了一个清楚的判断：激进 KV 压缩的瓶颈不只是 importance scoring 不够准，也可能是“只允许保留原始状态”这个约束太强。RestoreKV 把问题从 subset selection 扩展成 retained cache + learned complement，这个思路对后续做 prefix compression、memory token、context distillation、甚至训练期显式学习可压缩中间状态都有启发。量级上，它不是改写 Transformer 主干的工作，但在高压缩区间给出的恢复幅度很大，说明 cache 里确实存在可被小容量补码近似恢复的结构信息。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很克制。它不替换原有 eviction 方法，而是在其前面加一个单次 restore pass。具体做法是：先对完整上下文做正常 prefill，得到 full KV cache；然后插入少量 restore tokens，文中默认是 8 个，这些 token 在一次额外前向中可以 attend 到 full cache。这个 restore pass 只在构造压缩 cache 时运行一次，并通过 LoRA 适配过的注意力模块，把上下文信息写入这 8 个 restore token 对应的各层 KV 中，形成 restore cache。之后再按原始 eviction 规则，从真实上下文 token 的 KV 中选出剩余预算的 retained cache；restore cache 与 retained cache 拼接后，组成总预算不变的最终 cache。

训练方式是离线 self-distillation。教师模型是 frozen full-cache model，学生模型使用 budget-matched final cache。给定同一 context 和 query，优化目标是让学生在 answer token 上匹配教师分布。更新参数非常少，只训练 restore token embeddings 和 restore pass 中的 LoRA；backbone 与 base evictor 都冻结。这个设计有两个关键点。第一，restore 不是通用前缀，也不是把整个 prefix 重写成新状态，而是只学习一个小补丁，因此兼容已有 importance scorer。第二，LoRA 只在 restore pass 打开，后续 query processing 和 decoding 完全沿用原始压缩 cache 的推理路径，所以在线开销几乎不变。

论文里最有信息量的部分是组件消融。作者把收益拆成“restore token 自身记忆了什么”与“注意力侧适配学会了如何从 full cache 提炼补偿信息”两部分。结果显示，仅优化 restore embeddings，KVzip 在 5% 预算下从 38.2 提到 42.1，提升有限；固定 embeddings、只学 LoRA 可到 71.9；只适配 q/k/v 投影就有 72.4，接近完整 RestoreKV 的 73.2。这说明主要收益来自 attention-side adaptation，而不是把常识或模板塞进几个特殊 token 里。换句话说，restore tokens 更像一组可学习的读写槽位，真正起作用的是它们如何从 full cache 中抽取并编码“被 eviction 后最容易丢失的补充信息”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面比较完整：4 个模型骨干、4 个长上下文 benchmark、5 种 base eviction 方法。论文强调的是一致性而不是只挑单一方法做最优结果。最醒目的数字来自 Qwen3-4B + KVzip：在 5% KV budget 下，RULER-4K 准确率从 38.2 提升到 73.2，恢复幅度很大。应用到 KVzip+ 时，在 KVPress Benchmark 上 16× compression 仍可达到 86.4 的 RULER accuracy。作者还展示了随压缩率变化的曲线：在轻度压缩时，base eviction 与 full-cache 差距本来就不大，RestoreKV 增益有限；压缩越激进，selection-only 方法掉得越快，RestoreKV 越能缩小 gap，这和方法动机是对齐的。

开销方面，32K context 下，8 个 restore token 带来的额外压缩时间只有 0.03 到 0.04 秒，不到总 compression time 的 0.5%；峰值显存增加 84MB，约 0.4%。这点很关键，因为很多 cache reconstruction 方法的问题不是效果，而是把 query-time 或 decode-time 路径改复杂了。RestoreKV 把额外成本限制在一次性 cache construction 阶段，因此更像工程上可插拔的增强模块。

从消融看，论文还验证了几个判断：一是 restore cache 的收益在不同 base evictor 上都存在，说明它不是绑定某个 importance metric 的技巧；二是预算分配需要平衡，restore cache 占比过小补偿不足，过大又会挤占 retained original KV；三是 attention projection 的 LoRA 已经覆盖大部分收益，提示未来若要进一步压缩训练成本，可以优先保留这一部分适配。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解作者到底改了什么：不是改 eviction score，而是在 eviction 前多做一次“生成补码”的 pass。然后看方法部分里 restore cache 的构造流程，以及训练目标如何用 full-cache teacher 做蒸馏。真正值得停下来看的，是组件消融和 budget ablation。那几组结果基本回答了三个核心问题：收益来自哪里、为什么不是 restore token 在硬记忆、以及 restore/retain 预算怎么分。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction 的问题重述、方法图、主结果表、component ablation、overhead 表。读的时候重点想两件事。第一，这个方法为什么能在不改 query-time 路径的情况下恢复行为；第二，它是否意味着 KV cache 里存在一种低秩或低容量的“补充表示”，可以由少量 learned slots 近似承载。后者对做训练期 memory token 或 context bottleneck 设计的人更有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical failure mode in long-context inference. In query-agnostic KV eviction, a long prefix must be compressed once, before future user queries are known, into a reusable KV cache. Existing methods mostly treat this as a pure selection problem: under a fixed budget, keep the most important original KV pairs. The paper argues that this formulation breaks down under aggressive compression. The issue is not only imperfect importance scoring; it is also the restriction that the compressed cache can only contain retained original states. What is missing is a small, context-conditioned complement that can be generated before eviction and used to recover behavior lost by dropping most of the prefix.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it exposes a representational bottleneck at the interface between long-context modeling and serving. The key message is that high-ratio KV compression should not be framed only as better subset selection. A compressed cache may need both preserved original states and a learned residual memory. That idea is relevant beyond serving: it connects to prefix compression, memory tokens, context distillation, and training-time designs that encourage compressible intermediate states. The empirical gains at very small KV budgets suggest that a nontrivial fraction of useful prefix information can indeed be reconstructed from a tiny learned complement.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RestoreKV is deliberately lightweight. It does not replace the base eviction method. Instead, it adds a single restore pass before eviction. The pipeline is: run normal prefill on the full context; insert a small number of restore tokens, eight by default; let those tokens attend to the full KV cache in one extra forward pass with LoRA-adapted attention layers; use the resulting per-layer KV states of the restore tokens as a compact restore cache; then apply the original query-agnostic evictor to the real context tokens and keep the remaining budget as retained cache. The final compressed cache is the concatenation of retained original KV pairs and the learned restore cache, with the same total KV budget as the baseline.

Training is offline self-distillation from a frozen full-cache teacher. For the same context and downstream query, the student using the budget-matched compressed cache is trained to match the teacher’s answer-token distributions. Only the restore-token embeddings and lightweight LoRA adapters are updated; the backbone model and the base evictor stay frozen. This design matters for two reasons. First, RestoreKV is a complement, not a rewrite: it preserves most selected original states and only learns a small residual cache. Second, LoRA is used only during restore-cache construction. After that, query processing and decoding are identical to the base method, so online inference cost is unchanged.

The most informative part of the paper is the component analysis. The authors separate gains from learned restore-token content versus gains from attention-side adaptation. At a 5% KV budget, optimizing restore embeddings alone improves KVzip from 38.2 to 42.1, which is modest. Keeping embeddings fixed but learning LoRA reaches 71.9. Adapting only q/k/v projections reaches 72.4, close to the full RestoreKV result of 73.2. This strongly suggests that the method works because the adapted attention mechanism learns how to extract a compact, context-specific complement from the full cache, not because a few special tokens memorize generic information.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is reasonably broad: four backbones, four long-context benchmarks, and five base eviction methods. The paper emphasizes consistency across settings rather than a single best-case result. The headline number is on Qwen3-4B with KVzip: at a 5% KV budget on RULER-4K, accuracy improves from 38.2 to 73.2. Applied to KVzip+, RestoreKV reaches 86.4 RULER accuracy at 16x compression on the KVPress Benchmark. The compression-ratio curves are also important: under mild compression, baseline eviction is already close to full-cache behavior, so RestoreKV adds little; under aggressive compression, selection-only methods degrade sharply, and RestoreKV closes a large part of the gap. That pattern matches the paper’s central claim.

The overhead numbers are small enough to matter in practice. On 32K-context evaluation, the eight-token restore pass adds only 0.03 to 0.04 seconds, less than 0.5% of total compression time, and 84 MB of peak memory, around 0.4%. This is a strong point of the design. Many cache reconstruction ideas improve quality but complicate query-time or decode-time execution. RestoreKV keeps all extra work in one-time cache construction.

The ablations also support several useful conclusions: the gains transfer across different base evictors, so the method is not tied to one scoring heuristic; the budget split between restore cache and retained original KV matters, indicating a real trade-off between residual capacity and direct preservation; and most of the benefit already comes from adapting attention projections, which suggests a cheaper training variant may be possible.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with Figure 1 and Figure 2. They make the contribution clear: this is not a better importance scorer, but a learned residual cache generated before eviction. Then read the method section for the restore-cache construction and the distillation objective against the full-cache teacher. The sections worth slowing down for are the component ablations and the budget-allocation study. Those results answer the main questions: where the gains come from, why the method is not just memorization in special tokens, and how much budget should be allocated to restoration versus retained original KV.

If you only have 20 to 30 minutes, the best order is: introduction, method figure, main result table, component ablation, and overhead table. The two questions to keep in mind are: why can this recover behavior without changing query-time execution, and does it imply that prefix information contains a low-capacity residual component that can be encoded in a few learned slots? The second question is the more interesting one for people thinking about training-time memory tokens or context bottlenecks.

recommendation.zh: KV cache优化的新思路，从「选保留」转向「选保留+轻量恢复」，看§3方法和§4实验即可
recommendation.en: Novel KV cache optimization combining eviction with learned lightweight restoration; read §3 method and §4 experiments only

paper.title: Rethinking Video Token Compression with a Global Codebook: Learning Once, Compressing Everywhere
paper.abstract: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) represent videos as dense sequences of visual tokens, whose length grows with the temporal and spatial extent of the input. These tokens often contain substantial redundancy arising from repeated visual patterns, leading to unnecessary computation in the subsequent language-model processing. Existing token compression methods, including pruning and merging, perform compression online during inference, repeatedly incurring additional computation for each i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Video-LLM 中视觉 token 过长的问题，但切入点不是再做一个在线剪枝或合并器，而是把“如何分组压缩视觉 token”的知识从单个视频中抽出来，预先学习成一个可复用的全局 codebook。核心问题是：视频中大量局部视觉模式会跨样本重复，是否可以把这种重复性离线建模，并在推理时用很低的额外成本完成压缩。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限，更偏向 VLM 推理效率和视觉 token 表示压缩。但它有一个有用的信号：视觉 token 压缩不一定要绑定下游 Video-LLM 的 attention 或重要性估计，也不一定要在每个输入上重新计算压缩结构。对于研究视觉 tokenizer、视频 token 预算、native multimodal pretrain 的人，这篇论文提供了一个可插拔的“全局视觉分组先验”思路。它不是重新训练视觉编码器，也不是学习离散视觉词表，而是在冻结特征空间中学习聚类先验，再用连续 embedding 的均值池化保持与现有 Video-LLM 的接口兼容。
summary.technical_approach: ONCE 的方法分成离线和在线两段。离线阶段先在冻结视觉特征空间中构造语料级 sketch。每个视频按时间轴分成 L 个 bin，避免只采到局部时间片段；sketch 数量按 m = min{N, clip(ceil(N/R), m_min, m_max)} 控制，其中 N 是源 token 数，R 是目标压缩比例。每个时间 bin 内使用 spherical Lloyd 聚类，得到归一化代表向量，并记录它代表的源 token 数量。随后把所有视频的代表向量汇总成带权 sketch 集合。为了避免常见场景和高频视觉模式占用过多 codeword，论文引入 balanced prototype fitting，并用源 token 数和类别频率修正形成 effective weight；没有类别标签时可退化为不做长尾校正。在线阶段给定一个视频，先用全局 codebook 找出当前视频支持度最高的 codeword，受预算 B 约束选择一组 codeword；然后把原始视觉 token 重新分配到这些 codeword，并对原始连续 embedding 做均值池化。关键点是输出仍然是连续视觉 token，而不是离散 code index，因此不需要改 Video-LLM 参数，也不需要针对每个输入做优化。
summary.experiments: 论文在 4 个视频理解 benchmark 和 2 个 Video-LLM backbone 上评估 ONCE，并与输入自适应的剪枝、合并类压缩方法比较。实验结论是 ONCE 在准确率和推理成本之间取得较好的折中，尤其在 token budget 较紧时准确率下降更小；同时由于压缩决策主要复用离线 codebook，推理阶段的额外开销更低。可用内容没有给出完整表格数字，因此不应把结果解读为某个具体任务上的绝对优势。更可靠的读法是：ONCE 的收益来自把 per-video 相似度估计和重要性估计改成 corpus-level grouping prior，而不是来自更复杂的在线压缩网络。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–20 分钟。重点看 Method 中的两部分：temporal corpus sketching 和 balanced prototype fitting；它们决定了 codebook 是否能覆盖长视频中的时间多样性和低频视觉模式。然后看在线阶段的 budget-aware selection、token reassignment 和 mean pooling，确认它为什么能保持与冻结 Video-LLM 兼容。实验部分优先看 accuracy–efficiency 曲线、不同 token budget 下的结果，以及跨 backbone 的迁移实验。对于预训练研究，最值得深挖的是：这种全局 codebook 是否可以前移到视觉 tokenizer 或多模态预训练数据构建阶段，而不是只作为推理压缩模块。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the long visual-token sequence problem in Video-LLMs. Its main question is whether video-token compression has to be recomputed online for every input, or whether recurring visual patterns across videos can be captured once as a reusable global grouping prior.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to multimodal inference efficiency than to language-model pretraining itself. Still, it is useful for researchers working on visual tokenization and native multimodal pretraining. The key idea is to decouple compression from model-specific attention scores or online token merging. ONCE learns a global codebook in a frozen visual feature space and uses it only as a grouping guide; the compressed outputs remain continuous visual embeddings. This makes the method compatible with existing Video-LLMs without changing their parameters.
summary_en.technical_approach: ONCE has an offline-to-online design. Offline, it builds a compact corpus sketch from frozen visual features. Each video is temporally stratified into L bins, and the number of representatives is controlled by m = min{N, clip(ceil(N/R), m_min, m_max)}. Within each temporal bin, spherical Lloyd clustering is applied to normalized token features. Each representative stores both its visual vector and the number of source tokens it summarizes. The corpus-level codebook is then fitted with balanced assignment, using source-token mass and optional category-frequency correction to reduce over-allocation to dominant visual patterns. Online, ONCE selects the codewords best supported by the current video under a token budget B, assigns dense visual tokens to the selected codewords using cosine similarity, and mean-pools the original continuous embeddings. The codebook provides grouping structure, but the downstream Video-LLM still receives continuous visual tokens rather than discrete indices.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates ONCE on four video-understanding benchmarks and two Video-LLM backbones, comparing it with input-adaptive pruning and merging baselines. The reported pattern is that ONCE gives a better accuracy–efficiency trade-off, with its clearest gains under tight token budgets, while reducing inference overhead because most grouping knowledge is learned offline. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so the safest interpretation is methodological: the advantage comes from reusing a corpus-level grouping prior instead of recomputing compression structure from scratch for every video.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the temporal sketch construction, balanced codebook fitting, and the online selection-plus-pooling procedure. In the experiments, prioritize accuracy–efficiency curves, results under small token budgets, and transfer across the two Video-LLM backbones. For pretraining-oriented readers, the interesting follow-up question is whether this global visual grouping prior should be integrated earlier into visual tokenizer design or multimodal pretraining data pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 codebook 训练和压缩-精度曲线；离线全局码本若稳，Video-LLM serving 可少一层在线启发式。
recommendation.en: Read the codebook training and compression-accuracy curves; if stable, this removes one online heuristic from Video-LLM serving.

paper.title: CURE: Local Uncertainty Repair for Block-Parallel Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding mitigates the latency of sequential generation in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) by interleaving draft generation with target verification. However, existing parallel drafting backends often suffer from rapid accuracy degradation over long horizons, leading to high rejection rates during verification and suboptimal wall-clock speedups. We observe that drafting errors are not uniformly distributed but typically stem from localized high-uncertainty tokens that des

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 block-parallel speculative decoding 的一个具体痛点：并行 draft 虽然便宜，但一旦某个位置出错，后面整段候选都会因为前缀校验而被连带拒绝，形成 error propagation cascade。作者的观察是，错误并不是均匀分布的，往往集中在少数高不确定 token 上。如果能只在这些局部位置做修复，而不是对整段做密集树扩展，就有机会在不把 verifier 成本推高太多的前提下，提高接受长度和端到端吞吐。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工作，不属于预训练核心，但对大模型系统研究有现实意义。它的价值不在提出全新的 speculative decoding 框架，而在把 block-parallel backend 的结构性弱点讲清楚，并给出一个训练无关、可插拔的修补机制。对基座研究员来说，启发主要有两点：一是 speculative decoding 的收益不只取决于 draft 模型整体精度，还取决于错误空间分布；二是 acceptance length 与 verification cost 之间需要做硬件感知的折中，不能只看理论接受率。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CURE，一个 budget-aware dynamic repair tree。输入是 block-parallel draft 一次性生成的长度 K 候选块及其 logits。标准单路径 speculative decoding 只验证这条主路径，一旦第 k 个 token 被 target 判错，k 之后的 token 即使本身合理也会被整体丢弃。CURE 的做法是先找出最可能引发级联拒绝的局部脆弱点，再只在这些点上分叉。

具体来说，作者用 top-1 与 top-2 log-prob margin 作为置信度指标，定位 Uncertainty Focal Points。margin 小意味着 draft 在该位置犹豫，局部错误概率高。然后在给定 verifier budget 下，只对这些位置生成替代分支，而不是对所有位置均匀展开候选树。这样做的理由很直接：如果大部分 token 都高度可预测，全面树扩展会把 target verification 的 token 数和显存占用迅速推高，浪费在本来就不会错的区域。

论文把这个过程形式化为一个受预算约束的 candidate-tree optimization：目标是在总验证预算 V_max 下最大化可接受长度。效率指标则写成期望接受 token 数除以 draft 成本加 verifier 成本。这个表述虽然不复杂，但把 speculative decoding 的关键权衡写得比较清楚：只有当额外分支带来的 accepted length 增益超过 target tree verification 的额外代价时，墙钟时间才会真正改善。

另一个实用点是 cache-resynchronization。因为 repair branch 可能改变被接受的路径，draft model 的内部状态需要与 target 最终接受的前缀重新对齐。作者设计了一个无需重训 draft 的 cache 同步机制，使 CURE 可以作为 plug-and-play 模块接在 block-parallel backend 上。这一点比单纯提出一个更复杂的树策略更重要，因为很多 speculative decoding 方法卡在工程接入成本高、需要专门训练 draft backend。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖代码生成主场景和一个 out-of-domain 推理任务。代码基准包括 HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench-lite，外域测试是 GSM8K。作者报告，相比单路径并行 draft backend，CURE 能把每步 accepted tokens 提高 4.2% 到 7.5%，相对 target-only 自回归解码实现 2.66× 到 3.49× 的端到端加速。

这些数字的含义要分开看。accepted tokens per step 的提升幅度并不夸张，说明 CURE 不是通过大规模树搜索硬拉接受率，而是在局部修补上做了较克制的改进；但由于 speculative decoding 的瓶颈常常是 memory-bound 的 sequential target pass，哪怕接受长度有中等提升，也可能转化成较明显的墙钟收益。作者还强调 acceptance–compute Pareto trade-off：repair 分支越多，接受长度通常越长，但 target verification 也会逐渐饱和，超过某个点后不再带来净加速。

从全文给出的信息看，论文的实验重点不是模型质量变化，而是系统层面的吞吐与接受率权衡。因此读结果时应重点看不同 budget、不同 block setting 下的曲线，而不是只盯住单个 speedup 数字。另一个值得注意的点是，方法在代码任务上更自然，因为代码 token 分布往往“整体结构稳定、局部变量和 API 选择不稳定”，正好符合 UFP 假设；GSM8K 的结果更多是在说明方法并非完全依赖代码域。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，30 分钟左右可以抓住主要内容。先看 Introduction，重点理解作者提出的 error propagation cascade 和 Uncertainty Focal Points 这两个概念。然后直接看 Methodology 里关于预算约束优化的定义，弄清楚它不是一般 tree speculative decoding，而是局部、受预算限制的 repair。接着看 cache-resynchronization 部分，这是方法能否落地的关键工程点。

实验部分建议重点看三类图表：一是 accepted tokens per step 的提升；二是 end-to-end speedup；三是 acceptance 与 verification cost 的 Pareto 曲线。若时间有限，可以跳过过多实现细节，只保留一个判断：CURE 何时比单路径 block-parallel 更划算，何时额外分支已经不值。

如果你做的是 serving 或推理系统，这篇的可读性会高于纯算法论文；如果你主要做预训练，它更像一个了解推理侧约束如何反过来影响模型设计的参考材料。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific weakness of block-parallel speculative decoding. Parallel drafting is cheap, but once an early token is wrong, standard prefix verification rejects the entire remaining block, creating an error-propagation cascade. The authors observe that these errors are not uniformly spread across positions. They tend to concentrate around a few high-uncertainty tokens. If repair is applied only at those local failure points, rather than through dense tree expansion everywhere, accepted length can improve without exploding verifier cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining contribution, but it is practically relevant for large-model systems. Its value is not in inventing a completely new speculative-decoding paradigm. The useful part is a clear diagnosis of block-parallel drafting failure modes and a training-free, plug-in repair mechanism. For foundation-model researchers, two lessons stand out. First, speculative-decoding gains depend not only on average draft accuracy, but also on the spatial distribution of draft errors. Second, accepted-length gains must be evaluated jointly with verification overhead; higher acceptance is not automatically better if target-side tree verification saturates memory or compute.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is CURE, a budget-aware dynamic repair tree. A block-parallel draft model produces a length-K candidate block and its logits in one pass. In standard single-path speculative decoding, only that path is verified. If token k is rejected by the target model, all later tokens are discarded even when many of them would have matched the target had the earlier local error been repaired. CURE tries to fix exactly those fragile points.

The mechanism starts by identifying Uncertainty Focal Points using the top-1 versus top-2 log-probability margin from the draft model. A small margin indicates local ambiguity and a higher chance that this position will trigger downstream rejection. Under a fixed verifier budget, the method spawns alternative branches only at these focal points instead of expanding a dense candidate tree over the whole block. The motivation is simple: if most tokens are already predictable, uniform tree expansion wastes target verification on positions that do not need repair.

The paper formulates this as a budget-constrained candidate-tree optimization problem. The objective is to maximize accepted length under a verification budget V_max. The effective generation rate is written as expected accepted tokens divided by draft cost plus verifier cost.
