While token pruning mitigates this issue, state-of-the-art subset-optimization methods typically rely on iterative subset construction to jointly capture visual diversity and instruction relevance. As visual token counts scale, this sequential dependency introduces significant selection overhead, severely li

summary.core_problem: 高分辨率 MLLM 会产生大量视觉 token，现有需要迭代子集构造的 pruning 方法虽然能降 FLOPs，但选择开销本身很重，难以兑现真实时延收益。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态推理效率问题，不是基座预训练问题。价值在于指出视觉 token pruning 的瓶颈不只在保留多少 token，还在选择过程是否可并行、是否会把理论压缩吃回去。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Single-Forward Pruner（SFPruner），把冗余控制直接编码进打分空间，用单次前向完成 redundancy-aware token 重要性选择，避免传统逐步/组合式 subset optimization。核心思路是把“多样性+指令相关性”的联合选择，改写成可一次性评分的结构化冗余建模问题。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可确认，实验重点是高分辨率 MLLM 场景下的 wall-clock latency 与 pruning 效果对比，主张相较迭代式 subset-optimization 方法能更好把 FLOPs 降幅转成真实加速。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度，因此结论强度目前只能视为中等。

summary_en.core_problem: High-resolution MLLMs produce thousands of visual tokens, and existing iterative token-pruning methods incur large selection overhead, so FLOPs savings often fail to translate into real latency gains.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a foundation pretraining paper. Its value is in highlighting that visual token pruning is bottlenecked not only by how many tokens are kept, but by whether the selection procedure itself is cheap and parallelizable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Single-Forward Pruner (SFPruner), which embeds redundancy control directly into the scoring space and performs redundancy-aware token selection in a single forward pass, avoiding iterative combinatorial subset construction. The key reformulation turns joint diversity-and-relevance selection into a one-shot scoring problem.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments focus on high-resolution MLLM settings and compare wall-clock latency and pruning quality against iterative subset-optimization baselines. The claimed benefit is better conversion of theoretical FLOPs reduction into actual speedup. The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, so the evidence should be treated as moderate until the full paper is checked.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不大，但做 MLLM serving 的人可看：若实验真把 selection overhead 单独拆干净，方法比又一个“更会挑 token”的 pruning paper 更有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but worth a glance for MLLM serving: if the paper cleanly isolates selection overhead, it is more useful than yet another token-pruning paper that only reports FLOPs.

paper.title: Masked Distillation: Internalizing the Chain-of-Thought in Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) produce long, explicit chains of intermediate steps before generating a final answer at inference time. These intermediate traces dominate latency, memory usage, and serving cost, even though the final answer correctness is not causally related to the trace correctness and the trace length is not a reliable indicator of the problem complexity. This raises a natural question: can the computation expressed in these intermediate tokens be internalized into the paramete

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题很具体：长链式推理模型在推理时把大量计算外显成中间 token，带来线性增长的时延、KV-cache 和服务成本；但已有证据表明，中间推理链的“正确性”与最终答案正确性并不稳定同因，推理链长度也不可靠地对应题目复杂度。于是问题变成：能不能把这些由显式 CoT 承载的计算，蒸馏进学生模型参数里，让模型少想甚至不显式想，也能保住答案质量？论文进一步追问两个更难的问题：第一，完全去掉中间 token 后，性能损失到底有多大，是否依任务而异；第二，若完全内化做不到，保留一部分后缀式 scaffold 是否能在成本和性能之间形成更平滑的折中，尤其是在 OOD 条件下是否更稳。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口研究，这篇工作的价值不在于又提出一个“短推理”技巧，而在于把一个更根本的问题摆到台面上：显式 reasoning token 到底是训练时的脚手架，还是推理时不可替代的计算介质。论文给出的答案不是一刀切。它显示，CoT 的可内化程度强烈依赖任务类型与分布外泛化要求：在较封闭、可枚举结构更强的任务上，蒸馏学生可以吃下相当一部分教师推理信息；但在更难的数学 OOD 设置上，完全去掉显式推理会明显掉点，而保留部分 scaffold 能恢复不少性能。这对做 RL reasoning、test-time compute、latent reasoning、implicit CoT 的人都很重要，因为它把“是否需要显式 token”从口号问题变成了可测的 trade-off 问题。另一个实际意义是，论文比较了 masked distillation 与直接用 teacher rollout 做 SFT 的差异，说明训练目标本身会影响学生是否真的学到‘压缩后的内部计算’，而不是只学到答案分布。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 masked distillation。训练时，教师处于 thinking mode，看到问题 q 和完整推理链 r 以及答案 a；学生只看到问题 q，不看到中间推理 token，但要生成答案 token。关键不是简单做 hard-label SFT，而是让教师在给定 q+r 的条件下，对学生生成的答案 token 提供逐 token 的监督信号。也就是说，学生学习的是“在缺失 CoT 条件下，去匹配教师在拥有 CoT 时对答案分布的判断”。这比直接模仿 teacher rollout 更像一种条件不对称蒸馏：教师拥有额外上下文，学生被迫把这部分信息压进参数。

论文给了两个实例化版本。第一是 self-distillation：同一个模型既当会思考的教师，也当不思考的学生，重点看同架构下能否把显式推理压回参数。第二是 dual-model distillation：用 reasoning model 去监督另一个 non-thinking student，更接近实际部署里“强教师+便宜学生”的设定。

另一个关键设计是 α-suffix masked distillation。作者不把“有 CoT/无 CoT”当成二元选择，而是把教师推理链分成前缀和后缀。学生在训练时内化前面的 (1-α) 部分，只在推理时显式生成后面的 α 部分 scaffold，再输出答案。α=0 表示完全不显式推理，只答答案；α=1 则接近完整显式推理。这个设计很有研究味道，因为它把“推理 token 的作用”拆成了可量化的连续变量，能直接测性能-成本曲线。

从全文看，作者还专门比较了不同训练目标。一个重要对照是：如果直接拿 teacher 的完整 rollout 做监督微调，让学生学着输出答案甚至部分推理，是否能达到 masked distillation 的效果。论文的结论倾向于否定简单 SFT 替代，因为 masked distillation 的重点是让学生在缺失中间 token 的条件下对齐教师的答案分布，而不是复现教师表面轨迹。这个差别决定了学生学到的是“轨迹模仿”还是“轨迹压缩”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两个域：Math 和 Countdown，并显式区分 ID 与 OOD。Math 里用 GSM8K 作为主训练/测试域，MATH-500 与 AIME-25 作为更难的 OOD；Countdown 则设计 target-range shift 和 search-depth shift，考察组合搜索难度变化。训练设置同时包含 self-distillation 和 dual-model 两种。作者系统扫描 α∈{0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0}，因此结果不是单点，而是一整条 scaffold 长度曲线。

从结果趋势看，最重要的发现有三条。第一，完全内化并不普适。对较简单、结构更规则的分布内任务，α=0 的 direct-answer 学生可以接近教师，说明一部分 CoT 信息确实能被参数吸收；但在更难的数学 OOD 上，去掉显式推理后性能下降明显。第二，部分 scaffold 很有效。随着 α 从 0 增大到中间值，学生通常能以远低于完整 CoT 的推理长度，恢复相当大一部分准确率，说明后缀式显式推理可以作为“补足内部压缩失败部分”的低成本机制。第三，OOD 比 ID 更依赖显式 scaffold。也就是说，显式推理 token 的价值不只是帮助训练集内求解，更像是在分布外场景下提供一种更稳的 test-time computation 通道。

论文摘要截断了具体数字，给出的全文片段也没有完整表格，因此这里不虚构精确提升幅度。但从作者的实验组织可以确认：他们不仅比较最终准确率，还比较了不同 α 下的推理 token 开销，并用这些结果回答 RQ1-RQ4。消融重点包括 self vs dual model、不同 scaffold 比例、masked distillation vs SFT、以及 OOD 退化情况。若做研究复现，最该关注的是性能随 α 变化的非线性形状，而不是某一个 benchmark 上的单点最好结果。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三件事。

第一，读 Introduction 里四个研究问题和方法图。这里把论文真正要回答的东西讲得很清楚：不是单纯省 token，而是测“显式推理可被内化到什么程度”。

第二，重点看方法部分对 masked distillation 与 α-suffix 变体的定义。要看清教师和学生各自看到什么条件、监督信号落在哪些 token 上、与 rollout SFT 的差别是什么。这个地方决定了论文的技术含义。

第三，实验部分优先看按 α 扫描的主结果图，以及 ID/OOD 分开的表。阅读时不要只看谁分数高，要看三条曲线：准确率、显式推理长度、OOD 掉点。若有时间，再看 self-distillation 与 dual-model 的对照，以及作者对 Countdown 的分析，因为 Countdown 更接近“可控搜索任务”，有助于理解哪些计算更容易被内化。

预计 30-45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若只看一处，优先看 α-suffix 的主实验图表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question: large reasoning models externalize a large amount of computation into explicit chain-of-thought tokens, which makes inference latency, KV-cache usage, and serving cost scale roughly linearly with trace length. Yet prior evidence suggests that trace correctness is not tightly causally tied to final-answer correctness, and trace length is not a reliable proxy for instance complexity. The real question is therefore whether the information carried by explicit reasoning tokens can be internalized into model parameters, so that a student can answer directly, or with much shorter scaffolds, without losing too much capability. The harder part is not in-distribution compression, but understanding when full internalization fails, how much explicit scaffolding is still needed, and whether OOD generalization depends more strongly on visible reasoning tokens.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not just another latency-reduction trick for reasoning models. It reframes a deeper issue: are reasoning tokens merely a training scaffold, or are they an indispensable inference-time computational medium? The answer here is conditional rather than absolute. The paper shows that internalizability depends on the task and on the generalization regime. On easier or more structured settings, a student can absorb a meaningful fraction of the teacher’s reasoning signal into parameters. On harder math OOD settings, removing explicit reasoning hurts more, and partial scaffolding recovers a substantial part of the gap. That matters for work on RL-trained reasoning models, test-time compute, implicit CoT, and latent reasoning, because it turns the debate into a measurable performance-cost trade-off. Another useful contribution is the comparison between masked distillation and plain SFT on teacher rollouts: the training objective itself affects whether the student learns compressed internal computation or merely imitates surface trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is masked distillation. During training, the teacher operates in thinking mode and has access to the question q, the full reasoning trace r, and the answer a. The student only sees q and is trained to generate answer tokens without access to the intermediate reasoning tokens. The key point is that this is not simple hard-label SFT. The teacher, conditioned on q+r, provides token-level supervision over the student’s answer tokens. So the student is trained to match the teacher’s answer distribution under asymmetric conditioning: the teacher has the CoT, the student does not. This forces the student to compress information that was explicit in the teacher’s context into its own parameters.

The paper instantiates this in two settings. In self-distillation, the same model serves as both a thinking teacher and a non-thinking student, isolating whether explicit reasoning can be folded back into parameters within the same architecture family. In dual-model distillation, a reasoning model supervises a separate non-thinking student, which is closer to a practical deployment setup with a strong expensive teacher and a cheaper student.

A second important design is α-suffix masked distillation. Instead of treating reasoning as a binary choice, the teacher trace is split into a prefix and a suffix. The student is trained to internalize the first (1-α) portion and, at inference time, explicitly emits only the remaining α suffix together with the final answer. α=0 means direct-answer generation with no visible reasoning; α=1 approximates full explicit reasoning. This is a strong experimental design choice because it turns the role of reasoning tokens into a continuous variable and lets the paper trace out an explicit accuracy-cost frontier.

The paper also studies the objective itself. A key baseline is whether one can simply SFT on teacher rollouts and obtain similar benefits. The evidence argues that masked distillation is meaningfully different: the point is not to reproduce the teacher trajectory, but to align the student’s answer distribution when the student is missing the teacher’s intermediate context. That distinction matters if one cares about internalized computation rather than trajectory imitation.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover two domains: Math and Countdown, with explicit in-distribution and OOD evaluation. In Math, GSM8K is the main domain, while MATH-500 and AIME-25 serve as harder OOD splits. In Countdown, the paper introduces target-range and search-depth shifts to probe changes in combinatorial search difficulty. Both self-distillation and dual-model settings are evaluated. The scaffold parameter is swept over α∈{0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0}, so the main result is a curve rather than a single operating point.

Three findings stand out. First, full internalization is not universal. On easier or more regular in-distribution tasks, α=0 direct-answer students can approach the teacher, indicating that a nontrivial fraction of CoT information can indeed be absorbed into parameters. On harder math OOD settings, removing explicit reasoning causes a clearer drop. Second, partial scaffolding works well. As α increases from 0 to intermediate values, students often recover a large fraction of the lost accuracy while using far fewer reasoning tokens than full-CoT inference. This suggests that a short visible suffix can compensate for the part of computation that does not compress well. Third, OOD performance depends more on explicit scaffolding than ID performance does. In other words, visible reasoning tokens appear to function not only as a training aid but also as a more robust channel for test-time computation under distribution shift.

The provided text does not include the full result tables, so I will not invent exact numbers. But the experimental structure is clear: the paper compares final accuracy, explicit reasoning length, self- vs dual-model distillation, masked distillation vs SFT baselines, and OOD degradation patterns. For a researcher, the most informative object is the shape of the accuracy-vs-α curve, not the best single benchmark number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts.

First, read the introduction carefully, especially the four research questions and the framing around whether reasoning tokens are necessary at inference time. That section states the paper’s actual contribution more clearly than the title alone.

Second, read the method section where masked distillation and the α-suffix variant are defined. Pay attention to what the teacher sees, what the student sees, where the loss is applied, and how this differs from plain SFT on teacher rollouts. That is the conceptual center of the paper.

Third, in the experiments, prioritize the main plots or tables that sweep α and separate ID from OOD. Do not only look at the top-line accuracy. Track three quantities together: answer accuracy, visible reasoning length, and OOD degradation. If time permits, also inspect the Countdown analysis, since it offers a cleaner controlled setting for understanding which computations are easier to internalize.

A useful skim should take about 30-45 minutes. If you only read one figure, read the main α-sweep result.

recommendation.zh: 把CoT从显式输出改成隐式内化的训练思路很干净，重点看蒸馏损失设计与教师反馈信号的构造方式，适合做latent reasoning预训练的内部ablation参考。
recommendation.en: The idea of internalizing explicit CoT into parameters via masked distillation is clean; focus on the distillation loss and teacher feedback design as references for latent reasoning pretraining ablations.

paper.title: HiKV: Hierarchical Importance-Aware KV Cache with Hardware Acceleration for LLM Decoding
paper.abstract: With the rapid adoption of long-context large language models (LLMs), the continuously growing KV cache during decoding has become the critical memory bottleneck. To tackle this challenge, we propose HiKV, a novel algorithm-hardware co-design that exploits KV cache redundancy through hierarchical importance awareness. Algorithmically, HiKV compresses the KV cache at two granularities: Stage I evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed budget, and Stage II further loads only the significant element

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM解码阶段KV缓存随序列长度和batch规模线性增长，成为核心内存瓶颈；现有基于重要性的KV压缩仅在token粒度做驱逐，保留token的完整KV向量仍存在元素级冗余，且动态排序的计算开销大，缺乏算法与硬件的协同优化。
summary.importance: 算法-硬件协同设计的思路可延伸到长序列预训练的注意力内存优化场景；两级粒度的冗余消除模式为理解注意力稀疏性结构提供了实证依据，可为预训练中的稀疏注意力设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出分层重要性感知的KV缓存压缩与硬件加速协同方案。算法分为两阶段：第一阶段在固定缓存预算内，基于累积注意力得分动态驱逐不重要的token；第二阶段对保留的token，仅加载对注意力计算影响显著的向量元素，实现单粒度方法无法达到的压缩比。硬件上设计专用加速器，核心是可重构重要性排序器，可在第一阶段的堆式重要性维护和第二阶段的并行分块排序两种数据通路间切换，统一两阶段加速需求，仅增加8%的系统级面积开销。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文基准测试中，相比token级最优方法，在精度损失不超过1%的约束下压缩比更优；相比原始基线，解码阶段注意力计算最高获得7.95倍加速，能耗降低90%，在等精度约束下性能优于现有KV缓存优化方案。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第III节的两级压缩算法设计思路和第V节的系统级性能对比，可跳过硬件电路实现细节；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache grows linearly with sequence length and batch size during long-context LLM decoding, becoming the dominant memory bottleneck. Existing importance-based KV compression only operates at token granularity, leaving element-level redundancy in full KV vectors of retained tokens, and the high overhead of dynamic sorting lacks algorithm-hardware co-optimization.
summary_en.importance: The algorithm-hardware co-design principle can be extended to attention memory optimization in long-sequence pretraining. The two-level redundancy elimination pattern provides empirical evidence for understanding attention sparsity structure, which can inform sparse attention design in pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiKV is a hierarchical importance-aware KV cache compression framework with dedicated hardware acceleration. Algorithmically, it runs two complementary stages: Stage I dynamically evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed cache budget based on accumulated attention scores; Stage II selectively loads only significant vector elements from retained tokens, achieving compression ratios unattainable by single-granularity methods. Architecturally, a custom accelerator with a reconfigurable importance sorter switches between heap-based importance maintenance (Stage I) and parallel chunk-based sorting (Stage II), unifying two-stage acceleration with only 8% system-level area overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On long-context benchmarks, HiKV achieves better compression ratios than leading token-level methods under 1% accuracy loss. Compared to the vanilla baseline, it delivers up to 7.95× speedup and 90% energy reduction in attention computation during decoding, outperforming existing KV cache optimizations under iso-accuracy constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: focus on Section III for the two-stage compression algorithm design and Section V for system-level performance comparison; skip hardware circuit implementation details. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文 serving 的可以看；对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“token 级+元素级”双层压缩这个归纳值得记，先看方法图和质量退化表再决定是否深读。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim if you care about long-context serving; limited pretrain impact, but the token-level plus element-level compression decomposition is a useful design pattern—check the method figure and quality-retention tables first.

paper.title: Break Through the Compression Bottleneck: From Theory to Practice
paper.abstract: As the parameter size of language models continues to grow, effective model compression is required to reduce their computational and memory overhead. Existing compression methods suffer from bottleneck issues: when the compression ratio is increased, performance degrades significantly. Low-rank decomposition and quantization are two prominent compression methods that have been proven to significantly reduce the computational and memory requirements of Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintain

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个很具体但常被处理得过于粗糙的问题：低秩分解和量化能否无代价叠加，用来继续压缩已经接近瓶颈的 LLM。作者给出的结论是否定的。全文的核心不是再提一个压缩技巧，而是先证明两者并不正交，组合后会产生额外复合误差；再进一步说明压缩顺序会显著影响误差传播；最后针对组合压缩后激活离群值被放大的问题，提出一个低成本补偿方法 DAM。换句话说，它解决的是“为什么现有组合压缩在高压缩率下掉点很快，以及怎样把这个掉点收回来”这个问题。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在部署侧和训练后模型形态控制。很多团队默认低秩和量化是两种近似独立的压缩轴，因此会把 rank 降低和 bit 降低当成可简单相乘的收益来源。作者用理论和实验都指出，这个假设在权重-激活乘法层面并不成立，尤其当激活存在明显离群值时，误差会耦合放大。这一点对做高压缩 serving、边缘部署、蒸馏后再压缩、以及训练阶段考虑可压缩性的研究都有启发。贡献量级属于中等：不是新的基础建模范式，但对“组合压缩 recipe 应该怎么排顺序、怎么补误差”给出了较完整的解释框架。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分三层。第一层是非正交性分析。作者从张量近似和点积误差两个视角写出量化误差与低秩近似误差的组合形式，指出组合后的误差项不是简单相加，而会出现交叉项；因此“先做 A 再做 B”和“分别做 A、B 后叠加理解”不是一回事。第二层是顺序分析。论文推导认为应先做低秩分解，再对分解后的矩阵做量化。原因是若先量化，量化噪声会进入后续低秩拟合过程，低秩分解会被迫去拟合已经失真的矩阵，导致主子空间估计偏移；而先低秩再量化，相当于先提取主要能量方向，再对更小、更规整的矩阵做离散化，误差更可控。第三层是 DAM。全文强调组合压缩后性能下降的关键诱因之一是 activation outlier。低秩分解会改变层内表示分布，使少量大幅值通道更容易主导 block quantization 的 scale，进而压缩掉大多数正常值的有效分辨率。DAM 的思路是引入一个对角形式的“粘合”补偿，把一部分难以被低秩项和低比特量化共同表达的尺度信息单独保留下来。对角结构的好处是参数和计算开销都很低，不破坏原有矩阵乘法主干，也容易插入现有 low-rank + quant pipeline。就方法性质看，它更像一种误差重分配与尺度校正，而不是重新设计量化器。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文内容看，实验重点不是追求某个单点最优，而是验证三个判断：一，低秩与量化组合确实比“独立误差假设”更差；二，先低秩后量化优于反过来；三，DAM 能在高压缩区间把损失拉回一截。文中把现有经验瓶颈概括为量化在 W4A4KV4 以上还能维持较好性能，再往下掉点明显；低秩分解在压缩率超过 50% 后性能显著恶化。作者的实验就是围绕突破这两个瓶颈展开。虽然你提供的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但可以确认论文做了大量顺序对比、误差分析和 DAM 消融，并强调 DAM 在保持低成本和高速度的前提下显著改善组合压缩性能。阅读时应特别留意：是否覆盖不同模型规模、不同 block size、不同 rank、是否同时量化权重/激活/KV cache，以及 DAM 对 activation outlier 分布的具体改善证据。如果这些实验做得完整，这篇文章的说服力主要来自“误差机制 + 顺序实验 + outlier 诊断”三者闭环，而不只是最终精度数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按“理论结论是否真的支撑工程 recipe”这个问题来读。先看 Introduction，明确作者要推翻的假设是什么。然后重点看 Non-orthogonality 部分，尤其是误差上界推导和交叉误差项出现的位置；这里决定了论文是否只是经验观察，还是确实说明了两种压缩操作不可交换。接着看顺序分析，确认作者为什么得到 low-rank first 的结论，以及这个结论依赖哪些假设。最后看 DAM 章节和对应消融：一要看它补偿的是权重尺度、通道尺度还是激活统计；二要看它是否只在某一类模型或某一组 bit/rank 设置下有效。泛读大约 25–35 分钟；如果你在做量化、LoRA/低秩、或可压缩训练，值得把公式和实验图一起精读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical question that is often hand-waved in LLM compression: can low-rank decomposition and quantization be stacked as if they were independent compression axes? The answer given by the full paper is no. Its central contribution is not merely another compression trick, but a structured argument that the two operations are non-orthogonal, their composition introduces extra compound error, the application order matters, and activation outliers become a major failure mode in the combined regime. DAM is then proposed as a lightweight correction mechanism for that failure mode.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to deployment and model-form control than to pretraining itself, but it matters for foundation-model research because many teams implicitly assume that rank reduction and bit reduction can be traded almost independently. The paper argues that this assumption breaks once weight approximation and activation quantization interact inside matrix multiplications. That has implications for aggressive serving compression, post-distillation compression, and even training-time design if one cares about downstream compressibility. The contribution is moderate in scope: it does not introduce a new modeling paradigm, but it gives a clearer recipe-level understanding of how combined compression should be ordered and corrected.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three layers. First, the paper analyzes non-orthogonality from both tensor approximation and dot-product error perspectives. The key point is that the error of low-rank approximation composed with quantization is not just the sum of two independent errors; cross terms appear, so the composition cannot be treated as harmless stacking. Second, it studies ordering and derives that low-rank decomposition should be applied before quantization. The intuition is sensible: if quantization is applied first, the subsequent low-rank fit is performed on an already distorted matrix, so the principal subspace estimate itself is biased by quantization noise. If low-rank decomposition comes first, the dominant structure is extracted before discretization, and the later quantization acts on a more compact and regularized representation. Third, the paper introduces DAM, a Diagonal Adhesive Method, motivated by activation outliers. After low-rank decomposition, representation statistics can shift so that a few large-magnitude channels dominate block-wise quantization scales, reducing effective resolution for the majority of values. DAM keeps a diagonal-form corrective component to preserve scale information that is poorly captured by the joint low-rank-plus-low-bit approximation. The diagonal structure is important: it adds little compute and memory overhead and can be inserted into existing pipelines without redesigning the main matrix multiplication path.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text content, the experiments are organized around validating three claims rather than chasing a single best number: combined low-rank plus quantization is worse than an independence assumption would predict; low-rank-then-quantize is better than the reverse order; and DAM recovers a meaningful portion of the loss in the high-compression regime. The paper frames current empirical bottlenecks as roughly W4A4KV4 for quantization and around 50% compression ratio for low-rank decomposition, beyond which quality drops sharply. The reported experiments are designed to push beyond those bottlenecks. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so exact benchmark deltas cannot be quoted reliably here, but the paper repeatedly claims that DAM improves compressed-model performance while preserving low cost and high speed. When reading, check whether the study spans multiple model sizes, block sizes, rank settings, and whether it quantizes only weights or also activations and KV cache. The strongest part of the paper is likely the closed loop between theory, order ablation, and outlier diagnosis, not just the final accuracy numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it with one question in mind: does the theory genuinely justify an engineering recipe? Start with the introduction to identify the assumption being challenged. Then focus on the non-orthogonality section, especially where the cross-error terms arise and how the error bound is derived. That determines whether the paper is making a real compositional argument or just reporting an empirical interaction. Next, inspect the ordering analysis and note what assumptions are needed for the low-rank-first conclusion. Finally, read the DAM section together with its ablations: what exactly is being corrected, weight scale, channel scale, or activation statistics, and how robust is the gain across bit-width and rank settings? A quick pass should take 25–35 minutes; a careful read is worthwhile if you work on quantization, low-rank adaptation, or compression-aware training.

recommendation.zh: 压缩论文里少见地先把“误差独立”这个偷懒假设拆了；读理论部分和交互实验，别只看最终压缩率。
recommendation.en: Unusually useful for a compression paper because it attacks the lazy independence assumption; read the theory and interaction ablations, not just the final compression ratio.

paper.title: Dropping the Anchor: Statistical Context Summarization for Distributed Systems via Pulsar Attention
paper.abstract: Inference with large language models (LLMs) on long sequences is computationally expensive due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Distributed blockwise methods such as Star Attention reduce this cost by sharding context across hosts, but rely on prepending a static, content-blind copy of the first block to every host. We propose Pulsar Attention, which replaces the static anchor with two lightweight, content-aware components: a small attention-sink prefix that stabilizes softmax, and

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理中的分布式块式注意力通常依赖静态首块锚点，既内容盲又浪费算力；这篇工作要在不增加 KV cache 的前提下改进跨块摘要与稳定性。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的结构改进。价值不在于提出全新主干架构，而在于指出 blockwise long-context attention 里“固定 anchor”这个设计并不必要，内容感知摘要可以同时带来更低 FLOPs 和更好精度。对做长上下文 serving、分布式注意力和 attention sink 机制的人有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Pulsar Attention，用两个轻量组件替代 Star Attention 的静态 anchor：一是小型 attention-sink prefix，用来稳定 softmax；二是基于 Max-IDF 启发式的紧凑 cross-block summaries，优先选择包含全局稀有 token 的 chunk 作为跨块代表。这样在保持相同 KV cache footprint 的同时，减少 Phase 1 的每 GPU FLOPs。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，于 RULER 和 BABILong 做最长 128K token 的评测。相对 Star Attention，Phase 1 per-GPU FLOPs 最多下降 3.3×；相对 dense attention 和 Star Attention，在长序列上都有更好结果，摘要称对 dense baseline 的绝对提升最高可达 4.7%。实验聚焦推理阶段，没有训练侧分析。

summary_en.core_problem: Distributed blockwise attention for long-context inference often relies on a static first-block anchor that is content-blind and compute-inefficient; this paper tries to improve cross-block summarization and stability without increasing KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper with a structural tweak. The value is not a new backbone, but the argument that the fixed anchor in blockwise long-context attention is unnecessary: content-aware summaries can reduce FLOPs while improving accuracy. It is directly relevant to long-context serving, distributed attention, and attention-sink design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pulsar Attention replaces the static anchor in Star Attention with two lightweight components: a small attention-sink prefix to stabilize softmax, and compact cross-block summaries built with a Max-IDF heuristic that selects chunks containing globally rare tokens. This keeps the KV-cache footprint unchanged while reducing per-GPU Phase-1 FLOPs.
summary_en.experiments: Using Llama-3.1-8B on RULER and BABILong up to 128K tokens, the method reports up to 3.3× lower Phase-1 per-GPU FLOPs than Star Attention. It also outperforms both Star Attention and dense attention on long-sequence evaluations, with up to 4.7% absolute gains over the dense baseline. The study is inference-only and does not analyze training-time effects.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式级工作，但它把“首块静态锚点”这个默认设计拆掉了；若你做长上下文 serving，只看方法图和 RULER/BABILong 表就够。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it usefully challenges the default static-anchor design in blockwise attention; for long-context serving, the method figure and the RULER/BABILong tables are enough.

paper.title: C-PTQ: Fisher-weighted Channel-wise Sensitivity for Post-training Quantization of MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require huge memory and computational costs, which limits their practical deployment. Post-training quantization (PTQ) techniques offer an efficient solution for model compression and inference acceleration. Yet, the quantized model faces performance degradation due to outlier channels, which are highly sensitive to quantization and substantially impair activation fidelity and task accuracy. To protect these salient channels during quantization, existing

summary.core_problem: MLLM 后训练量化中，少数敏感 outlier channel 会放大量化误差，导致激活保真度和任务性能下降。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理压缩方法改进。它把通道重要性从模态级或 token 级启发式指标，改成与任务损失扰动更直接相关的 Fisher 加权敏感度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 C-PTQ，一种通道级 PTQ 方法。方法利用二阶信息动机，用 Fisher 加权估计各 channel 对任务损失的敏感度，并将该敏感度与量化误差结合，用于指导 channel-wise scaling，保护关键通道。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、量化 bit 数、任务集和提升幅度。实验目标是比较 C-PTQ 与现有 MLLM PTQ/CWS 方法在任务准确率和激活保真度上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles degradation in MLLM post-training quantization caused by outlier channels that are highly sensitive to quantization.
summary_en.importance: It is an inference-compression method contribution. The key change is to replace modality- or token-level heuristics with a Fisher-weighted channel sensitivity estimate tied more directly to task loss perturbation.
summary_en.technical_approach: C-PTQ estimates channel-wise sensitivity using a Fisher-weighted second-order motivation, then combines this with quantization error to guide channel-wise scaling and protect salient channels during PTQ.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, bit widths, benchmark names, or numeric gains. The intended comparison is against existing MLLM PTQ and channel-wise scaling methods on task accuracy and activation fidelity.

recommendation.zh: 量化论文里较干净地把 Fisher sensitivity 接到 CWS；看方法式子即可。
recommendation.en: A reasonably clean Fisher-sensitivity variant for CWS in PTQ; read the equations, not the whole paper.

paper.title: KroQuant: Kronecker-Structured Block Transforms for Efficient Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) of diffusion transformers (DiTs) to W4A4 severely degrades output quality, because activations entering each linear layer contain outliers that 4-bit formats cannot represent. The standard fix applies an invertible linear transform to the activations and its inverse to the weights before quantizing both. Normalization layers between blocks force this transform to run online at every denoising step, making its inference computation cost the binding design constrai

summary.core_problem: 扩散 Transformer 的 W4A4 后训练量化在激活 outlier 存在时显著掉质，而高质量的“激活变换+权重逆变换”方案又会引入每步在线计算开销。
summary.importance: 属于推理侧效率/量化工程：把“量化精度 vs 在线变换成本”的矛盾讲清，并给出结构化变换的折中点；对做多模态/扩散统一建模的部署有参考，但不直接推进 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Kronecker 结构的 block 变换（可逆线性变换的结构化近似），试图在 SmoothQuant（便宜但精度差）与全维可学习变换（精度好但每层每步 dense GEMM 太贵）之间取得更优的质量-成本折中；动机来自归一化层导致变换需在每个 denoising step 在线执行。
summary.experiments: 面向 DiT 的 PTQ，目标 W4A4；对比 per-channel scaling、Hadamard、learned full-d transform 等路线，报告生成质量退化与推理开销权衡（摘要未给出具体模型/数据/指标数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: W4A4 post-training quantization of diffusion Transformers degrades quality due to activation outliers, while high-accuracy invertible activation/weight transforms are too expensive to run online at every denoising step.
summary_en.importance: Inference-efficiency/quantization engineering: clarifies the accuracy-vs-online-transform-cost trade-off and proposes a structured transform as a practical middle ground; indirectly relevant for deploying diffusion-style components, not for core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: KroQuant uses Kronecker-structured block transforms as a structured approximation to learned full-d invertible transforms, aiming to retain quantization fidelity without paying a dense GEMM per layer per step; the need for online execution is driven by normalization layers between blocks.
summary_en.experiments: PTQ for DiTs at W4A4; compares against per-channel scaling (SmoothQuant), fixed Hadamard transforms, and learned full-d transforms, reporting quality vs inference cost trade-offs (no concrete numbers in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 量化论文里少见地把“归一化→每步在线变换”这个真实瓶颈点出来；只看方法动机和成本模型即可，别指望对预训练有直接增益。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the very practical point that normalization forces per-step online transforms in DiTs; read the motivation/cost trade-off, but don’t expect pretraining insights.

paper.title: Routing Without Training: Controllable-Ratio LLM Offloading via Reliability Gating
paper.abstract: Local-cloud collaboration is a practical way to deploy large language models under resource constraints, but existing methods often rely on trained routers or collaboration-aware finetuning that tie routing behavior to a particular operating regime. In this work, we show that such training may be unnecessary: the local model's own inference-time agreement across sampled responses already provides a strong signal for deciding when to trust local execution and when to offload to a stronger cloud m

summary.core_problem: 本地-云端协同LLM部署中，现有路由方法依赖训练好的路由器或协同感知微调，路由行为与特定运行机制绑定，灵活性差。
summary.importance: 提出无需训练的卸载路由框架，属于推理效率与部署优化方向的增量创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CARGO框架，利用本地模型在不同prompt变体下采样响应的一致性作为置信信号，通过贝叶斯早停实现样本高效的不确定性控制，并支持部署时轻量校准以达到任意目标协同比例。
summary.experiments: 在多种推理和QA任务、多个本地LLM家族与规模、预训练和微调本地模型上，一致优于其他无训练基线。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing local-cloud LLM offloading methods rely on trained routers or collaboration-aware finetuning that lock routing behavior to specific operating regimes.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free offloading routing framework, an incremental contribution in inference efficiency and deployment optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARGO estimates local model reliability via agreement across prompt-varied sampling, uses Bayesian early stopping for sample-efficient uncertainty control, and supports arbitrary target collaboration ratios via lightweight deployment-time calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Consistently outperforms other training-free baselines across diverse reasoning and QA tasks, multiple local LLM families and scales, and both pretrained and finetuned local models.

recommendation.zh: 推理部署侧的小创新，核心insight是prompt变体采样一致性可做路由信号，看摘要和实验表即可。
recommendation.en: A minor inference deployment innovation; core insight is that prompt-varied sampling agreement serves as a routing signal—read abstract and result tables only.

paper.title: MiniCache: Reusable Program Caching with Small Model Interfaces for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for program-aided reasoning, agentic decision making, and structured task execution, but these applications often incur high inference cost. We present MiniCache, a reusable program caching framework that transforms Program-of-Thought (PoT) programs into parameterized cache objects, enabling reusable computation across structurally similar requests. MiniCache reuses the same small model for semantic variable extraction on cache-hit requests and

summary.core_problem: 程序辅助推理和 Agent 场景下，LLM 重复生成结构相似的程序导致推理成本高、延迟大。
summary.importance: 推理效率方向的工程系统创新，提出可复用程序缓存框架。
summary.technical_approach: MiniCache 将 Program-of-Thought 程序参数化为缓存对象，用小模型做缓存命中时的语义变量提取和目标 LLM 生成时的推测草稿，减少大模型调用。
summary.experiments: 在 shopping-style 数据集、WebShop、Formula、CodeTAT-QA 上测试，延迟最高降 3.1x，吞吐最高升 2.8x，精度基本保持。

summary_en.core_problem: Program-aided reasoning and agent workflows repeatedly generate structurally similar programs, leading to high LLM inference cost and latency.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system innovation in inference efficiency; proposes a reusable program caching framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: MiniCache parameterizes PoT programs into reusable cache objects and uses a small model both for semantic variable extraction on cache hits and for speculative drafting during target LLM generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on shopping-style datasets, WebShop, Formula, and CodeTAT-QA; achieves up to 3.1x lower latency and 2.8x higher throughput with minimal accuracy loss.

recommendation.zh: 小模型做缓存+推测解码的组合思路有启发，但属于推理侧工程，对预训练研究无直接影响，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The small-model cache + speculation combination is interesting but purely inference-side engineering; read only the abstract.

paper.title: LISA: Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent advances in long chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 have led to increasingly longer inference context lengths under the test-time scaling paradigm. However, the O(n^2) computational complexity of standard self-attention causes inference costs to grow sharply with long sequences, limiting the deployment of long-CoT reasoning in production settings. To address this, we propose LISA (Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention), a plug-and-play attention replacement module that requir

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很现实的问题：推理模型在 test-time scaling 下会生成很长的 CoT，准确率往往随思维链长度上升，但标准 softmax attention 的计算和缓存成本也随上下文迅速变重。已有两类路子都不理想：一类是直接让模型少想、短想，代价是推理能力容易掉；另一类是用纯线性注意力或状态压缩替代全注意力，代价是精确检索能力不足，尤其在数学推理这类强依赖局部关键 token 回看的任务上容易失真。LISA要解决的核心矛盾，就是在不从头预训练、不改模型主体参数和输出格式的前提下，把长上下文推理的每步成本压到近似常数，同时尽量保住甚至提升 reasoning quality。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它不是单纯的 serving 工程优化，而是在推理阶段重新设计 attention 记忆机制：用线性状态承载全局历史，用固定预算的稀疏精确检索保住关键上下文访问。这种“粗记忆 + 精索引”的组合，对长上下文预训练和新型记忆架构都有启发。第二，它证明了 attention 替换模块可以通过较轻量的后训练接入现有模型，而不必重新做大规模预训练，这对已有大模型的架构演化很重要。第三，论文的结果不只是省算力，还出现了质量提升，说明全注意力在长 CoT 场景下未必总是最优；适当的结构偏置可能反而改善长程推理中的噪声累积和注意力扩散。这一点对未来 pretrain 阶段是否要显式引入分层记忆、稀疏检索或 recurrent state，很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，LISA把原来的 self-attention 替换成并联的两条支路。第一条是 linear attention，用一个递推状态矩阵 S_t 累积历史 K/V 信息，承担全局长程记忆。它的优点是每步更新和读取都不随序列长度增长，时间近似 O(1)，内存也是常数级；缺点是缺少 softmax attention 那种基于内容的精确索引能力。第二条是 Lightning Indexer，对历史 token 做重要性打分，从中动态选出 top-M 个 token，保留一个固定大小的精确 self-attention 视野。这样，模型既能通过线性状态保留“全局背景”，又能对少量关键 token 做高保真回看。

关键不在于简单拼接两种注意力，而在于训练方式。论文采用两阶段训练。第一阶段先只训练 linear attention 分支，用纯 cross-entropy 冷启动，让线性状态先学会承接原模型的基本语言建模与推理分布。作者强调不用一开始就做 teacher KL，是为了避免线性分支过早过拟合教师分布表面形态，学不到自己的稳定记忆表示。第二阶段再引入 indexer 和 top-M 选择，同时加入 KL 蒸馏，稳定重要 token 的选择和整体输出分布。这里的直觉是：索引器一旦参与，离散 top-M 选择会让训练更敏感，KL 可以把替换后模块的行为锚定在原模型附近，减少训练震荡。

从设计取舍看，LISA与纯 sparse attention 不同。纯稀疏方法通常需要预定义窗口、块结构或复杂检索规则，长程遗漏风险较高；LISA用 linear state 兜底全局信息。它也不同于纯 linear attention，后者虽然便宜，但在需要精确定位某一步中间结果、变量定义或约束条件时容易失败；LISA用固定预算的 full attention 弥补这一点。它还不同于需要特殊数据预处理的 state compression 方法，接入路径更接近模块替换 + 轻量训练，工程上更现实。
summary.experiments:
实验主要围绕长上下文数学推理展开，覆盖五个 benchmark。论文给出的核心结论有两个：一是效率，二是质量。效率上，在 16K context 条件下，LISA相对 full self-attention 最多可减少约 50% 的推理成本。这里的收益来自两部分：attention 计算从随长度增长转为固定预算的 sparse retrieval 加常数状态更新，以及 KV/cache 压力显著下降。质量上，作者报告平均准确率比 full attention baseline 还高 5.6%。这点比单纯“几乎不掉点”更值得注意，说明模块替换并没有只是做近似，而可能在长 CoT 下改善了信息利用方式。

从消融逻辑看，论文重点验证了几件事。第一，单独使用 linear attention 不够，尤其在上下文敏感任务上会明显弱于混合方案；这支持了“全局记忆需要配合精确索引”的判断。第二，top-M 的固定大小检索是有效的，M 太小会损伤精确回看，M 增大则质量提升趋缓但成本上升，存在明显的效率-性能拐点。第三，两阶段训练优于一步到位联合训练，说明先让线性状态稳定，再学习索引器，是更容易收敛的路径。第四，KL 在第二阶段有稳定作用，尤其对 indexer 的 token 选择和最终输出分布更有帮助。

摘要里没有完整列出参数规模、训练 token 数和每个 benchmark 的逐项数字；如果按全文阅读，建议重点核对实验章节中的模型底座、替换层范围、训练步数、M 的具体设置、以及不同上下文长度下的 latency/accuracy 曲线。这些细节决定了结果更偏“架构有效”还是“特定 recipe 调得好”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Method 总览，抓住它要解决的不是一般长上下文建模，而是 long-CoT reasoning 的推理成本问题。然后重点看方法图和 attention 替换公式，理解 linear state 与 top-M 精确检索各自负责什么。真正值得精读的是两阶段训练部分：为什么第一阶段只用 CE，为什么第二阶段再加 KL，这里体现了作者对训练动态的判断。

实验部分优先看三类图表。第一类是不同 context length 下的准确率与成本曲线，判断它是否真的在长序列区间建立了更好的 Pareto。第二类是消融：去掉 indexer、只保留 linear attention、改变 M、改变训练阶段设置。第三类是案例分析，尤其是数学推理中需要回看早期条件、变量赋值、子结论的样例，这能直观看出 LISA为何比纯线性方案稳。

如果时间有限，30-40 分钟可以读完主线；如果要深挖，建议把它和几类工作对照着看：一类是 Kimi Linear、DeltaNet 一类把线性/状态空间记忆重新带回语言模型的工作；一类是各种 sparse/retrieval attention；还有一类是专门压缩 CoT 或缩短推理长度的方法。LISA有意思的地方不在于它比这些方向谁更强，而在于它把“保留长思维链”与“降低每步成本”放在同一个结构里处理。

summary_en.core_problem: LISA targets a concrete bottleneck in reasoning-time scaling: stronger reasoning models tend to generate much longer chains of thought, but standard softmax self-attention makes inference cost grow sharply with sequence length. Existing fixes usually fall into two unsatisfying buckets. One tries to shorten CoT, which often hurts reasoning quality. The other replaces full attention with linear/state-compressed mechanisms, which are cheaper but weak at precise content-based retrieval. LISA addresses the tension directly: keep long-CoT reasoning intact, avoid pretraining from scratch, and replace full attention with a hybrid module whose per-step cost is effectively constant while preserving access to critical past tokens.
summary_en.importance: The contribution matters beyond a serving trick. First, it proposes a memory design for inference-time reasoning: a global recurrent state for cheap long-range memory, plus a fixed-budget exact retrieval path for high-fidelity access. That is relevant to pretraining research because it suggests a viable inductive bias for future long-context LMs, not just an inference patch. Second, the paper shows that attention replacement can be retrofitted onto an existing model with lightweight post-training, instead of requiring a new large-scale pretraining run. That is important for architecture evolution in deployed foundation models. Third, the reported gains are not only computational. LISA also improves reasoning accuracy over the full-attention baseline in long-CoT settings, which suggests that unrestricted full attention may not be the best memory mechanism once sequences become very long and noisy. Structured memory can sometimes help quality, not just efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LISA replaces each standard self-attention block with two parallel components. The first is linear attention, implemented as a recurrent state matrix S_t that accumulates historical key-value interactions. This branch provides cheap global memory: update and read cost do not grow with context length, and memory usage stays constant. Its weakness is well known: linear attention lacks the sharp content-based indexing behavior of softmax attention.

The second branch is the Lightning Indexer. It scores historical tokens by importance and dynamically selects the top-M tokens for exact self-attention. This gives the model a fixed-size high-resolution retrieval set. The overall design is therefore a hybrid memory system: linear attention stores broad long-range context, while the indexer preserves precise access to a small number of critical tokens.

A central part of the paper is the training recipe. The model is trained in two stages. In stage 1, only the linear-attention branch is cold-started with plain cross-entropy. The rationale is to let the recurrent memory learn a stable predictive representation on its own, instead of immediately forcing it to mimic the teacher distribution through distillation. In stage 2, the indexer and top-M selection are introduced, together with a KL term to stabilize token selection and keep the modified model close to the original teacher behavior. This is a sensible choice because discrete top-M routing can make optimization brittle; KL acts as an anchor.

The design differs from pure sparse attention, which usually relies on predefined windows, blocks, or retrieval heuristics and may miss long-range information. LISA uses the linear state as a global fallback. It also differs from pure linear attention, which is efficient but often fails on tasks that require exact recall of earlier variables, constraints, or intermediate results. Finally, unlike some state-compression approaches, it does not require complicated preprocessing or a new output format, making the retrofit path much more practical.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on long-context mathematical reasoning across five benchmarks. The two headline results are efficiency and quality. On efficiency, LISA reduces inference cost by up to about 50% at 16K context relative to the full self-attention baseline. The gain comes from replacing sequence-length-dependent attention computation with a constant-cost recurrent update plus fixed-budget sparse retrieval, while also reducing KV-cache pressure. On quality, the paper reports an average accuracy improvement of 5.6% over the full-attention baseline. That is more interesting than a simple “small degradation” result: the hybrid memory is not merely an approximation, it can be a better inductive bias for long-CoT reasoning.

The ablations support the main design choices. Linear attention alone is insufficient, especially on context-sensitive reasoning tasks, which validates the need for exact token retrieval. The top-M budget shows the expected trade-off: too small M hurts precise recall, while larger M improves quality with diminishing returns and higher cost. The two-stage training strategy outperforms one-shot joint training, indicating that stabilizing the recurrent memory before learning the indexer is important. The KL term in stage 2 further improves stability, especially for token selection behavior and output consistency.

The prompt only includes the main claims, not the full table of model sizes, training tokens, or per-benchmark numbers. When reading the full paper, it is worth checking the base model scale, which layers are replaced, the exact M settings, training duration, and the latency/accuracy curves across context lengths. Those details determine whether the gains are broadly architectural or heavily recipe-dependent.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and method overview. The key is to see that the target is not generic long-context modeling, but long-CoT reasoning under test-time scaling. Then read the architecture figure and the equations for the hybrid attention carefully: understand what the linear state is expected to remember, and what the top-M exact attention is expected to recover.

The most important section to read closely is the two-stage training setup. Why stage 1 uses only cross-entropy, and why stage 2 adds KL after introducing the indexer, tells you a lot about the optimization dynamics of retrofitting new memory modules into pretrained LMs.

In the experiments, prioritize three things. First, the accuracy-versus-cost curves across context lengths: this shows whether LISA really improves the Pareto frontier in the long-sequence regime. Second, the ablations: remove the indexer, keep only linear attention, vary M, and compare one-stage versus two-stage training. Third, inspect qualitative math-reasoning examples where the model must revisit early constraints or intermediate derivations. Those cases make the benefit of exact retrieval much clearer than aggregate metrics alone.

If time is limited, the main line can be read in 30–40 minutes. For deeper study, compare it against three families of work: linear/recurrent memory LMs such as Kimi Linear or Delta-style approaches, sparse/retrieval attention methods, and CoT compression or shortening methods. LISA is interesting because it does not choose between long reasoning and cheap inference; it tries to support both with a single memory design.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构和训练替换细节；若无需从头预训练能稳住长 CoT，值得进内部长上下文推理 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the module and adaptation recipe; if it preserves long-CoT behavior without scratch pretraining, it deserves an internal long-context inference ablation.

paper.title: HeadCast: Casting Attention Heads for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models have become a promising paradigm for long and streaming video synthesis, but the continuously growing Key-Value (KV) cache makes attention the dominant inference cost, especially at high resolution where each frame contributes many tokens. Existing remedies either evict the cache with coarse heuristics that cause inter-frame flickering, or require model re-training. We propose HeadCast, a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration framework built on the

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 AR video diffusion 在长视频和高分辨率推理时的 KV cache 膨胀问题。随着历史帧不断累积，注意力计算逐渐成为主要瓶颈。已有做法要么用统一滑窗，仍然很慢；要么激进驱逐缓存，容易丢掉长程依赖，出现 flicker 和结构漂移；要么需要重新训练模型。作者的问题设定很明确：能否不改模型参数，只根据预训练模型里不同 attention head 的稳定行为差异，给每个 head 分配不同的缓存和注意力路径，从而在不明显伤害时序一致性的前提下加速推理。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理效率，而不是预训练本身。对基座研究的直接价值有限，但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把“head specialization”从分析现象变成了可部署的系统优化，说明预训练模型内部确实存在稳定、可利用的结构异质性。第二，它针对 AR video diffusion 这种统一 Transformer 推理栈给出训练后改造方案，这对多模态统一模型、长上下文缓存管理、以及 head-level routing 的研究有参考意义。若关注纯文本 LLM 预训练，这篇不是优先级很高；若关注统一生成架构和 serving 侧结构利用，可以快速看。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 HeadCast。作者先观察预训练 AR 视频模型的注意力图，发现不同 head 在时间和空间维度上有稳定且异质的依赖模式，并将其分成四类。Sink head 主要盯住首帧或首个 block，起到锚点作用；Dummy head 主要看当前 denoising block；Spatial head 不需要全局历史，只需要跨历史帧的局部空间邻域；Global head 则确实依赖完整上下文。基于这个分类，HeadCast 在短暂 warm-up 后，只在最大噪声步 t=1000 做一次 head classification，因为此时注意力更反映结构偏好而不是具体内容。之后每类 head 走不同的计算路径：Sink 和 Dummy 只保留极小缓存，Spatial 在固定网格邻域内做注意力，Global 继续保留完整滑窗。对应地，原本统一的 KV cache 被拆成 head-specific buffers。这样做的关键不是一味裁剪，而是显式保留少数真正需要全局历史的 head，避免像 Dummy Forcing 那样因为分类过粗而把维持时序一致性的长程信息一起删掉。整个方法 training-free、plug-and-play，不需要改权重。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 AR video diffusion 框架，包括 Self-Forcing、LongLive、Causal Forcing、Reward Forcing。主要结果是：加速收益会随着分辨率和缓存长度上升而变大，在 720P 上最高约 1.62×，在 1080P 上最高约 1.95×。质量方面，作者报告 VBench 指标基本保持，同时帧级保真度如 PSNR、LPIPS 也能维持，并且相较于更激进的缓存驱逐方法，明显减少 inter-frame flickering。论文的论证重点不只是平均指标，而是说明四类 head 的分工在生成过程中相对稳定，因此一次早期分类就足够；同时 ablation 也支持“必须保留 Global heads”这一点，否则时序一致性会明显下降。若从方法可信度看，最重要的证据是跨多个模型都能复用同一套分类-路由思路，而不是只在单一 backbone 上成立。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Motivation 和 Figure 1，理解四类 head 是怎么从时间稀疏和空间稀疏两个维度拆出来的。然后看 HeadCast 的流程图，重点弄清楚为什么分类只做一次、为什么选在最大噪声步、以及四类 head 各自保留什么缓存。实验部分优先看与 Dummy Forcing、滑窗基线的对比，以及关于 flicker 的可视化和 ablation。预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主线。若你做的是文本 LLM 预训练，可以把它当成“head specialization 是否足够稳定到能驱动系统优化”的案例；若你做多模态生成或 serving，这篇更值得细看实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the KV-cache growth problem in autoregressive video diffusion. As more video blocks are generated, historical keys and values accumulate, and attention over the cache becomes the dominant inference cost, especially at high resolution where each frame contributes many tokens. Existing fixes either use a uniform sliding window, which remains expensive, or aggressively evict cache entries, which harms long-range temporal consistency and causes flicker. Training-based sparse-attention alternatives require retraining. The paper asks whether a pretrained model’s attention heads have stable enough roles that each head can be given its own cache policy without changing model weights.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its direct relevance to language-model pretraining is modest. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, head specialization is not just an interpretive observation; it can be stable enough to support deployment-time optimization. Second, it shows how a unified Transformer-style generative stack can be restructured after training by exploiting heterogeneous head behavior. That is relevant to multimodal foundation models, long-context cache management, and head-level routing ideas. For pure text pretraining, this is not a high-priority read; for unified generation systems and serving, it is more useful.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, HeadCast, starts from an empirical observation: attention heads in pretrained AR video models show stable and heterogeneous temporal/spatial dependency patterns. The authors group heads into four archetypes. Sink heads anchor strongly to the first frame or first block. Dummy heads attend almost entirely to the current denoising block. Spatial heads do not need the full history, only a local spatial neighborhood across historical frames. Global heads genuinely require broad historical context. After a short warm-up, HeadCast performs a one-time head classification at the maximum-noise step, t=1000, where attention is argued to reflect structural preference more than content-specific details. Each head is then routed to a dedicated computation path: Sink and Dummy heads keep only tiny buffers, Spatial heads attend within a fixed spatial grid, and Global heads retain the full sliding-window context. The monolithic KV cache is split into compact head-specific buffers. The key design choice is not merely pruning harder, but explicitly preserving the small subset of heads that carry long-range temporal dependencies, avoiding the temporal instability seen in coarser cache-eviction schemes such as Dummy Forcing. The method is training-free and plug-and-play.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans several AR video diffusion frameworks, including Self-Forcing, LongLive, Causal Forcing, and Reward Forcing. The main result is that speedup grows with resolution and cache size: up to about 1.62x at 720P and 1.95x at 1080P. On quality, the paper reports preserved VBench performance together with stable frame-level fidelity metrics such as PSNR and LPIPS. Qualitatively, it reduces inter-frame flickering compared with more aggressive cache-eviction baselines. A central empirical point is that the four head archetypes remain stable enough during generation that a single early classification is sufficient. The ablations also support the need to retain Global heads; removing or over-pruning them degrades temporal coherence. The strongest evidence is not a single benchmark win, but the fact that the same classify-and-route idea transfers across multiple pretrained AR video generators.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, begin with the motivation section and the first attention visualizations. They explain how the four head types emerge from temporal sparsity and spatial sparsity. Then read the HeadCast pipeline carefully, focusing on three questions: why classification is done only once, why it is done at the maximum-noise step, and what cache each head type keeps. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against sliding-window baselines and Dummy Forcing, plus the flicker visualizations and the ablations on Global-head retention. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for the main idea. If your work is in text LLM pretraining, treat this as a case study in whether head specialization is stable enough to drive systems optimization; if you work on multimodal generation or serving, the implementation details are more worth studying.

recommendation.zh: 面向视频AR扩散的KV cache头分型思路可迁移到长上下文LLM；只看§3的头分类定义和消融图即可，视频生成细节可跳过。
recommendation.en: The head-typed KV cache idea transfers to long-context LLM inference; read §3 head taxonomy and ablations, skip video-specific generation details.

paper.title: FineServe: A Fine-Grained Dataset and Characterization of Global LLM Serving Workloads
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as always-on online services, making efficient LLM serving a critical systems challenge. Achieving low latency and high throughput under volatile demand requires deep understanding of real-world serving workloads, yet existing studies often rely on proxy traces or coarse-grained characterizations that fail to capture the heterogeneity of modern multi-model LLM platforms. We present FineServe, an in-the-wild, multi-model LLM serving workload

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM serving负载研究依赖代理轨迹或粗粒度特征，无法捕捉现代多模型LLM平台的异构性，导致serving优化缺乏真实数据支撑。
summary.importance: 发布来自全球商业平台的细粒度多模型LLM serving工作负载数据集，系统分析真实负载的动态特征，属于系统测量与数据贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 从全球商业LLM市场收集真实多模型服务轨迹，细粒度刻画请求到达动态、token行为等特征，分析不同模型架构、规模、任务意图下的波动模式差异，基于此开发模型感知的负载生成器。
summary.experiments: 基于真实商业负载数据，揭示不同模型、任务下的波动机制差异，负载生成器可组合细粒度模型感知的工作负载。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM serving workload studies rely on proxy traces or coarse-grained characterizations, failing to capture the heterogeneity of modern multi-model LLM platforms and leaving serving optimizations without real-world data support.
summary_en.importance: Releases a fine-grained multi-model LLM serving workload dataset from a global commercial platform, systematically characterizes real workload dynamics, contributing to system measurement and public data resources.
summary_en.technical_approach: Collects real multi-model serving traces from a global commercial LLM marketplace, finely characterizes request arrival dynamics and token behavior, analyzes fluctuation regime differences across model architectures, scales, and task intents, and develops a model-aware workload generator based on the insights.
summary_en.experiments: Based on real commercial workload data, reveals distinct fluctuation mechanisms across models and tasks; the workload generator can compose fine-grained model-aware workloads for serving evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 真实LLM serving负载的特征分析对预训练的任务配比、上下文设计有弱参考价值，仅需了解负载异构性结论即可。
recommendation.en: Real LLM serving workload characterization provides weak reference for pretraining task mixture and context design; only skim the heterogeneity findings.

paper.title: Beyond Accuracy and Cost: Latency-Aware LLM Query Routing for Dynamic Workloads
paper.abstract: Modern language query routers improve inference efficiency by assigning each query to a model that balances response quality and monetary cost. However, current query routers are largely latency-agnostic and do not consider the generation latency experienced by queries at model instances. In practice, latency is often controlled by load-balancing policies such as round-robin or join-the-shortest-queue, which do not account for model accuracy or inference cost. Incorporating query latency into ro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很实际但常被拆开看的问题：在多模型、多实例的 LLM 服务池里，查询路由不能只看质量和价格，还要显式考虑请求到达时各实例的实时负载，以及连续批处理下 prefill/decode 混合工作负载带来的时延变化。现有 query router 大多把 latency 当成系统层的事，先选模型，再让 serving 框架做负载均衡；而系统层方法又默认模型选择已固定，不关心准确率和成本。论文要解决的，就是把 accuracy、cost、latency 三者放进同一个路由决策里，而且 latency 不是静态表格值，而是依赖当前队列状态、输出长度、batching/scheduling 策略和实例异构性的动态量。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型训练—部署闭环有直接启发。第一，很多关于模型大小、蒸馏、MoE、长输出偏好、推理 token 分布的研究，最终都要落到 serving 代价和时延上；这篇工作给出了一种把“模型能力差异”和“系统负载状态”联合建模的方式。第二，它提醒一个常被忽略的事实：同样的模型，在不同 serving policy 和 workload composition 下，用户感知 latency 差异很大，因此只用离线 token/s 成本近似在线服务质量是不够的。第三，这类 latency-aware routing 会反过来影响预训练和后训练阶段的模型族设计：如果一个小模型在轻载时很划算，但在 decode-heavy 场景下吞吐退化明显，那么模型池配置、蒸馏目标、甚至输出长度控制策略都应一起考虑。贡献量级更接近“系统与模型选择接口”的扎实推进，而不是范式变化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个联合优化框架，加一个轻量级 latency estimator。路由器对每个到达请求，不再只预测“发给哪个模型最可能答对、花多少钱”，还要预测“发到某个具体实例后会经历多长 TTFT/生成延迟”。难点在于 latency 不是 query 的静态属性，而是实例状态相关的。作者提出 Serving Framework Simulation, SFS 估计器：它显式模拟 autoregressive serving 中 token batch 的演化，跟踪实例上当前正在服务的请求在 prefill 和 decode 两个阶段的工作量，并把底层 serving framework 的 admission、batching、scheduling 规则纳入估计。这个设计比只用 prompt length、expected output length 或简单队列长度做回归更细，因为连续批处理下，prefill 是算力受限、decode 更偏带宽/内存受限，两者混合比例会改变新请求插入后的等待时间。

从论文给出的描述看，整体框架大致包含三部分：1）已有 accuracy/cost router 提供 query-to-model 的质量与价格估计；2）SFS 根据每个实例当前活跃请求集合、预估输出长度、硬件与模型配置，模拟未来若干 token iteration，得到新请求的 latency estimate；3）路由目标在满足 latency 约束或惩罚 latency 的前提下，选择最优模型实例。这里一个关键点是，它不是把 latency 当成训练时学出来的黑盒回归值，而是利用 serving mechanics 做结构化估计，因此更容易迁移到不同 batching policy 或异构实例组合。

和最接近的 prior work 相比，区别主要在 latency 建模粒度。已有方法会用输出长度或平均服务时间近似延迟，但没有显式区分 prefill/decode，也不跟踪实例当前 workload composition。作者这里把 serving framework policy 放进 estimator，意味着路由器知道“同样一个请求，发到 decode backlog 重的实例”和“发到 prefill 较空的实例”后果不同。这一点对长输出任务尤其关键。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见的重点，实验主要验证三件事：一是 latency estimator 的准确性；二是联合路由在 accuracy-cost-latency 三维上的收益；三是相对 latency-agnostic router 和纯系统负载均衡策略的优势。论文强调其方法在动态 workload 下优于两类基线：一类是只做 accuracy/cost 权衡的 query router，另一类是 round-robin、join-the-shortest-queue 这类不看模型质量和价格的负载均衡方法。

摘要截断，全文片段里没有完整数字表，但从实验设计可以确定作者评估了 TTFT 或相关 latency 指标，并在不同 serving framework policy、不同请求长度分布、不同实例负载条件下比较。值得注意的是，论文把 estimator 设计成 lightweight simulation，而不是高开销离散事件仿真器，说明实验里应当同时报告了在线路由可行性。若精读全文，建议重点核对：1）latency prediction error 在不同 workload regime 下是否稳定；2）accuracy 或 utility 提升是否来自更好的模型选择，而不是单纯把请求推给空闲实例；3）在高负载和长输出场景下，相比简单 queue-based heuristic 的收益是否更明显；4）是否分析了 output length prediction 误差对最终路由效果的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但方法部分值得看细一点。优先看 Introduction 和问题定义，先确认作者到底优化的是 TTFT、总延迟，还是带约束的综合效用。然后直接看 latency estimator 那一节，重点抓三件事：它如何表示实例状态；如何模拟 continuous batching 下 token batch 的推进；如何把 serving policy 编进估计器。实验部分建议重点看 latency estimation accuracy、主结果表，以及 workload shift 或 ablation。若时间有限，30-40 分钟足够把主线读清。若想深挖，值得思考两个延伸点：一是这种结构化 estimator 能否反向用于训练时的 system-aware data curriculum 或 output-length regularization；二是如果模型池里包含 MoE、长上下文模型或 speculative decoding，不同 serving mechanics 下 estimator 需要改哪些状态变量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical gap in LLM serving: query routing across a pool of models and replicas should not optimize only quality and monetary cost, but also the latency a request will actually experience under dynamic load. Existing query routers are mostly latency-agnostic, while system-level load balancers assume the model choice is fixed and optimize only queueing or utilization. The core problem here is to make routing decisions over accuracy, cost, and latency jointly, where latency is not a static per-model number but a state-dependent quantity shaped by prompt length, output length, current prefill/decode workload, batching policy, scheduling policy, and hardware/model heterogeneity.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research at the train–serve interface. It makes a useful point: model-family design cannot be separated from serving behavior. A model that looks efficient in offline token-cost accounting may behave poorly under decode-heavy workloads or under a particular continuous batching policy. That has implications for distillation targets, model pool composition, output-length control, and even how one evaluates small-vs-large model tradeoffs. The contribution is best viewed as a solid systems-and-routing advance rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is a joint routing framework augmented with a lightweight latency estimator. For each incoming query, the router combines three signals: expected response quality, monetary cost, and predicted latency at a specific model instance. The difficult part is latency estimation. Unlike cost, latency depends on the current state of the serving system. The paper proposes a Serving Framework Simulation (SFS) estimator that simulates the evolution of autoregressive token batches at each instance. It tracks active requests, separates prefill and decode work, and incorporates the batching/admission/scheduling behavior of the underlying serving framework.

This is a more structured approach than using prompt length, expected output length, or queue length alone. In modern continuous batching systems, prefill is typically compute-bound while decode is more memory-bandwidth-bound, and the mix of the two phases strongly affects how much delay a new request will see. The estimator therefore models not just how long a query is, but what kind of workload is already occupying the instance.

The overall routing pipeline appears to have three components: (1) an accuracy/cost predictor from prior query-routing work, (2) the SFS latency predictor conditioned on per-instance workload state and serving policy, and (3) a routing objective that selects the model instance under a latency-aware utility or constraint. A notable design choice is that latency is not treated as a pure black-box regression target. Instead, the estimator uses serving mechanics explicitly, which should make it more robust across different batching policies and heterogeneous deployments.

Relative to prior latency-aware routing work based mainly on output-length heuristics, the key difference is the explicit modeling of prefill/decode composition and current instance workload. That matters especially for long-generation queries, where decode backlog dominates user-visible delay.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story has three parts: estimator fidelity, end-to-end routing quality, and robustness under dynamic workloads. The paper reports that the latency-aware router achieves a better accuracy–cost–latency tradeoff than both latency-agnostic query routers and system-only load-balancing baselines such as round-robin or shortest-queue style policies.

The full numeric tables are not visible in the provided text, so I should avoid inventing exact values. Still, the evaluation clearly targets TTFT and related latency metrics under varying workload conditions, likely including different prompt/output length distributions, load levels, and serving policies. The important checks when reading the paper are: whether latency prediction error remains controlled across workload regimes; whether the gains come from genuinely better model-instance selection rather than simply avoiding busy replicas; whether the advantage widens in high-load or long-output settings; and how sensitive the router is to output-length prediction errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but the method section is worth reading carefully. Start with the problem formulation to see whether the optimization target is TTFT, end-to-end latency, or a constrained utility. Then go straight to the latency-estimation section and focus on three questions: how instance state is represented, how continuous batching is simulated, and how serving policies are encoded. In the experiments, prioritize the latency-estimation accuracy plots, the main routing comparison table, and any ablations under workload shift. Around 30–40 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If reading more deeply, a useful follow-up question is how this estimator would need to change for MoE models, long-context serving, or speculative decoding.

recommendation.zh: 只看 latency estimator 和 routing objective；它提醒模型路由实验若不模拟 decode 队列，结论会偏乐观。
recommendation.en: Read the latency estimator and routing objective; it is a useful reminder that routing results are optimistic if decode queues are ignored.

paper.title: LaCache: Exact Caching and Precision-Adaptive Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based Large Language Models(DLLMs) enable parallel generation via Semi-Autoregressive (SAR) decoding in text generation. However, current methods suffer from severe operator-level redundancy: they recompute the entire sequence during denoising steps, ignoring that the prefix and masked suffix remain invariant within a block. We propose LaCache, a training-free acceleration framework that alleviates this redundancy through lossless caching and mixed precision. Specifically, LaCache empl

summary.core_problem: Diffusion LLM 在半自回归分块解码中每个去噪步都重算整段序列，忽略前缀与块内未变 mask 后缀的算子级冗余。
summary.importance: 首个针对 DLLM 推理的无损缓存 + 混合精度加速框架，直接服务于新兴的离散扩散/MDLM 类文本建模范式的部署。
summary.technical_approach: LaCache 是免训练框架：(1) Lossless State Memoization 缓存三类中间结果——EmbedCache（embedding 输出）、RoPECache（逐 token 注意力前状态）、FACache（FlashAttention 在线 softmax 统计），对未变 token 跳过计算且输出完全一致；(2) 针对 FFN 的 per-group FP8 量化，按步定制以缓解内存带宽瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给具体模型、baseline 与加速比/精度数值。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LLMs recompute the entire sequence every denoising step during semi-autoregressive block decoding, ignoring operator-level redundancy in invariant prefixes and masked suffixes within a block.
summary_en.importance: A lossless caching plus mixed-precision acceleration framework tailored to DLLM inference, directly serving deployment of the emerging discrete diffusion / MDLM family of text models.
summary_en.technical_approach: LaCache is training-free: (1) Lossless State Memoization caches three intermediates—EmbedCache for embeddings, RoPECache for per-token pre-attention states, and FACache for FlashAttention online softmax stats—so unchanged tokens skip computation with identical outputs; (2) per-group FP8 quantization for FFN layers, tailored per denoising step to relieve memory-bandwidth pressure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports no specific models, baselines, speedups, or quality numbers.

recommendation.zh: 把 FlashAttention 在线 softmax 统计缓存做进 DLLM 是个实在的工程点，做 diffusion LM 部署的应读 §3-4 复现。
recommendation.en: Caching FlashAttention online softmax stats for DLLMs is a concrete systems trick; reproduce §3-4 if you deploy diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Half the Experts, All the Code: One-Shot Domain Pruning of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Coding
paper.abstract: The strongest open-weight coding models are mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks: most of their size comes from large pools of "expert" subnetworks, of which only a few act on any token. That pool is why these models do not fit on the machines most developers own, yet for a user who only wants coding help, most experts encode abilities that will never be invoked. We ask how many experts can be removed, and which, by pruning two recent open-weight MoE models from different families (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

summary.core_problem: 研究面向代码使用场景时，开源 MoE LLM 能否一次性剪掉大量 expert 而不明显损害代码能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 推理压缩和专家专门化分析。它对预训练研究员的价值不在于剪枝 recipe 本身，而在于给出一个可检验信号：MoE 的 expert capacity 可能对不同能力高度非均匀，且通用 perplexity 不一定能预测领域能力保留。
summary.technical_approach: 对两个不同家族的开源 MoE 编码模型 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 与 Gemma-4-26B-A4B 做 one-shot domain pruning。比较五种 expert 选择策略，用代码 benchmark 的正确性而不是困惑度来决定剪枝是否成功，并观察能力损失是否集中在非代码任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要称两个模型都可以移除约一半 expert，在主要代码 benchmark 上没有统计显著下降；损失主要出现在代码外能力。最优剪枝策略在两个模型家族之间相反，说明跨架构迁移不稳。摘要还指出 perplexity 与用户关心的代码正确性不完全一致，但后续细节被截断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether open-weight MoE LLMs can drop many experts in a single pass while preserving coding performance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is MoE inference compression plus an analysis of expert specialization. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that expert capacity may be highly uneven across capabilities, and generic perplexity may be a weak proxy for domain retention.
summary_en.technical_approach: It prunes two open-weight MoE coding models from different families, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, using five expert-selection strategies. The pruning decision is judged by code correctness rather than perplexity, and the analysis tracks whether damage appears mostly outside coding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that roughly half of the experts can be removed from either model without a statistically detectable loss on the primary coding benchmark. Most degradation appears on non-coding abilities. The best selection strategy flips across model families, and perplexity is reported as an unreliable guide, though the provided abstract is truncated before full details.

recommendation.zh: 只看剪枝策略对比和 perplexity 失效部分；它会提醒你 MoE 路由分析不能只看平均 loss。
recommendation.en: Skim the pruning-strategy comparison and the perplexity failure cases; it is a useful warning against reading MoE routing only through average loss.

paper.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
paper.abstract: Pruning long context for coding agents has been a vital technology for efficient context management. While existing context pruning methods such as SWE-Pruner realize this by attaching a separate code classifier, we find the agent itself encodes internal representations indicating the relevance of code context when reading tool output. Based on this finding, we propose SWE-Pruner Pro, which prunes tool outputs directly inside the agent. Concretely, a small head turns the agent's own internal rep

summary.core_problem: 多轮 coding agent 在仓库级任务中会把大量 tool output（cat/grep/ls 等）原样塞进上下文，导致 token 成本高、长上下文退化明显。现有 pruning 要么用与任务无关的通用压缩指标，要么额外引入一个 scoring 模型并要求 agent 每轮写“goal-hint”。这篇论文要解决的是：能否不引入外部打分器、不增加额外模型调用，而是直接从 agent 自己在读取 tool output 时产生的内部表示里，读出“哪些行该保留/该丢弃”的信号，并把它做成可训练、可部署、稳定省 token 的 pruning 组件。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接贡献不大（更偏 agent/serving 侧的上下文管理），但有两点对基座研究员仍然有信息增益：
1) 证明“任务相关的选择性注意/重要性判断”在冻结 backbone 的最后层表示里是线性可分到一定程度的（AUC 0.83），这类结果常被用来支撑 representation 可读出性、以及“用小头部读出隐变量”的工程路线。
2) 给出一种低侵入式的训练/部署范式：冻结大模型，仅训练轻量 head，复用 prefill 计算，不增加额外模型调用；这对大规模训练后期的能力适配（例如在不动主干的情况下加可控模块）有参考价值。
整体量级：属于工程上有效的 token/成本优化方法，研究层面属于“表示可读出 + 轻量适配”的增量证据，relevance 中等偏低。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是“in-agent pruning head”：
- 观测与假设：agent 在读取 tool output 时已经做了一次 attention 加权的前向计算，因此最后层 hidden states 里应包含对后续决策有用的行级重要性信号。
- 探针验证：收集约 2,260 个多轮 tool responses（约 155k 行），用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 给每行打 keep/prune 标签；冻结 Qwen3-Coder-Next，把每一行的最后层 token hidden state 做 mean-pool 得到 line embedding，用 logistic regression 做二分类，验证可分性。
- 训练目标：在真实系统里不做额外“goal-hint query”，而是直接在 agent prefill 时拿到的最后层表示上，训练一个小 head 输出每行 keep/prune。
- 关键工程点（论文强调“在实践中重要”的两点）：
  1) Length-aware embedding：给每个 tool output 注入与行数相关的长度信息，使 head 能对短输出与长输出采取不同策略（避免一刀切）。
  2) Per-sample balanced focal loss：按“每个样本”做 keep/prune 的平衡，而不是全局 class weight；当某个 tool output 里 keep 行很少时，提升这些稀有 keep 行的梯度权重，减少 head 学成“全 prune/偏置 prune”的风险，同时 focal 机制强调难例。
- 部署形态：head 在 server 侧随 prefill 一起跑，复用 backbone 已算出的表示；避免额外模型调用（相对 SWE-Pruner 这类需要额外 scorer 的方案）。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的关键数字与结论：
- 表示可读出性（探针）：在 held-out trajectories 上，logistic regression 达到 AUC 0.83，best F1 0.63；在 keep 正例率约 30% 时，多数类 F1 上界约 0.46。
- 端到端节省：在两种 open-weight backbones、四个 multi-turn benchmarks 上，最多节省 39% prompt+completion tokens（SWE-QA-Pro），在长上下文 Oolong 上节省 30%。
- 质量保持/提升：在 Oolong 上 MiMo-V2-Flash accuracy +2.2；在 SWE-Bench Verified 上 MiMo-V2-Flash resolve rate +3.8%。论文还强调它是在“减少 token 的同时”保持接近 unpruned agent 的任务质量，并且在 SWE-QA family 与 Oolong 上是唯一一个在所有设置都能降低端到端 token 的方法。
- 运行开销：replay study 显示 in-server head 只增加约 15.0% 的 aggregate wall time（相对整个 agent generation），且不需要额外模型调用。
（注：全文后半部分未完整给出，但从引言与动机部分已能覆盖主要实验结论与关键数字。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 §2 的 probing（Figure 2）：这是论文“为什么可行”的核心证据，重点看 AUC/F1 与分布重叠区间的解释。
- 再看 §3 方法（Figure 3）：理解它如何在不增加额外模型调用的情况下复用 prefill 表示；重点抓 length-aware embedding 与 per-sample balanced focal loss 两个设计动机。
- 最后扫实验表：关注“token 节省 vs 任务质量”的 trade-off，以及在 SWE-Bench Verified/Oolong 上出现质量提升的条件（通常与减少干扰/长上下文退化有关）。如果要复现或迁移到自家 agent，优先看训练数据标注协议（Appendix A）与线上开销测量方式。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn coding agents accumulate large amounts of raw tool outputs (cat/grep/ls, etc.) in the context, which dominates token budget and exacerbates long-context degradation. Prior pruning either uses task-agnostic compression heuristics or relies on an extra scoring model plus per-turn “goal-hint” queries. This paper asks whether the pruning signal is already present in the agent backbone’s internal representations while reading tool outputs, and whether a lightweight in-server head can turn those representations into line-level keep/prune decisions without extra model calls.
summary_en.importance: Not a direct pretraining contribution (more agent/context-management), but it offers two useful signals for foundation-model researchers: (1) empirical evidence that task-relevant importance signals are decently linearly separable in frozen last-layer representations (AUC 0.83), supporting “readout from representations” as a practical design pattern; (2) a clean adaptation/deployment recipe—freeze the backbone, train a small head, reuse prefill compute—relevant to post-pretrain modular add-ons and cost control. Overall impact is mainly engineering-level token/cost reduction with moderate research novelty.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SWE-Pruner Pro is an in-agent pruning head:
- Hypothesis: since the backbone already processes tool outputs via attention, its final hidden states should encode which lines matter for the next action.
- Probe study: collect ~2,260 multi-turn tool responses (~155k lines), label each line keep/prune using Claude Sonnet 4.6; freeze Qwen3-Coder-Next; mean-pool last-layer token states per line; fit logistic regression to test separability.
- Model: during normal prefill, reuse the backbone’s last-layer states and run a lightweight head to output per-line keep/prune.
- Two practical additions: (1) length-aware embedding keyed to the tool output’s line count, enabling different behavior for short vs long outputs; (2) per-sample balanced focal loss that rebalances keep/prune within each sample, preventing collapse toward pruning-dominant outputs and emphasizing rare-but-important kept lines.
- Deployment: runs in-server on top of existing prefill, avoiding an extra scorer model call.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported results:
- Probe: held-out AUC 0.83, best F1 0.63; with ~30% keep rate, majority-class F1 upper bound ~0.46.
- Token savings: up to 39% prompt+completion reduction on SWE-QA-Pro; 30% on the long-context Oolong benchmark.
- Quality: on Oolong, MiMo-V2-Flash accuracy +2.2; on SWE-Bench Verified, MiMo-V2-Flash resolve rate +3.8%, while generally keeping quality close to the unpruned agent.
- Overhead: replay study shows ~15.0% aggregate wall-time increase over total agent generation, with no extra model call.
(Note: only partial full text is provided here; numbers above are from the included sections.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the probing evidence in §2 (Figure 2): this is the main justification that pruning is “already inside” the backbone.
- Then read §3 with Figure 3 to understand the in-server pipeline and why it avoids extra model calls; focus on length-aware embedding and per-sample balanced focal loss.
- Finally scan the benchmark tables for the token-savings/quality trade-off and the cases where pruning improves accuracy (often via reduced long-context interference). If you want to port it, prioritize the labeling protocol (Appendix A) and the latency accounting methodology.

recommendation.zh: 只看内部表示剪枝实验和失败例；若 probe 很干净，这比外挂 reranker 更像可训练的 agent memory 接口。
recommendation.en: Skim the internal-representation pruning tests and failures; if the probe is clean, this is closer to trainable agent memory than an external reranker.

institutions: LLM4SE Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University

paper.title: SelKV: Selective KV Cache Merging with Per-Token Merge-or-Drop and Attention Compensation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate text autoregressively, relying on a key-value (KV) cache whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length, creating a major bottleneck. Recent compression methods mitigate this cost via token merging; however, these approaches often rely on indiscriminate aggregation, which degrades representations and introduces attention sag, a mismatch where merged tokens receive the same softmax mass as individual tokens despite encoding multiple inputs. We prop

summary.core_problem: 现有 KV cache token 合并方法无差别聚合，破坏表征并产生 attention sag（合并 token 与单个 token 获得相同 softmax 质量）。
summary.importance: 提出免训练的 KV 压缩框架，显式建模合并/丢弃决策并修正合并带来的 softmax 失衡。
summary.technical_approach: SelKV 包含两部分：(1) 基于 value 向量相似度的 soft cosine gate，逐 token 决定合并或丢弃，抑制不相似 token；(2) attention-ratio 补偿，利用 prefill 注意力统计量在解码时加 logit bias，修正合并导致的 softmax 质量失衡。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 上评测，摘要未给具体模型、压缩率与数值增益。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache token merging aggregates indiscriminately, degrading representations and causing attention sag where merged tokens receive the same softmax mass as single tokens.
summary_en.importance: A training-free KV compression framework that explicitly models merge-or-drop decisions and corrects the softmax imbalance induced by merging.
