summary_en.technical_approach: SelKV has two components: (1) a soft cosine gate over value-vector similarity that makes per-token merge/drop decisions and suppresses dissimilar tokens; (2) an attention-ratio compensation that adds a decoding-time logit bias derived from prefill attention statistics to correct softmax mass imbalance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongBench; the abstract reports no specific models, compression ratios, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: attention sag 的诊断和 logit-bias 补偿思路值得做 KV 压缩的人看 §3，但整体是增量改进。
recommendation.en: The attention-sag diagnosis and logit-bias compensation are worth reading in §3 if you work on KV compression; otherwise incremental.

paper.title: Lossless but Not Free: An Empirical Anatomy of Speculative Decoding on Consumer Hardware
paper.abstract: Single-stream autoregressive decoding of large language models is bound by memory bandwidth: each generated token requires one full forward pass through the target model, and successive passes cannot be parallelized. Speculative decoding restructures this computation: a small draft model proposes $K$ tokens autoregressively, the target model scores all of them in one batched pass, and a rejection-sampling rule provably preserves the target model's output distribution. We present a from-scratch,

summary.core_problem: 评估 speculative decoding 在消费级硬件上是否真正带来端到端加速，以及分布无损性在实际实现中如何验证。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率工程实证。它不是新算法，但对 serving 和本地部署有参考价值，尤其提醒 speculative decoding 的理论无损不等于免费加速。
summary.technical_approach: 从零实现 device-agnostic speculative decoding，支持 CUDA、MPS 和 CPU。小 draft model 自回归提出 K 个 token，target model 一次 batched pass 验证，并用 rejection sampling 保持 target 分布不变。论文在多个 draft/target/backend 配置下测量接受率、wall-clock speedup 和分布一致性。
summary.experiments: 在消费级 Apple-silicon 笔记本上测试 5 种 draft/target 后端配置。分布等价性通过三层验证，包括约 9,200 个真实模型 token 的 two-sample test，χ²=162.5、dof=200、p=0.976，以及 greedy sequence exact agreement。最佳配置在 K=6 达到 1.61× wall-clock speedup，接受率从 69.7% 开始随位置下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether speculative decoding actually delivers end-to-end speedups on consumer hardware, and how to verify its lossless distributional property in practice.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency engineering study rather than a new decoding algorithm. Its useful contribution is an empirical reminder that distribution-preserving speculative decoding does not automatically translate into large wall-clock gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author implements device-agnostic speculative decoding from scratch across CUDA, MPS, and CPU. A small draft model proposes K autoregressive tokens, the target model verifies them in one batched pass, and rejection sampling preserves the target model distribution. The study measures acceptance profiles, wall-clock speed, and distribution equivalence across draft/target/backend configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five draft/target backend configurations on a consumer Apple-silicon laptop. Distributional equivalence is checked at three levels, including a two-sample test over about 9,200 real-model tokens with χ²=162.5, dof=200, p=0.976, plus exact greedy-sequence agreement. The best setup reaches a 1.61× wall-clock speedup at K=6, with acceptance starting at 69.7% and declining across positions.

recommendation.zh: 没有新算法，但实测很接地气；只看 acceptance 曲线和后端对比，别把 1.6× 当通用结论。
recommendation.en: No new algorithm, but the measurements are grounded; read the acceptance and backend tables, not the 1.6× number as a universal claim.

paper.title: VarRate: Training-Free Variable-Rate KV Cache Compression for Long-Context LLMs
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck in long-context large language model (LLM) inference. Two leading training-free families are both structurally limited: token-selection methods (SnapKV, Ada-KV) score importance from an observation window and evict low-scoring tokens, but eviction is irreversible -- so when the importance signal degrades under query-agnostic reuse, accuracy collapses by 11-15 points; uniform low-rank coding keeps every token but spends equal rank everywhere,

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存占用过高，以及 token eviction 在长距离查询下不可逆丢信息的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理效率方法。它把 KV 压缩从“删 token”转成“给每个 token 分配不同低秩预算”，保留所有 token 的非零信息。对长上下文 serving、预训练侧长上下文评测和压缩鲁棒性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VarRate 是训练免费的 KV codec。它根据 query salience 为不同 token 分配可变低秩 rank，而不是直接淘汰低分 token；所有 token 都保留非零 rank。相对于统一低秩压缩，它避免把预算平均浪费在不重要位置；相对于 SnapKV、Ada-KV 等选择式方法，它避免不可逆删除。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 上，以相同 20% KV 预算比较训练免费的 token-selection 方法和低秩方法。摘要称 SnapKV、Ada-KV 类方法在 query-agnostic reuse 下会掉 11-15 分，而 VarRate 在相同困难场景下只掉 3.5-5.5 分。摘要未给出完整模型规模和全部任务明细。
summary.authors_note: Iowa State University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache memory pressure in long-context LLM inference and the irreversible information loss caused by token eviction.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It reframes KV compression from dropping tokens to allocating different low-rank budgets per token, keeping nonzero information for every position. It is relevant to long-context serving and to robustness analysis of compression schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: VarRate is a training-free KV codec that assigns variable low-rank ranks to tokens according to query salience. It keeps every token at a nonzero rank. Compared with uniform low-rank compression, it avoids wasting equal budget everywhere; compared with SnapKV- or Ada-KV-style token selection, it avoids irreversible eviction.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports LongBench results at a matched 20% KV budget. The abstract states that token-selection methods lose 11–15 points when query-agnostic reuse degrades the importance signal, while VarRate loses only 3.5–5.5 points in the same regime. The abstract does not provide full model sizes or all task-level details.
summary_en.authors_note: Iowa State University.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 LongBench 失败案例即可；“低秩保留全部 token”比 eviction 更稳，是长上下文压缩的有用 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and LongBench failure cases; keeping all tokens at low rank is a useful prior over eviction for long-context compression.

paper.title: FlashDecoder: Real-Time Latent-to-Pixel Streaming Decoder with Transformers
paper.abstract: Real-time video generation demands fast decoding as much as fast denoising, yet current latent video diffusion models rely on 3D convolutional decoders that are slow and memory-intensive at high resolutions or for long video. We introduce FlashDecoder, a fast, memory-efficient pure-Transformer video decoder that decodes latents to pixels frame by frame. At each step, the current frame attends only to a fixed-size window of past frames through a rolling KV cache. The fixed temporal window keeps d

summary.core_problem: 解决 latent video diffusion 在 latent-to-pixel 解码阶段的速度和显存瓶颈，使长视频或高分辨率视频可以流式、低延迟解码。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成推理侧的系统和架构改进。它不改变 diffusion 训练目标，但把 3D convolutional decoder 替换为带 rolling KV cache 的纯 Transformer decoder，对多模态生成服务和长序列解码有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FlashDecoder，按帧顺序把 video latents 解码到像素。当前帧只 attend 到固定窗口内的历史帧，并维护 rolling KV cache，因此时序窗口固定、显存和延迟不随视频长度线性增长。由于天然逐帧处理，模型获得时间因果性，不需要显式 attention mask，并可训练到 1080p 分辨率。
summary.experiments: 在 Wan2.1 和 Wan2.2 latent spaces 上测试。摘要报告 FlashDecoder 在 1080p 下达到与卷积 decoder 相近的重建质量，例如 PSNR 41.55dB vs. 41.49dB，同时解码速度提升 3.6x-4.7x；未给出参数量和训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the latent-to-pixel decoding bottleneck in latent video diffusion, where conventional 3D convolutional decoders are slow and memory-heavy for high-resolution or long videos.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-side architecture and systems contribution for video generation. It does not change the diffusion objective, but the rolling-KV-cache Transformer decoder is relevant to streaming multimodal generation and long-sequence decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlashDecoder is a pure Transformer video decoder that decodes frames sequentially. Each frame attends only to a fixed-size window of previous frames through a rolling KV cache, making latency and memory bounded with respect to video length. Sequential processing gives temporal causality without explicit masks and supports training at up to 1080p.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Wan2.1 and Wan2.2 latent spaces. The abstract reports reconstruction quality comparable to convolutional decoders, such as 41.55 dB versus 41.49 dB PSNR at 1080p, while decoding 3.6x to 4.7x faster. Model size and training data scale are not specified.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构图和速度表即可；对 LLM 预训练无直接动作，但 rolling KV cache 解码器值得服务侧同学借鉴。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture figure and speed table only; no direct pretraining action, but the rolling-KV decoder is useful for serving-oriented designs.

paper.title: Attention-Free and Lightweight Token Reduction for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal understanding, yet remain challenging to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices due to the substantial computational overhead of processing numerous visual tokens. Token reduction is a promising direction for accelerating VLMs inference, but existing approaches either rely on attention maps that are incompatible with modern acceleration frameworks or depend on computationally intensive pairwise similarity compariso

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM视觉token缩减方法要么依赖attention map难以适配现代推理加速框架，要么pairwise相似度计算开销过大，无法兼顾部署效率与性能。
summary.importance: 提出无注意力依赖的轻量token缩减即插即用模块，降低VLM端侧部署的视觉token计算开销，属于工程效率改进。
summary.technical_approach: 从信息论视角出发，设计基于熵的token重要性评估准则，无需attention权重即可筛选信息量大且具备多样性的视觉token，生成紧凑视觉表示，可作为插件接入现有VLM。
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露具体模型参数量、测试数据集与量化性能提升，仅声明方法兼容主流加速框架、计算开销低。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM token reduction methods either rely on attention maps incompatible with modern acceleration frameworks or require expensive pairwise similarity computation, failing to balance deployment efficiency and performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an attention-free, lightweight plug-and-play token reduction module to cut VLM edge deployment overhead, representing an engineering efficiency improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts an information-theoretic perspective, designs an entropy-based token importance criterion to select informative and diverse visual tokens without attention weights, producing compact visual representations compatible with off-the-shelf VLMs as a plug-in.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; no specific model sizes, test datasets, or quantitative performance gains are disclosed, only claims of compatibility with mainstream acceleration frameworks and low overhead.

recommendation.zh: VLM端侧部署的token剪枝实用方案，无注意力依赖适配加速库，只看熵准则的token打分设计即可。
recommendation.en: Practical VLM token pruning for edge deployment without attention map dependency; only review the entropy-based token scoring design.

paper.title: Less Experts, Faster Decoding: Cost-Aware Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), but their inference efficiency depends strongly on expert activation patterns. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel, yet existing draft selection strategies primarily optimize acceptance likelihood. In large-scale MoE models, however, selecting draft tokens also determines the union of experts activated during

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 模型中 speculative decoding 只追求草稿 token 接受率、却忽略专家权重访存成本的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与 MoE 成本建模。它指出 MoE 推理的瓶颈不只是 token 数和接受率，还取决于验证阶段被草稿树触发的专家集合大小；这个观察对 MoE serving、路由设计和推测解码策略都有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 EcoSpec，在 draft-tree 选择时加入预测的边际专家激活成本。相较于只按 token 概率或接受概率扩展草稿，它把候选 token 会引入的新专家权重访存纳入目标函数，从而减少 expert scattering，即高概率候选路由到互不重叠专家导致的访存扩散。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验围绕大规模 MoE 推理中的 speculative decoding 展开，对比现有以接受率为中心的草稿选择策略。给定信息未提供具体 MoE 模型、参数量、专家数、硬件配置、吞吐提升或延迟下降幅度，因此需要读正文确认收益是否来自真实 serving 瓶颈而非简化成本模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses speculative decoding for MoE models when draft-token selection ignores expert-weight memory cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and MoE cost-modeling contribution. It argues that MoE speculative decoding is governed not only by acceptance rate and token count, but also by the union of experts activated during verification, which directly affects serving efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: EcoSpec augments draft-tree selection with predicted marginal expert activation cost. Instead of expanding candidates purely by probability or expected acceptance, it penalizes tokens that introduce additional expert-weight memory traffic, reducing expert scattering across draft candidates.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare cost-aware speculative decoding against acceptance-centered draft selection for large MoE inference. The supplied abstract does not give the exact MoE models, parameter counts, expert counts, hardware setup, throughput gains, or latency reductions, so the main paper is needed to judge how much of the gain holds under real serving conditions.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 expert-scattering 的测量和成本模型；若复现成立，MoE 推测解码不能再只优化接受率。
recommendation.en: Read the expert-scattering measurements and cost model; if they reproduce, MoE speculative decoding should not optimize acceptance rate alone.

paper.title: VisCo: Leveraging Large Language Models as Intrinsic Encoders for Visual Token Compression
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) process large numbers of visual tokens, resulting in substantial inference latency and memory overhead. This has motivated extensive research on visual token compression. While training-free strategies rely on heuristic metrics and suffer significant performance degradation under high compression ratios, many training-based methods introduce external compression modules that force the VLM backbone to adapt, incurring substantial retraining cost and compromising VLMs

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 推理中视觉 token 数量过多导致的延迟和显存开销问题，尤其关注高压缩率下性能退化和重训练成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 推理效率方法。它的价值不在预训练 recipe，而在提出一种利用已训练 VLM 内部表征做视觉 token 压缩的思路，避免额外压缩模块破坏 backbone 先验。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VisCo，一个训练高效的自压缩框架。方法把预训练 VLM 作为内在编码器，使用参数共享的 autoencoder 结构，用少量 memory tokens 承载视觉信息，并把编码阶段的层级信息传递到解码阶段。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据、具体 VLM backbone、压缩率、基线和提升幅度。能确认的是它对比了 training-free 启发式压缩和引入外部模块的 training-based 压缩路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the latency and memory cost caused by excessive visual tokens in VLM inference, especially under aggressive compression where existing methods often lose accuracy or require costly retraining.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution for VLMs. Its useful angle is to reuse the pretrained VLM’s own representational capacity for compression instead of adding an external compressor that may disturb the backbone’s priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: VisCo is a training-efficient self-compression framework. It treats the pretrained VLM as an intrinsic encoder, builds a parameter-sharing autoencoder, stores compressed visual information in a small set of memory tokens, and transfers hierarchical information from encoding to decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, exact VLM backbone, compression ratios, baselines, or numerical gains. It positions the method against training-free heuristic token pruning and training-based methods with external compression modules.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM token 压缩路线备查即可；重点看 memory token 自编码设计，别把它当预训练方法论。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a VLM token-compression reference; inspect the memory-token autoencoder design, but do not treat it as a pretraining result.

paper.title: FlashDiff: Efficient Regional Execution and Scheduling for Diffusion Model Serving
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have become the central backbone for modern image, video, and audio generation, but their efficient service remains a challenge. Unlike autoregressive decoding, diffusion inference repeatedly updates high-dimensional spatial or temporal latents over many denoising steps. This all-region execution pattern makes generation latency high and limits serving throughput. Existing multi-GPU parallelization methods can reduce per-step computation, but often introduce substantial activati

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion 图像、视频和音频生成服务中，每个 denoising step 都对完整 latent 区域执行计算，导致延迟高、吞吐低，以及多 GPU 并行通信开销抵消计算收益的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 diffusion serving 系统优化，而不是预训练方法；但它针对 AR decoding 之外的生成式推理形态，能提示统一生成模型 serving 不能直接套用 LLM token-by-token 的优化假设。
summary.technical_approach: FlashDiff 基于一个观察：diffusion refinement 在空间或时间 latent 区域上并不均匀，不同区域稳定速度不同，相邻 denoising steps 之间还有较强时间相关性。系统据此做 adaptive regional execution 和 scheduling，避免对已经稳定的区域重复执行全量更新，并在多 GPU 场景下降低无效计算和 activation exchange 的相对成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和数值结果；只说明其目标是提升 diffusion serving 的 latency 和 throughput，并指出现有多 GPU 并行方法常因 activation exchange overhead 使通信抵消计算收益。

summary_en.core_problem: FlashDiff targets high latency and low throughput in serving diffusion models for image, video, and audio generation, where every denoising step typically updates the full high-dimensional latent.
summary_en.importance: This is a diffusion serving systems paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance is that it studies a non-autoregressive generation workload whose bottlenecks differ from token-by-token LLM decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method exploits the observation that diffusion refinement is spatially or temporally non-uniform: different latent regions stabilize at different rates, and neighboring denoising steps are strongly correlated. FlashDiff uses adaptive regional execution and scheduling to avoid redundant full-region computation and to reduce the impact of activation exchange in multi-GPU execution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, or numerical speedups. It frames the evaluation around latency and throughput improvements over existing multi-GPU diffusion serving approaches, which can suffer from communication overhead dominating compute savings.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统假设是否成立：regional stabilization 若稳健，未来 AR+diffusion 统一 serving 会用到这个抽象。
recommendation.en: Skim only the system assumption: if regional stabilization is robust, this abstraction may matter for unified AR+diffusion serving.

paper.title: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity. We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability. Treating visua

summary.core_problem: VLM推理时视觉token序列过长导致计算开销大，现有token剪枝在高压缩率下信息损失严重。
summary.importance: 推理效率方向的方法改进，提出训练无关的保守token凝聚范式，属于增量型创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SpecFlow，将视觉token视为kNN图节点，通过谱热流计算重要性场、自适应空间划分保证覆盖、信息聚合到coreset sink保持统计守恒，无需微调。
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM架构和任务上与现有SOTA token剪枝方法对比，高压缩率下性能更优，兼容FlashAttention，即插即用。

summary_en.core_problem: Long visual token sequences make VLM inference expensive; existing token pruning methods degrade severely under high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: Incremental improvement in inference efficiency; proposes a training-free conservative token condensation paradigm as an alternative to destructive pruning.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecFlow treats visual tokens as nodes in a kNN graph, computes importance via spectral heat flow, allocates budgets through adaptive spatial partitioning, and aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to preserve statistical conservation, requiring no fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple VLM architectures and tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art token pruning methods especially at high compression rates; plug-and-play and FlashAttention-compatible.

recommendation.zh: VLM视觉token压缩的工程改进，训练无关思路有参考价值但非范式突破，看方法节即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering improvement for VLM visual token compression; training-free design is worth noting but not paradigm-shifting—skim the method section only.

paper.title: OS-Pruner: Pruning Chains-of-Thought of Reasoning Models via Optimal Stopping
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. However, these models often exhibit "computational overthinking," generating redundant reasoning steps that increase latency and cost without improving accuracy. Recent studies suggest that CoT trajectories can be significantly pruned, yet existing methods often rely on forcing a static thinking budget, heuristic filtering, sub-optimal early exit via classification,

summary.core_problem: 现有CoT推理剪枝方法依赖静态思考预算、启发式过滤、子优分类早停或需要重训练，无法动态平衡推理准确率与token成本。
summary.importance: 提出轻量插件式OS-Pruner框架，将CoT剪枝建模为最优停止问题，无需重训练即可动态决定推理终止点。
summary.technical_approach: 给定推理前缀，训练轻量停止决策器，优化显式效用函数（最终答案准确率减去生成长度对应的成本），动态判断是否值得继续生成后续推理步骤，无需修改原推理模型。
summary.experiments: 在多个主流推理基准上测试，在最小精度损失下显著缩短CoT推理长度，降低推理延迟与成本，效果优于现有静态剪枝与启发式早停方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing CoT pruning methods rely on static thinking budgets, heuristic filtering, suboptimal classification-based early exit or expensive retraining, failing to dynamically trade off reasoning accuracy and token cost.
summary_en.importance: Proposes OS-Pruner, a lightweight plug-in framework that formulates CoT pruning as an optimal stopping problem, dynamically determining reasoning termination points without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Given a reasoning prefix, trains a lightweight stopping classifier that optimizes an explicit utility function (final answer accuracy minus cost of generated length) to dynamically decide whether further reasoning is worth the token cost, requiring no modification to the original reasoning model.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple mainstream reasoning benchmarks, significantly reduces CoT length with minimal accuracy loss, lowering inference latency and cost, outperforming existing static pruning and heuristic early exit methods.

recommendation.zh: CoT剪枝的常规增量工作，将最优停止理论引入早停决策，作为推理效率方向文献备查，无需细读
recommendation.en: Routine incremental CoT pruning work applying optimal stopping for early exit, catalog as inference efficiency literature, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Adaptive Model Compression (AMC): Saliency-Driven Resource Allocation for Ultra-Low-Power Transformer Inference
paper.abstract: Deploying large-scale transformer models on resource-constrained edge devices remains a challenge due to the high energy and memory overhead inherent in static inference, which processes simple and complex tokens with uniform intensity. To address this, we propose Adaptive Model Compression (AMC), a saliency-driven framework that dynamically allocates hardware resources based on token importance. By implementing a multi-tier architecture, our system identifies critical high-saliency information

summary.core_problem: 解决 Transformer 在低功耗边缘设备上推理时，静态计算策略对简单 token 和复杂 token 一视同仁，导致能耗和内存开销过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和硬件资源调度方法。它不直接推进预训练，但对端侧 LLM/VLM 部署中的动态精度、动态低秩、token 级资源分配有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adaptive Model Compression，使用 saliency 信号判断 token 或中间表示的重要性；高 saliency 信息走全精度路径，低 saliency 信息则更激进地降低 rank 和 bit-width。方法重点不是训练新模型，而是在推理时做多层级资源分配。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 45nm CMOS 硬件设定下，系统能耗降低 59.2%，吞吐提升 2.24 倍，准确率损失 3.6%。未给出模型规模、任务集合、baseline 细节和 saliency 估计开销，结论需要看正文实验设置是否公平。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the inefficiency of static Transformer inference on ultra-low-power edge devices, where easy and hard tokens receive the same compute and precision budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency and hardware-aware resource allocation method. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to dynamic precision, low-rank execution, and token-level compute allocation for edge LLM deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adaptive Model Compression uses saliency signals to decide which information should be processed at full precision and which can tolerate aggressive rank and bit-width reduction. The main idea is a multi-tier inference path rather than a new training objective or model family.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 59.2% system-energy reduction and 2.24x throughput improvement on a 45nm CMOS hardware setup, with a 3.6% accuracy drop. Model scale, task suite, baselines, and saliency overhead are not specified in the abstract, so the claims depend heavily on the full setup.

recommendation.zh: 端侧动态压缩方向可以扫一眼，但对预训练没有直接动作；重点检查 saliency 计算开销是否被算进系统收益。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance for edge-side dynamic compression, but not a pretraining lever; check whether saliency overhead is included in the reported system gains.

paper.title: Model Guides You How to Draw: Adaptive Visual Gating for Unified Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) with interleaved reasoning, which generate both textual and visual steps as part of intermediate reasoning traces, have demonstrated great potential for visual mathematical reasoning tasks. However, we identify a key insight in this paradigm: generating intermediate visual reasoning steps is not always beneficial and can even be harmful, as self-generated visual steps may introduce erroneous visual evidence that misleads subsequent reasoning. Moreover, frequently

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态推理模型在中间推理链中何时该生成视觉步骤、何时不该生成，目前缺少可靠的自适应决策机制。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是预训练论文，但它触及一个对 native multimodal 建模很关键的问题：中间视觉 token/图像生成并非总是有益，错误视觉证据会反过来污染后续推理，同时还带来明显推理开销。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Adaptive Visual Gating，根据模型内部信号在完整视觉生成前预测该步视觉化是否值得执行。核心信号包括 Generation Intent（模型是否已有明确绘制计划）和 Visual Confidence 等，用门控策略动态决定是否触发视觉中间步骤，从而统一兼顾准确率与效率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体参数规模，但任务聚焦 visual mathematical reasoning。主要对比对象应是总是生成视觉中间步骤的统一多模态推理模型。论文声称同时改善准确率与推理效率，关键价值在于揭示“视觉 CoT 不是越多越好”的条件性结论，而非绝对性能数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Unified multimodal reasoning models lack a reliable mechanism to decide when intermediate visual reasoning steps should be generated and when they should be skipped.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it touches a question that matters for native multimodal modeling: intermediate visual generation is not always helpful, can inject misleading evidence, and adds substantial inference cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Adaptive Visual Gating, which uses internal model signals to predict before full visual generation whether a visual step is worth executing. The key signals include Generation Intent and Visual Confidence, and a gating policy dynamically decides whether to trigger visual intermediate steps.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, but the focus is visual mathematical reasoning. The likely baseline is always-on interleaved visual reasoning. The main value is the conditional finding that visual CoT is not uniformly beneficial, rather than any raw leaderboard number.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain，但结论对原生多模态很实用：中间视觉步骤会自我污染推理。读引言和门控信号设计就够，别被任务分数带偏。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but useful for native multimodal work: intermediate visual steps can poison later reasoning. Read the motivation and gating signals, not the benchmark chase.

paper.title: Beyond the Eye: Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Regulated Implicit Visual Tools
paper.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made remarkable progress on fine-grained perception tasks under the "Thinking with Images" (TwI) paradigm by iteratively performing various visual tool operations. However, this paradigm relies heavily on frequent external tool calls and repeated image re-encoding, which leads to substantial computational overhead and inference latency. To address these issues, we propose Beyond the Eye (BEE), a novel implicit visual tool paradigm centered on

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态大模型Thinking with Images范式依赖频繁外部视觉工具调用、重复图像编码导致推理开销和延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 多模态推理范式的效率改进，将显式工具调用内化到模型内部，属于MLLM后训练方法的增量创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BEE隐式视觉工具范式，通过两阶段训练：1) 构造形式化思维链SFT数据，将视觉工具调用行为融入训练目标；2) 自调节训练，鼓励模型自适应平衡内部知识与隐式工具调用，避免冗余工具使用。
summary.experiments: 未给出具体模型参数量和数据集规模，仅说明在细粒度感知任务上显著降低推理延迟，同时保持性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the high computational overhead and latency in MLLM 'Thinking with Images' paradigms caused by frequent external visual tool calls and repeated image re-encoding.
summary_en.importance: Efficiency-oriented improvement of multimodal reasoning paradigm that internalizes explicit tool calls; incremental innovation in MLLM post-training methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BEE, an implicit visual tool paradigm with two-stage training: (1) formalized CoT SFT that encodes visual tool invocation behaviors into the training objective; (2) self-regulated training that adaptively balances internal knowledge and implicit tools to avoid redundant usage.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model size and dataset scale not provided; only claims significantly reduced inference latency while maintaining performance on fine-grained perception tasks.

recommendation.zh: MLLM工具调用内化的思路可参考，但实验细节不足，作为后训练范式的弱信号备查即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of internalizing tool calls in MLLMs is worth noting, but experimental details are insufficient; keep as a weak signal for post-training paradigm reference.

paper.title: BlockServe: Block-Grained Continuous Batching for High-Throughput Diffusion LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Efficient serving of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is hindered by convergence heterogeneity: when batching multiple requests, different sequences converge at different rates, causing faster requests to stall behind slower stragglers and introducing compute bubbles and tail latency. We present BlockServe, a continuous batching framework that integrates block-grained scheduling -- immediately evicting completed requests at block boundaries -- with mixed-state execution that extends dual

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 diffusion LLM 在批量服务时的调度失配问题。dLLM 不是逐 token 生成，而是按 block 做多步去噪。不同请求会在不同 block 边界收敛或结束，快请求会被慢请求拖住，导致 active batch 中出现空转位置、GPU 利用率下降和尾延迟上升。AR LLM 的 token-level continuous batching 不能直接复用到这个场景。
summary.importance: 价值主要在 dLLM serving，而不是预训练目标本身。它给 diffusion LM 的系统可用性补了一块关键接口：block 长度、去噪步数、提前结束机制、padding 形状都会影响吞吐。对做新型语言建模范式的人，启发点是模型设计不能只看单请求延迟和质量，还要看 block 级执行能否被连续调度。否则 parallel denoising 的理论并行性会在真实多请求负载下被 straggler 抵消。
summary.technical_approach: BlockServe 把生成长度切成固定长度 block，每个 block 执行 S 步 diffusion denoising。系统维护一个 active set，允许不同请求处在不同 block index。核心是三部分。第一，block-grained scheduler 以一个 block-cycle 为调度量，执行完一个 block 后立即检查 EOS 或 block limit，完成的请求马上移出 active set，而不是等整个 batch 同步。第二，mixed-state memory manager 把不同 block 进度的请求重新映射到统一 dense tensor 中，通过显式 position alignment 和 gather-scatter indexing 支持异构 batch。这样可以沿用 dual cache 和 parallel decoding，不需要引入定制 kernel。第三，compute-aware admission controller 不再用固定 batch size，而是用 token budget 估计 dense tensor bounding box 的真实开销。当前 batch 的 row width、padding 和请求长度会影响可接纳请求数，因此控制器可以在长请求释放后回收 padding 空间，并补入更多短请求。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Dream 和 LLaDA 两类 dLLM 上进行，覆盖 5 个 benchmark。相对 Fast-dLLM，BlockServe 的吞吐提升为 1.9–10.6×，生成质量保持在相近水平。论文还报告 token-budget admission 可以把有效 batch capacity 提高约 2–4×。这些数字说明瓶颈主要来自调度和内存形状，而不是 diffusion step 本身的算子效率。更有用的实验信号是：完成请求在 block 边界立即驱逐后，compute bubbles 明显减少；使用 token budget 后，系统能利用 padding 回收带来的容量，而固定 batch size 做不到。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 convergence heterogeneity 的定义，它解释了为什么 AR continuous batching 不够用。再看 Figure 1 和 Algorithm 1，理解 block-cycle、eviction、refill 的执行顺序。方法部分重点看 scheduler、token budget admission 和 mixed-state memory manager。实验部分只需抓住三类结果：吞吐提升、质量是否退化、不同负载几何下的 capacity 变化。值得细看的是它对 block size、denoising steps、prompt/generation length 分布的敏感性；这些因素会反过来影响 dLLM 训练和推理接口的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a serving bottleneck specific to diffusion LLMs. These models generate blocks through iterative denoising rather than producing one token at a time. In a batch, requests can finish or converge at different block boundaries. Finished requests then wait for slower ones, leaving idle slots inside the active batch and increasing tail latency. Token-level continuous batching from autoregressive serving does not map cleanly to this execution model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on dLLM serving, but it is relevant to language-modeling research because it exposes a practical constraint of diffusion-style generation. Block length, number of denoising steps, early stopping, and padding geometry all affect whether parallel denoising translates into real throughput. For diffusion LM design, the lesson is that single-request latency is not enough; the generation process also needs a scheduling unit that works under concurrent workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: BlockServe divides each generation into fixed-length blocks, with each block processed by S denoising steps. It keeps an active set whose requests may be at different block indices. The system has three main components. A block-grained scheduler advances the active batch by one block-cycle, then immediately evicts requests that reach EOS or their block limit. A mixed-state memory manager packs heterogeneous requests into a unified dense tensor layout with explicit position alignment and gather-scatter indexing, extending dual cache and parallel decoding without custom kernels. A compute-aware admission controller replaces fixed batch size with a token budget based on the dense tensor bounding box. This lets the system recover padding and row-width slack after long requests leave, then admit more pending requests.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Dream and LLaDA on five benchmarks. BlockServe reports 1.9–10.6× higher throughput than Fast-dLLM while maintaining comparable generation quality. The token-budget admission policy increases effective batch capacity by about 2–4×. The useful signal is that much of the lost efficiency in batched dLLM inference comes from scheduling and tensor-shape waste, not only from the denoising computation itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the definition of convergence heterogeneity in the introduction. Then read Figure 1 and Algorithm 1 to understand the block-cycle execution loop. The most relevant method details are the block-grained scheduler, token-budget admission, and mixed-state memory layout. In the experiments, focus on throughput, quality retention, and how capacity changes under different request-length distributions. The sensitivity to block size, denoising steps, and prompt-generation length mix is the part most likely to inform diffusion LM design.

recommendation.zh: dLLM serving 的关键不是算子而是收敛异质性；只看调度设计和对 Fast-dLLM 的消融即可。
recommendation.en: The useful point is that dLLM serving is limited by convergence heterogeneity, not just kernels; read the scheduler and Fast-dLLM ablations.

paper.title: COBS: Cumulant Order Block Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Block sparse attention is a hardware friendly way to alleviate the key-value (KV) cache read bottleneck in large language models (LLMs). However, it is not prevalent among leading open-weight LLMs, which rely instead on dense attention or fine-grained selection, thereby motivating our analysis. We study DeepSeek's Native Sparse Attention (NSA) as a representative method, whose three-branch design lets us isolate block selection, the most challenging and consequential stage. We formalize selectio

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究长上下文解码中的 KV cache 读取瓶颈，核心问题是：block sparse attention 很适合硬件连续读取，但真正难的是在不读取完整 block 的情况下，准确选出对当前 query 贡献最大的历史 block。
summary.importance: 它对长上下文 LLM 的高效注意力设计有直接启发。论文把 block selection 明确化为估计 block attention mass，即一个 block 内 attention score 的总贡献。这个视角比只比较稀疏 pattern 更有用，因为它说明了为什么 mean-pooling 这类一阶 selector 会失败：它只看 block key 的均值，忽略了 block 内 key 分布沿 query 方向的弯曲程度。对预训练研究的意义在于，如果长上下文稀疏注意力要进入模型架构或训练 recipe，selector 的统计摘要需要和注意力目标对齐，而不是只追求缓存小或实现简单。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 DeepSeek Native Sparse Attention 作为分析对象。NSA 有 compression、selection 和 sliding-window 三个分支，其中 selection branch 决定哪些远距离 block 会被全分辨率读取。作者先在明确假设下证明，若目标是保持 dense attention 输出，block ranking 可以归约为按 attention mass 排序。Oracle Sparse Attention 使用真实 mass 排序，实验上接近 dense attention，说明主要困难不在排序准则，而在如何便宜地估计 mass。COBS 从 cumulant expansion 出发近似 block 的 log-sum-exp 贡献。一阶项对应 query 与 block mean key 的内积；二阶项引入 block 内 key covariance，即 query 方向上的方差项。为控制开销，COBS 对每个 block 缓存压缩后的 covariance，包括低秩分解、query-subspace projection 和 FP4 quantization。选择阶段用这个二阶估计给 block 打分，再对 top-k block 做细粒度 attention。
summary.experiments: 主要结果来自 11-task、32k context 的 RULER 配置。NSA baseline 平均分为 0.2999，COBS 提升到 0.8195，dense attention 为 0.9040。按论文口径，COBS 补回了 NSA 与 dense attention 差距的约 86%。同时，它的 KV cache read traffic 只有 NSA baseline 的 1.21×，比 dense attention 少 15.15×。Oracle mass selection 接近 dense attention，支持 attention mass 是合理选择目标。消融实验用于分离 covariance 项、低秩压缩、query 子空间投影和量化等设计的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。Section 3 最重要，它把 block selection 归约为 attention mass ranking，并用 oracle 结果验证准则。Section 4 解释 cumulant expansion，重点看一阶 selector 丢掉了什么；这里是论文的核心洞察。Section 5 看 COBS 如何缓存和压缩 covariance，注意额外 cache 开销与读取流量的取舍。Section 7 和 Figure 1 看 RULER 结果、traffic 对比和消融。需要带着一个问题读：这些 block-level 统计是否适合在预训练时固定进架构，还是更适合作为推理时的 cache-side 增强。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the KV-cache read bottleneck in long-context decoding. The central question is how to make hardware-friendly block sparse attention work: before reading a full block, the model needs a cheap selector that can identify the blocks contributing most to the current query.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to efficient long-context LLM design. It frames block selection as estimating block attention mass, the total attention contribution of a block. This is a more precise target than comparing sparse patterns alone. It also explains why first-order selectors based on mean-pooled keys can fail: they capture the block mean but ignore how the keys vary along the query direction. For pretraining and architecture work, the implication is that sparse-attention summaries should be matched to the attention objective, not only to cache size or implementation convenience.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis uses DeepSeek Native Sparse Attention as the reference system. NSA combines a compression branch, a selection branch, and a sliding-window branch; the paper isolates the selection branch because it decides which distant blocks are read at full resolution. Under explicit assumptions, the authors reduce output-preserving block selection to ranking blocks by attention mass. An oracle selector using exact mass nearly matches dense attention, which suggests that the main problem is estimating the mass cheaply. COBS derives a second-order selector from a cumulant expansion of the block contribution. The first-order term is the query dot product with the block mean key. The second-order term uses the within-block key covariance, capturing variance in the query direction. To keep the cache practical, COBS stores a compressed covariance per block using low-rank factorization, query-subspace projection, and FP4 quantization, then selects top-k blocks for fine-grained attention.
summary_en.experiments: On an 11-task 32k-context RULER configuration, the NSA baseline scores 0.2999 on average, COBS reaches 0.8195, and dense attention reaches 0.9040. By the authors' calculation, COBS closes about 86% of the gap between NSA and dense attention. Its KV-cache read traffic is only 1.21× that of the NSA baseline and 15.15× lower than dense attention. The oracle mass selector performs close to dense attention, supporting attention mass as the right selection target. Ablations separate the effects of the covariance term, compression choices, query-subspace projection, and quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Section 3 is the key part: it formalizes block selection as attention-mass ranking and validates the criterion with an oracle. Section 4 explains the cumulant view and why first-order selectors miss an important second-order term. Section 5 gives the practical COBS design, especially how covariance is cached and compressed. Section 7 and Figure 1 are useful for the RULER results, traffic comparison, and ablations. The main question to keep in mind is whether these block-level statistics should be built into a pretrained long-context architecture or used as an inference-side cache enhancement.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是问题拆解，不是名字里的新算法；先看它把 block selection 归约成 attention mass 的论证，再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the problem decomposition, not the new acronym; read the attention-mass reduction first, then decide whether it merits reproduction.

paper.title: Sensitivity-Aware Thresholding and Token Routing for Activation Sparsification in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Efficient inference in Large Language Models (LLMs) requires deciding where computation can be reduced while preserving model quality. We study this problem through multilayer perceptron (MLP) activation sparsification and token-level conditional routing. We first propose Sensitivity-Aware Thresholding for Sparsity (SATS), a threshold calibration method to choose layerwise gate thresholds using a local MLP output sensitivity proxy rather than calibrating thresholds directly from activation perce

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 推理时如何在 MLP 层减少激活计算，同时尽量保持模型质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法改进。它不是新的预训练范式，但触及一个对大模型 serving 有实际意义的问题：哪些 token、哪些层、哪些 MLP 激活可以安全跳过或稀疏化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SATS，即 Sensitivity-Aware Thresholding for Sparsity。它仍沿用对 MLP gate activation 设阈值的稀疏化机制，但不再用激活分位数直接校准阈值，而是用局部 MLP 输出敏感度作为代理信号选择各层阈值。论文还提出轻量 token routing，在 token 级别动态选择 base path 或 modified path，避免对所有 token 一刀切地使用修改后计算路径。
summary.experiments: 在多个近期 open-weight LLM 上评估 SATS 和 token routing。摘要未给出具体模型规模、稀疏率、延迟收益或精度下降数字；只能确认论文报告了相对 percentile-based calibration 和统一修改路径的对比与消融。
summary.authors_note: Santa Clara University 和 Sogang University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to reduce MLP activation computation during LLM inference while preserving model quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its value is in probing where computation can be skipped safely across layers and tokens in deployed LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose SATS, a sensitivity-aware calibration rule for activation sparsification. It keeps the standard mechanism of thresholding MLP gate activations, but replaces percentile-based threshold selection with a local proxy for MLP output sensitivity. They also introduce lightweight token-level routing that chooses between a base path and a modified path per token, instead of applying the modified computation uniformly.
summary_en.experiments: The methods are evaluated on several recent open-weight LLMs. The provided abstract does not include exact model sizes, sparsity levels, latency gains, or accuracy drops, but indicates comparisons against percentile calibration and uniform application of modified computation.
summary_en.authors_note: Santa Clara University and Sogang University.

recommendation.zh: 可扫方法图和消融；对 pretrain 没直接动作，但“敏感度而非分位数”是稀疏化校准里更干净的信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; it does not change pretraining practice, but sensitivity-based calibration is a cleaner sparsification signal than percentiles.

paper.title: Seeing is Free, Speaking is Not: Uncovering the True Energy Bottleneck in Edge VLM Inference
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the perceptual backbone of embodied AI, but their energy footprint on edge hardware remains poorly understood. Existing efficiency efforts focus predominantly on reducing visual tokens, implicitly treating visual processing as the dominant energy cost. We overturn this implicit assumption through the first systematic energy profiling of on-device VLM inference, spanning five models across three architecture families, four input resolutions, and two hardware plat

summary.core_problem: 澄清端侧VLM推理的真实能耗分布，纠正此前默认视觉处理是主要能耗瓶颈的认知偏差
summary.importance: 系统分析贡献，首次完成跨模型、跨硬件、跨输入设置的端侧VLM能耗profiling，为端侧VLM推理优化方向提供实测依据
summary.technical_approach: 选取3个架构族共5个VLM模型、4种输入分辨率，在NVIDIA RTX 3070和Jetson Orin NX两个硬件平台上，系统测量推理功率、时延、token级计算开销分布
summary.experiments: 得到三个核心结论：1. 模型平均推理功率为固有常数，随输入分辨率、图像复杂度、提示类型的波动小于5%，能耗差异全部来自推理时延；2. 每个输出token的时延是输入视觉token的11-39倍，自回归解码是核心能耗瓶颈；3. 视觉token压缩的能耗收益被显著高估

summary_en.core_problem: Clarify the real energy consumption distribution of on-device VLM inference, correcting the prior misperception that visual processing is the dominant energy bottleneck
summary_en.importance: System analysis contribution that presents the first cross-model, cross-hardware, cross-setting energy profiling for on-device VLMs, providing empirical evidence for on-device VLM inference optimization directions
summary_en.technical_approach: Selects 5 VLM models from 3 architecture families and 4 input resolutions, systematically measures inference power, latency and per-token compute overhead on NVIDIA RTX 3070 and Jetson Orin NX platforms
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings: 1. Average inference power is a model-intrinsic constant with <5% variation across inputs, all energy difference comes from latency; 2. Each output token costs 11-39x more latency than each input visual token, autoregressive decoding is the core energy bottleneck; 3. Energy gains from visual token reduction are significantly overestimated

recommendation.zh: 端侧VLM能耗的实测分析，核心结论符合直觉——自回归解码才是真瓶颈，看摘要三个结论即可，无需读全文
recommendation.en: Empirical energy profiling for on-device VLMs, the core finding that autoregressive decoding is the real bottleneck is intuitive; reading the three abstract findings is sufficient

paper.title: GATS: Graph-Augmented Tree Search with Layered World Models for Efficient Agent Planning
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise in multi-step planning tasks, but existing approaches like LATS (Language Agent Tree Search) and ReAct rely heavily on LLM inference during planning, leading to high computational costs and stochastic behavior. We present \textbf{GATS} (Graph-Augmented Tree Search), a planning framework that combines systematic UCB1-based tree search with a layered world model to eliminate LLM calls during inference while achieving superior planning performanc

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent规划方法（LATS、ReAct）在规划阶段过度依赖LLM推理，导致计算成本高、行为随机性强的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出结合树搜索与分层世界模型的Agent规划框架，在降低推理成本的同时提升规划成功率
summary.technical_approach: 原创GATS框架，三层世界模型分别为L1精确符号动作匹配、L2执行日志统计学习、L3未知动作的LLM预测，结合UCB1树搜索，推理时无需频繁调用LLM
summary.experiments: 合成规划任务上成功率100%（LATS为92%、ReAct为64%）；在覆盖编码、网页导航、长程任务的12种场景压力测试中保持100%成功率

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent planning methods such as LATS and ReAct rely excessively on LLM inference during planning, leading to high computational cost and high stochasticity
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: an agent planning framework combining tree search with layered world models, improving planning success rate while reducing inference cost
summary_en.technical_approach: Original GATS framework with a 3-layer world model: L1 exact symbolic action matching, L2 statistical learning from execution logs, L3 LLM-based prediction for unknown actions, paired with UCB1 tree search to minimize LLM calls during inference
summary_en.experiments: 100% success rate on synthetic planning tasks (92% for LATS, 64% for ReAct); maintains 100% success rate on 12-scenario stress tests covering coding, web navigation, and long-horizon tasks

recommendation.zh: Agent规划侧的增量改进，分层世界模型替代LLM调用的思路可参考，无需深读，作为方法库备查即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on agent planning; the layered world model design for reducing LLM calls is worth noting for reference only, no deep reading required

paper.title: Prompt Compression via Activation Aggregation
paper.abstract: Large language models process prompts by propagating activations through dozens of layers before generating a response. We ask whether the task-relevant information contained in an instruction prompt can be compressed into a single activation vector and re-injected into the model, replacing the original token sequence? We show this is achievable using a learned weighted sum of activations extracted at an intermediate layer and injected at an early layer of the target LLM. The compressed vector p

summary.core_problem: 解决固定 instruction prompt 每次推理都要完整前向传播的重复计算问题，并探查提示信息是否能被压缩成单个激活向量再注入模型。
summary.importance: 这篇工作兼具推理效率和机制分析价值。对 serving 侧，它提供了一种介于 prompt caching 与 soft prompt 之间的新压缩思路；对基座研究员，它给出一个更有意思的结论：中层激活可以跨层迁移，说明表示空间存在比通常假设更强的层间兼容性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 Activation Aggregation：从源 prompt 在中间层提取 token 级激活，学习一个加权求和得到单个压缩向量，再把该向量注入目标 LLM 的较早层，以替代原始 token 序列。核心不只是做 pooling，而是学习哪些位置和哪些中层表示最能保留任务相关信息，并验证单向量是否足以驱动后续生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要称压缩后相对完整 prompt 处理的准确率下降低于 2%。实验重点是固定 instruction prompt 的场景，比较完整提示、压缩激活注入等方案，并分析跨层注入的可行性。未在摘要中给出模型规模、数据集和具体 baseline 名称，因此目前更像一篇有趣的 early signal；若正文 setup 干净，这对 prompt-side compute reduction 和表示分析都值得跟进。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a fixed instruction prompt can be replaced by a single compressed activation vector, avoiding repeated full prompt processing at inference time.
summary_en.importance: It matters for both efficiency and representation analysis. On the systems side, it offers an alternative to prompt caching or soft prompts for fixed instructions. On the science side, it suggests stronger cross-layer compatibility than many people implicitly assume.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Activation Aggregation, extracts token activations from an intermediate layer, learns a weighted sum to form one compressed vector, and injects that vector into an early layer of the target LLM in place of the original token sequence. The key idea is to preserve task-relevant information in a single latent state rather than a token prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports under 2% accuracy drop relative to full prompt processing. The evaluation appears to compare full prompts against compressed-vector injection in fixed-instruction settings and includes analysis of cross-layer transferability. Model sizes, datasets, and exact baselines are not exposed in the abstract, so this is best treated as a promising but still setup-sensitive result.

recommendation.zh: 别把它只当压缩技巧看；如果实验控制得住，这会改你对“prompt 必须以 token 形式存在”的 prior，先看方法图和层间注入消融。
recommendation.en: Don’t read this as just another compression trick; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that prompts must live as tokens—start with the method figure and layer-injection ablations.

paper.title: It Takes a MAESTRO To Prune Bad Experts
paper.abstract: Sparsely-activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models achieve remarkable inference efficiency by activating only a small fraction of parameters per token, yet their full expert banks reside in memory at all times, creating a prohibitive deployment bottleneck. Existing structured pruning methods, largely designed for dense transformers, assess expert importance using locally derived heuristics that are blind to the interdependent nature of MoE routing. We introduce MAESTRO (Markov-chain App

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 语言模型部署时 expert bank 常驻显存带来的内存瓶颈，并避免用 dense Transformer 剪枝启发式误判 expert 重要性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 推理压缩和结构化剪枝方法。对基座研究员的间接价值在于，它把 MoE routing 的跨层依赖作为 expert 重要性信号；这类信号也可能反过来帮助分析预训练中的专家专化、路由退化和容量分配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAESTRO，即 Markov-chain Approximated Expert Sparsification via Transition-based Routing。方法把自回归生成中的 expert activation trajectory 建模为遍历 Markov chain，用 stationary distribution 表示跨层 expert routing 依赖，从而得到全局 aware 的 expert importance heuristic。相比只看局部权重、激活或梯度的剪枝，它显式利用 token 生成过程中专家选择的转移结构。
summary.experiments: 在五个不同领域评估，包括 Safety、Bias、Ethics 等维度。摘要称 MAESTRO 在结构化剪枝设定下相较现有强 baseline，平均性能保持率最高提升 10.61%。摘要未给出具体 MoE 模型名称、参数规模、保留 expert 比例和完整 benchmark 列表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Indian Institute of Technology Delhi；未见主流大模型训练团队或知名 MoE 作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the memory bottleneck of MoE language-model deployment, where all experts remain resident in memory despite sparse token-level activation.
summary_en.importance: This is a MoE inference-compression and structured-pruning contribution. Its value for pretraining researchers is indirect but real: it treats cross-layer routing dynamics as an expert-importance signal, which may also inform analysis of expert specialization and routing collapse during training.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAESTRO, or Markov-chain Approximated Expert Sparsification via Transition-based Routing, models autoregressive expert activation trajectories as ergodic Markov chains. The stationary distribution is used as a globally aware expert-importance heuristic that captures cross-layer routing dependencies, unlike local pruning heuristics designed mainly for dense Transformers.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated across five domains, including Safety, Bias, and Ethics. The abstract reports up to a 10.61% improvement in average performance retention over existing pruning baselines under structured expert pruning. The provided abstract does not specify the exact MoE models, parameter counts, pruning ratios, or full benchmark list.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Indian Institute of Technology Delhi; no major foundation-model MoE training lab affiliation is indicated in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 routing 统计怎么做；若只关心线上压缩，结果表有用，预训练 insight 主要在专家转移矩阵。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the routing statistics; if you only care about deployment compression, the tables suffice, while the pretraining signal is in the expert transition matrix.

paper.title: Closing the Null Space: Guidance-Aware Quantization for Classifier-Free Diffusion
paper.abstract: Deploying classifier-free guidance (CFG) diffusion models under real-world compute budgets requires quantization, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods treat CFG models as single-branch networks, ignoring the paired conditional/unconditional structure that CFG inference fundamentally relies on. This structural blind spot has two consequences. At the system level, the two-pass CFG execution pattern imposes a latency overhead that parameter-count and bit-operation metrics conceal e

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型训练后量化方法将CFG的条件/无条件分支当作单分支处理，导致量化后无条件分支漂移、引导预测失真，且实际延迟收益远低于理论BOPs估计。
summary.importance: 原理分析+方法创新：首次形式化证明并命名CFG量化中的分支漂移陷阱，提出感知引导的量化方法解决该问题。
summary.technical_approach: 解析证明CFG量化中存在仅匹配引导间隙却允许无条件分支任意漂移的零空间；提出同时约束条件分支、无条件分支与引导间隙的感知引导量化校准策略。
summary.experiments: 在常用CFG扩散生成模型上做INT8 PTQ实验，对比现有单分支量化方法，验证生成质量提升与实际推理延迟收益。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-training quantization for CFG diffusion models treats conditional and unconditional branches as a single network, causing unconditional branch drift that corrupts guided predictions and yields far lower real latency gains than theoretical BOP estimates.
summary_en.importance: Analytical + methodological contribution: first formal proof and naming of the branch-drift trap in CFG quantization, plus a guidance-aware quantization solution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analytically proves the existence of a null space where matching the guidance gap alone allows arbitrary drift in the unconditional branch; proposes a guidance-aware calibration strategy that jointly constrains conditional branch, unconditional branch, and guidance gap.
summary_en.experiments: INT8 PTQ experiments on common CFG diffusion models, comparing against single-branch quantization baselines and validating improved generation quality and real inference latency gains.

recommendation.zh: 针对扩散模型CFG量化的分支漂移问题，对LLM预训练研究员仅作多分支推理量化的参考，看证明部分即可。
recommendation.en: Relevant only as a reference for multi-branch inference quantization; pretraining researchers can skim the proof section and skip the rest.

paper.title: TriRoute: Unified Learned Routing for Joint Adaptive Attention, Experts, and KV-Cache Allocation
paper.abstract: Conditional computation can decouple language model quality from per-token inference cost, yet leading techniques act on a single axis in isolation: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) sparsifies the FFN, Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) skips whole transformer blocks, and KV-cache quantization compresses attention memory. We argue these three decisions (attention resolution, expert selection, and cache bit-width) are strongly coupled and should be made jointly: a token rare enough to warrant full attention may als

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是条件计算被“分轴优化”之后留下的结构性浪费。现有做法里，MoE 只管 FFN 稀疏化，MoD 只管跳层，KV-cache quantization 只管注意力记忆压缩。它们都在降低推理成本，但默认这些决策可以独立做。作者认为这是假设错了：一个 token 该不该看全局、该不该走重专家、它写入 cache 时该用几 bit，这三件事在语义上是耦合的。稀有实体词可能 FFN 变换不复杂，却需要高分辨率注意力和高精度 KV；功能词则可能三者都可以降配。核心问题因此是：能否用一个统一路由器，在每层、每 token 上联合决定 attention resolution、expert selection 和 KV precision，并把 FLOPs 与 memory 预算折成一个可控旋钮，而不是分别调三套稀疏超参。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义主要在架构与 serving 接口。它不是传统 pretrain recipe 论文，但它触及一个越来越重要的问题：训练时若不把推理资源分配作为模型内部决策的一部分，后续再把 MoE、跳层、KV 量化拼起来，往往会出现局部最优和尾部 token 退化。TriRoute 的价值在于把三种条件计算统一成一个 joint routing 问题，并显式处理跨轴 collapse 和统一预算控制。若实验结论成立，这说明未来模型设计不该把“参数激活”“深度使用”“记忆精度”视为三条独立工程线，而应当共同训练。量级上，这更像一篇有想法的系统化架构论文：它未必立刻改变主流预训练范式，但对长上下文 serving、native sparse model、以及 train-time aware inference optimization 都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
TriRoute 的核心是一个共享 controller。对每个 layer、每个 token，它同时输出三类决策。第一是 attention mode，候选包括 skip、local-window、full，决定该 token 在当前层使用多少注意力分辨率。第二是 FFN expert routing，在 E 个专家中选稀疏子集，并引入一个 null expert，把 MoD 式的 FFN skip 视为专家选择的特例，而不是额外分支。第三是 KV bit-width，决定该 token 自己写入 cache 时用 2/4/8/16 bit 中哪一档，从而影响未来 token 检索它时的保真度。这个设计的关键不是把三件事并排放在一起，而是共享同一份 token 表征，让路由器学到“什么 token 值得在哪些资源上花钱”。

训练上有三块技术处理。其一，三类决策的离散空间异质性很强：expert routing 是大类别稀疏选择，attention mode 和 bit-width 是小规模但代价差异很不均匀的分类。作者采用按轴定制的 straight-through / Gumbel-Softmax 松弛，并做温度退火，尽量让梯度尺度可比。其二，作者强调 cross-axis collapse cascade：如果 attention router 先学会大面积 skip，下游 FFN router 看到的输入分布会退化，进一步失去区分能力，bit router 也会变得无意义。为此论文设计了 coupling-aware balancing objective，不只做单轴 load balancing，而是抑制一个轴塌缩后拖垮其他轴。其三，预算控制采用统一可微 cost model，把 FLOPs 和 KV memory 合成单一成本，再用在线 Lagrangian dual 调节，使目标平均预算 C* 成为唯一外部旋钮。这样用户不需要分别调 expert sparsity、depth sparsity 和 quantization ratio。论文还探索 shared vs separate routers，以及 token/per-head/per-layer-group 的路由粒度，最后发现 attention 用 per-head routing，而 FFN 与 bit routing 用 token-level，是较好的折中。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 160M 到 1.3B 的 decoder-only 模型，并按 compute-optimal token budget 训练。主结果是：在匹配推理 FLOPs 和 memory 的条件下，TriRoute 优于作者构造的“独立调优后再组合”的 MoD + MoE + KV-quantization baseline，形成更好的 cost-quality Pareto 前沿。摘要里特别强调它对 rare tokens 和 tail-case accuracy 保留得更好，这与论文动机一致：统一路由比单轴稀疏更能保护语义关键 token。全文还做了几类重要消融。第一，共享路由器通常优于完全分离的三个路由器，说明三轴之间确实存在可利用的相关性；但在极高 sparsity 下会出现表示干扰，说明共享并非无条件更好。第二，路由粒度上，attention 若只做 token-level 可能过粗，per-head 更灵活；而 FFN 和 bit-width 不一定需要更细粒度。第三，coupling-aware balancing loss 对训练稳定性有明显作用，没有它时会出现某一轴先塌缩、随后其他轴跟着失效的连锁现象。第四，统一预算控制能较平滑地扫出不同成本点，而不是三套超参各自漂移。当前公开内容里没有看到特别细的绝对数字表格，但从论文叙述看，作者重点不是追求单点最优，而是证明联合路由在同等成本下更稳、更能保住长尾 token 的质量。
summary.reading_guide: 先看 Introduction 和方法总图，确认作者统一的是哪三条资源轴，以及为什么它们不是独立决策。然后重点读方法部分的三块：异质离散路由的训练松弛、cross-axis collapse 的分析与 balancing loss、统一成本模型与 Lagrangian 预算控制。这三处决定了论文是否只是“把三种技巧拼起来”，还是确实提出了新的联合优化框架。实验部分优先看 Pareto 曲线、shared vs separate router 消融、routing granularity 消融，以及 tail-case/rare token 的分析。如果时间有限，建议 30 分钟读主线：方法概览 + 主结果图 + 三个关键消融。若要判断它对真实系统是否有落地价值，还要留意两点：一是训练时引入的路由复杂度是否会抵消收益；二是 per-token/per-layer/per-head 的动态决策在实际 serving stack 中如何实现，尤其是与现有 KV layout、kernel fusion、batching 策略的兼容性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural inefficiency in conditional computation. Current methods optimize different inference resources in isolation: MoE sparsifies the FFN, Mixture-of-Depths skips blocks, and KV-cache quantization compresses attention memory. The authors argue that these decisions are semantically coupled. A rare entity token may not need a heavy FFN transformation, yet it may still require full attention and high-precision KV storage because future tokens must retrieve it accurately. Function words are different on all three axes. The core problem is therefore whether one can learn a single routing policy that jointly decides attention resolution, expert usage, and KV precision for each token at each layer, while exposing one unified cost knob instead of three unrelated sparsity hyperparameters.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, the paper sits at the architecture/serving boundary rather than in classic pretraining recipes. Its main significance is conceptual: it treats compute allocation as a joint modeling problem, not as a post hoc combination of separate tricks. If that framing is right, then future sparse models should co-train parameter activation, depth usage, and memory fidelity rather than optimize them independently. That matters for long-context serving, native sparse architectures, and train-time awareness of inference constraints. The contribution is not a new language-modeling objective, but a fairly systematic attempt to unify three major conditional-compute mechanisms under one learned controller.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TriRoute uses a shared controller that emits three coordinated decisions for every token at every layer. First, it chooses an attention mode: skip, local-window, or full. Second, it performs sparse FFN expert routing over E experts, with a null expert that recovers MoD-style FFN skipping as a special case. Third, it selects the bit-width used when the token writes its own key/value to the cache, choosing among 2, 4, 8, and 16 bits. The key idea is not just to place three routers side by side, but to let them share token representations so the model can learn which tokens deserve which kinds of resources.

Training this system is nontrivial because the routing spaces are heterogeneous. Expert routing is a large sparse categorical problem, while attention mode and bit-width are small categorical choices with highly uneven sensitivities. The paper uses per-axis straight-through / Gumbel-Softmax relaxations with temperature annealing to keep gradients usable. A second technical issue is cross-axis collapse. The authors argue, and empirically show, that collapse in one axis can induce collapse in the others: if attention routing becomes overly skip-heavy, the FFN router sees degraded inputs and loses discrimination, which then makes bit allocation less meaningful. To address this, they introduce a coupling-aware balancing objective rather than relying only on standard single-axis load balancing. Third, they define a unified differentiable cost model that combines FLOPs and KV memory, and enforce a target average budget with an online Lagrangian controller. This gives a single external budget knob. The paper also studies design choices such as shared versus separate routers and routing granularity, finding that per-head attention routing with token-level FFN and bit routing is a good trade-off.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span decoder-only models from 160M to 1.3B parameters, trained at compute-optimal token budgets. The main empirical claim is Pareto improvement: at matched inference FLOPs and memory, TriRoute outperforms the best independently tuned combination of MoD, MoE, and KV quantization. The paper also emphasizes better preservation of tail-case accuracy, especially on rare or semantically important tokens, which is exactly where isolated sparsity methods often fail. Several ablations are important. Shared routing generally beats fully separate routers, indicating that the three axes do carry exploitable correlations, although interference appears at very high sparsity. Routing granularity matters as well: attention benefits from per-head decisions, while FFN and bit-width routing do not obviously need finer granularity than token level. Another key result is that the coupling-aware balancing loss improves training stability; without it, one routing axis can collapse early and drag the others down. The unified budget controller also appears to produce smoother cost-quality trade-offs than tuning three mechanisms independently. The paper’s emphasis is less on one headline benchmark number and more on demonstrating that joint routing is a better way to spend a fixed inference budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: Begin with the introduction and the architecture overview to understand why the three resource axes are coupled rather than independent. Then focus on three technical sections: the heterogeneous routing relaxations, the analysis of cross-axis collapse and the balancing loss, and the unified cost model with the Lagrangian budget controller. Those are the parts that determine whether the paper is merely combining existing ideas or actually proposing a new optimization framework. In the experiments, prioritize the Pareto curves, the shared-versus-separate router ablation, the routing-granularity study, and the tail-token analysis. A 30-minute skim can cover the method overview, the main result figures, and the key ablations. For a deeper read, pay attention to implementation implications: how much training overhead the controller adds, and whether per-token/per-layer/per-head dynamic decisions can be realized cleanly in real serving stacks with existing KV layouts, fused kernels, and batching constraints.

recommendation.zh: 想法比数字更值得看；只读 controller 设计和预算损失，别被未披露的加速结果牵着走。
recommendation.en: The idea is more useful than the reported numbers; read the controller and budget objective, not the unspecified speedup claims.

paper.title: Think Before You Grid-Search: Floor-First Triage for LLM Serving
paper.abstract: LLM serving optimization typically benchmarks many configurations and reaches for heavy profilers when latency targets are missed. We argue for the reverse discipline: estimation is the analytical layer of profiling -- without it, optimization degenerates to grid search. Floor First is a residual-driven triage workflow. Each decode step is modeled as a five-dimensional resource vector (HBM bytes, FLOPs, network bytes, network messages, KV capacity); summing within a resource and maximizing acros

summary.core_problem: LLM推理服务优化的配置空间覆盖并行布局、批处理、量化、稀疏注意力、内核调优等多个维度，现有实践主要依赖网格搜索和临时性能分析，缺乏系统化的分诊决策流程，无法快速判断性能差距是源于硬件理论下限还是实现层面的可优化空间。
summary.importance: 提出了残差驱动的服务优化分诊方法，比盲目网格搜索效率更高，对生产环境LLM部署的性能调优有实际指导意义。对预训练研究员的价值在于可以清晰理解MoE等模型的部署资源瓶颈边界，辅助训练-部署联合设计。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是Floor First工作流：先基于模型维度、校准后的硬件速率、并行策略和负载形态计算每步延迟的理论下限，再将实测延迟与下限的差值作为残差判断优化优先级。具体包含四层设计：一是有明确停止规则的分诊流程，区分管线优化和内核优化两个方向；二是双边下限模型，乐观下限取各资源争用的最大值（假设资源完全重叠），悲观下限取各资源成本的总和（假设无重叠），实测值在区间内的位置可直接诊断资源重叠程度；三是墙序分析，按负载增长时的瓶颈先后（KV容量、KV带宽、权重带宽、计算）对比部署方案，而非仅看同批次延迟；四是屋顶线指标规范，明确不同阶段的有效利用率指标和分诊阈值校准方法。同时提供零依赖的Python计算器和可在Agent优化循环中执行的技能。
summary.experiments: 以DeepSeek-V3.2风格MoE模型在16张H20 GPU上的解码阶段为案例，推导了TP与EP+DP的最优选择、单流延迟物理边界、稀疏注意力的影响，首次给出了外销版H20 GPU的ridge点表征。案例数据为分析性下限值，通信常数经集群校准，GPU速率来自官方数据手册；实测延迟与下限的残差扫描实验计划在后续版本中补充。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2章的分诊工作流设计和第3章的双边下限模型，第5章的H20部署案例有实际参考价值。全文泛读约15-20分钟，适合需要做LLM部署性能调优的工程师快速了解方法论。
summary.authors_note: 具体作者与所属机构未在提供内容中明确，研究参考了LMSYS、蚂蚁集团的DeepSeek部署实践。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM serving optimization spans a vast configuration space including parallelism layout, batching, quantization, sparse attention, and kernel tuning. Current practices rely heavily on grid search and ad-hoc profiling, lacking a systematic triage workflow to quickly determine whether a performance gap comes from fundamental hardware limits or addressable implementation inefficiencies.
summary_en.importance: The residual-driven triage methodology provides a more efficient alternative to blind grid search for production LLM deployment. For pretraining researchers, it clarifies the resource bottleneck boundaries of models like MoE, which informs co-design of training and deployment pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is the Floor First workflow, which first computes per-step latency floors from model dimensions, calibrated hardware rates, parallelism setup, and workload shape, then uses the gap (residual) between measured latency and the floor to prioritize optimization. It has four key components: 1) A triage workflow with explicit stopping rules that dispatches work to pipeline optimization or kernel optimization tracks; 2) A two-sided floor model with an optimistic bound (max of per-resource contention, assuming full resource overlap) and a pessimistic bound (sum of per-resource costs, assuming no overlap), where the measurement's position in the interval directly diagnoses resource overlap; 3) Wall-order analysis that compares deployment options by which resource binds first as load grows (KV capacity, KV bandwidth, weight bandwidth, compute) rather than just same-batch latency; 4) Roofline metric discipline that defines meaningful utilization metrics per phase and calibration protocols for triage thresholds. A zero-dependency Python calculator and agent-enforceable optimization skill are also provided.
summary_en.experiments: A case study on a DeepSeek-V3.2-style MoE model with 16 H20 GPUs analyzes decode-stage tradeoffs between TP and EP+DP, single-stream latency physical bounds, and sparse attention effects. It provides the first ridge-point characterization of export-grade H20 GPUs. Results are analytical floors calibrated with cluster-measured communication constants and datasheet GPU rates; empirical residual sweep experiments are planned for a future revision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (triage workflow design) and Section 3 (two-sided floor model). Section 5 (H20 deployment case study) has practical reference value. Full skimming takes ~15-20 minutes, suitable for engineers doing LLM serving performance tuning.
summary_en.authors_note: Specific authors and affiliations are not clearly disclosed in the provided content; the research references DeepSeek deployment practices from LMSYS and Ant Group.

recommendation.zh: 只看§3的五维资源建模和[max, sum]区间判断法，做新架构推理成本估算时能省不少无意义的profiling工作。
recommendation.en: Read §3 for the 5-dim resource model and [max, sum] interval diagnostic; it cuts down pointless profiling work when estimating inference cost for new architectures.

paper.title: Bridging Diffusion Pruning and Step Distillation with Teacher-Aligned Repair
paper.abstract: Diffusion models generate high-quality images, but their inference cost comes from two sources: large denoising networks and repeated denoising steps. Existing compression pipelines usually attack these costs separately. Pruning reduces the network, but most pruning methods still rely on a long post-pruning retraining stage to recover a many-step sampler. Step distillation reduces the number of denoising steps, but it usually assumes a student that can already follow the teacher well enough to r

summary.core_problem: 解决图像 diffusion 模型推理成本同时来自网络规模和去噪步数时，剪枝与步数蒸馏难以直接衔接的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 diffusion 生成模型压缩与推理加速工作。对 LLM 基座研究员的间接价值在于提醒：结构压缩后的 student 可能已经偏离 teacher 分布，直接做 step distillation 会给出坏梯度。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先指出把 post-pruning retraining 直接替换为 step distillation 会失败；随后加入一个短的 teacher-alignment repair 阶段，在 noisy real-image latents 上把剪枝后的生成器重新对齐 teacher，再交给 one-step distillation。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到实验以 EDM2-XS teacher 为起点，剪枝后直接运行 SiDA 会产生不可用样本；加入 teacher-aligned repair 后再进行一步蒸馏。摘要未给出剪枝比例、FID、采样步数或速度提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to combine pruning and step distillation for image diffusion models, where inference cost comes from both network size and repeated denoising steps.
summary_en.importance: This is a diffusion compression and inference-efficiency paper. Its indirect lesson for LLM researchers is that a structurally compressed student may drift too far from the teacher distribution for step distillation to provide useful gradients.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper shows that replacing post-pruning retraining with step distillation fails. It introduces a short teacher-alignment repair stage that matches the pruned generator to the teacher on noisy real-image latents before handing the checkpoint to one-step distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments starting from an EDM2-XS teacher, where running SiDA directly from a pruned checkpoint produces unusable samples. The proposed repair stage is then used before one-step distillation. No pruning ratio, FID, step count, or speedup numbers are given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 弱相关但有一个干净教训：压缩后别急着蒸馏，先看 teacher alignment；读失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: Weakly relevant but with a clean lesson: after compression, check teacher alignment before distillation; the failure case is the useful part.

paper.title: Doomed from the Start: Early Abort of LLM Agent Episodes via a Recall-Controlled Probe Cascade
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents solving multi-step tasks frequently commit to trajectories that are doomed to fail, yet continue to consume substantial inference compute before the failure becomes observable. We show that failure is predictable early from the agent's internal representations: lightweight per-round probes on hidden activations anticipate eventual episode failure as early as the first interaction round, where scorers reading only the agent's observable behavior are barely better

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent在多步任务中常走上注定失败的轨迹，却持续消耗大量推理算力直到失败显现。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次利用Agent内部隐藏激活的轻量探针实现早期失败预测并构建可召回率保证的中止级联。
summary.technical_approach: 在每轮Agent隐藏状态上训练轻量探针预测最终失败，构建逐轮分布无关的校准门控，联合搜索每轮召回预算以保证全局成功episode存活率。
summary.experiments: 在TextCraft环境上测试两种Agent模型，90%召回目标下节省47.1%推理计算，第一轮即可预测失败且远优于仅看可观测行为的scorer。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents on multi-step tasks often follow doomed trajectories but continue consuming substantial inference compute until failure becomes observable.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first to use lightweight probes on agent internal hidden activations for early failure prediction with a recall-guaranteed abort cascade.
summary_en.technical_approach: Train lightweight per-round probes on hidden activations to predict eventual failure; build a distribution-free calibrated gate per round with jointly searched per-round recall budgets to guarantee global success-episode survival rate.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on TextCraft with two agent models. At 90% recall target, saves 47.1% inference compute; failure is predictable as early as round 1, far outperforming observable-behavior-only scorers.

recommendation.zh: 用内部激活探针做Agent早期中止的思路干净，对推理成本优化有参考，重点看§3探针设计和Fig 4早期预测曲线。
recommendation.en: Clean idea of using internal activation probes for early agent abort; useful for inference cost optimization. Focus on §3 probe design and Fig 4 early prediction curves.

paper.title: TORINO: Token Reduction via Interpretable Concept Overlap in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across different tasks, but their computational cost is dominated by the large number of visual tokens fed to the language model. Existing token reduction methods rely on attention-based scores or pairwise similarity, without an explicit semantic representation of each token. We introduce TORINO (TOken Reduction via Interpretable coNcept Overlap), a plug-and-play framework for adaptive visual token reduction in VLMs that req

summary.core_problem: TORINO 解决的是 VLM 推理时视觉 token 过多的问题：CLIP/ViT 产生的数百个 patch token 直接送入 LLM，带来较高的注意力计算和显存开销；已有剪枝或合并方法多依赖 attention、CLS 相似度或 embedding 距离，缺少对 token 语义冗余的显式刻画。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在两个接口问题：第一，解释性工具能否反过来指导模型计算路径；第二，视觉 token 压缩是否应从几何相似转向概念相似。对 native multimodal LLM 和图像 tokenization 方向有启发，因为它把视觉 token 的压缩依据从局部外观相似度换成 SAE latent 中的共享概念激活。中等压缩率下，如果语义冗余确实比 embedding 距离更可靠，这类方法可能成为多模态长上下文推理中的轻量前处理模块。
summary.technical_approach: TORINO 是一个无需微调的 inference-time 框架。它把视觉 encoder 某层输出的 patch token 输入到预训练 Sparse Autoencoder，得到稀疏 latent 表示。每个 latent 维度被视为一个较可解释的视觉概念，例如 sky、bull、grass、horns。方法用 token 的主导激活 latent 或共享 latent 来定义 concept overlap，再按概念重叠把 token 分组。分组后有两种压缩方式：一类是在组内剪掉被认为冗余的 token，另一类是将组内 token 融合成代表 token。关键区别在于，它不是用原始 embedding 的欧氏距离做合并，也不是用 attention 分数估计重要性，而是先把 token 映射到稀疏概念空间，再根据概念共享关系做决策。论文采用 Matryoshka BatchTopK SAE：BatchTopK 控制平均激活特征数，Matryoshka 结构让特征字典带有嵌套层级，这有利于用粗粒度概念形成语义区域，用细粒度概念保留局部差异。TORINO 还有固定预算版本，可以在目标 token 数约束下保留概念分组准则；自适应版本则让简单图像压缩得更强，复杂图像保留更多组。
summary.experiments: 根据论文给出的摘要和引言，实验重点是比较 TORINO 与 attention-based、CLS-similarity、pairwise-similarity 等视觉 token reduction baseline，在多个 VLM benchmark 上的性能-压缩折中。作者强调优势主要出现在 moderate-reduction regime，即中等压缩率区间：此时语义冗余仍有可利用空间，概念分组比纯相似度合并更容易保留任务相关信息。论文还分析了这种优势的区间性：压缩过轻时，各方法差距有限；压缩过重时，任何方法都会丢失必要视觉证据，概念空间也难以补偿。由于提供的正文片段没有包含完整结果表和具体数值，参数量、token 数、各 benchmark 精确提升幅度不宜补写。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分中 concept overlap 的定义、分组策略、组内 prune/merge 的具体实现，以及 fixed-budget 版本如何满足目标 token 数。实验部分重点看性能-压缩曲线，而不是只看单点结果；尤其要确认 moderate-reduction 区间的定义、不同 benchmark 上是否一致、以及在复杂图像和简单图像上的自适应 token 数分布。消融部分建议关注 SAE 层选择、latent 宽度、BatchTopK/Matryoshka 设置、用主导 latent 分组和多 latent overlap 分组的差别。若关心多模态预训练，可重点思考一个问题：SAE 字典是在 frozen encoder 上后训练得到，还是可以在未来作为 tokenizer/connector 训练目标的一部分。

summary_en.core_problem: TORINO targets the visual-token bottleneck in VLM inference. A CLIP/ViT encoder emits hundreds of patch tokens, and passing all of them into the LLM dominates latency and memory. Prior reduction methods usually rely on attention scores, CLS similarity, or raw embedding distance, which do not explicitly represent what semantic concept each token carries.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is not a new pretraining recipe, but a useful interface between interpretability and multimodal tokenization. The paper asks whether an SAE dictionary can be used as an operational compression signal, rather than only as a post-hoc analysis tool. For native multimodal LMs, the useful idea is to compress visual tokens by shared concept activations instead of local visual similarity. If this signal remains reliable at scale, it could be a lightweight front-end for multimodal long-context inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: TORINO is a plug-and-play inference-time method. It takes visual patch tokens from a frozen VLM, projects them through a pretrained Sparse Autoencoder, and obtains sparse latent activations. These latent dimensions are treated as interpretable visual concepts, such as sky, bull, grass, or horns. The method defines concept overlap through shared SAE activations, groups tokens by their dominant or overlapping active concepts, and then either prunes redundant tokens within each group or merges them into representative tokens. The central distinction from attention- or similarity-based reduction is the intermediate sparse concept space: reduction decisions are made after semantic decomposition, not directly in the dense embedding space. The paper uses Matryoshka BatchTopK SAEs.
