BatchTopK controls the average number of active features, while the Matryoshka objective encourages a nested feature hierarchy, which is useful for grouping coarse semantic regions while preserving finer distinctions when needed. A fixed-budget variant enforces a target number of output tokens while keeping the concept-guided grouping criterion.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided text, the empirical claim is that TORINO outperforms attention- and similarity-based baselines across VLM benchmarks in the moderate-reduction regime. This regime matters because semantic redundancy is still exploitable: mild compression leaves little room for improvement, while overly aggressive compression removes necessary visual evidence regardless of the scoring signal. The paper also appears to analyze why the advantage is regime-specific. The available content does not include the full result tables, so exact model sizes, token budgets, benchmark scores, and numerical gains should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is enough. Focus on the method section defining concept overlap, the grouping rule, the prune/merge procedure, and the fixed-budget variant. In the experiments, read the accuracy-vs-token curves rather than isolated numbers. Check whether the moderate-compression advantage is consistent across benchmarks, and whether adaptive token counts correlate with image complexity. The most useful ablations are likely SAE layer choice, latent width, BatchTopK/Matryoshka settings, and dominant-latent grouping versus multi-latent overlap. For multimodal pretraining, the key follow-up question is whether such SAE dictionaries should remain a post-hoc compression tool or be incorporated into tokenizer/connector training.

recommendation.zh: 用 SAE 提取的语义概念来做视觉 Token 压缩，思路很巧，为 VLM 推理加速提供了一个比 attention score 更具可解释性的 baseline，值得一看。
recommendation.en: Cleverly uses SAE-extracted semantic concepts for visual token compression, providing a more interpretable baseline than attention scores for VLM inference acceleration; worth a skim.

paper.title: How Much of the Routing Gap Is Real? Decomposing the Router-to-Oracle Gap into Reproducible Specialist Advantage and Single-Draw Label Noise
paper.abstract: Routing among large language models (LLMs) promises better quality at lower cost, motivated by the reported gap between learned routers and a per-instance oracle. But that oracle is computed from a single correctness label per (query, model), so under stochastic decoding it is one Bernoulli draw, not a reproducible property. We recast the question structurally: the expected per-instance oracle decomposes as $O^{\exp}=O^{\mathrm{repro}}+Δ$, into reproducible single-commit headroom $O^{\mathrm{rep

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM路由评测普遍使用单次采样构造的先知路由（oracle）：每个query对应每个模型仅生成1次输出判断正确性，以此计算路由器到oracle的性能gap。该gap没有区分随机解码带来的不可约单次采样噪声，与确实可通过路由到对应专家模型复现的性能提升，容易导致对路由性能上限和优化方向的误判。
summary.importance: 纠正了路由领域长期沿用的oracle指标存在的系统性向上偏差，给出了gap的严格分解方法和标准化测量协议，对MoE路由设计、多模型池服务调度、路由方法的公平评测都有直接参考价值，可避免优化资源浪费在不可复现的噪声分量上。
summary.technical_approach: 将温度>0下每个(query, model)对的正确性建模为伯努利随机变量，证明现有单次采样oracle是对多个伯努利变量取最大值，天然存在向上偏差。推导了精确的非负gap分解：路由器到期望oracle的gap可拆分为两部分，一是可复现的专家优势，即任意单提交路由器可达到的性能上限；二是单次采样标签噪声，即任何单提交路由器都无法捕获、仅能通过测试时多次重采样获得的收益。同时给出齐次困难查询、低可靠性模型场景下的噪声占比闭式表达和下界，配套提出k≥10次采样的重估计测量协议、修正后的可复现oracle定义及阈值变体，开源了重计算后的数据集和实现代码。
summary.experiments: 在真实开放模型池上的测量显示，现有公开报告的路由器到oracle gap中，12%~36%属于不可约的单次采样标签噪声，剩余大部分为真实可恢复的专家优势。理论推导表明，当所有模型在某类query上的正确率均较低时，噪声占比可达Θ(1-p̄)量级，极端场景下单次采样oracle会严重高估路由可实现的收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计耗时15分钟。重点看第三节的gap分解定理、第六节真实模型池上的噪声占比测量结果，掌握修正后的oracle测量协议；完整证明细节可跳过，核心结论是路由评测不能使用单次采样oracle作为性能上限，否则会系统性高估路由潜力。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM routing benchmarks universally compute the router-to-oracle performance gap using a single-draw oracle, where correctness for each (query, model) pair is evaluated from only one sampled generation under stochastic decoding. This metric fails to separate irreducible single-sample noise from reproducible performance gains achievable by routing to a specialist model, leading to misestimation of routing upper bounds and misaligned optimization targets.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies and corrects a systematic upward bias in the standard oracle metric widely used in LLM routing research. It provides a rigorous gap decomposition framework and standardized measurement protocol, with direct practical value for MoE routing design, multi-model pool serving scheduling, and fair evaluation of routing methods, preventing wasted optimization effort on irrecoverable noise components.
summary_en.technical_approach: Correctness for each (query, model) pair under non-zero temperature is modeled as a Bernoulli random variable. The standard single-draw oracle, which takes the maximum over these binary single samples, is formally proved to be an upward-biased estimator. An exact non-negative decomposition is derived: the router-to-expected-oracle gap splits into two parts: (1) reproducible specialist advantage, the upper bound achievable by any single-commit router, and (2) single-draw label noise, which no single-commit router can capture and is only accessible via test-time resampling. Closed-form bias expressions and lower bounds on noise share are derived for scenarios including homogeneously hard queries and low model reliability. A measurement protocol using k≥10 samples per (query, model) pair is introduced, alongside a corrected reproducible oracle definition and threshold variant, with open-sourced re-estimated datasets and implementation code.
summary_en.experiments: Measurements on real open model pools show 12% to 36% of the reported router-to-oracle gap comes from irreducible single-draw label noise, with the remainder consisting of genuine recoverable specialist advantage. Theoretical results indicate that for query classes where all models have low success probability, the noise share scales as Θ(1-p̄), and single-draw oracles can severely overestimate achievable routing gains in extreme cases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in ~15 minutes. Focus on the gap decomposition theorems in Section 3 and the empirical noise share measurements on real model pools in Section 6 to understand the corrected oracle measurement protocol. Full proof details can be skipped for most readers; the key takeaway is that single-draw oracles systematically overestimate routing potential and should not be used as a performance upper bound for routing evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看分解式和噪声界；若成立，很多 routing oracle gap 不能再当可学习上界。
recommendation.en: Read the decomposition and noise bounds; if they hold, many routing oracle gaps should not be treated as learnable headroom.

paper.title: KVpop -- Key-Value Cache Compression with Predictive Online Pruning
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache growth is a major bottleneck in autoregressive decoding, as memory and bandwidth scale linearly with context length. Existing KV eviction methods often rely on static heuristics or proxy scores, which poorly track future token utility and cause brittle eviction as relevance shifts. To address this, we introduce KVpop, which learns a fixed-budget KV eviction policy by directly supervising the keep-or-drop decision. The scorer is trained against a novel future-attention target

summary.core_problem: 现有KV缓存压缩方法要么依赖启发式规则无法精准识别长期有用token，要么学习式策略在token插入时就做驱逐决策且监督信号未对齐未来实际效用，导致高压缩率下性能下降明显。
summary.importance: KV缓存驱逐策略的设计可与训练阶段的未来注意力监督信号深度结合，该思路不仅适用于推理优化，还可迁移到Transformer-SSM混合架构等需要动态选择序列记忆的场景；延迟决策到驱逐边界的设计，为平衡短期上下文证据与长期记忆保留提供了可落地的方案，且无需修改基础模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作为预训练LLM的稀疏注意力改造方案，每个KV头固定保留少量sink token、最近的保护窗口token，其余旧token竞争固定数量的长期缓存槽位；核心设计包括两点：一是用token离开保护窗口后收到的未来注意力质量作为监督信号，训练时通过转置注意力pass计算目标，无需实例化稠密注意力图，无推理开销；二是支持有状态打分器，将token的打分决策延迟到其即将离开保护窗口的驱逐边界，利用保护窗口内积累的近未来上下文提升判断准确性；训练时采用边界感知的pairwise logistic loss，仅关注决定缓存去留的边界处token排序，推理时每个头的KV缓存大小固定。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-4B上，75%和88%的KV压缩率下分别保留95%和94%的稠密注意力性能；在Qwen3-8B上，同压缩率下分别保留95%和99%的稠密注意力性能，表现优于启发式与现有学习式驱逐基线；学到的驱逐策略可迁移到分布外的代码生成与STEM推理基准，同时实现近乎恒定的内存占用与更快的长序列生成速度。
summary.reading_guide: 先看引言中现有KV驱逐方法的缺陷与Figure1的整体架构示意图，再泛读方法部分的未来注意力目标定义、边界感知损失设计与有状态打分器机制；实验部分重点关注不同压缩率下的性能保留率与跨域迁移结果，附录的实现细节可按需查阅，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache compression methods rely on either heuristic rules that fail to identify long-term useful tokens or learned policies that make eviction decisions at insertion time with supervision unaligned to future utility, leading to steep performance drops at high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: The design of KV eviction policies can be tightly coupled with training-time supervision from future attention patterns, a principle that extends beyond inference optimization to memory selection mechanisms in hybrid architectures such as Transformer-SSM models. The delayed-decision framing provides a practical way to balance short-term context evidence and long-term memory retention without modifying the base model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: A sparse-attention retrofit for pretrained LLMs that enforces a fixed per-head KV budget: each head permanently retains a small set of sink tokens, a protected window of recent tokens, and a fixed-size top-k long-range cache for older tokens. Two core designs distinguish it from prior work: first, supervision uses the future attention mass a token receives after leaving the protected window, computed via a training-only transposed attention pass that avoids materializing dense attention maps, adding no inference overhead; second, stateful scorers delay retention scoring until the token reaches the eviction boundary, leveraging near-future context accumulated during the protected period. Training uses a boundary-aware pairwise logistic loss that only focuses on token ranking decisions that determine cache membership, keeping per-step compute overhead low.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-4B, it retains 95% and 94% of dense-attention performance at 75% and 88% KV compression ratios respectively. On Qwen3-8B, it retains 95% and 99% of dense performance under the same compression ratios, outperforming both heuristic and existing learned eviction baselines. The learned policy transfers to out-of-domain code generation and STEM reasoning benchmarks, with near-constant memory usage and faster long-sequence generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the limitations of prior KV eviction methods in the introduction and the overall pipeline diagram in Figure 1, then skim the method section for the future-attention target definition, boundary-aware loss design, and stateful scorer mechanism. Focus the experiment review on performance retention across compression ratios and out-of-domain transfer results; skip appendix implementation details unless reproducing the method. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读这篇主要不是学 serving，而是看它把“未来注意力”当监督信号这件事；若结果稳，说明很多 KV 启发式其实一直在错估 token utility。
recommendation.en: Read it less for serving tricks and more for the idea of supervising cache eviction with future attention; if the setup holds, many heuristic KV policies have been mismeasuring token utility.

paper.title: Do All Visual Tokens Matter Equally? Object-Evidence Preserving Token Merging for Vision-Language Retrieval
paper.abstract: Multi-vector vision-language retrieval preserves fine-grained visual evidence through maximum-similarity late interaction, but dense image-side tokens make storage and scoring expensive. Existing token compression methods reduce this cost, yet they can remove or collapse object- and region-level evidence that future query tokens may need to select. We propose SaMer, an object-aware token merging framework that compresses image-side post-projector tokens into $K$ representative centroids while pr

summary.core_problem: 解决多向量 vision-language retrieval 中图像侧 token 过多导致的存储和 late-interaction 打分成本问题，同时避免压缩破坏对象级证据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态检索推理效率方法。它不直接推进 VLM 预训练，但对视觉 token 压缩如何保留可查询证据有工程参考，尤其适合关注长文档图像检索或多模态 serving 成本的人。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SaMer，一个 object-aware token merging 框架，把 image-side post-projector tokens 合并为 K 个代表性 centroid，并保持原 late-interaction 接口。训练时用 object annotations 作为 merge prior，约束不同实例的 token 不被混合；推理时不需要检测器或标注，只调整共享 projection layer，冻结视觉和语言 backbone。
summary.experiments: 在 K=64 时，SaMer 移除超过 93% 的图像侧 token，使 ColPali 存储降低 16.09 倍，并在 Flickr30K 和 MSCOCO 上提升 R@1。摘要没有给出完整 baseline 表，但强调相比一般 token compression，object-evidence preserving 的合并策略能同时降成本和保留检索性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Catholic University of Korea、Korea University 和 AIGEN Sciences Inc。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the storage and scoring cost of dense image-side tokens in multi-vector vision-language retrieval, while trying not to destroy object-level evidence needed by future text queries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for multimodal retrieval. It does not directly advance VLM pretraining, but it is relevant for understanding how visual-token compression can preserve query-selectable evidence under late interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: SaMer merges image-side post-projector tokens into K representative centroids while preserving the original late-interaction interface. It uses object annotations only during training as a merge prior to discourage cross-instance mixing; at inference it needs no detector or bounding boxes and adapts only the shared projection layer with frozen vision and language backbones.
summary_en.experiments: With K=64, SaMer removes more than 93% of image-side tokens, reduces ColPali storage by 16.09x, and improves R@1 on Flickr30K and MSCOCO. The abstract does not provide the full baseline table, but the reported result suggests object-aware merging can reduce cost without the usual retrieval degradation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with The Catholic University of Korea, Korea University, and AIGEN Sciences Inc.

recommendation.zh: 只看 K=64 压缩结果和 object prior 设计；对视觉 token serving 有用，但不是预训练层面的结论。
recommendation.en: Read only the K=64 compression result and the object-prior design; useful for visual-token serving, not a pretraining-level result.

paper.title: RotateAttention: RoPE-Aware Rotation and Range Rectification for INT4 Quantized Attention in Video Generation
paper.abstract: In \textbf{DiT-based video generation models equipped with 3D Rotary Position Embeddings (3D RoPE)}, the attention mechanism remains a primary computational bottleneck due to its quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. While quantized \textbf{FlashAttention} offers a promising path toward hardware acceleration, existing low-bit quantization methods overlook two critical challenges in this setting: \textbf{1)} applying online rotation matrices -- a widely used technique for mitigati

summary.core_problem: 在使用 3D RoPE 的 DiT 视频生成模型中，将注意力模块做 INT4 量化加速，同时避免 RoPE 与低比特旋转/量化策略冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和低比特注意力优化。虽然目标是视频生成 DiT，不是 LLM，但 RoPE-aware attention quantization、outlier 处理和 FlashAttention 量化路径对长序列 LLM 推理有可迁移的工程信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RotateAttention，一个 mixed-precision INT4 FlashAttention 方案。核心观察是 Q/K outlier 分布受 3D RoPE 维度划分显著影响；方法针对 RoPE 调整在线旋转矩阵使用方式，并对非负注意力矩阵 P 的量化范围做 rectification，减少对称量化浪费动态范围的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频模型规模、视频长度、硬件平台、速度提升或质量指标变化。实验应围绕 DiT-based video generation with 3D RoPE，对比常规低比特量化和量化 FlashAttention 的效率与生成质量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology 及独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets INT4 quantized attention for DiT-based video generation models using 3D RoPE, where RoPE interacts poorly with common rotation-based outlier mitigation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for low-bit attention. Although the target is video DiT rather than LLMs, the RoPE-aware treatment of Q/K outliers and quantized FlashAttention has transferable engineering value for long-sequence models.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes RotateAttention, a mixed-precision INT4 FlashAttention method. The key observation is that Q/K outlier distributions are strongly affected by the dimensional partitioning of 3D RoPE. The method adapts online rotations to RoPE and rectifies the quantization range for the non-negative attention matrix P to avoid wasting half of the symmetric INT4 range.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, video lengths, hardware setup, speedups, or quality deltas. The evaluation is expected to compare RotateAttention with existing low-bit and quantized FlashAttention baselines on DiT video generation models with 3D RoPE.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations are The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Independent Researcher.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和方法图就够；RoPE 与 INT4 attention 的冲突是真问题，但视频 DiT 结论需谨慎迁移到 LLM。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and method figure; the RoPE–INT4 attention conflict is real, but results from video DiTs should be transferred to LLMs cautiously.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Seeing Once is Enough? Online Geometry-Aware Token Pruning for 3D Question Answering
paper.abstract: Recent Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on 2D question answering tasks. However, extending these models to the 3D question answering remains challenging, as they typically require multiple views of the scene, which incurs substantial computational cost at inference. To mitigate this issue, existing solutions rely on strategic frame selection or token-merging algorithms that require preprocessing in advance all frames of the scene, i.e., an offlin

summary.core_problem: 降低多视角 3D Question Answering 中 MLLM 推理时的视觉 token 数量和显存开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法，目标是 3D 多模态问答中的在线 token pruning。它不是预训练工作，但对多模态长输入的 token 冗余处理有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法利用深度信息和相机位姿，把每帧图像 token 投影到共享 voxel 空间，识别跨帧空间重叠区域，并在 token 进入语言模型前剪掉冗余 token。核心区别是在线处理，不需要提前读取并预处理整个场景，也不需要额外训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM、3D QA 数据集、token 削减比例、显存下降幅度或准确率变化；声称可无训练接入现有 MLLM，并降低内存使用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the high visual-token and memory cost of multi-view MLLM inference for 3D question answering.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for 3D multimodal QA. It is not a pretraining paper, but it offers a useful data-redundancy signal for handling multi-view visual inputs before the language model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method projects tokens from each incoming frame into a shared voxel space using depth and camera pose, detects spatial overlap across frames, and prunes redundant image tokens before they are fed to the language model. Unlike offline frame selection or token merging, it operates online and requires no additional training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the evaluated MLLMs, 3D QA datasets, pruning ratios, memory savings, or accuracy trade-offs. It claims seamless integration with existing MLLMs and lower memory usage.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；它处理的是多视角 token 冗余，不改变 MLLM 训练范式。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations only; it is useful token-redundancy engineering, not a change to MLLM training.

paper.title: OmniFocus: Query-Guided Modality-Balanced Token Compression for Omni-Modal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Omni modal large language models (OmniLLMs) have attracted wide attention for their ability to jointly process audio and video, but they generate large token sequences under audio-visual inputs, leading to substantial inference cost. Existing audio-visual token compression methods often rely on unimodal guidance, overlooking the temporal locality of query-relevant evidence in audio-visual inputs and implicitly assuming that the two modalities share a temporally aligned information density distri

summary.core_problem: 在音视频输入的 OmniLLM 中，如何在不训练模型的情况下压缩大量多模态 token，同时尽量保留与查询相关的证据。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态推理效率方法，不是预训练方法；它对预训练研究的间接价值在于提醒音频和视频 token 的信息密度未必同步，统一模型的 token budget 不能只按单一模态估计。
summary.technical_approach: OmniFocus 是 training-free 的 query-guided token compression 方法。它分别估计视频和音频 token 对当前查询的重要性，而不是用单一模态引导另一模态；再用模态对称的压缩策略保留各自显著证据，并维持音视频对齐，减少单模态引导带来的 modality bias。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen2.5-Omni 系列模型，在四个音视频 benchmark 上评估压缩效果。摘要说明方法优于现有音视频 token 压缩思路，但截断文本未提供具体压缩率、准确率变化和延迟收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to compress long audio-video token sequences for OmniLLMs at inference time while preserving query-relevant evidence.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method rather than a pretraining method. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers is that audio and video may have different temporal information-density profiles, so token budgets in unified models should not be estimated from a single modality.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniFocus is a training-free, query-guided token-compression method. It estimates importance independently for video and audio tokens, instead of using one modality to guide compression of the other. The design keeps modality-specific salient evidence while maintaining audio-video alignment, reducing modality bias from unimodal guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on the Qwen2.5-Omni model family across four audio-video benchmarks. The abstract indicates improvements over prior audio-video token-compression approaches, but the provided text does not include exact compression ratios, accuracy deltas, or latency numbers.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；独立估计音频/视频重要性这个假设，对多模态 token 配比有弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and ablations; independent audio/video importance is a useful weak signal for multimodal token budgeting.

paper.title: The risk of KV cache compression
paper.abstract: Transformer inference on long sequences is expensive because softmax attention repeatedly reads from a large KV cache. The prevalent approach to this bottleneck is KV cache compression, which replaces the full cache with a compact summary. Despite its practical importance, the design of such summaries is largely driven by empirical experimentation. On the theoretical side, existing results show that KV cache compression can be impossible in the worst case, but offer little systematic guidance fo

summary.core_problem: KV cache compression常用启发式规则决定保留哪些 token，例如近因性、累计 attention mass 或 attention sink，但缺少一个回答“什么时候能安全压缩、压缩到多小会不可避免地产生误差”的理论框架。该工作研究固定压缩预算下，压缩后的 KV cache 在未来 query 上保留 softmax attention 输出的最小可达风险。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏理论和推理效率，但对长上下文预训练研究也有启发。它把 KV cache 看成模型对过去上下文的可查询记忆，而不是一串可按局部分数删除的 token。结论提示：压缩是否安全取决于未来 query 如何探测这段 cache；如果很多历史 token 对未来 query 是可区分、可单独检索的，小摘要必然丢信息；如果 query 分布只能看到低复杂度结构，则可以大幅压缩。这有助于设计长上下文模型和推理系统时区分“上下文长度”与“可用记忆容量”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，单个 attention head 的 KV cache 被形式化为 key-value 空间上的概率测度 P。softmax attention 被改写为带 Gaussian kernel 的积分形式，value 输出只依赖于 P 在未来 query 下诱导的加权响应。KV 压缩因此变成稀疏测度近似：用一个更少原子的测度 Q 替代完整 cache，并度量两者在未来 query 分布上的 attention 输出误差。该工作给出 minimax risk 的上下界，用一个数据相关的 intrinsic complexity 描述 cache 在未来 query 下的可压缩性。它还区分了能访问未来 query 分布和不能访问未来 query 分布的算法，证明两者存在风险差距。算法设计原则不是简单 token eviction，而是保留未来 query 实际能区分的 kernel-weighted value 结构。
summary.experiments: 实验部分主要用于验证理论设计原则，而不是追求大规模系统指标。作者在 LongBench 上做 targeted evaluation，将理论原则实例化为一个 KV compression 算法，并和常见压缩启发式进行比较。结果显示，在长上下文任务和压缩预算受限时，该方法能保持较好的任务表现，说明基于 query-cache 交互结构的压缩比单纯按近因性或历史 attention mass 更稳。材料中未给出完整表格数字，因此不宜过度解读绝对性能。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30 分钟。先看 Problem setup，理解为什么 softmax attention 可以写成 context measure 上的 kernel attention；再看 minimax risk 的定义和上下界陈述，重点是 intrinsic complexity 如何刻画“未来 query 能分辨多少历史信息”。算法部分主要看它如何在 causal prefill 和 autoregressive decoding 中近似这些理论条件。实验只需看 LongBench 设置、压缩预算和失败案例，因为理论假设与真实 Transformer 多层多头之间的差距是判断实用性的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache compression is widely used for long-context inference, but most methods rely on heuristics such as recency, accumulated attention mass, or attention sinks. The paper asks a more basic question: for a fixed compression budget, what is the unavoidable error when replacing a full KV cache with a compact summary that must preserve future softmax attention outputs?
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly about inference efficiency, but it is relevant to long-context model research because it treats the KV cache as a queryable memory rather than a sequence of tokens with fixed salience. The key implication is that compressibility is not an intrinsic property of a token. It depends on how future queries interact with the cache. If many past items are separately retrievable, small summaries must lose information. If future queries only probe a low-complexity structure, substantial compression is possible. This distinction matters for both serving systems and the design of long-context training regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes the KV cache of a single attention head as a probability measure over key-value pairs. Softmax attention is rewritten as a kernel attention map, using a Gaussian-kernel representation after absorbing key-norm factors into the measure. Compression then becomes sparse approximation of this measure: replace the full context measure P with an m-atomic summary Q and measure the discrepancy in attention outputs under a future-query distribution. The main theoretical contribution is a characterization of minimax risk through an intrinsic complexity measure that captures how richly future queries can probe the cache. The results also show a separation between algorithms that know the future-query distribution and those that do not. The resulting design principle is to preserve the query-visible kernel-weighted value structure, not just to evict tokens by local importance scores.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section instantiates the theory into a concrete KV compression algorithm and evaluates it on LongBench with targeted long-context experiments. The reported behavior is consistent with the theory: compression works better when the retained summary matches the future query-cache interaction, and simple eviction heuristics are less reliable under tight budgets. The experiments should be read as evidence that the theoretical criteria are operational, rather than as a complete systems benchmark. The provided material does not include enough table-level numbers to make precise claims about absolute margins.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30-minute skim is appropriate. Start with the problem setup to understand the measure-theoretic view of attention. Then read the minimax-risk definitions and the upper/lower-bound statements; the important object is the intrinsic complexity measure, not the proof details. The algorithm section is useful for seeing how the theory maps to causal prefill and autoregressive decoding. For the experiments, focus on LongBench settings, compression budgets, and cases where the method fails or degrades, since these reveal the gap between the single-head theory and real multi-layer Transformers.

recommendation.zh: 从最小最大风险角度给出KV压缩的理论边界和设计原则，做长上下文推理优化的话看风险刻画章节即可。
recommendation.en: Minimax risk characterization of KV compression provides theoretical bounds and design principles; read the risk analysis section if working on long-context inference optimization.

paper.title: PARTREP: Learning What to Repeat for Decoder-only LLMs
paper.abstract: While decoder-only LLMs excel at a vast array of natural language tasks, it suffers from an asymmetric information flow induced by causal attention: later tokens are richer in contextual grounding than earlier ones. A simple and effective remedy is prompt repetition -- just appending a second copy of prompt before generation can redistribute grounding across positions and improve reasoning performance. However, full repetition of the original prompt doubles the KV cache footprint and quadruples

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 decoder-only LLM 的一个结构性问题：因果注意力导致信息流不对称，序列后部 token 比前部 token 拥有更充分的上下文 grounding，因此模型会出现 premise order sensitivity、选项顺序偏置、lost-in-the-middle 等现象。已有工作发现把 prompt 完整重复一遍能缓解这个问题，但代价很高：KV cache 翻倍，prefill attention 计算接近四倍。论文要解决的是，能不能只重复一小部分真正关键的 token，保留大部分收益，同时把额外内存和计算压下来。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在对 AR 解码范式局限的一个很具体的修补：它把“prompt repetition 为什么有效”进一步落到 token 级信息选择上，并给出一个可部署的近似方案。对做架构和推理的人，这篇文章有两个启发。第一，很多所谓 reasoning 提升并不一定来自更强的推理机制，而可能来自更均匀的上下文可达性。第二，token 级 surprisal/NLL 可以作为 prompt 内部信息密度的代理信号，这个想法未必只适用于 repetition，也可能用于长上下文压缩、检索片段重排、甚至训练时的 token-level curriculum。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 PartRep，核心思想是 selective repetition。不是把整段 prompt 再复制一次，而是从原 prompt 中选出一个子序列 t_part，追加到末尾，让这些被选中的 token 在序列后部形成“回声”，从而给后续位置提供更好的可访问上下文。

作者先把问题形式化为一个受预算约束的 token selection 问题：在重复比例 τ 给定时，找一个 subsequence，使模型准确率最大。为什么限定输出必须是原 prompt 的子序列，而不是摘要或重写？作者给出的理由很务实：如果 selector 只是对每个 token 做二分类，就可以用很轻的 gate 实现；如果要生成摘要，就会引入新的生成模型和额外不稳定性，成本也未必低。

选择信号方面，论文提出用 token-wise NLL 作为信息重要性的代理。直觉是：高 NLL token 说明它难以由前文预测，信息没有被上下文冗余编码，因此把它在后部再放一次，边际收益更大。这个假设不是拍脑袋，文中在附录和实验里都试图说明，高 NLL token 的重复比低 NLL token 或随机 token 更有效。

但精确 NLL 需要先完整跑一遍模型，这会抵消效率收益。为此作者训练了一个轻量 gate，用目标模型早期层 hidden states 预测哪些 token 属于 top-τ 高 NLL。实现上是一个带 attention 的两层 MLP，挂在目标模型中间层表示上，在 mid-prefill 阶段就能做选择。随后把选中的 token 通过一段很短的自然语言桥接语拼接到原 prompt 后面，例如提示模型“注意这些关键 token”，然后只做一次最终前向生成。

从机制上看，PartRep 不是在改变模型参数，也不是在做 retrieval augmentation，而是在利用 AR 模型对后部 token 更敏感这一事实，主动把高信息密度 token 重新放到更有利的位置。它和 full repetition 的区别不只是压缩长度，而是默认 prompt 内部信息分布高度不均匀，真正值得“回声强化”的只是少数 token。
summary.experiments:
论文在 8 个 benchmark 上做实验，覆盖 GSM8K、RULER 等任务，并在 Qwen2.5、Llama3.2、Gemma4 等多个 decoder-only 模型家族上验证。主结论是：PartRep 基本保留了 full repetition 的准确率收益，有些设置下还能略好，同时只需要 59.4% 的 KV cache 预算和 79.0% 的 prefill FLOPs。这个结果说明，full repetition 的收益并不要求把整个 prompt 原样复制，关键是把少量高价值 token 放到序列尾部。

从论文给出的任务类型看，收益主要出现在需要较强上下文整合或长上下文定位的场景，这和方法假设一致。作者还比较了不同 token 选择策略，核心是验证 NLL 作为 importance signal 是否成立。虽然你给出的全文片段没有展开所有表格，但从方法叙述可以看出，论文至少对比了随机选择、可能的启发式选择，以及 oracle-like NLL 选择与 gate 预测选择之间的差距。这里最重要的不是绝对分数，而是两点：一，真实 NLL 排序确实比简单启发式更接近 full repetition；二，轻量 gate 对高 NLL token 的近似已经足够把大部分收益拿回来。

另一个值得注意的实验维度是效率。作者没有只报 accuracy，而是明确把 prefill FLOPs 和 KV cache footprint 作为约束目标来衡量，这使得 PartRep 更像一个可落地的 inference-time method，而不是单纯 prompt trick。对于长上下文场景，这一点比小幅精度差异更关键。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，弄清楚作者到底在修什么问题：不是一般的 prompt engineering，而是 causal attention 带来的位置不对称。然后看方法部分里两个关键点：为什么用 token-wise NLL 做选择信号，以及 gate 如何在不额外完整前向的情况下近似这个信号。

实验部分建议优先看三类表：一是 PartRep 对 full repetition 和原始 prompt 的精度对比；二是不同选择策略的消融；三是效率表，尤其 KV cache 和 prefill FLOPs。若时间有限，20 到 30 分钟足够。若想深一点，可以追问两个问题：高 NLL token 是否只是“稀有词/数字/实体”的替代指标；以及这种方法在 instruction-heavy prompt、代码 prompt、超长检索上下文里是否会出现选择偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural weakness of decoder-only LLMs: causal attention creates asymmetric information flow, so later tokens are better grounded than earlier ones. This asymmetry is linked to premise-order sensitivity, option-order bias, and lost-in-the-middle behavior. Full prompt repetition is known to help, because the second copy gives the model a late-position “echo” of the original context. But full repetition is expensive: it doubles KV cache and roughly quadruples prefill attention cost. The paper asks whether one can repeat only a small subset of critical tokens and retain most of the benefit.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but real. The paper turns prompt repetition from a heuristic into a token-selection problem and offers a deployable approximation. Two ideas are useful beyond this specific method. First, some apparent reasoning gains may come from better context accessibility rather than deeper reasoning ability. Second, token-level surprisal or NLL can serve as a practical proxy for information density inside a prompt. That idea could transfer to long-context compression, retrieval chunk prioritization, or even token-level curriculum design during training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, PartRep, performs selective repetition instead of duplicating the entire prompt. Given an input sequence t, it chooses a subsequence t_part and appends only that subsequence near the end of the prompt. The goal is to create late-position echoes for the most informative tokens while staying within a repetition budget τ.

The formulation is deliberately constrained: the selector must output a subsequence of the original prompt, not a summary or a rewritten version. This keeps the selector lightweight, since it only needs to make binary keep/drop decisions per token. A more general compressor would require generation in vocabulary space and would likely erase the efficiency advantage.

For token importance, the paper uses token-wise negative log-likelihood as the main signal. The intuition is simple: high-NLL tokens are hard to predict from the preceding context, so their information is not redundantly encoded elsewhere. Repeating them should therefore provide the largest marginal gain when placed later in the sequence. The paper argues, both conceptually and empirically, that repeating high-surprisal tokens is more useful than repeating low-surprisal or random tokens.

Exact NLL, however, would require a full forward pass, which defeats the purpose. To avoid that, the authors train a lightweight gate that predicts the top-τ high-NLL tokens from early-layer hidden states of the target model. The gate is implemented as a small two-layer MLP with attention on top of intermediate representations, enabling token selection during mid-prefill. The selected tokens are then appended through a short natural-language bridge, and the model performs a single final generation pass.

Mechanistically, PartRep does not change model parameters and is not a retrieval method. It exploits a known property of autoregressive transformers: tokens placed later in the sequence are more accessible under causal attention. The key claim is that prompt information is highly non-uniform, so only a small subset of tokens needs to be echoed.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates on 8 benchmarks, including GSM8K and RULER, and across several decoder-only model families such as Qwen2.5, Llama3.2, and Gemma4. The main result is that PartRep largely preserves the accuracy gains of full repetition, and in some settings slightly exceeds it, while using only 59.4% of the KV cache budget and 79.0% of the prefill FLOPs. This is the central empirical point: the benefit of repetition does not require duplicating the whole prompt.

The gains appear on tasks that require stronger context integration or long-context access, which is consistent with the method’s motivation. The paper also studies token-selection strategies to validate NLL as an importance signal. Even though the provided excerpt does not include all tables, the method description makes clear that the authors compare oracle-like NLL selection, learned gate selection, and weaker baselines such as random or heuristic choices. The important takeaway is not the exact score gap, but the pattern: true NLL ranking is a strong selector, and the lightweight gate is accurate enough to recover most of that benefit without paying the full cost.

Another strength is that the paper treats efficiency as a first-class metric. It reports not only task accuracy but also prefill FLOPs and KV cache footprint. That makes PartRep more than a prompt trick; it is an inference-time systems method targeted at long-context deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and problem formulation to understand the exact failure mode: the method is not generic prompt engineering, but a response to causal-attention asymmetry. Then read the method section with two questions in mind: why token-wise NLL is a sensible importance signal, and how the gate approximates that signal without requiring an extra full pass.

In the experiments, prioritize three pieces: accuracy versus the original prompt and full repetition, ablations over token-selection strategies, and the efficiency tables for KV cache and prefill FLOPs. Twenty to thirty minutes should be enough. If you want to think more deeply, two follow-up questions are worth asking: whether high-NLL tokens are simply a proxy for rare entities, numbers, and symbols; and whether the same selection rule remains stable for instruction-heavy prompts, code prompts, or very long retrieval contexts.

recommendation.zh: 只看 NLL 选 token 和缓存成本分析；它像廉价 context reordering，不改训练，但能暴露 causal attention 的位置偏置。
recommendation.en: Skim the NLL token selection and cache-cost analysis; it is cheap context reordering, not training, but it exposes a real positional bias in causal attention.

institutions: Pohang University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Mapping Text to Multiplex Graph: Prompt Compression as Lévy Walk-Guided Graph Pruning
paper.abstract: Existing prompt compression methods treat text as flat token sequences, failing to capture the distributed nature of important information, which is often spread across multiple locations and connected through both local syntactic dependencies and global semantic relations. Such relational structure is naturally represented as a graph, where tokens or sentences become nodes and their dependencies become edges. To this end, we propose RAGP, which formulates prompt compression as Redundancy-Aware

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决长提示压缩时的信息保留问题：现有方法把 prompt 当平坦 token 序列处理，难以保留分散在不同位置、由局部依赖和全局语义共同决定的重要信息。
summary.importance: 它属于推理侧效率工作，而不是基座预训练。启发点在于：如果长上下文压缩要做得更稳，可能需要显式建模跨位置关系，而不是只做 token saliency 排序。对 serving、context pruning、retrieval 前处理有一定参考价值，但对 pretrain 方法论影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 RAGP，把 prompt compression 建模为 multiplex graph 上的冗余感知图剪枝。图中同时编码细粒度 attention 依赖和粗粒度语义关系；然后用 Lévy walk 在“局部稠密、全局稀疏”的异构结构中寻找非冗余节点，以兼顾局部探索和远距离跳转。整体是图建模 + 剪枝策略的组合，不是新的语言模型架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要只给出 LongBench 结果：在 4x compression ratio 下，RAGP 平均分数 49.3，并优于若干现有 prompt compression 方法。未在摘要中看到更完整的模型规模、额外延迟、图构建成本、或不同 backbone 上的稳定性信息，因此工程可用性还要看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Joey Tianyi Zhou。其余机构信息在给定材料中不完整。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets information preservation in long-prompt compression: existing methods treat prompts as flat token sequences and struggle to retain information distributed across distant positions and linked by both local dependencies and global semantics.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a foundation pretraining paper. The useful takeaway is that robust long-context compression may require explicit relational modeling instead of pure token saliency ranking. It is relevant to serving, context pruning, and retrieval-side preprocessing, but only indirectly informative for pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, RAGP, formulates prompt compression as redundancy-aware graph pruning on a multiplex graph. The graph jointly captures fine-grained attention-based dependencies and coarse semantic relations. Lévy walks are then used to identify non-redundant nodes in this heterogeneous structure, balancing local exploration with long-range jumps. This is a graph-based pruning strategy, not a new LM architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports results on LongBench: under a 4x compression ratio, RAGP achieves an average score of 49.3 and outperforms existing prompt compression baselines. The abstract does not provide enough detail on model sizes, latency overhead, graph construction cost, or robustness across backbones, so practical value depends on the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Joey Tianyi Zhou. Institution details are incomplete in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 更像 context pruning 工程招式，不会改变你对 pretrain 的 prior；若你在做长上下文 serving，只看方法图和 LongBench 主表即可。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a context-pruning trick, not something that changes pretraining priors; if you care about long-context serving, the method diagram and the main LongBench table are enough.

paper.title: Towards Memory-Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation via Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) streaming models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, the linearly growing Key-Value (KV) cache poses a significant bottleneck, leading to memory overload and degraded inference throughput. A common compression method is to drop redundant KV tokens, which often breaks long-range dependencies, resulting in temporal flickering and identity loss. In this paper, we propose Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption (ISPA), a novel framework that sh

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归长视频生成中 KV cache 随时间线性增长，导致显存爆炸和吞吐下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率与缓存压缩。虽然场景是视频生成，不是文本 LLM，但“不要丢 KV，而是把历史吸收到参数里”的思路，对长上下文推理和实例级缓存压缩有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ISPA（Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption）。方法在短暂 warmup 后，监控全局注意力与局部注意力的输出差异，在切换点求解一个闭式最小二乘问题，得到 instance-specific 的权重调制项，把历史上下文“吸收”进部分层参数中；随后将部分层从 full attention 切到 local attention，以减少 KV cache 负担。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其目标是 AR streaming video generation，主要对比常见的 KV token 丢弃式压缩方法，关注显存、吞吐以及时序闪烁和身份保持。未在摘要中给出模型参数量、数据规模和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the linear KV-cache growth in autoregressive long-video generation, which causes memory blow-up and poor inference throughput.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper. The setting is video generation rather than text LLMs, but the idea of absorbing history into parameters instead of dropping KV tokens is still mildly relevant for long-context inference research.
summary_en.technical_approach: ISPA (Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption) performs a brief warmup, measures the discrepancy between global and local attention, and at a transition point solves a closed-form least-squares problem to obtain an instance-specific weight modulation. This lets some layers switch from full attention to local attention while compensating for lost global context through temporary parameter adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on autoregressive streaming video generation, mainly against token-dropping KV compression baselines, with metrics around memory, throughput, temporal flicker, and identity preservation. Model size, data scale, and exact gains are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本 LLM，但思路有点意思：把 cache 压缩从删 token 改成实例级参数吸收。先看闭式解那一节；若代价太高，对 LLM 未必成立。
recommendation.en: Not a text-LLM paper, but the angle is interesting: turn cache compression from token dropping into instance-specific parameter absorption. Read the closed-form adaptation section first; the overhead may kill it for LLMs.

paper.title: Enhancing Flow Matching with A Unified Guidance Framework for Efficient and Robust Speech Synthesis
paper.abstract: Flow Matching (FM) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for speech generation but remains constrained by high inference latency and timbre leakage. To address these bottlenecks, we propose a unified guidance framework that enhances generation efficiency and robustness through two complementary strategies. On the data front, we introduce Data-guidance via heterogeneous augmentation, encouraging the model to disentangle linguistic content from acoustic residue. In parallel, we propose an enhanced Mo

summary.core_problem: 解决基于 Flow Matching 的语音生成在推理延迟高和音色泄漏上的两个常见瓶颈。
summary.importance: 属于语音生成方法改进。对做统一生成范式、AR+diffusion/flow 联合建模或语音 LM 的研究员有边缘参考价值，但不是基座预训练主线。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一 guidance 框架，包含两部分：一是数据侧的 heterogeneous augmentation，用于更好地解耦语言内容与声学残留；二是模型侧的 enhanced model-guidance，将轨迹校正与内在 guidance 目标结合，把条件信息蒸馏进权重并拉直采样轨迹，从而去掉 CFG 的额外开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要称相对强基线可将推理速度提升接近 3 倍，同时提升说话人相似度；未给出模型参数、训练数据规模和具体基线名称。结果看起来更偏工程收益而非范式变化。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表中包含 Yang Song。若确为同名研究者，则其在 score-based generative modeling / diffusion 方向有代表性工作。仅凭摘要无法稳妥确认全部机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two common bottlenecks in flow-matching speech synthesis: high inference latency and timbre leakage.
summary_en.importance: This is a speech-generation method paper. It has some peripheral value for researchers interested in unified generative paradigms or speech-language modeling, but it is not central to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a unified guidance framework with two components: data-guidance via heterogeneous augmentation to better disentangle linguistic content from acoustic residue, and enhanced model-guidance that combines trajectory rectification with an intrinsic guidance objective to distill conditional knowledge into the network and straighten sampling trajectories, removing CFG overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims nearly 3x faster inference and improved speaker similarity over strong baselines, but gives no model sizes, training data scale, or baseline names. The contribution appears more engineering-oriented than paradigm-shifting.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Yang Song. If this is the well-known researcher of the same name, the work connects to score-based generative modeling and diffusion. Full institutional attribution cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 flow/diffusion 生成的采样路径与 guidance 设计，可只看去 CFG 的那部分；对文本预训练本身没有直接迁移。
recommendation.en: Read only if you care about guidance design and trajectory straightening in flow/diffusion generation; the transfer to text pretraining is limited.

paper.title: Fork-Think with Confidence
paper.abstract: Parallel thinking has enjoyed great success for boosting LLM performance on reasoning tasks without the need for any re-training. However, existing methods follow a think-first-then-decide paradigm, i.e., they first sample multiple reasoning paths, which inevitably leads to overgeneration, then prune or stop unnecessary paths to compensate. In contrast, decide-first-then-think, i.e., first identifying points that are likely to lead to desirable generations, has been underexplored so far. Followi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是推理时并行采样的一个老问题：为了拿到更好的 reasoning trace，现有 parallel thinking 方法通常一开始就并行采很多条路径，再在中途或末尾做剪枝、投票或聚合。这样做的问题不是思路不对，而是算力花得太早、太粗。大量分支其实在前期就已经偏离有效解空间，后面再剪掉只是补救。作者提出的核心问题是：能不能先用一条 seed path 判断“哪里值得分叉”，再只在这些位置展开并行推理，从而减少无效生成，同时保留多样性带来的收益。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对 post-train 之后的 inference-time scaling 有直接启发，尤其适合关注“推理能力到底来自模型本身，还是来自搜索/采样策略”的读者。它的重要性主要有两点。第一，它把 parallel reasoning 的默认范式从 think-first-then-decide 改成 decide-first-then-think，这个视角是清楚的，也有一定普适性。第二，它提示了一个更一般的问题：模型内部的置信度信号能否作为 test-time compute allocation 的依据。这个问题和动态解码、early exit、adaptive compute、甚至训练时的 curriculum/uncertainty 建模都有接口。贡献量级不算改写范式，但属于一个值得继续追的推理时策略点。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Fork-Think with Confidence，核心流程分三步。第一步，先对问题生成一条 greedy seed path，而不是一开始就采样多条 reasoning trace。第二步，在这条 seed path 上识别适合“分叉”的 token 位置。作者借用了 pivot token 的想法：某些 token 对后续生成轨迹影响很大，如果在这些位置附近改变 continuation，后续 reasoning path 的差异会被放大。具体识别信号来自模型置信度，直觉上是当模型在某个位置不够确定时，这里更可能是后续推理走向分化的关键点。第三步，只在选中的 forking points 上采样多个 continuation，再对这些分支做聚合得到最终答案。

和已有方法相比，差异不在于更复杂的 verifier 或 scorer，而在于把“采样预算”从序列起点后移到更有信息的位置。传统 parallel sampling 在 prompt 之后立刻分叉，优点是简单，缺点是前缀阶段的随机性会制造很多表面不同、实质低效的路径。Fork-Think 先走一条确定性主干，再在局部高不确定位置展开，等于把多样性集中投放到更可能改变结论的步骤上。论文里还强调，这个框架和已有 pruning、aggregation 方法是兼容的，不是替代关系。也就是说，它更像一个前置的 compute allocation 策略。

从机制上看，这个方法成立依赖两个假设：一是 greedy seed path 至少能走到“有代表性”的中间状态；二是 token-level confidence 与后续 reasoning branching value 有相关性。作者的实验基本支持这两个假设，但也意味着它对 seed path 质量有依赖。如果模型一开始就走偏，后续再聪明地分叉也只是围绕错误主干展开。
summary.experiments:
论文在 3 个模型和 3 个 reasoning benchmark 上做了系统评测。摘要和正文给出的主结果是：相较于标准 parallel think，Fork-Think 在保持或提升任务表现的同时，整体 token cost 最多下降约 30%，整体运行时间最多下降约 57%。这个结果说明收益主要来自两部分：一是少生成了无效分支；二是分叉发生得更晚，前缀共享更多，因此真实解码开销下降。

作者还做了几类比较关键的消融。第一类是 forking position 的影响。结论很明确：较晚的分叉点通常比一开始就并行采样效果更好，说明 reasoning 的关键不在“尽早制造多样性”，而在“在合适的位置制造多样性”。第二类是不同 confidence-based 选点策略的比较，用来验证置信度是否真能找到有价值的 pivot。第三类是与不同 aggregation 方式的组合实验，说明 Fork-Think 不是依赖某一种特定投票器才成立。

从阅读价值看，最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 上的绝对分数，而是 compute-performance 曲线的形状变化：在相近预算下，它能把更多算力放到高价值分支上，因此效率更高。如果正文里给了不同 fork 数、不同 seed decoding 策略、不同温度设置的结果，这些表通常比主表更能说明方法边界。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议控制在 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Figure 1，把 think-first-then-decide 和 decide-first-then-think 的差别吃透；这是整篇最重要的 conceptual move。然后看方法部分里 forking point 的定义与 confidence 计算方式，重点确认作者到底用的是 token probability、entropy、margin，还是某种归一化后的不确定性指标。接着看主实验表，关注 token cost、wall-clock time 和 accuracy 三者是否同时报告。最后看消融，尤其是“later fork is better”那组结果，它决定这篇工作的说服力。

如果只想判断是否值得进一步跟进，优先看三处：方法总览图、fork position 消融、与标准 parallel think 的效率对比。若要深挖，可以继续想两个问题：一，confidence 是否只是一个便宜 proxy，未来能否换成 value-of-branch 估计器；二，这种 decide-first-then-think 能否迁移到 tree search、speculative reasoning 或 verifier-guided decoding。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits a basic inefficiency in parallel reasoning at inference time. Most existing methods follow a think-first-then-decide pattern: sample multiple reasoning traces up front, then prune, stop, or aggregate later. This works, but it spends compute too early and too broadly. Many branches are low-value from the start, so later pruning only recovers part of the waste. The paper asks a cleaner question: can we first identify where branching is likely to matter, and only then expand multiple continuations from those points?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research through the test-time compute lens. Its value is less about raw benchmark gains and more about reframing how inference-time scaling should allocate budget. Two aspects matter. First, it proposes a clear alternative to the default parallel sampling recipe: decide-first-then-think. Second, it suggests that model confidence can be used as a signal for adaptive compute allocation. That connects naturally to broader topics such as uncertainty-aware decoding, adaptive computation, verifier-guided search, and even training-time uncertainty modeling. The contribution is moderate in scale, but the framing is useful.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Fork-Think with Confidence, has three stages. First, instead of sampling many traces immediately, it generates a single greedy seed path. Second, it scans this seed path to identify promising forking points. The intuition comes from pivot tokens: some token positions have disproportionate influence on downstream generation, so branching near them can produce meaningfully different reasoning trajectories. The paper uses model confidence to detect such positions. Low-confidence points are treated as likely decision bottlenecks where alternative continuations may be valuable. Third, the method samples multiple continuations only from those selected points and aggregates them into the final answer.

The main difference from prior work is not a stronger verifier or a more complex scorer. It is a different placement of sampling budget. Standard parallel thinking branches right after the prompt, which is simple but often wasteful: early randomness creates many superficially diverse but low-value traces. Fork-Think keeps the prefix deterministic, then injects diversity later at positions that are more likely to affect the final reasoning outcome. The paper also emphasizes compatibility with existing pruning and aggregation methods, so this should be read as a front-end compute allocation strategy rather than a full replacement for downstream selection.

Mechanistically, the method relies on two assumptions. First, the greedy seed path must reach a reasonably representative intermediate state. Second, token-level confidence must correlate with branching value. The experiments support both to some extent, but they also expose the main limitation: if the seed path is already badly off-track, later branching may only explore variations around a wrong backbone.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates on three models and three reasoning benchmarks. The headline result reported in the abstract and main text is that, compared with standard parallel thinking, Fork-Think reduces total token cost by up to about 30% and end-to-end runtime by up to about 57%, while maintaining or improving task performance. The runtime gain is plausible because branching happens later, so more prefix computation is shared and fewer low-value continuations are generated.

The ablations are the most informative part. One key study varies the forking position and shows that later branching points often outperform branching at the beginning. This is an important result: the benefit of parallel reasoning does not come from maximizing diversity as early as possible, but from placing diversity where the reasoning trajectory is genuinely unstable. Another set of ablations compares different confidence-based selection rules for identifying fork points. A third set studies compatibility with different aggregation schemes, supporting the claim that Fork-Think is not tied to one specific voting or reranking mechanism.

For a careful reader, the most useful signal is not the absolute benchmark score but the compute-performance tradeoff curve. The method appears to shift budget toward higher-value branches under the same or lower inference cost. If the full paper includes results over different numbers of forks, temperatures, or seed decoding choices, those tables are likely more revealing than the main leaderboard-style summary.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A 20-30 minute skim is enough to extract the main idea. Start with Figure 1, because the conceptual shift from think-first-then-decide to decide-first-then-think is the center of the paper. Then read the method section carefully enough to pin down how confidence is computed: token probability, entropy, margin, or some normalized uncertainty score. After that, inspect the main results table and check whether accuracy, token cost, and wall-clock time are all reported together. Finally, read the ablation on fork position. That section carries much of the paper's actual evidence.

If deciding whether to follow up, focus on three items: the method overview figure, the fork-position ablation, and the efficiency comparison against standard parallel thinking. If reading more deeply, two questions are worth keeping in mind: whether confidence is only a cheap proxy for branch value, and whether the same decide-first-then-think principle can be extended to tree search, speculative reasoning, or verifier-guided decoding.

recommendation.zh: 推理时计算定向分配的简洁有效方法，§3的分叉点识别策略可直接复现到内部推理pipeline，重点看方法和消融实验
recommendation.en: Simple and effective method for targeted test-time compute allocation; §3 forking point identification is directly reproducible for internal reasoning pipelines, focus on method and ablation

paper.title: Coverage-Driven KV Cache Eviction for Efficient and Improved Inference of LLM
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex tasks like question answering and summarization, thanks to their ability to handle long-context inputs. However, deploying LLMs is costly, not only due to the high computational demands of quadratic complexity of self-attention and auto-regressive generation, but also because of the significant memory overhead required for storing the key-value (KV) cache during inference. To reduce the memory cost, existing KV-cache eviction strategies leverage the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是长上下文推理中的 KV cache 压缩问题。已有 eviction 方法主要按注意力分数保留 token，但在高压缩率下，不同 head 和不同 layer 往往保留同一批靠近 prompt 末尾的 token，导致被覆盖的唯一 token 数下降。作者把这种现象称为 coverage loss，并认为它是长上下文任务性能下降的关键原因。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在推理效率，不是预训练方法本身。对基座研究的启发在于：KV cache 压缩不能只看单个 head 或单层的局部重要性，还要看跨 head、跨 layer 后的信息覆盖。这个观察也可用于分析长上下文模型的注意力冗余、recency bias，以及训练时是否学到更均匀的信息路由。量级上属于实用型改进，适合做 serving 或长上下文推理系统的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 K-VEC，一种 coverage-aware KV cache eviction 方法。核心不是重新训练模型，而是在推理时改变 cache token 的选择策略。论文先分析 SnapKV 等方法的 eviction score，发现多个 head 和 layer 的选择高度重合，并且偏向 prompt 末尾。K-VEC 用两个模块缓解这个问题：cross-head coverage 通过调整少量 head 的 attention span，让不同 head 覆盖更不同的 token；cross-layer coverage 鼓励后续 layer 选择那些全局重要但早期 layer 未覆盖的 token。这样做的目标是，在相同 KV budget 下，提高被至少一个 head 或 layer 保留过的唯一 token 数。作者还用 information bottleneck 视角解释 coverage 与输入输出互信息之间的关系：覆盖越低，可传递到生成端的信息越少，长上下文任务更容易退化。
summary.experiments: 实验沿用 SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O 等工作的长上下文评测设置，在 LongBench 的 16 个子任务上测试，包括单文档问答、多文档问答、摘要、few-shot learning、合成任务和代码任务。KV cache budget 设置为 128、256、512、1024 token。K-VEC 在低 budget 下收益更明显，128 token budget 时单项最高比已有方法提升 10.35 分，16 个数据集平均提升 1.61 分。论文还做了模块消融和敏感性分析，用来验证 cross-head coverage 与 cross-layer coverage 分别带来的贡献。计算开销与已有 eviction 方法保持接近，主要额外成本来自 coverage-aware 的选择逻辑。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 coverage loss 的定义，以及 Figure 1 到 Figure 3 对 recency bias 和 token 覆盖下降的可视化。方法部分关注 cross-head coverage 和 cross-layer coverage 如何改变 token 选择，而不是只看最终分数。实验部分优先看 128 和 256 token budget 下的 LongBench 表格，以及消融实验；这些结果最能说明 coverage 是否比单纯 attention score 更稳。理论部分可以快速看结论，信息瓶颈推导更多是为经验观察提供解释，不是方法成立的唯一依据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache compression for long-context LLM inference. Existing eviction methods retain tokens based on attention-derived scores, but under aggressive budgets, different heads and layers often keep the same recent tokens. This reduces the number of unique input tokens covered by the cache, and the paper identifies this coverage loss as a major source of degradation on long-context reasoning tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on inference efficiency rather than pretraining. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the coverage view: cache quality should not be measured only by local attention scores, but also by how much non-redundant information survives across heads and layers. This also provides a diagnostic lens for attention redundancy, recency bias, and long-context routing behavior. The impact is practical and system-facing, with moderate research relevance for long-context model analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: K-VEC is a coverage-aware KV-cache eviction strategy applied at inference time. The paper first shows that SnapKV-like scoring produces overlapping selections across heads and layers, with a strong bias toward the end of the prompt. K-VEC introduces two mechanisms. Cross-head coverage adjusts the attention span of selected heads so that different heads preserve more diverse tokens. Cross-layer coverage encourages later layers to retain globally useful tokens that were not selected by earlier layers. The method therefore tries to maximize useful unique-token coverage under the same cache budget. The authors also frame coverage loss through an information-bottleneck argument: when fewer input tokens are represented in the cache, the mutual information between the input and the generated output is constrained.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation follows prior KV-cache eviction protocols and uses 16 LongBench subsets, covering single-document QA, multi-document QA, summarization, few-shot tasks, synthetic tasks, and code. Cache budgets are 128, 256, 512, and 1024 tokens. Gains are largest under tight budgets: at 128 cached tokens, K-VEC reports up to a 10.35-point improvement on an individual task and an average gain of 1.61 points across the 16 datasets over existing methods. Ablations and sensitivity studies are used to isolate the effect of the cross-head and cross-layer coverage modules. Runtime overhead is kept close to prior eviction methods, since the main change is in token selection rather than model computation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the coverage-loss analysis in the introduction and the visual evidence in Figures 1 to 3. Then read the method description of cross-head and cross-layer coverage; that is where the actual design choice sits. In the experiments, focus on LongBench results under 128 and 256 token budgets, since aggressive compression exposes the method’s behavior most clearly. The information-bottleneck section can be read for intuition, but the empirical coverage analysis is the stronger part of the paper.

recommendation.zh: 别只把它当又一篇 KV eviction；若主表成立，‘coverage 而非 attention 峰值’这个解释值得迁移到长上下文训练与稀疏注意力设计里。
recommendation.en: Do not dismiss this as just another KV eviction paper; if the main tables hold, the ‘coverage over peak attention’ framing is worth porting into long-context training and sparse-attention design.

paper.title: Before Thinking, Learn to Decide: Proactive Routing for Efficient Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large multimodal models have achieved strong reasoning on complex visual tasks, but their inference efficiency is often restricted by long chains of thought. A promising solution is to pair a small draft model with a large target model, enabling cooperative inference employing a routing signal that adaptively routes queries to either the draft or target model based on their difficulties for optimal efficiency and accuracy. Yet, the remaining bottleneck is to establish a reliable query difficulty

summary.core_problem: 在多模态视觉推理中，如何在不依赖“生成完长 CoT 后再看 token 概率”的滞后信号、也不依赖对采样分布敏感的 SFT 特殊 token 方案的前提下，提前判断样本难度并进行 draft/target 模型路由，从而降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率与路由策略，不是预训练主线。对预训练研究的间接启发在于：它把“难度/可解性”建模成可学习的评分头，并用 RL（GRPO）训练在生成前给出可用信号；这种“前置评分信号”如果迁移到 pretrain/posttrain 接口上，可能用于数据课程、动态采样或训练时的 compute routing（例如 MoE/early-exit 的数据侧信号）。但论文的核心贡献仍在推理阶段系统设计。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP)：在生成开始前就做路由。
- DRL (Draft Rating Learning)：让 draft 模型在不生成推理链的情况下，直接对输入给出“我能否解”的细粒度评分分布。
- JRL (Joint Rating Learning)：进一步同时预测 target 模型对该样本的适配度/收益，使路由不仅把难题交给大模型，也能把“大模型特别擅长”的样本交给它。
- 训练方法：使用 GRPO 风格的强化学习来学评分（全文应给出 reward 设计与采样细节）。
- 推理策略：基于评分的三阶段路由与排序策略；DRL 侧重置信分布，JRL 侧重 draft/target 的相对能力评估。
summary.experiments:
文中明确给出的数字：在 MathVista 上，JRL 路由达到 2.41× 加速，并且“略微超过更强的 target model”。此外作者在 MathVerse 等数据上展示 token-probability routing 与准确率相关性不成立（Fig.2 a/b），以及特殊 token 路由对正负轨迹采样分布敏感。
由于你提供的全文片段未包含完整实验表，draft/target 的具体模型规格、不同阈值下的 cost-accuracy 曲线、以及在更多基准上的稳定性需要到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，优先抓三块：
- Sec.2 的失败分析（为什么 token 概率与准确率在多模态长推理下脱钩；为什么特殊 token 路由对数据分布敏感）。
- DRL/JRL 的 reward 与训练细节（评分信号如何定义、如何避免学成“长度/格式”代理）。
- MathVista 的 cost-accuracy 曲线与路由阈值敏感性。预计 30–45 分钟能把方法与主要结论读清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: How to obtain a reliable, early difficulty/solvability signal for multimodal visual reasoning so that queries can be proactively routed between a small draft model and a large target model before generating long chains-of-thought, avoiding both post-hoc token-probability heuristics and SFT-based special-token routing that is sensitive to trajectory sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency/routing paper rather than pretraining. The pretraining-relevant takeaway is the framing of “instance difficulty / model suitability” as a learnable rating signal trained with RL, produced before generation. Similar signals could potentially inform curriculum sampling, compute-aware training, or data-conditioned routing (e.g., MoE/early-exit) at training time, but that is not the paper’s main focus.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP), making routing decisions at the start of generation.
- Draft Rating Learning (DRL): trains the draft model to output a fine-grained solvability/confidence distribution for an input without generating reasoning steps.
- Joint Rating Learning (JRL): additionally predicts the target model’s suitability/expected benefit, enabling routing based on both models’ strengths rather than only the draft’s uncertainty.
- Training uses a GRPO-style RL procedure (details depend on the full paper: reward definition, sampling, and stabilization).
- Inference uses score-based, multi-stage routing/selection strategies: DRL leverages confidence distributions; JRL leverages joint draft/target capability estimates.
summary_en.experiments:
A concrete number stated: on MathVista, JRL achieves 2.41× speedup while slightly outperforming the stronger target model. They also provide diagnostic evidence (e.g., on MathVerse) that mean token probability is not monotonically correlated with accuracy in multimodal long reasoning, and that special-token routing is sensitive to the distribution of correct/incorrect trajectories.
The excerpt does not include full result tables; you should verify model sizes, routing thresholds, and cost–accuracy trade-off curves in the experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with focus:
- The failure analysis section explaining why token-probability routing breaks in multimodal long reasoning and why special-token routing is data-sensitive.
- The DRL/JRL training objective and reward design (to ensure the rating is not a proxy for length/format).
- The MathVista cost–accuracy curves and threshold sensitivity. About 30–45 minutes for a solid pass.

recommendation.zh: 看 cost-accuracy frontier 和失败路由分析；若 solvability 估计干净，可借鉴到推理计算分配。
recommendation.en: Read the cost-accuracy frontier and routing failures; if solvability is estimated cleanly, it informs test-time compute allocation.

paper.title: Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
paper.abstract: Hybrid attention models improve long-context efficiency by retaining only a subset of full-attention layers and replacing the remaining layers with linear attention. However, the effectiveness of Transformer-to-hybrid conversion critically depends on which layers preserve full attention. Existing hybrid layer selection methods typically rely on heuristic strategies such as fixed placement patterns or layerwise scoring, implicitly treating layer importance as isolated and overlooking the interdep

summary.core_problem: 现有将预训练Transformer转换为混合注意力架构（部分层保留全注意力，其余替换为线性注意力）的层选择方法存在三类缺陷：一是固定排布规则忽略预训练模型各层的功能异质性；二是逐层单独扰动/替换的打分方法，未考虑全局混合配置下的层间依赖——功能相关层联合转换会放大性能退化，功能重叠层同时保留会带来收益递减；三是逐层打分需要多次单步扰动，选择开销高，难以扩展到深层大模型。该问题本质是预算约束下的组合子集优化，现有启发式方法均未有效处理。
summary.importance: 为预训练Transformer适配长上下文高效混合架构提供了低成本路径，无需从头训练混合模型即可复用预训练权重，具备工程落地价值。层选择思路从孤立打分转向全局联合优化，为高效架构适配提供了新的设计逻辑。使用合成检索数据训练门控的方案，降低了数据成本，提升了流程可复现性。
summary.technical_approach: FlashMorph的核心流程分为三步：1）构建可变形模型：为每个预训练全注意力层添加一个已转换的线性注意力分支，引入逐层可学习门控，实现层在全注意力与线性注意力之间的连续插值；2）层选择阶段：冻结预训练主干和所有线性注意力分支的参数，仅联合优化逐层门控，训练数据采用合成检索数据，通过联合优化得到全局配置下各层保留全注意力的相对必要性，而非依赖孤立的逐层打分；3）架构实例化与微调：按给定的全注意力层预算，将优化后的门控离散化，得到最终混合架构，再通过标准蒸馏和长上下文微调完成转换。与现有方法相比，该方法显式建模了层间的互补性与冗余性，选层所需的训练token量显著降低。
summary.experiments: 现有公开内容显示，FlashMorph的选层效率显著优于逐层打分类方法，仅需更少的训练token即可完成层选择，最终转换得到的混合模型在质量-效率权衡上优于固定排布、逐层打分等现有策略。提供的全文片段未披露完整实验细节（如测试模型参数量、具体性能提升数值、基准测试结果）。
summary.reading_guide: 先泛读引言部分，重点理解混合层选择的组合优化本质，以及现有方法的三类核心缺陷。再看方法部分的可变形模型设计、冻结主干的门控优化流程，以及选择合成检索数据的原因。若后续补充完整实验，可关注选层效率和下游性能的对比数据。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing layer selection methods for converting pretrained Transformers to hybrid attention architectures (which mix full-attention and linear-attention layers) have three key limitations. First, fixed placement rules ignore the functional heterogeneity of pretrained layers. Second, per-layer scoring via repeated single-layer perturbation or replacement fails to capture inter-layer dependencies under global hybrid configurations: jointly converting functionally correlated layers amplifies performance degradation, while retaining overlapping layers leads to diminishing returns. Third, per-layer scoring requires repeated single-step perturbations, resulting in high selection overhead that scales poorly to deep models. The task is fundamentally a budget-constrained combinatorial subset optimization problem, which prior heuristic approaches do not address effectively.
summary_en.importance: This method provides a low-cost path to adapt pretrained Transformers to efficient long-context hybrid architectures without full retraining, which has practical engineering value for LLM inference efficiency optimization. The shift from isolated per-layer scoring to joint global optimization for layer selection introduces a new design logic for efficient architecture adaptation. The use of synthetic retrieval data for gate training reduces data costs and improves the reproducibility of the hybrid model conversion pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlashMorph follows three core steps. First, a morphable model is constructed: each pretrained full-attention layer is paired with a pre-converted linear-attention branch, and layer-wise learnable gates are added to enable continuous interpolation between the two attention types. Second, during the layer selection stage, all parameters of the pretrained backbone and linear-attention branches are frozen, and only the layer-wise gates are jointly optimized on synthetic retrieval data. This joint optimization estimates the relative necessity of retaining full attention for each layer under a global hybrid configuration, instead of relying on isolated per-layer scoring. Third, the optimized gates are discretized according to a predefined full-attention layer budget to instantiate the target hybrid architecture, which is further tuned via standard distillation and long-context finetuning. Compared to prior methods, FlashMorph explicitly models inter-layer complementarity and redundancy, and requires significantly fewer training tokens for layer selection.
summary_en.experiments: Available content indicates FlashMorph achieves significantly higher layer selection efficiency than per-layer scoring methods, requiring far fewer training tokens to complete the selection step. The resulting hybrid models deliver a better quality-efficiency tradeoff than existing strategies including fixed interleaving and per-layer scoring. Full experimental details (such as test model parameter sizes, concrete performance gains, benchmark results) are not included in the provided full-text fragment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to grasp the combinatorial nature of hybrid layer selection and the three core limitations of prior methods. Then move to the method section, focusing on the morphable model design, the frozen-backbone gate optimization pipeline, and the rationale for using synthetic retrieval data. If full experimental content is available later, review the layer selection efficiency and downstream performance comparisons. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融即可；它把 hybrid 层选择从局部打分改成全局组合搜索，这个 setup 比常见规则更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; the useful part is recasting hybrid-layer choice as global subset search rather than isolated layer scoring.

paper.title: TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Coding agents are rapidly becoming a major application of agentic LLMs, but serving them efficiently remains challenging. Progress on this challenge requires understanding real workload patterns, yet the data needed for such analysis is largely absent. Existing public traces and benchmarks do not capture real, day-to-day coding-agent usage across multiple agents and model families for serving-system analysis. To help fill this gap, we collect and release a trace of roughly 4,300 coding-agent ses

summary.core_problem: 编码 Agent 正成为 LLM 的重要负载，但现有公开 trace 和能力 benchmark 都无法反映真实日常使用中多模型、多 Agent、多步工具调用的工作负载特征，导致服务系统优化缺乏数据依据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 pretrain↔posttrain↔serving 的闭环视角：编码 Agent 的真实使用模式（长上下文、短输出、频繁工具调用、高前缀缓存依赖）直接反推基座模型应该在哪些维度优化——长上下文注意力效率、工具调用格式的稳定性、短输出场景的 decode 开销、推理时的 KV-cache 友好结构。这些数据也能指导构造更贴近真实分布的 agent 预训练 / SFT 数据混合，而不是只在 SWE-bench 这类窄任务上过拟合。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一套 trace 采集、格式归一化、隐私匿名化、统计分析的完整流水线。数据来自 43 名开发者约 8 个月的日常使用，覆盖 Claude Code 和 Codex 两个 Agent、20+ 模型版本。分析维度分为四层：(1) 会话级：自主循环长度、完成时长、上下文增长与缩减模式；(2) 单步 LLM 调用级：前缀 token 数、新增输入 token 数、输出 token 数、decode 速度与 TTFT；(3) 工具调用级：工具种类分布、调用频次长尾、延迟长尾；(4) 前缀缓存级：命中率、miss 来源、miss 带来的额外 prefill 开销。最后基于观察提出面向编码 Agent 的服务系统优化方向。
summary.experiments: 核心统计结果：约 4,300 个会话、350,000 次 LLM 步骤、430,000 次工具调用。会话平均 8.8 次 LLM 调用、10.8 次工具调用，平均完成时长 4.3 分钟，p90 超过 6.4 分钟。单步中位数：前缀缓存读取约 119K token、新增输入 875 token、输出仅 214 token，呈现典型长上下文短输出特征。decode 速度中位数：Claude 46.8 归一化 token/s，Codex 33.9 归一化 token/s，变异系数均大于 50%；Codex 纯 decode 中位数 61.3 token/s，TTFT 约 3.1 秒。工具调用：观察到 80+ 种工具，前 3 种工具占全部调用的 80% 以上；超过 1 分钟的工具调用只占 4%，却占总工具调用时间的 85%。前缀缓存全局命中率 95.7%，主要 miss 发生在跨请求的人类思考/输入间隙（超过缓存淘汰时间）；缓存 miss 导致的额外 prefill token 数是真正新输入 token 的 3.8 倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先读引言和贡献部分明确数据规模与覆盖范围；然后直接看各节的统计图表和关键分位数数字，跳过流水线的工程实现细节；重点关注会话级上下文增长模式、单步 token 长度分布、工具延迟长尾、前缀缓存 miss 来源这四组观察；最后读作者列出的系统优化方向清单，把其中与模型架构/训练相关的点（稀疏注意力、KV 缓存友好结构、工具延迟预测的语义信号）摘出来即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Coding agents are becoming a major LLM workload, but existing public traces and capability benchmarks fail to capture real, day-to-day usage patterns across multiple agents, model families, and multi-step tool-calling behavior, leaving serving-system optimizations without empirical grounding.
summary_en.importance: The main implication for pretraining research lies in the closed-loop view of pretrain ↔ posttrain ↔ serving. Real coding-agent usage patterns—long contexts, short outputs, frequent tool calls, heavy reliance on prefix caching—directly suggest which dimensions base models should be optimized for: long-context attention efficiency, stability of tool-call formatting, decode cost under short-output regimes, and KV-cache-friendly structures during inference. These statistics can also guide the construction of agentic pretraining / SFT data mixtures that better match real usage, instead of overfitting to narrow benchmarks such as SWE-bench.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a complete pipeline for trace collection, format normalization, privacy anonymization, and statistical analysis. Data comes from 43 developers over roughly eight months of daily use, covering two agents (Claude Code and Codex) and more than 20 model versions. Analysis is organized into four layers: (1) Session level: length of autonomous loops, end-to-end completion time, patterns of context growth and reduction. (2) Per-step LLM invocation level: prefix tokens, newly appended input tokens, output tokens, decode speed, and TTFT. (3) Tool-call level: tool-type distribution, long-tailed call frequency, and long-tailed latency. (4) Prefix-cache level: hit rate, sources of misses, and extra prefill cost caused by misses. The paper concludes with a list of serving-system optimization directions derived from these observations.
summary_en.experiments: Key statistics: roughly 4,300 sessions, 350,000 LLM steps, and 430,000 tool calls. Per session: on average 8.8 LLM calls, 10.8 tool invocations, 4.3 minutes mean completion time with p90 above 6.4 minutes. Per-step medians: about 119K tokens read from prefix cache, 875 newly appended input tokens, and only 214 output tokens—a clear long-context / short-output profile. Decode speed medians: 46.8 normalized tokens/s for Claude and 33.9 for Codex, both with coefficient of variation above 50%; Codex has a median pure decode speed of 61.3 tokens/s and estimated TTFT of 3.1 seconds per step. Tool calls: more than 80 distinct tools observed, with the top 3 tools accounting for over 80% of all invocations; tool calls longer than 1 minute represent only 4% of calls but 85% of total tool-call time. Prefix cache: 95.7% global hit rate; most misses occur across request boundaries during human reading / thinking / typing gaps that exceed cache eviction windows; cache misses cause 3.8× more tokens to be prefilled than truly unique input tokens would require.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading, estimated 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction and contributions to grasp dataset scale and coverage. Then jump directly to the statistical figures and key percentile numbers in each analysis section, skipping low-level engineering details of the collection pipeline. Focus on four groups of observations: session-level context growth patterns, per-step token length distributions, long-tailed tool latency, and sources of prefix-cache misses. Finally, read the list of proposed system optimizations and extract points relevant to model architecture and training—sparse attention, KV-cache-friendly structures, and semantic signals for tool-latency prediction.

recommendation.zh: UW团队发布的首个真实代码智能体工作负载trace，§3的负载统计可直接指导agent基座的训练数据分布设计与推理适配
recommendation.en: First real coding agent workload trace released by UW team; §3 workload statistics can directly guide training data distribution design and inference adaptation for agent foundation models

paper.title: ReFreeKV: Towards Threshold-Free KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: To reduce memory consumption during LLM inference, a handful of methods have been proposed for KV cache pruning. While these techniques can accomplish lossless memory reduction on many datasets, they often hinge on an under-emphasized condition: an input/domain-specific threshold for KV cache budget needs to be pre-determined to achieve the optimal performance. However, such input-sensitive design may be considerably limited in real-world scenarios, as open-domain inputs span diverse domains, le

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 KV cache 压缩方法在真实开放输入中依赖数据集特定阈值的问题：同一个 cache budget 在 LongBench、GSM8K、needle-in-the-haystack 等任务上表现差异很大，固定阈值难以迁移。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对长上下文模型的推理侧评估有启发。它把 KV 压缩目标从“在某个 benchmark 上压到多小”改成“在不调输入特定阈值的情况下维持接近 full-cache 的性能”。这个目标更接近实际服务场景，也提醒长上下文能力评估不能只看单一数据集上的压缩率。
summary.technical_approach: ReFreeKV 采用两阶段流程。第一步根据位置重要性对所有 KV cache 位置排序。第二步按排序逐步保留 key-value 向量，并用一个输入不敏感的停止准则决定何时停止保留。核心是 Uni-Metric：它不是为每个数据集预先设定 cache ratio 或固定 token 数，而是用一个相对稳定的指标动态决定预算。方法仍然有停止阈值，但不需要针对输入域、长度或任务难度校准。实现上强调并行算子，避免逐 token 的顺序处理，使延迟接近已有高效 KV pruning 方法。
summary.experiments: 论文使用 13 个数据集，覆盖数学与常识推理、阅读理解、代码、长上下文检索等任务，并在多个规模的 LLM 上测试。引言给出的关键数字包括：Llama3-70B 在 20K tokens 下 KV cache 可达约 50GB；D2O 在 LongBench 上 20% cache budget 可接近 full-cache，但在 GSM8K 上可能需要约 80%；CAKE 在 LongBench 上保留 1024 个位置可行，但同样预算在 needle-in-the-haystack 上失效。ReFreeKV 在 Llama3-8B 上自动分配平均 63.7% 的 KV budget，并在 13 个数据集平均表现上略高于 full-cache。它不是每个数据集压缩率最高的方法，但在“不调数据集阈值且保持性能”这个约束下更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对阈值敏感性的实验动机，尤其是不同数据集所需预算差异；再看 Methodology 中 Uni-Metric 的定义和停止准则，这是论文的主要技术点；最后看 Table 2 和延迟实验，判断它是否真的在性能、压缩率、运行开销之间取得了可用折中。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必深挖所有推理系统实现细节，但可以关注它提出的评估目标：压缩方法需要在混合分布输入上稳定，而不是只在单一 benchmark 上报告最优预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical weakness in KV-cache compression: most pruning methods require an input- or dataset-specific cache budget, and the same threshold can fail badly when domains, sequence lengths, or task difficulty change.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful lesson for foundation-model work is the evaluation objective. For long-context models, a KV-compression method should not only report the smallest budget on a fixed benchmark; it should preserve full-cache behavior under mixed, open-domain inputs without per-dataset calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReFreeKV uses a two-stage pruning procedure. It first ranks cache positions by positional importance, then keeps KV vectors progressively according to that ranking until a stopping rule is satisfied. The key component is Uni-Metric, a stopping metric designed to be insensitive to input domain and sequence length. The method is not literally thresholdless; rather, its threshold does not need to be tuned for each dataset or input type. The implementation is designed around parallel operators, so the pruning overhead stays comparable to prior efficient KV-pruning approaches.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 13 datasets spanning reasoning, reading comprehension, coding, and long-context retrieval, with multiple LLM sizes.
