The paper reports several calibration failures for prior methods: D2O can match full-cache performance on LongBench with a 20% budget but may need around 80% on GSM8K; CAKE works with 1024 retained positions on LongBench but underperforms on needle-in-the-haystack. With Llama3-8B, ReFreeKV allocates an average KV budget of 63.7% and slightly exceeds full-cache performance on average across the 13 datasets. Its main result is not maximum compression on every dataset, but stable performance without dataset-specific budget tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the motivation experiments in the introduction first, because they define the failure mode clearly. Then focus on the Uni-Metric definition and the stopping rule in the method section. The most informative results are the mixed-dataset comparison table and the latency study. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is the evaluation principle for long-context serving: robustness under distribution mixtures matters more than a tuned compression ratio on one benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员重点看§3的目标函数设计，其自适应预算思想可迁移到训练时的稀疏注意力正则与KV感知预训练。
recommendation.en: For pretraining researchers, focus on §3 objective design; its adaptive budgeting idea transfers to sparse attention regularization and KV-aware pretraining.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: EntroRouter: Learning Efficient Model Routing via Entropy Regulation
paper.abstract: Model routing balances solution accuracy and computational cost by selecting among models of varying capabilities. While recent multi-round frameworks interleave reasoning and planning, we identify a structural failure mode termed Trust Region Collapse. We demonstrate that the deep coupling of reasoning and routing, exacerbated by the dominance of strong pre-training priors under sparse supervision, leads to degenerate local optima where capable experts are systematically suppressed. To decouple

summary.core_problem: 研究多模型路由在准确率和计算成本之间的权衡，并指出多轮“推理-路由”耦合框架会出现强模型被系统性压制的退化现象。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理时模型选择方法与训练稳定性分析。它不直接改进预训练，但对级联模型、router、混合专家式 serving 的奖励设计有参考意义，尤其是稀疏监督下 router 容易坍缩的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EntroRouter，一个单轮模型路由框架，把熵调控作为显式目标。先用 Soft Supervision 拟合“适合模型”的分布，形成高熵探索先验；再用 Soft Anchor 引入离线能力估计，在强化学习阶段控制熵收缩，避免策略过早集中到局部解。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了广泛实验，目标是验证 EntroRouter 相比多轮路由和常规强化学习路由在准确率-成本权衡上更稳；但摘要未给出模型池规模、任务集合、基线名称、提升幅度或统计显著性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies model routing under an accuracy-cost tradeoff and identifies a degeneracy where multi-round reasoning-routing systems systematically suppress capable experts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time routing method plus a failure-mode analysis. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to cascaded LLM systems, router training, and serving-time mixtures where sparse supervision can collapse exploration.
summary_en.technical_approach: EntroRouter is a single-round routing framework with entropy regulation as an explicit objective. It first uses Soft Supervision to fit a distribution over suitable models and create a high-entropy exploration prior, then applies a Soft Anchor based on offline capability estimates to contract entropy safely during RL.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments showing improved accuracy-cost tradeoffs over routing baselines, but it does not specify model-pool size, datasets, baseline details, numerical gains, or significance tests.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Trust Region Collapse 的定义和熵收缩实验；对预训练无直接动作，但 router 坍缩分析可迁移到 MoE/服务路由。
recommendation.en: Read only the Trust Region Collapse setup and entropy-contraction ablation; it is not a pretraining lever, but the router-collapse diagnosis transfers to MoE and serving routers.

paper.title: FlexMoE: One-for-All Nested Intra-Expert Pruning for MoE Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model ability with sparsely activated experts, making this architecture a standard recipe for modern large models. However, sparse activation does not remove the deployment burden of storing and serving all experts, and the available deployment budget can vary substantially across devices, users, and workloads. Existing MoE compression methods are still largely fixed-budget, typically optimizing one compressed endpoint at each chosen target budget.

summary.core_problem: 把一个已训练好的 MoE 语言模型压缩成多个可部署预算下的嵌套子网络，而不是为每个预算单独训练一个压缩模型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 推理与部署压缩方法。稀疏激活降低了每次前向计算量，但没有降低存储全部专家和服务多种硬件预算的负担；FlexMoE 针对的是实际部署中预算连续变化的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先对每个 expert 的 FFN channel 做重要性排序，再让每个 expert 学习离散剪枝动作。训练时逐步增加成本压力，使一次 action-training 可以导出从高预算到低预算的一系列 action mask；这些 mask 对应嵌套在同一个 ranked base model 里的多个子网络。相对固定预算剪枝，它把多端点压缩改成一次训练、多预算导出。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 名称或提升幅度。实验目标应是比较不同部署预算下的 MoE 压缩质量，并验证单次训练导出的嵌套子网络是否接近或优于固定预算压缩端点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to convert a pretrained MoE language model into a nested family of deployable subnetworks across different inference and storage budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-side MoE compression contribution. Sparse activation reduces per-token compute, but it does not remove the need to store and serve all experts; FlexMoE targets the practical case where deployment budgets vary by device, user, or workload.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlexMoE ranks FFN channels inside each expert by importance, then trains discrete pruning actions for experts. By gradually increasing cost pressure, a single action-training run exports a sequence of masks from high to low budgets, producing reliable subnetworks nested within the same ranked base model. The main shift is from fixed-budget endpoint compression to one training run that supports many budgets.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The relevant experimental question is whether the nested subnetworks retain quality across budgets compared with separately optimized fixed-budget MoE compression methods.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和预算曲线即可；对预训练的直接反馈有限，但 MoE 部署预算连续化这个 setup 很贴近真实服务。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and budget-quality curves; it is not a pretraining paper, but the continuous-budget MoE setup is close to real serving constraints.

paper.title: NLL-Guided Full-Attention Layer Selection for Training-Free Sliding-Window Adaptation
paper.abstract: Hybrid attention models that mix full and sliding-window attention across layers offer a promising approach to efficient long-context inference, but the critical question of \emph{which layers} should retain full attention remains unsolved. Existing methods use either fixed periodic patterns or attention-based heuristics that may not capture what matters for downstream accuracy. We propose NLL-guided layer selection, a training-free method that directly measures each layer's importance by comput

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理里，用“部分层全注意力 + 其余层滑窗注意力”的混合注意力可以显著降 prefill 成本，但“到底该保留哪些层的全注意力”缺少可靠、与下游准确率直接相关的选择准则；固定周期选层和基于注意力权重的启发式在不同模型/任务上不稳定，且同样预算下选层差异会带来巨大精度落差。
summary.importance: 这是一个偏部署侧的推理适配问题，不直接改变预训练，但对“预训练为全注意力、部署改稀疏注意力”的落地链路很关键：给出了一个与任务目标一致（答案 token 的 NLL）的训练外校准信号，能把混合注意力的层选择从经验规则变成可复现的测量问题。对做长上下文 serving、以及研究“哪些层承担长程信息流”也有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是用 teacher-forcing 的答案 token 负对数似然（NLL）来度量“某一层在 prefill 阶段需要全注意力的程度”。具体做法：
1) 采用 SWAA 设定：prefill 阶段每层可选 Full Attention(FA) 或 Sliding-Window Attention(SWA)；decode 阶段保持全层 FA（full-attention decode），以尽量隔离 prefill 稀疏化带来的信息丢失。
2) 对每一层 ℓ 计算一个增益分数 Δℓ：在“其他层都用 SWA”的基线下，仅把第 ℓ 层切到 FA，比较答案 token 的平均 NLL 下降量（NLL(all-SWA) − NLL(only-ℓ-FA)）。Δℓ 越大，表示该层的全注意力越能改善从长 prompt 到答案的可预测性。
3) 在一个小的长上下文校准集上对 Δℓ 做平均，然后直接取 top-k 层作为给定 FA 预算下的保留层集合 S（贪心选择）。
4) 论文还做了“去混淆”校准：用短 prompt 也算一遍层排序，与长 prompt 的排序相关性较低（Spearman ρ=0.306），用来支持该信号确实在捕捉长程依赖需求，而不是泛化的‘某层更敏感’。
取舍上，这个方法把问题从‘看注意力图/结构先验’转成‘直接测量对答案概率的贡献’，代价是需要 L+1 次前向（每个样本），但不需要训练、无梯度、一次性校准可摊销。
summary.experiments:
主要实验在 Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507（36 层）+ LongMemEval（500 样本，6 类长程记忆任务，平均 prompt ~24k token）。推理配置沿用 SWAA：window=2048、keep-first-10 attention sinks、decode 全 FA。
关键结果：
- 在仅保留 1/4 层 FA 的预算下，NLL-guided 选层在 LongMemEval 达到 64.6% accuracy；与 1/2-FA 的周期性选层基线 65.0% 接近，但 FA 预算减半。
- 相比 SWAA 报告的周期性 1/4-FA 基线，提升 10.4 个百分点（说明“选哪些层”比“选多少层”更关键）。
- 选层好坏差异很大：同为 1/4-FA，在 Qwen3-4B 上好/坏选择可差 26+ 个百分点（强调该问题的敏感性）。
- 校准成本：用 64 个长样本（16k–32k）做校准；每样本 L+1 次前向；4 GPU 约 15 分钟。以 24k prompt 估算，约 1,354 次请求后摊销回本。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Method 里 Δℓ 的定义与“只在 prefill 对 prompt 用 SWA、答案 token 仍全上下文”的实现细节；这是方法成立的关键假设。
- 重点看实验部分关于“1/4-FA 逼近 1/2-FA”的主结果，以及“好/坏选层差 26pp”的敏感性描述，理解为什么需要可测量的选层准则。
- 看 long vs short prompt 的相关性分析（Spearman ρ=0.306），这是论文用来证明信号指向‘长程注意力需求’而非一般层脆弱性的主要证据。
- 如果要复现/落地，优先翻 Appendix 的实现与成本估算：L+1 前向如何做、校准集如何选、以及 break-even 的计算口径。

summary_en.core_problem: Hybrid attention for long-context inference (keeping full attention in only a subset of layers while using sliding-window attention elsewhere during prefill) can cut quadratic cost, but the key decision—which layers should retain full attention under a fixed budget—has no robust, accuracy-aligned criterion. Periodic patterns and attention-weight heuristics are brittle, and layer choice can swing downstream accuracy dramatically.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-time adaptation paper rather than a pretraining recipe change, but it matters for the common mismatch where models are pretrained with dense attention and deployed with sparse/limited attention. The contribution is a simple, training-free calibration signal directly tied to task likelihood (answer-token NLL), turning layer selection into a measurable objective. It also provides a practical probe for which depths carry long-range information flow under long prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method scores each layer by how much full attention at that layer improves answer-token likelihood under a SWAA-style setup.
- Setup: During prefill, each layer can be Full Attention (FA) or Sliding-Window Attention (SWA); during decoding, all layers use FA (full-attention decode) to isolate prefill degradation.
- Per-layer scoring: For a prompt+answer pair, compute mean NLL on answer tokens under (i) all layers SWA in prefill, and (ii) only layer ℓ switched to FA while all others remain SWA. The score Δℓ is the NLL reduction from (ii) vs (i). Larger Δℓ implies that layer benefits more from global context during prefill.
- Selection: Average Δℓ over a small long-context calibration set, then pick the top-k layers (greedy) for the FA budget.
- Deconfounding check: Repeat ranking with short prompts and show low rank correlation with long-prompt ranking (Spearman ρ=0.306), arguing the signal is specific to long-range needs rather than generic layer sensitivity.
Trade-off: requires L+1 forward passes per calibration example (no gradients, no generation), but it is a one-off cost amortized over deployment.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 (36 layers) with LongMemEval (500 samples across 6 long-memory task types; ~24k-token prompts). SWAA configuration: window size 2048, keep-first-10 attention sinks, full-attention decode.
Key numbers:
- With only 1/4 of layers using FA during prefill, NLL-guided selection reaches 64.6% accuracy on LongMemEval, close to a periodic 1/2-FA baseline at 65.0% while using half the FA budget.
- Beats the SWAA-reported periodic 1/4-FA baseline by 10.4 percentage points.
- Highlights high sensitivity: for the same 1/4-FA budget, good vs poor layer choices can differ by 26+ accuracy points on Qwen3-4B.
- Practicality: calibration uses 64 long examples (16k–32k tokens), costs ~15 minutes on 4 GPUs; break-even estimated at ~1,354 inference requests for 24k prompts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 minutes):
- Method section: focus on the exact definition of Δℓ and the inference-faithful detail that SWA is applied to prompt tokens during prefill while answer tokens still attend globally (to emulate full-attention decode).
- Experiments: read the main LongMemEval table/claims around “1/4-FA matches 1/2-FA periodic” and the reported 26pp spread across layer selections.
- The long-vs-short prompt ranking correlation (ρ=0.306) is the main evidence that the metric targets long-range attention demand.
- For implementation, check appendix details on how they run L+1 passes efficiently and how they compute amortization/break-even.

recommendation.zh: 只看 NLL 层重要性定义和 LongMemEval 消融；它给长上下文部署一个干净信号，但还不是训练侧结论。
recommendation.en: Read the NLL-based layer-importance definition and LongMemEval ablations; it is a clean deployment signal, not yet a pretraining-side result.

paper.title: CSD: Content-aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Image Generation
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) has emerged as a key solution to accelerate the inference of autoregressive models. However, in the field of image generation, it faces the challenge of low acceptance rates, and directly relaxing its criteria leads to degradation in image quality. In this paper, we propose a novel content-aware speculative decoding algorithm, termed CSD, which integrates an entropy-based probability relaxation mechanism with an optimal resampling strategy to enhance the inference effic

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归图像生成中 speculative decoding 接受率低、直接放宽接受准则又会损害生成质量的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理加速方法。它把 LLM 推理中常见的 speculative decoding 迁移到离散图像 token 生成，并尝试处理图像区域信息密度不均带来的接受率差异。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CSD，即 content-aware speculative decoding。核心做法是用基于熵的概率放宽机制，根据图像不同区域的信息不确定性动态调整候选 token 接受概率；低细节区域更容易接受 draft token，从而提高吞吐。同时加入 optimal resampling strategy 和 distribution alignment filter，减少放宽接受准则带来的目标分布偏移。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Lumina-mGPT 等自回归图像生成模型上进行；摘要声称提升接受率和推理效率，同时保持生成质量，但给出的摘要被截断，未提供具体加速倍数、FID/CLIP 等指标或完整 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the low acceptance rate of speculative decoding in autoregressive image generation, where naive acceptance relaxation tends to hurt image quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It ports speculative decoding ideas from language generation to discrete image-token generation and focuses on the uneven information density across image regions.
summary_en.technical_approach: CSD uses an entropy-based probability relaxation rule to make token acceptance content-aware. Low-detail or low-uncertainty regions receive looser acceptance thresholds, while an optimal resampling strategy and a distribution-alignment filter are used to reduce mismatch against the target model distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Lumina-mGPT and other autoregressive image-generation settings. The provided abstract claims better acceptance rate and efficiency with preserved quality, but the excerpt is truncated and does not expose concrete speedup numbers, image-quality metrics, or full baselines.

recommendation.zh: 可作 speculative decoding 迁移到非文本 token 的案例看，核心只需读接受准则和分布校准；对预训练方法论帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Useful mainly as a non-text-token speculative decoding case; read the acceptance rule and distribution filter, not the whole paper.

paper.title: Information-Aware KV Cache Compression for Long Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning capability has advanced rapidly in large language models (LLMs), leading to an increasing size of key-value (KV) cache in both prefilling and decoding stages. Existing KV cache compression methods mainly rely on attention weights to estimate token importance. While attention effectively captures contextual relevance, it overlooks complementary information-theoretic signals related to predictive uncertainty and token informativeness. In this paper, we revisit token importance from a for

summary.core_problem: 长上下文与长解码推理使 KV cache 成为推理阶段的主要内存/带宽瓶颈。现有 KV 压缩多用“最近窗口的注意力权重”估计 token 重要性，偏短视：它更像在回答“最近在看什么”，而不是“未来会不会用到什么”。论文要解决的是：如何用更前瞻的信号挑选应保留的 KV token，在相同 cache budget 下尽量不伤长推理能力。
summary.importance:
这是推理效率方向（efficient），不是预训练方法论文。但它对基座研究仍有两点启发：
1) 重要性估计不应只依赖 attention（相关性），还应引入不确定性/信息量（informativeness）信号；这类信号同样可能用于数据筛选、课程学习或训练时的 token reweighting。
2) 提出 Forward Influence 这种“删掉某 token 对未来预测分布的影响”的定义，为分析长程依赖提供了更可解释的度量框架（尽管计算代价高，更多用于分析/标定）。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先用 Forward Influence 论证注意力分数的局限，再提出 InfoKV 的熵感知压缩策略。

1) Forward Influence（分析指标）：对某个历史 token xi，定义其对未来一段上下文 chunk 的影响为：从 KV 中移除 xi 后，未来各步预测分布与原分布的 KL 散度均值。这个指标是“前瞻的 token utility”，用来观察不同选择准则（attention、entropy 等）保留的 token 对远期预测的持续影响。

2) 熵作为 token 信息量：用下一 token 预测分布的熵衡量不确定性。高熵意味着模型对下一步更不确定，作者经验性地认为这对应更“信息密集”的上下文（内容词等），更可能影响后续推理轨迹。

3) InfoKV（方法）：在 token 选择时把 entropy 信号纳入重要性评分，而不是只看最近窗口 attention。文中还提到结合“中间层到最终层的表征演化”来刻画跨层的重要性（layer-wise orthogonal signal），用于更稳地决定哪些 token 在多层共享的压缩选择中应被保留。

4) 适用场景：同时覆盖 long prefilling（长输入）与 long decoding（长输出推理）。核心目标是在固定 cache budget 下维持推理正确率/遵循能力/代码质量。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖：
- Long prefilling：在 LongReason 上，用 Llama-3.1 / Llama-3.2，不同 context length 与不同 cache budget 下，InfoKV 相比注意力型 KV 压缩更能保住推理表现。
- Long decoding：在 DeepSeek-R1 上评测 IFEval、AIME 2024、LiveCodeBench，InfoKV 在数学推理、指令遵循、代码生成上有“显著提升”。

但你提供的正文片段未包含具体数值表格（例如在某个 budget 下准确率/通过率提升多少、压缩率、吞吐/显存节省曲线、与哪些具体 baselines 对比）。如果要把它当作可落地的 serving 方案，需要核对：
- 选择策略的计算开销（熵需要额外 softmax/统计；是否会抵消收益）；
- 是否逐层不同选择还是全层共享；
- 对不同任务类型（检索式、数学、代码、对话）的敏感性；
- 与主流方法（window-attn、H2O、StreamingLLM 类）在同等实现条件下的对照。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Forward Influence 的定义与图 1 类分析图：理解作者为何认为 attention 主要影响近邻，而高熵 token 对远期更关键。
- 再看 InfoKV 的打分公式：entropy 如何与 attention/跨层表征信号结合，是否需要校准超参。
- 最后看长解码实验（AIME/LiveCodeBench）：这些任务更能暴露“未来会用到的早期信息”是否被保住。
- 阅读时要带着一个工程问题：熵信号在推理时如何高效计算与更新；如果需要频繁全词表熵，可能需要近似或复用 logits。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context prefilling and long-horizon decoding make KV cache the dominant memory/bandwidth bottleneck at inference. Most KV compression methods rank tokens by attention weights from a recent window, which is inherently backward-looking and tends to preserve locally relevant tokens rather than tokens that will matter for future reasoning steps. The paper targets a forward-looking token-utility criterion to retain the right KV entries under a fixed cache budget without degrading long reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency (serving) contribution rather than a pretraining method. For foundation-model researchers, it still provides two useful angles: (1) token importance should combine relevance (attention) with informativeness/uncertainty signals, which may generalize to data filtering or token reweighting during training; (2) the Forward Influence definition offers a clearer analysis tool for long-range dependency utility, even if it is too expensive for routine use.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first introduces a forward-looking analysis metric, then proposes an entropy-aware KV selection scheme (InfoKV).

1) Forward Influence (analysis): for a past token xi, remove it from the KV cache and measure the average KL divergence between the original future predictive distributions and the distributions after removal over a future chunk. This quantifies how much xi affects future generation, not just recent attention.

2) Entropy as informativeness: use the entropy of the next-token predictive distribution as a proxy for uncertainty/information content. High-entropy contexts are argued to carry richer semantic information and to have more persistent influence on distant future steps.

3) InfoKV (method): incorporate entropy into token-importance scoring for KV retention, instead of relying purely on attention scores. The method also mentions combining entropy with a layer-wise signal based on representation evolution from intermediate to final layers, aiming to capture importance that is orthogonal to the sequence dimension.

4) Scope: designed to work for both long prefilling and long decoding, optimizing reasoning quality under constrained KV budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the Forward Influence definition and the motivating plots (often early figures) to understand the claimed locality of attention-based selection.
- Inspect the exact scoring/selection rule in InfoKV: how entropy is combined with other signals and what hyperparameters are introduced.
- Prioritize long-decoding results (AIME/LiveCodeBench), since they best stress “future utility”.
- Keep an engineering lens: how entropy is computed/updated efficiently during decoding; if it requires frequent full-vocab operations, approximations may be necessary.

recommendation.zh: 建议读分析图：高熵 token 影响远未来这个 prior 若稳，KV 策略不能只按 attention heavy hitter 做。
recommendation.en: Read the analysis figures: if high-entropy tokens truly affect distant future context, KV policies should not rely only on attention heavy hitters.

paper.title: Position Rebinding Cache Reuse: Replay-Free Visual Revisiting for Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Interleaved multimodal reasoning improves visual grounding by revisiting visual evidence during multi-step generation, yet existing methods typically rely on token replay, repeatedly forwarding selected visual tokens. A natural shortcut is to reuse the historical visual key-value (KV) cache directly. However, we identify a critical failure mode of this strategy: cached visual keys are already bound to their original positional context. Such stale positional binding distorts attention under later

summary.core_problem: 交错多模态推理中，现有token回放方法存在冗余计算，而直接复用历史视觉KV缓存会因旧位置绑定干扰注意力、触发自回归解码崩溃，缺乏有效的无回放视觉证据复现方案。
summary.importance: 明确了多模态KV缓存复用的核心失效机制为位置上下文不匹配，为MLLM推理优化、甚至未来支持跨上下文视觉特征复用的位置编码预训练设计提供了问题指向；缓存复用框架可降低多模态长上下文推理的计算开销，对部署侧有实际参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出无回放的位置重绑定缓存复用（PRCR）框架，核心包含两部分：一是原始视觉证据内存，存储加位置编码前的原始视觉KV及对应视觉token的空间坐标；二是位置重分配机制，当需要复现视觉证据时，为选中的KV重新分配适配当前解码上下文的位置、重新施加位置编码后，再插入活跃解码器缓存，无需重新前向传播视觉token。
summary.experiments: 以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为基线，在M3CoT数据集上，直接KV复用方案准确率从基线的66.4%骤降至23.5%，且频繁出现重复token循环、输出熵崩溃的解码失效现象；PRCR可恢复至甚至超过token回放方法的准确率，同时在不同的视觉token选择预算、模型规模下，显著降低视觉复现环节的FLOPs。
summary.reading_guide: 先通读引言中直接KV复用失效的核心现象（图1a、图2的解码崩溃分析），再了解PRCR的两大核心模块设计，重点关注图1的准确率-FLOPs对比、图3的注意力扰动诊断结果，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In interleaved multimodal reasoning, existing token replay methods introduce heavy redundant computation, while direct reuse of historical visual KV caches disrupts attention and triggers catastrophic autoregressive decoding collapse due to stale positional binding, leaving a gap for efficient replay-free visual evidence revisiting solutions.
summary_en.importance: It identifies positional context mismatch as the root failure mode of multimodal KV cache reuse, providing clear guidance for MLLM inference optimization and even future pretraining design of positional encoding schemes that support cross-context visual feature reuse. The cache reuse framework also cuts computational overhead for multimodal long-context inference, with practical reference value for deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Position Rebinding Cache Reuse (PRCR), a replay-free framework with two core components: 1) Raw Visual Evidence Memory, which stores pre-positional-encoding visual KV entries along with the spatial coordinates of corresponding visual tokens; 2) Position Reassignment mechanism, which reallocates context-compatible positions to selected KV entries during visual revisiting, re-applies positional encoding, and inserts the reconstructed cache into the active decoder cache without re-forwarding visual tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as the baseline, Direct KV Cache Reuse reduces M3CoT accuracy sharply from 66.4% to 23.5%, accompanied by frequent repeated-token loops and output entropy collapse. PRCR recovers to or even outperforms the accuracy of token replay methods, while substantially reducing FLOPs of the visual revisiting stage across different selected-token budgets and model scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the core failure phenomenon of direct KV reuse in the introduction (Figure 1a, decoding collapse analysis in Figure 2), then review the two core modules of PRCR. Focus on Figure 1 (accuracy vs. FLOPs comparison) and Figure 3 (attention perturbation diagnosis). Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 failure analysis 和位置重绑定公式；它提醒 cache 不是无语义状态，做 VLM 长链推理优化时这个坑很实。
recommendation.en: Read the failure analysis and the rebinding formulation; it is a concrete warning that cache is not position-free state in long-chain VLM inference.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: TMP: Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning for Large-scale Image Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Modern image generation model rapidly grows their sizes to meet high-fidelity image synthesis. However, they gradually become unaffordable for their enormous parameter consumption and computation budget that lead to massive resources requirement and gpu memory footprint. In this paper, we propose TMP, the first Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning framework that generalizes prevalent image tasks (T2I and TI2I) and architectures (Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and Diffusion transformer (DiT)). It could

summary.core_problem: 如何在尽量少损伤生成质量的前提下，把超大规模图像生成/编辑模型压到可负担的推理成本与显存占用。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在推理侧模型压缩：把“结构化剪枝 + 不同子模块混合策略”做成可覆盖 MoE 与 DiT、T2I 与 TI2I 的统一框架，并给出大模型（80B 级）可在单卡消费级 GPU 跑起来的工程落地案例。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning (TMP)：用树状结构组织剪枝决策，在不同层/模块上采用不同剪枝策略（mixed-policy），声称可同时适配 MoE 与 DiT 架构；定位为 step-distilled 模型的最后阶段压缩，并配合工程优化降低显存与推理开销。
summary.experiments: 在开源 HunyuanImage-3.0 instruct 与 Z-Image turbo 上实验；报告将 HunyuanImage 从 80B 剪到 20B（75% 参数下降）且“有限”质量损失；并声称通过工程技巧使 20B 版本可在单张 24GB RTX 4090 上推理。摘要未给出明确指标/对比细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to compress very large image generation/editing models to affordable inference cost and memory footprint with limited quality degradation.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-side compression contribution: a unified structured pruning framework claimed to cover both MoE and DiT, across T2I and image editing, plus a practical case of running an 80B-class model after pruning on a single consumer GPU.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning (TMP): organizes pruning decisions in a tree and applies different pruning policies across layers/modules, targeting both MoE and DiT. Positioned as a final-stage compression step for step-distilled models, coupled with engineering optimizations for memory/inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on open-source HunyuanImage-3.0 instruct and Z-Image turbo; reports compressing HunyuanImage from 80B to 20B (75% reduction) with limited quality loss, and enabling inference of the pruned 20B model on a single 24GB RTX 4090. The abstract does not provide concrete metrics/baselines.

recommendation.zh: 偏工程的生成模型剪枝落地，和基座预训练关系不大；想借鉴“MoE/DiT 统一剪枝接口”可扫一眼，但质量评估是否干净要打问号。
recommendation.en: Mostly an engineering-oriented pruning story, weakly tied to foundation pretraining; skim only if you care about a unified pruning interface for MoE/DiT, but treat quality claims as weak without clean eval.

paper.title: Quantization Inflates Reasoning: Token Inflation as a Hidden Cost of Low-Bit Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Quantization is widely used to reduce the inference cost of large language models, but its effect on reasoning models is not fully captured by final-answer accuracy or per-token latency. We show that low-bit post-training quantization can introduce a hidden test-time compute cost: quantized reasoning models often generate longer chains of thought even when they still answer correctly. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, scientific question answering, and agentic tool-use benchmarks,

summary.core_problem: 现有低比特训练后量化（PTQ）的评估体系仅关注最终答案准确率和单token延迟，完全忽略了推理类LLM的核心成本变量——推理阶段生成的思维链（CoT）token数量；低比特PTQ会导致推理模型在正确率基本不变的情况下生成更长的推理轨迹，产生隐藏的端到端推理成本膨胀，抵消甚至超过量化带来的单token加速收益。
summary.importance: 该工作系统性揭示了量化与推理计算行为的耦合效应，填补了推理模型量化评估的关键盲区。对预训练-部署闭环的具体影响包括三点：1）推翻了“量化后正确率不变则部署成本降低”的默认假设，要求推理模型部署时必须测量端到端延迟，而非仅看单token速度；2）为后训练、量化感知训练（QAT）提出了新的优化目标——控制推理token开销，而非仅约束权重精度损失；3）对推理增强预训练（如R1类模型的训练）有间接启示：模型的推理长度偏好对权重的数值精度非常敏感，训练时的数值稳定性会直接影响部署时的推理成本。
summary.technical_approach: 1）定义核心指标CoT Token Inflation Ratio（CTIR）：量化模型与全精度基线在同一benchmark上的平均推理token数的比值，用于量化膨胀程度，计算时严格拆分推理token（<think>标签内或CoT段）与答案token，避免指标偏差。2）严格控制变量实验：设置temperature=0消除采样噪声，仅评估权重-only PTQ（隔离量化算法、激活量化等其他变量），覆盖4B到30B参数的dense、MoE两类推理架构，横跨数学、代码、科学问答、工具调用四类重推理任务，同时加入轻推理的通用语言benchmark作为对照组，验证膨胀效应的任务相关性。3）行为分析：对推理轨迹的语义重复度、中间步骤数量做统计，区分“冗余措辞”和“重复推理”两类膨胀来源，验证额外推理步骤对正确率无贡献。4）缓解策略评估：分别测试prompt调控（要求推理简洁）、解码约束（限制最大推理长度）、量化感知训练（QAT）三种方案的效果，对比其准确率-长度的trade-off。
summary.experiments: 评测模型包括Qwen3-4B-Thinking、Phi-4-14B（dense架构），Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking（MoE架构）；量化方法覆盖GPTQ、AWQ、SmoothQuant、ParoQuant等主流权重-only PTQ，位宽为INT4、INT3。核心结果：1）INT4/INT3量化在多数推理benchmark上最终答案准确率损失<2%（几乎无损），但CTIR可达1.15~1.4（推理token数增加15%~40%）；例如MoE模型的INT3量化在AIME25上准确率仅降0.3%，但CTIR达1.32。2）膨胀程度与任务推理强度正相关：轻推理的通用语言benchmark（HellaSwag、MMLU-Pro）的CTIR仅1.02~1.07，几乎无膨胀。3）行为层面：量化模型的推理轨迹中，语义重复片段占比提升8%~15%，中间验证步骤数量增加20%以上，这些额外步骤未带来正确率提升。4）缓解策略效果：prompt要求简洁仅在部分benchmark上降低CTIR，同时导致准确率下降3%~5%；解码硬截断推理长度会大幅降低正确率；QAT可将准确率损失控制在1%以内，同时将CTIR降到1.05以内，是当前最优的缓解方向。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先级：1）第4章的核心实验结果表格，重点对比不同模型、不同量化位宽、不同任务下的CTIR与准确率变化，这是全文的核心实证依据；2）第6章的行为分析部分，明确膨胀的具体表现是重复推理而非冗余措辞，理解其对计算成本的实际影响；3）第5章CTIR的定义与计算细节，注意推理token与答案token的拆分逻辑，避免后续复现或使用时出现指标偏差；4）第7章的缓解策略对比，重点分析QAT能同时控制精度损失和token膨胀的内在原因。可跳过附录中具体量化算法的参数配置细节（除非从事量化工程落地）。值得深挖的方向：推理模型的数值精度如何影响其“终止推理、输出答案”的决策阈值，是否可以在预训练、RL训练阶段引入推理长度正则化，来提升模型的量化鲁棒性，从训练源头降低部署时的隐藏成本。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation protocols for low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) only track final-answer accuracy and per-token latency, completely ignoring a core cost variable for reasoning-optimized LLMs: the number of chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens generated at inference time. Low-bit PTQ can cause reasoning models to produce significantly longer reasoning trajectories while maintaining nearly unchanged answer accuracy, creating a hidden end-to-end inference cost inflation that offsets or even outweighs the per-token speedup from quantization.
summary_en.importance: This work systematically reveals the coupling effect between quantization and reasoning computational behavior, filling a critical blind spot in the evaluation of quantized reasoning models. Its concrete impacts on the pretraining-deployment loop include three points: 1) It overturns the default assumption that "unchanged accuracy after quantization equals lower deployment cost", requiring end-to-end latency measurement (instead of per-token speed only) for reasoning model deployment. 2) It proposes a new optimization target for post-training and quantization-aware training (QAT): controlling reasoning token overhead, rather than only constraining weight precision loss. 3) It provides indirect implications for reasoning-enhanced pretraining (e.g., R1-style model training): a model's reasoning length preference is highly sensitive to weight numerical precision, so numerical stability during training directly affects inference cost at deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Define the core metric CoT Token Inflation Ratio (CTIR): the ratio of the average number of reasoning tokens generated by a quantized model versus its full-precision baseline on the same benchmark, used to quantify inflation degree. Calculation strictly splits reasoning tokens (within <think> tags or CoT segments) and answer tokens to avoid metric bias. 2) Strict controlled variable experiments: set temperature=0 to eliminate sampling noise, evaluate weight-only PTQ only (to isolate variables like quantization algorithm and activation quantization), cover dense and MoE reasoning architectures with 4B to 30B parameters, span four reasoning-heavy task categories (mathematics, code generation, scientific QA, agentic tool use), and add light-reasoning general language benchmarks as control groups to verify the task correlation of inflation. 3) Behavioral analysis: quantify semantic repetition rate and number of intermediate steps in reasoning trajectories, distinguish two inflation sources (redundant wording vs repeated reasoning), and verify that extra reasoning steps contribute nothing to accuracy. 4) Mitigation strategy evaluation: test three approaches respectively (prompt regulation for concise reasoning, decoding constraints on maximum reasoning length, QAT) and compare their accuracy-length trade-offs.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated models include Qwen3-4B-Thinking, Phi-4-14B (dense), and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking (MoE). Quantization methods cover mainstream weight-only PTQ approaches including GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, ParoQuant, with bit widths INT4 and INT3. Core results: 1) INT4/INT3 quantization introduces <2% final-answer accuracy loss (nearly lossless) on most reasoning benchmarks, but CTIR reaches 1.15–1.4 (15%–40% increase in reasoning tokens). For example, INT3 quantization on the MoE model reduces AIME25 accuracy by only 0.3% but reaches a CTIR of 1.32. 2) Inflation degree positively correlates with task reasoning intensity: CTIR for light-reasoning general language benchmarks (HellaSwag, MMLU-Pro) is only 1.02–1.07, with negligible inflation. 3) Behavioral findings: quantized models show 8%–15% higher proportion of semantically repeated segments in reasoning trajectories, and the number of intermediate verification steps increases by over 20%, with these extra steps bringing no accuracy improvement. 4) Mitigation performance: Prompting for conciseness only reduces CTIR on a subset of benchmarks, while causing 3%–5% accuracy drop; hard truncation of reasoning length severely hurts accuracy; QAT keeps accuracy loss within 1% while suppressing CTIR to below 1.05, making it the most promising mitigation direction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Priority reading order: 1) Core experimental result tables in Section 4, especially the comparison of CTIR and accuracy changes across models, quantization bit widths, and tasks — this is the core empirical evidence of the paper. 2) Behavioral analysis in Section 6, to clarify that inflation manifests as repeated reasoning rather than redundant wording, and understand its actual impact on computational cost. 3) CTIR definition and calculation details in Section 5, especially the split logic between reasoning tokens and answer tokens, to avoid metric bias in reproduction or application. 4) Mitigation strategy comparison in Section 7, focus on the internal reason why QAT can simultaneously control precision loss and token inflation. Skip appendix sections on specific quantization algorithm parameter configurations (unless working on quantization engineering deployment). Worth deeper exploration: How numerical precision of reasoning models affects their decision threshold for "terminating reasoning and outputting answers", and whether reasoning length regularization can be introduced during pretraining or RL training to improve model quantization robustness, reducing hidden deployment costs from the training source.

recommendation.zh: 量化reasoning模型的'准确率不掉=没事'被打脸：token变长直接吞掉端到端加速，立刻在内部Serving测算里复现这个指标。
recommendation.en: Kills the naive 'accuracy preserved, speedup achieved' story for quantized reasoning models—token inflation eats the wall-clock win; add this metric to your serving eval now.

paper.title: RoPE-Aware Bit Allocation for KV-Cache Quantization
paper.abstract: Existing low-bit KV-cache quantizers often treat each cached key as a flat vector. Under RoPE, however, a key's contribution to a future attention logit decomposes into a position-dependent sum over two-dimensional frequency blocks. This makes key-cache quantization a block-wise bit-allocation problem: high-energy RoPE blocks are more sensitive to quantization error and should receive more bits. We introduce Block-GTQ, a RoPE-aware bit allocator for key-cache quantization built on TurboQuant-MSE

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里一个很具体但常被粗糙处理的问题：RoPE 模型中的 key cache 量化，不应被看成普通向量压缩，而应被看成“对未来 attention logit 影响不同的频率块之间如何分配比特”的问题。现有低比特 KV-cache 方法大多把每个 key 当成平坦向量，优化重建误差；但在 RoPE 下，query-key logit 是按 2 维旋转频率块分解的，不同 block 对未来 logits 的敏感度并不一样。结果是，统一 bit allocation 会把预算浪费在低影响 block 上，同时压坏真正决定注意力分布的高能量 block，尤其在长上下文和推理任务上会出现性能塌陷。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的意义主要不在“又一个量化技巧”，而在于它把 KV-cache 压缩目标重新对齐到了模型真正使用 key 的方式上：不是最小化向量 MSE，而是更接近最小化 RoPE attention logit 误差。这种目标重写很有启发性，因为它说明推理侧压缩如果忽略预训练时引入的结构性归纳偏置，往往会在表面压缩率相同的情况下造成完全不同的功能退化。对长上下文 serving 来说，这项工作给出了一条很实用的路线：在不改模型、不引入 recent buffer 依赖的前提下，仅通过更合理的 bit allocation 就能显著改善低比特 K-cache 的可用性。对预训练研究员而言，更重要的启发是：RoPE 不是“后处理细节”，它改变了表示的误差几何，任何压缩、蒸馏、甚至训练时正则都可能需要围绕这种 block structure 重新设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Block-GTQ。它建立在 TurboQuant-MSE 之上，但不再对整个 key head 统一分配 bit，而是对每个 layer、每个 KV head 内的 RoPE 2D block 做整数 bit allocation。论文先从 RoPE attention 写出 logit 形式：对于相对位置 Δ，logit 是 q^T R_Δ k，可拆成多个 2×2 旋转块项之和。于是 key 的量化误差对 logit 的影响天然是 block-wise 的。基于这个观察，作者为每个 block 构造了一个无需标签的 energy score，来自 Q/K 激活统计，用来近似该 block 对未来 query-key 信号的重要性。然后结合 TQ-MSE 的经验误差率律 4^{-b}，把“给某个 block 多 1 bit 能减少多少预期误差”写成边际收益，并在固定平均 bit budget 下做 greedy integer allocation。分到相同比特宽度的 block 再复用原始 TQ-MSE 的局部编码器，因此实现代价不高。值向量 V 没有参与 RoPE key-logit 计算，所以仍然采用 uniform TQ-MSE。这个设计很克制：它不改 attention，不改 cache layout 的语义，只改 K 的 bit 分配策略。论文还实现了 packed-cache serving path，把压缩后的 K/V code 直接用于推理路径，而不是只做离线误差分析。
summary.experiments: 实验分三层。第一层是机制验证：在 10 个模型的诊断面板上，作者比较了相同 K-only bit budget 下 Block-GTQ 与 uniform TQ-MSE 的 RoPE-logit 保真度。在 2 b/dim 和 3 b/dim 两个预算下，per-layer RoPE-logit MAE 相对下降 32% 到 80%，并且在 367/367 个 layer comparison 上全部胜出，说明收益不是少数层驱动，而是相当稳定的结构性改进。第二层是长上下文任务：在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，K2V2 预算下，六任务 NIAH 平均分从 70.6 提升到 97.4；八任务 LongBench-EN 平均分从 36.87 提升到 53.31。这个幅度已经说明 uniform K quantization 在低比特下不是“略差”，而是会明显破坏可用性。第三层是推理与数学任务鲁棒性：在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 上，AIME 2024/2025 的 K3V2 设置里，Block-GTQ 达到 51.7/37.5，接近 fp16 的 54.2/37.9，而 uniform TQ-MSE 直接掉到 0.0/0.0。这个结果很关键，因为它说明低比特 key 误差会通过 attention 分布放大，最终把长链推理彻底打坏；而 RoPE-aware allocation 可以显著缓解。系统侧，在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上用 K3V3 Block-GTQ 的 packed path，相比 fp16 FlashAttention2，128K context 下 KV cache 压缩 3.24×，峰值显存从 56.31GB 降到 19.85GB，单请求 decode latency 从 70.96ms 降到 52.95ms；256K 和 512K 时 fp16 baseline 已 OOM，而压缩路径仍可运行，峰值显存分别为 33.42GB 和 60.56GB。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先抓三处。第一，看引言和 RoPE-structured key-cache error 的推导，确认作者为什么坚持“key 量化目标应是 logit preservation 而不是 vector reconstruction”。这是整篇文章最有信息量的地方。第二，看 bit allocation 的公式化部分，重点理解 energy score 的定义、为什么能做到 label-free、以及 4^{-b} 误差率律如何把 allocation 变成 greedy marginal gain 问题。第三，看实验里 AIME 和 LongBench/NIAH 的结果表，这些比单纯 logit MAE 更能说明方法是否真的保住了模型功能。若时间有限，优先读方法章节前半、主结果表、以及 packed serving 的实现说明，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主要贡献。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是 energy profile 是否与预训练阶段不同层的频率利用模式有关；二是这种 block-aware 思路能否迁移到训练时的表示正则、蒸馏损失或 tokenizer 设计上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific but important mismatch in long-context inference: key-cache quantization in RoPE-based models should not be treated as flat vector compression. Under RoPE, a future query-key logit decomposes into a sum over 2D frequency blocks, and different blocks contribute very differently to the final attention score. Existing low-bit KV-cache methods mostly optimize reconstruction error on the key vector itself, which ignores this structured sensitivity. As a result, uniform bit allocation can waste precision on low-impact blocks while under-protecting the blocks that actually control attention logits, leading to severe degradation on long-context and reasoning tasks.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not just a better quantizer. The paper reframes KV-cache compression around the quantity the model actually uses: RoPE attention logits rather than vector MSE. That shift is useful for foundation-model researchers because it shows how inference-time compression can fail when it ignores the representational geometry induced by pretraining choices such as RoPE. In practical serving, the method shows that one can recover much of the utility of low-bit key caches without changing the model or relying on an fp16 recent-key buffer. More broadly, it suggests that RoPE is not a superficial implementation detail; it changes how errors propagate, so compression, distillation, and possibly even training-time regularization may need to respect the same block structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Block-GTQ, is built on TurboQuant-MSE but replaces uniform per-head bit allocation with integer bit allocation over RoPE 2D blocks inside each layer and KV head. The starting point is the RoPE attention logit q^T R_Δ k, which decomposes into a sum of 2×2 rotated block terms. This makes key-cache quantization naturally block-sensitive: quantization error in different blocks perturbs future logits by different amounts. The paper defines a label-free block energy score from Q/K activation statistics to estimate how important each block is for future query-key interactions. It then combines this score with the TQ-MSE empirical error law, where squared error scales roughly as 4^{-b}, to compute the marginal gain of assigning one more bit to a block. Under a fixed average-bit budget, bits are allocated greedily as integers. Blocks with the same assigned width are then encoded using the original TQ-MSE local quantizer, so the implementation remains lightweight. Values are still quantized with uniform TQ-MSE because V does not enter the RoPE key-logit computation. The paper also implements a packed-cache serving path so the compressed K/V codes are used in an actual inference pipeline rather than only in offline analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation has three layers. First, mechanism validation: on a ten-model diagnostic panel, Block-GTQ is compared against uniform TQ-MSE at matched K-only budgets. At both 2 and 3 bits per dimension, it reduces per-layer RoPE-logit MAE by 32% to 80%, and wins all 367/367 layer comparisons at each budget. This indicates a broad structural improvement rather than gains from a few favorable layers. Second, long-context downstream tasks: on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at K2V2, the six-task NIAH average rises from 70.6 to 97.4, and the eight-task LongBench-EN average rises from 36.87 to 53.31 relative to uniform-allocation TQ-MSE. Third, reasoning robustness: on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, AIME 2024/2025 scores at K3V2 are 51.7/37.5 for Block-GTQ, close to fp16 at 54.2/37.9, while uniform TQ-MSE collapses to 0.0/0.0. That result is especially telling because it shows how low-bit key errors can destroy long-chain reasoning once they distort attention distributions, and how RoPE-aware allocation can prevent that failure. On the systems side, with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and a K3V3 packed path, the method achieves 3.24× KV-cache compression at 128K context, reduces peak memory from 56.31GB to 19.85GB, and lowers single-request decode latency from 70.96ms to 52.95ms. At 256K and 512K, the fp16 baseline runs out of memory, while the packed path remains feasible at 33.42GB and 60.56GB peak memory.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the derivation of RoPE-structured key-cache error. That is where the paper makes its central case that key quantization should preserve logits rather than just reconstruct vectors. Second, read the bit-allocation section carefully, especially how the energy score is defined, why it is label-free, and how the 4^{-b} rate law turns allocation into a greedy marginal-gain problem. Third, inspect the AIME and LongBench/NIAH result tables, since they show whether the improved logit fidelity actually preserves model function. If time is limited, the first half of the method section, the main result tables, and the packed-serving implementation notes are enough to capture the contribution in about 25 to 35 minutes. Two deeper follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the learned energy profiles reflect layerwise frequency usage patterns from pretraining, and whether the same block-aware idea could be transferred to training-time regularization, distillation losses, or representation design.

recommendation.zh: RoPE频率块特性是预训练架构设计的核心细节，重点看§3的块能量计算逻辑，可反哺预训练时的RoPE超参与维度分配。
recommendation.en: RoPE frequency block characteristics are a core pre-training architecture detail; focus on §3's block energy calculation logic, which can inform RoPE hyperparameter and dimension allocation during pre-training.

paper.title: CompressKV: Semantic-Retrieval-Guided KV-Cache Compression for Resource-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint and decoding cost of key-value (KV) caches, limiting sustainable deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Existing KV cache eviction methods typically apply heuristic token scoring over all heads in GQA-based LLMs. These methods ignore the different functionalities of attention heads, leading to the eviction of critical tokens and thus degrading the performance of LLMs. To address this issue

summary.core_problem: 现有基于注意力分数的 KV cache 驱逐方法在 GQA 架构上对所有 head 做均等聚合，忽视了 head 功能异质性，导致偏向保留 prompt 首尾的 Streaming Heads 主导打分，中间语义关键 token 被误驱逐；同时各层 KV 预算要么固定均分，要么依赖在线统计，泛化性和开销都不理想。
summary.importance: 属于推理效率方向的增量工作，主要价值在于再次明确指出 GQA 下 head 异质性对 KV 压缩策略的影响，并给出一个基于离线层误差分配预算的实用方案。对 pretrain 研究的直接启发有限，但对理解 attention head 分工、长上下文推理时的信息保留机制有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CompressKV，分三步：(1) 离线识别 Semantic Retrieval Heads（SRHs），即能同时关注 prompt 首尾 token 及其周边语义上下文的 head，而不是只盯住首尾的 Streaming Heads；(2) 在每层内仅用 SRHs 的注意力分数来选择重要 token，并在该层的所有 head 间共享同一套保留 token 索引，避免 Streaming Heads 主导驱逐决策；(3) 离线计算每层在压缩前后 attention block 输出差的 Frobenius 范数，以此估计该层对压缩误差的敏感度，按比例分配各层 KV 预算，不引入在线开销。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 和 Needle-in-a-Haystack 上评测多个 GQA LLM。LongBench 上以 19% KV 预算保留超过 99% 的全 cache 性能，3% 预算下保留约 97% 的 QA 准确率；NIAH 上以 0.7% KV 存储达到 90% 的基线检索准确率。实验验证了 SRH 选择和离线层自适应分配两个组件各自有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看方法部分对 Streaming Heads 与 Semantic Retrieval Heads 的区分、以及基于 Frobenius 范数做离线层预算分配的思路。图 1 关于 head 异质性导致误驱逐的示意比较直观。预计阅读时间 15–20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing attention-score-based KV cache eviction methods for GQA models aggregate scores uniformly across heads, ignoring functional heterogeneity across attention heads. As a result, Streaming Heads that focus primarily on the beginning and end of the prompt dominate eviction decisions, causing semantically important mid-context tokens to be discarded. Existing layer budget allocation is either fixed across layers or relies on online statistics with limited generalization and non-trivial overhead.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental inference-efficiency paper. Its main value is in making the head-heterogeneity problem in GQA-based KV compression explicit and providing a practical, offline layer-budget allocation scheme. Its direct implications for pretraining are limited, but it offers useful observations on attention head specialization and information retention in long-context inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: CompressKV consists of three steps: (1) offline identification of Semantic Retrieval Heads (SRHs), i.e., heads that retrieve important mid-prompt tokens and attend to their semantic context, as opposed to Streaming Heads that mostly attend to initial and final tokens; (2) important-token selection based only on SRH attention scores within each layer, with a single set of preserved token indices shared across all heads in that layer, so that eviction is no longer dominated by Streaming Heads; (3) offline error-aware layer budget allocation, where the Frobenius norm of the attention-block output difference between full and compressed cache is used to estimate per-layer compression sensitivity, and budgets are allocated proportionally without online overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongBench and Needle-in-a-Haystack across multiple GQA LLMs. On LongBench, CompressKV retains over 99% of full-cache performance with 19% KV budget and about 97% QA accuracy with 3% budget. On NIAH, it reaches 90% of baseline retrieval accuracy with only 0.7% KV storage. Ablations support the contribution of both SRH-based token selection and offline layer-adaptive allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the distinction between Streaming Heads and Semantic Retrieval Heads, and on the offline Frobenius-based layer budget allocation idea. Figure 1 gives a clear illustration of how head heterogeneity causes incorrect eviction. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 SRH 识别和 layer budget ablation；若只在少数长文任务上有效，不要过度外推到训练期 head 分工。
recommendation.en: Read the SRH identification and layer-budget ablations; if gains are task-narrow, do not overread them as training-time head specialization.

paper.title: Accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models with Prior-Corrected Token Reduction
paper.abstract: Visual token reduction has emerged as an effective strategy for accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Many existing methods prune tokens by ranking text-visual attention scores. However, we show that attention is often dominated by a model-induced prior: even without textual instruction, MLLMs tend to focus on certain task-agnostic regions. Consequently, the attention scores of instruction-conditioned tokens are suppressed, increasing the risk that these tokens are discarded dur

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝中，文本-视觉注意力被模型固有先验主导，导致任务相关 token 被误删的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理加速方法和注意力信号分析。它提醒视觉 token reduction 不能直接把 cross-attention 当作任务条件重要性，注意力里混有与指令无关的区域偏好。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prior-Corrected Token Reduction，训练免费。方法先估计无文本指令或弱条件下的模型诱导先验注意力，再与任务条件下的后验注意力做对比，用二者差异衡量每个视觉 token 对当前指令额外提供的信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、benchmark 名称和提升幅度。实验主张是在不训练模型的前提下减少视觉 token，并尽量保持多模态推理性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses visual-token pruning in MLLMs where text-visual attention is contaminated by model-induced priors, causing task-relevant tokens to be pruned.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method plus a useful diagnostic about attention signals. It argues that cross-attention should not be treated as task-conditioned token importance without correcting for instruction-agnostic visual priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Prior-Corrected Token Reduction, a training-free pruning method. The method estimates a prior attention map induced by the model, contrasts it with the task-conditioned posterior attention, and ranks tokens by the additional usable information contributed under the current instruction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, benchmark names, or numerical gains. The claimed evaluation is training-free visual-token reduction with preserved multimodal reasoning performance.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和注意力先验分析即可；对预训练不直接，但能提醒别把 MLLM attention 当干净监督信号。
recommendation.en: Read the method figure and prior-attention analysis; it is not pretraining work, but it cautions against treating MLLM attention as a clean supervision signal.

paper.title: Spectral Evolution-Guided Token Pruning in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reducing visual token redundancy is critical for accelerating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) without degrading cross-modal reasoning performance. Existing token pruning methods typically rely on single-layer signals, such as attention scores or token similarities, which overlook the cross-layer transformation of visual representations and may exhibit positional bias in multimodal token sequences. To address this limitation, we propose a training-free token pruning framework based on Cr

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝过度依赖单层 attention 或相似度信号，忽略视觉表征跨层演化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练免费推理加速方法。它把 token 重要性从单点统计改为跨层动态统计，对理解 MLLM 中视觉 token 的语义激活有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Cross-Layer Spectral Evolution。方法在频域中度量视觉 token 表征如何随 Transformer 层变化，认为从高频结构细节向低频语义抽象发生更强谱重分布的 token 更可能语义活跃，应被保留。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和提升幅度。实验目标是训练免费剪枝视觉 token，并在降低推理成本的同时保持跨模态推理性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses MLLM visual-token pruning methods that rely on single-layer attention or similarity signals and ignore cross-layer representational evolution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference acceleration method. It shifts token importance from a single-layer statistic to a cross-layer dynamic signal, which is a useful lens for visual-token activity in MLLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Cross-Layer Spectral Evolution. The method measures how each visual token evolves across Transformer layers in the frequency domain, preserving tokens with stronger spectral redistribution from high-frequency structure toward low-frequency semantic abstraction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, dataset names, or numerical gains. The evaluation claims training-free visual-token pruning with reduced inference cost and preserved cross-modal reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 读 Fig/ablation 就够；频域跨层信号比单层 attention 干净一些，但仍是 MLLM 推理剪枝增量。
recommendation.en: The figure and ablations are enough; cross-layer spectral signals may be cleaner than single-layer attention, but this remains incremental MLLM pruning work.

paper.title: Towards Fast and Effective Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Adaptive Quasi-Gaussian Sampling
paper.abstract: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for \emph{Multimodal Large Language Models} (MLLMs) due to the excessive computation and memory footprint. Thus, \emph{keyframe selection} is often adopted to mitigate this shortcoming, which however still suffers from low flexibility and high noise due to its hard sampling principle. In this paper, we define video frame selection as a problem of \emph{Quasi-Gaussian Sampling}, and propose an adaptive and training-free approach termed \textbf

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频 MLLM 推理中帧数过多导致的计算和显存开销问题，同时避免硬关键帧选择带来的噪声和不灵活。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理侧效率方法。它不改变 MLLM 预训练目标，但对长视频多模态系统如何做输入压缩有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdaQ，将视频帧选择建模为 Quasi-Gaussian Sampling；借鉴 Gaussian 3-sigma 规则，为局部查询使用较小采样区间，为全局查询使用较大采样区间，从而自适应地选择帧。
summary.experiments: 论文将 AdaQ 应用于 4 个 MLLM 和 3 个 embedding model。摘要称相对默认 MLLM 和已有采样方法有明显性能收益，但未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the compute and memory cost of long-video MLLM inference while reducing the rigidity and noise introduced by hard keyframe selection.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference-efficiency method. It does not modify multimodal pretraining, but it is relevant to input compression and video-token budgeting in long-video MLLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaQ formulates frame selection as Quasi-Gaussian Sampling. Inspired by the Gaussian 3-sigma rule, it adapts the sampling interval: narrower for local queries and wider for global queries.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four MLLMs with three embedding models. The abstract reports clear gains over default MLLM inference and prior sampling baselines, but does not provide exact model sizes, datasets, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；它是输入预算启发，不是多模态预训练信号的改进。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations only; this is an input-budgeting trick, not a change to multimodal pretraining signals.

paper.title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Hybrid reasoning models can answer directly or spend extra tokens on extended thinking. A practical router should choose between these modes for each query, so easy problems avoid unnecessary reasoning and hard problems receive enough budget to finish the answer. Existing routers move in this direction, but they typically require labeled training data or fix thinking budgets up front, ignoring answer-level evidence from the model itself. We introduce DART, a training-free routing framework that

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 hybrid reasoning model 的推理预算分配问题：简单问题不应总是进入长思考模式，困难问题又需要足够预算完成推理和最终答案。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理与服务策略，不是预训练方法。它对基座研究的启发在于模型自身生成的短答案一致性可以作为难度和置信度信号。相比训练一个 router，DART 使用 NoThink draft 的一致性做决策，降低了对标注难度数据、模型特定微调和闭源接口权限的依赖。它也提醒评测 reasoning model 时要区分思考 trace 和最终答案的截断问题，否则 always-thinking baseline 可能被生成上限低估。
summary.technical_approach: DART 是一个无训练的两阶段路由框架。第一阶段 SC-Route 对同一问题采样 K 个 NoThink draft，论文主设定使用 K=2。系统先抽取每个 draft 的答案，再用任务相关的 equivalence function 判断是否等价。如果两个 draft 的答案一致，就直接接受 NoThink 答案；如果不一致，则认为该问题需要 Think 模式。第二阶段只作用于 disagreement cases：当模型提供 token log-probability 和可控 thinking budget 时，DART 用 draft entropy 预测查询级预算，把更多 token 分给不确定性更高的问题。这个设计的取舍很明确：Stage 1 只依赖文本输出，适合 API-only 模型；Stage 2 能进一步省 token，但需要更强的接口能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在 Qwen3 8B 到 32B 以及 DeepSeek-V3.2 上评估。作者报告，在主要比较中，DART 的准确率通常可以持平或超过 always-thinking，同时减少 thinking token。数学任务上，DART 在部分设置中相对 always-thinking 最高提升 9.0 个百分点，并减少 15% 到 69% 的 thinking token。代码任务中，在 execution-based equivalence 下，最高提升 22.5 个百分点，并减少 51% 到 63% 的 thinking token。监督 router 诊断实验显示，draft unanimity 比 entropy 或 draft length 更能预测 always-thinking 是否会答对。论文还指出，单次调用中把 reasoning trace 和 final answer 放在同一个生成上限下，会让 always-thinking 因答案未完整输出而被低估，附录 C 专门量化了这一评测伪差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分的 Algorithm 1、SC-Route 的 K=2 unanimity 设计、answer extraction 与 equivalence function 的定义。实验部分重点看 token saving 与 accuracy 的 trade-off 表，以及数学和代码任务中 DART 相对 always-thinking 的结果。附录 C 值得快速看，因为它涉及 reasoning model 评测协议：如果思考和答案共享同一个 generation cap，结论可能混入截断效应。若关心 serving，可进一步看 Stage 2 的 entropy-to-budget 映射；若只关心 API 可用方案，Stage 1 已经是主要贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies adaptive inference for hybrid reasoning models: the system should answer easy queries directly, while allocating enough thinking budget to queries that genuinely need extended reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-time routing paper, not a pretraining contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is the use of the model’s own short no-think drafts as a difficulty signal. DART avoids labeled difficulty data and model-specific router training, and it works with text-only APIs for its first stage. The paper also makes a useful evaluation point: always-thinking baselines can be underestimated when the reasoning trace and final answer share a tight generation cap.
summary_en.technical_approach: DART has two stages. Stage 1, SC-Route, samples K no-think drafts for the same query, with K=2 as the main setting. It extracts the answer from each draft and checks agreement using a task-specific equivalence function. If the drafts unanimously agree, DART accepts the direct answer. If they disagree, the query is routed to Think mode. Stage 2 applies only to routed queries. When log probabilities and budget controls are available, DART maps draft entropy to a query-specific thinking budget, giving more tokens to higher-uncertainty cases. The design separates a broadly usable text-only routing signal from an optional budget-allocation module that requires richer model access.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates DART on Qwen3 models from 8B to 32B and on DeepSeek-V3.2. In the main reported comparisons, DART often matches or exceeds always-thinking accuracy while using fewer thinking tokens. On math tasks, the best reported point estimate is a 9.0-point accuracy gain with 15% to 69% fewer thinking tokens. On code tasks, using execution-based answer equivalence, the reported gain reaches 22.5 points with 51% to 63% fewer thinking tokens. A supervised-router diagnostic finds that draft unanimity is more predictive than entropy or draft length. The paper also analyzes a truncation artifact in single-call evaluations, where extended reasoning can consume the generation cap before the final answer is emitted.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Read Algorithm 1 and the SC-Route section first, especially the strict unanimity rule, answer extraction, and equivalence checking. Then inspect the main accuracy-versus-token tables for math and code. Appendix C is useful for anyone evaluating reasoning models, because it explains how a shared generation cap can distort always-thinking baselines. For deployment use, focus on the entropy-to-budget mapping in Stage 2. For API-only use, Stage 1 is the central mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 这是干净的 test-time budget heuristic；先看 draft agreement 失败样例，若鲁棒可直接进内部 serving ablation。
recommendation.en: This is a clean test-time budget heuristic; read the draft-disagreement failure cases first, and if robust, it belongs in an internal serving ablation.

paper.title: HyperQuant: A Rate-Distortion-Optimal Quantization Pipeline for Large Language and Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We present HyperQuant (Hadamard, optimallY Packing, Entropy Rice-coding), a unified post-training quantization pipeline for the weights and the KV cache of large language and diffusion transformers. Across a suite of self-contained experiments (Table 1), HyperQuant outperforms the recent HIGGS scheme at every operating point from 3 to 5 bits per scalar (bps) on weights, and beats both TurboQuant and OCTOPUS on KV quantization down to 1.7 bps. Beyond the LLM setting, HyperQuant quantizes the 19B-

summary.core_problem: 现有覆盖LLM、扩散Transformer的训练后量化方案（权重量化+KV缓存量化）普遍采用固定码率码本，未充分利用熵编码的压缩潜力，同时低比特下KV缓存的内积估计存在系统性偏差，缺乏无数据依赖、适配硬件计算指令、达到最优率失真权衡的统一量化流水线。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的HyperQuant是工程完成度较高的无数据训练后量化方案，在3-5比特权重量化、1.7-3比特KV缓存量化区间性能超过此前公开方案，同时统一支持自回归LLM和DiT结构的视频扩散模型，对推理部署有直接工程参考价值；其对量化率失真差距的量化分解、格点量化加熵编码的组合设计，也为后续量化方案优化提供了清晰的对比基线。
summary.technical_approach: HyperQuant将四个成熟信号处理组件按率失真最优原则组装为统一流水线：1）按硬件MMA计算块和格点维度做分块随机哈达玛变换，将权重和KV向量的分布转为近似高斯，变换可折叠进前序RMSNorm/LayerNorm操作，无额外运行时开销；2）采用低维最优格点（E8/D4/A2）做向量量化，消除有限大小Lloyd码本存在的码本外误差；3）剥离格点成员身份可确定的冗余比特，对量化索引用适配高斯分布的Rice编码做熵编码，实际码率与目标码率偏差在0.01bps以内；4）针对KV缓存设计偏差校正选项，包括±1随机旋转、量化Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换和减性抖动，证明减性格点抖动可保证单向量级别的内积估计无偏，而非仅分布平均无偏。
summary.experiments: 在Llama-3.1-8B上，3-5bps权重量化全区间性能超过此前的HIGGS方案，4bps下实现权重压缩3.9倍、KV缓存压缩3.79倍，精度接近无损；KV缓存量化在1.7bps下性能超过TurboQuant和OCTOPUS；同一条流水线应用于19B参数的LTX-2视频DiT模型，4bps下权重压缩3.7倍，无可见逐帧画质损失。消融实验拆解了与HIGGS的性能差距来源：约2/3来自固定码率的索引冗余（任何熵编码改造都可回收这部分收益），约1/3来自无限格点码本相对有限Lloyd码本的结构优势；E8格点相对低维格点在3bps下可带来0.53PPL的额外增益，4bps以上增益可忽略。KV缓存量化存在两个清晰的质量区间：≥2.5bps时所有偏差校正变体的PPL与fp16差距在0.04以内，1.7-2.5bps区间QJL风格旋转可带来最高0.5PPL的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 从事推理优化和部署的读者可精读，预训练方向读者泛读即可。重点关注第6章的率失真差距分解、KV缓存两档质量区间的结论，以及格点量化加熵编码的核心设计思路，不需要过度纠结具体硬件适配细节，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) pipelines for LLMs and diffusion Transformers (covering both weight and KV cache quantization) rely on fixed-rate codebooks, leaving entropy coding compression potential untapped. Low-bit KV cache quantization also suffers from systematic inner product estimation bias, and no unified, data-free, hardware-aligned pipeline exists that achieves optimal rate-distortion tradeoffs across both autoregressive and diffusion model families.
summary_en.importance: HyperQuant is a production-ready, data-free PTQ pipeline that outperforms prior open schemes across the 3-5 bps weight quantization and 1.7-3 bps KV cache quantization regimes, with unified support for both LLMs and DiT-based video diffusion models, delivering direct practical value for inference deployment. Its explicit decomposition of quantization rate-distortion gaps, and the combined lattice quantization + entropy coding design, set a clear baseline for future quantization optimization work.
summary_en.technical_approach: HyperQuant assembles four established signal processing components into a rate-distortion optimal unified pipeline: 1) Tile-wise Randomized Hadamard Transform aligned to hardware MMA tile sizes and lattice dimensions, transforming weight and KV vector distributions to approximate Gaussian, with transforms foldable into preceding RMSNorm/LayerNorm operations for zero runtime overhead; 2) Vector quantization with optimal low-dimensional lattices (E8/D4/A2), eliminating out-of-codebook error present in finite-size Lloyd codebooks; 3) Bit-stripping of redundant bits deterministically fixed by lattice membership, followed by Rice coding of quantization indices calibrated to per-tile Gaussian distributions, achieving actual bitrates within 0.01 bps of target values; 4) KV cache bias correction options including ±1 random rotation, quantized Johnson-Lindenstrauss transform, and subtractive dither, with formal proof that subtractive lattice dither guarantees per-vector inner product unbiasedness rather than only distribution-average unbiasedness.
summary_en.experiments: On Llama-3.1-8B, HyperQuant outperforms the prior leading scheme HIGGS across all 3-5 bps weight operating points, achieving ~3.9x weight compression and ~3.79x KV cache compression at 4 bps with near-lossless quality. KV cache quantization outperforms TurboQuant and OCTOPUS down to 1.7 bps. The same pipeline applied to the 19B-parameter LTX-2 video DiT delivers 3.7x weight compression at 4 bps with no observable per-frame artifacts. Ablations decompose the performance gap to HIGGS: ~2/3 comes from fixed-rate index redundancy recoverable via entropy coding, ~1/3 comes from the structural advantage of unbounded lattice codebooks over finite Lloyd codebooks; E8 lattices deliver an additional 0.53 PPL gain at 3 bps with negligible gains above 4 bps. KV cache quantization shows two clear regimes: ≥2.5 bps where all bias correction variants are within 0.04 PPL of fp16, and 1.7-2.5 bps where QJL-style rotation delivers up to 0.5 PPL advantage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Readers focused on inference optimization and deployment can read in full; pretraining researchers may skim. Focus on the rate-distortion gap decomposition in Section 6, the two-regime characterization of KV cache quantization quality, and the core lattice quantization + entropy coding design. Hardware-specific implementation details can be skipped for readers not focused on serving systems. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是新数学，但把 Hadamard、lattice 和熵编码拼得很工程化；只看 Table 1 和 H100 端到端段落即可。
recommendation.en: The math is not new, but the Hadamard-lattice-entropy stack looks engineered well; read Table 1 and the H100 end-to-end section.

paper.title: On the Expressive Power of Weight Quantization in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: In recent years, weight quantization that encodes the learnable parameters of large language models in an $n$-bit format has garnered significant attention due to its potential for model compression and inference acceleration. Many practical techniques have been developed; however, the theoretical understanding of many aspects, especially the approximation and degradation of expressive power as the number of quantization bits decreases, remains unclear. In this paper, we provide a theoretical in

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM权重量化实践进展快，但缺乏不同比特数下模型表达能力的系统理论刻画，通用近似能力、比特降低时的表达退化规律、量化极限精度三个核心问题无明确答案。
summary.importance: 从理论层面确认1.58-bit（三值）是权重量化的精度下限，为预训练后量化方案选型、低比特预训练的可行性判断提供了理论依据，也能解释当前1-bit量化效果劣化、1.58-bit可对齐全精度性能的实践现象。
summary.technical_approach: 拆解Transformer的注意力和MLP核心模块，基于泛函分析的通用近似定理分情形推导：对n>1位的量化权重，只要MLP宽度不超过H+M+O(||x||∞)，量化LLM可在紧集连续函数空间稠密，具备通用近似能力；对n=1的二值权重，存在无法被任意近似的反例函数，由此推导log2(3)≈1.58-bit（三值权重）为量化极限精度。
summary.experiments: 该工作为纯理论研究，无实证实验。核心产出为两组形式化证明：一是n>1位量化LLM满足通用近似的架构约束，二是1-bit量化存在表达坍缩的反例，结论与微软1.58-bit量化的已有实践结果吻合。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1节的三个核心问题定义、核心结论定理1、极限精度推导段落，跳过复杂数学证明细节，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Practical LLM weight quantization has advanced rapidly, but systematic theoretical characterizations of expressive power across bit widths remain missing, including universal approximation guarantees, degradation patterns as bit count drops, and the fundamental lower precision limit.
summary_en.importance: It theoretically confirms 1.58-bit (ternary) as the lower precision bound of weight quantization, providing a formal basis for post-training quantization recipe selection and low-bit pretraining feasibility analysis. It also explains the empirical gap between 1-bit quantization performance degradation and 1.58-bit quantization alignment with full-precision model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work decomposes Transformer into attention and MLP modules, and derives expressive power properties via the universal approximation theorem in functional analysis. For n>1-bit weights, quantized LLMs with MLP width bounded by H+M+O(||x||∞) are dense in the continuous function space over compact sets, satisfying universal approximation. For n=1 (binary) weights, counterexample functions exist that cannot be approximated arbitrarily well, leading to the conclusion that log2(3) ≈ 1.58-bit (ternary weights) is the limiting precision.
summary_en.experiments: This is a purely theoretical work with no empirical experiments. Core outputs are two formal proofs: one for the universal approximation condition of n>1-bit quantized LLMs, and one for the expressive collapse counterexample of 1-bit quantization. The conclusion aligns with existing empirical results from Microsoft's 1.58-bit quantization work.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 for the three core research questions, Theorem 1 for the core conclusion, and the limiting precision derivation section. Skip dense mathematical proof details. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 权重量化的理论边界分析，重点看§3的1.58-bit极限证明和§4的表达退化上界，可作为量化感知预训练的理论参考。
recommendation.en: Theoretical boundary analysis of weight quantization; focus on §3 1.58-bit limit proof and §4 expressive degradation upper bound as a reference for quantization-aware pretraining.

paper.title: Spatial-Aware Reduction Framework: Towards Efficient and Faithful Visual State Space Models
paper.abstract: Mamba demonstrates strong efficiency in modeling long visual sequences. However, when token reduction is applied to structurally enhanced Mamba variants, these models exhibit a severe performance collapse. We attribute this degradation to the spatially agnostic nature of existing reduction methods, which violate the two-dimensional structural premise required by the selective scanning mechanism. In this work, we propose STORM, a spatial-aware token reduction framework designed to maintain struct

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉Mamba等结构增强型SSM在应用现有token reduction方法时，因 reduction 破坏2D空间结构导致的严重性能崩溃问题
summary.importance: 视觉SSM效率领域的方法改进，首次指出token reduction的空间无关性是破坏SSM选择性扫描结构前提的核心原因，结论可迁移至LLM长上下文token pruning
summary.technical_approach: 提出STORM空间感知token reduction框架，将reduction重构为空间单元上的结构化操作，施加局部约束保留网格拓扑与邻域一致性，是即插即用的无训练模块，可适配现有reduction pipeline
summary.experiments: 在多种视觉Mamba backbone上的无训练剪枝任务中取得SOTA精度，未披露具体参数量，无LLM相关实验

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses severe performance collapse of structurally enhanced visual SSMs (e.g., Vision Mamba) when applying existing token reduction methods, which destroy the 2D spatial structure required by the selective scanning mechanism
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement in visual SSM efficiency; first identifies that spatial-agnostic token reduction violates SSMs' structural inductive bias, with conclusions transferable to LLM long-context token pruning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes STORM, a plug-and-play training-free framework that reformulates token reduction as structured operations on spatial units, enforcing localized constraints to preserve grid topology and neighborhood coherence for existing reduction pipelines
summary_en.experiments: Achieves state-of-the-art pruning accuracy across diverse Vision Mamba backbones under training-free settings; no explicit parameter scale or LLM-related experiments reported

recommendation.zh: 核心结论（token reduction需匹配模型结构归纳偏置）可参考，仅看摘要和Fig1的性能对比即可，无需读全文
recommendation.en: Core conclusion (token reduction must align with model structural inductive bias) is referenceable; only read abstract and Figure 1, skip full text

paper.title: Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR): Function-Preserving SVD Compression for LLMs
paper.abstract: We present Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR), an SVD-based LLM compression framework that guides each weight matrix's low-rank approximation with a backward-signal influence metric. Starting from the activation-aware optimum of SVD-LLM(W), AIR runs a single closed-form alternating least squares (ALS) sweep that integrates influence element-wise under a monotone-descent guarantee. AIR is layer-local and composes orthogonally with end-to-end methods: alone it exceeds ACIP, and AIR+LoRA o

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但长期存在的压缩问题：SVD 类低秩压缩很便宜，也天然适合 Transformer 线性层，但标准 SVD 只最小化权重矩阵的重构误差，SVD-LLM(W) 这类方法虽然进一步引入了 activation-aware profiling，能保住前向表示，却仍然不知道“哪些权重误差真的会影响最终预测”。已有 backward-signal 方法要么效果不如 activation-only 基线，要么需要端到端优化，代价高、工程复杂。AIR 要解决的核心点，是在保持 layer-local、闭式、低成本的前提下，把逐元素的后向影响信号真正整合进低秩近似，而不是只把 backward signal 当作一个粗糙权重或额外启发式。
summary.importance: 对大模型研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在于它把“函数保持型压缩”往前推进了一步：一方面说明 activation-aware 已经不够，压缩时需要区分哪些残差会传到输出端；另一方面也说明 backward information 并不一定需要 critic-like 的全局优化或复杂蒸馏，局部闭式更新也能吃到这部分收益。对基座研究员更有启发的是方法论：很多压缩、剪枝、量化问题里，前向统计和后向影响往往都重要，关键不是有没有 backward signal，而是如何把它嵌入一个可解、稳定、可扩展的目标。AIR 给出的答案是把 influence 作为逐元素加权残差引入，再用 rank-wise ALS 近似求解。这种设计对后续做 low-rank adaptation、结构化压缩、甚至训练期正则化都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三层。第一层是沿用 SVD-LLM(W) 的 activation profiling。作者先用校准集收集隐藏状态 X，通过 profiling 矩阵 S 把原始权重 W 映射到 latent space，得到 W' = WS 一类的变换，使得原本的输出误差 ||WX - W_k X||_F^2 可以转成对 profiled weight 的近似问题。这样 activation-aware 目标仍然保留了 SVD 的可处理性。

第二层是 backward influence 的构造。作者不限定唯一信号，而是接受一类逐元素影响分数 I，包括 Weight×Gradient、对角 Fisher、以及 LRP/AttnLRP。默认实现用 AttnLRP，理由是它不依赖梯度回传规则，且对近零激活更稳。具体做法是对每个样本得到逐层 relevance 矩阵，再在校准集上累加绝对值，并做层内均值归一化。这里一个重要实验结论是：在 AIR 的更新机制下，具体选哪种“合理的” backward signal 差别不大，真正决定效果的是整合机制本身。

第三层是核心创新：把 influence 以逐元素加权的方式并入 activation-aware 目标。作者定义混合损失，大意是对 profiled residual 的每个元素乘上 sqrt(1 + delta * I_ij)。这个 all-ones anchor 很关键，它避免低影响位置被“打折”到几乎不管，只是在高影响位置额外提高误差代价。问题在于，带逐元素权重的低秩逼近一般没有标准 SVD 闭式解。AIR 的处理是：先用 SVD(W', k) 作为初始化，再做一次 rank-wise 的 alternating least squares sweep，从后往前更新每个 rank-1 分量 (sigma_r, u_r, v_r)。作者给出了闭式更新，并证明单步是 monotone descent。逆序更新的动机也很明确：先修正尾部成分，尽量少扰动前几个主奇异方向。

从设计取舍看，AIR 明显是在 ACIP 和 SVD-LLM 之间找平衡。它不像 ACIP 那样做端到端优化，也不需要 LoRA 式额外训练才能起效；但又比纯 activation-aware 多了一层函数敏感性。作者还展示了 AIR 与 LoRA 微调是正交可叠加的，说明它更像一个高质量初始化或局部压缩器，而不是完整替代 end-to-end reconstruction。
summary.experiments:
实验主线比较清楚。核心结果是在 LLaMA-7B 上，不同保留率下 AIR 相比 SVD-LLM(W) 的 WikiText-2 perplexity 明显更低：在 60% / 40% / 20% 参数保留率时，困惑度分别降低约 18% / 33% / 45%。这说明压缩越激进，逐元素 influence weighting 的收益越大，因为误差预算更紧，残差该放在哪些位置变得更重要。

数据效率也是一个亮点。作者报告 AIR 在大致相同质量下只需要约 10% 的 calibration data，就能匹配 SVD-LLM(W) 的效果，也就是校准数据需求下降约 90%。这点很实用，因为很多后训练压缩流程真正卡的不是算法，而是拿不到足够代表性的校准集。

泛化方面，方法不只在 LLaMA-7B 上有效，也覆盖了 LLaMA、Mistral、Vicuna 等家族。说明它并不依赖某个特定模型的奇异值谱形态。消融里有几个值得注意的结论：第一，合理的 backward signal 之间差异很小，LRP-epsilon、Weight×Gradient、Fisher 在 AIR 框架下几乎等价；第二，若换成无信息或弱信息的 influence baseline，性能会明显掉下去，说明 backward signal 仍然要有基本质量；第三，all-ones anchor 和 delta 的设置会影响稳定性，纯 influence-only 的加权不如 activation + influence 的混合目标稳。

系统指标上，作者给了部署层面的数字：在 40GB A100 上，60% 参数保留率可带来约 64% 的 peak memory 和 53% 的 per-token latency，相当于参数节省确实转化成了实际推理收益，而不是只停留在理论压缩率。另一个重要结果是 AIR + LoRA 在各压缩率下都优于 ACIP，说明 layer-local 压缩和轻量端到端补偿是互补的。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议抓三部分。

第一，看方法部分里 hybrid objective 的定义，以及为什么 element-wise weighted low-rank approximation 不能直接用标准 SVD 解。这里是整篇文章最核心的数学动机。若只看结论，很容易误以为 AIR 只是“给 SVD 加了个 backward 权重”，但真正有效的是后面的 rank-wise ALS 近似求解。

第二，看 ALS 更新的推导和更新顺序。重点不是把公式逐行抄下来，而是理解两个设计：为什么从 SVD-LLM(W) 的 activation-aware optimum 出发；为什么按 rank 从后往前扫一遍就够。这里能看出作者在效果、复杂度、稳定性之间的平衡。

第三，看消融表和 Figure 3 一类分析图。建议重点确认三件事：不同 influence signal 是否真的接近等效；all-ones anchor 是否必要；校准数据量缩小时 AIR 的退化曲线是否更缓。若只想快速判断是否值得复现，这几张图比主表更有信息量。

这篇适合 30 到 45 分钟泛读。若你做的是压缩、低秩适配、训练后结构化优化，可以再花时间看附录里关于 LRP 和 weighted objective 的推导。

summary_en.core_problem: AIR addresses a specific weakness of SVD-based LLM compression. Plain SVD is cheap and structurally aligned with transformer linear layers, but it only minimizes matrix reconstruction error. Activation-aware variants such as SVD-LLM(W) preserve forward activations better, yet they still do not distinguish which approximation errors actually matter for the final prediction. Prior backward-signal methods either underperform activation-only baselines or rely on expensive end-to-end optimization. The paper asks whether one can inject backward functional importance into low-rank compression while keeping the procedure layer-local, closed-form, and lightweight.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a new pretraining method, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it sharpens the notion of function-preserving compression. The paper shows that forward statistics alone are not enough once compression becomes aggressive; one also needs a notion of output-side sensitivity. More importantly, it shows that backward information does not have to be consumed through full reconstruction training or global fine-tuning. A carefully designed local objective plus a simple solver can already recover much of the benefit. That design pattern is useful beyond post-training compression: it is relevant to pruning, low-rank adaptation, structured regularization, and any setting where forward usage and backward influence need to be balanced.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components.

First, AIR inherits the activation-aware profiling step from SVD-LLM(W). Hidden states X are collected on a calibration set, and a profiling matrix S is used to transform the weight matrix into a latent space, so the activation reconstruction objective becomes a low-rank approximation problem on the profiled weight W'. This preserves the computational convenience of SVD while making the objective more aligned with actual layer inputs.

Second, AIR constructs an element-wise influence matrix I from backward information. The framework is agnostic to the exact signal: Weight×Gradient, diagonal Fisher, and LRP-style relevance are all allowed. The default choice is AttnLRP, motivated by gradient-free propagation rules and better robustness around near-zero activations. Per-sample relevance maps are accumulated in absolute value over the calibration set and normalized to unit mean per layer. One of the paper’s useful findings is that, once AIR’s integration mechanism is used, the exact choice among reasonable backward signals matters much less than how the signal is incorporated.

Third, AIR defines a hybrid activation-and-influence-aware objective. Each element of the profiled residual is weighted by a factor of the form sqrt(1 + delta * I_ij). The additive all-ones anchor is important: low-influence entries are not discounted away; high-influence entries simply become more expensive to approximate poorly. This leads to an element-wise weighted low-rank approximation problem, which in general has no standard SVD closed-form solution. AIR therefore starts from the activation-aware optimum SVD(W', k), then performs a single rank-wise alternating least squares sweep. Each rank-1 component is updated in closed form, and the updates are ordered from the tail components toward the leading ones to avoid disturbing the dominant singular directions too much. The paper also provides a monotone-descent guarantee for this sweep.

Conceptually, AIR sits between SVD-LLM and ACIP. It is much cheaper and more local than end-to-end reconstruction methods, but it is more function-aware than pure activation-based compression. The paper further shows that AIR composes well with LoRA-style end-to-end correction, which makes it look like a strong local compressor or initializer rather than a replacement for all downstream reconstruction.
summary_en.experiments:
