The main empirical result is on LLaMA-7B. At 60%, 40%, and 20% parameter retention, AIR reduces WikiText-2 perplexity relative to SVD-LLM(W) by about 18%, 33%, and 45%, respectively. The gain grows as compression becomes more aggressive, which is exactly where better allocation of approximation error should matter most.

Calibration efficiency is another strong point. AIR reportedly matches the quality of SVD-LLM(W) with roughly 90% less calibration data. That matters in practice because many post-training compression pipelines are bottlenecked by representative calibration data rather than by solver cost.

The method is also tested across multiple model families, including LLaMA, Mistral, and Vicuna, suggesting that the effect is not tied to one specific singular-value profile. The ablations are informative. Reasonable backward signals such as LRP-epsilon, Weight×Gradient, and Fisher become nearly equivalent under AIR’s update rule, while weak or uninformative signals perform worse. The additive anchor and the influence strength delta also matter: a pure influence-only weighting is less stable than the hybrid activation-plus-influence objective.

On system metrics, the paper reports that at 60% retention on a 40GB A100, the compressed model achieves about 64% peak-memory usage and 53% per-token latency relative to the original, indicating that parameter savings translate into actual inference gains. AIR combined with LoRA also outperforms ACIP across retention rates, supporting the claim that local compression and lightweight end-to-end correction are complementary.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts.

First, read the definition of the hybrid objective and the discussion of why element-wise weighted low-rank approximation cannot be solved by standard SVD. That is the real mathematical motivation of the paper. Without it, AIR can look like a minor reweighting trick, which would miss the point.

Second, read the derivation of the rank-wise ALS updates and the reverse update order. The key questions are why the method starts from the activation-aware optimum and why a single backward sweep over rank components is enough. This is where the paper’s balance between quality, cost, and stability becomes clear.

Third, inspect the ablations and analysis figures, especially the ones testing signal choice, the all-ones anchor, and reduced calibration data. Those sections are more informative than the headline table if the goal is to decide whether the method is robust enough to reproduce.

This is a 30–45 minute skim for someone already familiar with SVD-LLM and post-training compression. If your work touches low-rank adaptation or function-preserving model surgery, the appendix on LRP and the weighted objective is worth extra time.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和校准数据消融即可；它不会改变压缩范式，但 influence 信号可能是低秩剪裁的好特征。
recommendation.en: Read the method and calibration-data ablation; it will not change the compression paradigm, but influence is a useful feature for low-rank pruning.

paper.title: Pruning via Causal Attribution Preserves Reasoning Performance in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning but incur substantial inference cost. We introduce Causal Attribution Pruning (CAP), a training-free method that identifies critical attention heads by measuring their causal impact on reasoning tasks and uses these head-level scores to guide fine-grained weight pruning. For each attention head, CAP estimates the expected performance degradation when the head is masked during forward passes on a small calibration set of reasoning problem

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想在不训练的前提下，对 LLM 做更保留推理能力的稀疏剪枝，降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 它属于推理效率方向的实用改进：不是预训练方法创新，但对理解“哪些头真正支撑 reasoning”有一点启发。贡献类型是训练后压缩方法，而非基座训练范式变化。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Causal Attribution Pruning（CAP）。核心做法是：在一个小型 reasoning 校准集上，逐个遮蔽 attention head，测量该 head 被干预后对任务性能的期望下降，把这个因果归因分数映射为对应投影矩阵的权重重要性，再据此做细粒度剪枝。相比只看权重大小或激活统计，CAP 直接用干预式指标估计功能贡献。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct，在 GSM8K、StrategyQA、ARC-Challenge 上测试 10%、20%、50% 稀疏率。摘要声称在 20% sparsity、ARC-Challenge 上相对 Wanda 有最高 61% 的准确率增益。整体看是中等规模、后训练压缩设定，结论更像特定任务上的保真剪枝，而不是通用预训练 insight。

summary_en.core_problem: This work aims to prune LLMs in a training-free way while preserving reasoning performance better, thereby reducing inference cost.
summary_en.importance: It is a practical efficiency paper rather than a pretraining contribution. The main value for a foundation-model researcher is limited but nonzero: it offers some signal about which attention heads matter for reasoning under intervention.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Causal Attribution Pruning (CAP). On a small reasoning calibration set, it masks each attention head and measures the expected performance drop caused by the intervention. These causal attribution scores are then converted into weight-level importance values for the corresponding projection matrices, enabling fine-grained pruning. Unlike magnitude- or activation-based criteria, CAP uses interventional estimates of functional contribution.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct on GSM8K, StrategyQA, and ARC-Challenge at 10%, 20%, and 50% sparsity. The abstract reports up to 61% relative accuracy gain over Wanda on ARC-Challenge at 20% sparsity. This is a moderate-scale post-training compression setup, more about preserving reasoning under pruning than about core pretraining insights.

recommendation.zh: 偏部署侧，和 pretrain 关系不深；只需看 head-level causal attribution 这一步，若你在做结构稀疏或机制分析，可拿来当一个更干净的重要性度量。
recommendation.en: Mostly an inference-side paper; only the head-level causal attribution is worth a look if you work on structured sparsity or mechanistic importance measures.

paper.title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
paper.abstract: LLM serving exhibits extreme length variability, making size-based scheduling difficult in practice. Recent LLM schedulers approximate SJF/SRPT using predicted decode lengths or ranks and primarily report mean-centric metrics such as TTFT and TBT. We show that these prediction-driven policies can be fragile under distribution shifts, bursty arrivals, and GPU memory pressure, while offering limited control over the tail latency (P90-P99) that dominates user experience, even with perfect decode-le

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 LLM 在线推理调度中的尾延迟问题。现有系统常用输出长度预测来近似 SJF 或 SRPT，以降低平均响应时间。但 reasoning workload 的 decode 长度高度不稳定，分布会随时间和请求类型变化，预测驱动策略在 bursty arrival、分布漂移和 GPU KV cache 压力下容易失效，也很难直接控制 P90 到 P99 的 TTLT。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练的关系偏系统侧，但对研究有现实意义：reasoning model 的生成长度、KV cache 占用和用户可见延迟正在成为模型训练目标之外的约束。若 posttrain 鼓励更长链路推理，serving 层就需要更稳健的调度策略。该工作强调不要只围绕平均 TTFT/TBT 优化，也不要假设 decode length 可可靠预测；这对设计推理模型的训练预算、长度控制和部署评测都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法用 distribution-aware boosting 替代显式长度预测。它以 FCFS 为基线，对请求计算连续的 soft boost，再按 arrival time minus boost 排序。boost 来自轻量可观测信号，例如已解码 token 数、历史请求延迟分布等，而不是预测最终 decode 长度或剩余长度。这样的策略避免了硬性的短作业优先排序，在部分可观测和分布漂移下更稳。LLM serving 的特殊难点是 KV cache 让调度和内存强耦合：抢占、换出和重算会影响 TTLT。为此，方法把 boost-based scheduling 和 cache-aware preemption / eviction 联合设计，避免为了降低排队时间而造成 KV cache thrashing。
summary.experiments: 可见内容报告了多种异构 workload 下的实验，包括 decode 长度长尾、bursty arrivals、predictor 质量下降和分布漂移场景。指标关注 tail TTLT、吞吐 tokens/s，以及 TTFT/TBT 等交互延迟。结果主张是：相比 prediction-heavy 的 SRPT 近似，distribution-aware 且 eviction-conscious 的调度在 P90/P99 TTLT 和吞吐上更稳定，尤其在预测器退化或 workload 变化时优势更明显。当前提供内容未包含完整结果表，因此不宜补充具体提升百分比。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Background，重点理解为什么“完美长度预测也不等于尾延迟可控”。再看 boost policy 的定义，以及它如何从经典 tail-optimal scheduling 改造成适合 LLM serving 的在线策略。系统部分重点看 KV cache eviction 与 preemption 的联合设计。实验部分优先看 P90/P99 TTLT、throughput、predictor degradation、distribution shift 的图表。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Cornell University、Microsoft Azure System Research、NVIDIA。可见内容只显示 Yueying Li 为通讯作者，完整作者列表无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: This work targets tail latency in online LLM inference. Existing schedulers often predict output length or remaining decode length and approximate SJF or SRPT, which is effective for mean latency when size estimates are accurate. In reasoning-heavy workloads, decode length is highly variable, workload distributions shift, and bursty arrivals are common. Under these conditions, prediction-driven scheduling can be fragile and may still provide poor control over P90 to P99 TTLT.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on the serving side, but it matters for model research because reasoning-oriented posttraining changes the length and memory profile of inference. Longer adaptive generation increases KV-cache pressure and makes average-centric metrics less informative. The work argues for deployment-aware evaluation of reasoning models: output-length behavior, tail latency, and cache dynamics should be treated as part of the practical cost of a model, not just as an implementation detail.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed scheduler replaces explicit decode-length prediction with distribution-aware soft priority boosting. It starts from FCFS and assigns each request a smooth boost computed from lightweight observable signals, such as decoded-token progress and historical latency statistics. Requests are then ordered by arrival time minus boost, rather than by predicted final length or remaining length. This avoids hard size-based ranking and is intended to be more robust under partial observability and distribution shift. The system also co-designs scheduling with cache-aware preemption and eviction, since LLM decoding is stateful and memory-coupled. A priority decision that ignores KV-cache capacity can reduce queueing delay but increase TTLT through recomputation and cache thrashing.
summary_en.experiments: The visible content reports experiments across heterogeneous workloads with long-tailed decode lengths, bursty arrivals, degraded predictors, and distribution shifts. The evaluation emphasizes tail TTLT, throughput in tokens per second, and interactive latency metrics such as TTFT and TBT. The reported conclusion is that distribution-aware boosting combined with eviction-aware execution improves tail TTLT and throughput more consistently than prediction-heavy SRPT-style baselines, especially when predictor quality drops or workload distributions change. The supplied text does not include the full result tables, so exact percentage gains are not recoverable here.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the Introduction and Background first to understand why accurate length prediction alone does not solve tail latency. Then focus on the boost-based scheduling rule and how it differs from SJF/SRPT-style ranking. The most important systems detail is the coupling between prioritization, KV-cache eviction, and preemption. In the evaluation, prioritize the plots for P90/P99 TTLT, throughput, predictor degradation, and distribution shift.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations shown in the supplied text include Cornell University, Microsoft Azure System Research, and NVIDIA. Yueying Li is listed as the correspondence contact; the complete author list is not available from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 推理调度方向的扎实工作，尾延迟优化思路对 pretrain 研究员理解 serving 约束反哺训练配置有参考，重点看 §3 优先级设计与 §5 尾延迟分解。
recommendation.en: Solid inference-scheduling work; tail-latency insights inform how serving constraints should feed back into pretraining configs; focus on §3 priority design and §5 tail breakdown.

paper.title: ConSA: Controllable Sparsity in Hybrid Attention via Learnable Allocation
paper.abstract: Hybrid architectures combining full attention (FA) and sliding-window attention (SWA) are a promising paradigm for efficient LLM inference. However, existing methods typically rely on hand-crafted rules or simple post-hoc heuristics for FA/SWA allocation and offer limited analysis of the attention behaviors underlying these designs. We propose Controllable Sparsity in Hybrid Attention (ConSA), a framework that learns optimal FA/SWA assignment under a user-specified sparsity target. ConSA employs

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是混合注意力结构中 FA/SWA 如何分配的问题。已有 Mistral、Gemma 2 一类模型多用手工交错规则，LoZA 一类方法用校准分数再排序，但都很难在给定稀疏率下稳定找到合适的层或头分配。ConSA 把问题改写成带约束的离散结构搜索：在指定 SWA 占比时，学习每个层或 KV-head 应该保留 full attention 还是改成 sliding-window attention。
summary.importance: 对预训练和长上下文模型压缩有直接参考价值。它不是单纯做 inference trick，而是在预训练模型上学习结构稀疏模式，再继续训练固定结构。比较有用的观察是：学习到的结构不是均匀交错，而是底层更多 SWA，中间层集中保留 FA。这提示混合注意力的分配应更多依赖层和头的注意力行为，而不是按固定周期设计。贡献量级偏方法和分析型，适合用于 hybrid attention recipe 的设计参考。
summary.technical_approach: ConSA 为每个注意力单元引入二值变量 z，用来在 FA 和 SWA 之间做硬选择。稀疏率 ρ 定义为被分配到 SWA 的 KV-head 比例。训练时使用 hard concrete 分布和 L0 regularization，使二值 mask 可微近似优化；同时用 augmented Lagrangian 约束目标稀疏率，避免先学连续 gate、再 post-hoc 排序带来的稀疏率漂移和选择不稳定。方法支持两种粒度：layer-wise 把整层分成 FA 或 SWA，KV-head-wise 允许同一层内不同 KV-head 采用不同注意力。流程上先联合优化 mask 参数和模型权重，得到结构后将 mask 二值化并固定，再做 continued pre-training。与手工规则相比，它把结构选择变成显式约束优化；与校准打分方法相比，它直接优化稀疏目标，不依赖小校准集上标量分数的排序可靠性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 0.6B 和 1.7B 两个模型尺度，以及多个目标稀疏率。主要结论是学习式分配稳定优于规则式 hybrid attention baseline，KV-head 粒度优于 layer 粒度。消融显示，L0 + augmented Lagrangian 的约束优化优于无约束 scalar gate 加 post-hoc ranking 的校准式做法。结构分析给出一个较稳定的模式：底层更倾向 SWA，中间层形成连续 FA block；这个模式在不同模型尺度、不同稀疏率、不同分配粒度下都出现。注意力行为分析还显示，不同层和头的 attention spike range 并不能简单归为 retrieval 或 streaming 两类，ConSA 的分配与这些更细粒度的长程依赖行为更一致。给定内容未提供具体 benchmark 分数和提升百分比，精读时需要核对实验表格中的每个稀疏率设置、窗口大小、continued pre-training token 数和长上下文任务结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对手工交错、LoZA 校准式选择的限制分析，再看 Method 中 L0 mask、hard concrete 和 augmented Lagrangian 约束的定义。实验部分重点看三类图表：不同稀疏率下 ConSA 与规则 baseline 的对比，layer-wise 与 KV-head-wise 的差异，学习到的 FA/SWA 分布热图。对预训练研究更有价值的是结构分析部分，尤其是 SWA-bottom / FA-middle 模式，以及它和原模型 intrinsic attention behavior 的对应关系。若要复现，需要额外确认 SWA window size、mask-learning 阶段训练步数、mask 二值化阈值、continued pre-training 数据是否与原预训练分布一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to allocate full attention and sliding-window attention inside a hybrid Transformer. Existing production-style designs often use hand-written interleaving patterns, while calibration methods such as scalar layer scoring can be brittle under different sparsity targets. ConSA turns the allocation problem into constrained structure learning: given a target fraction of SWA units, learn which layers or KV heads should remain full attention.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining-oriented architecture design rather than just serving optimization. It shows that hybrid attention should not be specified only by fixed periodic rules. The learned pattern consistently places SWA in lower layers and concentrates FA in middle-layer blocks. This is a useful design signal for efficient long-context pretraining and continued pretraining recipes. The contribution is mainly methodological and diagnostic: it provides a controllable allocation mechanism and a clearer view of how attention behavior varies across layers and KV heads.
summary_en.technical_approach: ConSA introduces a binary variable for each attention unit, selecting between FA and SWA. The target sparsity is defined as the fraction of KV heads assigned to SWA. During mask learning, the binary decisions are relaxed with a hard-concrete parameterization under L0 regularization, and an augmented Lagrangian term enforces the user-specified sparsity target. The method supports layer-wise allocation and finer KV-head-wise allocation. After jointly optimizing mask parameters and model weights, the masks are binarized and fixed for continued pretraining. Compared with hand-crafted interleaving, ConSA optimizes the allocation directly. Compared with calibration-and-ranking methods, it avoids relying on weak scalar scores and enforces the sparsity constraint during training rather than after training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on 0.6B and 1.7B models across multiple sparsity levels. Learned allocations consistently outperform rule-based baselines, and KV-head-wise allocation gives clearer gains than layer-wise allocation. Ablations indicate that the L0 plus augmented-Lagrangian formulation works better than unconstrained scalar gates followed by post-hoc ranking. The structural analysis finds a stable SWA-bottom / FA-middle pattern across scales, sparsity levels, and granularities. The attention-behavior analysis suggests a richer range of attention spike patterns than a simple retrieval-versus-streaming split, and these patterns align with ConSA’s learned assignments. The provided content does not include exact benchmark numbers or percentage gains, so the experimental tables should be checked for the actual margins, window size, continued-pretraining budget, and long-context evaluation setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for the main idea. Read the Introduction for the critique of manual hybrid patterns and calibration-based selection. Then focus on the Method section for the L0 mask, hard-concrete relaxation, and augmented-Lagrangian constraint. In the experiments, prioritize the allocation heatmaps, the layer-wise versus KV-head-wise comparison, and the results under different sparsity targets. The most useful part for pretraining work is the analysis of the learned FA/SWA pattern and its relation to intrinsic attention behavior. For reproduction, check the SWA window size, mask-learning schedule, binarization rule, continued-pretraining data, and whether the evaluation includes long-context tasks sensitive to global attention.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但把 hybrid attention 从拍脑袋规则改成可学习约束优化，这点很实用；只看 learned pattern 和 head-wise ablation 就够。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it replaces hand-tuned hybrid attention rules with a clean constrained-learning setup; read the learned allocation patterns and head-wise ablations.

paper.title: MODE: Modality-Decomposed Expert-Level Mixed-Precision Quantization for MoE Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Large Language Models (MoE-MLLMs) offer remarkable performance but incur prohibitive GPU memory costs, making compression essential. Among PTQ methods, expert-level mixed-precision quantization has proven effective for MoE-LLMs, yet suffers notable degradation on MoE-MLLMs due to two overlooked biases in expert importance estimation. (1) At the cross-modal level, the numerical dominance of vision tokens causes expert selection frequency to be dominated by vision tok

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 MoE 多模态大模型的后训练量化问题：已有按专家频率分配 bit-width 的混合精度方法在 MoE-MLLM 上失效，原因是视觉 token 数量远多于文本 token，且视觉 token 内部高度冗余，导致专家重要性估计被偏置。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在 MoE-MLLM 的推理压缩和路由统计解释。它指出，MoE 专家重要性不能直接用全 token activation frequency 衡量；在多模态模型中，路由统计会被模态比例和视觉冗余共同扭曲。这个结论对量化、专家裁剪、路由分析、训练时负载均衡指标设计都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: MODE 的核心是 modality-decomposed expert importance。它先把文本 token 和视觉 token 的专家选择频率分开统计并归一化，避免视觉 token 的数量优势掩盖文本关键专家。然后在视觉侧只使用每层的 key vision tokens 估计频率，降低重复视觉 patch 对路由统计的噪声。除频率外，MODE 还分别在文本 token 和关键视觉 token 上测量专家量化敏感度，例如观察低比特量化后输出 logits 的 KL divergence。最终把分模态频率和分模态敏感度合成专家重要性分数，并通过整数线性规划在给定 bit budget 下求每个专家的精度分配。
summary.experiments: 论文在三个 MoE-MLLM 系列、十个多模态 benchmark 上评估多种低比特 weight-only quantization 设置。动机实验使用 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct 和 512 个 ShareGPT4V 图文样本作为校准集，展示全局 activation frequency 会低估文本关键专家，例如某些文本高频专家在总频率中低于层平均。主要结果是 W3A16 下，MODE 在 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct 上平均精度下降 2.84%，在 Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct 上下降 2.08%。相较面向 dense MLLM、MoE-LLM 或通用 MoE-MLLM 的 PTQ 方法，MODE 在低比特下保持更小退化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Motivation 中两类 bias 的可视化：跨模态频率被视觉 token 主导，以及视觉内部冗余导致专家频率虚高。方法部分重点看 importance score 的定义和 ILP 约束，因为这是可迁移到其他 MoE 压缩方法的部分。实验部分主要看 W3A16、W4A16 等不同 bit budget 下的平均退化，以及 key vision token、modality-separated frequency、sensitivity term 的消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets post-training quantization for MoE multimodal LLMs. Existing expert-level mixed-precision quantization methods rely on expert activation frequency, but this proxy becomes biased in MoE-MLLMs because vision tokens dominate token counts and many vision tokens are redundant.
summary_en.importance: The useful insight is that expert importance in multimodal MoE models cannot be read directly from global routing frequency. Routing statistics are shaped by modality imbalance and by redundancy within the visual stream. This has implications beyond PTQ, including expert pruning, router analysis, load-balancing objectives, and how to interpret expert specialization during multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MODE builds a modality-decomposed expert importance estimate. It separately collects and normalizes expert selection frequencies for text and vision tokens, so text-critical experts are not hidden by the much larger number of visual tokens. On the vision side, it further estimates frequency using only layer-wise key vision tokens, filtering out redundant visual patches that would otherwise cast many near-duplicate router votes. Frequency is not the only signal: MODE also measures quantization sensitivity separately for text tokens and key vision tokens, using output-logit changes such as KL divergence after low-bit quantization. These modality-specific frequency and sensitivity signals are combined into an expert importance score, and an integer linear programming formulation assigns per-expert precision under a target bit budget.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers three MoE-MLLM families, ten multimodal benchmarks, and several low-bit weight-only quantization settings. The motivation study uses Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct with 512 ShareGPT4V image-text samples for calibration, showing that global activation frequency can systematically undervalue text-critical experts. For example, experts frequently selected by text tokens may still fall below the layer-average total frequency because visual routing dominates. At W3A16, MODE reports only 2.84% average accuracy degradation on Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and 2.08% on Kimi-VL-A3B-Instruct. It outperforms PTQ baselines designed for dense MLLMs, MoE LLMs, and generic MoE-MLLM settings under comparable low-bit budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Read the motivation figures first: they make the two biases clear, namely cross-modal dominance by vision tokens and intra-vision distortion from redundant patches. In the method section, focus on the importance-score construction and the ILP precision-allocation objective, since these are the parts most likely to transfer to other MoE compression work. In the experiments, check W3A16 and W4A16 regimes, average degradation across benchmarks, and ablations for key vision token selection, modality-separated frequency, and the sensitivity term.

recommendation.zh: 只看专家重要性估计和视觉 token 去冗余 ablation；这个 bias 对 MoE-MMLM 量化和路由监控都有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the expert-importance estimator and visual-token denoising ablations; the bias diagnosis is useful for MoE-MLLM quantization and routing telemetry.

paper.title: Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) web agents are usually deployed as tool callers: each turn, the model reads a fresh page observation and emits one structured tool action. When every action is a low-level primitive, horizons grow quickly and so do policy-facing LLM completions, dominating latency and cost on benchmarks such as Mind2Web and WebArena. Recent systems therefore wrap repeated interaction fragments as web skills: callable tools built from successful trajectories or induced programs, so one

summary.core_problem: 解决现有Web Agent技能库依赖指令/站点元数据匹配，导致跨未见站点技能复用率低、步骤与token开销大的问题
summary.importance: 通用Web Agent方法创新：提出基于页面布局结构匹配的跨站点技能迁移范式，提升技能复用率并降低推理成本
summary.technical_approach: 提出SkillMigrator框架：1）从成功轨迹中诱导出可迁移的交互模式（技能），存储为布局结构-动作的映射；2）跨站点匹配时基于DOM布局结构而非指令语义或站点元数据，触发对应技能执行，替代多步低阶工具调用
summary.experiments: 在Mind2Web、WebArena等Web Agent基准上测试，SkillMigrator的跨站点技能复用率显著高于基于指令/元数据匹配的基线，步骤数与token开销大幅降低

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the low cross-unseen-site skill reuse rate and high step/token cost of existing Web Agent skill libraries relying on instruction/site metadata matching
summary_en.importance: General Web Agent method innovation: proposes a cross-site skill transfer paradigm based on page layout structure matching, improving skill reuse rate and reducing inference cost
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SkillMigrator framework: 1) induces transferable interaction patterns (skills) from successful trajectories, stored as layout structure-action mappings; 2) triggers skills via DOM layout structure matching instead of instruction semantics or site metadata, replacing multi-step low-level tool calls
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Mind2Web, WebArena benchmarks; SkillMigrator achieves significantly higher cross-site skill reuse rate than instruction/metadata matching baselines, with greatly reduced step count and token cost

recommendation.zh: Web Agent技能迁移的增量改进，仅需了解布局结构匹配比语义匹配更适合跨站点技能复用这一结论即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement of Web Agent skill transfer, only need to grasp that layout structure matching outperforms semantic matching for cross-site skill reuse

paper.title: Follow the Latent Roadmap: Navigating Revocable Decoding for Diffusion LLMs with Anchor Tokens
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) offer a promising avenue for parallel generation but face a trade-off between decoding speed and quality. While revocable decoding strategies attempt to mitigate errors by verifying and remasking tokens, they typically operate within a mixed-quality context. This leads to two critical failures: \textit{Error Propagation}, where new tokens absorb toxic information from erroneous context, and \textit{Local Error Reinforcement}, where errors mutually reinforc

summary.core_problem: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的可撤销并行解码通过“生成-验证-重掩码”机制平衡解码速度与质量，但所有操作均在“可靠已确认token+待验证候选token”的混合质量上下文中执行，导致两个关键失效模式：1）错误传播：待生成的掩码token无差别地将所有待验证token视为可靠上下文，吸收其中的错误信息；2）局部错误强化：多个错误待验证token互相支撑形成局部一致的错误簇，逃避验证机制检测。现有可撤销解码方法未对上下文token的可信度做区分，无法针对性解决上述问题。
summary.importance: 提供了训练无关的即插即用dLLM解码增强方案，无需重新训练模型即可提升生成质量，尤其适配数学、代码这类对错误敏感的任务。提出的锚令牌混合上下文处理框架完全在嵌入空间实现，兼容FlashAttention，可迁移至其他非自回归生成范式的解码优化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ASRD（锚监督可撤销解码）框架，所有操作均在嵌入空间执行，兼容FlashAttention，完全训练无关，可即插即用适配现有dLLM。核心组件为动态锚令牌缓存（ATC）：将跨多个解码步骤保持时间一致性（即预测结果稳定不变）的token标记为可信锚令牌，存入缓存形成可信上下文骨架。基于ATC设计两个互补策略：1）锚引导生成：向掩码位置的嵌入注入熵加权的锚信号，降低待验证错误token对新生成token的干扰，缓解错误传播；2）锚扰动验证：使用与锚信号正交的扰动探测待验证token，仅判定那些依赖局部错误簇、不被锚信号支持的token为验证失败，将其重掩码以重新生成，解决局部错误强化。与现有方法的核心区别：现有可撤销解码对所有上下文token一视同仁，ASRD先分离可信锚上下文，再基于锚信号分别引导生成与验证过程。
summary.experiments: 当前公开的论文片段仅明确ASRD为训练无关的即插即用增强模块，适配现有dLLM架构，目标在数学、代码等对错误敏感的生成任务上提升解码质量。完整量化结果（性能提升幅度、速度-质量权衡数据）未包含在提供的全文片段中，需参考原论文完整版本获取详细实验验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction部分对两种失效模式（错误传播、局部错误强化）的定义与示意，再重点阅读方法部分的锚令牌识别逻辑、两个嵌入空间策略的实现细节，尤其关注嵌入空间操作如何兼容FlashAttention、不引入额外计算开销。预计阅读时间25-30分钟，优先查看方法框架示意图。

summary_en.core_problem: Revocable parallel decoding for diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) balances speed and quality via a generate-verify-remask pipeline, but all operations run on mixed-quality contexts interleaving reliable confirmed tokens and tentative candidate tokens. This causes two critical failure modes: (1) Error Propagation, where unmasked [MASK] tokens treat all tentative tokens as reliable context and absorb embedded errors; (2) Local Error Reinforcement, where mutually consistent erroneous tentative tokens form local clusters that evade verification checks. Existing revocable decoding methods treat all context tokens equally, with no mechanism to isolate trusted context to address these failures.
summary_en.importance: Delivers a training-free, plug-and-play decoding enhancement for dLLMs that improves generation quality without retraining, especially suited for error-sensitive tasks like math and coding. The anchor-token framework for handling mixed-quality contexts operates entirely in embedding space, is compatible with FlashAttention, and can be generalized to decoding optimization for other non-autoregressive generation paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ASRD (Anchor Supervised Revocable Decoding), a fully embedding-space framework compatible with FlashAttention, requiring no model retraining and working as a drop-in module for existing dLLMs. The core component is the dynamic Anchor Tokens Cache (ATC): tokens that maintain temporal consistency (stable predictions across multiple decoding steps) are promoted to trusted anchors and stored in the cache to form a reliable context skeleton. Two complementary embedding-level strategies are built on the ATC: (1) Anchor-Guided Generation injects entropy-weighted anchor signals into [MASK] token embeddings to reduce interference from erroneous tentative tokens, mitigating Error Propagation; (2) Anchor-Perturbed Verification probes tentative tokens with an orthogonal anchor-derived perturbation, only revoking tokens that rely on local error clusters rather than anchor-supported global consistency, addressing Local Error Reinforcement. The core difference from prior work is that ASRD first isolates trusted anchor context, instead of applying uniform generation and verification logic across all tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The available paper fragment positions ASRD as a training-free, plug-and-play enhancement for existing dLLMs, targeted at improving performance on error-sensitive generation tasks like math and coding. Full quantitative results (performance gain magnitudes, speed-quality tradeoff metrics) are not included in the provided content; refer to the complete paper for detailed experimental validation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction first to understand the two defined failure modes of revocable dLLM decoding and their illustrative examples. Focus on the method section's anchor token identification logic and implementation details of the two embedding-space strategies, with special attention to how embedding-space operations preserve FlashAttention compatibility without introducing extra compute overhead. Expected reading time: 25-30 minutes; prioritize the method framework diagram.

recommendation.zh: 读 anchor 判定和消融就够；若时间一致性真能隔离可信上下文，dLLM 解码评测应加入这条 baseline。
recommendation.en: Read the anchor selection rule and ablations; if temporal consistency reliably isolates trusted context, this should become a baseline in dLLM decoding evaluations.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: MosaicQuant: Inlier-Outlier Disaggregation for Unified 4-Bit LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: 4-bit quantization significantly reduces the memory footprint and accelerates the inference of large language models (LLMs). However, its limited bit-width representation struggles to faithfully capture both dense common values (\emph{inliers}) and rare large-magnitude values (\emph{outliers}), causing substantial accuracy degradation. Existing mixed-precision methods mitigate this by retaining outliers in high precision, but at the cost of breaking the uniformity of low-bit execution, introduci

summary.core_problem: 现有4bit LLM量化方法为保留离群值精度采用混合精度，破坏低位执行统一性，引入精度转换与额外数据搬运，抵消实际加速收益。
summary.importance: 提出统一4bit量化范式，兼顾精度与执行效率，属于推理量化方法的架构级创新。
summary.technical_approach: MosaicQuant采用内点-离群点解耦原理：将全权重矩阵量化为稠密4bit基础分量（内点精确、离群点带损），再引入稀疏4bit残差分量补偿离群点量化误差，全程保持4bit统一执行。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体评测模型规模、基准数据集与精度/速度提升幅度，仅声明实现稠密4bit执行的同时缓解离群点导致的精度下降。
summary.authors_note: 作者含多所高校与工业界研究者，无公开顶级团队知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing 4-bit LLM quantization methods use mixed precision to preserve outlier accuracy, breaking low-bit execution uniformity and introducing precision conversion plus extra data movement that erode practical speedups.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified 4-bit quantization paradigm balancing accuracy and execution efficiency, representing an architectural innovation in inference quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: MosaicQuant follows an inlier-outlier disaggregation principle: the full weight matrix is quantized into a dense 4-bit base component (faithful for inliers, lossy for outliers), then a sparse 4-bit residual component compensates for outlier quantization error, maintaining uniform 4-bit execution end-to-end.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not disclose evaluated model scales, benchmark datasets, or quantitative accuracy/speedup margins; only claims to mitigate outlier-induced accuracy degradation while preserving dense 4-bit execution.
summary_en.authors_note: Multiple authors from academia and industry; no publicly recognized prominent researchers from top-tier labs identified.

recommendation.zh: 统一4bit量化的实用方案，做推理部署或低比特训练模拟的人看§3解耦设计与§5硬件实测即可。
recommendation.en: Practical unified 4-bit quantization scheme; for inference deployment or low-bit training simulation researchers, read §3 disaggregation design and §5 hardware measurement results only.

paper.title: Last But Not Least: Boundary Attention CalibratiON for Multimodal KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong vision-language reasoning, but long visual contexts enlarge the KV cache and increase decoding latency. Existing compression methods rely on observation window attention for stable token-importance estimation, yet this aggregation can dilute sparse visual evidence and discard answer-critical tokens under aggressive compression. Therefore, we identify last-query attention as a complementary source for recovering such evidence, but its answer

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型在处理长视觉上下文时，KV Cache 显著增加导致解码延迟。现有的 KV Cache 压缩方法依赖观察窗口注意力来估计 token 重要性，这在激进压缩下容易稀释稀疏的视觉证据并丢弃关键 token。
summary.importance: 提出了一种名为 BACON 的即插即用方法，通过结合 last-query 注意力来校准 token 重要性估计，有效缓解了激进压缩下的关键信息丢失问题。
summary.technical_approach: 识别出 last-query 注意力是恢复稀疏视觉证据的补充来源。BACON 使用 last-query 证据校准观察窗口注意力，并通过层内连贯性和层间持久性抑制与答案无关的噪声信号，从而更准确地保留关键 KV Cache。
summary.experiments: 在多种 benchmark、模型和压缩预算下，BACON 在最激进的预算下将多模态 KV 压缩性能平均提升 7.5%，最高提升达 30.9%。
summary.authors_note: 由浙江实验室、港中文和新国大合作，聚焦 MLLM 的推理效率优化。

summary_en.core_problem: In Multimodal LLMs, long visual contexts inflate the KV cache and increase decoding latency. Existing KV cache compression methods rely on observation window attention for token importance, which can dilute sparse visual evidence and discard critical tokens under aggressive compression.
summary_en.importance: Proposes BACON, a plug-and-play method that calibrates token importance estimation by incorporating last-query attention, effectively mitigating critical information loss under aggressive compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: Identifies last-query attention as a complementary source for recovering sparse visual evidence. BACON calibrates observation window attention with last-query evidence and suppresses answer-irrelevant noise via intra-layer coherence and inter-layer persistence to better retain critical KV cache.
summary_en.experiments: Across diverse benchmarks, models, and budgets, BACON improves multimodal KV compression by 7.5% on average under the most aggressive budget, with gains up to 30.9%.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Zhejiang Lab, CUHK, and NUS, focusing on inference efficiency optimization for MLLMs.

recommendation.zh: 针对 MLLM 的 KV Cache 压缩，利用 last-query attention 找回被稀释的视觉证据，是一个实用的推理优化 trick，关注其重要性校准机制。
recommendation.en: A practical inference optimization trick for MLLM KV cache compression that uses last-query attention to recover diluted visual evidence; focus on its importance calibration mechanism.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Stepwise Token Selection for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: In multimodal large language models (MLLMs), inference cost is largely dominated by the visual token prefix rather than the language backbone, making token reduction a key factor for improving efficiency. Existing approaches typically assign independent importance scores to visual tokens and retain a fixed number of top-ranked tokens, implicitly assuming token independence and a uniform compression ratio across inputs. In this work, we reformulate visual token pruning as a sequential decision-ma

summary.core_problem: 降低 MLLM 推理中视觉 token 前缀带来的计算开销，同时避免固定 top-k 剪枝忽略 token 依赖和样本差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法改进。它不直接改变预训练范式，但对原生多模态模型的 token budget、视觉前缀压缩和端到端可训练剪枝有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 把视觉 token 剪枝重写为序列决策问题：用 pointer-style selection 逐步选择 token，每一步条件化于已选 token；再加入 learned termination action 动态决定保留数量。为接入标准语言建模目标，使用基于 variance-preserving noise interpolation 的可微松弛，使选择模块可端到端训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、具体 MLLM backbone、训练数据或提升幅度。实验应主要比较独立打分 top-k、固定压缩率剪枝和动态停止的 cost-quality trade-off。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the inference cost of MLLMs dominated by long visual-token prefixes, without relying on fixed top-k pruning that ignores token dependency and input-level variation.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency method. It does not directly change pretraining, but it is relevant to token budgeting, visual-prefix compression, and trainable pruning for native multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: It reformulates visual-token pruning as sequential decision making: a pointer-style selector chooses tokens step by step, each decision conditioned on previously selected tokens, and a learned termination action decides the retained set size. A differentiable relaxation based on variance-preserving noise interpolation allows training under standard language-modeling objectives.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, MLLM backbones, training data, or exact gains. The expected comparisons are against independent top-k scoring and fixed-ratio pruning under cost-quality trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 思路比固定 top-k 干净一些；只看方法和 cost-quality 图即可，结论是否能迁移到预训练阶段还没证据。
recommendation.en: The setup is cleaner than fixed top-k pruning; read the method and cost-quality plots only, since pretraining-time transfer is not established.

paper.title: One Layer's Trash is Another Layer's Treasure: Adaptive Layer-wise Visual Token Selection in LVLMs
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse multimodal tasks, yet their practical deployment remains constrained by the computational burden arising from lengthy visual tokens. While visual token pruning has emerged as a promising solution, existing methods suffer from a fundamental limitation: once tokens are pruned at a specific layer, they become inaccessible to all subsequent layers, leading to premature information loss that can compromise model perf

summary.core_problem: 降低 LVLM 中长视觉 token 序列带来的推理计算负担，同时避免一次性剪枝造成后续层无法恢复关键信息。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态大模型推理效率方法，不是预训练范式；有价值的点在于指出不同层需要的视觉区域不同，静态 token pruning 的“剪掉即永久丢失”假设过强。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ALVTS，即 Adaptive Layer-wise Visual Token Selection。方法在各层引入轻量 token selector，为当前层选择需要继续参与计算的重要视觉 token；低重要性 token 不是永久删除，而是跳过当前层或以路由方式减少计算，使后续层仍可根据自身需求访问不同 token 子集。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、具体 LVLM backbone、数据集和加速/精度数字；实验应与静态视觉 token pruning 方法比较，关注多模态任务精度、FLOPs/latency 降低和不同层 token 选择模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the inference cost of LVLMs caused by long visual-token sequences while avoiding irreversible information loss from one-shot pruning.
summary_en.importance: This is an LVLM inference-efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining method. The useful observation is that different layers attend to different visual regions, making static pruning too rigid.
summary_en.technical_approach: ALVTS introduces a lightweight token selector at each layer. Important visual tokens are routed for further computation, while less important ones can skip selected layers instead of being permanently removed, allowing later layers to use a different token subset.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, backbones, datasets, or exact speed/accuracy numbers. The key experiments are expected to compare against static visual-token pruning on multimodal accuracy and compute or latency reduction.

recommendation.zh: 只看层间 token 重要性分析即可；方法像动态 MoE 路由的视觉版，结论对 VLM serving 比 pretrain 更有用。
recommendation.en: Read only the layer-wise token-importance analysis; the method is a visual-token routing variant, more useful for VLM serving than pretraining.

paper.title: Towards Direct Latent-Space Synthesis for Parallel Branches in LLM-Agent Workflows
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly serve as execution engines for agentic systems, yet they still consume context through a sequential text interface. This creates a mismatch with modern structured agent workflows, in which independent branches explore subtasks, retrieve evidence, or generate candidate solutions before a final synthesis step. Existing systems typically merge these branches by concatenating their textual outputs, which discards the parallel structure and incurs redundant prefill

summary.core_problem: 论文试图解决并行 agent workflow 在合成阶段仍要把多个分支输出串接成文本、再由 synthesizer 重新 prefill 的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型接口研究的启发在于：LLM 不一定只能通过线性文本上下文交换中间状态。把并行分支的 KV cache 作为可消费的 latent context，可以减少重复 prefill，并保留分支之间的独立结构。这个方向和长上下文 RAG 的 cache reuse、agent latent communication、非线性上下文接口有关，但论文主要还是推理时系统与适配训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: Parallel-Synthesis 让下游 synthesizer 直接读取多个 worker agent 产生的 KV cache，而不是读取这些 worker 输出的文本拼接。由于这些 cache 来自独立上下文，不能直接当作一个标准自回归 prefix 使用，方法引入 cache mapper 对分支 cache 做校准，并用 synthesizer LoRA 让模型适应这种非顺序的 cache 输入接口。训练数据分三类：一类是 continued-pretraining-style dialogue data，用于让模型广泛适应 parallel cache contexts；一类是 multi-source synthesis tasks，用于学习从多个 cached contexts 汇聚信息；一类是从标准文本拼接 synthesis pipeline 蒸馏来的数据，用于保留复杂轨迹上的判断和推理能力。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖数学推理、科学问答、代码生成、tool-use agentic QA、多 agent 诊断推理等任务。相对于标准文本拼接 synthesis，Parallel-Synthesis 在 9 个数据集中的 7 个达到持平或更好，剩余 2 个只有小幅差距。效率收益主要来自避免重新 prefill 分支输出，time-to-first-token 降低约 2.5 倍到 11 倍。摘要和正文片段没有给出完整参数规模、训练 token 数和每项任务的细粒度表格，因此需要查看实验表确认收益是否集中在长分支、高并行度场景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 理解问题设定：DAG-style agent workflow 与线性上下文接口的冲突。然后看方法部分的 cache mapper、synthesizer LoRA 和训练数据构造。实验部分重点看三点：不同分支数量和分支长度下 TTFT 的变化；7/9 数据集持平或提升的具体分布；失败或小幅落后的两个数据集是否暴露了 latent cache 合成在细节保真、跨分支冲突处理上的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a mismatch in parallel agent workflows: independent branches are executed in parallel, but their outputs are usually concatenated into a single text prompt and prefilling is repeated by the final synthesizer.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea is a non-textual interface for agent communication. Instead of treating every intermediate result as serialized natural language, the synthesizer consumes branch KV caches directly. This is relevant to latent communication, cache reuse for long-context RAG, and non-linear context interfaces. The contribution is closer to inference-time systems plus adaptation training than to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Parallel-Synthesis reuses KV caches produced by parallel worker agents and feeds them to a downstream synthesizer. Because these caches were produced under independent contexts, they are not equivalent to a single autoregressive prefix. The method uses a cache mapper to calibrate branch caches and a synthesizer LoRA to adapt the model to the non-sequential cache interface. The adaptation data has three roles: continued-pretraining-style dialogue data for broad exposure to parallel cache contexts, multi-source synthesis data for aggregating information from multiple cached contexts, and distillation data from a standard text-concatenation synthesis pipeline to preserve judgment and reasoning over complex trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, tool-use agentic QA, and multi-agent diagnostic reasoning. Compared with standard text-based synthesis, Parallel-Synthesis matches or improves performance on 7 of 9 datasets and has only small gaps on the remaining two. The main efficiency result is lower time-to-first-token by avoiding re-prefill of branch outputs, with reported speedups of about 2.5x to 11x. The provided text does not include full model sizes, training-token counts, or per-dataset tables, so the detailed evidence should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25 to 35 minutes. Read the introduction to understand the conflict between DAG-like agent workflows and the linear context interface. Then inspect the method sections on the cache mapper, synthesizer LoRA, and adaptation data. In the experiments, focus on how TTFT scales with branch length and branch count, where the 7-of-9 quality result comes from, and whether the two weaker datasets reveal limitations in preserving fine-grained evidence or resolving conflicts across branches.

recommendation.zh: KV-cache 可以被校准并合并——这个观察对长上下文推理和多分支 agent 有启示，但工程性强理论贡献弱，看 §3 cache mapper 设计即可。
recommendation.en: KV-caches can be calibrated and merged — an interesting observation for long-context and multi-branch agents, but mostly engineering; read §3 on cache mapper design only.

paper.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Ultra-long-context capability is becoming indispensable for frontier LLMs: agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory all require the model to jointly attend over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, yet the quadratic cost of softmax attention makes this untenable at deployment scale. We introduce MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA). A lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and inde

summary.core_problem: 在数十万到百万 token 长上下文推理中，标准 softmax attention 的二次复杂度让部署成本难以承受。
summary.importance: 这是来自 MiniMax 的长上下文稀疏注意力系统性工作，贡献在注意力结构与 GPU 执行路径的联合设计。对预训练研究员的价值不只是推理加速，还在于它会反过来影响长上下文预训练时该保留什么注意力归纳偏置。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MiniMax Sparse Attention。它基于 GQA 做 blockwise sparse attention：轻量 Index Branch 对 KV block 打分，并为每个 GQA group 独立选择 Top-k block；Main Branch 只在被选中的 block 上做精确 block-sparse attention。方法刻意保持结构简单，便于跨 GPU 部署，并配套设计执行路径，把稀疏性转化为实际速度收益。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调面向 agent workflow、仓库级代码推理和持久记忆等超长上下文场景，并提到通过 GPU co-design 获得实际加速。给出的片段未包含模型规模、上下文长度、训练方式、质量损失、吞吐或延迟数字，需要重点查看实验表和 kernel 细节。
summary.authors_note: MiniMax 团队工作；作者列表包括 Xunhao Lai、Weiqi Xu、Yufeng Yang、Qiaorui Chen、Yang Xu、Lunbin Zeng、Xiaolong Li、Haohai Sun、Haichao Zhu、Vito Zhang 等。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the deployment cost of standard quadratic softmax attention for hundreds-of-thousands to million-token contexts.
summary_en.importance: This is a MiniMax long-context sparse-attention system paper. Its contribution is the joint design of an attention pattern and a GPU execution path. For pretraining researchers, the key issue is not only faster inference, but also what long-context inductive bias should be trained into future base models.
summary_en.technical_approach: MiniMax Sparse Attention builds blockwise sparse attention on top of GQA. A lightweight Index Branch scores KV blocks and independently selects Top-k blocks for each GQA group. The Main Branch then performs exact block-sparse attention only over the selected blocks. The design emphasizes simplicity and GPU portability, with a dedicated execution path to turn sparsity into real speedups.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory over ultra-long contexts, and claims practical acceleration through GPU co-design. The provided text does not include model scale, context length, training setup, quality drop, throughput, or latency numbers; those tables are the parts to inspect.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from MiniMax. The listed authors include Xunhao Lai, Weiqi Xu, Yufeng Yang, Qiaorui Chen, Yang Xu, Lunbin Zeng, Xiaolong Li, Haohai Sun, Haichao Zhu, and Vito Zhang.

recommendation.zh: 必须看实验和 kernel 设计；若质量损失小，应立刻复现 group-specific block selection 的长上下文 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the experiments and kernel design; if quality loss is small, reproduce the group-specific block-selection ablation for long-context training and serving.

paper.title: Functional Cache Grafting: Robust and Rapid Code-Policy Synthesis for Embodied Agents
paper.abstract: Code-writing large language models (CodeLLMs) generate executable code policies for embodied agents by translating natural language goals and environmental constraints into structured control programs. However, policy generation in open-domain embodied environments suffers from two fundamental limitations: (i) delayed decoding caused by repetitive prefill computation over long prompts, and (ii) limited robustness due to fully generative decoding, which often produces API mismatches, missing safe

summary.core_problem: CodeLLM为具身Agent生成代码策略时，存在长prompt预填充计算重复导致的解码延迟，以及全生成式解码导致的鲁棒性差（API错、缺安全检查等）问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出函数级KV缓存嫁接框架，同时解决代码策略生成的速度与鲁棒性问题。
summary.technical_approach: 维护函数级已验证代码骨架及其对应的Transformer KV缓存库；新任务时检索相关函数，通过拼接（stitching）嫁接其KV缓存，复用预计算结果并保证代码结构正确性。
summary.experiments: 摘要截断，未给出具体模型、数据集、基线与性能提升数据。

summary_en.core_problem: When CodeLLMs generate code policies for embodied agents, they face two issues: decoding delay from repeated prefill computation on long prompts, and poor robustness from fully generative decoding (API mismatches, missing safety guards, etc.).
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, proposing a functional KV cache grafting framework that simultaneously solves speed and robustness problems in code policy generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maintains a library of function-level validated code skeletons and their corresponding Transformer KV caches; retrieves relevant functions for new tasks and grafts their KV caches via stitching to reuse precomputed results and ensure code structure correctness.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; no specific model, dataset, baseline, or performance improvement data provided.

recommendation.zh: KV-cache拼接复用的思路可迁移至长上下文推理，只看方法部分的缓存嫁接实现细节即可。
recommendation.en: KV-cache stitching and reuse idea is transferable to long-context inference; only read implementation details of cache grafting in the method section.

paper.title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) addresses the high inference costs of LLMs by having lightweight drafters generate candidates for large verifiers to validate in parallel. Existing draft-verify methods use binary decisions: accept or fully recompute. Yet we find that many rejected tokens can be verified correctly by a slim submodel derived from the full verifier via intra-model routing, instead of the full verifier. This motivates our slim-verifier to handle tokens requiring moderate verification resou

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 speculative decoding 里的一个老问题：传统 draft-verify 框架把 token 处理成二元决策，要么直接接受 drafter 的结果，要么交给大模型完整重算。但实际推理里有不少 token 处在中间地带——小模型不够稳，大模型又有些浪费。论文试图把这部分 token 从“必须 full verifier 重算”中分离出来，用一个由大模型内部路由得到的 slim-verifier 先处理，从而减少大模型调用频率，提升整体吞吐。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身的直接影响有限，更偏 inference/serving，但有两点仍值得注意。第一，它把 speculative decoding 从二层 accept/reject 改写成多层 verification，提出了一个更细粒度的计算分配视角，这对以后把同一预训练模型切成多种算力档位有启发。第二，slim-verifier 不是单独训练一个中间模型，而是从 verifier 内部通过 routing 派生，这种 intra-model resource allocation 思路和 MoE、early exit、layer skipping 有相通之处。对做架构和训练的人来说，问题变成：能否在预训练阶段就让模型内部自然形成适合多级验证的子网络，而不是推理时再硬切。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 VIA-SD，一个三层或多层的 speculative decoding 框架：drafter 先生成候选 token；随后不是直接由 full verifier 做唯一裁决，而是先经过 slim-verifier 这一中间层。作者的出发点来自一个 KL 视角：传统 speculative decoding 依赖 drafter 分布与 verifier 分布足够接近，才能有高接受率和高加速比；如果把 verifier 分布和 drafter 分布之间插入一个中间分布，就可以把原本一次性完成的验证拆成层级式逼近。论文把 slim-verifier 视为这个中间分布的近似实现。

实现上，slim-verifier 不是额外训练的独立模型，而是从大 verifier 内部路由出来的轻量子模型。摘要和正文给出的描述表明，它通过 intra-model routing 动态选择较小的计算路径，使其在保持与 full verifier 较高分布对齐的同时，成本显著低于完整前向。推理流程是分层的：对于 drafter 给出的 token，高置信样本可直接接受；被初步拒绝但难度中等的 token 交给 slim-verifier 重新生成或验证；只有更难的 token 才升级到 full verifier。这样做和传统 speculative decoding 的区别不只是多了一级模型，而是把“拒绝”从终点改成了“继续分流”的起点。

论文还强调，这个中间层不是只做 binary decision，而是可以主动参与 regeneration。也就是说，slim-verifier 既是 verifier，也是中等算力生成器。这一点很关键，因为如果它只能判断不能生成，很多 token 最终还是会落回 full verifier，节省不了多少算力。作者据此把 speculative decoding 重新表述为 staged multi-tier verification，而不是单次并行校验。

从相关工作位置看，VIA-SD 与 EAGLE、层跳过式 SD、级联式 SD 的差别在于：它不主要强化 drafter，也不只是让中间模型做接受/拒绝判断，而是让由大模型派生出的中间子模型承担一部分真正的生成责任。这个设计减少了独立中间模型训练和分布失配问题，也更容易与现有大模型结构兼容。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 summarization、translation、reasoning、QA、coding 等多类任务，重点指标是 rejection rate 和端到端 speedup。论文报告 VIA-SD 相比已有 speculative decoding 基线，拒绝率可降到 0.10–0.22 区间，并带来约 10–20% 的额外加速。这说明中间层确实接住了一部分原本会落到 full verifier 的 token。

从论文给出的主结论看，三层配置是效率和准确性之间较平衡的实例化。层数再多虽然理论上更细，但会引入更多调度和同步开销，未必继续带来净收益。作者因此不是简单主张“层越多越好”，而是通过实验指出 practical sweet spot 在三层附近。

另一个值得注意的点是，收益来自两部分：一是 slim-verifier 与 full verifier 分布更接近，因此能比独立小模型更可靠地处理中等难度 token；二是 full verifier 的调用频率下降，减少了最昂贵前向的占比。论文还强调方法在多任务上都保持稳定，而不是只在某一类生成任务上有效，这对 serving 方案比较重要。

不过从预训练研究视角看，实验主要证明的是推理阶段的系统收益，而不是训练阶段的可迁移规律。若要进一步判断其研究价值，最好关注消融：slim-verifier 的路由方式、容量大小、以及不同 tier 的接受/升级阈值如何影响 rejection rate 和 speedup，这些细节决定方法是否能推广到更大模型或更长上下文。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Figure 1 和方法总览，理解它和标准 speculative decoding 的结构差异：关键不是多一个小模型，而是把 verifier 内部切出一个可生成的中间层。然后看理论部分里 KL/divergence 的动机，不必深究推导，抓住“引入中间分布以降低直接对齐难度”即可。接着看主实验表，重点关注 rejection rate、speedup、以及三层配置相对两层基线的增益。最后看消融，尤其是 slim-verifier 的构造方式和 tier 阈值设置。预计 20 分钟左右可以完成有效泛读；如果你做 serving 或推理系统，可以再细看实现细节和并行调度开销。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学 ReLER / 人工智能学院，与新加坡 A*STAR CFAR、IHPC、NUS 合作；通讯作者为 Yi Yang。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a limitation in standard speculative decoding: the draft-verify pipeline uses a binary policy. A drafted token is either accepted as-is or rejected and fully regenerated by the large verifier. In practice, many rejected tokens are not truly “hard”; they are simply not reliable enough for direct acceptance. The paper asks whether these middle-zone tokens can be handled by an intermediate verifier with much lower cost than the full model, thereby reducing expensive large-model invocations.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance is on inference efficiency rather than pretraining, but the design idea is still useful for foundation-model researchers. The paper reframes speculative decoding as hierarchical compute allocation instead of binary acceptance. That is interesting because it aligns with broader questions in model architecture: can a pretrained model expose internal sub-networks that are strong enough to serve as intermediate generators or verifiers? The proposed slim-verifier, derived through intra-model routing rather than trained as a separate model, also connects naturally to MoE-style conditional computation, early exit, and layer-skipping ideas.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, VIA-SD, introduces a multi-tier speculative decoding framework with a drafter, a routed slim-verifier, and a full verifier. The conceptual motivation comes from a KL-divergence view of speculative decoding. Standard two-tier SD works well when the drafter distribution is sufficiently aligned with the verifier distribution. The authors argue that this alignment can be decomposed through an intermediate distribution, making verification a staged process rather than a single accept/reject event. The slim-verifier is intended as a practical approximation to that intermediate distribution.

A key implementation choice is that the slim-verifier is not an independently trained middle model. Instead, it is an intra-model subnetwork routed from the full verifier, so it inherits stronger distributional alignment with the target model than an external small model would. At inference time, drafted tokens are processed hierarchically. High-confidence cases can be accepted directly. Tokens that are not accepted but are still moderate in difficulty are passed to the slim-verifier, which can either verify/regenerate them itself or defer them upward to the full verifier. Only the hardest cases require the full model. This changes rejection from a terminal event into a routing decision.

Another important point is that the slim-verifier is not just a confidence filter. It actively participates in token regeneration. That matters because a pure classifier-style intermediate stage would still send most rejected tokens back to the full verifier, limiting savings. By allowing the intermediate model to generate, VIA-SD turns speculative decoding into staged generation-and-verification.

Relative to prior work such as stronger drafters, layer-skipping SD, or cascading verification, the distinction here is that the intermediate tier is both verifier and generator, and it is derived from the full model itself. That reduces the need for separately trained intermediate models and may mitigate cross-model mismatch.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover summarization, translation, reasoning, QA, and coding. The main reported gains are lower rejection rates, around 0.10–0.22, and an additional 10–20% speedup over strong speculative decoding baselines. This supports the central claim that a meaningful fraction of tokens previously escalated to the full verifier can be absorbed by the slim-verifier.

A notable empirical conclusion is that a three-tier setup appears to be the practical sweet spot. Adding an intermediate stage helps, but adding too many stages would introduce routing, synchronization, and scheduling overheads that can offset the theoretical gains. The paper therefore argues for a balanced hierarchy rather than an arbitrarily deep cascade.

The speedup seems to come from two sources: the slim-verifier is more aligned with the full verifier than an external small model, so it can handle medium-difficulty tokens more reliably; and the frequency of full-verifier calls drops, reducing the share of the most expensive forward passes. The paper also emphasizes that the gains are consistent across multiple task types rather than confined to a single generation domain.

From a pretraining perspective, the experiments mainly validate a serving-time systems idea rather than a training-time law. The most useful parts to inspect are the ablations on routing design, slim-verifier capacity, and tier thresholds, because those determine whether the method is likely to scale to larger models or longer contexts.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with Figure 1 and the method overview to understand the structural difference from standard speculative decoding. The main idea is not merely “add another small model,” but “derive a generative intermediate verifier from the full model.” Then read the KL-motivation section lightly; the important takeaway is that an intermediate distribution can make alignment easier in stages. After that, go straight to the main tables and focus on rejection rate, end-to-end speedup, and the comparison between two-tier and three-tier setups. If time permits, read the ablations on slim-verifier construction and routing thresholds. Around 20 minutes should be enough for an informed skim. If you work on serving systems, spend extra time on implementation overhead and scheduling details.
summary_en.authors_note: ReLER and the College of Artificial Intelligence at Zhejiang University, with collaborators from A*STAR CFAR, A*STAR IHPC, and NUS; corresponding author: Yi Yang.

recommendation.zh: 工程味道足但偏 serving 细节；如果你在做自研推测解码，看 §3 路由设计和 acceptance 统计即可，不必深挖对 pretrain 的启发。
recommendation.en: A solid serving-side tweak for speculative decoding; read the routing design and rejection stats if you run your own SD stack, but it offers little for pretrain methodology.

paper.title: Adaptive Multi-Resolution Procedural Knowledge Compression for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to tackle complex tasks with autonomous workflows. Recently, reusable natural language skills have emerged as a popular paradigm to inject procedural knowledge into LLM applications. Since popular skills are often invoked repeatedly, placing their full text in every context significantly increases prefill cost and latency. While text compression techniques have the potential to solve this problem, most existing methods are designed to compress factual

summary.core_problem: 解决LLM中可复用自然语言技能（procedural knowledge）的上下文膨胀问题——高频技能的完整文本重复放入上下文显著增加prefill成本和延迟。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出自适应多分辨率软token压缩框架SKIM，专门针对程序性知识压缩，区别于传统文档/事实知识压缩。
summary.technical_approach: SKIM框架：1) 使用自编码器将技能文本压缩为软token序列；2) 自适应选择压缩分辨率以匹配不同技能的复杂度；3) 支持轻量级离线压缩以应对社区技能频繁更新；4) 在压缩中保留工作流间的逻辑依赖关系。
summary.experiments: 在多个技能库和下游任务上评估，与事实知识压缩方法对比，验证在保持任务效果的同时降低prefill成本。
summary.authors_note: 清华大学人工智能研究院刘奕群、张敏团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses context inflation from reusable natural language skills in LLMs—placing full skill texts in every context significantly increases prefill cost and latency.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes SKIM, an adaptive multi-resolution soft token compression framework specifically for procedural knowledge compression, distinct from traditional document/factual knowledge compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: SKIM framework: 1) Uses autoencoders to compress skill texts into soft token sequences; 2) Adaptively selects compression resolution matching skill complexity; 3) Supports lightweight offline compression for frequently updated community skills; 4) Preserves logical dependencies across workflows.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multiple skill libraries and downstream tasks, compared against factual knowledge compression methods, verifying reduced prefill cost while maintaining task performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Tsinghua University, Institute for AI. Authors include Yiqun Liu and Min Zhang.

recommendation.zh: 程序性知识压缩的方法创新，针对推理阶段prefill成本优化，与预训练训练侧无关，作为效率方向参考备查。
recommendation.en: Method innovation in procedural knowledge compression for inference prefill cost optimization; tangential to pretraining, useful as efficiency reference.

paper.title: Context-Driven Incremental Compression for Multi-Turn Dialogue Generation
paper.abstract: Modern conversational agents condition on an ever-growing dialogue history at each turn, incurring redundant attention and encoding costs that grow with conversation length. Naive truncation or summarization degrades fidelity, while existing context compressors lack cross-turn memory sharing or revision, causing information loss and compounding errors in long dialogues. We revisit the context compression under conversational dynamics and empirically present its fragility. To improve both efficie

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮对话中上下文随轮次增长而带来的推理成本上升，以及现有压缩方法因跨轮记忆不可修订而导致的信息丢失和误差累积。
summary.importance: 这是一个推理期上下文管理问题，贡献主要是长对话场景下的系统式压缩机制，而不是基座预训练方法本身。对做长上下文 serving、memory abstraction、对话 agent 的研究员有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Context-Driven Incremental Compression（C-DIC），把对话拆成交错的上下文线程，并为每个线程维护可修订的压缩状态；每轮通过 retrieve-revise-writeback 循环共享跨轮信息、修正陈旧记忆。训练上把 TBPTT 适配到多轮对话压缩学习，以控制长序列训练成本并让压缩器学习跨轮更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调对现有上下文压缩方法在多轮对话中的脆弱性做了系统实证，并展示 C-DIC 在长程对话中兼顾效率与鲁棒性。公开摘要未给出明确模型规模、数据规模和具体提升幅度，因此目前更适合作为方法思路参考，而非可直接采纳的定量结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Simon See、Lei Chen。可确认机构信息不足，摘要层面看更偏系统/应用场景下的长对话上下文管理。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the growing inference cost in multi-turn dialogue as history expands, and the information loss/error accumulation caused by existing compressors that cannot revise memory across turns.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-time context management problem rather than a core pretraining contribution. It is still relevant for researchers working on long-context serving, memory abstraction, and dialogue agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Context-Driven Incremental Compression (C-DIC), which decomposes a conversation into interleaved contextual threads and maintains revisable compressed states per thread. Each turn runs a retrieve-revise-writeback loop to share information across turns and refresh stale memory. Training adapts truncated BPTT to the multi-turn compression setting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims a systematic empirical study of the fragility of prior context compression methods in conversational settings, and shows that C-DIC improves both efficiency and robustness over long dialogues. The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, or concrete gains, so the current signal is more methodological than quantitative.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Simon See and Lei Chen. Institution details are not reliably recoverable from the provided metadata; the work appears closer to systems-oriented long-dialogue context management.

recommendation.zh: 更像对话 memory engineering，不改 pretrain prior；若你做长上下文推理，只看其可修订压缩状态设计，别对训练结论投入太多信任。
recommendation.en: This is more dialogue-memory engineering than a pretraining result; if you care about long-context inference, inspect the revisable memory design and treat the training claims as weak signal.

paper.title: CRUMB: Efficient Prior Fitted Network Inference via Distributionally Matched Context Batching
paper.abstract: Prior-fitted networks (PFNs) are a promising class of tabular foundation models that perform in-context learning, whereby the entire labelled training set is supplied as context, and predictions for test queries are produced in a single forward pass. However, the quadratically scaling self-attention mechanism in many PFN architectures makes inference prohibitive for very large training datasets. We propose CRUMB (Clustered Retrieval Using Minimised-MMD Batching), a three-stage inference wrapper

summary.core_problem: 如何解决 Prior-Fitted Networks (PFNs) 在处理大规模表格训练数据时，由于自注意力机制导致的推理成本过高问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种高效的 PFN 推理包装器 CRUMB，通过分布匹配的上下文批处理，显著降低了 PFN 在大规模数据集上的推理成本，且无需重新训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CRUMB：(i) 对测试查询进行聚类；(ii) 通过贪心最小化最大均值差异 (MMD)，为每个聚类选择一个分布匹配的小型训练子集；(iii) 在每个缩减上下文的批次上运行精确的 PFN 推理。
summary.experiments: 在 51 个数据集的 TabArena 基准上，跨三种 PFN 架构（TabPFNv2, TabICLv1, TabICLv2）进行评估，CRUMB 优于现有的上下文选择策略。

summary_en.core_problem: How to solve the prohibitive inference cost of Prior-Fitted Networks (PFNs) on large tabular training datasets due to the self-attention mechanism?
summary_en.importance: Proposes CRUMB, an efficient PFN inference wrapper that significantly reduces inference costs on large datasets through distributionally matched context batching, without requiring retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CRUMB: (i) clusters test queries, (ii) selects a small, distributionally matched training subset for each cluster by greedily minimizing Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), and (iii) runs exact PFN inference on each reduced-context batch.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the 51-dataset TabArena benchmark across three PFN architectures (TabPFNv2, TabICLv1, TabICLv2), showing CRUMB outperforms existing context selection strategies.

recommendation.zh: 针对表格数据基础模型（PFNs）的上下文检索/压缩优化，对通用 LLM 的 KV-cache 压缩或 RAG 检索有一定启发，但领域较窄，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Context retrieval/compression optimization for tabular foundation models (PFNs), offers some inspiration for general LLM KV-cache compression or RAG, but the domain is narrow, useful as literature reference.

paper.title: Optimal Post-Training Quantization Scales and Where to Find Them
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large language models by mapping weights to low-bit representations. The scaling factor that defines the quantization grid is typically chosen using simple, data-free heuristics. In this work, we present PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), an algorithm that leverages calibration data to compute the optimal channel-wise weight scales exactly and efficiently under round-to-nearest quantization. PiSO partitions the scale search space into finitely many i

summary.core_problem: 后训练量化（PTQ）中缩放因子通常采用简单无数据启发式（如 absmax）选择，忽略了输入激活如何在层输出处放大概率化误差；现有数据感知方法有限，且最优通道级缩放因子能否在 round-to-nearest 量化下被精确高效计算是一个未解决问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在于量化校准数据效率的改进——PiSO 减少了精确定量所需的校准数据量，这对于模型压缩与部署环节和预训练的接口有参考价值；此外，scale 优化与误差校正算法的联合优化思路可迁移至其他模型压缩场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PiSO（Piecewise Scale Optimization）算法，核心洞察是量化函数 q(w;s) 关于 s 是分段常数的，因此可将实轴（s 的搜索空间）划分为有限多个区间，每个区间内误差函数有闭式最优解。通过高效增量更新遍历这些区间，可在多项式时间内得到每个通道的全局最优 scale。通过两种互补近似扩展到分组量化（其中一种可捕捉跨组交互），并提出三种策略与 GPTQ 等贪婪误差校正方法交错优化 scale 和权重网格分配。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上进行了多模型尺寸和目标位宽的综合实验。结果显示 PiSO 无论单独使用还是与 GPTQ、Qronos 结合，都在困惑度和下游零样本精度上取得持续改进；目标位宽越窄（量化越困难），改进幅度越大。PiSO 同时减少了 RTN 和与 GPTQ 结合场景下所需的校准数据量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看方法章节中 PiSO 算法的三个关键观察（通道可分性、固定网格分配的闭式最优、分段常数洞察），与 GPTQ 的结合策略，以及实验章节中的低位宽消融结果。预计阅读时间：25-35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Scaling factors in post-training quantization (PTQ) are typically chosen using simple data-free heuristics (e.g., absmax) that ignore how input activations amplify quantization errors at layer output. Existing data-aware methods are limited, and whether optimal channel-wise scales can be computed exactly and efficiently under round-to-nearest quantization remained an open question.
summary_en.importance: The primary relevance to pretraining research is improved calibration data efficiency for quantization — PiSO reduces the amount of calibration data needed for accurate quantization, which has implications for the model compression/deployment interface with pretraining. The joint optimization of scale and error correction also provides a transferable idea to other model compression scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), whose key insight is that the quantization function q(w;s) is piecewise constant in s, allowing the real line (search space for s) to be partitioned into finitely many intervals where the error admits a closed-form minimizer. Sweeping these intervals with efficient incremental updates yields the globally optimal scale per channel in polynomial time. Extends to group-wise quantization via two complementary approximations (one capturing cross-group interactions), and proposes three interleaving strategies to integrate with greedy error correction methods like GPTQ.
summary_en.experiments: Comprehensive experiments on Llama and Qwen models across multiple model sizes and target weight bit-widths. PiSO yields consistent improvements in perplexity and downstream zero-shot accuracy, both standalone and when combined with GPTQ and Qronos. Benefits increase as target bit-width narrows and quantization becomes more challenging. PiSO also reduces calibration data requirements under both RTN and GPTQ-integrated settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methods section for PiSO's three key observations (channel separability, closed-form optimum for fixed grid assignment, piecewise constant insight), GPTQ integration strategies, and the low-bitwidth ablation results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: PiSO对PTQ量化给出了一个干净的闭形式解，比传统启发式有理论优势，做低bit推理的人应看§3的分区分析
recommendation.en: PiSO provides a clean closed-form solution for PTQ scale optimization with theoretical advantages over heuristics; §3 interval analysis is worth reading for low-bit inference practitioners

paper.title: Streaming Knowledge Compilation: Proactive Materiality-Scored Pinning for Time-Evolving LLM Wikis
paper.abstract: LLM wiki systems compile knowledge into pre-filled KV caches for efficient inference, but assume a static corpus -- an assumption that fails whenever the underlying information landscape evolves. We formalize Streaming Knowledge Compilation: given a document stream, a fixed token budget, and future queries unknown at ingestion time, maintain a compiled wiki that minimizes cumulative regret against an offline oracle with perfect foresight. The enabling insight is a materiality signal $φ_t(k,n)\in

summary.core_problem: LLM wiki 系统将知识编译到预填充 KV cache 中以实现高效推理，但假设语料库是静态的——当底层信息随时间演化时这一假设失效。
summary.importance: 首次形式化 Streaming Knowledge Compilation 问题：在文档流、固定 token 预算和未知未来查询的约束下，维护编译 wiki 并最小化与离线 oracle 的累计 regret。贡献类型：理论框架创新 + 算法设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 materiality signal φ_t(k,n) ∈ [0,1]，对实体 k 在时间 t 的文档重要性打分，作为查询相关性的替代信号用于主动 pinning；证明 O(√(T log K)) 的 regret bound。在金融领域用 Llama 3.1 8B 冻结分类头预测异常波动作为 φ_t。
summary.experiments: 金融领域：76K 文章，严格时间分割，AUROC = 0.728；实现 1.49× 更高的 realized 指标（摘要被截断）。
summary.authors_note: Juan M. Huerta（未明确标注机构）

summary_en.core_problem: LLM wiki systems compile knowledge into pre-filled KV caches for efficient inference but assume a static corpus, which fails when the underlying information landscape evolves over time.
summary_en.importance: First formalization of Streaming Knowledge Compilation: maintaining a compiled wiki under a document stream, fixed token budget, and unknown future queries to minimize cumulative regret against an offline oracle. Contribution: theoretical framework + algorithm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a materiality signal φ_t(k,n) ∈ [0,1] scoring document importance for entity k at time t, acting as a query-relevance surrogate for proactive pinning; proves an O(√(T log K)) regret bound. Instantiated in finance using a frozen Llama 3.1 8B classification head to predict abnormal stock volatility as φ_t.
summary_en.experiments: Finance domain: 76K articles, strict temporal split, AUROC = 0.728; achieves 1.49× higher realized metric (abstract truncated).
summary_en.authors_note: Juan M. Huerta (institution not explicitly stated)

recommendation.zh: 理论框架有趣但落地场景偏门（金融 wiki），对 pretrain 研究员几乎无启发；作为 KV-cache 应用文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Theoretical framework is interesting but the use case is niche (finance wiki); offers little insight for pretrain researchers—keep as literature reference only.

paper.title: Trainable Smooth-Rotation Transforms with Learned Channel Scales for LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is one of the most practical ways to reduce the serving cost of Large Language Models (LLMs), but activation quantization remains difficult because outlier-dominated channels lead to large quantization errors. This paper investigates whether part of this degradation is caused by over-migration in scaling-based equivalent transformations. We introduce a quantile-robust scaling policy for SmoothRot-style transforms by replacing max-based activation statistics with

summary.core_problem: LLM 后训练量化（PTQ）中，激活量化因异常值主导的通道导致大量化误差仍很困难；本文调查部分性能下降是否由基于缩放的等价变换中的过度迁移（over-migration）引起。
summary.importance: 分析 SmoothRot 类变换中的 over-migration 问题并提出改进。贡献类型：量化方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 用高 quantile 替代 max 基激活统计量，引入 quantile-robust 缩放策略；补充以约束梯度优化通道尺度。方法组合：quantile-only 策略搜索、联合 (alpha, q) 搜索、可训练通道尺度。
summary.experiments: LLaMA-3.2-1B，W4A4 量化。Quantile-only 策略搜索比 SmoothRot baseline 改进 11.1% selected-layer 误差；联合搜索改进 12%；训练方法达到 18.5%。在所有 decoder-block down-projection 层上重放最佳策略，将 full-layer mean error 从 97.51 降至 78.08（19.9%）。
summary.authors_note: Obuda University（匈牙利欧布达大学）

summary_en.core_problem: Activation quantization in LLM post-training quantization (PTQ) remains difficult because outlier-dominated channels lead to large quantization errors; this paper investigates whether part of the degradation is caused by over-migration in scaling-based equivalent transformations.
summary_en.importance: Analyzes the over-migration problem in SmoothRot-style transforms and proposes improvements. Contribution: quantization method refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces a quantile-robust scaling policy replacing max-based activation statistics with high quantiles, complemented by constrained gradient-based optimization of channel scales. Method combinations: quantile-only policy search, joint (alpha, q) search, and trainable channel scales.
summary_en.experiments: LLaMA-3.2-1B, W4A4 quantization. Quantile-only policy search improves selected-layer error by 11.1% over SmoothRot baseline; joint search improves by 12%; training reaches 18.5%. Replaying best selected-layer policy on all decoder-block down-projection layers reduces full-layer mean error from 97.51 to 78.08 (19.9%).
summary_en.authors_note: Obuda University, Hungary

recommendation.zh: SmoothRot 的增量改进，量化误差指标有一定提升但未报告端到端 perplexity 或下游任务效果；对 pretrain 无直接启发。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to SmoothRot quantization with demonstrated error metric gains, but no end-to-end perplexity or downstream task results reported; no direct pretrain relevance.

paper.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing a severe GPU memory bottleneck for ultra-long context serving. In this report, we propose Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA), a novel inference paradigm powered by a Neural Memory Indexer built upon the DeepSeek-V4 architecture. Rather than passively attending to all historical tokens, LSA proactively predicts future context demands and preserves only the query-critical KV chunks in the GPU memory. Crucially, we instantiate t

summary.core_problem: 传统LLM解码时需加载全部KV cache，超长上下文推理时GPU内存瓶颈严重。
summary.importance: 范式级创新：提出Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA)，由Neural Memory Indexer主动预测未来上下文需求，仅保留关键KV chunk在GPU内存中。
summary.technical_approach: LSA采用backbone-free解耦训练策略：将indexer建模为标准dual-encoder架构，独立于LLM backbone单独训练（用标准检索训练框架，无需加载大模型。在DeepSeek-V4架构上实例化。
summary.experiments: 在主要长上下文评测套件上验证了效率显著提升（未见完整数据（abstract被截断）。声称显著提升serving效率并同时作为attention denoiser。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek团队。这是继DeepSeek-V4架构的FlashMemory技术报告。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing severe GPU memory bottlenecks for ultra-long context serving.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm-level innovation: Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA) proactively predicts future context demands and retains only query-critical KV chunks in GPU memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: LSA uses a backbone-free decoupled training strategy: the indexer is formulated as a standard dual-encoder architecture, trained independently using standard retrieval frameworks without loading the massive backbone model. Instantiated on DeepSeek-V4.
summary_en.experiments: Significant improvements on major long-context evaluation suites (results truncated). Claims both serving efficiency and acts as attention denoiser.
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek team; this is the FlashMemory technical report for DeepSeek-V4.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对长上下文推理的认知——用独立dual-encoder indexer预测未来KV需求，backbone-free训练策略极具工程启发性，应立刻在内部ablation中复现核心思路。
recommendation.en: Changes my view on long-context inference: a standalone dual-encoder indexer predicting future KV needs with backbone-free training is highly engineerable; should reproduce core idea in internal ablations immediately.

paper.title: AsyncLane: Decoupling Refinement from Advancement in Diffusion Language Model Decoding
paper.abstract: Block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding is the standard inference paradigm for diffusion large language models (DLMs), but it imposes a strict dependency between blocks: the next block cannot begin until the current block is fully decoded or its denoising budget is exhausted. We observe that once a block exposes a reliable delimiter boundary or stable semantic prefix, continuation generation need not wait for every residual token to be resolved. We propose AsyncLane, a training-free decoding sch
