summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 diffusion language model 推理中的 block completion barrier。现有 block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding 通常要求当前 block 完成或耗尽 denoising budget 后，下一 block 才能开始。问题在于，当前 block 里剩余的低置信 token 还在 refinement 时，后续生成有时已经可以依赖一个稳定前缀或 delimiter boundary 继续推进。把 refinement 和 advancement 绑在同一条串行路径上，会浪费推理并行性。
summary.importance: 它对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，主要是 diffusion LM 的 decoding 和 serving 调度。但它提供了一个有用信号：非 AR 模型的吞吐优势不只来自一次预测多个 mask token，也取决于推理依赖图能否被重新组织。对于设计 diffusion/any-order LM 的训练目标，这篇论文也提醒一点：如果模型能更早形成可靠边界或稳定语义前缀，推理调度就有更多空间。因此它更像是连接建模范式和系统效率的工作。
summary.technical_approach: AsyncLane 是 training-free scheduler，不改模型参数。它把标准 block-wise decoding 中的单一全局 block pointer 替换为 active lanes。generate lane 负责推进生成前沿；refine lane 负责继续修正已经发现的前缀。当 generate lane 暴露出可靠 delimiter boundary 时，调度器执行 branch-and-refine：边界前的前缀交给 refine lane，边界后的 continuation 交给新的 generate lane。这样，未来区域可以开始 denoising，而过去前缀仍保持可编辑。为了降低多 lane 带来的模型调用开销，论文利用 fork 后 sibling lanes 共享前缀状态，做 grouped batched forwards；复用 future-window logits 作为后续 generate lane 的高置信 draft；用 cascading termination 避免在 EOS 或未解决前沿之后继续创建无效 lane；并通过 compact cache refresh 和 refresh-logit reuse 控制双向 attention 下的 stale prefix 问题。
summary.experiments: 实验在 LLaDA 和 Dream 两类 diffusion LM backbone 上进行，任务包括 mathematical reasoning 和 code generation。论文报告 AsyncLane 在所有测试的 benchmark-length 设置下取得最高 throughput，并且生成长度越长，吞吐优势越明显。质量方面保持 competitive generation quality，没有把速度收益完全建立在明显退化的输出上。给出的全文片段没有包含具体吞吐数字、pass 数、延迟或准确率表，因此只能确认趋势和比较结论，不能核验精确幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20-30 分钟。重点看方法图和 active-lane scheduling 的定义，理解 lane state、generate/refine role、boundary-triggered fork 的执行顺序。然后看 efficient execution 部分，尤其是 grouped batched forwards、future-window logit reuse、cache refresh 这几项，因为这些决定了多 lane 调度是否真的省时。实验部分主要看按生成长度分组的 throughput-quality 曲线，以及 LLaDA 与 Dream 上是否表现一致。若关注预训练本身，可以快速读完，不必深挖系统实现细节；若在做 diffusion LM serving，则值得仔细检查边界检测规则和 stale prefix 处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the block completion barrier in diffusion language model decoding. In common block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding, the next block cannot start until the current block is fully decoded or its denoising budget is exhausted. This serializes two different operations: refining low-confidence positions in the current block and advancing the generation frontier. Once a stable prefix or delimiter boundary has emerged, the continuation does not always need to wait for every remaining token in the current block to be resolved.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is moderate; this is primarily a decoding and serving scheduler for diffusion LMs. Its broader lesson is useful: the throughput advantage of non-AR models depends not only on predicting multiple masked tokens per pass, but also on how the inference dependency graph is scheduled. It also gives a modeling signal. If a diffusion or any-order LM can expose reliable boundaries early, decoding can exploit more parallelism. The work therefore sits between modeling assumptions and systems efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: AsyncLane is a training-free scheduler. It replaces the single global block pointer in standard block-wise decoding with a set of active lanes. A generate lane advances the frontier. A refine lane keeps improving an already discovered prefix. When a generate lane reveals a reliable delimiter boundary, the scheduler performs branch-and-refine: the prefix before the boundary is assigned to a refine lane, and the continuation after the boundary is assigned to a new generate lane. The future region can then begin denoising while the past remains editable. To keep the cost under control, AsyncLane exploits shared prefix states among forked sibling lanes and evaluates them with grouped batched forwards. It reuses future-window logits as high-confidence drafts for later generate lanes, uses cascading termination to avoid creating lanes beyond EOS or unresolved frontiers, and applies compact cache refresh plus refresh-logit reuse to reduce stale-prefix issues under bidirectional attention.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on LLaDA and Dream backbones, with mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks. AsyncLane achieves the highest throughput across the evaluated benchmark-length settings, and the advantage becomes larger for longer generations. Generation quality remains competitive, so the speedup is not simply obtained by allowing large quality degradation. The provided full-content excerpt does not include exact throughput, latency, pass-count, or accuracy numbers, so the quantitative magnitude cannot be independently summarized beyond the reported trend.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 20-30 minutes. Focus first on the method figure and the definition of active-lane scheduling: lane state, generate versus refine roles, and the boundary-triggered fork procedure. Then read the efficient execution part, especially grouped batched forwards, future-window logit reuse, and cache refresh, because these details determine whether multiple active lanes reduce wall-clock time. In the experiments, look for throughput-quality curves grouped by generation length and check whether the behavior is consistent on both LLaDA and Dream. For pretraining-focused readers, a quick read is enough. For diffusion LM serving work, the boundary detection rule and stale-prefix handling are the parts to inspect carefully.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看，尤其如果你还在判断 DLM 有没有工程生命力；先看调度假设和 wall-clock 表，若收益真实，很多“DLM 太慢”的 prior 要改写一部分。
recommendation.en: This is worth reading if you still doubt DLMs have any systems future; check the scheduling assumptions and wall-clock tables first—if the gains are real, part of the “DLMs are too slow” prior needs updating.

paper.title: Enabling KV Caching of Shared Prefix for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching for shared prefixes is essential for high-throughput large language model (LLM) serving, but it faces critical challenges in emerging diffusion language models (DLMs). In DLMs, bidirectional attention means that updating any token dynamically alters the entire context and its corresponding KVs. Thus, existing caching techniques developed for LLMs, which assume that KVs remain invariant once computed, corrupt the shared prefix KVs. Our experiments show that applying these t

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散语言模型在共享前缀场景下无法直接复用 KV cache 的问题；双向注意力会让任意 token 更新污染整段上下文的 KV，导致现有 LLM 缓存方法在 DLM 上几乎失效。
summary.importance: 这是面向新型语言建模范式的 serving 基础设施问题。贡献类型主要是推理系统方法：把 AR LLM 中成熟的 shared-prefix caching 迁移到 DLM 时，先明确指出“直接套用会精度崩塌”，再给出可工作的缓存策略。对判断 DLM 是否具备实际部署前景有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 bidirectional prefix caching（bicache）。核心观察是：共享前缀对应的 KV 在浅层相对稳定、可复用，而深层会因双向上下文更新而失真；可复用的浅层深度又取决于请求中 shared prefix token 的占比。基于此，方法动态识别一个安全的浅层边界，只缓存并复用这些层的前缀 KV，避免深层缓存带来的语义污染。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模，但实验结论很明确：把现有 LLM 的 shared-prefix caching 直接用于 DLM，会让准确率接近 0；bicache 在保持精度的同时提升吞吐。论文的关键实验应包括：不同共享前缀比例下的安全缓存深度分析、与无缓存/错误缓存/静态层数缓存的对比，以及吞吐-精度权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles shared-prefix KV caching for diffusion language models, where bidirectional attention makes any token update alter the whole context and invalidates standard LLM caching assumptions.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-enablement problem for an alternative LM paradigm. The contribution is mainly systems-oriented: it shows that naively reusing AR-LM prefix caching in DLMs can collapse accuracy, then provides a workable caching scheme. That matters if one wants DLMs to be deployable rather than just trainable.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes bidirectional prefix caching (bicache). The key observation is that shared-prefix KVs remain relatively stable and reusable in shallow layers, while deeper layers become corrupted by bidirectional context updates; the safe shallow depth depends on the fraction of shared-prefix tokens in each request. Bicache dynamically selects this safe boundary and only reuses prefix KVs there.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full model scales, but the main empirical result is clear: applying existing LLM shared-prefix caching to DLMs drives accuracy close to zero, whereas bicache preserves accuracy while improving throughput. The important experiments likely analyze safe cache depth vs. shared-prefix ratio and compare against no-cache, naive cache, and static-depth baselines.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 DLM，不要只盯训练目标；这篇把“能不能像 AR 一样高吞吐部署”这个硬约束讲清了，先看失败案例和层深稳定性分析。
recommendation.en: If you care about DLMs, do not stop at the objective; this paper makes the serving constraint concrete, and the failure case plus layerwise stability analysis are the parts worth reading.

paper.title: Still: Amortized KV Cache Compaction in a Single Forward Pass
paper.abstract: The KV cache is the memory bottleneck of long-horizon language model deployment. Practically, a deployable compactor must be lightweight enough to call during inference, expressive enough to preserve context under constraint, and reusable across a trajectory. Existing compaction methods satisfy only part of this requirement: selection methods are lightweight but subset-bound, while synthesis methods are expressive but rely on per-context optimization. Here we introduce Still, a small per-layer P

summary.core_problem: 如何在长上下文 LLM 推理中，通过单次前向传播实现轻量且高压缩率的 KV Cache 压缩？
summary.importance: 提出了一种摊销的 KV Cache 压缩方法，在保持高压缩率的同时，避免了现有方法中选择性压缩的子集限制和合成性压缩的逐上下文优化开销。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 Still，一个针对冻结基础模型训练的小型逐层 Perceiver。它在单次前向传播中生成紧凑的 Key 和 Value，实现摊销的 KV Cache 压缩。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen 和 Gemma 模型上，Still 在 8x 到 200x 的压缩率和 8k 到 128k 的上下文长度下，实现了速度和质量的良好平衡。在长上下文 RULER 网格上，超过最强基线 8-22 分。在 HELMET 上的自由形式摘要任务中也保持了大部分全上下文增益。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve lightweight and high-compression KV Cache compaction in a single forward pass for long-context LLM inference?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an amortized KV Cache compaction method that maintains high compression rates while avoiding the subset limitations of selective compression and the per-context optimization overhead of synthetic compression in existing methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Still, a small per-layer Perceiver trained against a frozen base model. It generates compact Keys and Values in a single forward pass, enabling amortized KV Cache compaction.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen and Gemma models, Still achieves a favorable speed-quality balance across compression ratios from 8x to 200x and context lengths from 8k to 128k. It outperforms the strongest baseline by 8-22 points on the long-context RULER grid and preserves most full-context gains on free-form summarization in HELMET.

recommendation.zh: 用 Perceiver 做 KV Cache 的单次前向压缩，思路干净，值得关注其在极高压缩率（200x）下的表现和训练代价。
recommendation.en: Using a Perceiver for single-forward KV Cache compaction is a clean approach; worth checking its performance at extreme compression ratios (200x) and the training cost.

paper.title: OffQ: Taming Structured Outliers in LLM Quantization by Offsetting
paper.abstract: Low-bit quantization has been widely adopted to accelerate the inference of large language models (LLMs) by significantly reducing computational cost and memory usage. However, activation outliers pose a major challenge to effective quantization, often leading to notable performance degradation. In this paper, we introduce OffQ, a method designed to mitigate activation outliers in low-bit quantization through a novel offsetting mechanism. Specifically, OffQ first identifies a low-dimensional out

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 LLM 低比特推理量化里一个很硬的瓶颈：激活中的结构化 outlier 会主导动态范围，使得 W4A4KV4 这类全链路 4-bit 量化很难稳定工作。已有方法要么靠更复杂的旋转/仿射变换，要么引入 mixed precision 或非均匀量化，但这些方案通常会破坏统一低比特执行的简洁性，增加 kernel、数据搬运和部署复杂度。论文要解决的问题是：能否在保持标准均匀量化和统一 4-bit matmul 的前提下，把这些 outlier 的影响从主分布里“拿掉”，从而让 W4A4KV4 变得更可靠。
summary.importance: 它不属于 pretrain recipe 本身，但对大模型基础设施和研究迭代效率有现实意义。原因很直接：如果 W4A4KV4 能更稳，低成本评测、蒸馏、长上下文实验、边缘部署和大规模 serving 的门槛都会下降。更重要的是，这篇工作不是单纯做工程 patch，而是利用了近期关于 activation singular defects 的结构性观察——outlier 并非完全随机，而是落在低维子空间里。这个认识对模型表示分析也有启发：LLM 激活异常值可能来自某种稳定的全局方向，而不是局部噪声。贡献量级上，它更像是一个干净的 PTQ 机制创新，重点在“如何处理结构化 outlier 而不牺牲统一低比特执行”。
summary.technical_approach:
OffQ 的方法可以概括成三步：先找出 outlier 方向，再把 outlier 能量集中到极少数通道，最后把这些通道转成可被量化 zero-point 吸收的 offset。

第一步是识别低维 outlier subspace。作者基于近期 singular defects 的观察，认为高范数 token 的异常激活在不同层、token id、位置上共享相近方向，因此可以用一个 tailored top-1 PCA 去抓住主 outlier 方向。这里的重点不是做高成本全量 PCA，而是用足够便宜的 top-1 近似，提取最主要的异常方向。

第二步是旋转并集中 outlier。找到主方向后，OffQ 通过正交旋转把原本分散在多个维度上的大幅值激活，尽量压缩到一个或极少数 channel 中。这个思路和 QuaRot/SpinQuant 一样都利用旋转不改变线性层等价性，但目标不同：QuaRot 更偏向把分布整体高斯化、均匀化；OffQ 更明确地把结构化异常值“聚拢”，为后续消除做准备。

第三步是 group-wise offset absorption。作者先重排通道，使每个 group 分配到一个 outlier channel；然后在组内施加特定 Hadamard rotation，把这个 outlier channel 的能量转化为共享 offset。这个 offset 最终被吸收到标准均匀量化的 zero-point 中。直观上看，相当于把“一个特别大的异常通道”从需要被精确表示的信号里剥离出来，改写成组级别的基线偏移量。这样剩余待量化值的标准差显著下降，量化步长不再被少量极端值绑架。

这个设计有几个值得注意的取舍。第一，它坚持 uniform quantization，而不是上非均匀 codebook，因此硬件兼容性更好。第二，它避免 mixed precision，不需要为 outlier channel 保留高精度路径，因此执行图更整齐。第三，它不依赖反向传播学习旋转矩阵，减少了校准成本和额外参数。代价则是方法强依赖“outlier 低维且方向稳定”这一经验事实；如果某些模型或层的 outlier 结构更分散，top-1 PCA + 单通道集中可能就不够。
summary.experiments:
论文聚焦最困难的 W4A4KV4 设定，也就是权重、激活、KV cache 全部 4-bit。这个设定比只量化权重或只量化激活更能检验方法是否真的把 outlier 问题处理干净。

从全文片段可确认的结果层面，作者声称在多种 LLM 架构和 benchmark 上，OffQ 在 perplexity 和 accuracy 上都稳定优于一系列现有基线，同时保持端到端统一低比特推理的效率。虽然给出的片段没有列出具体表格数字，但实验设计的关键比较对象已经很明确：应包括未处理 outlier 的标准 PTQ、旋转类方法如 QuaRot/SpinQuant，以及更复杂的等价变换或 mixed-precision 方法。

真正值得关注的实验，不只是主结果，而是以下几类分析。其一，激活分布统计：经过 top-1 PCA 旋转和 offset absorption 后，标准差、峰度、极值占比是否显著下降。其二，分组大小和通道重排策略的敏感性：group 太小会增加元数据和实现复杂度，太大则 offset 难以精确吸收 outlier。其三，不同层、不同模型家族上的稳定性：如果 outlier 方向确实具有跨层一致性，那么 top-1 PCA 的收益应当比较稳。其四，吞吐和 kernel 复杂度：论文的卖点之一是保持 uniform 4-bit execution，因此需要看实际部署时是否真的没有被额外变换开销抵消。

如果正文包含与 mixed-precision 或 learned rotation 方法的对比，重点应看在相近 perplexity 下，OffQ 是否能用更简单的 kernel 路径达到接近效果；或者在相近执行复杂度下，是否明显降低量化误差。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction，把三类已有路线分清：更复杂的变换、mixed precision、非均匀量化。然后直接看方法图，理解 OffQ 的核心不是“再做一次更强旋转”，而是“把 outlier 变成 offset，让 zero-point 去吸收”。这个点抓住后，整篇文章会顺很多。

方法部分重点看四处：top-1 PCA 如何定义和估计；旋转后为何能把 outlier 集中到 1 个 channel；channel grouping/reordering 的具体规则；Hadamard rotation 后 offset 如何并入标准 quantizer 的 zero-point。若这些公式写得清楚，基本就能判断它是否容易落地。

实验部分优先看主表、激活统计图、以及 latency/throughput 对比。若时间有限，先看和 QuaRot、SpinQuant、mixed-precision baseline 的比较，再看消融。预计阅读时间 20 分钟左右。若你关心 serving 或低比特训练前评测，这篇值得把实现细节也看一遍，因为它的价值主要在部署友好性，而不只是离线指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a hard bottleneck in low-bit LLM inference: structured activation outliers dominate the dynamic range and make full W4A4KV4 quantization unreliable. Existing fixes usually rely on more complex learned transformations, mixed precision, or non-uniform quantization, but those approaches often complicate kernels and weaken the appeal of uniform low-bit execution. The central question here is whether one can remove the effect of activation outliers while keeping standard uniform quantization and fully 4-bit matrix multiplications.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for foundation-model research infrastructure. More reliable W4A4KV4 quantization lowers the cost of evaluation, distillation, long-context experiments, and deployment. More interestingly, the method is built on a structural observation rather than a pure engineering patch: activation outliers appear to lie in a low-dimensional subspace, consistent with recent singular-defect analyses. That makes the paper relevant beyond systems work, because it suggests that extreme activations in LLMs are not arbitrary noise but may reflect stable global directions in representation space. In contribution scale, this is a clean PTQ mechanism innovation focused on handling structured outliers without sacrificing uniform low-bit execution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
OffQ has a simple three-stage logic: identify the outlier direction, concentrate outlier energy into very few channels, then convert that energy into offsets that can be absorbed by the quantizer zero-point.

First, it identifies a low-dimensional outlier subspace using a tailored top-1 PCA procedure. The motivation comes from recent observations that high-norm activation outliers share similar directions across layers, token identities, and sequence positions. Instead of expensive full PCA or learned transformations, OffQ extracts the dominant outlier direction with a lightweight top-1 procedure.

Second, it applies an orthonormal rotation so that large-magnitude activations are concentrated into one or a few channels. This is related to rotation-based methods such as QuaRot and SpinQuant, but the goal is different. Those methods mainly try to spread energy and make the distribution more Gaussian-like. OffQ explicitly tries to gather structured outlier mass into a minimal set of channels so that it can be removed cleanly afterward.

Third, it performs group-wise offset absorption. Channels are reordered into groups, each assigned one outlier channel. A specialized Hadamard rotation is then applied within each group to transform the outlier energy into a shared offset. That offset is absorbed into the zero-point of standard low-bit quantization. Intuitively, instead of forcing the quantizer to represent a very large outlier channel directly, the method rewrites its effect as a group-level baseline shift. The remaining values then have much smaller variance and can be quantized more accurately.

The design choices are important. It keeps uniform quantization rather than switching to non-uniform codebooks, which helps hardware compatibility. It avoids mixed precision, so execution remains homogeneous. It also avoids backpropagation-based rotation learning, reducing calibration cost and implementation burden. The main assumption is that outliers are indeed low-dimensional and directionally stable; if that structure breaks, top-1 concentration may become less effective.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper focuses on the difficult W4A4KV4 setting, where weights, activations, and KV cache are all quantized to 4 bits. This is a much stronger test than weight-only quantization and is the right place to evaluate whether outlier handling is genuinely effective.

From the provided full-content excerpt, the authors report consistent improvements in both perplexity and downstream accuracy across multiple LLM architectures and benchmarks, compared with a range of strong baselines, while preserving the simplicity of end-to-end uniform low-bit inference. The excerpt does not include the exact numeric tables, but the intended comparisons are clear: standard PTQ without strong outlier handling, rotation-based baselines such as QuaRot and SpinQuant, and more complex alternatives such as learned equivalent transforms or mixed-precision methods.

The most informative experiments are likely not only the headline metrics but also the distributional analyses: whether standard deviation, tail mass, and extreme-value concentration drop after top-1 PCA rotation and offset absorption; how sensitive the method is to group size and channel reordering; whether the gains are stable across layers and model families; and whether the runtime overhead of the extra transforms is small enough that the uniform 4-bit execution path still delivers practical speedups.

If the full paper includes comparisons against mixed-precision or learned-rotation methods, the key question is whether OffQ reaches similar perplexity with a simpler kernel path, or clearly better accuracy at comparable execution complexity.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and separate the three existing solution families: stronger transformations, mixed precision, and non-uniform quantization. Then read the method figure. The main idea is not just another rotation trick; it is to turn outlier channels into offsets that the quantizer zero-point can absorb.

In the method section, focus on four details: how top-1 PCA is defined and estimated, why the rotation can concentrate outliers into one channel, how channel grouping and reordering are constructed, and how the Hadamard transform makes offset absorption compatible with a standard quantizer. If those pieces are mathematically clean, the method is likely practical.

In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison table, activation-statistics plots, and latency or throughput results. If time is limited, first compare against QuaRot, SpinQuant, and mixed-precision baselines, then check the ablations. Estimated reading time is around 20 minutes. If you care about serving or low-cost model evaluation, it is worth reading the implementation details as well, because deployment simplicity is a major part of the contribution.

recommendation.zh: W4A4KV4量化方向的扎实工程工作，top-1 PCA+offset思路值得参考；关注实验部分具体效果数据。
recommendation.en: Solid engineering work on W4A4KV4 quantization; top-1 PCA + offset approach worth noting—read the experiment section for concrete performance data.

institutions: Swiss Data Science Center, ETHZ & EPFL

paper.title: SigmaScale: LLM Compression with SVD-based Low-Rank Decomposition and Learned Scaling Matrices
paper.abstract: We present SigmaScale, a method for learning auxiliary scaling matrices $S$ to aid truncated Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) based Large Language Model (LLM) compression. Instead of deriving scaling matrices analytically, SigmaScale optimizes two sets of vectors that define diagonal row and column scaling transformations under an activation-aware compression loss. We show that learned scaling lowers the effective intrinsic rank of weight matrices, as reflected by reductions in effective-rank

summary.core_problem: 在基于截断 SVD 的 LLM 低秩压缩中，如何通过可学习缩放变换进一步降低压缩误差并提升压缩后性能。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的模型压缩工作，不直接推进预训练方法，但对理解权重矩阵可压缩性、激活感知压缩目标以及低秩结构的可塑性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SigmaScale，在做 SVD 低秩分解前，不再使用解析式缩放矩阵，而是学习两组对角缩放向量，对权重矩阵做行/列缩放变换。训练目标是 activation-aware compression loss。论文还用 effective-rank entropy 作为分析工具，声称学习到的缩放会降低有效内在秩，并且这一变化与压缩损失相关。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 上进行，与相近的 SVD 压缩方法比较，指标包括 perplexity 和 zero-shot benchmark。结论是 SigmaScale 与现有 SVD-based 方法大体相当，在部分任务上更好。摘要没有给出明确压缩倍率和稳定领先幅度，因此更像是局部改良而非明显跃迁。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Aalborg University Copenhagen、University of Genoa、CERN 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to reduce error in truncated-SVD compression of LLMs by learning scaling transformations instead of using analytically derived ones.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and compression paper rather than a pretraining contribution. Its main value for a foundation-model researcher is the perspective on weight compressibility, activation-aware objectives, and how much low-rank structure can be reshaped by simple learned transforms.
summary_en.technical_approach: SigmaScale learns two sets of diagonal row/column scaling vectors applied before truncated SVD, replacing fixed analytical scaling rules. The optimization target is an activation-aware compression loss. The paper also analyzes effective-rank entropy and argues that learned scaling lowers the effective intrinsic rank of weight matrices, which correlates with compression loss.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Qwen3-8B, compared against closely related SVD-based compression baselines using perplexity and zero-shot benchmarks. The reported outcome is competitive overall, with gains on some tasks. The abstract does not show a clear compression-ratio-versus-quality frontier or large margins, so this reads more like a careful local improvement than a major shift.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with Aalborg University Copenhagen, the University of Genoa, CERN, and others.

recommendation.zh: 是个干净的 SVD 小改进，不会改变你对压缩的总体判断；若你关心低秩可塑性，只看 effective-rank 分析和压缩损失相关性即可。
recommendation.en: A clean but local SVD tweak; it will not change your overall compression prior, but the effective-rank analysis is worth a quick look if you care about low-rank plasticity.

institutions: European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN), Geneva

paper.title: YouZhi: Towards High-Concurrency Financial LLMs via Adaptive GQA-to-MLA Transition
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) drive significant financial innovations, yet their high-concurrency deployment is severely bottlenecked by KV cache memory overhead, which inflates infrastructure costs and throttles scalability. To address this, we propose YouZhi-LLM, a highly efficient financial LLM empowered by a comprehensive structural transition and training pipeline natively built on the Huawei Ascend ecosystem. At its algorithmic core, YouZhi-LLM features a layer-adaptive GQA-to-MLA transitio

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很实际、但常被金融垂类模型忽略的问题：如何把已有 GQA 架构的大模型改造成更适合高并发线上服务的 MLA 架构，同时尽量不伤害原有语言建模能力和金融领域能力。难点不在于“能不能转”，而在于“怎么转得细”。论文全文的关键发现是，GQA→MLA 转换带来的困惑度退化具有明显层间异质性：浅层更能接受较大的 FreqFold 压缩，部分中层则对 RoPE 频率近似更敏感，统一配置会把本来可控的结构改造变成不必要的能力损失。因此核心问题被具体化为：在给定 KV cache 压缩目标下，如何做逐层自适应的结构迁移，并配合后续训练把结构损伤和领域能力缺口补回来。
summary.importance: 对预训练/基座研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它说明“架构改造”和“后训练恢复”可以作为一个连续流程来设计，而不是先压缩、再单独补救。对于已经训练完成的大模型，这是一种介于重新预训练和纯推理优化之间的中间路线。第二，它给出一个较清楚的信号：注意力结构的可替换性不是全层均匀的，层功能分化会直接决定结构迁移的代价。这一点对后续做 GQA/MQA/MLA/混合注意力、甚至 MoE 层级异构设计都有参考意义。贡献量级上，它更像一篇工程导向但方法上有实质内容的系统论文，不是新的预训练范式，但对“如何把已有基座模型改造成可部署模型”这件事有较强现实价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是逐层退化分析。作者在 partial RoPE stage 做单层替换实验：一次只把一个 GQA 层改成 MLA，其余层保持不变，然后测困惑度变化。这样可以把不同层对 FreqFold 的敏感性拆开看。结果显示，浅层在较大 FreqFold 下反而更稳，说明主成分压缩收益大于频率近似误差；中层则更依赖精确频率信息，FreqFold=1 往往最好。

第二部分是 layer-adaptive GQA-to-MLA transition。作者把每层 FreqFold 选择写成组合优化问题，但直接穷举不可行，于是改写成多轮顺序决策，逐层分配压缩配置，目标是在整体 KV 压缩和困惑度退化之间找更优折中。虽然给出的摘要片段没有完整展开算法细节，但从全文脉络看，核心不是训练一个复杂控制器，而是利用前面的层敏感性分析，把统一超参替换成逐层可变配置。这一点与常见“一刀切 MLA 转换”区别很大。

第三部分是能力恢复与领域注入。结构迁移后，作者没有只做普通 SFT，而是设计了完整 post-training pipeline：包括分层数据压缩、金融领域数据增强、合规拒答数据构造、以及指令跟随强化。这里的逻辑很清楚：结构转换先解决服务瓶颈，但会损伤表示能力；后训练再把通用能力和金融能力拉回到可用区间。论文还强调其训练和部署都原生适配华为 Ascend 生态，并在 vLLM-Ascend 上实现 MLA operator，这使得方法不是停留在离线实验，而是能落到真实 serving 栈里。
summary.experiments: 实验里最重要的结果有三类。第一类是结构转换本身的收益。作者报告最终模型实现了 72% 的 KV cache 降低，以及 2.69× 的最大并发提升，这直接对应高并发金融场景的部署目标。第二类是逐层自适应优于统一转换。全文的关键证据来自 layer-wise perplexity degradation 曲线：不同层的最优 FreqFold 明显不同，说明统一配置不是 Pareto 最优。作者声称在多个主流 LLM 上，自适应分配相比 uniform conversion 能显著降低困惑度退化。第三类是后训练恢复效果。通过金融数据增强、拒答构造和指令强化，模型不仅补回了结构改造造成的能力损失，还在金融 benchmark 和真实手机银行任务上取得提升。摘要片段没有给出完整参数规模和全部 benchmark 数字，因此无法在这里精确复述每个表格的绝对分数；但从全文主线看，最该关注的不是单点分数，而是“精度-并发”Pareto 前沿是否整体右上移动，论文声称这一点成立。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。第一看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，理解作者到底在优化什么：不是单纯压缩，而是面向高并发金融服务的 accuracy-efficiency trade-off。第二看方法部分关于单层替换分析和 Figure 4，这基本是全文最有信息量的地方，决定了为什么必须做 layer-adaptive 而不是统一 FreqFold。第三看实验里关于 KV cache、最大并发、以及金融任务恢复效果的表格，判断这是不是“压缩后还能用”，还是“压缩后重新训回来了”。

预计 25-35 分钟可以完成有效泛读。若要深挖，重点看两点：一是逐层敏感性的来源，是否和层内频率编码使用方式、特征谱分布、或注意力头功能分工有关；二是 post-training 在恢复结构损伤时到底恢复了什么，是语言建模能力、指令能力，还是金融知识本身。前者关系到能否推广到别的架构迁移，后者关系到这种路线是否能替代部分持续预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a deployment-driven but technically nontrivial problem: how to convert existing GQA-based LLMs into MLA-style models for high-concurrency serving, while keeping the loss in language modeling quality and domain capability under control. The key observation from the full paper is that GQA-to-MLA conversion is not layer-uniform. Different layers react very differently to FreqFold compression during the partial-RoPE transition. Early layers can tolerate more aggressive folding, while some middle layers are much more sensitive to RoPE frequency approximation. So the real problem is not merely whether MLA can compress KV cache, but how to perform a layer-adaptive structural transition and then recover the lost capacity through targeted post-training.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, the main value is methodological rather than conceptual novelty. It shows that architectural conversion and capability recovery should be treated as one pipeline, not as separate compression and fine-tuning stages. This is useful for practitioners working with already-trained base models, where full re-pretraining is too expensive but pure inference-side optimization is insufficient. A second useful signal is that attention-structure substitutability is strongly layer-dependent. That matters beyond MLA: it is relevant to mixed attention designs, GQA/MQA/MLA hybrids, and more generally to heterogeneous layer design in large models. The contribution is best read as a solid systems-and-modeling paper with practical implications, not as a new pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three connected pieces. First, the authors run a layer-wise degradation study. In the partial-RoPE stage, they convert only one layer from GQA to MLA at a time while keeping all other layers unchanged, then measure perplexity degradation. This isolates each layer’s sensitivity to different FreqFold settings. The main finding is clear: shallow layers often prefer larger FreqFold values, suggesting that principal-component concentration helps more than frequency approximation hurts; middle layers often prefer FreqFold=1, meaning accurate RoPE frequency preservation matters more there.

Second, they build a layer-adaptive GQA-to-MLA transition algorithm. The per-layer FreqFold assignment is formulated as a combinatorial optimization problem, then reframed as a multi-round sequential decision process to avoid brute-force search over all layer configurations. The central idea is simple but important: replace a uniform conversion hyperparameter with a per-layer allocation strategy guided by measured sensitivity. That is the main methodological difference from one-shot, globally uniform MLA conversion.

Third, they add a post-training pipeline to recover capability and inject financial expertise. This includes stratified data compression, financial-domain augmentation, refusal-data construction for compliance scenarios, and instruction-following reinforcement. The logic is coherent: structural conversion solves the serving bottleneck, but it weakens representation quality; post-training is then used to restore general and domain-specific competence. The paper also emphasizes native implementation on Huawei Ascend and deployment through vLLM-Ascend with MLA operators, which makes the work more than an offline architecture study.
summary_en.experiments: The most important results fall into three groups. First, the serving gains are substantial: the final model reports a 72% reduction in KV-cache usage and a 2.69× increase in maximum concurrency. These are the headline numbers because the target setting is high-traffic financial deployment. Second, the layer-adaptive conversion outperforms uniform conversion. The evidence comes from the layer-wise perplexity degradation curves: the optimal FreqFold differs markedly by layer, so a single global setting is not Pareto-efficient. The paper reports lower perplexity degradation than uniform baselines across several mainstream LLM backbones. Third, the post-training pipeline recovers and improves task performance. With domain augmentation, refusal construction, and instruction reinforcement, the converted model not only regains capability lost during transition but also improves on financial benchmarks and real mobile-banking tasks. The provided text does not include the full model sizes or every benchmark score, so the most reliable takeaway is the shift of the accuracy-efficiency frontier rather than any single absolute metric.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. Start with the introduction and the first system-level figures to understand the actual optimization target: not generic compression, but the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under high-concurrency financial serving. Then go to the method section around the single-layer conversion analysis and the layer-wise degradation figure. That is the most informative part of the paper and the main reason the adaptive design is justified. Finally, inspect the tables on KV-cache reduction, concurrency, and financial-task recovery to judge whether the converted model remains practically usable.

A solid skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. If you want to go deeper, there are two worthwhile questions. One is why layer sensitivity differs: is it tied to RoPE usage, spectral structure of features, or functional specialization across layers? The other is what exactly post-training recovers after structural conversion: language modeling quality, instruction following, domain knowledge, or all three to different degrees. Those questions determine how transferable this recipe is to other architecture transitions.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §方法和消融表：GQA→MLA 的逐层改造若可复现，可作为存量模型降 KV 的现实路线。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: if the layerwise GQA-to-MLA conversion holds up, it is a practical path for reducing KV cost in existing models.

paper.title: When Attention Collapses: Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning from Structure to Semantics
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but suffer from significant computational overhead during inference. While visual token pruning offers a promising solution, existing methods predominantly rely on initial attention scores. This single-metric paradigm presents a critical flaw: high attention scores inherently collapse onto semantically similar regions, thereby severely reducing feature diversity and discarding vital contextual details. To address this, we in

summary.core_problem: 论文关注的是 VLM 推理阶段的视觉 token 剪枝，但切入点不是单纯追求更高压缩率，而是指出现有 attention-based pruning 的一个结构性问题：如果只按注意力分数保留 token，高分 token 会在语义上彼此靠近，形成局部聚集，结果是保留了很多相似区域，却丢掉了全局结构和上下文细节。作者要解决的核心问题，是如何让剪枝策略符合表示在不同阶段的演化规律：进入 LLM 之前先保住结构多样性，进入 LLM 之后再按任务语义做进一步筛选。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏高质量推理优化，而不是预训练本身。对基座研究的启发在两点。第一，它把视觉编码器和语言解码器中的表示动态分开分析，说明“一个统一重要性指标贯穿全流程”往往不成立，这对多模态统一建模、token budget 分配、以及未来训练时是否显式鼓励 token 多样性都有参考意义。第二，它揭示 attention score 不是天然可靠的 token saliency proxy，至少在视觉侧深层表示中会和特征相似性塌缩到一起。这个观察对做视觉 tokenizer、跨模态压缩、甚至训练期 token dropping 都有方法论价值。不过从筛选标准看，它主要属于 efficient/VLM inference 方向，和预训练的直接距离较远，适合泛读而非深挖。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 STS，Structure-to-Semantics，是一个 training-free 的两阶段剪枝框架。第一阶段发生在视觉编码器输出、送入 LLM 之前。作者不再直接按 attention 排序，而是把 token 选择写成一个受“势能/排斥”启发的采样目标：把每个视觉 token 看成特征空间中的带电粒子，语义越相似，排斥越强。这样选出的子集会主动避开语义上彼此过近的 token，从而保留更分散、更完整的结构信息。第二阶段发生在 LLM 中间层，利用 instruction-aware cross-attention 做语义相关性过滤，把与当前任务无关的视觉 token 再剪掉一部分。支撑这个设计的，是作者对两处表示动态的经验分析：在视觉编码器深层，feature-similar tokens 的 attention score 越来越相近，导致 attention 难以区分冗余 token；而在 LLM 解码器中，早层更偏广泛上下文聚合，深层才逐步集中到任务相关视觉区域。论文还提出了一个 KNN Consistency Score，用来量化“特征相近的 token 是否也拿到相近 attention 分数”，作为 attention collapse 的诊断指标。与已有单阶段 attention pruning 相比，STS 的区别不只是多加一步，而是把‘保结构多样性’和‘保任务语义’明确拆成两个阶段，并分别用不同信号处理。
summary.experiments: 实验在多个 VLM 和多个 benchmark 上做，目标是验证效率—性能折中。作者报告的主结论是：在较激进的 token reduction 下，STS 比单纯 attention-based pruning 更能维持任务性能，同时减少推理开销。经验分析部分先给出证据：在 LLaVA-1.5 上，随着视觉编码器层数加深，KNN Consistency Score 上升，说明 attention similarity 与 feature similarity 越来越绑定，单看 attention 更容易选出语义扎堆的 token。随后在下游评测中，STS 在相同保留 token 预算下通常优于对比方法，尤其在高压缩场景下更稳，因为第一阶段保住了全局结构覆盖，第二阶段再补上任务相关性。论文摘要和你提供的正文片段没有包含完整表格数值，因此这里不编造具体 latency、FLOPs 或准确率差值；阅读时应重点核对三类结果：不同压缩率下的性能曲线、两阶段各自的消融贡献、以及不同插入层位置对结果的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议按“分析先行，方法随后”的顺序。先看 Empirical Analysis，尤其是 KNN Consistency Score 的定义和随层深变化的图，这部分决定了作者为什么认为 attention-only pruning 不够。然后看 STS 的两阶段设计：视觉侧的 repulsion-based sampling 怎么实现，LLM 中间层的语义剪枝用什么信号、插在哪一层。实验部分重点看 efficiency-performance trade-off 曲线和消融表，确认收益来自阶段解耦，而不是简单多剪一次。若只是判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟左右足够；若要复现或迁移到别的 VLM，需要细看附录中的实现细节、复杂度分析和不同模型上的超参数设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies visual token pruning for VLM inference, but its main point is not just higher compression. It identifies a structural flaw in attention-based pruning: selecting tokens purely by attention tends to keep many semantically similar regions because high-attention tokens collapse into local clusters. That preserves redundancy while discarding global structure and contextual detail. The core problem is therefore stage mismatch: before the LLM, pruning should preserve structural diversity; inside the LLM, pruning should focus on task-specific semantics.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from two observations. First, it separates representation dynamics in the vision encoder from those in the language decoder, showing that one universal token-importance signal is often the wrong abstraction. That is useful for multimodal token budgeting, compression-aware architecture design, and possibly training-time token dropping. Second, it argues that attention scores are not a reliable saliency proxy on the visual side once deeper representations become semantically clustered. That insight may matter beyond pruning, including visual tokenizers and multimodal compression. Still, the direct connection to pretraining is limited, so this is better treated as a skim paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, STS (Structure-to-Semantics), is a training-free two-stage pruning framework. Stage one operates before visual tokens enter the LLM. Instead of ranking tokens only by attention, it formulates token selection with a potential-energy or repulsion-inspired objective: tokens are treated like charged particles in feature space, and semantically similar tokens repel each other more strongly. This encourages a selected subset that is spatially and semantically diverse, preserving global structure. Stage two operates inside an intermediate LLM layer and uses instruction-aware cross-attention to remove task-irrelevant visual tokens. The design is motivated by empirical analysis of representation dynamics. In deeper vision layers, feature-similar tokens receive increasingly similar attention scores, so attention loses discriminative power within local semantic neighborhoods. In the LLM decoder, earlier layers aggregate broad context while deeper layers become more task-focused. The paper also introduces a KNN Consistency Score to quantify how strongly feature similarity aligns with attention similarity, serving as a diagnostic for attention collapse. Compared with prior single-stage pruning methods, the novelty is not just adding another pruning step, but explicitly decoupling structural coverage from semantic relevance and using different signals for each stage.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on multiple VLMs and benchmarks to evaluate the efficiency-performance trade-off. The main result is that STS preserves task performance better than attention-based baselines under the same token budget, especially in aggressive pruning regimes. The empirical-analysis section first shows evidence for the claimed failure mode: on LLaVA-1.5, the KNN Consistency Score increases with vision-layer depth, indicating that attention similarity increasingly tracks feature similarity, which makes attention-only selection more redundant. Downstream evaluations then show that the two-stage strategy is more robust because stage one preserves global structural coverage and stage two restores task relevance. The excerpt provided here does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains in latency, FLOPs, or benchmark scores should be read from the main paper. The most useful results to inspect are the performance curves across pruning ratios, the ablations for each stage, and the sensitivity to the layer where semantic pruning is inserted.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good reading order is analysis first, method second. Start with the empirical-analysis section, especially the definition of the KNN Consistency Score and the layerwise plots showing attention collapse. That section explains why attention-only pruning is insufficient. Then read the STS method details: how the repulsion-based sampling is implemented before the LLM, what signal is used for semantic pruning inside the LLM, and where that pruning is applied. In the experiments, focus on efficiency-performance trade-off plots and ablation tables to verify that the gain comes from stage-aware decoupling rather than simply pruning more. Around 30 minutes is enough for a decision-level read. For reproduction or adaptation to another VLM, the appendix will matter for implementation details, complexity, and hyperparameter settings.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 VLM 视觉 token 剪枝中常见的 'attention collapse' 问题，提出的两阶段解耦策略（先结构多样性后语义过滤）对多模态模型的推理优化有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Identifies the 'attention collapse' issue in VLM visual token pruning. The proposed two-stage decoupled strategy (structural diversity followed by semantic filtering) offers insights for multimodal model inference optimization.

institutions: National University of Singapore (Suzhou) Research Institute

paper.title: Experience-Driven Dynamic Exits for LLMs with Reinforcement Learning

summary.core_problem: 研究如何让 LLM 在推理时根据样本难度动态选择提前退出层数，从而降低平均计算成本。
summary.importance: 贡献点是推理效率和动态计算分配：early exit 对 serving 成本有直接意义，也会影响我们如何评估不同层深度承载的语义与推理能力。它不是预训练方法，但对架构效率和训练-推理接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 从题名看，方法使用强化学习训练一个动态退出策略，根据历史经验或当前 token/样本状态决定是否继续经过更深层。核心问题应包括退出奖励如何平衡准确率与延迟、是否需要额外分类头或 confidence estimator、策略是否能跨任务泛化。
summary.experiments: 未提供摘要，无法确认模型规模、任务、硬件延迟、baseline 或节省比例。需要重点看是否报告真实 wall-clock latency，而不仅是 FLOPs 或层数节省；也要看长生成中逐 token 退出是否稳定。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School、Pengcheng Laboratory、Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab、Northwestern Polytechnical University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how an LLM can dynamically choose early-exit layers at inference time based on sample difficulty, reducing average compute cost.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in inference efficiency and dynamic compute allocation. Early exit matters for serving cost and also informs how semantic and reasoning capability is distributed across layers. It is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to architecture efficiency and the training-inference interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on the title, the method trains a reinforcement-learning policy to decide whether to exit or continue to deeper layers using experience or current token/sample state. Key questions are how the reward trades accuracy against latency, whether extra heads or confidence estimators are required, and whether the policy transfers across tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is unavailable, so the model sizes, tasks, hardware latency, baselines, and savings are unknown. The important check is whether the paper reports real wall-clock latency rather than only FLOPs or saved layers, and whether token-level exits remain stable during long generation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Pengcheng Laboratory, Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab, and Northwestern Polytechnical University.

recommendation.zh: 看 latency 表和退出策略泛化即可；early-exit 若只报 FLOPs，通常高估 serving 收益。
recommendation.en: Check the latency table and policy transfer; early-exit work that reports only FLOPs usually overstates serving gains.

paper.title: Entropy Gate: Entropy Quenching for Near-Lossless Token Compression in LLM Pipelines
paper.abstract: LLM pipelines waste substantial token budgets on low-information content: repeated context, verbose responses, and redundant boilerplate. We introduce Entropy Gate, a token compression framework applying entropy quenching $-$ a thermodynamic process that progressively freezes out low-energy tokens while preserving semantic fidelity. Each token receives a multi-factor information energy $E(t)$ combining statistical, structural, and positional components. An adaptive quenching schedule $T(τ) = T_0

summary.core_problem: 在不明显损伤语义的前提下压缩 LLM pipeline 中冗余 token，降低上下文和响应的 token 成本。
summary.importance: 这是推理侧 token compression 工作。问题本身对 serving 和长上下文成本有现实意义，但从摘要看包装术语较多，真正的新机制和与现有 summarization/pruning 方法的差异还需要谨慎核查。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Entropy Gate，为每个 token 定义结合统计、结构和位置因素的信息能量，再用类似退火/淬火的 schedule 逐步删除低能 token；同时设置 fidelity gate，当能量加权相似度低于阈值时停止压缩。论文还给出若干关于按能量排序保留 token 的理论性质。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称启发式第一阶段可实现 40%-60% 压缩，并保持接近无损的语义保真，但未在摘要中给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 或与已有 context compression 方法的定量对比，因此实验说服力目前偏弱。

summary_en.core_problem: To reduce token cost in LLM pipelines by compressing redundant context and verbose outputs while preserving semantics.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-side token compression paper. The problem matters for serving and long-context cost, but the abstract is heavy on thermodynamic framing, so the actual novelty relative to existing pruning/summarization methods needs careful checking.
summary_en.technical_approach: Entropy Gate assigns each token an information-energy score combining statistical, structural, and positional factors, then applies an adaptive quenching schedule to remove low-energy tokens. A fidelity gate stops compression when energy-weighted similarity falls below a threshold. The paper also states theoretical properties for energy-ranked token retention.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims a heuristic phase achieves 40%–60% compression with near-lossless semantic fidelity, but it does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative comparisons against prior context-compression methods, so the empirical case remains unclear from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 题目对 serving 成本有现实意义，但摘要里“热力学”味太重；先只看实验表和 ablation，若 baseline 不含现成 context compression，就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: The serving problem is real, but the thermodynamic framing looks heavier than the likely contribution; read the tables and ablations only, and treat it as weak evidence if standard context-compression baselines are missing.

paper.title: TGV-KV: Text-Grounded KV Eviction for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) inherit the auto-regressive generation paradigm and cache the keys and values (KV) of all previous tokens to accelerate inference, resulting in memory consumption that scales linearly with context length. This issue is particularly pronounced in VLMs due to substantial redundancy in the visual modality. Although KV cache eviction approaches can effectively reduce inference memory, they often incur significant performance degradation in VLMs, as most are designed for

summary.core_problem: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的KV缓存内存随上下文线性增长，且视觉模态存在大量冗余；现有KV缓存驱逐方法因忽视文本-视觉模态鸿沟导致在VLM上性能显著下降
summary.importance: 系统性分析了VLM中文本与视觉的模态鸿沟，提出文本引导的KV缓存驱逐策略，属于VLM推理效率的增量工作
summary.technical_approach: TGV-KV包含三个子模块：文本-视觉预算分配（TVB）基于互信息交互为每层分配预算；文本加权排序（TWR）评估优先级；第三个模块用于实际驱逐
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM benchmark上与现有KV eviction方法对比，声称在保持性能的同时显著减少内存。具体模型规模和提升幅度摘要中未详述
summary.authors_note: 机构未在提供信息中明确列出；Jizhihui Liu等

summary_en.core_problem: VLM KV-cache memory grows linearly with context length and visual tokens have high redundancy; existing KV eviction methods suffer significant performance drops on VLMs because they ignore the text-vision modality gap
summary_en.importance: Systematic analysis of the text-vision modality gap in VLMs; proposes text-guided KV eviction as an incremental advance in VLM inference efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: TGV-KV has three submodules: Text-Vision Budgeting (TVB) assigns per-layer budgets based on mutual information interaction; Text-Weighted Ranking (TWR) assesses token priority; plus an eviction mechanism
summary_en.experiments: Compared with existing KV eviction methods on multiple VLM benchmarks; claims significant memory reduction while preserving performance. Specific model sizes and quantitative margins not detailed in the abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions not clearly listed in provided information; Jizhihui Liu et al.

recommendation.zh: 文本引导视觉KV排序是合理观察，但属增量推理优化，对pretrain研究员价值有限，看摘要和Fig 2即可
recommendation.en: Text-guided visual KV ranking is a sensible observation but incremental inference optimization; limited value for pretraining researchers; read only abstract and Figure 2

paper.title: ART: Attention Run-time Termination for Efficient Large Language Model Decoding

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文解码里的一个很具体、也很硬的瓶颈：注意力计算并不总是需要把全部 KV cache 都读完，但现有方法大多在解码前用 key-only 规则做静态裁剪，无法在真正执行 attention 时根据 key 和 value 的联合作用决定“后面的 KV block 还值不值得继续读”。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在 FlashAttention 这类流式 kernel 内部，用几乎不增加额外开销的方式，在线判断当前 query 的注意力输出是否已经基本收敛，从而提前终止后续 KV block 的访存与计算。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是训练范式论文，而是推理侧的 kernel-level 方法。但它有两点启发比较实在。第一，它指出现有大量 KV 管理方法把 token 重要性近似成 key 或 attention score 的函数，这个近似和最终输出影响并不一致；真正决定输出的是 softmax 权重和 value 向量共同形成的加权和。第二，它把“输出是否收敛”变成运行时信号，而不是预估信号，这种思路比离线 importance predictor 更贴近真实计算路径，也更容易和已有 pruning/eviction 方法叠加。量级上看，它更像一个可组合的系统优化模块，而不是改变解码范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 ART，Attention Run-time Termination。它利用 FlashAttention 的块式流式执行特性：KV 被分成多个 block 顺序处理，kernel 在每处理完一个 block 后，内部都会得到一次中间 attention 输出 O^(t)。论文的观察是，很多 query 的 O^(t) 会在遍历完整个 KV 序列之前就趋于稳定，后续 block 对输出的增量很小。

因此 ART 不再提前预测哪些 token 重要，而是在 kernel 执行过程中直接监控中间输出的变化。终止判据不是单看幅值变化，也不是单看方向变化，而是同时看两件事：
1. scale stability：连续若干步中，输出更新量的范数是否已经足够小；
2. directional stability：更新方向是否已经和当前输出方向基本一致，说明后续只是在做很小的同向修正，而不是还存在明显的方向性重写。

这种设计的关键点在于，它试图近似“剩余未处理 KV 对最终输出的边际贡献是否可忽略”。只看 attention score 不够，因为高权重 token 的 value 可能接近零，低权重 token 的 value 也可能在某个方向上产生显著偏移。ART 直接在输出空间判断收敛，等于把 key-value 联合作用隐式纳入了判据。

从实现上，它嵌入在 block-wise attention kernel 内部，不需要额外训练 predictor，也不需要在解码前做离线分析。因为中间状态本来就在 FlashAttention 的 streaming softmax 过程中存在，所以额外成本主要是少量统计量维护和阈值判断。论文还强调它与已有 key-based KV 管理方法正交：先用外部方法缩小候选 KV，再由 ART 在运行时进一步提前停止，二者可以叠加。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在长上下文生成场景和 LongBench 上做，关注吞吐、延迟和质量保持。论文给出的主结论是：在大 batch 解码时，相比已有基线，ART 带来超过 20% 的 generation throughput 提升，同时生成质量损失可以忽略。这个结果的重要前提是 ART 不是单独替代所有 KV 管理方法，而是作为运行时 refinement 模块叠加到现有方法上，因此收益来自两部分：减少无效 KV block 读取，以及减少对应的 attention 计算。

从文中描述看，作者做了几类关键分析：
1. 输出收敛性可视化：展示 O^(t) 随 block 处理快速收敛，说明“提前停”不是拍脑袋，而是 attention kernel 的常见行为；
2. key-only 信号失配案例：给出 attention score 与真实输出影响不一致的例子，支撑 value-aware 的必要性；
3. 阈值与质量权衡：不同 termination threshold 下，吞吐提升和任务精度之间存在平滑 trade-off；
4. 与已有 KV 方法组合：ART 叠加后仍能继续提速，说明它捕捉到的是静态裁剪没覆盖的运行时冗余。

摘要里没有给出完整模型规模、上下文长度和全部 benchmark 数字；如果要复现或判断泛化性，需要重点看实验节里具体使用的 backbone、batch size、prompt/generation 长度，以及不同任务上质量退化是否均匀。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不是理论，而是机制和实现边界。

建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2/3/4，先建立三个判断：为什么 key-only pruning 不够；FlashAttention 为什么天然暴露中间输出；中间输出为什么会提前收敛。然后精看方法部分里 termination criterion 的定义，尤其是 scale 和 direction 两个稳定性量是怎么计算的、窗口长度和阈值怎么设、是否按 head 或 token 粒度判断。这里决定了方法是否稳，以及是否容易在不同模型上迁移。

实验部分重点看三类表图：
1. throughput/latency 提升在不同 batch size 下的变化；
2. 与现有 KV pruning/eviction 方法叠加后的收益；
3. 质量退化最明显的任务类型，判断 ART 是否更适合检索型长上下文，而不太适合需要远距离稀疏关键信息的任务。

如果只花 20-30 分钟，读方法总览、终止判据、主结果表和一组消融就够了。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是终止判据是否能给出误差上界，二是这种 output-convergence 信号能否反过来用于训练时的稀疏注意力或自适应上下文建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in long-context decoding: many attention computations do not need to read the entire KV cache, yet most prior methods make static, key-centric pruning decisions before decoding. That misses the fact that the final attention output depends on keys and values jointly. The core problem here is how to decide, during FlashAttention-style execution and with negligible overhead, whether the attention output for a query has already stabilized enough that the remaining KV blocks can be skipped.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-side systems paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it carries two useful lessons for foundation-model work. First, it makes explicit that key-only importance proxies are misaligned with actual output influence; the output is determined by the weighted sum over values, not by attention scores alone. Second, it replaces offline importance estimation with a runtime convergence signal taken from the real computation path. That makes the method more faithful to actual model behavior and naturally composable with existing KV pruning or eviction schemes. The contribution is best viewed as a practical kernel-level refinement, not a change in the decoding paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, ART (Attention Run-time Termination), exploits a property of FlashAttention-style blockwise execution. Keys and values are processed block by block, and after each block the kernel already maintains an intermediate attention output O^(t). The paper observes that for many queries, O^(t) stabilizes well before all KV blocks are consumed.

Instead of predicting token importance ahead of time, ART monitors the evolution of these intermediate outputs during kernel execution. The termination rule is based on output stability in two senses:
1. scale stability: whether the norm of the incremental update has become sufficiently small over recent steps;
2. directional stability: whether the update direction is no longer meaningfully changing the output direction, indicating only minor same-direction corrections remain.

This matters because attention-score-based criteria are incomplete. A token can receive nontrivial attention weight but contribute little if its value vector is uninformative; conversely, a lower-weight token can still shift the output in an important direction through its value. By checking convergence directly in output space, ART implicitly captures the joint effect of keys and values.

Implementation-wise, ART is inserted into the blockwise attention kernel itself. It does not require a learned predictor, offline preprocessing, or extra passes over the cache. Since the relevant intermediate states already exist in the streaming softmax computation, the added cost is mainly lightweight bookkeeping and threshold checks. The paper also emphasizes orthogonality: ART can be layered on top of existing key-based KV management methods, acting as a runtime refinement after static candidate reduction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. The main value is in the mechanism and its implementation boundary, not in deep theory.

Start with the introduction and the early figures. Three questions matter: why key-only pruning is insufficient, why FlashAttention naturally exposes intermediate outputs, and why those outputs often converge early. Then read the termination criterion carefully: how scale and direction are defined, whether stability is tracked per head or per token, and how thresholds or windows are chosen. That part determines whether the method is robust and portable.

In the experiments, focus on three things:
1. how throughput gains change with batch size;
2. whether ART still helps when combined with existing KV pruning or eviction methods;
3. which task types show the largest quality drop, if any.

A 20-30 minute read is enough for the method overview, the criterion, the main result table, and one ablation. The deeper questions are whether the stopping rule can be tied to an error bound, and whether the same output-convergence signal could inform adaptive sparse attention during training.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作常见问题是 wall-clock 不兑现或只在 toy setup 有效；先看是否真和 FlashAttention+KV cache 兼容，再决定要不要细读。
recommendation.en: These papers often save FLOPs but not latency; first check real wall-clock gains on top of FlashAttention and KV cache before spending time.

paper.title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods

summary.core_problem: 扩散式推测解码中，当草稿生成变得廉价后，瓶颈转移到了目标模型的验证阶段。现有树形验证方法按边际概率排序候选节点，忽略了验证是前缀条件的——被拒绝前缀下的子孙节点虽有高边际概率但无法到达，造成验证开销浪费且接受长度提升有限。
summary.importance: 揭示了扩散草稿树验证的核心低效原因：边际概率排序与前缀条件验证的结构性失配。对推测解码系统设计有直接的工程参考价值，尤其在扩散草稿器逐步实用化的背景下。
summary.technical_approach: TAPS 引入两个关键改进：(1) 一个轻量级可学习评分器，沿草稿路径估计每个候选 token 的条件接受概率，替代基于边际置信度的选择；(2) 代价感知的动态树剪枝，将接受概率沿候选树传播，在验证预算约束下贪婪选择一个紧凑的前缀闭合子树，最大化预期接受 token 数。
summary.experiments: 在 3 个目标模型和 2 个 GPU 平台上，TAPS 平均加速 5.44×，比 DFlash 和 DDTree 分别高 1.36× 和 1.74×。诊断性实验表明：目标接受 token 有 99% 出现在草稿器 top-8 边际候选中，说明候选池通常足够；但在预算前缀闭合树中，后期位置仍丢失 10-15% 的正确 token，印证正确 token 常在局部池中但被置于错误前缀下。验证预算从 64 节点扩到 512 节点时，延迟从 33ms 增至 81ms，而验证效率持续下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 2 节 Motivation，其中图 3 的三个诊断图清晰揭示了现有方法的结构性问题，值得仔细理解；第 3 节方法中的目标感知评分器设计和动态树选择算法；第 4 节的端到端吞吐量对比图。预估阅读时间 30-40 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息未在提供的片段中完整给出，从行文引用判断为活跃于 LLM 推理优化方向的研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: In diffusion-based speculative decoding, once draft generation becomes cheap, the bottleneck shifts to target-model verification. Existing tree-verification methods rank candidate nodes by marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned—descendants under rejected prefixes waste verification budget despite high marginal scores, yielding limited acceptance-length gains.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a fundamental structural mismatch between marginal-probability ranking and prefix-conditioned verification in diffusion draft trees. Offers direct engineering insights for speculative decoding systems, particularly as diffusion drafters become practical.
summary_en.technical_approach: TAPS introduces two key improvements: (1) a lightweight learned scorer that estimates conditional acceptance probability of each candidate token along its drafted path, replacing marginal-confidence-based selection; (2) cost-aware dynamic tree pruning that propagates acceptance probabilities through the candidate tree and greedily selects a compact prefix-closed subtree maximizing expected accepted tokens under a verification budget.
summary_en.experiments: Across 3 target models and 2 GPU platforms, TAPS achieves average 5.44× speedup, outperforming DFlash and DDTree by 1.36× and 1.74× respectively. Diagnostic experiments show: the target-accepted token appears in the drafter's top-8 marginal candidates 99% of the time (local pool is usually sufficient); yet budgeted prefix-closed trees still lose 10-15% of correct tokens at later positions (correct tokens exist locally but under wrong prefixes). Verification latency grows from 33ms to 81ms when expanding the budget from 64 to 512 nodes, with steadily declining efficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 Motivation and its three diagnostic figures (Figure 3) that cleanly expose the structural problem; Section 3 for the target-aware scorer and dynamic tree selection algorithm; Section 4 for end-to-end throughput comparisons. Estimated reading time: 30-40 min.
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliations not fully specified in the provided excerpts; the work is from researchers active in LLM inference optimization.

recommendation.zh: 只看 tree selection 部分；它抓住了验证前缀条件化这个细节，适合和内部 spec-decoding 实现对照。
recommendation.en: Skim the tree-selection section; the prefix-conditioned verification point is concrete enough to compare against internal speculative-decoding code.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: Extreme Low-Bit Inference in Reasoning Models: Failure Modes and Targeted Recovery
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) rely on long reasoning traces, making inference expensive. While low-bit quantization reduces per-token decoding cost, we show that aggressive 2-bit inference can fail to deliver end-to-end speedup because instability in the generation process inflates total token count. Instead of merely lowering answer accuracy, 2-bit quantization often produces much longer traces with repetitive loops, budget exhaustion, delayed commitment, and unclosed reasoning segments. We ana

summary.core_problem: 推理大模型的2比特等极低比特量化方案的效果退化机制缺乏清晰认知，现有评估仅关注最终答案准确率，混淆了量化、提示词格式、解码策略等多种变量的影响，无法定位低比特推理的具体故障点；同时推理过程中累积的量化误差对长推理轨迹的影响尚未被系统性分析。
summary.importance: 明确了极低比特量化对推理模型的损伤并非主要来自任务求解能力下降，而是推理过程的动态行为异常，为推理模型的压缩优化和预训练阶段的量化感知训练提供了具体的优化靶点，打破了“量化精度下降仅源于权重表示误差”的传统认知。
summary.technical_approach: 采用控制变量实验设置，固定提示词、解码策略、生成长度预算等变量，仅对比FP16、W4A16、W2A16 GPTQ量化的效果差异；除最终答案准确率外，引入推理长度、触发生成上限比例、think标签闭合率、首个答案出现位置、循环率等5个推理轨迹级指标，拆分量化故障为两类：路径寻找失败（进入循环前未生成有效答案）、提交失败（生成有效答案后未停止推理而是重复验证/重述）。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-32B两个规模的模型上测试，覆盖数学、常识推理共8个基准；2比特量化下，准确率下降伴随推理轨迹稳定性明显下降，循环率、触发生成上限比例上升，think标签闭合率下降；小模型（8B）的轨迹退化程度远大于大模型（32B）；准确率下降幅度与轨迹退化指标高度相关，更长的推理输出在2比特量化下多为非生产性的重复推理而非有效探索；两类故障在2比特量化下均被显著放大，小模型的故障覆盖几乎所有基准，大模型的故障集中在AIME、MATH、GPQA等高难度推理任务。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章推理轨迹分析部分和对应的图表，第4章的故障模式分类；泛读实验设置和生成长度预算的影响分析，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The degradation mechanism of extreme low-bit quantization such as 2-bit for large reasoning models lacks clear understanding. Existing evaluations only focus on final answer accuracy, confound the effects of multiple variables including quantization, prompt formatting, and decoding strategies, and cannot locate specific failure points of low-bit reasoning. Meanwhile, the impact of accumulated quantization errors during inference on long reasoning trajectories has not been systematically analyzed.
summary_en.importance: This work clarifies that the damage of extreme low-bit quantization to reasoning models does not mainly come from reduced task-solving ability, but from abnormal dynamic behavior of the reasoning process. It provides specific optimization targets for compression optimization of reasoning models and quantization-aware training during pretraining, breaking the traditional perception that "quantization accuracy degradation only originates from weight representation errors".
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled experimental setup is adopted, with fixed variables including prompts, decoding strategies, and generation length budgets, only comparing the performance differences between FP16, W4A16, and W2A16 GPTQ quantization. In addition to final answer accuracy, five reasoning trajectory-level metrics are introduced: reasoning length, hit-limit rate, think-closed rate, time to first answer (TTFA), and loop rate. Quantization failures are split into two categories: path-finding failure (no valid answer generated before entering loops) and commitment failure (failure to stop reasoning after generating a valid answer, instead repeating verification or restatement).
summary_en.experiments: Tests are conducted on Qwen3 models at two scales, 8B and 32B, covering 8 mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks. Under 2-bit quantization, accuracy drops are accompanied by significantly reduced reasoning trajectory stability, with increased loop rate and hit-limit rate, and decreased think-closed rate. The trajectory degradation of the smaller 8B model is far more severe than that of the 32B model. The magnitude of accuracy drop is highly correlated with trajectory degradation metrics; longer reasoning outputs under 2-bit quantization are mostly unproductive repeated reasoning rather than effective exploration. Both failure modes are significantly amplified under 2-bit quantization, with failures in the small model covering almost all benchmarks, while failures in the large model are concentrated on high-difficulty reasoning tasks such as AIME, MATH, and GPQA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for reasoning trajectory analysis and corresponding figures, and Chapter 4 for failure mode classification. Skim the experimental setup and analysis of generation budget impact, with an estimated reading time of 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了长推理模型在极低比特量化下特有的 'token 膨胀/死循环' 失效模式，对后训练和推理部署极具启发，建议重点看其失效模式分析。
recommendation.en: Reveals the unique 'token inflation/infinite loop' failure modes of long reasoning models under extreme low-bit quantization; highly inspiring for post-training and inference deployment. Focus on the failure mode analysis.

paper.title: SENSE: Semantic Embedding Navigation with Soft-gated Evaluation for Retrieval-based Speculative Decoding

summary.core_problem: SENSE 解决的是检索式 speculative decoding 中的词面刚性问题：候选片段通常依赖 token 级前缀或精确匹配，导致语义相近但表面形式不同的 draft 被检索不到或被验证阶段拒绝。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在推理效率，而不是预训练方法。对基座研究员的启发在于，它把 speculative decoding 的瓶颈从“更强 draft model”转向“更好的候选表示与验证准则”。如果候选来自检索库而不是生成模型，就没有 draft logits，传统基于概率分布校正的 SD 方法很难直接使用。SENSE 给出了一条替代路线：用目标模型 hidden state 做语义检索锚点，再用更宽松但受控的验证规则提高接受长度。这对大模型 serving、长文本生成加速、异构 tokenizer 场景都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两个核心模块组成。第一是 Semantic Embedding Navigation。它不只用目标模型当前 greedy token 作为检索键，而是把目标模型在当前 prefix 上的 hidden state 与预测 token 一起投影成 query embedding，再从静态 datastore 和动态上下文中检索长度最多为 M 的候选片段。这样做的动机是：hidden state 比离散 token 保留更多语义和上下文意图，能扩大候选池，减少对词面前缀的依赖。第二是 Soft-gated Evaluation。验证阶段仍然用目标模型对 prefix+draft 做 batched forward，但不是所有位置都要求精确 token match。它根据目标分布熵做 gating：高置信位置保持严格匹配，避免错误接受；高不确定位置允许基于 top-k 分布对齐的软验证，以保留语义等价但表面不同的候选。为控制大 batch 验证开销，方法还引入 parallelized neighborhood fusion，把候选邻域并行融合验证。和常规 RSD 相比，SENSE 的核心区别是同时放松检索键和验证准则，但仍把目标模型作为最终裁判，因此保持 training-free 和 plug-and-play。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaMA 和 Qwen 系列 backbone。论文报告最高 3.26× 解码加速，平均每次 decoding step 接受 4.09 个 token。关键实验关注 acceptance length、speedup、不同 backbone、不同检索候选设置和验证策略的影响。消融的主要信息是：只扩大检索空间不足以稳定提升，因为语义相近候选仍会在严格验证中被拒；只做软验证也不够，因为检索阶段如果仍受词面约束，候选质量和多样性有限。SEN 与 SE 组合后，接受长度和端到端速度才同时改善。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 中 SEN 的 query 构造、静态/动态 datastore 的使用方式，以及 SE 的 entropy-guided gating 规则。实验部分优先看 speedup 与 acceptance length 的主表、SEN/SE 消融、batch 验证开销分析。若关注 serving，可继续看统一 SD testbed 的组件拆分方式，因为它有助于比较不同 speculative decoding 方法时避免实现差异带来的偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: SENSE targets a rigidity problem in retrieval-based speculative decoding: retrieved drafts are usually tied to token-level prefixes or exact lexical matches, so semantically valid continuations can be missed during retrieval or rejected during verification.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about inference efficiency rather than pretraining. Its useful signal for foundation-model researchers is the shift from building a stronger draft model to improving candidate representation and acceptance criteria. Retrieval-based drafts do not naturally provide logits, which makes many distribution-correction techniques in speculative decoding hard to apply. SENSE instead uses target-model hidden states for semantic retrieval and a controlled soft verification rule to increase accepted length. This is relevant for serving large models, long-form generation, and heterogeneous-tokenizer settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. Semantic Embedding Navigation builds the retrieval query from the target model hidden state under the current prefix, together with the current greedy anchor token. This projected query is used to retrieve candidate continuations from static datastores and dynamic contexts. The reason is straightforward: hidden states carry richer semantic intent than a discrete next-token key, so the candidate pool is less constrained by surface-form overlap. Soft-gated Evaluation then verifies prefix-plus-draft batches with the target model, but it does not enforce exact token matching everywhere. It uses entropy as a gate: low-entropy positions remain strict, while uncertain positions can be accepted through top-k distributional alignment. The paper also uses parallelized neighborhood fusion to reduce the overhead of verifying many retrieved candidates. Compared with standard RSD, SENSE relaxes both retrieval and verification, while keeping the target model as the final verifier and requiring no training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on LLaMA and Qwen backbones. The paper reports up to 3.26× decoding speedup and a mean accepted length of 4.09 tokens per decoding step. The key metrics are acceptance length, end-to-end speedup, and verification overhead under different retrieval and gating configurations. The ablations support a useful point: broadening retrieval alone is not enough, because semantically similar drafts can still be rejected by exact matching; soft verification alone is also limited if the candidate set remains lexically narrow. The gains come from combining hidden-state retrieval with entropy-aware soft verification.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. Focus on the Method section for the SEN query construction, the use of static and dynamic datastores, and the entropy-guided SE rule. In the experiments, read the main speedup and accepted-length tables, the SEN/SE ablations, and the analysis of batched verification cost. For serving-oriented readers, the unified speculative-decoding testbed is also useful because it decomposes SD methods into comparable primitives.

recommendation.zh: 检索式 spec decoding 的关键是端到端 latency；只看 acceptance-rate/overhead 表，别只信 token/s。
recommendation.en: For retrieval-based speculative decoding, end-to-end latency is the real metric; inspect acceptance-rate and overhead tables, not just tokens/sec.

paper.title: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-model-based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown broad automation capabilities, yet deployment is bottlenecked by a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with interaction steps. For instance, UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76 GB of GPU memory on merely five screenshots, approaching the capacity of mainstream 80 GB accelerators. Existing KV compression methods share two structural assumptions: aggregating visual-token importance into a single shared saliency map, and apply

summary.core_problem: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的 GUI 智能体在处理多帧高分辨率截图时，KV Cache 会随交互步数线性增长，导致显存耗尽（如 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 处理 5 张截图即消耗 76GB 显存）。现有的 KV Cache 压缩方法假设所有注意力头共享单一显著性图，且采用固定的 Top-B 截断策略，这在 GUI 场景下会导致空间布局信息丢失和分布漂移问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了 GUI 场景下注意力机制的两个核心特性：子空间级别的空间特化（Spatial Specialization）和随时间步漂移的注意力熵（Entropy Drift）。提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的 KV Cache 压缩方案，为长上下文 GUI 智能体的部署提供了实用的显存优化手段。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STaR-KV 框架，包含三个核心机制：1) 在线空间分析（Online Spatial Profiling）：计算注意力子空间与 2D 屏幕坐标的互信息，保留对布局敏感的子空间信息；2) 累积时间稳定性衰减（Cumulative Temporal Stability Discount）：根据子空间在多帧间的稳定性，对历史视觉 Token 进行加权，抑制静态 UI 元素的冗余缓存，保留动态组件的 Token；3) 自适应熵锐化（Adaptive Entropy-Based Sharpening）：根据注意力分布的归一化熵动态调整温度参数，替代固定的 Top-B 截断，在平缓分布下避免任意截断，在尖峰分布下增强选择性。
summary.experiments: 在多个 GUI 智能体基准测试上，STaR-KV 无需微调即可应用于 UI-TARS 和 OpenCUA 等模型。在相同的显存预算下，其平均性能优于现有的 SOTA KV 压缩方法（如 GUIKV、SnapKV）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中的 Pilot 1 和 Pilot 2，这两个实验清晰地揭示了现有方法的盲区。Method 部分详细阐述了三个核心机制的实现细节，特别是互信息的计算和自适应熵锐化的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: GUI agents based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face severe memory bottlenecks due to the linear growth of KV cache with interaction steps when processing multiple high-resolution screenshots (e.g., UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76GB for just 5 screenshots). Existing KV cache compression methods assume a shared saliency map across all attention heads and apply a fixed Top-B cutoff, which leads to the loss of spatial layout information and distribution drift issues in GUI scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Reveals two core characteristics of attention mechanisms in GUI scenarios: subspace-level spatial specialization and entropy drift over time steps. Proposes a training-free, plug-and-play KV cache compression scheme, providing a practical memory optimization solution for deploying long-context GUI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the STaR-KV framework, featuring three core mechanisms: 1) Online Spatial Profiling: Calculates the mutual information between attention subspaces and 2D screen coordinates to preserve layout-sensitive subspace information; 2) Cumulative Temporal Stability Discount: Weights historical visual tokens based on the stability of their governing subspaces across frames, suppressing redundant cache entries from static UI elements while preserving tokens of dynamic components; 3) Adaptive Entropy-Based Sharpening (AEB): Dynamically adjusts the temperature parameter based on the normalized entropy of the attention distribution, replacing the fixed Top-B cutoff to avoid arbitrary truncation in flat distributions and enhance selectivity in peaky ones.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple GUI agent benchmarks, STaR-KV can be directly applied to models like UI-TARS and OpenCUA without fine-tuning. Under matched memory budgets, it achieves stronger average performance than SOTA KV compression methods (e.g., GUIKV, SnapKV).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Pilot 1 and Pilot 2 in the Introduction, which clearly reveal the blind spots of existing methods. The Method section details the implementation of the three core mechanisms, especially the calculation of mutual information and the design of adaptive entropy sharpening.

recommendation.zh: 只看 pilot measurements 和压缩策略即可；它对“统一视觉 saliency + 固定 top-B”的反例比较有用。
recommendation.en: Read the pilot measurements and compression policy; the useful part is the counterexample to global visual saliency plus fixed top-B pruning.

paper.title: dMoE: dLLMs with Learnable Block Experts
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models, offering competitive performance while naturally supporting parallel decoding. However, as dLLMs are increasingly integrated with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to scale model capacity, a fundamental mismatch arises between block parallel decoding and token-level expert selection. Specifically, each dLLM forward pass processes multiple tokens with bidirectional dependencies,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 diffusion LLM 与传统 token-level MoE 路由之间的不匹配。AR 模型一次前向通常只处理当前位置，token 级路由不会在单步内激活太多不同专家；但 dLLM，尤其是 block diffusion decoding，一次前向会并行处理一个 block 内多个 token，且这些 token 彼此有双向依赖。若仍按 token 独立选专家，一个 denoising step 内会激活大量不同专家，导致推理从算力受限转成显存带宽和 expert loading 受限。作者要解决的核心问题不是提升模型精度，而是在尽量不伤性能的前提下压缩单步内 unique experts 的数量，让 MoE dLLM 的并行解码真正落到端到端时延收益上。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究的价值高于一般推理论文，因为它触及的是新型语言建模范式与稀疏架构之间的接口问题。dLLM 正在尝试用并行解码挑战 AR，而 MoE 是扩容量的主流手段；如果两者在执行层面不兼容，模型容量优势就很难转化成实际吞吐。dMoE 给出的启发很明确：在 diffusion / masked 并行生成里，路由粒度不应默认沿用 AR 的 token-level 设计，block-level 或 step-aware routing 可能更自然。贡献量级属于中等：方法不复杂，但问题抓得准，实验也给出了较完整的效率—性能权衡。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 learnable block experts routing。作者的出发点有两个观察。第一，原始 token-level router 产生的 expert scores 本身已经包含了专家重要性信息，不一定需要重新设计一套完全不同的路由器。第二，不同 denoising step、不同 block 的专家分布集中度差异很大，因此压缩 unique experts 不能用固定阈值硬裁。

具体做法是先从 token-level expert scores 出发，聚合成 block-level expert scores。直观上，就是把一个 block 内多个 token 对各专家的偏好汇总，得到“这一整个 block 更值得保留哪些专家”的全局排序。然后再用这些 block-level scores 去约束原始 token-level routing：每个 token 仍然保留原来的 top-k 选择机制，但候选专家集合会被 block-level 结果裁剪，只允许在一个较小的共享专家池中选择。这样做的关键点是，它压缩的是一个前向步内的 unique expert count，而不是减少每个 token 的 active experts 数量，因此理论上更容易保住模型表达能力。

作者进一步引入 top-p 形式的动态控制，而不是固定保留前 m 个 block experts。原因是不同 denoising step 的路由熵不同：有些 step 专家偏好很集中，可以压得更狠；有些 step 更分散，需要保留更多候选。top-p 让保留的专家数随 block-level score 分布自适应变化。

训练上采用 self-distillation。论文描述是，在 forward pass 中就使用与推理一致的 routing procedure，让模型在受限专家集合下学习恢复原模型行为。这一点很重要，因为如果只在推理时硬套 block-level 约束，分布偏移会更明显。自蒸馏的作用是把原始 token-level 路由下的能力尽量迁移到压缩后的执行路径上。

从方法定位看，dMoE 不是改 MoE 层结构，也不是做 expert merging / pruning 的离线压缩，而是一个运行时可调的 routing compression 机制。它与 EC-DLM、TEAM、DES 的区别在于：它直接针对“单步 unique experts 过多”这个 dLLM 特有瓶颈，用 block 级共享候选池来压缩激活集合，而不是主要从负载均衡、跨 step 复用或候选约束的其他角度切入。
summary.experiments:
实验基座是 LLaDA2.0-mini，任务覆盖 MATH500、GSM8K、ARC-C、MMLU。论文给出的主结果比较完整：平均 unique experts 数量压缩 4.77 倍，同时保留 99.11% 的原始性能；显存占用下降 76.64% 到 79.84%；端到端时延获得 1.14 倍到 1.66 倍加速。这组数字说明方法确实抓住了瓶颈，因为如果只是减少少量专家激活，不会带来这么明显的 memory 和 latency 改善。

实验里最值得看的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是效率—性能曲线。作者强调 dMoE 是 tunable 的，意味着可以通过 top-p 调节压缩强度，在不同部署约束下选择更激进或更保守的路由。若全文中有曲线图，重点看随着 unique experts 下降，性能何时开始明显掉点，这能反映 block-level 共享候选池对表达能力的伤害边界。

另一个关键实验是对延迟来源的拆分。引言里提到 Section 3 证明 MoE latency 随 unique experts 线性增长，并且在端到端推理中占主导。这是整篇论文成立的前提。如果这个 profiling 做得扎实，那么 dMoE 的收益就不仅是经验现象，而是对 bottleneck 的直接打击。

还应关注与已有高效 MoE dLLM 方法的对比，例如 EC-DLM、TEAM、DES。作者声称 dMoE 在性能—效率权衡上更优。精读时要核对比较是否在相同 base model、相同 decoding setting、相同 expert budget 下进行。若条件不一致，结论力度会下降。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得比普通 skim 多花一点时间，因为它讨论的是 dLLM 和 MoE 的接口问题。先看 Introduction 前半部分，确认作者为什么说 dLLM 的并行 block decoding 会放大 token-level routing 的 unique expert 问题。然后直接看 profiling 或 latency 分解图，先判断 bottleneck 是否真的存在。

方法部分重点看三件事。第一，block-level expert scores 是怎么从 token-level scores 聚合出来的，是否只是简单求和/平均，还是有额外可学习参数。第二，block-level scores 如何约束原始 token routing，是否改变了每 token top-k，还是只缩小候选池。第三，top-p 动态控制和 self-distillation 的训练流程，这两点决定方法是否既可调又稳定。

实验建议优先看：unique experts 压缩比、memory、latency 三者的主表；top-p 或压缩强度的消融；不同 denoising steps / blocks 的专家集中度分析；与 EC-DLM、TEAM、DES 的对比。预计 40 分钟左右能读完关键部分。如果你在看 diffusion LM 或 MoE，这篇比一般效率小修小补更值得留档。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch between diffusion LLM decoding and conventional token-level MoE routing. In autoregressive models, one forward pass usually concerns a single next-token position, so token-wise routing does not activate too many distinct experts at once. In diffusion LLMs, especially under block diffusion decoding, one forward pass updates many tokens jointly with bidirectional dependencies. If routing is still done independently per token, the number of uniquely activated experts within a single denoising step grows rapidly, turning inference into a memory-bandwidth and expert-loading bottleneck. The goal is not mainly to improve accuracy, but to reduce unique expert activation per step while preserving model quality.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to foundation-model research than a typical inference tweak because it sits at the interface between a new language modeling paradigm and sparse scaling. Diffusion LMs aim to exploit parallel decoding, while MoE is a standard way to scale capacity. If the routing granularity is inherited blindly from autoregressive models, the capacity advantage does not translate into practical throughput. The paper’s main lesson is clear: in diffusion or masked parallel generation, routing granularity should not default to token level. Block-level or step-aware routing may be a more natural fit. The contribution is moderate in scale, but the problem formulation is sharp and the efficiency-quality trade-off is empirically well supported.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is a learnable block-level routing mechanism for MoE diffusion LLMs. The method is motivated by two observations. First, the original token-level router scores already contain useful information about expert importance, so one does not need to redesign routing from scratch. Second, expert concentration varies substantially across denoising steps and across blocks, so a fixed compression rule is too rigid.

Concretely, dMoE starts from token-level expert scores and aggregates them into block-level expert scores. Intuitively, it summarizes how strongly the tokens in a block collectively prefer each expert, producing a block-wise ranking over experts. These block-level scores are then used to constrain the original token-level routing. Each token still keeps its original top-k routing behavior, but the candidate expert set is restricted to a smaller shared pool selected at the block level. This is the key design choice: dMoE compresses the number of unique experts activated in one forward pass, rather than reducing the number of active experts per token. That makes it easier to preserve expressivity while improving efficiency.

The method further uses a top-p style dynamic control instead of keeping a fixed number of block experts.
