recommendation.zh: HRBench提供了混合推理策略的系统评估框架，对做推理优化或推理-time scaling的研究员有参考价值，建议浏览方法和分析部分。
recommendation.en: HRBench provides a systematic evaluation framework for hybrid reasoning strategies, useful for researchers working on reasoning optimization or inference-time scaling; skim the methodology and analysis sections.

paper.title: Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models rely on a KV cache of previously generated chunks to avoid redundant computation, but this cache quickly becomes a memory bottleneck as videos grow longer. Methods that quantize the KV cache to low bitwidths reduce memory pressure but degrade video quality. We show that a key driver of this degradation is a systematic bias in attention weights: due to the convexity of the exponential in softmax attention, quantization noise inflates the contributi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion 里的 KV-cache 低比特量化失真问题。核心观察是，INT2 量化后的质量下降不只是普通量化噪声，而是 softmax 注意力中出现了系统性偏置：被量化的历史 key 会获得过多注意力，挤压当前未量化 chunk 的注意力质量。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不高，但对长上下文生成模型和多模态 diffusion transformer 的推理系统有参考价值。它把 KV-cache 量化误差从“数值近似问题”细化到“softmax 分布偏移问题”，这对 LLM/VLM 的 KV 量化也有启发：key 的误差不只影响 score 的均方误差，还会通过指数函数改变 partition function，从而系统性改变注意力分配。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的关键是 Jensen bias correction。量化 key 时，key 误差近似为零均值，因此 pre-softmax score 在期望上可以保持无偏。但 softmax 使用 exp，指数函数是凸函数，零均值 score noise 经过 exp 后会带来正向膨胀：E[exp(s+η)] 大于 exp(s)。历史 cached token 的 key 被量化，而当前 chunk 的 key 没有被量化，于是 cached token 的 softmax 分母贡献被系统性放大。论文根据量化 step size 在线估计每个 attention score 的噪声方差，并在 cached-key score 上减去一个校正项。二阶 Taylor 近似下，校正项接近 score noise 方差的一半；方差由 query 各通道幅度和 key 量化步长共同决定。方法不需要重新训练，不修改 value cache，也可以和 Hadamard rotation、per-token 或 group-wise quantization 结合。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是提出新的视频生成模型，而是定位和修正 INT2/INT4 KV-cache 量化的注意力偏置。论文报告 INT4 KV-cache 量化通常还能维持可接受质量，INT2 会出现明显帧失真。注意力诊断显示，量化后 attention mass 会稳定偏向 cached tokens，这一现象跨 layer、head、denoising step 和 prompt 都存在，并且和视频质量下降相关。加入 Jensen bias correction 后，注意力分配更接近未量化模型，并在多个视频 diffusion 模型和量化配置上改善最终视频质量。提供的内容没有完整实验表，无法可靠给出具体 benchmark 数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的失真现象定义，Preliminaries 中的量化设定和 Hadamard rotation，Section 4 附近关于 Jensen bias 的推导，以及 Fig. 1–3 的 attention mass 诊断。若关心 LLM KV-cache 量化，可重点检查校正项是否依赖视频 diffusion 的 chunk 结构；如果公式只依赖 query 和 key quantization step size，它有机会迁移到文本和多模态长上下文 serving。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why low-bit KV-cache quantization hurts chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion. The main issue is not just random quantization error. Quantized cached keys systematically attract too much attention mass, stealing probability from the current, unquantized chunk.
summary_en.importance: The work is only indirectly related to LLM pretraining, but it is useful for long-context generative serving and multimodal transformer systems. Its main value is a sharper diagnosis of KV-cache quantization: key noise changes the softmax partition function through the exponential, so preserving unbiased pre-softmax scores is not enough. This is a relevant lesson for KV compression in LLMs and VLMs as well.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed fix targets what the authors call Jensen bias. Quantizing cached keys introduces approximately zero-mean perturbations to attention scores. Because softmax applies an exponential, positive score perturbations are amplified more than negative perturbations are suppressed, so E[exp(s+η)] exceeds exp(s). Since only past cached keys are quantized while current-chunk keys remain full precision, the bias selectively inflates the cached-token contribution. The method estimates a per-score correction from the quantization step sizes available at inference time and subtracts it from cached-key attention logits before softmax. A second-order Taylor approximation gives a practical correction close to half of the score-noise variance. The procedure is training-free, leaves cached values unchanged, and is compatible with Hadamard rotation and token/group-wise quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical story is built around attention diagnostics and end-to-end video quality. INT4 KV-cache quantization remains usable in the reported setting, while INT2 causes severe visual artifacts. The authors show a consistent shift of attention mass toward cached tokens across layers, heads, denoising steps, and prompts, and this shift correlates with poor video quality. Applying the correction brings the attention distribution closer to the unquantized model and improves video-generation benchmarks across multiple models and quantization schemes. The supplied text does not include the full result tables, so exact metric values should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode, the quantization preliminaries for the cache setup, the Jensen-bias derivation for the core idea, and Figures 1–3 for the diagnostic evidence. For LLM KV-cache work, the main question to check is whether the correction depends on video-specific chunking or only on query magnitudes and key quantization scales; the latter would make the idea easier to port to text and multimodal long-context inference.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Jensen bias 推导和量化消融；若 LLM KV 量化还默认零均值噪声无偏，这篇会改 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the Jensen-bias derivation and quantization ablations; it challenges the lazy prior that zero-mean KV noise is harmless under softmax.

paper.title: NestedKV: Nested Memory Routing for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: Long-context language models are limited by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache. Existing training-free KV compression methods usually rank tokens by one importance signal -- attention, recency, layer-wise allocation, or key distinctiveness -- which becomes brittle when useful context is globally distinctive, locally episodic, or immediately relevant. We introduce NestedKV, a key-only KV cache compression method inspired by the Continuum Memory System in Nested Learning. NestedKV ma

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长上下文推理中的 KV cache 内存问题：在不训练、不改模型和不改 attention kernel 的前提下，如何决定哪些历史 token 的 KV 应该保留。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，主要属于推理效率。但它对长上下文基座模型研究有参考价值。核心观察是，attention mass、recency、sink token 或单一 key distinctiveness 都只刻画一种“重要性”，在强压缩和超长上下文下容易错删答案相关 token。NestedKV 把 cache eviction 改写为 key 空间中的多时间尺度异常检测，这个角度有助于理解长上下文模型的内部记忆几何，也能为后续长上下文训练目标或注意力结构设计提供信号。
summary.technical_approach: NestedKV 在 prefill 之后、autoregressive decoding 之前压缩每层 KV cache。模型参数、value 向量内容和 attention 实现不变，只选择保留哪些位置。方法只使用 key stream，维护三类 anchor：stable/global anchor 捕捉文档级背景，episodic/block-level anchor 捕捉局部片段变化，current/sliding-window anchor 捕捉近端上下文。每个 token 会根据它相对不同 anchor 的 cosine anomaly 得到多套排名。外层的 training-free learner 再做两件事：一是按 head 调整不同时间尺度排名的权重，让不同 head 偏向不同记忆角色；二是用跨尺度排名分歧作为 surprise signal，在 blended score 和最强单尺度 score 之间平滑路由。最后再配合 adaptive per-head budget，区分“某个 head 内哪些 token 重要”和“哪个 head 应该获得更多 cache 预算”。
summary.experiments: 实验使用冻结的 Qwen3-4B 作为主模型，覆盖 RULER、LongBench、LooGLE、LongBench-E、InfiniteBench 和 MMLU-Pro。作者报告的主要趋势是，压缩越激进、上下文越长，多时间尺度 key anomaly 的优势越明显。在 RULER 多个 context length 与 compression ratio 组合上，NestedKV 达到最好或接近最好的结果。LongBench 在作者定义的 r=0.75 设置下，平均分从 30.77 提升到 50.06。MMLU-Pro 上，在 r=0.25 时与 Full KV 上限只差 0.2 分，说明短上下文知识能力基本没有被 cache 策略破坏。需要注意的是，结果主要支撑 training-free serving 场景，不能直接推出训练阶段的长程依赖学习能力提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 attention-based 压缩失配的图示和论证，再看 Method 中三类 anchor、cosine anomaly、head-adaptive mixing、surprise-gated routing 的定义。实验部分重点看 RULER 的长上下文高压缩区域、LongBench 平均分变化，以及 MMLU-Pro 是否保留短上下文能力。若只关心预训练，可以略读工程实现细节，重点保留 key 空间多尺度记忆这一建模视角。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the memory cost of long-context inference: how to compress the KV cache after prefill while keeping the model, the attention implementation, and the parameters unchanged.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant for long-context foundation model research. Its main point is that a single token-importance signal is brittle. Attention mass, recency, sink preservation, or a single key-distinctiveness score each captures only one notion of memory. Under aggressive compression, answer-bearing tokens may be globally distinctive, locally episodic, or immediately relevant, and these cases are not well served by one anchor. The key-space, multi-timescale view is useful for thinking about memory geometry in long-context models and may inform future training objectives or attention designs.
summary_en.technical_approach: NestedKV compresses the cache after prefill and before autoregressive decoding, independently at each Transformer layer. It only decides which cached positions remain; values, model weights, and attention kernels are unchanged. The method builds three key-space anchors: a stable/global anchor for document-level background, an episodic/block-level anchor for local topic shifts, and a current/sliding-window anchor for immediate context. Each token receives cosine-anomaly rankings against these timescales. A training-free outer combiner then adapts the mixture per attention head, upweighting the most discriminative timescale for that head. It also computes cross-scale rank disagreement as a surprise signal and routes each token between the blended score and the strongest individual timescale score. The final selection is paired with adaptive per-head cache budgets, separating token scoring within a head from memory allocation across heads.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use frozen Qwen3-4B and evaluate on RULER, LongBench, LooGLE, LongBench-E, InfiniteBench, and MMLU-Pro. The reported pattern is strongest under long contexts and aggressive compression. NestedKV is best or close to best across many RULER context-ratio cells. On LongBench, under the paper’s r=0.75 setting, the average score rises from 30.77 to 50.06. On MMLU-Pro, at r=0.25, it stays within 0.2 points of the Full KV result, suggesting that the compression rule does not materially damage short-context knowledge behavior. The evidence mainly supports training-free serving use cases; it should not be read as evidence that the model has learned better long-range dependencies during training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Start with the introduction’s argument that attention-based eviction can miss answer-bearing tokens. Then read the method definitions for the three anchors, cosine anomaly scoring, head-adaptive mixing, surprise-gated routing, and adaptive head budgets. In the experiments, focus on the high-compression long-context RULER cells, the LongBench average, and the MMLU-Pro retention result. Readers focused on pretraining can skip most implementation detail and keep the multi-timescale key-memory perspective.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和 head-adaptive budget 细节即可；多尺度 key 信号比单一 attention 分数更像可部署启发。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and head-adaptive budgets; multi-scale key signals look more deployable than another single attention-score heuristic.

paper.title: QAM-W: Joint 2D Codebook Quantization for LLM Weights via Hadamard Rotation and Activation-Aware Scaling
paper.abstract: Scalar post-training quantizers discard pairwise coordinate structure within weight rows. We introduce QAM-W (Quadrature Amplitude Modulation for Weights), a codec that recovers this structure: each row is L2-normalized, block-Hadamard rotated, paired into 2D coordinates, and quantized against a single Lloyd-Max codebook trained on the unit circular Gaussian, with activation-aware per-channel scaling. In a cross-model study spanning five LLMs from four families (1.1B--13B parameters) and eight q

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但实际的问题：在不重训模型的前提下，如何把 LLM 权重压到约 5–6 bits per weight 的区间，同时尽量不损失语言建模质量。作者指出，主流 PTQ 方法大多按标量独立量化，每个权重单独编码，忽略了同一行权重内部的相关结构；而这部分结构在中等码率区间仍有可利用的率失真冗余。论文想解决的不是极限低比特 4bpw 场景，而是“质量基本守住、存储再往下压一截”的带宽/存储甜点区间。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练方法本身，而在模型部署侧的权重表示设计。它给出一个清楚的结论：在 5–6 bpw 这一档，单纯做更细的标量量化未必是最优，利用轻量正交旋转后做 2D 联合编码，可以在不引入复杂解码结构的情况下吃到一部分相关性红利。论文的贡献量级是中等偏实用：不是改变量化范式的大工作，但把“旋转 + 激活感知缩放 + 小维度向量量化”组合成了一个工程上可落地、分析上也较完整的 codec，并且用跨模型实验把适用区间讲清楚了。另一个有价值的点是作者强调 paired KL 与 perplexity 变化几乎同序，这对量化方法的快速筛选有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由四步组成。第一步是行级范数分解：每一行权重先单独抽出 L2 norm，方向向量再单独编码。这样把“半径”和“方向”拆开，便于后续只处理方向失真。第二步是确定性的 block-Hadamard 旋转，并配合 sign mask。这样做不是为了学习一个最优旋转矩阵，而是用一个无需存储、可快速 butterfly 实现的正交变换，把原始坐标打散，使相邻坐标更接近各向同性的高斯对。第三步是把旋转后的相邻两个实数坐标配成一个 2D 点，再按 pair-specific scale 做归一化。这个 scale 不是简单按权重统计量给，而是借鉴 AWQ 的 activation-aware 思路，用层输出 trace identity 推导出的通道重要性来校准；作者用最多 1024 条单位化行做校准，估计每对坐标的尺度。第四步才是编码：核心版本 QAM-W 用一个在单位圆对称高斯上通过 Lloyd 迭代训练出的统一 2D codebook，对每个归一化后的二维点做最近邻查表量化。对照基线则是 polar coding，把幅值和相位分开量化。作者的论点是，若旋转后二维对近似 circular Gaussian，那么直接在二维平面上做 Lloyd-Max 码本，比“幅值 × 相位”分解更贴近真实失真几何，也比独立标量量化保留更多联合结构。论文还给了从 codec distortion 到 KL 的单调复合上界，用来解释为什么局部量化误差会映射到语言模型输出分布的变化。实现上作者刻意把维度固定在 2D，因为 11 bit/pair 的码本大小最多 16KB，可常驻 L1 cache，解码只需一次表查找和缩放，结构上比 additive codebook 或 trellis 类方法简单。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个 LLM、四个家族、参数规模 1.1B 到 13B，并在统一协议下比较八种量化配置。主结果是：activation-aware 的 QAM-W 在约 5.5 bpw 时，WikiText-2 perplexity 相对 BF16 的偏差在所有模型上都控制在 ±0.4% 以内；作者把这个质量区间与 SmoothQuant 的 W8A8 对齐，声称在达到相近质量包线时，权重位宽可少约 32%。这说明它主要赢在权重存储，而不是端到端 W/A 一体量化。论文也明确承认在严格 4 bpw 下，QTIP 更强，因此 QAM-W 的适用点不是极低比特。方法比较上，joint 2D codebook 优于 polar baseline，说明二维联合编码确实比“幅值+相位”分拆更有效；activation-aware scaling 也优于仅靠权重统计的版本，说明误差预算需要向高激活通道倾斜。作者还做了 paired KL 与 ΔPPL 的相关性分析，在 37 个 method-model 组合上得到 Spearman ρ=0.99，几乎可以把 paired KL 当成排序诊断指标。文中还提到统一的六任务 harness，但从给出的信息看，最扎实的证据仍是 perplexity 与 KL，而不是大规模下游任务提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看方法部分里 codec pipeline 的四步：row norm factorization、Hadamard rotation、pair scaling、2D codebook，这四步各自解决什么问题。第二，看作者为什么坚持 2D 而不是更高维向量量化：关键不只是精度，还有码本驻留 L1、解码查表简单、不会把 kernel 复杂度推高。第三，看实验里 5–6 bpw 与 4 bpw 的分界，这决定了方法的真实定位。建议重点看 Introduction、QAM-W Codec Pipeline、与 polar/QTIP/SmoothQuant 的对比结果，以及 paired KL vs ΔPPL 的相关性图表。预计 20–30 分钟能把核心思路和适用边界读明白；如果关心理论，可再看 distortion 到 KL 的分析部分，理解作者如何把局部量化误差和 LM 输出退化联系起来。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a narrow but practical question: how to compress LLM weights into the roughly 5–6 bits-per-weight regime with minimal quality loss, without retraining. The key observation is that most post-training quantizers are scalar and encode each weight independently, which ignores pairwise structure within a weight row. The authors are not trying to win the extreme 4 bpw setting; they focus on the middle regime where quality should remain close to BF16 while storage and bandwidth are pushed down further.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly on the deployment side rather than pretraining itself. The useful takeaway is that in the 5–6 bpw range, scalar quantization is not obviously the right endpoint: a lightweight combination of orthogonal rotation, activation-aware scaling, and 2D joint coding can recover some rate-distortion slack without introducing a complicated decoder. The contribution is moderate but concrete. It is not a new quantization paradigm, but it packages several known ideas into a codec with a clear operating regime and a reasonably complete analysis. Another useful point is the empirical result that paired KL tracks perplexity degradation almost perfectly, which may help with fast screening of quantization schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The codec has four main stages. First, each weight row is factorized into its L2 norm and a unit direction vector. This separates radial information from directional distortion. Second, the direction vector is transformed by a deterministic sign-masked block Hadamard rotation. The goal is not to learn a dense rotation, but to use a cheap orthogonal transform with butterfly structure and no matrix storage, so that coordinates become more homogeneous and adjacent pairs look closer to isotropic Gaussian samples. Third, adjacent rotated coordinates are grouped into 2D pairs and normalized by pair-specific scales. These scales are not purely weight-statistics based; the paper adds an AWQ-style activation-aware calibration motivated by a layer-output trace identity, so more important channels receive a different distortion budget. Fourth, each normalized 2D point is quantized using a single Lloyd-trained codebook learned on a unit circular Gaussian. This is the main QAM-W variant. The baseline instead uses polar coding, quantizing amplitude and phase separately. The authors argue that if rotated pairs are approximately circular Gaussian, direct 2D Lloyd-Max coding matches the geometry of the source better than amplitude-phase factorization, and preserves pairwise structure that scalar coding discards. The paper also provides a monotone composite bound from codec distortion to KL divergence, to justify why local weight distortion should correlate with output-distribution degradation. A deliberate design choice is to stay in 2D: with 11 bits per pair, the codebook fits within 16 KB and remains L1-resident, so decoding is just a lookup plus rescaling, much simpler than additive-codebook or trellis-style schemes.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans five LLMs from four families, ranging from 1.1B to 13B parameters, under a unified evaluation protocol with eight quantized configurations. The headline result is that the activation-aware QAM-W variant at about 5.5 bpw stays within ±0.4% WikiText-2 perplexity of BF16 on every tested model. The paper positions this as matching the quality envelope of SmoothQuant W8A8 while using about 32% fewer weight bits, so the gain is primarily in weight storage rather than full W/A quantization. The authors are also explicit about the boundary: at strict 4 bpw, QTIP performs better, so QAM-W is not presented as the best ultra-low-bit method. In ablations, joint 2D coding beats the polar baseline, supporting the claim that direct 2D coding is better aligned with the rotated source distribution than amplitude-phase decomposition. Activation-aware scaling also improves over weight-only calibration, indicating that channel importance matters even in this codec setting. A notable diagnostic result is that paired KL and relative perplexity change are almost perfectly rank-correlated across 37 method-model pairs, with Spearman rho = 0.99. The paper mentions a six-task harness as well, but the strongest evidence appears to be the perplexity and KL results rather than broad downstream gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, focus on three things. First, understand the four-stage pipeline: row norm factorization, Hadamard rotation, pair scaling, and 2D codebook quantization. Each stage has a distinct role. Second, pay attention to why the method stays in 2D instead of moving to higher-dimensional vector quantization: the argument is as much about decoder simplicity and cache residency as about distortion. Third, look at the empirical boundary between the 5–6 bpw regime and the 4 bpw regime, because that defines the real use case. The most useful sections are the introduction, the codec pipeline, the comparisons against polar/QTIP/SmoothQuant, and the KL-versus-perplexity analysis. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea and its operating range. If the theory matters to you, then read the distortion-to-KL analysis to see how the paper links local quantization error to LM output degradation.

recommendation.zh: 量化方法本身偏工程增量，但 KL→PPL 的强相关值得看；只读方法图和相关性实验即可。
recommendation.en: The codec is mostly an engineering increment, but the KL-to-PPL correlation is worth checking; read the method diagram and correlation table.

paper.title: O-MARC: Omni Memory-Augmented Compression Distillation for Efficient Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Omnimodal large language models enable unified audio video understanding, but long joint token sequences make inference costly, and existing benchmarks do not fully isolate audio visual association in noisy user generated videos. We introduce UGC-AVQA, a public UGC benchmark with 1,000 videos and 4,816 QA pairs, where an audio removal test ensures that benchmark questions require both acoustic and visual evidence. To reduce inference cost, we propose OMAC, a training free plug in compression met

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是全模态视频理解里的压缩问题：音频和视频同时输入时 token 序列很长，直接推理成本高；但简单压缩又容易删掉跨模态证据，尤其是短暂声音、场景切换、动作与声音之间的对应关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在文本基座训练，而在多模态 LM 的输入表示压缩和训练接口。它提醒一个关键点：音频和视频不能简单按各自冗余度独立压缩，因为很多有效信息来自二者的时间对齐和互相解释。对做 native multimodal pretrain、视频/音频 token budget 分配、长上下文多模态推理的人有参考意义。UGC-AVQA 也提供了一个更偏“音画关联”的评测切面，能减少模型只靠视觉先验答题的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文包含两部分。第一是 UGC-AVQA，一个面向用户生成短视频的音画关联 benchmark。样本来自公开短视频平台，共 1,000 个视频、4,816 个 QA。问题覆盖音画事件推进、场景或时间转移、跨场景音画对齐、细粒度音画对比。关键过滤步骤是 audio removal check：去掉音轨后让 Gemini-3.1-Flash 回答，只有模型在无音频条件下失败的样本才保留，以降低纯视觉可解的比例。第二是 OMAC/O-MARC。OMAC 是 training-free 插件式压缩方法，保留紧凑视觉 memory 和时间锚定的 audio anchors，并用视觉 memory 的分布来分配音频预算。这个设计的动机是：视觉里常有更稳定的场景结构，音频里可能有短但决定性的片段，因此音频压缩预算需要受视觉事件分布约束，而不是平均采样或孤立压缩。O-MARC 则进一步做 compression distillation，让较小模型在被压缩的多模态上下文上学习推理，减少推理时压缩分布和训练时完整上下文之间的不匹配。
summary.experiments: 数据方面，UGC-AVQA 的 benchmark split 包含 206 个视频、1,648 个 QA；其余 794 个视频作为训练 split。作者对 benchmark 候选和生成训练样本各抽取 30% 进行人工复核和修正。模型方面，实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B、7B、30B 量级。OMAC 在相近推理成本下优于直接 token compression。O-MARC 在 3B 设置下带来更明显收益；扩展到 7B 后，在总体平均分上超过同期训练式压缩 baseline。论文提供的片段没有完整表格数值，精确提升幅度需要看实验主表和各类别 breakdown。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看三处：第一，UGC-AVQA 的构造流程，尤其是 audio removal check，这决定了评测是否真的需要音频；第二，OMAC 的 token budget 分配和视觉 memory/audio anchors 设计，这是方法的核心；第三，3B/7B/30B 上 compression ratio、准确率和推理成本的对照表。若只关心预训练，可重点看它对多模态 token 压缩训练分布的启发，而不必深读 benchmark 样例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies efficient audiovisual reasoning for omnimodal LLMs. Joint audio-video inputs create long token sequences, while naive compression can remove the short acoustic cues and cross-modal alignments needed for answering.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly in multimodal token budgeting and the train–inference interface for compressed contexts. The useful lesson is that audio and video should not be compressed independently: decisive evidence often lies in the temporal relation between what is heard and what is seen. The UGC-AVQA benchmark is also useful as an evaluation slice for native multimodal models because it explicitly filters out questions solvable from visual priors alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two components. UGC-AVQA is a user-generated-video benchmark with 1,000 videos and 4,816 QA pairs, targeting audiovisual event progression, scene or temporal transitions, cross-scene alignment, and fine-grained contrast. A key design step is an audio-removal check: after removing the audio track, Gemini-3.1-Flash is asked to answer; only samples that fail under this setting are retained. On the method side, OMAC is a training-free plug-in compression method. It keeps compact visual memory and temporally grounded audio anchors, then allocates audio budget according to the visual memory distribution. This differs from modality-isolated compression because visual structure is used to guide where audio evidence should be preserved. O-MARC adds compression distillation, training the model to reason over memory-compressed multimodal contexts so that inference-time compressed inputs are less out-of-distribution.
summary_en.experiments: UGC-AVQA contains a benchmark split with 206 videos and 1,648 QA pairs, while the remaining 794 videos form the training split. The authors manually review and correct 30% of both benchmark candidates and generated training examples. Experiments are reported on Qwen2.5-Omni models at 3B, 7B, and 30B scales. OMAC improves over direct token compression at comparable inference cost. O-MARC gives stronger gains in the 3B setting, and the 7B version outperforms a contemporary training-based compression baseline on the overall average. Exact per-category gains require the full result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on the UGC-AVQA construction pipeline, especially the audio-removal filter; the OMAC memory and audio-anchor mechanism; and the main tables comparing compression ratio, accuracy, and inference cost across 3B/7B/30B models. Readers interested in multimodal pretraining should look for how compressed-context distillation changes the model’s operating distribution, rather than spending too much time on individual QA examples.

recommendation.zh: 免训练的多模态token压缩方法有实用价值，核心看§3的OMAC设计和§4的蒸馏框架，基准构建也值得参考
recommendation.en: The training-free multimodal token compression method has practical value. Focus on §3 for OMAC design and §4 for the distillation framework; the benchmark construction is also worth referencing.

paper.title: WINDQuant: Weight-Informed Neural Decision-Making for Global Mixed-Precision LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Quantization is an effective approach to reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet maintaining performance in the ultra-low-bit regime remains challenging. Existing post-training methods often suffer from severe accuracy degradation, while quantization-aware training requires costly retraining and additional resources. Moreover, most mixed-precision strategies rely on coarse-grained or heuristic sensitivity analysis that overlooks fine-grained variations

summary.core_problem: 在极低比特 LLM 量化中，如何在全局存储预算下自动决定不同权重块的 bit-width 和量化处理方式，减少性能退化。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的后训练量化方法。贡献不是新的量化算子，而是把 mixed-precision allocation 做成细粒度决策问题；对服务侧成本有意义，但对预训练方法论的直接信息较弱。
summary.technical_approach: WINDQuant 使用强化学习控制器，在 column-chunk 粒度为权重矩阵分配 bit-width 和量化 treatment。它避免只按层级或粗粒度敏感性启发式分配精度，在全局目标 bit-width 约束下搜索更灵活的混合精度方案。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是 ultra-low-bit LLM post-training quantization，并声称相比现有 PTQ 方法可减少精度下降；但所给摘要未列出具体模型参数量、评测任务、baseline 名称或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to automatically assign bit-widths and quantization treatments to different weight regions of an LLM under a global storage budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution for post-training quantization. Its main idea is not a new quantization operator, but a fine-grained mixed-precision allocation policy; it is relevant for serving cost, but only indirectly informative for pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: WINDQuant trains a reinforcement-learning allocation controller that operates at the column-chunk level inside weight matrices. Under a global target bit-width, it chooses precision and quantization treatments more flexibly than layer-level or heuristic sensitivity-based mixed-precision schemes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the setting as ultra-low-bit LLM post-training quantization and reports reduced accuracy degradation relative to existing methods, but the provided text does not include model sizes, task suites, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和消融就够；RL 分配 bit 的想法合理，但若没有跨模型迁移结果，容易只是搜索成本换精度。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations; RL-based bit allocation is plausible, but without cross-model transfer it may just trade search cost for accuracy.

paper.title: IndexMem: Learned KV-Cache Eviction with Latent Memory for Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to operate over long contexts, yet standard softmax attention incurs a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, quickly becoming the bottleneck for long context inference. A practical remedy is to evict less important KV entries; however, existing eviction policies are largely heuristic and struggle to capture the rich, input-dependent distribution of token importance. In this work, we introduce a learnable indexer that predicts KV

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理时 KV-cache 线性膨胀带来显存与带宽瓶颈。现有 KV eviction 多为启发式打分，难以做输入相关的“未来重要性”预测；同时被驱逐 token 信息永久丢失，导致长程检索/回忆不可逆退化。论文要解决的是：在固定 KV 预算下，如何更准确地保留未来会用到的 token，并为被驱逐 token 提供可恢复的信息通路。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身影响有限，但对“长上下文能力如何在推理侧落地”很直接：它把 KV eviction 从规则工程推进到可学习策略，并补上了 eviction 的信息不可逆问题。对做长上下文训练/评测的人也有间接价值：它提示了一个常被忽略的变量——推理时的 cache 管理策略会显著改变长程任务表现，可能影响 long-context benchmark 的可比性与训练-推理一致性讨论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两块组成：
1) Learned indexer（可学习打分器）：把“每个历史 token 的 KV 是否该保留”建模成一个预测问题，输出每个位置的重要性分数，再做 top-L' 选择与 cache compaction。相对 SnapKV（局部窗口注意力统计）、KeyDiff（key 差异度代理）、Expected Attention（用语料平均 query 估计）这类 proxy，indexer 试图直接拟合输入相关的未来使用分布。
2) Latent memory（驱逐信息的压缩记忆）：为避免 eviction 的永久遗忘，把被驱逐的 KV 信息在线压缩进一个固定大小的潜在记忆状态（latent slots）。后续解码时，注意力不仅能访问保留的 KV，也能访问这份压缩记忆，从而在“严格限制 KV 长度”的同时保留一定的长程可检索性。
整体上，它把 KV 管理写成“显式选择（保留少量原始 token）+ 连续压缩（把其余信息汇总进小内存）”的两通道结构，取舍是：保留通道保证精确信息，压缩通道提供长程召回的兜底。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的结果口径：
- RULER：在 Qwen/Mistral/Llama 系列上，长上下文指标最高可提升约 +25 分（相对若干 eviction baseline）。
- NIAH retrieval：更稳健的长程检索（文中强调“more robust”，但片段未给出具体数值表）。
- LongBench：整体分数更好（片段未给出具体提升幅度）。
当前提供的内容未包含：训练 indexer/latent memory 的监督信号构造、训练数据规模、不同 KV 预算下的曲线、以及与量化/低秩压缩的叠加实验细节；这些通常决定方法是否“工程可用”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 25–40 分钟，重点抓机制与实验结论）：
- 先看 unified scoring-and-selection 框架那一节：它把各类 eviction 方法统一成“打分→top-k→gather”，便于定位 indexer 的插入点。
- 重点看 indexer 的训练目标与特征输入：它到底在预测什么（未来 attention、未来 loss 贡献、还是某种 proxy），以及是否按 head/layer 分开建模。
- 重点看 latent memory 的更新规则与读写方式：是类似在线聚合/EMA、attention 写入、还是小型 RNN/MLP 更新；以及它如何与原 attention 融合。
- 实验部分优先看：不同 KV budget 下的性能-显存曲线、长程检索任务（NIAH/RULER）的失败案例分析、以及消融（无 indexer / 无 memory / 只 memory / 只 indexer）。这些决定它是不是“只在某个 benchmark 上有效”。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context decoding hits a memory/bandwidth wall because the KV cache grows linearly with context length. Existing KV eviction policies are mostly heuristic and fail to predict input-dependent, future token importance; worse, evicted tokens are gone forever, causing irreversible long-range forgetting. The paper targets a practical question: under a fixed KV budget, how to retain truly future-critical tokens while still preserving recoverable information from evicted ones.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-time contribution rather than a pretraining recipe change. Still, it matters for foundation-model researchers working on long-context: (1) it turns KV eviction into a learnable, context-adaptive policy; (2) it highlights that long-context benchmark outcomes can be strongly confounded by cache management, which affects training–inference consistency discussions and the interpretation of long-context evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
IndexMem combines two components:
- A learnable indexer that predicts per-token KV importance scores, then performs top-L' selection and cache compaction. This replaces hand-crafted proxies used by methods like SnapKV (local attention-window bias), KeyDiff (key diversity proxy), or Expected Attention (corpus-level average query assumption).
- A lightweight latent memory module that compresses evicted tokens into a fixed-size latent state updated online during decoding. Future steps can attend to both the retained raw KV entries and the latent memory, mitigating the irreversibility of eviction.
Conceptually, it is a two-path memory system: sparse exact retention for precision + continuous compression for long-range recall, trading a small extra compute/module for bounded KV footprint.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the reported highlights are:
- RULER: consistent gains across Qwen/Mistral/Llama families, with improvements up to about +25 points.
- NIAH retrieval: more robust long-range retrieval (exact numbers not visible in the excerpt).
- LongBench: improved overall scores (exact deltas not visible in the excerpt).
Key missing details in the excerpt that are important for assessing practicality include: how the indexer is trained (labels/objective), budget–quality curves, latency overhead, and composability with KV quantization/low-rank compression.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Start with the unified “scoring-and-selection” formulation to see precisely where the learnable indexer plugs in.
- Focus on the indexer training signal and inputs: what target it predicts (future attention, loss contribution, etc.), and whether it is head-/layer-specific.
- Inspect the latent memory read/write mechanism and how it is integrated into attention at decode time.
- In experiments, prioritize budget sweeps, ablations (indexer-only vs memory-only vs both), and failure-case analysis on retrieval-heavy tasks (RULER/NIAH).

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它不再把 KV eviction 当启发式排序，而是把“删掉后如何补偿”一起建模；先看方法图和同 budget 对比表，若 setup 不齐就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it treats KV eviction as a learned decision with explicit post-eviction compensation; check the method figure and same-budget comparisons first, otherwise treat the gains cautiously.

paper.title: Locality Matters for Training-Free Audio Token Compression in Audio-Language Models
paper.abstract: Audio-language models (ALMs) are increasingly used for audio captioning, question answering, and open-ended audio understanding, but their inference cost remains high when audio inputs are represented as long prefix-token sequences. These audio prefixes consume context budget, increase memory usage, and make deployment harder in resource-constrained or latency-sensitive settings. Existing training-free audio-token reduction methods mainly rely on fixed pooling or score-based pruning. Fixed pooli

summary.core_problem: 音频语言模型把音频表示成长前缀 token 后，推理成本、显存占用和上下文预算都会显著上升；论文要在不训练模型的情况下压缩这些音频 token。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练-free 的多模态推理压缩方法。它不直接改进预训练，但对音频 LM/VLM 的 token 预算、prefix 设计和部署成本有参考价值，尤其适合已有模型无法重新训练的场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Local Temporal Bipartite Merging，简称 LTBM，在音频编码器空间内只合并时间上相近且表示相似的 token。核心假设是声学语义通常具有局部连续性，因此不能只按全局相似度或单点重要性删 token。论文还设计 Global Merge 受控变体，用来隔离“时间局部性”本身是否带来收益。
summary.experiments: 实验面向 AudioCaps 等音频描述、音频问答和开放式音频理解任务，比较固定池化、基于分数的剪枝、全局合并和 LTBM。摘要没有给出具体压缩率、模型规模和数值提升，但实验重点是 coverage-quality trade-off：在减少音频前缀长度的同时尽量保留任务性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Audio-language models often encode audio as long prefix-token sequences, which increases inference cost, memory use, and context consumption; the paper targets training-free compression of these audio tokens.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference-efficiency method for audio-language models. It is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to multimodal token-budget design and deployment when retraining the model is not feasible.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Local Temporal Bipartite Merging, which merges similar audio tokens only within an explicit temporal window in encoder space. The key design choice is to preserve local acoustic neighborhoods rather than pruning isolated high-salience tokens or globally merging similar representations. A controlled Global Merge variant is used to test whether temporal locality itself is the useful inductive bias.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover audio captioning, audio question answering, and open-ended audio understanding, including AudioCaps according to the abstract. Baselines include fixed pooling, score-based pruning, and a global merge variant. The abstract does not provide exact model sizes, compression ratios, or metric deltas.

recommendation.zh: 只看 locality ablation 即可；它对音频 token 压缩有用，但不是会改变预训练 recipe 的结果。
recommendation.en: Read only the locality ablation; useful for audio-token compression, but it does not change a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Swift Sampling: Selecting Temporal Surprises via Taylor Series
paper.abstract: While most frames in long-form video are redundant, the critical information resides in temporal surprises: moments where the actual visual features deviate from their predicted evolution. Inspired by the human brain's predictive coding, we introduce Swift Sampling, an elegant, training-free frame selection algorithm that automatically identifies high-information moments in a video. Specifically, we model a video as a differentiable trajectory in the visual latent space and compute the velocity

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频中帧冗余高、视频模型或 VLM 处理成本随帧数快速上升的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个 training-free 的视频帧选择方法，用“时间惊讶度”而不是均匀采样或额外模型选择关键帧。对长视频 VLM 的 token/frame budget 分配有一定参考价值，但不是 LLM 基座方法。
summary.technical_approach: Swift Sampling 把视频表示成视觉 latent 空间中的可微轨迹，估计特征速度和加速度，再用 Taylor 展开预测后续帧的期望路径；实际特征偏离预测流形较大的帧被视为 temporal surprise 并被采样。方法不需要训练辅助网络，也减少视频级超参调节。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告该方法相对基线只增加约 0.02x 额外计算，开销比领先的 training-free 方法低约 30 倍；未在给定信息中披露具体数据集、模型规模、任务指标或精度提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Boston University 和 Microsoft Research India。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles redundant frame processing in long videos, where most frames add cost but little information.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a training-free frame selection rule based on temporal surprise rather than uniform sampling or auxiliary selector networks. It is mildly relevant to frame-budget allocation in long-video VLMs, but it is not a foundation-model pretraining result.
summary_en.technical_approach: Swift Sampling models a video as a differentiable trajectory in visual latent space, estimates feature velocity and acceleration, and uses a Taylor expansion to predict the expected path of future frames. Frames that deviate strongly from this path are selected as surprising frames.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports only about 0.02x additional compute over the baseline and roughly 30x lower overhead than a leading training-free method. The provided information does not include datasets, model sizes, task metrics, or accuracy deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Boston University and Microsoft Research India.

recommendation.zh: 可作为长视频 VLM 采帧启发，只看方法图和开销表；缺少端到端 LMM 证据，别高估。
recommendation.en: Useful as a hint for long-video VLM frame selection; read the method diagram and cost table, but do not overread it without end-to-end LMM evidence.

paper.title: Enhancing Visual Token Representations for Video Large Language Models via Training-Free Spatial-Temporal Pooling and Gridding
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced video understanding tasks, yet challenges remain in efficiently compressing visual tokens while preserving spatiotemporal interactions. Existing methods, such as LLaVA family, utilize simplistic pooling or interpolation techniques that overlook the intricate dynamics of visual tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ST-GridPool, a novel training-free visual token enhancement method designed specifically for Vi

summary.core_problem: 解决 Video LLM 在压缩视觉 token 时，简单池化或插值会破坏时空交互、导致性能下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理侧效率改进，重点是训练外的视觉 token 压缩。对做多模态基座的人有一点启发，主要价值在于 token 保真压缩的经验，而不是预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练免费的 ST-GridPool，由两部分组成：Pyramid Temporal Gridding 用分层时间网格保留多粒度时序关系；Norm-based Spatial Pooling 利用 token norm 与语义信息量的相关性，在空间上优先保留高信息区域。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 Video LLM benchmark 上稳定提升，无需重训，说明其作为 inference-time visual token reducer 有实用性；但未见参数规模、具体基座和提升幅度细节，结论更像工程经验而非范式变化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学、深圳大学、西安电子科技大学。属于视频 MLLM 效率优化方向，而非基座预训练团队的训练方法工作。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the loss of spatiotemporal interactions when Video LLMs compress visual tokens using naive pooling or interpolation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper. For foundation-model researchers, the value is limited but non-zero: it offers practical clues on preserving information under visual token compression rather than changing pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ST-GridPool, a training-free method with two components: Pyramid Temporal Gridding for multi-granular temporal structure, and Norm-based Spatial Pooling that keeps spatial tokens with larger norms as higher-information regions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims consistent gains across several Video LLM benchmarks without retraining, suggesting practical utility as an inference-time visual token reducer. However, the abstract does not expose enough setup detail to support stronger conclusions.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University, Shenzhen University, and Xidian University. This is a video-MLLM efficiency work rather than a core pretraining-method paper.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型 inference-time patch，不改训练范式；只看方法图和消融里“token norm 是否真能当信息量代理”那部分，别高估其普适性。
recommendation.en: This is an inference-time patch, not a training-method shift; read the method figure and the ablation on token norm as an information proxy, but do not overgeneralize it.

paper.title: PulseCol: Periodically Refreshed Column-Sparse Attention for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Inference in diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is computationally expensive, as full self-attention must be repeatedly executed at each step of the denoising process without KV cache. Recent sparse attention methods for dLLMs mitigate this cost via block-sparse computation, which is applied only in later iterations when model performance is less sensitive to coarse-grained sparse approximation, but yields limited improvements in computational efficiency and acceleration. This motivates a f

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（dLLM）推理需要在每个去噪步重复做全量自注意力，且无法像 AR 那样用 KV cache，导致注意力开销随步数线性累积；现有稀疏注意力多在后期才敢启用、且以块稀疏为主，早期去噪一旦稀疏化就容易掉质量。论文要解决的是：如何在早期去噪阶段也能安全引入稀疏注意力，并把算法稀疏真正转化为端到端 GPU 加速。
summary.importance: 对“非 AR 生成范式”的工程化落地更直接：它不改训练目标，而是抓住 dLLM 推理的结构性瓶颈（多步重复 attention）做可实现的加速。对预训练研究的启发主要在两点：1）dLLM 的注意力结构在去噪时间轴上有可复用的统计规律（相邻步相似、早期呈列稀疏），这类规律未来可反向影响训练（例如训练时加入稀疏/结构先验以提升可加速性）；2）提示 dLLM 的“早期敏感”并不等价于“必须全密集”，而是需要匹配正确的稀疏粒度。
summary.technical_approach:
核心观察：早期去噪步的注意力并非真正稠密，高分注意力集中在少数 key 的“列”（column）上，呈现列方向的稀疏结构；而已有方法常用块稀疏（block sparse）在空间上做粗粒度近似，容易在早期误删关键连接，从而表现为“早期稀疏很脆”。
方法 PulseCol：
1）列稀疏注意力（column-sparse）：直接选择少量重要的 key 列参与注意力计算，而不是按块保留/丢弃。直觉是更贴合早期注意力的真实形态，因此能把稀疏窗口前移到更早的去噪步。
2）周期刷新（periodically refreshed）：注意力模式会随去噪演化，若每步都重算稀疏索引会抵消收益；若全程固定又会失配。PulseCol 在相邻若干步复用同一组列索引，并每隔 R 步刷新一次以跟踪模式漂移，在“索引更新成本”和“模式失配误差”之间做折中。
3）工程实现：提供列稀疏 attention 的 GPU kernel，使得列选择带来的算子级 FLOPs/带宽节省能落到 wall-clock speedup，而不是停留在理论稀疏率。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的关键信息包括：
- 在相同稀疏预算下，PulseCol 的生成质量-效率折中优于已有 dLLM 稀疏注意力基线；尤其在高稀疏率下更稳。
- 80% sparsity 时，PulseCol 与全注意力相比“只略有落后”，同时明显优于既有稀疏方法（文中表述为 on average outperforms prior baselines）。
- 结合自定义列稀疏 kernel，在不同上下文长度下相对 FlashAttention 的端到端推理加速最高可达 1.95×。
（当前提供的全文片段未包含更细的任务指标/模型规模/步数 T/刷新周期 R 的具体数值表格；精读时需要从实验章节补齐这些可复现细节。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先抓三件事：
1）引言里对“早期注意力并不稠密、而是列稀疏”的实证图/统计（决定了为什么块稀疏不合适）。
2）方法部分：列索引如何选、如何在多头/多层共享或独立、刷新周期如何设定，以及索引更新本身的开销是否计入。
3）实验部分：在不同去噪阶段启用稀疏的策略、与哪些基线比（尤其是后期才稀疏的方案）、以及速度评测是否包含索引刷新与 kernel launch 的真实开销。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可把核心思路与主要结果读清；若要复现/迁移到自家 dLLM，需要额外细看 kernel 与 profiling 设定。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LMs must recompute full self-attention at every denoising step and cannot rely on KV cache, making inference expensive. Prior sparse-attention approaches for dLLMs typically sparsify only in late steps and often use coarse block sparsity; applying sparsity early tends to hurt quality. The paper targets early-step-safe sparsification and turning sparsity into real GPU speedups.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference/serving contribution for diffusion LMs rather than a new pretraining recipe. The pretraining-relevant takeaway is the empirical structure: attention patterns evolve smoothly across denoising steps and, crucially, early steps exhibit strong column-wise concentration. That suggests early-step fragility is not “sparsity is impossible” but “the sparsity granularity is mismatched,” and it hints at future training-time regularization/architectural priors to make diffusion inference more accelerator-friendly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Key finding: early denoising attention is not truly dense; high attention mass concentrates on a small set of key columns (column-wise sparsity). Block-sparse approximations are too coarse and can drop critical connections early.
PulseCol design:
1) Column-sparse attention: keep a selected subset of key columns instead of block structures, better matching the intrinsic pattern and enabling sparsity from earlier steps.
2) Periodic refresh: reuse the selected column indices for several adjacent denoising steps (to avoid recomputing sparsity every step), but refresh them every R steps to track pattern drift over the denoising trajectory.
3) Systems component: an optimized GPU kernel for column-sparse attention so algorithmic sparsity yields wall-clock gains.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported highlights:
- Under the same sparsity budget, PulseCol achieves a better quality–efficiency trade-off than prior sparse-attention baselines for dLLMs.
- At 80% sparsity, it is only slightly worse than full attention while clearly outperforming existing sparse methods.
- With the custom column-sparse kernel, it reaches up to 1.95× end-to-end speedup over FlashAttention across multiple context lengths.
(The provided full-text excerpt does not include the detailed tables for model size, denoising steps, refresh period, and task metrics; those need to be pulled from the experiments section for a complete reproduction-grade read.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
1) The empirical analysis showing column-wise sparsity in early denoising (figures/statistics that justify the design).
2) The method details: how columns are selected, whether indices are shared across heads/layers, refresh scheduling, and the overhead accounting.
3) The speed evaluation methodology: whether refresh/indexing costs are included, and how the kernel is benchmarked.
Time: ~20–30 minutes to capture the main idea and results; longer if you want to port the kernel or replicate profiling.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融即可；dLLM 没有 KV-cache 的痛点真实，column sparsity 是否稳要看质量-速度曲线。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; the no-KV-cache bottleneck is real, but column sparsity must be judged by the quality-speed curve.

paper.title: DASH: Fast Differentiable Architecture Search for Hybrid Attention in Minutes on a Single GPU
paper.abstract: Hybrid attention architectures are becoming an increasingly important paradigm for improving LLM inference efficiency while preserving model quality, making hybrid architecture design a central problem. Existing designs often rely on manual empirical rules or proxy-based selector signals for layer-wise operator allocation. Recent NAS-style systems such as Jet-Nemotron demonstrate the promise of automated hybrid architecture search. However, Jet-Nemotron's PostNAS search stages alone use 200B tok

summary.core_problem: 现有混合注意力架构的神经架构搜索（NAS）成本过高，Jet-Nemotron的PostNAS阶段需消耗200B tokens，无法作为常规设计工具；同时手动规则、选择器式架构设计方法未考虑层间算子的交互效应，难以得到全局最优的混合架构。
summary.importance: 将混合注意力架构的搜索成本降低了数个量级，让自动化架构搜索可作为LLM架构设计的常规工具，为高效LLM的架构迭代提供了低成本方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出可微搜索框架DASH，将离散的层级算子分配决策松弛为连续的架构逻辑变量，搜索过程中冻结模型与算子权重，仅优化架构参数，将搜索流程与最终模型适配步骤解耦，可选算子覆盖全注意力、窗口注意力、线性注意力三类。
summary.experiments: 单张RTX Pro 6000 GPU上仅需12.3M tokens、20分钟即可完成完整搜索流程；搜索得到的架构在RULER长上下文基准上性能优于所有选择器式混合注意力基线，RULER表现优于已发布的Jet-Nemotron模型，通用语言基准表现与Jet-Nemotron持平。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注引言部分的现有方法成本对比、方法部分的可微优化设计逻辑、实验部分的基线性能对比数据，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing neural architecture search (NAS) pipelines for hybrid attention LLMs have prohibitive cost: Jet-Nemotron's PostNAS stage consumes 200B tokens, making it unfit for routine design use. Meanwhile, manual rule-based and selector-style design methods ignore cross-layer operator interactions, and cannot produce globally optimal hybrid architectures.
summary_en.importance: DASH reduces the search cost of hybrid attention architectures by orders of magnitude, enabling automated architecture search to be used as a regular tool for LLM design, and provides a low-cost solution for efficient LLM architecture iteration.
summary_en.technical_approach: DASH is a differentiable search framework that relaxes discrete layer-wise operator allocation into continuous architecture logits. It freezes model and operator weights during search, only optimizes architecture parameters, and decouples the search process from final model adaptation. The optional operator set includes full attention, window attention, and linear attention.
summary_en.experiments: A full search run uses 12.3M tokens and completes in 20 minutes on a single RTX Pro 6000 GPU. Searched models outperform all selector-style hybrid attention baselines on the RULER long-context benchmark, achieve better RULER performance than released Jet-Nemotron models, and match Jet-Nemotron's performance on general language benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the cost comparison of existing methods in Introduction, the differentiable optimization design in Method section, and baseline performance comparison in Experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 Qwen2.5-3B 结果；若质量-延迟曲线干净，可作为内部 hybrid attention 搜索的廉价 baseline。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and Qwen2.5-3B results; if the quality-latency curve is clean, it is a cheap baseline for hybrid-attention search.

paper.title: Full Attention Strikes Back: Transferring Full Attention into Sparse within Hundred Training Steps
paper.abstract: Long-context inference in large language models is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of full attention. Existing efficient alternatives often rely either on native sparse training or on heuristic token eviction, creating an undesirable trade-off among efficiency, training cost, and accuracy. In this work, we show that full-attention LLMs are already intrinsically sparse and can be transformed into highly sparse models with only minimal adaptation. Our approach is built on three observations: (1

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长上下文推理中的 full attention 成本问题。核心问题不是重新训练一个原生 sparse attention 模型，而是问：已经用 full attention 训练好的 LLM，能否通过很小的改造和少量继续训练，转成高稀疏推理模型，同时尽量保持原能力。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究有间接但清楚的启发。它支持一个实用判断：full-attention 预训练仍然有竞争力，因为模型训练后已经形成可利用的 head-level 和 token-level 稀疏结构。相比从头训练稀疏架构，RTPurbo 更像是 post-pretrain 的结构压缩和推理适配。对基座训练的含义是，训练阶段可以先保留表达能力更稳的 full attention，再在部署前用低成本蒸馏和稀疏化提取推理效率。这会影响长上下文模型在训练目标、架构选择和 serving 成本之间的取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 RTPurbo。设计基于三个观察。第一，attention head 功能不均匀，只有少量 retrieval heads 真正需要远程上下文，多数 head 主要处理局部信息。因此方法只为 retrieval heads 保留完整或更长程的 KV 访问，对 local heads 丢弃远程 token。第二，远程检索主要依赖低维子空间。论文从 RoPE 的频率结构解释这一点：高频 rotary 分量随相对距离快速变化，长距离下更容易干扰语义检索；低频分量变化平滑，更适合保持远程相关性。因此 RTPurbo 用低维 projector/indexer 做 token selection，文中强调 16 维即可获得较高 recall。第三，固定 Top-k token budget 不适合所有 query，因为不同 query 的注意力分布尖锐程度不同。RTPurbo 使用 Top-p 式自适应选择，让 token 数随 attention mass 分布变化。最后，它用 self-distillation 对齐稀疏模型和原 full-attention 模型的输出，只需几百步、约 1M label tokens，避免大规模重新训练。
summary.experiments: 关键结果包括：16 维低维检索器可达到超过 90% 的 recall；少量自蒸馏即可恢复稀疏化后的性能；配合定制 sparse kernels，prefill 最高加速 9.36×，decoding 最高加速 2.01×。论文还报告 Top-p selector 在推理和长上下文任务上优于静态 Top-k，说明自适应 token budget 对保留能力很关键。整体实验支持一个结论：full-attention 模型内部已经存在显著稀疏性，稀疏化主要需要识别和对齐，而不一定需要从头训练稀疏模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 minimal surgery 的问题定义，以及 Insight Behind RTPurbo 部分对 retrieval heads、RoPE 低频子空间和自适应 sparsity 的解释。实验部分优先看四类结果：retrieval head 选择是否稳定、16 维 indexer 的 recall、Top-p 与 Top-k 的对照、自蒸馏步数和性能恢复曲线。对做预训练的人，最值得深挖的是 full-attention 训练后自然形成的稀疏结构，以及这种结构是否能反过来指导长上下文预训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost of full attention in long-context inference. The key question is whether a full-attention LLM can be converted into a highly sparse inference model with minimal modification and only a small amount of adaptation, instead of training a sparse-attention model from scratch.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining strategy through the training–serving interface. It suggests that full-attention pretraining remains a practical choice because trained models already contain exploitable sparsity at both the head and token levels. RTPurbo turns this latent structure into an inference-time sparse model through lightweight continuation and distillation. This changes the trade-off: one can keep the more reliable full-attention objective during pretraining, then extract efficiency before deployment, rather than committing to native sparse attention throughout training.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTPurbo is built around three observations. First, attention heads are functionally heterogeneous. Only a small subset acts as retrieval heads that need remote context; many other heads mostly use local information. RTPurbo therefore preserves long-range KV access for retrieval heads and removes remote tokens for local heads. Second, long-range retrieval can be approximated in a low-dimensional subspace. The paper links this to RoPE: high-frequency rotary components vary rapidly with relative distance and can hurt long-range matching, while low-frequency components change smoothly and better preserve retrieval signals. RTPurbo uses a compact low-dimensional projector or indexer for token selection, with 16 dimensions highlighted in the results. Third, a fixed Top-k budget is too rigid because different queries have different attention concentration. The method uses a Top-p-style adaptive selector. A short self-distillation stage then aligns the sparse model with the original full-attention model, requiring only a few hundred steps and about 1M label tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show that the 16-dimensional indexer achieves over 90% recall for relevant tokens. Self-distillation recovers sparse-model performance with a very small amount of training. With custom sparse kernels, RTPurbo reaches up to 9.36× prefill speedup and 2.01× decoding speedup. The ablations indicate that Top-p adaptive selection works better than static Top-k on reasoning and long-context tasks, supporting the claim that query-dependent token budgets are important. The experiments collectively show that much of the needed sparsity is already present in full-attention models.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the problem framing in the Introduction, especially the idea of minimal surgery on a full-attention model. Then read the RTPurbo insight section for retrieval-head specialization, the RoPE low-frequency argument, and adaptive sparsity. In the experiments, focus on four points: retrieval-head identification, 16-dimensional indexer recall, Top-p versus Top-k ablations, and the self-distillation recovery curve. For pretraining researchers, the most useful angle is whether the sparsity that emerges after full-attention training can inform future long-context training recipes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §attention-head ablation 和延迟表；若百步迁移成立，native sparse pretraining 的必要性要重新估。
recommendation.en: Read the attention-head ablations and latency table; if the hundred-step transfer holds, the need for native sparse pretraining should be re-estimated.

paper.title: Focus-then-Context: Subject-Centric Progressive Visual Token Reduction for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face a bottleneck of prohibitive computational costs arising from massive visual token sequences during inference. Existing vision token reduction methods alleviate this burden, but they unintentionally preserve the isolated visual subject strictly aligned with the user's query, which fails to substantially explore salient subjects and their contextual relationships. In this paper, we propose SPpruner, a subject-centric progressive reduction paradigm that emulates t

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 推理时视觉 token 序列过长导致计算开销高的问题，同时避免简单剪枝破坏主体与上下文关系。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它不改变预训练 recipe，但对多模态模型的 token budget、视觉信息瓶颈和推理成本有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPpruner，采用“先聚焦主体、再补上下文”的渐进式视觉 token reduction。第一步用 focus identification module 结合视觉显著性和语义相关性找出更完整的主体候选；第二步用 context-aware structural scanning 聚合邻近区域上下文，避免只保留孤立 query-aligned subject。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM backbone、视觉 token 压缩比例、延迟下降、显存节省或精度变化。应重点查看实验中不同压缩率下的性能-成本曲线，以及是否覆盖多图、细粒度定位和复杂关系问答。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces the high inference cost of VLMs caused by long visual-token sequences while trying to preserve subject-context relations.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It does not alter the pretraining recipe, but it is relevant to visual token budgets, multimodal bottlenecks, and deployment cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPpruner uses a progressive focus-then-context pruning strategy. A focus identification module combines visual saliency with semantic relevance to recover a broader subject set, followed by context-aware structural scanning that keeps neighboring contextual cues instead of isolated query-aligned patches.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the backbone VLMs, compression ratios, latency reduction, memory savings, or accuracy deltas. The key evidence would be performance-cost curves under different token budgets and robustness on fine-grained and relation-heavy VLM tasks.

recommendation.zh: 可看压缩率-精度曲线即可；若只在少数 VQA 集上调 pruning 策略，对预训练侧 insight 很有限。
recommendation.en: Skim the compression-accuracy curves; if it is just pruning tuned on a few VQA sets, the pretraining-side insight is thin.

paper.title: Q-ARVD: Quantizing Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models (ARVDs) have emerged as a promising architecture for streaming video generation, paving the way for real-time interactive video generation and world modeling. Despite their potential, the substantial inference cost of ARVDs remains a major obstacle to practical deployment, making model quantization a natural direction for improving efficiency. However, quantization for ARVDs remains largely unexplored. Our empirical analysis shows that directly applying exis

summary.core_problem: 研究自回归视频扩散模型在低比特量化时的退化问题，目标是在流式视频生成中降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率与量化行为分析。它不是 LLM 预训练工作，但 AR 生成链路中的误差累积和逐步敏感性，对理解长序列生成模型的压缩风险有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先实证分析标准 diffusion transformer 量化方法迁移到 ARVD 时的失效模式，指出自回归视频生成存在帧级量化敏感性严重不均衡的问题；摘要显示其核心观察是量化误差会沿自回归生成累积，导致不同帧对量化的容忍度呈指数式差异。具体 Q-ARVD 的完整校准、位宽分配或补偿策略需看正文确认。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、具体 baseline 或提升数值。已知实验重点应是将现有 diffusion transformer 量化方案直接用于 ARVD 后的性能下降，并比较 Q-ARVD 对生成质量和推理效率的影响。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National University of Singapore 和 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to quantize autoregressive video diffusion models while preserving generation quality for streaming video generation.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and quantization-behavior contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the error accumulation pattern in autoregressive generation is relevant to compression risks in long-sequence generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors empirically show that quantization methods designed for standard bidirectional diffusion transformers transfer poorly to ARVDs. The key observation in the abstract is highly unbalanced frame-wise sensitivity: quantization error accumulates through autoregressive generation and creates an exponential-like sensitivity decay across frames. The full paper is needed for the exact Q-ARVD calibration or bit-allocation mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected experimental setup compares direct application of existing diffusion-transformer quantization schemes against Q-ARVD on video quality and inference efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the National University of Singapore and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 只看量化敏感性分析即可；AR 生成里的误差累积是有用信号，方法本身离 LLM 预训练较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the sensitivity analysis; the AR error-accumulation signal is useful, but the method is far from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Block-Based Double Decoders
paper.abstract: Encoder-decoder models offer substantial inference-time savings over decoder-only models, but their pretraining objectives suffer from sparse supervision and dynamic sequence lengths, keeping them out of practice at scale. We propose block-based double decoders, a novel transformer architecture that utilizes doubly-causal block-based attention masks to train with full loss supervision and static sequence packing, combining decoder-only training efficiency with encoder-decoder inference efficienc

summary.core_problem: 编码器-解码器架构推理时KV缓存开销更低，但预训练阶段存在监督稀疏（仅少量token产生损失信号）、序列长度动态波动导致批处理效率低的问题，大规模场景下实用性不足；仅解码器模型训练效率高但推理成本高，现有PrefixLM等折中方案也未能同时实现训练阶段全token损失监督和静态序列长度。
summary.importance: 提出了新的注意力掩码设计思路，能够同时兼顾仅解码器模型的训练效率和编码器-解码器模型的推理效率，不需要在训练监督密度和推理开销之间做硬性权衡，为大规模生成模型的架构设计提供了新的折中方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出基于块的双解码器架构，核心是双因果块注意力掩码设计：架构包含两个解码器，第一个解码器采用标准因果掩码处理输入；第二个解码器同时对第一个解码器的输出、以及分块后的输入做交叉注意力，每个块内部使用全自注意力，块之间使用因果交叉注意力。该设计保证所有输入token都能产生损失信号，且打包后的序列长度跨批次保持固定，不需要动态批处理。
summary.experiments: 缩放律实验显示，跨所有测试参数规模，该架构性能显著优于编码器-解码器模型，与仅解码器模型表现接近；推理阶段，在不损失预填充缓存等现有优化能力的前提下，KV缓存内存占用和每token计算量至少降低2/3。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分对现有架构缺陷的分析、架构对比章节的设计逻辑，以及缩放律实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟；核心是理解双因果块掩码如何同时解决训练与推理效率的矛盾，不需要深入复现级别的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Encoder-decoder architectures achieve lower KV-cache overhead at inference, but their pretraining objectives suffer from sparse supervision (only a small fraction of tokens contribute loss signals) and dynamic sequence length fluctuations that reduce batch efficiency, making them impractical for large-scale use. Decoder-only models have high training efficiency but high inference cost, while existing compromises such as PrefixLM fail to deliver both full-token loss supervision and static sequence length during training.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a new attention mask design paradigm that balances the training efficiency of decoder-only models and the inference efficiency of encoder-decoder models, eliminating the forced trade-off between training supervision density and inference overhead. This provides a new architectural trade-off direction for large-scale generative model design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed block-based double decoder architecture centers on doubly-causal block-based attention masks. It includes two decoders: the first applies standard causal masks to process input; the second conducts cross-attention on both the first decoder's output and block-split input, with full self-attention within each block and causal cross-attention between blocks. This design ensures every input token contributes a loss signal, and packed sequence lengths remain fixed across batches, eliminating the need for dynamic batching.
summary_en.experiments: Scaling law experiments show that across all tested parameter scales, the architecture significantly outperforms encoder-decoder models and performs comparably to decoder-only models. At inference, it reduces KV-cache memory and per-token compute by at least 2/3 without sacrificing existing optimizations such as prefill caching.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of existing architectural flaws in the introduction, the design logic in the architecture comparison section, and scaling law experiment results. Expected reading time is 15 minutes. The core takeaway is how doubly-causal block masks resolve the conflict between training and inference efficiency, no need to dig into reproduction-level implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 架构设计巧妙，训练和推理效率的trade-off值得在内部小模型预训练中做消融验证，重点看§3的掩码设计
recommendation.en: Clever architecture design, the trade-off between training and inference efficiency is worth ablation verification in internal small model pretraining, focus on the mask design in §3

paper.title: Stage-adaptive Token Selection for Efficient Omni-modal LLMs
paper.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (om-LLMs) achieve unified audio-visual understanding by encoding video and audio into temporally aligned token sequences interleaved at the window level. However, processing these dense non-textual tokens throughout the LLM incurs substantial computational overhead. Although training-free token selection can reduce this cost, existing methods either focus on visual-only inputs or prune om-LLM tokens only before the LLM with fixed per-modality ratios, failing to c

summary.core_problem: 解决 omni-modal LLM 在视频和音频 token 密集输入下推理成本过高，而现有 token pruning 不能反映跨模态 token 重要性随层深变化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是典型高效推理工作，但有一条对统一多模态预训练也有价值的观察：音视频 token 依赖呈 block-wise 模式，且在深层逐渐减弱，说明跨模态融合后晚层存在大量冗余非文本 token。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SEATS，一种 training-free、stage-adaptive token selection 方法。先分析 om-LLM 的 layer-wise token dependency，再在进入 LLM 前和 LLM 内不同 stage 采用不同的音频/视觉 token 保留策略，而不是固定每模态比例的一次性裁剪。核心是按层深动态调整 pruning 强度，利用早层融合、晚层冗余的结构特征。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名和压缩比，但应在 omni-modal LLM 推理场景下与 visual-only pruning 和 fixed-ratio om-LLM pruning 比较，指标大概率包括吞吐、FLOPs/latency 与任务精度保持。价值主要在 dependency analysis 和无训练部署便利性。
summary.authors_note: 来自中国人民大学、WeChat Vision、腾讯。腾讯在多模态系统和部署优化上积累较深，这类工作通常工程针对性较强。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the high inference cost of omni-modal LLMs with dense video and audio tokens, where existing token pruning methods fail to capture how cross-modal token importance changes with depth.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency paper, but it contains a useful observation for unified multimodal pretraining as well: audio and visual token dependencies are block-wise and weaken with depth, implying substantial late-layer redundancy after cross-modal fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SEATS, a training-free stage-adaptive token selection method. It first analyzes layer-wise token dependency in omni-modal LLMs, then applies different token retention strategies before and within the LLM across stages, instead of a one-shot fixed per-modality pruning ratio. The core idea is depth-aware pruning that exploits early fusion and late redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model names or compression ratios, but the setup likely compares against visual-only pruning and fixed-ratio omni-modal pruning on throughput, FLOPs/latency, and accuracy retention. The main value is the dependency analysis and zero-training deployability.
summary_en.authors_note: From Renmin University of China, WeChat Vision, and Tencent. Tencent has strong experience in multimodal systems and deployment-oriented optimization, so the work is likely engineering-conscious.

recommendation.zh: 做统一多模态的人可以看它的层间依赖分析：若晚层音视频 token 真普遍冗余，训练时的 token budget 和 stage design 都该重想；正文先看 dependency 结果。
recommendation.en: If you work on unified multimodal models, read the dependency analysis first: if late-layer audio/video tokens are broadly redundant, both training token budgets and stage design need revisiting.

paper.title: Breaking Modality Heterogeneity in Low-Bit Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) is a pivotal technique for deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on resource-constrained devices. However, existing PTQ methods often degrade VLMs' accuracy due to the heterogeneous activation distributions of text and vision modalities during quantization. We find that this cross-modal heterogeneity is distributed unevenly across channels: a small subset of channels contains most modality-specific outliers, and these outliers typically reside in differ

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 VLM 低比特 PTQ 里一个很具体但常被粗糙处理的问题：文本 token 和视觉 token 的激活分布并不只是“整体不同”，而是差异集中在少量通道上，而且两种模态的异常通道位置并不重合。已有 transformation-based PTQ 往往对两种模态共享同一组变换，等于让同一套缩放或旋转同时适配两套冲突分布，结果是在低比特尤其是 W4A4、W3A3 这类设置下，量化误差被跨模态异质性放大。论文的核心问题不是一般性的量化精度提升，而是如何在不重新训练 VLM 的前提下，显式拆开这种通道级模态冲突。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练方法本身，而在统一多模态模型的表示结构理解。它给出一个较清楚的经验结论：VLM 的模态异质性并非均匀弥散在全层特征里，而是具有稀疏、通道化、模态错位的结构。这一点对后续做多模态预训练、共享骨干设计、模态对齐损失、甚至 tokenizer 后的表示整形都有启发。工程层面，这篇工作把 VLM PTQ 从“沿用 LLM 量化套路”推进到“按模态结构做分流”，贡献量级属于部署研究里的扎实改进，不改变模型训练范式，但对统一模型的内部统计结构有信息增益。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两步。第一步是 MOCD，Modality-specific Outlier Channel Decoupling。作者先分析校准集上的激活，发现视觉 token 往往呈长尾分布，少数通道幅值特别大；文本 token 的异常更分散，但仍可在通道维上识别出高风险位置。于是他们不再学习一套全通道共享变换，而是把输入通道划成三组：两种模态都相对稳定的 main channels、文本特有异常通道、视觉特有异常通道。划分依据也不是单一统计量：视觉侧更看重 magnitude saliency，文本侧更看重 response consistency，用来识别哪些通道对该模态更敏感、更不适合与另一模态共享量化路径。完成分组后，激活和权重矩阵按通道切分，分别走不同的量化分支。这样做的关键不是增加模型容量，而是避免让视觉异常值去主导文本量化尺度，反过来也一样。

第二步是 ACC，Adaptive Cross-Modal Calibration。即便 main channels 已经去掉了大部分模态特异异常，剩余通道里仍有分布偏移。作者因此又加了两个轻量校准支路：一个偏 weight-side，用来平滑因跨模态偏移而被放大的权重量化误差；另一个偏 activation-side，主要补偿文本 token 在量化后的偏差。这里的设计取舍很明确：不追求复杂的联合优化，而是在主干量化路径之外加小型可学习补偿，保持 PTQ 的训练成本和部署可行性。和传统 TPTQ 相比，区别不只是“多了一个校准模块”，而是先做通道级模态解耦，再对剩余共享部分做轻量修正，优化目标更贴合 VLM 的统计结构。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 Qwen2.5-VL-3B，在六个主流 benchmark 上评估多种量化配置，包括 W4A8、W4A4、W3A3、W3A2。最关键的结果是 W4A4 下几乎保住 FP16 水平：Qwen2.5-VL-7B 平均分 73.5，对比 FP16 的 74.3；Qwen2.5-VL-3B 为 69.6，对比 FP16 的 70.0。这个差距已经很小，说明方法确实把跨模态量化误差压到了较低水平。更有价值的是在更激进的 W3A3、W3A2 下仍然有效，说明收益不只是高位宽下的微调式修补，而是对低比特失真有更强鲁棒性。

从消融逻辑看，论文的证据链主要有三层：一是通道分布分析，证明模态异质性集中在少量且错位的通道；二是 MOCD 单独带来主要收益，说明“先分流”比“共享变换硬适配”更对症；三是 ACC 在 main channels 上继续缩小残余误差，尤其对文本侧恢复更明显。若全文里给出各模块逐步增益，阅读时应重点看 W4A4 和 W3A3 两档，因为这两档最能体现结构性改进，而不是量化噪声被高位宽掩盖。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Fig.2，确认作者观察到的不是一般性的模态均值差异，而是通道级 outlier 错位。然后看 Method 里 MOCD 的通道划分标准，这部分决定方法是否只是启发式工程，还是有稳定统计依据。接着看 ACC 的两个补偿支路，重点理解为什么一个修 weight-side、一个修 activation-side，以及为什么文本侧需要单独补偿。实验部分优先看主表里 Qwen2.5-VL-7B/3B 在 W4A4、W3A3、W3A2 的结果，再看消融表验证 MOCD 和 ACC 各自作用。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果做多模态量化或统一表示分析，值得把通道可视化和模块消融细看一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in low-bit PTQ for VLMs: text and vision activations are not merely different in aggregate, but differ in a channel-sparse and modality-misaligned way. A small subset of channels carries most modality-specific outliers, and the problematic channels for text are often not the same as those for vision. Existing transformation-based PTQ methods usually learn one shared transformation across both modalities, which forces a single quantization-friendly geometry onto conflicting activation statistics. The result is substantial degradation at low bit-widths, especially in W4A4 and below. The core problem here is how to explicitly decouple this channel-level cross-modal conflict without retraining the VLM.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is not in pretraining methodology directly, but in exposing a useful structural fact about unified multimodal models: modality heterogeneity is sparse, channelized, and unevenly distributed, rather than uniformly spread across the representation space. That observation matters beyond quantization. It has implications for multimodal backbone sharing, alignment losses, representation shaping after tokenization, and how much modality-specific structure remains inside supposedly unified hidden states. On the deployment side, the contribution is a solid PTQ advance for VLMs: instead of reusing LLM quantization recipes, it adapts the quantization path to multimodal internal statistics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. First is MOCD, Modality-specific Outlier Channel Decoupling. Using calibration activations, the authors identify that vision tokens tend to exhibit long-tailed channel distributions with a few very large-magnitude channels, while text tokens show a different outlier pattern that is still identifiable channel-wise. Rather than learning one shared transformation over all channels, they partition input channels into three disjoint groups: modality-compatible main channels, text-specific outlier channels, and vision-specific outlier channels. The partition is not based on a single heuristic. Vision-side channels are identified through magnitude saliency, while text-side channels are selected using response consistency, aiming to capture channels that are especially sensitive for one modality and should not share the same quantization path with the other. After partitioning, both activations and weights are split accordingly and quantized through separate branches. The key idea is not to add model capacity, but to prevent one modality’s outliers from dictating the quantization scale of the other.

Second is ACC, Adaptive Cross-Modal Calibration. Even after removing the most problematic modality-specific channels, the remaining shared channels still exhibit residual cross-modal mismatch. ACC adds two lightweight learnable branches: one addresses weight-side quantization errors that become amplified under cross-modal shifts, and the other compensates activation-side deviations, especially for text tokens. The design choice is pragmatic. Instead of introducing a heavy joint optimization scheme, the method keeps the PTQ setting intact and adds small corrective modules around the quantized path. Relative to prior transformation-based PTQ, the novelty is not just an extra calibration block; it is the sequence of first decoupling modality-specific channels, then calibrating the residual shared space.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are conducted on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B across six mainstream benchmarks, under W4A8, W4A4, W3A3, and W3A2 settings. The headline result is that W4A4 nearly preserves FP16 accuracy: the average score is 73.5 vs. 74.3 FP16 on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and 69.6 vs. 70.0 FP16 on Qwen2.5-VL-3B. That gap is small enough to suggest the method substantially suppresses cross-modal quantization error. More importantly, the method remains effective at W3A3 and W3A2, which indicates the gain is not a mild high-bit refinement but a more robust fix for aggressive low-bit distortion.

The ablation logic appears to have three layers. First, channel-distribution analysis establishes that modality heterogeneity is concentrated in a small and misaligned subset of channels. Second, MOCD contributes the bulk of the gain, supporting the claim that explicit channel-level decoupling is more appropriate than forcing a shared transformation. Third, ACC further reduces residual error in the main channels, with stronger recovery on the text side. When reading the full results, W4A4 and W3A3 are the most informative settings because they best expose structural improvements rather than letting higher precision hide quantization mistakes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the channel visualizations, especially the figure showing text/vision activation distributions. The important point is that the issue is not a generic modality gap, but channel-level outlier misalignment. Then read the MOCD section carefully to understand how channels are assigned to the three groups and whether the criteria are statistically grounded or mostly heuristic. After that, look at ACC and focus on why one branch targets weight-side smoothing while the other targets activation-side compensation, and why text requires dedicated recovery. In the experiments, prioritize the main tables for Qwen2.5-VL-7B/3B under W4A4, W3A3, and W3A2, then check the ablations to separate the effects of MOCD and ACC. A quick but useful read should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 outlier 通道统计和消融即可；它不会改变预训练判断，但会提醒 VLM 量化别把两种模态硬塞进同一校准桶。
recommendation.en: Skim the outlier-channel analysis and ablations; it will not change pretraining priors, but it is a useful warning against one-bucket calibration for VLM quantization.

paper.title: K-Quantization and its Impact on Output Performance
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have shown their remarkable capacities in many NLP tasks. However, their substantial size often presents challenges for deployment. This necessitates efficient techniques for model compression, with quantization emerging as a prominent solution. Despite its benefits, the exact impact of quantization (from 2- to 6-bit) on the performance and accuracy of LLMs remains an active area of research. This paper investigates the performance of eight LLM

summary.core_problem: 评估 2-bit 到 6-bit K-quantization 对多个 LLM 输出质量的影响，尤其关注压缩后知识、推理、代码理解和阅读理解能力的退化模式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率评测。它不是新的量化算法，而是对不同量化位宽和不同模型的性能损失做实证比较，可作为部署侧经验参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文对 8 个 LLM 应用不同 K-quantization 配置，从较激进的 Q2_K 到更高精度的 Q8_0，比较压缩后模型在多个 benchmark 上的表现。方法主要是横向测量，不涉及训练时量化或新的 calibration 技术。
summary.experiments: 使用 MMLU-Pro 测知识和推理，CRUXEval 测代码理解，MuSR 测阅读理解。结果显示 Q8_0 等较高精度通常表现更好，但收益递减；2-bit 等激进量化在部分模型上仍能保留可用准确率，但某些模型会明显退化。摘要未提供完整模型名单和具体分数表。
summary.authors_note: Lund University。未见可确认的知名作者背景或代表性系统工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures how K-quantization from 2 to 6 bits affects the output quality of several LLMs across reasoning, coding, and reading tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency evaluation rather than a new quantization method. Its value is practical: it documents degradation patterns across bit-widths and model families.
summary_en.technical_approach: Eight LLMs are evaluated under multiple K-quantization settings, ranging from aggressive Q2_K-style compression to higher-precision Q8_0. The study is mainly empirical and does not introduce a new calibration or quantization-aware training method.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses MMLU-Pro for knowledge and reasoning, CRUXEval for code comprehension, and MuSR for reading comprehension. Higher precision such as Q8_0 generally performs better with diminishing returns, while 2-bit quantization can remain usable for some models but causes large drops for others. The abstract does not expose the full model list or detailed score tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Lund University. No widely known author background is identifiable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 作为部署经验备查即可；没有新量化机制，读结论表比读方法更有收益。
recommendation.en: Useful as deployment bookkeeping, not as a new quantization idea; read the result tables rather than the method.

paper.title: Context Memorization for Efficient Long Context Generation
paper.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) applications increasingly rely on long conditioning prefixes to control model behavior at inference time. While prefix-augmented inference is effective, it incurs two structural limitations: i) the prefix's influence fades as generation proceeds, and ii) attention computation over the prefix scales linearly with its length. Existing approaches either keep the prefix in attention while compressing it, or internalize it into model parameters through gradient-based

summary.core_problem: 解决长前缀条件生成中两个问题：前缀影响随生成变弱，以及每步都对长前缀做 attention 带来的线性开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与长上下文效率方法。它尝试把固定 prefix 从在线 attention 中移出，用训练免费记忆替代完整前缀重算，对 prompt-heavy 应用和长上下文 serving 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 attention-state memory：预先计算 prefix 与 query token 之间的 attention states，并存入轻量 lookup memory。推理时模型不再完整 attending over prefix，而是检索这些预计算状态来保留前缀控制信号。方法不需要梯度训练，也比把 prefix 内化进参数更容易更新。
summary.experiments: 在 ManyICLBench 上使用 LLaMA-3.1-8B 评估；摘要报告在 1K 到 8K memory budget 下，相比常规 in-context learning 提升准确率，同时降低 prefix attention latency。具体延迟和准确率幅度需看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two issues in long-prefix generation: prefix influence fades over time, and attention over the prefix scales linearly with prefix length.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and long-context systems contribution. It tries to move fixed prefixes out of online attention through a training-free memory, which is relevant for prompt-heavy applications and serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, attention-state memory, precomputes attention states between prefix and query tokens and stores them in a lightweight lookup memory.
