At inference time, the model retrieves these states instead of attending over the full prefix. It avoids gradient-based parameter updates and supports easier prefix changes.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use LLaMA-3.1-8B on ManyICLBench. The abstract reports better accuracy than standard in-context learning under 1K–8K memory budgets while reducing attention latency over the prefix.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和延迟表即可；若结果稳，prefix-as-memory 比继续压 KV 更像可落地 serving trick。
recommendation.en: Read the method and latency table; if the numbers hold, prefix-as-memory is a more deployable serving trick than yet another KV compression variant.

paper.title: Stage-adaptive Token Selection for Efficient Omni-modal LLMs
paper.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (om-LLMs) achieve unified audio-visual understanding by encoding video and audio into temporally aligned token sequences interleaved at the window level. However, processing these dense non-textual tokens throughout the LLM incurs substantial computational overhead. Although training-free token selection can reduce this cost, existing methods either focus on visual-only inputs or prune om-LLM tokens only before the LLM with fixed per-modality ratios, failing to c

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 omni-modal LLM 在处理视频和音频密集 token 时推理成本过高，而现有训练免费 token selection 又无法刻画跨层、跨模态的重要性变化。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率优化。它的价值不在预训练本身，而在于给出一个关于 om-LLM 层间 token 依赖演化的经验观察：音视频 token 的依赖呈 block-wise 结构，并在深层逐渐减弱，因此后层存在可裁剪冗余。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先分析 om-LLM 的 layer-wise token dependency，发现视觉和音频 token 在深层的重要性下降。基于此提出 SEATS，一种 training-free、stage-adaptive token selection 方法：在进入 LLM 前先做预筛选，并在 LLM 内不同 stage 按模态和层深动态调整保留比例，而不是固定每种模态的压缩率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和数值结果，但可确认实验围绕 omni-modal 理解推理加速展开，比较对象应是无裁剪和固定比例裁剪方法。论文的关键证据应在 layer-wise dependency 分析图和不同 stage token 保留策略的效率-精度曲线上。缺少完整数字，当前更适合快速浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high inference cost of omni-modal LLMs when processing dense video and audio tokens, while existing training-free token selection methods fail to capture layer-wise and cross-modal changes in token importance.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency contribution. Its main value for foundation-model researchers is the empirical observation that audio and visual token dependencies show a block-wise pattern and weaken with depth, implying substantial late-layer redundancy after cross-modal fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first analyze layer-wise token dependency in omni-modal LLMs and find that visual and audio token importance declines in deeper layers. Based on this, they propose SEATS, a training-free stage-adaptive token selection method that performs pre-LLM filtering and then dynamically adjusts token retention ratios across stages and modalities, instead of using fixed pruning ratios.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact numbers, but the experiments clearly target omni-modal understanding with inference acceleration. The likely comparisons are against no pruning and fixed-ratio pruning baselines. The most useful evidence should be the dependency analysis figures and the efficiency-accuracy tradeoff curves under stage-adaptive retention.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，读价值主要在 layer-wise token dependency 分析；如果你做 unified multimodal serving，只看分析图和效率曲线就够了。
recommendation.en: Not deeply tied to pretraining; the useful part is the layer-wise token dependency analysis, and if you work on unified multimodal serving, the figures and efficiency curves are enough.

paper.title: CAPS: Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
paper.abstract: Parallel reasoning, where a generator samples many candidate solutions and an aggregator selects the best, is one of the most effective forms of test-time scaling in large language models, and pairwise self-verification has become its strongest aggregation primitive. Yet pairwise verification carries a heavy cost: each judgment reads two complete solutions in full, and existing methods perform tens of such judgments per problem regardless of whether the comparison is informative. We introduce CA

summary.core_problem: CAPS 解决的是 parallel reasoning 中 pairwise verifier 成本过高的问题。生成多个候选解以后，强聚合器通常要做成对比较，但每次比较都读取两份完整推理或代码，单次可能是 4K–8K token，验证成本很快超过生成成本。已有方法主要优化“比较哪些 pair”，很少优化“每个 pair 读多少证据”。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 test-time scaling 和 verifier 训练有直接参考价值。它把聚合器成本拆成两个可控维度：证据粒度和比较分布。这个拆分有助于理解为什么并行采样的收益常被 verifier 可靠性和成本限制住。对基座研究员更有用的点在于：候选多样性、验证器校准、局部证据判断能力，会共同决定推理时扩展曲线。若预训练或后训练希望提升模型的自验证能力，不能只看完整 CoT 判断准确率，也要看模型在部分证据下的 pairwise discrimination 能力。
summary.technical_approach: CAPS 是 inference-only 框架，不改模型权重。方法有两条轴。第一条是 evidence axis：比较时不总是读完整解，而是先看便宜证据，例如 boxed answer、代码开头、短 reasoning window；只有需要时再升级到更完整证据。第二条是 distribution axis：比较预算不均匀分配给所有候选，而是把更贵的 full-evidence comparison 留给更可能成为 winner 的候选。具体实现是四阶段 cascade，并给出 verifier-token cost 的闭式刻画。另有可选 rescue subroutine，用来降低最便宜证据层误判导致强候选被过早淘汰的风险。与 V1-Infer 的区别是：V1-Infer 重点在 uncertainty-guided Swiss tournament，即优化 pair selection；CAPS 同时改变每次比较的证据量和比较预算分布。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4 个 self-verifying 模型：Qwen3-14B、GPT-OSS-20B、Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507、Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507；5 个 reasoning benchmark：LiveCodeBench-v5、LiveCodeBench-v6、CodeContests、AIME 2025、HMMT February 2025。基线包括无验证 Vanilla、pointwise self-verification、V1-Infer。CAPS 在 20 个设置中全部超过 pointwise verification；相对 V1-Infer，在 14/20 个设置上更高，同时在代码任务上平均只使用 V1-Infer 25.4% 的 verifier-token budget。经验 token ratio 与闭式成本预测误差在 3 个百分点以内，说明节省主要来自结构设计，而不是单次调参。6 个落后于 V1-Infer 的结果差距不超过 3.4 Pass@1 points。作者还把失败场景归因到 partial evidence 与 full evidence 下 verifier pairwise accuracy 的差距，这给部署前判断 CAPS 是否适用提供了一个简单检查。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分对 evidence axis 和 distribution axis 的定义，以及四阶段 cascade 的成本推导；实验部分优先看 CAPS 与 V1-Infer 的 token budget/Pass@1 trade-off。若关心预训练或后训练，可以重点看 partial evidence verifier accuracy 的分析：它提示自验证能力不是单一能力，而是随证据粒度变化的条件判断能力。

summary_en.core_problem: CAPS targets the cost bottleneck in parallel reasoning with pairwise self-verification. After sampling many candidate solutions, strong aggregators often compare candidates head-to-head, but each comparison reads two full solutions, often 4K–8K tokens each. Existing methods mostly optimize which pairs to compare, while treating the evidence consumed per comparison as fixed.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to test-time scaling and verifier design. The useful abstraction is the separation between evidence granularity and comparison allocation. It clarifies why parallel sampling can become verifier-limited: candidate diversity is not enough if the aggregator is too expensive or poorly calibrated. For foundation-model training, the main signal is that self-verification should be evaluated not only on full-chain judgments, but also on partial-evidence pairwise discrimination.
summary_en.technical_approach: CAPS is an inference-only framework. It allocates verifier compute along two axes. The evidence axis controls how much of each candidate the judge reads, starting from cheap views such as boxed answers, early code lines, or short reasoning windows, and escalating when needed. The distribution axis controls where comparisons are spent, reserving expensive full-evidence comparisons for candidates that are more likely to be selected. The concrete method is a four-stage cascade with a closed-form verifier-token cost model. An optional rescue routine reduces the risk that a strong candidate is eliminated by an early low-evidence mistake. Compared with V1-Infer, which focuses on uncertainty-guided pair selection in a Swiss-style tournament, CAPS changes both the evidence used within each comparison and the allocation of comparison budget across the pool.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses four self-verifying models: Qwen3-14B, GPT-OSS-20B, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507. Benchmarks include LiveCodeBench-v5, LiveCodeBench-v6, CodeContests, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025. Baselines are vanilla selection without verification, pointwise self-verification, and V1-Infer. CAPS beats pointwise verification in all 20 settings. It outperforms V1-Infer in 14 of 20 settings while using, on code tasks, 25.4% of V1-Infer’s verifier-token budget on average. The observed token ratio is within three percentage points of the closed-form prediction. In the six cases where V1-Infer is better, the gap is at most 3.4 Pass@1 points. The paper links these cases to the verifier’s accuracy gap between partial and full evidence, which is a practical pre-deployment diagnostic.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim pass of 20–30 minutes is enough. Focus on the definitions of the evidence and distribution axes, the four-stage cascade, and the verifier-token cost derivation. In the experiments, prioritize the Pass@1 versus verifier-token comparisons against V1-Infer. For training researchers, the most useful part is the analysis of partial-evidence verifier accuracy, since it exposes a finer-grained view of self-verification capability.

recommendation.zh: 推理侧并行验证的效率优化方法，仅需阅读方法部分的双轴分配设计和成本推导即可
recommendation.en: Inference-side parallel verification efficiency optimization, only read the dual-axis allocation design and cost derivation in the method section

paper.title: GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Large Language Model Decoding
paper.abstract: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), the attention used in DeepSeek-V2/V3, jointly compresses keys and values into a low-rank latent and matches the H100 roofline almost perfectly. Its trained weights, however, expose only one decoding path - an absorbed MQA form - which ties efficient inference to H100-class compute-bandwidth ratios, forfeits tensor parallelism along the head axis, and yields no Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) gain on commodity inference GPUs such as the export-restricted H20. We pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 DeepSeek-V2/V3 所用 MLA 在推理部署上的一个结构性限制：它虽然把 KV cache 压得很低，但训练好的权重在解码时基本只暴露出一种高效路径，也就是 absorbed MQA 形式。这条路径在 H100 这类高算力高算带比硬件上很合适，但一旦换到 H20 这类带宽还在、算力明显下降的卡上，就会从 memory-bound 变成 compute-bound，吞吐掉得很厉害；同时它还不利于沿 head 维做 tensor parallel，也让 multi-token prediction 几乎拿不到收益。论文要解决的核心问题不是再发明一种更省 KV 的注意力，而是让同一套训练权重能根据硬件特性切换不同的等价解码路径，从而把 MLA 从“只适配一种 roofline 的设计”改成“可按硬件自适应部署的设计”。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理架构与系统效率，不属于 llm_pretrain 主线，但对做基座模型架构的人仍有参考价值，因为它讨论的是注意力参数化方式如何约束后续部署自由度。它的重要性主要有三层。第一，它指出 MLA 的优势并不是无条件成立，而是和 H100 的 compute/bandwidth 比较强耦合，这个判断很有现实意义。第二，它把“训练时参数等价、部署时路径可切换”明确成一个设计目标，这对以后做硬件感知架构搜索、attention parameterization、甚至 unified train-serve co-design 都有启发。第三，它给出了一条从已有 GQA checkpoint 迁移到 GQLA 的低成本路径 TransGQLA，说明这种结构改动不一定要从头预训练。量级上看，这更像一篇针对 MLA 部署局限的定向修正，而不是新的基础建模范式；启发主要在架构可部署性，而不是语言建模能力本身。
summary.technical_approach:
GQLA 的核心思想是保留 MLA 的 latent KV 压缩框架，但把上投影的索引方式从“按 query head 复制”改成“按 group 建模”，从而让同一组参数支持两条代数等价的解码路径。

先看 MLA 的问题。MLA 训练和 prefill 时可以像 MHA 一样把 latent 展开成 per-head K/V 来算 attention；但在 decoding 时，为了省 cache 和带宽，会把上投影吸收到 query/output projection 里，直接对 latent 做 attention，也就是 absorbed MQA path。这个路径的 arithmetic intensity 在 H100 上接近 roofline，很合适；但它只有这一条路。因为所有 query head 都共享同一个 latent KV，head 维 tensor parallel 很难做零冗余切分；而且一旦做 MTP，额外 query token 会继续抬高算强度，在 H20 这类低 ridge point 设备上几乎没有吞吐收益。

GQLA 的改法很克制。输入 token 先经 W^DKV 压到低秩 latent c_t^{KV}，这一点和 MLA 一样；不同之处在于 W^UK 和 W^UV 不再为每个 query head 单独展开，而是只展开成 g 个 KV groups。这样训练后权重可以有两种解码解释：
1) MQA-absorb path：和 MLA 一样，cache 里存 latent c^{KV} 加共享 RoPE key，所有 query head 直接对 latent 注意力，适合 H100 这类高算力卡；
2) GQA path：把 latent 物化成 per-group 的 K_C, V，并缓存这些 group 级 K/V，再用标准 GQA kernel 解码，适合 H20 这类更容易 compute-bound 的卡。

关键点在于这两条路径对同一组训练参数是代数等价的，不需要重新训练不同模型。论文推荐配置是 h_q=128, g=8，再配一个 MTP head。这个配置下，H100 上单 token decoding 走 MQA-absorb，继续吃到 MLA 的低 cache 优势；H20 上则走 GQA path，并借助更低的 arithmetic intensity 把运行点拉回硬件 ridge 附近，同时支持最多 8 路沿 group 维的零冗余 tensor parallel。

论文还提出 TransGQLA，用于把已有 pretrained GQA checkpoint 转成 GQLA。它是在 TransMLA 的转换流程上做一个很小的修改：head merging 时保留 group 索引，而不是合并到 query-head 级别。作者强调这基本是 one-line change，目的是避免从头预训练。另一个扩展是 sparse attention：由于 GQLA 在 GQA path 下的 query-per-KV-head 比 h_q/g=16，正好匹配 Tensor Core MMA tile，因此稀疏版本在 H20 类硬件上仍能保留 GQA 路径；而 sparse MLA 仍被锁在 sparse MQA-absorb 路径上。

方法上的核心贡献不是新的 attention score 公式，而是参数布局和缓存布局的重新设计，让“同权重多执行路径”成为可能。
summary.experiments:
实验由两部分组成：roofline 分析和实证验证。roofline 部分是全文论证的基础。作者给出 MLA canonical 配置在 H100 上单 token decoding 的 arithmetic intensity 约为 242 FLOPs/byte，接近 H100 BF16 ridge point 约 295，因此 MLA 在 H100 上几乎是理想匹配；但 H20 的 ridge 只有约 37 FLOPs/byte，MLA 远高于这个点，因而会变成 compute-bound。GQLA 的目标就是让同一权重在不同硬件上落到不同但都合理的 operating point。

论文声称在推荐配置 h_q=128, g=8 并带一个 MTP head 时，H100 + MQA-absorb path 可以继承 MLA 的甜点区，而 H20 + GQA path + s_q=2 的 multi-token prediction 能接近理想吞吐增益。这里最关键的实验信息不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是吞吐、算带匹配和 TP 可扩展性。正文片段提到在 LLaMA-3-8B 上验证了 TransGQLA，但没有给出完整表格数字，因此无法在这里复述具体 perplexity 或 throughput 数值。

从已给内容能确认的实验结论有三点。第一，GQLA 两条路径在数学上等价，因而不会因为切换路径而引入额外精度损失。第二，在 H100 类设备上，它不会牺牲 MLA 的优势，因为仍可走原来的 absorbed path。第三，在 H20 类设备上，它通过切到 GQA path 降低算强度，并让 MTP 真正带来吞吐提升，而不是像 MLA 那样继续被 compute 限制。

如果看消融重点，最值得关注的是 group 数 g、query head 数 h_q、MTP token 数 s_q 对 arithmetic intensity 和 cache footprint 的共同影响，以及 TransGQLA 转换后与原始 GQA/MLA 在质量和速度上的差距。论文的价值主要建立在这些 trade-off 是否被量化清楚。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“问题设定—公式等价—roofline—实证”四步读。

先看 Introduction，把作者对 MLA 三个缺点的界定看清楚：hardware coupling、TP-unfriendly、MTP-unfriendly。这里不是泛泛谈效率，而是在特定 roofline 模型下指出 MLA 为什么只适合一类 GPU。

然后看 Methods 里 GQLA 的参数化方式，尤其是 latent 到 K/V 的上投影为什么按 group 而不是按 head，以及两条解码路径为什么代数等价。这里是全文最核心的技术点。如果这部分没看懂，后面的硬件分析会显得像经验调参。

第三步重点看 Section 4 的 roofline analysis。作者的主要说服力来自 arithmetic intensity 的推导，而不是语言建模指标。要特别留意 H100 与 H20 的 ridge point、不同路径的 FLOPs/byte、以及 MTP 为什么会把 MLA 进一步推向 compute-bound。

最后看 LLaMA-3-8B 上的验证实验，重点不是绝对分数，而是路径切换是否保持质量、吞吐是否符合 roofline 预测、TP 是否真的做到零冗余。若只做泛读，30 分钟左右足够；若要判断这套设计是否值得用于新模型架构，建议把公式推导和硬件假设都过一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: GQLA addresses a structural deployment limitation of Multi-head Latent Attention as used in DeepSeek-V2/V3. MLA achieves very strong KV-cache compression, but at decode time its trained weights effectively expose only one efficient execution path: the absorbed MQA form. That path is well matched to H100-class hardware, where compute-to-bandwidth ratios are high, but it becomes poorly matched on lower-compute GPUs such as H20, where the same arithmetic intensity pushes decoding into a compute-bound regime. The same design also makes head-axis tensor parallelism awkward and leaves little or no throughput gain from multi-token prediction. The paper’s central problem is therefore not how to compress KV further, but how to parameterize latent attention so that one trained model can expose multiple algebraically equivalent decoding paths and choose the one that best matches the target hardware.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-architecture paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model researchers because it shows how attention parameterization can lock in or preserve deployment flexibility. Its importance is threefold. First, it makes explicit that MLA’s efficiency is hardware-conditional rather than universal; the design is tightly coupled to H100-like rooflines. Second, it elevates a useful design principle: keep training-time parameters fixed while exposing multiple deployment-time execution paths. That idea is relevant to train-serve co-design more broadly. Third, the proposed TransGQLA conversion suggests that this flexibility can be added to existing checkpoints without full pretraining. The contribution is best read as a targeted architectural correction to MLA’s deployment constraints, not as a new language-modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea of GQLA is to retain MLA’s latent KV compression while changing how the latent up-projections are indexed. Instead of effectively replicating them across all query heads, GQLA indexes them by groups. This small change allows the same trained parameters to support two algebraically equivalent decoding paths.

To understand the motivation, recall MLA’s behavior. During training and prefill, the latent can be expanded into per-head keys and values and attention is computed in an MHA-like form. During decoding, however, the up-projections are absorbed into the query and output projections so that attention runs directly against the latent, yielding an absorbed MQA-style path. This is excellent for H100 because the arithmetic intensity lands near the hardware roofline. But it is the only path MLA exposes. Since all query heads share one latent KV representation, tensor parallelism along the head axis becomes replication-heavy, and adding MTP further increases arithmetic intensity, which is especially harmful on H20-class devices.

GQLA keeps the same low-rank latent compression step via W^DKV, but changes W^UK and W^UV so that the latent expands into g KV groups rather than per-query-head representations. As a result, the trained weights admit two decode-time interpretations:
1) an MQA-absorb path, identical in spirit to MLA, where the cache stores the latent c^{KV} plus the shared RoPE key and all query heads attend directly to the latent; and
2) a GQA path, where the latent is materialized into per-group K and V tensors and decoding uses a standard GQA kernel.

The key point is that these two paths are algebraically equivalent over the same parameters. No retraining is needed to switch execution mode. The recommended configuration is h_q = 128 and g = 8, plus one MTP head. Under this setup, H100 can continue using the absorbed path and preserve MLA’s cache-efficiency sweet spot, while H20 can switch to the GQA path, lower effective arithmetic intensity, and recover throughput gains from MTP. The GQA path also enables up to 8-way zero-redundancy tensor parallelism along the group axis.

The paper also proposes TransGQLA, a lightweight conversion from a pretrained GQA checkpoint to GQLA. It is described as a minimal modification to the TransMLA pipeline: during head merging, preserve group indexing instead of collapsing everything to query-head indexing. A sparse-attention extension is also discussed. Because GQLA’s GQA path yields a query-per-KV-head ratio of h_q / g = 16, it aligns well with Tensor Core MMA tiling, allowing sparse GQLA to preserve the GQA path on H20-like hardware, unlike sparse MLA which remains locked to sparse absorbed-MQA execution.

The main contribution is therefore not a new attention score formulation, but a parameter and cache layout that preserves multiple hardware-adaptive execution paths for the same model weights.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation has two pillars: roofline analysis and empirical validation. The roofline argument is central. For canonical MLA settings, the paper estimates single-token decoding arithmetic intensity at about 242 FLOPs/byte, close to the H100 BF16 ridge point of roughly 295 FLOPs/byte. That explains why MLA is such a good fit on H100. But H20’s ridge point is only around 37 FLOPs/byte, so the same MLA decode path becomes strongly compute-bound there. GQLA is designed so that the same weights can land on different, more appropriate operating points depending on the hardware.

The paper claims that with the recommended h_q = 128, g = 8 configuration and one MTP head, H100 plus the MQA-absorb path preserves MLA’s favorable operating point, while H20 plus the GQA path at s_q = 2 can approach the hardware ridge and recover near-ideal throughput gains from MTP. The most important outcomes are therefore throughput, arithmetic-intensity matching, and tensor-parallel scalability rather than language-model benchmark gains. The provided text mentions validation on LLaMA-3-8B via TransGQLA, but does not include the full numerical tables, so exact perplexity or throughput numbers cannot be reproduced here.

Still, three conclusions are clear from the available content. First, the two GQLA paths are mathematically equivalent, so path switching should not introduce accuracy drift by itself. Second, on H100-class devices, GQLA does not give up MLA’s main advantage because it can still use the absorbed path. Third, on H20-class devices, switching to the GQA path lowers the effective compute pressure and allows MTP to produce real throughput gains instead of being nullified by compute bottlenecks.

For ablations, the most informative ones are likely the interactions among group count g, query-head count h_q, and MTP token count s_q, since these jointly determine cache footprint and arithmetic intensity. The paper’s practical value depends on whether those trade-offs are quantified cleanly against baseline GQA and MLA variants.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim order is: problem framing, equivalence construction, roofline analysis, then empirical validation.

Start with the introduction and make sure the three claimed MLA drawbacks are clear: hardware coupling, poor tensor-parallel behavior, and no MTP gain on lower-compute GPUs. The paper is not making a generic efficiency claim; it is making a hardware-specific argument grounded in roofline behavior.

Then read the method section carefully enough to understand why indexing the latent up-projections by group rather than by head creates two algebraically equivalent decode paths. That is the technical center of the paper. Without that, the hardware discussion can look like tuning rather than architecture.

Next, spend time on the roofline analysis. The paper’s main persuasive force comes from arithmetic-intensity calculations, not from language-model quality numbers. Pay attention to the ridge points for H100 and H20, the FLOPs/byte of each path, and why MTP pushes MLA further into the compute-bound regime.

Finally, read the LLaMA-3-8B validation with a focus on whether path switching preserves model quality, whether throughput follows the roofline predictions, and whether tensor parallelism is truly zero-redundancy along the group axis. A 30-minute skim is enough to capture the main idea, but a serious evaluation requires checking the derivations and hardware assumptions in detail.

recommendation.zh: 对DeepSeek MLA的一次实用且低成本的增强——双路径设计巧妙，同一套权重适配不同硬件，对多平台部署有直接参考价值。值得读方法部分理解代数等价性证明。
recommendation.en: A practical and low-cost enhancement to DeepSeek's MLA—the dual-path design is clever, enabling weight reuse across hardware. Worth reading the method section for the algebraic equivalence proof.

paper.title: Ghosted Layers: Unconstrained Activation Alignment for Recovering Layer-Pruned LLMs
paper.abstract: Layer pruning removes entire Transformer decoder blocks from large language models, but introduces a mismatch between the hidden state received by the next surviving layer and the distribution it was trained to process, leading to significant performance degradation. We propose Ghosted Layers, a training-free recovery module that addresses this issue by solving a boundary activation alignment problem. Our method derives a closed-form optimal linear operator from a small calibration set to recons

summary.core_problem: 层剪枝把一段 Transformer block 直接删掉，会让“下一层收到的 hidden state 分布”偏离它在预训练时见过的分布，导致性能显著掉点。问题是：在不做再训练（training-free）的前提下，能否用一个足够一般的补偿模块，把剪枝边界处的激活对齐到原模型，从而恢复性能；并解释为什么现有的线性补丁方法恢复不彻底。
summary.importance:
这篇更偏推理侧的模型压缩/恢复，不属于预训练方法本体。但它对预训练研究仍有两个启发点：
- 预训练得到的层间“接口分布”很脆弱，删层相当于制造了强分布移位；用显式的 activation alignment 可以把问题局部化、可度量化。
- 线性恢复模块的可表达性（是否允许反对称分量）会决定能否达到对齐目标的最优解，这对设计可插拔的 mid-train/continual 适配模块也有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法把“剪枝后性能下降”形式化为一个边界激活对齐问题。
- 设原模型在剪枝块前后的边界激活分别为 X_pre 与 X_post（把校准集上所有 token 展平到 T_D×C）。剪枝模型会把 X_pre 直接送到后续层，而原模型应送入的是 X_post，两者差异就是 boundary activation gap。
- 在剪枝边界插入一个线性算子 A，使得 A·X_pre 尽量逼近 X_post（或等价地最小化某种对齐误差）。
- 论文的关键点是：在“不限制 A 的结构”的情况下，这个线性回归/对齐问题有闭式最优解；而现有 LinearPatch 把 A 限制在一个很窄的子空间（Hadamard-rotated 的逐通道缩放且对称），因此只能得到受限最优。
- 进一步分析最优 A 的结构，指出其中存在显著的反对称（anti-symmetric）分量；这解释了为什么对称构造的补丁无法把 boundary error 降到位。
- 工程实现上用 forward hook 在边界处插入该算子；离线阶段只需跑一小段校准数据收集 X_pre/X_post 并解闭式解，推理时几乎不增加复杂度（线性变换）。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕两个指标：
- boundary activation error（用 MAE 衡量原模型 post-boundary hidden 与剪枝后输入下一层 hidden 的差异）：Ghosted Layers 能比 ReplaceMe、LinearPatch 等方法更充分地降低该误差。
- 下游任务/基准上的精度恢复：在多个 LLM backbone 与多个 benchmark 上，Ghosted Layers 在相同推理成本下恢复更好。
（你给的全文片段未包含具体模型列表、剪枝比例、以及各基准的数值表；需要在实验章节核对“剪多少层、校准集多大、提升多少点”。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20-30 分钟）：
- 先看方法部分对 activation alignment 的形式化，以及闭式解推导；这是全文的主要贡献。
- 再看他们对 LinearPatch“受限子空间 + 对称性限制”的分析，尤其是最优解含反对称分量的证据。
- 实验只需确认三件事：校准数据量是否很小、对不同剪枝策略是否鲁棒、以及在相同 FLOPs/延迟下是否稳定优于基线。

summary_en.core_problem: Layer pruning deletes entire decoder blocks, but it creates a distribution shift at the pruning boundary: the next surviving layer receives hidden states it was never trained to process, causing large accuracy drops. The paper targets a training-free recovery method that explicitly aligns boundary activations, and explains why prior linear patching methods cannot reach the true optimum due to structural constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily inference-time compression/recovery rather than pretraining. Still, it offers two useful takeaways for foundation-model researchers: (i) the inter-layer interface distribution learned during pretraining is fragile to structural edits, and boundary activation mismatch is a clean, measurable proxy for the damage; (ii) the expressivity of lightweight adaptation modules (e.g., allowing anti-symmetric components) can be the difference between partial and near-optimal alignment—relevant when designing plug-in adapters for continual/mid-training settings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They cast post-pruning recovery as an activation alignment problem.
- Collect boundary activations from the original model on a small calibration set: X_pre (input to the first pruned layer) and X_post (input to the first surviving layer after the pruned block), flattened over tokens.
- Insert a linear operator A at the pruning boundary so that A·X_pre matches X_post by minimizing an alignment objective.
- Main contribution: derive the closed-form unconstrained optimum over the full space of linear operators. Prior work (e.g., LinearPatch) restricts A to a narrow, symmetric subspace (Hadamard-rotated channel-wise scaling), which cannot achieve the unconstrained optimum.
- Analyze the optimal A and show it contains a substantial anti-symmetric component, structurally inaccessible to symmetric constructions—explaining the residual boundary error in prior methods.
- Implement A as a forward hook (“Ghosted Layers”): offline calibration to compute A, then plug-and-play inference with minimal overhead.
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate:
- Boundary activation error (MAE between original post-boundary hidden states and what the pruned model feeds into the next layer): Ghosted Layers reduces this error more than ReplaceMe/LinearPatch.
- Downstream benchmark recovery across multiple LLM backbones: consistently better accuracy recovery at matched inference cost.
(The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables; check the experimental section for pruning ratios, calibration size, and absolute accuracy gains.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 min):
- Read the method section for the alignment formulation and the closed-form solution.
- Read the analysis showing why symmetric/operator-subspace constraints (LinearPatch) miss the optimum, especially the anti-symmetric component evidence.
- In experiments, verify calibration data size, robustness across pruning criteria, and gains at matched latency/FLOPs.

recommendation.zh: 可 skim：只看闭式 alignment 推导和剪枝比例表；它不会改变 pretrain prior，但能补一条干净的压缩校准 baseline。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim for the closed-form alignment derivation and pruning-ratio tables; it will not change pretraining priors but gives a clean compression-calibration baseline.

paper.title: HodgeCover: Higher-Order Topological Coverage Drives Compression of Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers route tokens through a handful of experts, and learning-free compression of these layers reduces inference cost without retraining. A subtle obstruction blocks every existing compressor in this family: three experts can each be pairwise compatible yet form an irreducible cycle when merged together, so any score that ranks experts on pairwise signals is structurally blind to which triples are jointly mergeable. We show the obstruction is a precise mathematic

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很工程化的问题：在不做再训练、蒸馏或 LoRA 适配的前提下，如何把已经训练好的 sparse MoE 层压缩到更少专家，同时尽量保住语言建模质量。作者指出，现有 learning-free MoE 压缩方法大多依赖两两专家之间的相似性、saliency 或 merge score，但这种 pairwise 视角有结构性盲点：三个专家可能两两都“看起来能合并”，但三者一起合并时会出现不可约的循环冲突，导致真实 merge barrier 被低估。论文要解决的核心，就是如何显式识别并利用这种高阶、三元层面的 mergeability obstruction，而不是继续用 pairwise surrogate 近似它。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，这不是新的 MoE 训练范式，而是面向已训练基座模型的后验结构分析与压缩方法。不过它有两点启发比较实在。第一，它把 MoE 专家冗余问题从“相似度排序”推进到“高阶结构可合并性”，说明专家之间的冗余不是简单聚类问题，而带有拓扑约束；这对理解 MoE 在预训练后形成的功能分化有价值。第二，它给出一个无需再训练的压缩路径，适合已经很贵的大模型 checkpoint，在部署侧有直接意义，也能反过来帮助研究者分析训练后专家组织结构。量级上看，这更像是一个有新数学视角的压缩方法，而不是会改写 MoE 预训练主线的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的核心是把一个 MoE 层构造成 2 维 simplicial complex。顶点是专家；边表示专家对之间的 pairwise merge barrier；三角形表示三专家组的 triplet merge barrier。pairwise barrier 的定义，是把两个专家按 calibration 集上的路由频率做 frequency-weighted merge，然后测量合并前后输出分布的 KL 代价；triplet barrier 对三专家做同样的事。作者不是把这些 barrier 简单求和，而是把边上的 barrier 信号视作 1-cochain，在复形上做 Hodge decomposition，用 1-Laplacian L1 = ∂1^T∂1 + ∂2∂2^T 将其分解为 gradient、curl 和 harmonic 三部分。这里真正关键的是 harmonic component：它对应既不是纯局部梯度差异，也不是可由三角面边界解释掉的循环，而是高阶不可约残差。作者把它解释为 mergeability 的拓扑障碍。

在选择保留哪些专家时，HodgeCover 不是直接最小化全局 KL，而是把 harmonic-critical edges 和 triplet-critical triangles 当作需要“覆盖”的结构单元。具体做法是：先取 top-p% 的高权重 harmonic 边和 triplet 三角形，再用带 saliency 权重的 greedy submodular coverage 选出 k 个 survivor experts，使这些关键结构尽量被 survivor 集覆盖。未保留专家则通过 router redirect 映射到最近的 survivor。这里的 saliency 权重借鉴了 REAP，但选择目标已经从 pairwise ranking 变成 higher-order coverage。之后作者再叠加 Wanda，对 survivor 专家内部做非结构化剪枝，形成 HodgeCover+Wanda。这个组合的逻辑很清楚：HodgeCover 处理 expert axis 的压缩，Wanda 处理权重轴的稀疏化，两者基本正交。

和已有方法相比，REAP、REAM、MC-SMoE、STUN 主要都停留在 pairwise 或基于路由统计的专家筛选；有些方法虽然会看 triplet 信息，但只是把 triplet 聚合成 pairwise surrogate 或 binary veto，没有把“不可约循环残差”单独抽出来作为选择目标。HodgeCover 的新意就在这里：不是多加一点高阶特征，而是把高阶冲突作为主导压缩决策的对象。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三类 sparse MoE 家族，文中点名包括 Mixtral、OLMoE、Qwen 3.5 等不同规模模型。作者先做诊断实验，发现 harmonic component 在每层 merge barrier energy 中并不小，约占 29% 到 62%。这一步很重要，因为如果 harmonic 能量很弱，整套拓扑建模就会沦为形式化包装；现在至少说明高阶残差在真实 MoE 层里是显著存在的。

主结果是在 66% expert reduction 的设定下比较多种 learning-free 压缩方案。HodgeCover+Wanda 在所有测试模型上都拿到最好的 perplexity，并且相对 STUN+Wanda，某些下游准确率提升最高达到 12.6 个百分点。作者还做了关键消融：在 Qwen 3.5-35B 上，如果跳过 Hodge 步骤，只做匹配的非 Hodge 版本，会带来 5.74 个百分点的性能损失。这说明收益不只是来自 saliency 或 Wanda，而确实来自 higher-order selection objective。

从论文给出的描述看，实验重点不是追求极限压缩率，而是在中高压缩区间验证“高阶结构感知”是否比 pairwise heuristic 更稳。另一个值得注意的点是，方法只需要一个小 calibration corpus 和单次前向统计，不需要再训练，这使得结果的工程含义比很多需要恢复训练的压缩方法更直接。摘要里没有给出完整参数表和全部 PPL 数字，但全文的主张已经足够明确：高阶拓扑信息在无训练 MoE 压缩里是可测、可用、且有独立贡献的。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐行啃数学证明。建议先看 Introduction，把作者要打的靶子弄清楚：pairwise mergeability 为什么会失真。然后直接看定义 mergeability complex 和 Hodge decomposition 的部分，重点理解三个对象：edge barrier、triplet barrier、harmonic component。只要把 harmonic 理解成“无法被局部 pairwise 关系解释掉的循环冲突”，后面的选择目标就顺了。

实验部分优先看三类内容。第一，harmonic energy 占比的诊断图，这决定方法是否有存在必要。第二，66% expert reduction 下与 STUN、REAP 一类基线的主表。第三，skip-Hodge 的消融，这个最能说明方法的独立价值。附录里的证明、complex 构造细节、triangle set 的两阶段筛选可以按需看，预计 30 到 45 分钟能抓住主线。如果做 MoE 压缩或 expert specialization 分析，值得再细看 barrier 定义和 router redirect 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete post-training problem: how to compress a pretrained sparse MoE layer into fewer experts without retraining, distillation, or adapter tuning, while preserving language modeling quality. The key claim is that existing learning-free compressors rely mostly on pairwise compatibility signals, but pairwise signals are structurally insufficient. Three experts can look mutually mergeable in pairs, yet still form an irreducible cycle when merged jointly. The paper is therefore about detecting and exploiting this higher-order obstruction to mergeability, instead of approximating everything with pairwise scores.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining recipe for MoE, but it is relevant to foundation-model research in two ways. First, it reframes expert redundancy as a higher-order structural property rather than a simple similarity-ranking problem. That is useful for understanding how specialization emerges in pretrained MoE layers. Second, it offers a no-retraining compression path for expensive checkpoints, which matters in deployment and also gives a tool for probing post-training expert organization. The contribution is best viewed as a mathematically informed compression method with diagnostic value, not as a change to the main MoE pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method builds a 2D simplicial complex for each MoE layer. Experts are vertices. Pairwise merge barriers live on edges. Triplet merge barriers live on triangles. A pairwise barrier is defined by merging two experts with weights proportional to their routing frequencies on a small calibration set, then measuring the KL cost induced by replacing the pair with the merged expert. Triplet barriers are defined analogously for three experts.

The main step is to treat the edge-barrier signal as a 1-cochain and apply Hodge decomposition using the simplicial 1-Laplacian, L1 = ∂1^T∂1 + ∂2∂2^T. This decomposes the signal into gradient, curl, and harmonic components. The harmonic part is the crucial object: it captures residual cyclic inconsistency that cannot be explained away by local pairwise variation or by triangle-boundary terms. The paper interprets this harmonic residue as the true higher-order obstruction to expert mergeability.

HodgeCover then turns this diagnosis into a selection objective. Instead of directly minimizing a global KL objective, it identifies top-p% harmonic-critical edges and triplet-critical triangles, and selects k survivor experts by greedy submodular coverage of those critical structures, weighted by a saliency term adapted from REAP. Non-survivor experts are redirected to the nearest survivor through router remapping. The hybrid HodgeCover+Wanda then adds unstructured Wanda pruning on the surviving experts. The division of labor is clean: HodgeCover compresses along the expert axis, while Wanda sparsifies weights inside the retained experts.

Compared with REAP, REAM, MC-SMoE, and STUN, the difference is not just “using more features.” Those methods are still fundamentally pairwise or routing-statistic driven. Even methods that consume triplets usually collapse them into pairwise surrogates or veto rules. HodgeCover isolates the irreducible higher-order residue itself and uses it as the primary compression signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover three sparse MoE families, including models such as Mixtral, OLMoE, and Qwen 3.5 at different scales. The first important result is diagnostic: the harmonic component is not negligible. It accounts for about 29% to 62% of per-layer barrier energy. That matters because the whole topological framing would be weak if the harmonic residue were tiny. The paper shows it is substantial in real pretrained MoE layers.

The main comparison is at 66% expert reduction. Under that setting, HodgeCover+Wanda achieves the best perplexity on every tested model. Relative to STUN+Wanda, downstream accuracy gains reach as high as +12.6 percentage points. There is also a key ablation on Qwen 3.5-35B: removing the Hodge step and keeping a matched non-Hodge variant costs 5.74 percentage points. That ablation is the strongest evidence that the gain is not merely from saliency weighting or from Wanda, but from the higher-order selection objective itself.

The paper is not mainly about pushing the most extreme compression ratio. It is about showing that in a meaningful compression regime, higher-order structure-aware selection is more reliable than pairwise heuristics. Another practical point is that the method only needs a small calibration corpus and a single forward-pass style analysis, with no recovery training. That makes the engineering implications more direct than many compression methods that require retraining.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and make sure the failure mode of pairwise mergeability is clear. Then read the section defining the mergeability complex and the Hodge decomposition. The three objects to keep in mind are pairwise barriers, triplet barriers, and the harmonic component. If you understand the harmonic term as cyclic conflict that pairwise signals cannot explain, the rest of the method becomes straightforward.

In the experiments, focus on three things: the diagnostic plots showing harmonic energy share, the main table at 66% expert reduction against STUN/REAP-style baselines, and the skip-Hodge ablation. Those are enough to judge whether the method has independent value. The proofs and the detailed triangle-set construction in the appendix are optional unless you want to reproduce the method. Around 30 to 45 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea. If you work on MoE compression or expert specialization analysis, the barrier definitions and router redirection details are worth a closer look.

recommendation.zh: 用Hodge分解解决MoE专家合并的三元循环问题，数学很漂亮。对做MoE推理优化的人有参考价值，做预训练的人了解结论即可（无需深究拓扑细节）。
recommendation.en: Using Hodge decomposition to resolve the 3-cycle problem in MoE expert merging is mathematically elegant. Valuable for MoE inference optimization researchers; pretraining researchers need only know the conclusion (no need to dive into topology details).

paper.title: Dual-Dimensional Consistency: Balancing Budget and Quality in Adaptive Inference-Time Scaling

However, maximizing their potential through inference-time scaling faces challenges in trade-off between sampling budget and reasoning quality. Current strategies remain inefficient as they typically treat sampling width and depth as orthogonal objectives, where width consensus methods risk reinforcing hallucinations, while depth pruning mechanisms prematurely truncate complex yet valid reasoning chains. Therefore,

summary.core_problem: 解决LLM推理时缩放中采样预算与推理质量的权衡问题，现有方法将采样宽深度视为正交目标导致效率低、易出幻觉或截断有效推理链
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出统一的双维度一致性推理优化框架
summary.technical_approach: 耦合置信度加权贝叶斯协议与趋势感知分层剪枝，将计算资源集中到高质量推理路径，过滤幻觉同时加速共识达成
summary.experiments: 在5个基准上验证，token消耗降低10倍以上，推理效果保持或超过现有方法

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the trade-off between sampling budget and reasoning quality in LLM inference-time scaling, existing methods treat sampling width and depth as orthogonal objectives leading to low efficiency, hallucinations or truncated valid reasoning chains
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, proposes a unified dual-dimensional consistency inference optimization framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Couple confidence-weighted Bayesian protocol with trend-aware stratified pruning, concentrate computational resources on high-quality reasoning paths, filter hallucinations and accelerate consensus
