In the evaluation, focus on the range of attention variants, correctness checks, A100/H100 performance, and comparisons against template compilers and prior LLM-based generation. For pretraining efficiency, prioritize examples involving custom masks, normalization changes, and fused attention pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 只看 IR 设计和性能表；若验证链路扎实，它比“让 LLM 手写 CUDA”更接近可用工具。
recommendation.en: Skim the IR design and performance tables; if the verifier is solid, this is more practical than asking an LLM to write CUDA directly.

paper.title: Budgeted LoRA: Distillation as Structured Compute Allocation for Efficient Inference
paper.abstract: We study distillation for large language models under explicit compute constraints, with the goal of producing student models that are not only cheaper to train, but structurally efficient at inference time. While prior approaches to parameter-efficient distillation, such as LoRA, reduce adaptation cost, they leave the dense backbone unchanged and therefore fail to deliver meaningful inference savings. We propose Budgeted LoRA, a distillation framework that treats model compression as a structur

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 类参数高效蒸馏只降低适配成本、但保留 dense backbone 导致推理成本几乎不降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩和推理效率方法。它把蒸馏重新表述为结构化 compute allocation，而不是固定学生架构或简单插 LoRA，对“训练便宜”和“推理便宜”的区别讲得比较清楚。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Budgeted LoRA，在全局计算预算下分配 dense 计算和低秩路径容量。核心组件包括 module-level dense retention coefficients、自适应 low-rank allocation，以及训练后压缩步骤；压缩时选择性移除、近似或保留 dense 组件，以得到不同计算预算下的学生模型族。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是在显式计算约束下获得结构上更省推理的学生模型，但截断信息未给出具体模型规模、任务、baseline、压缩率或性能提升数值。因此实验可信度需要读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ADAPT Centre 和 Dublin City University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in LoRA-style distillation: it reduces adaptation cost but usually leaves the dense backbone intact, so inference cost barely changes.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and compression contribution. Its useful framing is to treat distillation as structured compute allocation, separating cheap training from genuinely cheaper inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Budgeted LoRA introduces a global compute budget and allocates capacity across dense and low-rank paths. It uses module-level dense retention coefficients, adaptive low-rank allocation, and a post-training compression stage that removes, approximates, or preserves dense components.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states the goal and method but does not expose model sizes, tasks, baselines, compression ratios, or quality-speed trade-offs in the provided excerpt. The empirical strength has to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the ADAPT Centre and Dublin City University.

recommendation.zh: 想做推理压缩可看方法定义；缺少实验细节前，先把它当 LoRA 稀疏化思路而不是可靠 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth a methods skim for compression work; until the curves are visible, treat it as a LoRA-structured sparsification idea, not a recipe.

paper.title: VLMaxxing through FrameMogging Training-Free Anti-Recomputation for Video Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Video vision-language models (VLMs) keep paying for visual state the stream already told us was stable. The factory wall did not move, but most VLM pipelines still hand the model dense RGB frames or a fresh prefix again. We study that waste as training-free anti-recomputation: reuse state when validation says it survives, and buy fresh evidence when the scene, query, or cache topology requires it.   The largest measured win is after ingest. On frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-4bit, adaptive same-vi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究视频 VLM 推理中重复计算的问题：同一段视频的多轮问题、相邻帧和稳定背景经常提供重复视觉信息，但现有系统仍反复做视觉编码、prefix prefill 或 dense frame 输入。论文的目标是在不训练模型的前提下，用缓存复用和轻量验证减少这些重复计算，同时尽量不改变回答。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对视频-语言模型的训练和系统设计有启发。它说明视频 VLM 的效率瓶颈不能简单归结为“少采样帧”或“压缩视觉 token”。不同阶段有不同上限：首次视频输入受视觉塔占比限制，同视频后续问题主要受 prefix/cache 复用影响，流式场景还要处理边界事件和缓存拓扑。对未来的 native multimodal pretraining，较有价值的点是：视频 tokenizer 或媒体流格式应显式暴露变化、稳定性和不确定性信号，而不是只输出均匀帧 token。
summary.technical_approach: 方法被组织成三个部分。C-PERSIST 针对同一视频的后续问题做持久缓存复用，并加入 selective visual-tail repair，避免直接继承缓存造成回答漂移。C-CEILING 给出阶段占比约束，用来解释局部加速为什么不能直接等价为端到端加速。C-VISION 评估首次视频输入时的 training-free vision pruning，即在不改模型权重的情况下跳过部分视觉塔计算。论文强调 codec 或像素差分信号只作为 freshness 和 uncertainty 的证据，不直接当作语义重要性判断；是否重要仍由问题和模型决定。
summary.experiments: 主要结果来自 frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-4bit。在 VideoMME breadth 的 93 个 paired queries 上，adaptive same-video follow-up reuse 在 62 个 repaired follow-up turns 中保持 paired choices 和 correctness，没有观察到 paired drift，同时把后续问题延迟降低 14.90–35.92 倍。首次输入阶段的收益较小，符合阶段占比上限。Gemma 在 32-frame short 设置下给出 1.316 倍 timed-skip 结果。n=60 的 composition audit 中，堆叠后的 1.042 倍端到端结果与测得的阶段占比预测一致。26B 级实验显示默认跨轮缓存路径并不总是安全，低 FPS dense baseline 也是强竞争基线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对三种 regime 的区分：fresh-video first pass、same-video follow-up、streaming。再看 C-PERSIST 的 repaired cache 设计和 93-query VideoMME 结果，这是主要实证贡献。C-CEILING 的阶段占比公式也值得看，它能防止把局部加速误读成端到端收益。若关注视频 tokenization 或 VLM serving，可以读 streaming 和 26B 级实验，重点看哪些缓存路径会破坏 follow-up fidelity。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies redundant computation in video VLM inference. A video often contains stable backgrounds and repeated visual evidence, and follow-up questions over the same video frequently reuse the same visual context. Current pipelines still re-run dense RGB ingestion, vision encoding, or prefix prefill. The goal is to reduce this recomputation without training the model and without changing answers.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an efficiency and systems paper, not a pretraining method. Its value for foundation-model research is in the decomposition of video VLM cost. First-pass video processing, same-video follow-up queries, and streaming have different ceilings and different failure modes. For future native multimodal pretraining, the paper points to a useful interface requirement: video streams or tokenizers should expose stability, change, and uncertainty signals, instead of forcing the model to infer them from uniformly sampled dense frames every time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach has three components. C-PERSIST handles same-video follow-up reuse through persistent cache inheritance plus selective visual-tail repair, because naive cache reuse can enter a failure basin. C-CEILING is a denominator analysis that relates local stage speedups to end-to-end wall-clock gains. C-VISION measures training-free pruning of vision-tower work on fresh videos. The paper treats codec and pixel signals as freshness or uncertainty cues, not as semantic saliency labels. The model and the query still decide what visual evidence matters.
summary_en.experiments: On frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-4bit, adaptive same-video follow-up reuse is evaluated on a 93-query VideoMME breadth setting. Across 62 repaired follow-up turns, it preserves paired choices and correctness with no observed paired drift, while reducing follow-up latency by 14.90–35.92x. First-pass gains are smaller, which matches the measured stage-share ceiling. A Gemma setting gives a clean 1.316x timed-skip result at 32 frames on short videos. In an n=60 composition audit, the stacked 1.042x end-to-end result lands close to what the stage-share terms predict. Larger 26B-class experiments show that default cross-turn cache reuse can be unsafe and that low-FPS dense baselines remain strong.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the separation between fresh-video passes, same-video follow-ups, and streaming. Then read the C-PERSIST design and the 93-query VideoMME evaluation, since that is where the largest measured gain appears. The C-CEILING section is also useful because it prevents over-reading local speedups. For readers working on video tokenization, multimodal serving, or long-context VLMs, the streaming and 26B-class cache-topology discussions are the parts to inspect more carefully.

recommendation.zh: 别被标题带跑：这是 serving/caching 论文，不碰预训练；只看 latency–accuracy 曲线和“漂移边界”压力测试，能直接指导视频多轮产品化。
recommendation.en: This is serving/caching, not pretraining; skim the latency–accuracy tradeoff and drift-bound stress tests for actionable multi-turn video deployment guidance.

paper.title: HeadQ: Model-Visible Distortion and Score-Space Correction for KV-Cache Quantization
paper.abstract: KV-cache quantizers usually optimize storage-space reconstruction, even though attention reads keys through logits and values through attention-weighted readout. We argue that persistent cache error should be measured in model-visible coordinates. For keys, the visible object is score error modulo constant shifts; this yields HeadQ, a key-side method that stores a low-rank residual side code in a calibration-learned query basis and applies it as an additive logit correction. For values, fixed-at

summary.core_problem: KV-cache 量化通常优化 key/value 向量的存储重构误差，但模型真正感知的是 attention logit 和加权 value readout，因此 MSE 可能不是合适目标。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把 KV-cache 量化的误差度量从存储空间转到模型可见空间，给出了更贴近 attention 计算路径的诊断和修正方法。对推理压缩有直接价值，也提醒预训练研究员：内部表示误差要按下游算子坐标系评估。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 HeadQ。key 侧不直接追求 key 向量 MSE，而是在校准学习到的 query basis 中存储低秩残差 side code，并在 attention score 上做加性 logit correction；value 侧用固定 attention 下的 A^2 加权 token distortion 作为替代目标。作者还用 null-space intervention、query-PCA control、wrong-sign HeadQ 等反事实实验排除单纯存储 MSE 解释。
summary.experiments: 在六个模型上比较 Fisher/score-space error、raw key MSE 与 attention KL 的相关性。结果显示 score-space 指标显著更能预测 attention KL。K-only WikiText-103 decode 实验中，在 value 保持 dense 的设定下，HeadQ 大约移除了 84%–94% 的 key-side cache error。Pythia matched checkpoints 被用于定位小模型低熵 route-flip 边界上的异常现象。
summary.authors_note: 作者 Jorge L. Ruiz Williams 为独立研究者；摘要未显示大型机构背景或已知代表性作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: KV-cache quantization usually minimizes reconstruction error in storage space, while the model actually consumes keys through attention logits and values through attention-weighted readout.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a model-visible error formulation for KV-cache quantization. It is useful for inference compression, and it also gives a broader lesson: representation error should be measured in the coordinate system used by the downstream operator.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HeadQ. On the key side, it stores a low-rank residual side code in a calibration-learned query basis and applies it as an additive correction to attention logits, instead of only minimizing key-vector MSE. On the value side, it uses an A^2-weighted token-distortion surrogate under fixed attention. The paper uses null-space interventions, query-PCA controls, same-budget counterexamples, and wrong-sign HeadQ to test against storage-MSE explanations.
summary_en.experiments: Across six models, Fisher or score-space error predicts attention KL much better than raw key MSE. In K-only WikiText-103 decoding with dense values, HeadQ removes roughly 84%–94% of the key-cache error. Matched Pythia checkpoints are used to localize a main anomaly to a low-entropy route-flip boundary in small models.
summary_en.authors_note: Jorge L. Ruiz Williams is listed as an independent researcher; the abstract does not provide evidence of a major lab affiliation or widely known author background.

recommendation.zh: 只看 score-space metric、wrong-sign control 和 Pythia 异常分析；这篇会改变你用 MSE 评估 cache 量化的习惯。
recommendation.en: Read the score-space metric, wrong-sign control, and Pythia anomaly analysis; it weakens the habit of judging cache quantization by MSE.

paper.title: AdapShot: Adaptive Many-Shot In-Context Learning with Semantic-Aware KV Cache Reuse
paper.abstract: Many-Shot In-Context Learning (ICL) has emerged as a promising paradigm, leveraging extensive examples to unlock the reasoning potential of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing methods typically rely on a predetermined, fixed number of shots. This static approach often fails to adapt to the varying difficulty of different queries, leading to either insufficient context or interference from noise. Furthermore, the prohibitive computational and memory costs of long contexts severely lim

summary.core_problem: 解决 many-shot ICL 中固定 shot 数无法适配样本难度，以及长上下文预填充带来的计算和显存成本问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理效率和上下文选择方法，重点在动态选择示例数量与 KV cache 复用。它不属于预训练方法，但对长上下文推理成本和 ICL 工程有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdapShot。先用 probe-based evaluation，根据输出熵估计当前 query 需要多少 shots；再通过 semantic-aware KV cache reuse 复用 probing 和正式推理阶段的前缀计算，减少重复 prefill。方法还试图处理复用 KV 时的位置不匹配问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、上下文长度、速度提升、显存节省或准确率变化。主要声明是动态 shot 数可减少不足上下文或噪声干扰，KV cache 复用降低 many-shot 推理成本。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Electronic Science and Technology of China。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two issues in many-shot ICL: fixed shot counts do not adapt to query difficulty, and long-context prefilling is expensive in compute and memory.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency and context-selection method centered on adaptive shot counts and KV-cache reuse. It is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to long-context inference cost and ICL engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdapShot uses a probe-based evaluation mechanism where output entropy estimates the optimal number of shots for a given query. It then applies semantic-aware KV-cache reuse to avoid redundant prefill computation across probing and final inference, with additional handling for positional mismatch during reuse.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmarks, model sizes, context lengths, speedups, memory savings, or accuracy numbers. The main claim is that adaptive shot selection reduces under-contexting or noise interference, while KV-cache reuse reduces many-shot inference cost.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China.

recommendation.zh: 工程上合理但像组合优化；先看 KV 复用的位置处理和熵阈值消融即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering-plausible but mostly a composition; check the positional handling for KV reuse and the entropy-threshold ablation.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Motion-Aware Caching for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generation paradigms offer theoretical promise for long video synthesis, yet their practical deployment is hindered by the computational burden of sequential iterative denoising. While cache reuse strategies can accelerate generation by skipping redundant denoising steps, existing methods rely on coarse-grained chunk-level skipping that fails to capture fine-grained pixel dynamics. This oversight is critical: pixels with high motion require more denoising steps to prevent er

summary.core_problem: 在自回归（chunk-wise）视频扩散生成里，推理时间主要被“每个 chunk 仍要做很多步迭代去噪”拖住。已有 cache/skip 方法要么面向非自回归 DiT、要么只能做 chunk 级二值跳步，忽略了同一 chunk 内不同帧/不同空间位置的运动差异，导致要么加速不够、要么高运动区域误差累积引发时序崩坏。论文要解决的是：在不引入显著额外显存的前提下，如何做细粒度（token/pixel 级）自适应缓存复用，让高运动区域多算、静态区域多跳，从而稳定加速 AR 视频扩散推理。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏“推理加速/缓存策略”，不是预训练方法论文；但它对做统一生成范式（AR+diffusion、chunk-wise 长视频）的人有参考价值：1）把“缓存误差”与“残差/速度场的稳定性”联系起来，给了一个可操作的判据；2）指出 AR chunk 设定下的两个结构性现象：跨 chunk 的时间冗余不均匀（heterogeneous temporal redundancy）以及 chunk 内帧差异（intra-chunk frame discrepancy），解释了为什么 chunk 级跳步会失效；3）用极轻量的运动代理（帧差）驱动 token 级算力分配，属于工程上可落地的加速路径。对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对“长序列生成的训练-推理接口”（训练用 CDF/AR，推理要可承受）有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 MotionCache：
1）误差分析：把 step-level residual caching 的近似误差上界与“残差不稳定性（residual instability）”绑定，强调误差不是均匀扩散的，而是会在不稳定区域累积并放大。
2）运动-误差的桥：证明/论证 chunk 内相邻帧差（frame difference）可作为缓存误差的上界或高相关代理，从而把“该不该重算”转化为“该 token 的运动强不强”。这一步的关键取舍是：不用光流/额外网络，避免引入额外推理成本与系统复杂度。
3）分层推理日程（coarse-to-fine schedule）：先做结构 warm-up（前若干步不激进跳步）以锁定全局结构与低频一致性；随后进入 token-wise 自适应阶段。
4）token 重要性与累计策略：为每个空间 token 计算 motion-aware importance（由帧差得到），并用加权的 token accumulation policy 决定哪些 token 在当前去噪步需要更新、哪些直接复用缓存 residual。直观上是“高运动区域更频繁刷新缓存，静态背景更激进复用”。
5）与已有方法差异：相对 FlowCache 的 chunk 级二值跳步，MotionCache 在 chunk 内做空间/帧级细粒度；相对 layer-level caching，保持 step-level 的低显存特性；相对通用 DiT 加速方法，显式适配 AR chunk + KV cache 的生成形态。
summary.experiments:
文中给了两个代表性 AR 视频生成模型上的加速与质量对比：
- SkyReels-V2：报告最高约 7.26× 加速，同时保持更好的视觉保真与时序一致性（相对基线与现有 cache/skip 方法）。引言里还给了未加速时的量级：A800、bs=1，生成 7 秒、540×540 约需 27 分钟，说明痛点主要在推理步数与时空注意力成本。
- MAGI-1：约 2.07× 加速，并同样强调质量保持。
摘要/引言层面能确认的硬数字主要是上述 speedup；更细的质量指标（如 FVD、CLIP-score、用户偏好、时序一致性度量）与消融（warm-up 长度、importance 计算、阈值/预算策略、不同噪声步调度）需要看实验章节与表格/附录才能完整复述。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 AR chunk 设定的两类结构性问题（heterogeneous temporal redundancy / intra-chunk frame discrepancy），这是它区别于“普通 DiT 加速”的关键动机。
- 再看理论部分关于“缓存误差 ≤ 残差不稳定性”以及“帧差作为误差上界/代理”的推导，理解它为什么敢用极轻量信号做 token 级决策。
- 最后看方法章节的 coarse-to-fine schedule：warm-up 的必要性、token accumulation policy 的具体形式（如何从 motion importance 变成更新掩码/预算）。
- 实验部分重点核对：不同运动强度场景下的失败案例、与 FlowCache 的对比、以及在不同分辨率/时长/步数设置下 speedup-质量曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive (chunk-wise) diffusion video generators still require many iterative denoising steps per chunk, making inference prohibitively slow. Existing caching/skip methods either target non-AR DiT setups or apply coarse chunk-level binary skipping, ignoring intra-chunk heterogeneity: high-motion regions need more updates to avoid error accumulation, while static regions can be aggressively reused. The paper addresses how to design a fine-grained, motion-adaptive caching policy (token/pixel-level) for AR video diffusion that accelerates inference without blowing up memory or destabilizing temporal coherence.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-acceleration paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect but practical for teams building AR+diffusion long-video systems: (1) it provides a stability-oriented lens—bounding caching approximation error via residual/velocity-field instability; (2) it highlights two AR-specific structural issues (heterogeneous temporal redundancy across chunks and intra-chunk frame discrepancy) explaining why chunk-level skipping underperforms; (3) it proposes a lightweight motion proxy (frame differences) to allocate compute at token granularity, aligning the training-time AR chunking design with a feasible inference-time budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MotionCache combines a theoretical motivation with a coarse-to-fine inference schedule:
1) Error bound: analyzes step-level residual caching and links approximation error to “residual instability”, emphasizing that errors amplify in unstable regions.
2) Motion proxy: argues/proves that intra-chunk frame differences upper-bound or strongly correlate with caching error, enabling motion-aware token importance without optical flow or extra networks.
3) Coarse-to-fine schedule: a warm-up phase computes early denoising steps more faithfully to lock global structure; later steps switch to token-wise adaptive reuse.
4) Token-wise adaptive policy: computes per-token motion importance and applies a weighted token accumulation/update rule—high-motion tokens are recomputed more often, static background tokens reuse cached residuals more aggressively.
5) Positioning vs prior work: finer than FlowCache’s chunk-level binary skipping; retains step-level caching’s low-memory profile compared to layer-level caching; explicitly tailored to AR chunk generation with KV cache rather than generic DiT acceleration.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported headline speedups on two AR video generators:
- SkyReels-V2: up to ~7.26× speedup while maintaining better visual fidelity and temporal coherence than baselines/previous caching methods. The introduction quantifies the baseline pain point: on an A800 with batch size 1, generating a 7-second 540×540 video takes ~27 minutes.
- MAGI-1: ~2.07× speedup with quality preservation.
The provided excerpt confirms speedup numbers; detailed quality metrics (e.g., FVD or other temporal-consistency measures), ablations (warm-up length, importance computation, thresholds/budgets, step schedules), and failure-case analysis should be taken from the main experiment section/tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the AR-specific motivation: heterogeneous temporal redundancy and intra-chunk frame discrepancy.
- Focus on the theory that ties caching error to residual instability, and why frame difference is a justified proxy.
- Study the method section describing the coarse-to-fine schedule (why warm-up is needed) and the exact token accumulation/update rule.
- In experiments, prioritize speedup–quality tradeoff curves, comparisons against FlowCache, and robustness across motion intensity, resolution, and video length.

recommendation.zh: 读误差分析和速度-质量曲线即可；这不是 pretrain 方法，但对长序列生成里的 cache 复用边界有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the error analysis and speed-quality curves; this is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for thinking about cache reuse limits in long-sequence generation.

institutions: Key Laboratory of Multimedia Trusted Perception and Efficient Computing
Ministry of Education of China, Xiamen University

paper.title: Statistically-Lossless Quantization of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Model quantization has become essential for efficient large language model deployment, yet existing approaches involve clear trade-offs: methods such as GPTQ and AWQ achieve practical compression but are lossy, while lossless techniques preserve fidelity but typically do not accelerate inference. This paper explores the middle ground of statistically-lossless compression through three complementary notions of losslessness for quantized LLMs. First, task-lossless compression preserves zero-shot b

summary.core_problem: 大语言模型量化在压缩率和精度之间存在明显权衡：GPTQ/AWQ 等有损压缩在低比特下会导致零样本精度下降，而无损压缩（如 ZipNN）压缩率有限且缺乏推理加速支持。本文试图寻找两者之间的平衡点，即“统计无损”量化。
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的量化范式——统计无损量化（SLQ），并从理论上证明了非对称量化在保持输出分布一致性上的必要性。该方法在保证模型输出统计特性不变的前提下，实现了比传统无损压缩更高的压缩率（低至 3.3 bpp），并能直接利用现有推理框架（如 vLLM）实现加速。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 区分了任务无损（TL，零样本精度在采样方差内）和分布无损（DL，输出分布几乎不可区分）。2. 提出预期接受率（EAR）指标来衡量量化前后分布的保真度。3. 理论证明非对称量化（带零点）相比对称量化能显著降低输出方差（Gamma-squared variance law）。4. 提出 SLQ 流程：使用 2-8 bit 的非对称标量量化，结合多比特 Shapley 敏感度估计和 ILP 分配。对于 DL，直接基于校准数据的 EAR 约束进行搜索；对于 TL，提出单点校准，利用 KL 恢复的线性关系推导比特位需求。
summary.experiments: TL 压缩可达到 3.3 bpp 的高压缩率；DL 压缩需要 5-6 bpp（EAR >= 0.99）。在 NVIDIA GPU 上结合 Humming kernel 库，集成到 vLLM 后，相比 BF16 吞吐量提升 1.7-3.6 倍，且在保持无损精度的同时，性能始终优于 FP8。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对统计无损（TL/DL）的定义，以及非对称量化优势的理论分析（Gamma-squared variance law）。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM quantization faces a trade-off between compression and accuracy: lossy methods (GPTQ/AWQ) degrade zero-shot accuracy at low bitwidths, while lossless methods (ZipNN) offer limited compression and lack inference acceleration. This paper explores a middle ground: 'statistically-lossless' quantization.
summary_en.importance: Introduces Statistically Lossless Quantization (SLQ), a novel paradigm, and theoretically proves the necessity of asymmetric quantization for maintaining output distribution fidelity. SLQ achieves higher compression rates (down to 3.3 bpp) than traditional lossless methods while preserving statistical output characteristics and enabling direct acceleration in existing frameworks like vLLM.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Distinguishes Task-Lossless (TL, zero-shot accuracy within sampling variance) and Distribution-Lossless (DL, indistinguishable output distributions). 2. Proposes Expected Acceptance Rate (EAR) to measure distribution fidelity. 3. Theoretically proves that asymmetric quantization (with zero-point) significantly reduces output variance compared to symmetric grids (Gamma-squared variance law). 4. Proposes the SLQ pipeline: asymmetric scalar quantization across 2-8 bits, using multi-bitwidth Shapley sensitivity estimation and ILP allocation. DL uses EAR constraints from calibration data; TL uses single-point calibration exploiting linear KL-recovery to derive bitwidth requirements.
summary_en.experiments: TL compression achieves high rates (down to 3.3 bpp); DL requires 5-6 bpp (EAR >= 0.99). Integrated into vLLM with the Humming kernel library on NVIDIA GPUs, SLQ yields 1.7-3.6x throughput over BF16, consistently outperforming FP8 while maintaining lossless accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definitions of TL/DL in the Introduction and the theoretical analysis of asymmetric quantization (Gamma-squared variance law). Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 提出的统计无损量化定义为量化保真度评估提供了新标准，只看§2的度量定义和实验结果部分即可
recommendation.en: Proposes statistically lossless quantization definitions and EAR metric for fidelity evaluation, only need to read §2 metric definition and experiment results.

paper.title: BWLA: Breaking the Barrier of W1AX Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have driven major progress in NLP, yet their substantial memory and compute demands still hinder practical deployment. Binarization can compress weights to 1 bit, fundamentally lowering compute and bandwidth cost. However, existing methods cannot address activation heavy tails and thus must keep activations in high precision, preventing true end-to-end acceleration. To overcome this limitation, we propose BWLA (Binarized Weights and Low-bit Activations), the first po

summary.core_problem: BWLA 处理的是 W1AX 后训练量化的两个主要瓶颈：LLM 权重按通道多为单峰、近似高斯分布，和 ±1 二值码本不匹配；激活存在明显重尾和极端 outlier，低比特量化时误差被少数大值主导。已有二值化 PTQ 多保留高精度激活，推理时仍要反量化权重，难以获得端到端低比特执行收益。
summary.importance: 这项工作更偏 efficient serving，但对预训练研究也有间接参考价值。它把二值权重量化的难点从“只看权重误差”推进到“权重分布形状和激活分布形状的联合可量化性”。这对低比特预训练、QAT 预训练、BitNet 类架构都有启发：如果训练过程能主动形成更适合二值码本的权重分布，并控制激活重尾，后续量化会容易很多。贡献量级主要在 PTQ 方法层面，不是新的基座训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: BWLA 的核心是用正交变换同时改造权重和激活。对线性层而言，正交矩阵满足 R^{-1}=R^T，因此可以在权重侧和激活侧成对插入变换，在保持前向等价的同时改变数值分布。Orthogonal-Kronecker Transformation, OKT, 通过梯度无关的目标鼓励权重从单峰分布变成更接近对称双峰分布，使其更贴合 {-1,+1} 二值码本。它用 EM 风格的条件最小化求解正交矩阵，并用 Kronecker 分解把一个大正交矩阵拆成两个小正交矩阵，降低 PTQ 阶段的计算和存储开销。同一个变换作用到激活后，还可以削弱激活 outlier 的影响。Proximal SVD Projection, PSP, 在对齐后的坐标系里加入轻量低秩修正，用近端上界和截断 SVD 吸收残余 outlier，减少二值化后的局部误差。和 BiLLM、ARB-LLM 这类主要依赖 Hessian 或显著性保留的 weight-only 二值化不同，BWLA 明确把低比特激活纳入目标；和 BitNet a4.8 这类 QAT 路线不同，它不需要端到端再训练。
summary.experiments: 可见内容给出的关键设定是 1-bit 权重加低比特激活，例如 W1A6；对比对象包括 BiLLM、ARB-LLM 等后训练二值化方法，以及需要 QAT 的 BitNet a4.8。动机实验显示，现有二值化方法在权重量化后若继续把激活压到低比特，精度会明显受损，因此通常保留高精度激活。文中还用 LLaMA2-70B 的 FP16 推理内存超过 120GB 说明部署压力。提供的正文片段没有包含完整结果表、困惑度数值、下游任务分数或逐层消融数字；能确认的是作者声称在多个 LLM 上优于既有 PTQ 方法，并实现纯 PTQ 下的 W1AX 高精度量化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，Introduction 中对 W1AX 失败原因的分解，尤其是权重单峰分布和激活重尾的图示；第二，Method 中 OKT 的目标函数、EM 式更新和 Kronecker 参数化，这是方法的主要信息量；第三，PSP 的低秩修正是否真的带来稳定增益，需要结合消融表看。若只关心预训练，可把它当作低比特友好训练目标的参考：训练时是否应显式约束权重双峰性和激活 outlier，而不是事后补救。

summary_en.core_problem: BWLA targets the W1AX post-training quantization setting: 1-bit weights with low-bit activations. The main failure modes are distributional. Per-channel LLM weights are usually unimodal and quasi-Gaussian, which is poorly matched to a binary ±1 codebook. Activations have heavy tails and extreme outliers, so low-bit activation quantization is dominated by a small number of large values. Existing binarization methods often keep activations in high precision, which limits real end-to-end acceleration.
summary_en.importance: The work is primarily an inference-efficiency contribution, but it is still informative for pretraining researchers. It frames low-bit model quality as a joint property of weight geometry and activation statistics, not just a local weight reconstruction problem. This matters for low-bit pretraining and BitNet-style model design: a training recipe that naturally produces bimodal weights and controlled activation tails should be easier to quantize than a standard dense model repaired after training. The contribution is methodological within PTQ rather than a new pretraining objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: BWLA inserts an orthogonal transformation around linear layers. Because an orthogonal matrix satisfies R^{-1}=R^T, the transformation can be paired across weights and activations while preserving the original forward computation. Orthogonal-Kronecker Transformation, or OKT, optimizes a gradient-free objective that encourages weights to form symmetric bimodal clusters aligned with the {-1,+1} codebook. The orthogonal matrix is solved through an EM-style conditional minimization, and a Kronecker factorization represents the large transform using two smaller orthogonal matrices. This keeps the PTQ overhead small. The same transform also acts on activations and reduces the effect of outliers. Proximal SVD Projection, or PSP, adds a lightweight low-rank correction in the transformed coordinate space, using a proximal upper bound and truncated SVD to absorb remaining outliers. Compared with BiLLM and ARB-LLM, BWLA is not only weight-centric. Compared with BitNet a4.8, it avoids full quantization-aware training.
summary_en.experiments: The visible text establishes the main regime as W1AX, for example 1-bit weights with 6-bit activations. The baselines discussed include BiLLM and ARB-LLM for post-training binarization, and BitNet a4.8 as a QAT-based reference for 1-bit weights with 4-bit activations. The motivation study shows that existing binary-weight PTQ methods degrade sharply once activations are also quantized to low precision, which explains why many of them retain full-precision activations. The paper also cites LLaMA2-70B requiring more than 120 GB at FP16 as the deployment pressure point. The provided manuscript excerpt does not include the final numerical tables, perplexity values, task scores, or ablation numbers; the reported claim is that BWLA outperforms prior PTQ methods across multiple LLMs under pure post-training quantization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the distribution analysis in the introduction, especially the figures contrasting unimodal weights and heavy-tailed activations. Then read the OKT formulation, its EM-style update, and the Kronecker parameterization. Finally, check the PSP ablation if the full tables are available, since that determines whether the low-rank correction is essential or mostly a cleanup step. For pretraining work, the useful angle is whether low-bit-friendly training should explicitly encourage bimodal weights and suppress activation outliers before quantization.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和实验表；若 W1A6 在主流模型上不靠校准集过拟合成立，能改变对二值化只能省权重带宽的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the method and result tables; if W1A6 holds on mainstream models without calibration overfit, it weakens the prior that binarization only saves weight bandwidth.

paper.title: Make Your LVLM KV Cache More Lightweight
paper.abstract: Key-Value (KV) cache has become a de facto component of modern Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) for inference. While it enhances decoding efficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs), its direct adoption in LVLMs introduces substantial GPU memory overhead due to the large number of vision tokens processed during the prefill stage. To tackle this problem, we propose LightKV, a novel approach that reduces KV cache size by exploiting the redundancy among vision-token embeddings. Guided by text pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 LVLM 推理阶段一个很具体但很实际的问题：视觉 token 在 prefill 阶段数量过大，导致 KV cache 显存占用远高于纯文本 LLM，而现有 KV 压缩方法大多在生成阶段做 token 剪枝，或者只看视觉侧冗余，没有充分利用文本提示对“哪些视觉 token 重要”的指导。LightKV 的目标是在不重训模型的前提下，于 prefill 阶段直接压缩视觉 token 对应的 KV cache，同时尽量不损伤多模态理解性能。
summary.importance: 它不属于预训练方法，而是典型的 efficient 类工作。但对基座研究仍有两点启发。第一，LVLM 的系统瓶颈和 LLM 不同，prefill 阶段的视觉 token 爆炸是核心问题，说明统一多模态建模时 tokenization 设计会直接决定部署成本。第二，作者证明“文本提示引导的视觉压缩”优于纯视觉压缩，这说明跨模态注意力不仅是建模工具，也可以作为推理时的信息选择信号。对做视觉 tokenizer、长上下文多模态建模、训练时 token budget 设计的人，这个观察是有价值的。
summary.technical_approach: LightKV 是一个 training-free 的 prefill 压缩方法，核心思想是：不要把所有视觉 token 原样写入后续层的 KV cache，而是在 prefill 过程中先做一次受文本提示引导的聚合压缩。方法分三步。1）把视觉 token 看成图节点，节点间边权由 feature divergence 度量，用来判断哪些 token 信息相近、可以聚合。这里的目标不是简单删 token，而是把冗余 token 的信息合并到更有代表性的 token 上。2）为了避免两两计算 divergence 带来的高复杂度，作者按原始空间位置把视觉 token 划分为多个 sub-windows，在局部窗口内做压缩与消息聚合。这样复杂度更可控，也更符合视觉 patch 的局部相关性。3）最关键的是引入文本提示引导。作者不采用纯视觉独立压缩，而是利用运行时 cross-modal attention 分数，让文本 token 对视觉 token 的重要性评估参与更新过程。直觉上，用户问题决定了哪些图像区域值得保留，因此 prompt-aware 压缩比 vision-only 压缩更合理。论文还强调该方法可兼容 vision encoder-based 和 encoder-free 的 LVLM，不需要改模型参数，也不需要额外训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 8 个开源 LVLM 和 8 个 benchmark，模型包括 LLaVA-v1.5 7B/13B、LLaVA-NeXT 7B/13B、InternVL2-8B、EVE-7B-v1、EVE-7B-v1-HD、Qwen2.5-VL。作者报告的主结果是：视觉 token 的 KV memory 可减少 50%，同时整体性能基本保持，有些 benchmark 甚至超过原始模型；在相同 token 长度生成预算下，FLOPs 降低约 40%。从论文叙述看，prompt-aware 设计优于现有 vision-only 压缩基线，这是方法成立的关键证据。另一个重要点是它把压缩时机前移到 prefill，而不是等 KV 已经写满后再做裁剪，因此对显存峰值更直接有效。全文片段没有给出逐 benchmark 的具体分数和不同压缩率下的退化曲线，但从作者总结可确认：方法在多种架构上都有可迁移性，且不是依赖某一个模型的特例。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 里对问题的界定，尤其是为什么 LVLM 的 KV cache 问题比 LLM 更严重：异构 token 和超长视觉前缀。然后直接看方法部分的三步设计，重点不是图建模细节本身，而是为什么要用 prompt-aware cross-modal attention 来指导压缩。接着看主表，确认 50% KV 压缩和性能保持是否在不同模型上都成立；再看消融，比较 vision-only 与 prompt-guided 的差异，以及 sub-window 划分对效率和效果的影响。如果只想判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟足够；如果要复现，需额外关注它插入压缩的位置、对不同层是否统一处理、以及压缩后 KV 的重排方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical inference bottleneck in LVLMs: vision tokens dominate the prefill stage, so the KV cache consumes far more GPU memory than in text-only LLMs. Existing KV reduction methods mostly prune after prefill or rely on vision-only redundancy signals, which is suboptimal because the user prompt already tells the model which visual content matters. LightKV aims to compress the vision-side KV cache during prefill, without retraining, while preserving multimodal performance.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it still carries two useful lessons for foundation-model work. First, the systems bottleneck in LVLMs is structurally different from that in LLMs: the visual prefix explosion during prefill is often the dominant memory issue. That makes tokenization and token budget design a first-order modeling choice, not just a serving detail. Second, the paper shows that text-guided visual compression works better than vision-only compression, suggesting that cross-modal attention is not only a modeling mechanism but also a useful runtime signal for information selection. That matters for multimodal tokenizers, long-context multimodal modeling, and training-time allocation of visual tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach: LightKV is a training-free prefill-time compression method. The central idea is to avoid writing all vision tokens into the downstream KV cache as-is; instead, it aggregates and compresses them during prefill under prompt guidance. The method has three steps. (1) Vision tokens are treated as graph nodes, and edges are defined by a feature divergence metric that estimates redundancy. The goal is not naive token dropping, but information aggregation from redundant tokens into more representative ones. (2) To avoid the quadratic cost of pairwise divergence over many vision tokens, the method partitions tokens into spatial sub-windows and performs local compression and message passing inside them. This reduces complexity and matches the locality of visual patches. (3) The key design is prompt-aware guidance. Rather than compressing vision tokens independently, LightKV uses on-the-fly cross-modal attention scores between text tokens and vision tokens to decide which visual content should be preserved. This is a sensible choice because the prompt determines relevance. The method is designed to be plug-and-play across both vision-encoder-based and encoder-free LVLMs, with no parameter updates.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers eight open-source LVLMs and eight benchmarks, including LLaVA-v1.5 7B/13B, LLaVA-NeXT 7B/13B, InternVL2-8B, EVE-7B-v1, EVE-7B-v1-HD, and Qwen2.5-VL. The headline result is that LightKV reduces the KV memory of vision tokens by 50% while largely preserving performance, and in some cases even improving over the vanilla model. Under the same generation token budget, it also reduces FLOPs by about 40%. The most important empirical claim is that prompt-aware compression outperforms prior vision-only baselines, which is the main evidence that cross-modal guidance is doing real work. Another important point is that compression happens during prefill rather than after the cache is already populated, so it directly lowers peak memory. The excerpt does not provide enough table detail to restate benchmark-by-benchmark numbers or degradation curves at different compression ratios, but the paper clearly presents the method as architecture-agnostic rather than tuned to one specific LVLM.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the problem framing in the introduction, especially why KV cache is a more severe issue in LVLMs than in LLMs: heterogeneous tokens and very long visual prefixes. Then go straight to the three-step method and focus less on the graph formalism itself and more on why prompt-aware cross-modal attention is the right compression signal. After that, inspect the main results table to verify whether the 50% KV reduction holds consistently across model families, and then read the ablations comparing vision-only versus prompt-guided compression, as well as the effect of sub-window partitioning on efficiency and accuracy. If the goal is only to assess relevance, 30 minutes is enough. If the goal is reproduction, pay attention to where compression is inserted, whether all layers are treated the same way, and how the compressed KV entries are reordered or merged.

recommendation.zh: 只看压缩位置和消融表即可；prompt-aware token 压缩是合理工程线索，但不改变预训练侧判断。
recommendation.en: Read only the compression-placement and ablation tables; prompt-aware token compression is a useful serving clue, not a pretraining prior shift.

paper.title: LLM-Guided Runtime Parameter Optimization for Energy-Efficient Model Inference
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an integral part of many real-world workflows. However, LLMs consume a lot of energy, which becomes a large concern in the scale of the demand for these tools. As LLMs become integrated into different workflows, different applications have arisen to deal with the challenge of running inference for these tools. This raises another issue of choosing the runtime parameter values for these services in order to minimize the energy consumption. Oftentimes this

summary.core_problem: 为不同硬件和推理服务自动选择运行时参数，以降低 LLM 推理能耗。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理部署侧的工程流程改进。它关注能耗调参，而不是模型结构、训练目标或预训练数据；对基座研究的价值主要在于提醒 serving 参数会改变系统级成本曲线。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 human-in-the-loop 的 LLM 辅助调参流程：人类给出具体反馈和提示策略，让聊天模型迭代提出运行时参数配置，并根据能耗反馈继续搜索。方法更像用 LLM 替代部分手工经验和传统黑盒搜索，而不是新的优化算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称该流程能比传统搜索更快找到节能推理参数，并能适配不同硬件设置；未给出模型规模、硬件矩阵、能耗指标、baseline 搜索预算或提升幅度等细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Virginia Polytechnic and State University；未见与 LLM 预训练或主流 serving 系统相关的代表性背景信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to automatically tune runtime parameters for LLM inference services to reduce energy consumption across hardware setups.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering workflow contribution for inference deployment. It does not change model architecture, training objectives, or pretraining data, but it is a reminder that serving-time knobs can move the system-level cost curve.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a human-in-the-loop LLM-assisted tuning loop: human-written feedback prompts guide a chat model to iteratively suggest runtime parameter settings based on energy feedback. The method replaces part of manual expertise or black-box search with prompted LLM interaction rather than introducing a new optimizer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims faster discovery of energy-efficient inference parameters than traditional search and adaptation to different hardware setups. It does not report model sizes, hardware coverage, energy metrics, search budgets, or quantitative gains in the provided text.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Virginia Polytechnic and State University; no widely known LLM pretraining or serving-system track record is identifiable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看流程图和实验设置即可；把 LLM 当调参助手不新，若没有干净能耗基准，结论只能当部署侧弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim only the workflow and setup; using an LLM as a tuning assistant is not new, and without clean energy baselines the result is only a weak serving signal.

paper.title: When Hidden States Drift: Can KV Caches Rescue Long-Range Speculative Decoding?
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference, but SOTA hidden-state-based drafters suffer from long-range decay: draft accuracy degrades as the speculative step increases. Existing work attributes this decay to train-inference mismatch and proposes test-time training (TTT) as a remedy, yet we observe that long-range decay persists even in TTT-trained drafters. We revisit long-range decay from the perspective of context information preservation. In hidden-state reuse, we argue the target hidden

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解 hidden-state-based speculative decoding 在长 speculative step 下 draft accuracy 衰减的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的机制性工作，来自阿里 Qwen 应用团队。关键价值不只是加速，而是重新解释 long-range speculative decoding 的失败原因：问题可能不是单纯的 train-inference mismatch，而是 hidden state 本身作为上下文压缩表示会丢掉后续 draft step 需要的信息。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从上下文信息保留角度重审 speculative decoding。它认为复用 target hidden state 等价于使用一个带偏置的上下文压缩：该 hidden state 是按当前位置 query 聚合历史 token 得到的，适合当前位置 next-token prediction，但会压制对后续 speculative step 重要的信息。相比之下，target model 的 KV cache 保留 token-wise key/value 表示，是更显式的上下文载体。基于这一分析，论文转向利用 KV cache 来支撑长程 draft，而不是只依赖单个 hidden state。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明已有 hidden-state-based drafter 在 speculative step 增大时 draft accuracy 会下降，并且即使用 test-time training 训练过的 drafter，long-range decay 仍然存在。具体模型规模、数据集、吞吐提升、acceptance rate 或速度提升幅度未在提供的摘要中给出。
summary.authors_note: 论文来自 Alibaba Qwen Applications Business Group，并包含 University of Science and Technology of China、Zhejiang University 等机构作者；Qwen 团队在开源大模型、长上下文和推理系统方向有持续工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why hidden-state-based speculative decoding loses draft accuracy as the speculative horizon grows, and whether KV caches can mitigate that long-range decay.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper with a useful mechanistic angle from Alibaba's Qwen ecosystem. The main contribution is not just acceleration: it reframes long-range speculative failure as an information-preservation problem rather than merely a train-inference mismatch.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes hidden-state reuse as biased context compression. A target hidden state aggregates prior tokens according to the current-position query, making it suitable for immediate next-token prediction but potentially suppressing information needed by later speculative steps. In contrast, the target model's KV cache retains token-wise key/value representations and acts as a more explicit context store. The proposed direction is to use KV-cache information for longer-range drafting rather than relying only on a single hidden vector.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that hidden-state-based drafters suffer draft-accuracy decay as the speculative step increases, and that the decay persists even for drafters trained with test-time training. The supplied abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, acceptance-rate numbers, or end-to-end speedup figures.
summary_en.authors_note: The work involves Alibaba's Qwen Applications Business Group, along with authors from the University of Science and Technology of China and Zhejiang University. The Qwen ecosystem has substantial prior work on open LLMs, long context, and inference systems.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制分析部分；它把 speculative decay 从训练错配改写成上下文压缩问题，可能影响 drafter 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism section: it recasts speculative decay as context-compression failure, which can change how drafters are designed.

institutions: Qwen Applications Business Group of Alibaba
University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction via a Unified Information-Theoretic Objective
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is essential for large language model inference, yet its memory overhead poses a critical bottleneck for long-context generation. Existing eviction policies predominantly rely on empirical heuristics, lacking a rigorous theoretical foundation. This work rethinks KV cache eviction through the lens of the Information Bottleneck principle. Under a linear-Gaussian surrogate of attention, we derive a closed-form mutual information objective that characterizes the effective info

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理时 KV cache 线性增长带来显存瓶颈。现有 eviction 多是经验启发式（按注意力分数、按多样性等），缺少统一目标与可解释的“为什么这样删”。论文要解决的是：能否给 KV eviction 一个信息论目标，并据此导出低开销、效果稳定的删缓存策略。
summary.importance: 属于推理系统/效率方向而非预训练，但对基座研究仍有两点价值：1）把一堆看似不同的 eviction 规则统一到同一个互信息/容量最大化目标下，提供了更可解释的分析框架，便于做机制分析与设计新策略；2）若做长上下文 continual pretrain 或长序列评测，推理阶段的 cache 策略会显著影响可用上下文与有效信息保留，进而影响对“模型是否真的学会长程依赖”的判断。整体建议泛读，重点看其统一目标与 CapKV 的可实现近似。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是用 Information Bottleneck 视角重述 eviction：在一个线性-高斯的注意力替身模型下，把 KV cache 看成一组线性通信信道；在固定预算B下选择子集C，使“未来查询（latent future queries）与传输后的表示”之间的互信息最大，即最大化保留子集的有效信息容量。
- 建模：用线性高斯抽象把 attention 的聚合写成可分析的线性传输过程。作者强调这是 tractable abstraction，不是对真实 Transformer 的精确刻画。
- 统一解释：注意力模式驱动的删法（按历史 attention 低的 token 删）与结构/几何多样性驱动的删法，都可视为在近似同一个容量最大化目标，只是近似方式不同。
- CapKV：提出显式优化容量的 eviction。做法是构造简化的 capacity matrix，并用统计杠杆分数（statistical leverage scores）对 token 重要性打分，采用贪心选择保留高杠杆 token，作为对最优互信息目标的确定性近似。相比纯 attention-score 规则，CapKV 试图更直接刻画“这个 token 的表示子空间对未来查询有多大信息承载能力”。
summary.experiments: 作者在多种模型架构与长上下文基准上做了对比，结论是 CapKV 在“生成保真度 vs 显存节省”的 trade-off 上优于先前方法，并声称其容量指标与下游性能有较强相关性。由于你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格数字（压缩率、困惑度/准确率下降幅度、不同预算B下曲线等），这里无法可靠复述精确数值；精读时建议直接对照主结果表与不同 eviction ratio 的曲线，确认其优势是否在多个预算区间都稳定，以及开销（额外矩阵/分数计算）是否可接受。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看引言与 Figure 1：作者如何把不同 eviction 家族统一到“互信息/容量最大化”的黄色目标块，以及 CapKV 对应的紫色近似目标。
- 方法部分重点抓两件事：线性-高斯 surrogate 下互信息的闭式形式长什么样；CapKV 的 leverage score 从哪个矩阵来、计算复杂度如何、是否需要跨层/跨头聚合。
- 实验部分优先看：不同 cache budget/压缩率下的性能曲线、以及与 attention-score 类方法的对照。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可理解框架；若要落地实现，需要额外时间核对其工程细节与开销。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache grows linearly with context length and becomes the dominant memory bottleneck in long-context decoding. Existing eviction policies are largely heuristic (attention-score based or diversity/geometry based). The paper asks whether KV eviction can be formulated under a single information-theoretic objective and turned into a practical, low-overhead policy.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than pretraining. Still useful for foundation-model researchers because (1) it provides a unifying, interpretable objective—mutual-information / capacity maximization—that explains many seemingly different eviction heuristics; (2) for long-context evaluation or continual pretraining setups, eviction policies can confound conclusions about long-range capability by changing what information is effectively retained during decoding. Recommended as a skim focused on the objective and the CapKV approximation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key move is an Information Bottleneck framing under a linear-Gaussian surrogate of attention:
- Abstraction: treat attention as a linear transmission process and the KV cache entries as a set of linear communication channels.
- Objective: given a cache budget B, select a subset of channels that maximizes the mutual information between (latent) future queries and the transmitted representations—equivalently, maximize an information-capacity metric of the retained subset.
- Unification: attention-pattern eviction and structure/diversity-based eviction are interpreted as different approximations to the same global capacity objective.
- CapKV: a capacity-aware eviction rule that greedily keeps tokens with the highest statistical leverage scores computed from a simplified capacity matrix, yielding a deterministic approximation to the MI-maximization target rather than an empirical scoring heuristic.
summary_en.experiments: Reported experiments across multiple model architectures and long-context benchmarks show CapKV achieves a better fidelity–memory trade-off than prior methods, and the derived capacity metric correlates with downstream performance. The provided content snippet does not include the main tables/figures with exact numbers (e.g., retention ratios, perplexity/accuracy deltas, curves over budgets), so the precise margins cannot be quoted reliably here; the main results table and budget-sweep plots are the places to verify robustness and overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the intro and Figure 1 to see how the paper maps diverse eviction heuristics onto a single MI/capacity objective.
- In methodology, focus on (a) the closed-form MI/capacity expression under the linear-Gaussian surrogate, and (b) how CapKV’s leverage scores are derived and what the computational overhead is.
- In experiments, prioritize performance-vs-budget curves and comparisons against attention-score baselines.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for the conceptual framework; more if you intend to implement and need engineering details.

recommendation.zh: 只看推导和实验主表；若 log-det 代理在多模型上稳，这会改变 KV eviction 还停留在启发式调参的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and main tables; if the log-det proxy holds across models, it moves KV eviction beyond heuristic tuning.

paper.title: Rethinking Layer Redundancy in Large Language Models: Calibration Objectives and Search for Depth Pruning
paper.abstract: Depth pruning improves the inference efficiency of large language models by removing Transformer blocks. Prior work has focused on importance criteria and search algorithms, often treating layer redundancy as an inherent structural property of pretrained networks. In contrast, we adopt a \emph{functional perspective}, where redundancy is jointly influenced by the model and the evaluation objective, suggesting that a universal ranking may not be sufficient. Through an empirical study across three

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论深度剪枝中的一个基础假设：Transformer 层冗余是否是预训练模型自身的固定结构属性。作者给出的答案是否定的。层是否可删，取决于模型、校准数据和校准目标三者的组合。用语言建模 perplexity 找到的冗余层，未必适合保留下游推理能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型压缩研究的启发在于，它把“层重要性”从静态 ranking 问题改写为目标条件化的子集选择问题。这会影响模型发布前的压缩流程：如果压缩后的模型要服务推理、问答或工具调用，只用 C4 perplexity 做校准可能选错层。贡献不在新剪枝算法，而在清楚地分离了校准目标和搜索算法两个因素，并证明前者往往更关键。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把深度剪枝形式化为从 N 个 Transformer block 中选择 k 个删除层的组合优化问题。目标是最小化删除这些层后在校准集上的损失退化。这个形式化强调两点。第一，多层删除不是单层删除效果的简单相加，因为删除前面层会改变后续层看到的 hidden-state 分布，导致重构误差传播。第二，最优删除集合是 θ、loss、data 的函数，不是模型参数 θ 单独决定的属性。实验上，作者固定模型和数据，分别改变校准目标与搜索算法。校准目标包括 C4 上的 negative log-likelihood/perplexity，以及面向 commonsense reasoning 的 task likelihood margin。搜索算法共 7 种，用来观察在同一目标下是否会收敛到相似剪枝模式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个开源 LLM 家族、2 类校准目标和 7 种搜索算法。典型模型层数约为 32 到 40，剪枝预算 k 包括 7、9、11；对应组合空间约为 10^7 到 10^9，不能穷举。主要发现有三点。第一，perplexity 目标下，被删除层常集中在中后段的连续区域；task likelihood margin 下，删除层更分散，并且不同搜索算法之间差异更大。第二，perplexity 排名和下游 commonsense accuracy 排名经常不一致，Spearman 相关从 -0.78 到接近 0，多数设置为负相关。第三，在固定校准目标后，不同搜索算法的结果相对接近，平均 accuracy 差异约 1 到 3 个百分点。这说明在该实验范围内，校准目标比具体搜索算法更影响剪枝结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看第 2 节的 subset selection 形式化，它解释了为什么 top-k 单层重要性排序不可靠。然后看实验中的 pruning pattern 图，比较 perplexity 和 task likelihood margin 下的删层分布。最后看 perplexity rank 与 downstream accuracy rank 的相关性结果，这是全文最有信息量的证据。无需细读 7 个搜索算法的实现细节，除非正在做剪枝系统或压缩评测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether redundant Transformer layers are an intrinsic property of a pretrained LLM. Its answer is no. A layer can look redundant under language-modeling perplexity while still being useful for downstream reasoning. Redundancy should therefore be treated as conditional on the model, calibration data, and evaluation objective.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological rather than algorithmic. It warns against using a universal layer-importance ranking for depth pruning. For compressed LLM releases, especially models expected to retain reasoning or task accuracy, C4 perplexity alone may be a poor calibration objective. The paper makes a useful distinction between the search procedure and the calibration loss, and shows that the latter can dominate the pruning outcome.
summary_en.technical_approach: Depth pruning is formulated as subset selection over Transformer blocks. Given N layers and a pruning budget k, the goal is to remove a subset that minimizes loss degradation on a calibration set. This framing matters because multi-layer removal is non-additive: deleting one layer changes the hidden-state distribution consumed by all later layers, so single-layer scores do not reliably predict the effect of deleting a set of layers. The authors then vary two axes independently: the calibration objective and the search algorithm. The objectives are language-modeling negative log-likelihood/perplexity on C4 and a task likelihood margin for commonsense reasoning. Seven search algorithms are compared under the same objectives to test whether algorithm choice or objective choice explains pruning behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans three open LLM families, two calibration objectives, and seven search algorithms. The models have roughly 32 to 40 layers, with pruning budgets such as 7, 9, and 11 layers; the resulting search spaces range from about 10^7 to 10^9 candidates. Three empirical patterns stand out. Under perplexity, removed layers tend to form contiguous mid-to-late blocks. Under task likelihood margin, removals are more distributed and more algorithm-dependent. Perplexity rankings and downstream accuracy rankings are often misaligned, with Spearman correlations ranging from -0.78 to near zero and mostly negative. Within a fixed objective, different search algorithms usually produce similar performance, with average accuracy gaps around 1 to 3 percentage points.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. The subset-selection formulation is the key section because it explains why independent layer ranking is a fragile assumption. The pruning-pattern figures are the fastest way to see the objective dependence. The rank-correlation analysis between perplexity and downstream accuracy is the main result to inspect carefully. The individual search algorithms can be read lightly unless depth-pruning implementation is the target.

recommendation.zh: 推翻层冗余是模型固有属性的认知，做剪枝实验时优先对齐评估目标而非选择复杂搜索算法
recommendation.en: Overturns the perception that layer redundancy is an inherent model property, prioritize aligning evaluation objectives over selecting complex search algorithms when doing pruning experiments

paper.title: Salca: A Sparsity-Aware Hardware Accelerator for Efficient Long-Context Attention Decoding
paper.abstract: Long contexts improve capabilities of large language models but pose serious hardware challenges: compute and memory footprints grow linearly with sequence length. Particularly, the decoding phase continuously accesses massive KV cache, dramatically increasing bandwidth and computing pressure. Existing accelerators are primarily designed and evaluated for short contexts. They suffer from significant performance degradation when processing long contexts. To bridge this gap, we identify the major

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文解码阶段 attention 对 KV cache 带宽和计算的压力，尤其是现有加速器在长序列下性能明显退化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是硬件-软件协同的推理效率工作，对做基座预训练的人不是核心主线，但对理解长上下文 serving 的真实瓶颈、以及稀疏注意力在系统侧能否落地有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成：软件侧提出 dual-compression dynamic sparse attention，把超低比特量化与特征稀疏结合，降低预测和访存开销；同时设计硬件友好的近似 Top-K，把筛选复杂度从 O(n log k) 降到 O(n)。硬件侧则围绕整数计算、稀疏访存和长 KV 访问路径做专门优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出芯片面积、工艺节点、吞吐/延迟/能效的具体数字，也没有说明与哪些 GPU/ASIC baseline 对比。当前能确认的是它面向 long-context decoding，而不是训练；是否对真实 LLM workload 有代表性，需要看 evaluation setup 是否覆盖不同 head 数、cache 长度和 batch 形态。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学工作。更偏体系结构与硬件加速方向，不属于 LLM 预训练方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the bandwidth and compute bottleneck of attention decoding under long contexts, where KV-cache access dominates and existing accelerators degrade sharply with sequence length.
summary_en.importance: This is a hardware-software co-design paper for inference efficiency. It is not central to pretraining research, but it is still useful for understanding real long-context serving bottlenecks and whether sparse attention ideas survive contact with systems constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two parts. On the software side, it proposes dual-compression dynamic sparse attention, combining ultra-low-precision quantization with feature sparsity to reduce prediction and memory overhead. It also introduces a hardware-friendly approximate Top-K that reduces filtering complexity from O(n log k) to O(n). On the hardware side, it optimizes integer compute, sparse memory access, and long-KV data movement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report process node, area, throughput, latency, or energy numbers, nor the exact GPU/ASIC baselines. What is clear is that the target is long-context decoding rather than training. Whether the evaluation reflects realistic LLM workloads depends on coverage over head counts, cache lengths, and batch shapes.
summary_en.authors_note: This is from Fudan University and is primarily a computer architecture / accelerator paper rather than an LLM pretraining methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，知道“长上下文瓶颈主要卡在 KV 访存而非算子 FLOPs”就够了；除非你在做软硬协同，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Not central to pretraining; the main takeaway is that long-context decoding is bottlenecked more by KV movement than raw FLOPs, so skip the full paper unless you care about HW-SW co-design.

paper.title: MTRouter: Cost-Aware Multi-Turn LLM Routing with History-Model Joint Embeddings
paper.abstract: Multi-turn, long-horizon tasks are increasingly common for large language models (LLMs), but solving them typically requires many sequential model invocations, accumulating substantial inference costs. Here, we study cost-aware multi-turn LLM routing: selecting which model to invoke at each turn from a model pool, given a fixed cost budget. We propose MTRouter, which encodes the interaction history and candidate models into joint history-model embeddings, and learns an outcome estimator from log

summary.core_problem: 多轮长轨迹任务里，单次调用模型的质量不再是主要成本项，真正的瓶颈是“几十次调用叠加的总 token 成本”。论文要解决的是：在给定每回合预算约束下，如何在每一轮动态选择不同能力/价格的模型，使最终任务成功率最大化；并且在离线日志数据上学习这种路由策略，避免昂贵的在线探索。
summary.importance:
更偏推理/系统侧，但对预训练研究仍有两点间接价值：
- 评测与数据收集会被路由策略改变。多模型混用会改变失败模式与轨迹分布，进而影响用这些轨迹做 continual pretrain / agent 数据回灌时的数据配比与噪声结构。
- 方法上把“模型身份”显式参数化为 embedding（含元数据与残差向量），提供了一种把异构模型当作可学习条件变量的思路，未来可类比到 pretrain 里的 mixture-of-experts/mixture-of-models 或 teacher 选择。
但它不是预训练目标/优化的直接贡献，属于 skim 级别更合适。
summary.technical_approach:
MTRouter 的核心是一个离线 outcome estimator：输入是(当前历史 h_t, 候选模型 a)的联合表示，输出是“如果这一轮用该模型，最终 episode 的终止得分/成功率会怎样”的预测。
- 历史表示：把任务块 + 累积对话/观察序列化，用冻结的文本 encoder ϕ 编成向量 z_x。上下文不固定保留 K 轮，而是用 8192 token 的预算截断：永远保留任务块，优先保留最近交互，丢弃最旧内容。
- 模型表示：每个候选模型 a 用 ψ(a) 得到 z_a，由两部分组成：结构化属性 attr_a（上下文长度、知识截止日期、价格等）+ 可学习残差 e_a（吸收元数据解释不了的行为差异），并对残差做正则以防过拟合。
- 联合表示：将 z_x 与 z_a 组合成 joint embedding，喂给回归/分类式的 outcome 预测头。
- 训练信号：从 logged trajectories 学习。论文强调用 error-aware adjustment 来稳定离线训练信号（全文细节应在方法段落：通常是处理 off-policy 偏差、把中间噪声与终局回报对齐的问题）。
- 推理时路由：每一轮对候选池逐个打分，选预测终局 outcome 最高的模型；同时受 per-episode 成本预算 B 与最大轮数 T_max 约束。
与常见 episode-level routing 的区别是：它不在开局一次性选定模型，而是显式建模“历史×模型”的交互，并用终局 outcome 监督来学习哪些回合值得用贵模型。
summary.experiments:
任务与指标：ScienceWorld 与 Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE)，包含 test 与 OOD（语义分布偏移）设置；比较 performance–cost trade-off。
主要结果（摘要与引言给出的数字）：
- ScienceWorld (test)：MTRouter 平均分 53.8，对比 GPT-5 的 48.4；同时总成本降低 58.7%。
- HLE (test)：在准确率“有竞争力”的前提下，总成本降低 43.4%（文中未在给定片段里给出具体准确率数值）。
- 行为分析：不是“更多切换=更好”。作者声称相较 Router-R1，MTRouter 用更少的模型切换达到成功；对短暂错误更鲁棒；并出现按工具/动作的模型专门化（对应 Figures 3–6）。
实现细节里一个关键工程点是 8192 token 的历史截断策略，它会影响长轨迹任务的路由可学习性与泛化。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看问题设定与约束：预算 B、回合上限、成本如何按 token 与定价计算。
- 重点看方法里两类 embedding：history encoder 是否冻结、模型 embedding 如何由元数据+残差组成，以及残差正则怎么做。
- 再看主结果表（ScienceWorld/HLE 的 cost–performance 曲线或表格）和 OOD 结果，确认收益是否来自少量关键回合。
- 最后快速扫 Figures 3–6 的路由行为分析：切换次数分布、按工具/动作的模型使用热力图。
如果只关心预训练启发：把它当作“异构 teacher/模型池的条件化建模”案例即可，不必深挖环境细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon, multi-turn agent tasks, total inference cost is dominated by many sequential model calls and growing context. The paper studies budgeted turn-level routing: at each turn, choose a model from a pool (with different price/quality) to maximize final episode outcome under a per-episode cost budget, learned primarily from offline logged trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to inference/agent systems than pretraining, but it has two indirect implications for foundation-model research: (1) routing changes the trajectory distribution and failure modes, which matters if those trajectories are later recycled for continual pretraining or data curation; (2) the paper treats “model identity” as a learnable condition via embeddings (metadata + residual), a pattern that can transfer to mixture-style training or teacher selection. It does not introduce a new pretraining objective or scaling result, so it remains a skim-level read for pretrain-focused work.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MTRouter learns an offline outcome estimator over joint (history, model) representations.
- History embedding: serialize task block + interaction context; encode with a frozen text encoder ϕ into z_x. Context is truncated by a token budget (8192): always keep the task block and the most recent turns.
- Model embedding: represent each candidate model a with ψ(a), combining structured attributes (context limit, knowledge cutoff, pricing, etc.) and a learnable residual vector e_a to capture behavior not explained by metadata; residual is regularized to reduce overfitting.
- Joint embedding: combine z_x and z_a into a joint feature fed to a predictor of terminal episode outcome (score/accuracy).
- Training: supervised from logged trajectories, with an “error-aware adjustment” to stabilize learning from offline data (intended to mitigate noisy credit assignment from turn choice to terminal outcome).
- Inference: at each turn, score candidates and pick the model with the highest predicted terminal outcome, subject to a per-episode cost budget B and turn limit.
Key distinction vs episode-level routing: decisions are adaptive per turn and explicitly model history×model interactions with terminal-outcome supervision.
summary_en.experiments:
Benchmarks: ScienceWorld and Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE), with test and semantic OOD settings; evaluated on performance–cost trade-offs.
Reported headline numbers:
- ScienceWorld (test): improves average score from 48.4 (GPT-5 baseline) to 53.8 while reducing total cost by 58.7%.
- HLE (test): achieves competitive accuracy while reducing total cost by 43.4% (exact accuracy not shown in the provided excerpt).
Behavioral analyses claim: fewer unnecessary switches than Router-R1, better recovery from transient errors, and emergent specialization by tools/actions (referenced as Figures 3–6). A notable implementation detail is the 8192-token truncation policy, which can materially affect long-horizon routing performance.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the formal setup: budget constraint, how cost is computed from tokens and pricing, and termination conditions.
- Focus on representation design: frozen history encoder, model embedding as metadata + residual, and how residual regularization is done.
- Check the main cost–performance results on ScienceWorld/HLE and the OOD table to see whether gains persist under shift.
- Skim the routing-behavior figures (switch counts, per-tool/action usage) to understand where savings come from.
For pretraining relevance, treat it mainly as an example of conditioning on heterogeneous model identities rather than an algorithm to port directly.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由器训练数据和 cost accounting；若账算得干净，它可直接影响评测、合成数据和 agent rollout 的预算设计。
recommendation.en: Read the router data setup and cost accounting; if those are clean, the method matters for eval, synthetic-data, and agent-rollout budgets.

paper.title: HeadRouter: Dynamic Head-Weight Routing for Task-Adaptive Audio Token Pruning in Large Audio Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent large audio language models (LALMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in processing extended multi-modal sequences, yet incur high inference costs. Token compression is an effective method that directly reduces redundant tokens in the sequence. Existing compression methods usually assume that all attention heads in LALMs contribute equally to various audio tasks and calculate token importance by averaging scores across all heads. However, our analysis demonstrates that attention heads e

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是大音频语言模型推理阶段的音频 token 压缩问题。已有方法常把所有注意力头一视同仁，用跨头平均的注意力分数做 token 重要性估计；作者指出这在音频场景里不成立，因为不同头对语义类任务和声学类任务的响应差异很大，而且真正对音频有贡献的头是稀疏的。结果是，统一的剪枝规则会在某些任务上错删关键信息，尤其在长音频和高压缩率下更明显。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限，因为它不改预训练目标、数据或架构，而是推理时的训练免调优压缩方法。但它有两个启发点值得记住。第一，注意力头在跨模态模型里并不是均匀可替换的，头的功能分化可以作为动态路由信号，而不只是解释性现象。第二，音频 token 压缩不能照搬文本或视觉里的位置启发式，必须考虑语音/非语音结构、语义任务与声学任务的差异。对做语音 LM、统一多模态 LM、长上下文推理优化的人，这个观察有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 HeadRouter，核心是“先判断当前输入更像语义任务还是声学任务，再按这个判断去重配各注意力头的权重”，最后用重加权后的注意力分数做 token 剪枝。具体分三步。第一步，作者对每个注意力头计算基于熵的 selectivity score，用来衡量该头对音频 token 的注意力是否集中；注意力越集中，说明该头更有选择性。第二步，把所有头的 selectivity 的标准差作为一个紧凑路由信号：标准差低时，输入更接近语义型；标准差高时，更接近声学型。这个设计对应作者的经验观察：语义任务上的头权重分布更平缓，声学任务上更尖锐、更异质。第三步，不是硬切换到某一种头配置，而是在三组预先标定的 head-weight profile——semantic、uniform、acoustic——之间做 Gaussian soft mixing，得到样本级连续权重，再据此汇总头级注意力，给每个音频 token 打分并剪枝。作者还强调使用 no-RoPE 的选择性统计来减轻位置偏置，因为一些已有方法会偏向保留尾部 token。和 FastV、Frame 这类方法相比，区别不在于更复杂的打分器，而在于把“任务异质性”和“头行为异质性”显式纳入压缩策略，而且整个过程不需要额外训练。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 AudioMarathon 和 MMAU-Pro 两个综合音频评测上做，覆盖语义理解与声学分析。论文给出的最醒目结果是：在移除 30% 音频 token 时，HeadRouter 不但没有掉点，反而超过未剪枝基线；在 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 上 AudioMarathon 平均分提升 1.2 分，在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上提升 2.1 分。作者把它与固定 head profile、均匀跨头平均、位置/时间采样、已有 attention-based pruning 方法做比较，在更激进的剪枝率下仍更稳。消融的关键信息有三类：一是语义/声学两端的 head profile 确实不同，固定单一 profile 会在另一类任务上明显吃亏；二是 soft mixing 比硬路由更稳，说明任务边界不是离散的；三是 no-RoPE selectivity 与音频结构更一致，能减少“保尾弃前”的位置偏置。论文还展示了 oracle 剪枝模式，说明有效保留往往集中在 voiced segments，而不是均匀时间采样。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三部分。先看引言里的 Figure 1、2、3，理解作者为什么认为音频任务异质性会让统一剪枝失效。再看分析部分关于 head-behavior heterogeneity 的图，尤其语义任务和声学任务的头分布差异，这决定了方法是否站得住。最后看方法图和主结果表，确认 routing signal、三种 profile、soft mixing 分别带来什么收益。预计 20 到 30 分钟能抓住主要内容。如果只想判断是否值得复现，优先看 30% 以上剪枝率下与 unpruned baseline 和强基线的对比，以及消融里 soft vs hard routing、with vs without no-RoPE 的差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies inference-time audio token pruning for large audio-language models. Existing attention-based pruning methods typically average attention scores across all heads, implicitly assuming that heads contribute equally to all audio tasks. The authors show this assumption breaks in audio: only a sparse subset of heads is strongly audio-responsive, and the useful heads differ substantially between semantic tasks and acoustic tasks. As a result, a single global pruning rule tends to remove task-critical information, especially under long-context and aggressive compression settings.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, since it does not modify the training objective, data mixture, or model architecture. Its value is more indirect. First, it provides a concrete example that head specialization in multimodal models is operationally useful, not just an interpretability artifact. Second, it argues that audio compression should be structure-aware: voiced vs. silent regions, semantic vs. acoustic objectives, and modality-specific attention behavior matter more than generic positional heuristics. That is relevant for researchers working on speech/audio LMs, unified multimodal LMs, and long-context efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: HeadRouter is a training-free, per-sample routing method that first infers whether an input behaves more like a semantic task or an acoustic task, then reweights attention heads accordingly before scoring tokens for pruning. The method has three main steps. First, for each attention head, it computes an entropy-based selectivity score measuring how concentrated the head’s attention is over audio tokens; sharper attention implies stronger selectivity. Second, it uses the standard deviation of these selectivity scores across heads as a compact routing signal. Low variance indicates a more semantic-like regime, while high variance indicates a more acoustic-like regime, matching the authors’ empirical observation that acoustic tasks induce more heterogeneous head behavior. Third, instead of hard-switching between discrete modes, it performs Gaussian soft mixing over three pre-calibrated head-weight profiles—semantic, uniform, and acoustic—to obtain a continuous sample-specific head weighting. These weights are then used to aggregate head-level attention into token importance scores for pruning. A notable implementation detail is the use of no-RoPE selectivity statistics to reduce positional bias; prior methods tend to over-retain tail tokens. Relative to methods such as FastV or temporal subsampling, the main difference is not a more complex scorer but an explicit use of task heterogeneity and head heterogeneity, without any additional training.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on AudioMarathon and MMAU-Pro, covering both semantic understanding and acoustic analysis. The headline result is that HeadRouter can outperform the unpruned baseline while removing 30% of audio tokens: on AudioMarathon, it improves the average score by +1.2 points for Qwen2.5-Omni-3B and +2.1 points for Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. The paper compares against fixed head profiles, uniform cross-head averaging, temporal/positional subsampling, and prior attention-based pruning baselines, and reports more stable behavior under higher pruning ratios. The most useful ablations are: (1) semantic and acoustic head profiles are genuinely different, and a single fixed profile hurts one side or the other; (2) soft profile mixing is more robust than hard routing, suggesting task regimes are not cleanly discrete; and (3) no-RoPE selectivity better matches audio structure and reduces the tail-retention bias seen in prior methods. The oracle pruning visualizations also support the claim that effective retention aligns with voiced segments rather than uniform temporal sampling.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction figures that motivate task heterogeneity and show why one-size-fits-all pruning fails. Then read the analysis section on head-behavior heterogeneity, especially the contrast between semantic and acoustic tasks; that is the empirical foundation of the method. Finally, inspect the method diagram and the main result tables to see how much each component matters: routing signal, profile design, and soft mixing. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If deciding whether to reproduce it, focus on comparisons at 30%+ pruning, and on the ablations for soft vs. hard routing and with vs. without no-RoPE statistics.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了音频 LM 中 attention head 的任务特异性稀疏激活模式，提出的 training-free token pruning 方法对多模态长上下文推理优化有启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals task-specific sparse activation patterns of attention heads in audio LMs; the proposed training-free token pruning method is inspiring for multimodal long-context inference optimization.

paper.abstract: Long-context ability, has become one of the most important iteration direction of next-generation Large Language Models, particularly in semantic understanding/reasoning, code agentic intelligence and recommendation system. However, the standard softmax attention exhibits quadratic time complexity with respect to sequence length. As the sequence length increases, this incurs substantial overhead in long-context settings, leading the training and inference costs of extremely long sequences deteri

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是长上下文 Transformer 的 KV cache 和注意力计算开销问题，目标是在保留远程依赖可见性的同时，把远距离历史压缩到更少的 summary token 中。
summary.importance: 这篇更适合泛读。它不是预训练目标层面的新范式，而是长上下文架构和推理效率方向的工程型方案。对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“序列级 KV 压缩”作为介于全量 KV 保留和线性/滑窗注意力之间的路线：不追求固定大小状态，也不完全丢弃远距上下文，而是用可学习 summary token 以 O(n/k) 的形式保留历史摘要。这类设计会影响长上下文预训练的数据组织、位置编码、mask 设计和后续 RL/agent 轨迹训练的稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: Kwai Summary Attention, 简称 KSA，将输入序列切成固定大小 chunk，并在每个 chunk 边界插入一个可学习 summary token。summary token 的职责是汇总当前 chunk，因此它只看同一 chunk 内的文本 token。后续文本 token 则同时看局部邻近文本和此前 chunk 的 summary token。这样，近处信息仍通过局部文本注意力保留细节，远处信息通过 summary token 提供压缩后的全局记忆。与 GQA、MLA 这类按 head 或低秩投影压缩每个 token 的 KV 不同，KSA 压缩的是序列长度维度；与滑窗注意力不同，它没有完全切断窗口外信息；与线性注意力不同，它不是把所有历史压成固定状态，而是按 chunk 保留一串显式摘要。图中还给出 hybrid-KSA 的设计：KSA block 与 full attention block 交错使用，例如 3 个 KSA block 配 1 个 full attention block，用来平衡表达能力和效率。
summary.experiments: 提供内容显示作者做了从零训练和持续预训练两类实验，并在多个下游 benchmark 上比较 KSA 及其架构变体，同时提供训练 recipe 和计算 kernel。由于给出的全文片段未包含具体结果表格，不能确认准确提升幅度、模型规模和长上下文 benchmark 分数。可确认的实验关注点包括：KSA 相比 full attention 的 KV cache 与计算节省；相比 sliding-window 或 linear attention 的长程依赖保留；chunk size、summary token 位置、KSA/full attention 混合比例等消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Figure 2，理解 summary token 的插入方式和 mask 规则，这是整篇的核心。然后看 methodology 中对三条路线的比较：GQA/MLA 的每 token KV 压缩、SWA/linear 的固定或局部状态、KSA 的序列级压缩。实验部分优先查找长上下文检索、困惑度或语言建模 loss、KV cache 占用、decode latency，以及 hybrid 比例消融。若只关心预训练架构选择，重点看从零训练和 CPT 是否稳定，以及 KSA 是否需要特殊 curriculum 或位置编码调整。
summary.authors_note: 快手/Kwai，Kuaishou-OneRec 开源仓库；作者名单未在提供内容中出现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the KV-cache and attention-compute cost of long-context Transformers. The goal is to preserve access to distant dependencies while compressing long-range history into a smaller set of summary tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is a skim-level paper for pretraining researchers. It is not a new language modeling objective, but an efficient long-context architecture. The useful idea is sequence-level KV compression as a middle path between full attention and fixed-state or local attention. Instead of keeping every past token or discarding everything outside a window, KSA keeps an explicit compressed history at O(n/k) granularity. This design can affect long-context pretraining recipes, masking, positional encoding, and the stability of later RL or agent-trajectory training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Kwai Summary Attention splits the sequence into chunks and inserts a learnable summary token at each chunk boundary. A summary token summarizes its own chunk and only attends to text tokens within that chunk. Later text tokens attend to local neighboring text tokens and to summary tokens from previous chunks. Nearby context is therefore represented with token-level detail, while distant context is represented through explicit learned summaries. This differs from GQA and MLA, which compress KV per token through head sharing or low-rank projections. It also differs from sliding-window attention, which drops out-of-window context, and from linear attention, which compresses the whole past into a fixed-size state. The report also proposes a hybrid design that interleaves KSA blocks with full-attention blocks; the figure suggests a 3-to-1 KSA/full-attention pattern as one operating point.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text states that the authors run both from-scratch training and continual pretraining, evaluate on a range of downstream benchmarks, and perform ablations over architectural variants. They also release training recipes and a computation kernel. The available excerpt does not include the numerical tables, so exact model sizes, benchmark scores, latency reductions, and KV-cache savings cannot be verified here. The key experimental axes to inspect are KSA versus full attention in memory and latency, KSA versus sliding-window or linear attention in long-range dependency retention, and ablations over chunk size, summary-token placement, and the KSA/full-attention mixing ratio.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figure 2 to understand token insertion and the attention masks; that is the core mechanism. Then read the methodology comparison among per-token KV compression, local or fixed-state attention, and KSA-style sequence-level compression. In the experiments, look for long-context retrieval results, language modeling loss or perplexity, KV-cache footprint, decoding latency, and hybrid-ratio ablations. For pretraining architecture decisions, the most relevant evidence is whether KSA remains stable in from-scratch training and CPT, and whether it requires special curriculum or positional-encoding changes.
summary_en.authors_note: Kwai/Kuaishou, with a Kuaishou-OneRec open-source repository; the author list is not present in the provided text.
